text: 活动开始前，请把手机关机。
pinyin: huó dòng kāi shǐ qián , qǐng bǎ shǒu jī guān jī .
meaning: Please switch your phone off before the activity starts.

text: 开机
pinyin: kāi jī
meaning: to switch a device on

text: 出来以后再开机，看新消息。
pinyin: chū lái yǐ hòu zài kāi jī , kàn xīn xiāo xī .
meaning: Switch it on again after coming out and check new messages.

text: 随时
pinyin: suí shí
meaning: at any time

text: 有问题随时发消息，回复可能要等。
pinyin: yǒu wèn tí suí shí fā xiāo xī , huí fù kě néng yào děng .
meaning: Message at any time if there is a problem; a reply may take time.

text: 通
pinyin: tōng
meaning: to connect; get through

text: 电话还没通，我先发短信。
pinyin: diàn huà hái méi tōng , wǒ xiān fā duǎn xìn .
meaning: The call has not connected; I will send a text first.

text: 通过
pinyin: tōng guò
meaning: to pass through

text: 从入口通过，别走出口。
pinyin: cóng rù kǒu tōng guò , bié zǒu chū kǒu .
meaning: Go through the entrance, not the exit.

text: 进入
pinyin: jìn rù
meaning: to enter

text: 确认入口后，我们进入图书馆。
pinyin: què rèn rù kǒu hòu , wǒ men jìn rù tú shū guǎn .
meaning: After checking the entrance, we enter the library.

text: 走进
pinyin: zǒu jìn
meaning: to walk into

text: 我走进门，先看通知。
pinyin: wǒ zǒu jìn mén , xiān kàn tōng zhī .
meaning: I walk through the door and check the notice first.

text: 走开
pinyin: zǒu kāi
meaning: to walk away

text: 先别走开，我去问工作人员。
pinyin: xiān bié zǒu kāi , wǒ qù wèn gōng zuò rén yuán .
meaning: Do not walk away yet; I will ask a staff member.

text: 走过
pinyin: zǒu guò
meaning: to walk past

text: 我刚走过书店，没有进去。
pinyin: wǒ gāng zǒu guò shū diàn , méi yǒu jìn qù .
meaning: I just walked past the bookshop without going in.

text: 出口
pinyin: chū kǒu
meaning: exit

text: 出口在右边。
pinyin: chū kǒu zài yòu biān .
meaning: The exit is on the right.

text: 入口
pinyin: rù kǒu
meaning: entrance

text: 新的入口在东边。
pinyin: xīn de rù kǒu zài dōng biān .
meaning: The new entrance is on the east side.

text: 找出
pinyin: zhǎo chū
meaning: to find out; locate

text: 先找出最新的一条消息。
pinyin: xiān zhǎo chū zuì xīn de yī tiáo xiāo xī .
meaning: Find the newest message first.

text: 拿出
pinyin: ná chū
meaning: to take out

text: 进入以后拿出要还的书。
pinyin: jìn rù yǐ hòu ná chū yào huán de shū .
meaning: Take out the books to return after entering.

text: 我们经常见面，今天重新确认地址。
pinyin: wǒ men jīng cháng jiàn miàn , jīn tiān chóng xīn què rèn dì zhǐ .
meaning: We meet often; today we are confirming the address anew.

text: 到了，发消息，等朋友。
pinyin: dào le , fā xiāo xī , děng péng you .
meaning: Arrive, message, wait for the friend.

text: 我一到北门，就给你发消息。
pinyin: wǒ yī dào běi mén , jiù gěi nǐ fā xiāo xī .
meaning: I will message you as soon as I reach the north gate.

text: 我重新发了地址，先看最新的消息。
pinyin: wǒ chóng xīn fā le dì zhǐ , xiān kàn zuì xīn de xiāo xī .
meaning: I sent the address again; check the latest message first.

text: 我一到东边，就给你发消息。
pinyin: wǒ yī dào dōng biān , jiù gěi nǐ fā xiāo xī .
meaning: I will message as soon as I reach the east side.

text: 正是
pinyin: zhèng shì
meaning: exactly; precisely is

text: 这正是我想问的问题。
pinyin: zhè zhèng shì wǒ xiǎng wèn de wèn tí .
meaning: This is exactly the question I wanted to ask.

text: 正确
pinyin: zhèng què
meaning: correct

text: 这条地址是正确的，日期还要核对。
pinyin: zhè tiáo dì zhǐ shì zhèng què de , rì qī hái yào hé duì .
meaning: This address is correct; the date still needs checking.

text: 准确
pinyin: zhǔn què
meaning: accurate

text: 请说准确的时间，不要只说晚上。
pinyin: qǐng shuō zhǔn què de shí jiān , bú yào zhǐ shuō wǎn shang .
meaning: Please give the precise time, not just evening.

text: 真正
pinyin: zhēn zhèng
meaning: truly; genuinely

text: 我真正想确认的是入口。
pinyin: wǒ zhēn zhèng xiǎng què rèn de shì rù kǒu .
meaning: What I truly want to confirm is the entrance.

text: 直接
pinyin: zhí jiē
meaning: directly

text: 我直接问负责人，不猜他的意思。
pinyin: wǒ zhí jiē wèn fù zé rén , bù cāi tā de yì si .
meaning: I ask the person in charge directly rather than guessing what he means.

text: 意思
pinyin: yì si
meaning: meaning; intention

text: 我的意思是先确认，不是先进去。
pinyin: wǒ de yì si shì xiān què rèn , bù shì xiān jìn qù .
meaning: I mean to confirm first, not to go in first.

text: 重点
pinyin: zhòng diǎn
meaning: main point

text: 重点是今天的地址，不是旧图片。
pinyin: zhòng diǎn shì jīn tiān de dì zhǐ , bù shì jiù tú piàn .
meaning: The main point is today’s address, not the old image.

text: 主要
pinyin: zhǔ yào
meaning: main; principal

text: 主要问题是时间还没有确认。
pinyin: zhǔ yào wèn tí shì shí jiān hái méi yǒu què rèn .
meaning: The main problem is that the time is unconfirmed.

text: 观点
pinyin: guān diǎn
meaning: viewpoint

text: 我们观点不同，也可以慢慢讨论。
pinyin: wǒ men guān diǎn bù tóng , yě kě yǐ màn màn tǎo lùn .
meaning: We have different views but can still discuss them calmly.

text: 角度
pinyin: jiǎo dù
meaning: angle; perspective

text: 从客人的角度看，通知要清楚。
pinyin: cóng kè rén de jiǎo dù kàn , tōng zhī yào qīng chǔ .
meaning: From a guest’s perspective, the notice needs to be clear.

text: 方面
pinyin: fāng miàn
meaning: aspect

text: 时间方面还有一个问题。
pinyin: shí jiān fāng miàn hái yǒu yī gè wèn tí .
meaning: There is another issue concerning time.

text: 提
pinyin: tí
meaning: to raise; bring up

text: 有问题可以提，不用等到最后。
pinyin: yǒu wèn tí kě yǐ tí , bù yòng děng dào zuì hòu .
meaning: You can raise a problem without waiting until the end.

text: 提出
pinyin: tí chū
meaning: to put forward

text: 朋友提出先问入口的意见。
pinyin: péng you tí chū xiān wèn rù kǒu de yì jiàn .
meaning: My friend suggests asking about the entrance first.

text: 提到
pinyin: tí dào
meaning: to mention

text: 他提到北门，但没说从那里进。
pinyin: tā tí dào běi mén , dàn méi shuō cóng nà lǐ jìn .
meaning: He mentioned the north gate but did not say to enter there.

text: 讨论
pinyin: tǎo lùn
meaning: to discuss

text: 我们先讨论时间，再写通知。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān tǎo lùn shí jiān , zài xiě tōng zhī .
meaning: We will discuss the time first, then write the notice.

text: 问题
pinyin: wèn tí
meaning: question; problem

text: 这个问题是问时间，不是问价格。
pinyin: zhè gè wèn tí shì wèn shí jiān , bù shì wèn jià gé .
meaning: This question asks about time, not price.

text: 道理
pinyin: dào lǐ
meaning: reason; principle

text: 先确认再出发，这个道理我明白。
pinyin: xiān què rèn zài chū fā , zhè gè dào lǐ wǒ míng bái .
meaning: I understand why we should confirm before leaving.

text: 实际
pinyin: shí jì
meaning: actual; practical

text: 实际的入口在东边。
pinyin: shí jì de rù kǒu zài dōng biān .
meaning: The actual entrance is on the east side.

text: 实在
pinyin: shí zài
meaning: really; indeed

text: 这个时间实在不方便，我们换一天吧。
pinyin: zhè gè shí jiān shí zài bù fāng biàn , wǒ men huàn yī tiān ba .
meaning: This time really is inconvenient; let us choose another day.

text: 我对这个安排还有问题。
pinyin: wǒ duì zhè gè ān pái hái yǒu wèn tí .
meaning: I still have questions about this arrangement.

text: 同样
pinyin: tóng yàng
meaning: same; equally

text: 两个朋友有同样的问题。
pinyin: liǎng gè péng you yǒu tóng yàng de wèn tí .
meaning: Two friends have the same question.

text: 相同
pinyin: xiāng tóng
meaning: identical; the same

text: 两条消息的地址相同，日期不同。
pinyin: liǎng tiáo xiāo xī de dì zhǐ xiāng tóng , rì qī bù tóng .
meaning: The two messages have the same address but different dates.

text: 对，我就是这个意思。
pinyin: duì , wǒ jiù shì zhè gè yì si .
meaning: Yes, that is exactly what I mean.

text: 我说的就是今天，不是明天。
pinyin: wǒ shuō de jiù shì jīn tiān , bù shì míng tiān .
meaning: I mean today, not tomorrow.

text: 我明白，但这个时间实在不方便。
pinyin: wǒ míng bái , dàn zhè gè shí jiān shí zài bù fāng biàn .
meaning: I understand, but this time really is inconvenient.

text: 故意
pinyin: gù yì
meaning: deliberately; on purpose

text: 我不是故意拿错你的笔。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì gù yì ná cuò nǐ de bǐ .
meaning: I did not take your pen by mistake on purpose.

text: 好像
pinyin: hǎo xiàng
meaning: to seem; as if

text: 你好像不太开心，我问一下。
pinyin: nǐ hǎo xiàng bù tài kāi xīn , wǒ wèn yī xià .
meaning: You seem a little unhappy; I will ask.

text: 以为
pinyin: yǐ wéi
meaning: to think mistakenly or without confirmation

text: 我以为你同意了，其实还没问。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ tóng yì le , qí shí hái méi wèn .
meaning: I thought you agreed, but had not actually asked.

text: 感觉
pinyin: gǎn jué
meaning: to feel; perceive

text: 我感觉你有点儿不舒服。
pinyin: wǒ gǎn jué nǐ yǒu diǎn ér bù shū fú .
meaning: I feel that you are a little uncomfortable.

text: 难看
pinyin: nán kàn
meaning: unpleasant-looking; ugly

text: 我不喜欢这件衣服，但不说你穿得难看。
pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huān zhè jiàn yī fú , dàn bù shuō nǐ chuān de nán kàn .
meaning: I dislike this item of clothing but do not tell you that you look ugly in it.

text: 可怕
pinyin: kě pà
meaning: frightening

text: 那个故事有点儿可怕，先别讲了。
pinyin: nà gè gù shì yǒu diǎn ér kě pà , xiān bié jiǎng le .
meaning: That story is a little frightening; stop telling it for now.

text: 笑话
pinyin: xiào hua
meaning: to ridicule; laugh at

text: 别笑话别人说得慢。
pinyin: bié xiào hua bié ren shuō de màn .
meaning: Do not ridicule someone for speaking slowly.

text: 笑话儿
pinyin: xiào huar
meaning: joke; a northern rhotic noun form

text: 这个笑话儿不好笑，换个话题吧。
pinyin: zhè gè xiào huar bù hǎo xiào , huàn gè huà tí ba .
meaning: This joke is not funny; let us change the topic.

text: 哭
pinyin: kū
meaning: to cry

text: 她哭了，我先问要不要帮忙。
pinyin: tā kū le , wǒ xiān wèn yào bù yào bāng máng .
meaning: She is crying; I first ask whether she wants help.

text: 喊
pinyin: hǎn
meaning: to shout; call out

text: 别喊，我在你旁边。
pinyin: bié hǎn , wǒ zài nǐ páng biān .
meaning: Do not shout; I am beside you.

text: 眼
pinyin: yǎn
meaning: eye

text: 别用手碰眼，先洗手。
pinyin: bié yòng shǒu pèng yǎn , xiān xǐ shǒu .
meaning: Do not touch your eyes with your hands; wash your hands first.

text: 眼睛
pinyin: yǎn jing
meaning: eyes

text: 她的眼睛有点儿红。
pinyin: tā de yǎn jing yǒu diǎn ér hóng .
meaning: Her eyes are a little red.

text: 脸
pinyin: liǎn
meaning: face

text: 他笑了，但不能只看脸就猜意思。
pinyin: tā xiào le , dàn bù néng zhǐ kàn liǎn jiù cāi yì si .
meaning: He smiled, but we cannot infer intention just from his face.

text: 嘴
pinyin: zuǐ
meaning: mouth

text: 他用手指了指嘴，没有说话。
pinyin: tā yòng shǒu zhǐ le zhǐ zuǐ , méi yǒu shuō huà .
meaning: He pointed at his mouth without speaking.

text: 头发
pinyin: tóu fa
meaning: hair

text: 我刚剪头发，朋友差点儿没认出来。
pinyin: wǒ gāng jiǎn tóu fa , péng you chà diǎn ér méi rèn chū lái .
meaning: I just had my hair cut; my friend nearly did not recognize me.

text: 点头
pinyin: diǎn tóu
meaning: to nod

text: 他点头了，我还要确认是不是同意。
pinyin: tā diǎn tóu le , wǒ hái yào què rèn shì bú shì tóng yì .
meaning: He nodded; I still need to confirm whether he agrees.

text: 小心
pinyin: xiǎo xīn
meaning: to be careful

text: 小心，杯子在桌边。
pinyin: xiǎo xīn , bēi zi zài zhuō biān .
meaning: Be careful; the cup is at the edge of the table.

text: 假
pinyin: jiǎ
meaning: false; fake

text: 那是假消息，不是真的通知。
pinyin: nà shì jiǎ xiāo xī , bù shì zhēn de tōng zhī .
meaning: That is a false message, not a real notice.

text: 好人
pinyin: hǎo rén
meaning: good person

text: 做好人不等于替朋友决定一切。
pinyin: zuò hǎo rén bù děng yú tì péng you jué dìng yī qiè .
meaning: Being a good person does not mean deciding everything for a friend.

text: 坏人
pinyin: huài rén
meaning: bad person

text: 拿错笔不等于就是坏人。
pinyin: ná cuò bǐ bù děng yú jiù shì huài rén .
meaning: Taking the wrong pen does not automatically make someone a bad person.

text: 好事
pinyin: hǎo shì
meaning: good deed; good thing

text: 先问需不需要帮助，再做好事。
pinyin: xiān wèn xū bù xū yào bāng zhù , zài zuò hǎo shì .
meaning: Ask whether help is needed before doing a good deed.

text: 气
pinyin: qì
meaning: to anger; annoy

text: 别故意气我，我真的不喜欢。
pinyin: bié gù yì qì wǒ , wǒ zhēn de bù xǐ huān .
meaning: Do not deliberately annoy me; I truly dislike it.

text: 我不是故意拿错笔的，对不起。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì gù yì ná cuò bǐ de , duì bù qǐ .
meaning: I did not intentionally take the wrong pen; sorry.

text: 你是在开玩笑吧？
pinyin: nǐ shì zài kāi wán xiào ba ?
meaning: You are joking, right?

text: 你是不是没听清？
pinyin: nǐ shì bú shì méi tīng qīng ?
meaning: Did you perhaps not hear clearly?

text: 你是不是在开玩笑？
pinyin: nǐ shì bú shì zài kāi wán xiào ?
meaning: Are you joking?

text: 对不起，我不继续说了。
pinyin: duì bù qǐ , wǒ bù jì xù shuō le .
meaning: Sorry, I will stop.

text: 必须
pinyin: bì xū
meaning: must; be required to

text: 下雪以后路不好走，必须先问场地的情况。
pinyin: xià xuě yǐ hòu lù bù hǎo zǒu , bì xū xiān wèn chǎng dì de qíng kuàng .
meaning: After snow the route is difficult; we must first ask about the venue.

text: 差不多
pinyin: chà bu duō
meaning: approximately; almost

text: 两条路的时间差不多，但不是完全一样。
pinyin: liǎng tiáo lù de shí jiān chà bu duō , dàn bù shì wán quán yī yàng .
meaning: The two routes take approximately the same time, but not exactly.

text: 如果
pinyin: rú guǒ
meaning: if

text: 如果明天下雨，我们就在室内见。
pinyin: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ , wǒ men jiù zài shì nèi jiàn .
meaning: If it rains tomorrow, we will meet indoors.

text: 只要
pinyin: zhǐ yào
meaning: as long as; provided that

text: 只要你有空，就可以参加。
pinyin: zhǐ yào nǐ yǒu kōng , jiù kě yǐ cān jiā .
meaning: As long as you are free, you can take part.

text: 条件
pinyin: tiáo jiàn
meaning: condition

text: 有空是这里说的条件，不是说必须下雨。
pinyin: yǒu kōng shì zhè lǐ shuō de tiáo jiàn , bù shì shuō bì xū xià yǔ .
meaning: Being free is the condition here; it does not mean rain is required.

text: 气温
pinyin: qì wēn
meaning: air temperature

text: 气温只有三度，我多带一件衣服。
pinyin: qì wēn zhǐ yǒu sān dù , wǒ duō dài yī jiàn yī fú .
meaning: The air temperature is only three degrees; I will bring another layer.

text: 多云
pinyin: duō yún
meaning: cloudy

text: 预报说多云，还没有说会下雨。
pinyin: yù bào shuō duō yún , hái méi yǒu shuō huì xià yǔ .
meaning: The forecast says cloudy; it has not said it will rain.

text: 晴
pinyin: qíng
meaning: clear; sunny

text: 天晴了，也要先看场地有没有开。
pinyin: tiān qíng le , yě yào xiān kàn chǎng dì yǒu méi yǒu kāi .
meaning: It has cleared up, but we still need to check whether the venue is open.

text: 晴天
pinyin: qíng tiān
meaning: sunny day; clear weather

text: 晴天我们在公园见。
pinyin: qíng tiān wǒ men zài gōng yuán jiàn .
meaning: In clear weather we meet at the park.

text: 阴
pinyin: yīn
meaning: overcast

text: 今天阴，但不一定下雨。
pinyin: jīn tiān yīn , dàn bù yí dìng xià yǔ .
meaning: Today is overcast, but it will not necessarily rain.

text: 阴天
pinyin: yīn tiān
meaning: overcast day

text: 阴天也可以出门，先看预报。
pinyin: yīn tiān yě kě yǐ chū mén , xiān kàn yù bào .
meaning: You can go out on an overcast day too; check the forecast first.

text: 下雪
pinyin: xià xuě
meaning: to snow

text: 如果下雪，就不骑车。
pinyin: rú guǒ xià xuě , jiù bù qí chē .
meaning: If it snows, we will not ride bicycles.

text: 雪
pinyin: xuě
meaning: snow

text: 路上有雪，走路要小心。
pinyin: lù shàng yǒu xuě , zǒu lù yào xiǎo xīn .
meaning: There is snow on the road; walk carefully.

text: 春天
pinyin: chūn tiān
meaning: spring

text: 春天我们常在公园见。
pinyin: chūn tiān wǒ men cháng zài gōng yuán jiàn .
meaning: We often meet in the park in spring.

text: 夏天
pinyin: xià tiān
meaning: summer

text: 夏天气温高，带水来吧。
pinyin: xià tiān qì wēn gāo , dài shuǐ lái ba .
meaning: Temperatures are high in summer; bring water.

text: 秋天
pinyin: qiū tiān
meaning: autumn

text: 秋天凉快，我想出去走走。
pinyin: qiū tiān liáng kuai , wǒ xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu .
meaning: Autumn is pleasantly cool; I would like to go for a walk.

text: 冬天
pinyin: dōng tiān
meaning: winter

text: 冬天也能见面，可以选室内。
pinyin: dōng tiān yě néng jiàn miàn , kě yǐ xuǎn shì nèi .
meaning: We can meet in winter too; we can choose indoors.

text: 北方
pinyin: běi fāng
meaning: the north; northern region

text: 租
pinyin: zū
meaning: to rent; lease

text: 想租以前先问条件。
pinyin: xiǎng zū yǐ qián xiān wèn tiáo jiàn .
meaning: Ask about the conditions before renting.

text: 出租
pinyin: chū zū
meaning: to rent out

text: 这间房出租，但还要确认时间。
pinyin: zhè jiān fáng chū zū , dàn hái yào què rèn shí jiān .
meaning: This room is for rent, but the time still needs confirmation.

text: 出租车
pinyin: chū zū chē
meaning: taxi

text: 朋友坐出租车来看房。
pinyin: péng you zuò chū zū chē lái kàn fáng .
meaning: My friend takes a taxi to view the room.

text: 酒店
pinyin: jiǔ diàn
meaning: hotel

text: 酒店是这次暂时住的地方。
pinyin: jiǔ diàn shì zhè cì zàn shí zhù de dì fāng .
meaning: The hotel is temporary accommodation for this visit.

text: 店
pinyin: diàn
meaning: shop; store

text: 店里买东西，不是看这间房。
pinyin: diàn lǐ mǎi dōng xi , bù shì kàn zhè jiān fáng .
meaning: You buy things in the shop, rather than view this room there.

text: 大衣
pinyin: dà yī
meaning: overcoat

text: 大衣挂着，别放在地上。
pinyin: dà yī guà zhe , bié fàng zài dì shang .
meaning: The overcoat is hanging; do not put it on the floor.

text: 大小
pinyin: dà xiǎo
meaning: size

text: 房间的大小要实际看。
pinyin: fáng jiān de dà xiǎo yào shí jì kàn .
meaning: The size of the room needs to be seen in person.

text: 椅子
pinyin: yǐ zi
meaning: chair

text: 门边有两把椅子。
pinyin: mén biān yǒu liǎng bǎ yǐ zi .
meaning: There are two chairs by the door.

text: 洗衣机
pinyin: xǐ yī jī
meaning: washing machine

text: 洗衣机可以用，但先问怎么用。
pinyin: xǐ yī jī kě yǐ yòng , dàn xiān wèn zěn me yòng .
meaning: The washing machine may be used, but first ask how.

text: 洗澡
pinyin: xǐ zǎo
meaning: to bathe; take a shower

text: 洗澡前先问热水什么时候有。
pinyin: xǐ zǎo qián xiān wèn rè shuǐ shén me shí hou yǒu .
meaning: Before showering, ask when hot water is available.

text: 脏
pinyin: zāng
meaning: dirty

text: 这个杯垫有点脏，先洗一下。
pinyin: zhè gè bēi diàn yǒu diǎn zāng , xiān xǐ yī xià .
meaning: This coaster is a little dirty; wash it first.

text: 装
pinyin: zhuāng
meaning: to pack; put into; install

text: 把书装进包，不装湿衣服。
pinyin: bǎ shū zhuāng jìn bāo , bù zhuāng shī yī fú .
meaning: Put the books in the bag, not wet clothes.

text: 留
pinyin: liú
meaning: to stay; retain

text: 可以留一会儿，不是今天就搬进来。
pinyin: kě yǐ liú yī huì er , bù shì jīn tiān jiù bān jìn lái .
meaning: You may stay a while; that does not mean move in today.

text: 留下
pinyin: liú xia
meaning: to leave behind; stay

text: 把联系方式留下，明天再说。
pinyin: bǎ lián xì fāng shì liú xia , míng tiān zài shuō .
meaning: Leave your contact details; we can discuss tomorrow.

text: 里头
pinyin: lǐ tou
meaning: inside

text: 里头有桌子，先进去看看。
pinyin: lǐ tou yǒu zhuō zi , xiān jìn qù kàn kàn .
meaning: There is a table inside; first go in and look.

text: 里头的头是轻声，不单独读成头发的头。
pinyin: lǐ tou de tou shì qīng shēng , bù dān dú dú chéng tóu fà de tou .
meaning: The suffix in 里头 is neutral; it is not read independently as the full-tone 头 in hair.

text: 面
pinyin: miàn
meaning: face; surface; side

text: 桌子的面很平，没有放书。
pinyin: zhuō zi de miàn hěn píng , méi yǒu fàng shū .
meaning: The table’s surface is flat and has no books on it.

text: 面前
pinyin: miàn qián
meaning: in front of; before

text: 面前有桌子，别挡着门。
pinyin: miàn qián yǒu zhuō zi , bié dǎng zhe mén .
meaning: There is a table in front of you; do not block the door.

text: 有人
pinyin: yǒu rén
meaning: someone; there are people

text: 屋里有人，先敲门。
pinyin: wū lǐ yǒu rén , xiān qiāo mén .
meaning: There is someone in the room; knock first.

text: 院
pinyin: yuàn
meaning: courtyard; institute

text: 院里有树，不是房间里。
pinyin: yuàn lǐ yǒu shù , bù shì fáng jiān lǐ .
meaning: There are trees in the courtyard, not inside the room.

text: 院子
pinyin: yuàn zi
meaning: courtyard

text: 院子门开着，但先问能不能进。
pinyin: yuàn zi mén kāi zhe , dàn xiān wèn néng bù néng jìn .
meaning: The courtyard gate is open, but first ask whether you may enter.

text: 门开着，先敲门吧。
pinyin: mén kāi zhe , xiān qiāo mén ba .
meaning: The door is open; knock first.

text: 她拿着书介绍房间。
pinyin: tā ná zhe shū jiè shào fáng jiān .
meaning: She introduces the room while holding a book.

text: 门开着也先问一声。
pinyin: mén kāi zhe yě xiān wèn yī shēng .
meaning: Ask first even if the door is open.

text: 先看条件，明天再商量。
pinyin: xiān kàn tiáo jiàn , míng tiān zài shāng liáng .
meaning: Check the conditions first and discuss tomorrow.

text: 啊
pinyin: a
meaning: sentence-final particle; exclamation

text: 原来是你啊。
pinyin: yuán lái shì nǐ a .
meaning: Oh, it turns out to be you.

text: 的话
pinyin: de huà
meaning: if; in the case of

text: 有空的话，来坐一会儿。
pinyin: yǒu kōng de huà , lái zuò yī huì er .
meaning: If you are free, come and sit for a while.

text: 我带书、笔等东西。
pinyin: wǒ dài shū , bǐ děng dōng xi .
meaning: I bring books, pens and other things.

text: 家
pinyin: jiā
meaning: suffix for a specialist or practitioner

text: 科学家不是科学的家。
pinyin: kē xué jiā bù shì kē xué de jiā .
meaning: 科学家 means scientist, not a house belonging to science.

text: 大家都认识老王，但新人先问怎么称呼。
pinyin: dà jiā dōu rèn shi lǎo wáng , dàn xīn rén xiān wèn zěn me chēng hū .
meaning: Everyone knows Old Wang, but a newcomer should ask how to address him first.

text: 小
pinyin: xiǎo
meaning: familiar prefix before a surname

text: 小王说可以这样叫她。
pinyin: xiǎo wáng shuō kě yǐ zhè yàng jiào tā .
meaning: Xiao Wang says this way of addressing her is okay.

text: 姓
pinyin: xìng
meaning: to have the surname; surname

text: 我姓王，不是姓小。
pinyin: wǒ xìng wáng , bù shì xìng xiǎo .
meaning: My surname is Wang, not Xiao.

text: 姓名
pinyin: xìng míng
meaning: full name

text: 姓名包括姓和名。
pinyin: xìng míng bāo kuò xìng hé míng .
meaning: A full name includes the surname and given name.

text: 叫作
pinyin: jiào zuò
meaning: to be called; be named

text: 这个活动叫作朋友读书。
pinyin: zhè gè huó dòng jiào zuò péng you dú shū .
meaning: This activity is called Friends Read.

text: 人们
pinyin: rén men
meaning: people

text: 人们的习惯不同，不能都猜一样。
pinyin: rén men de xí guàn bù tóng , bù néng dōu cāi yī yàng .
meaning: People have different habits; do not assume all are alike.

text: 人口
pinyin: rén kǒu
meaning: population

text: 报纸写的是人口，不是今天参加的人数。
pinyin: bào zhǐ xiě de shì rén kǒu , bù shì jīn tiān cān jiā de rén shù .
meaning: The newspaper reports population, not today’s attendance.

text: 全国
pinyin: quán guó
meaning: the whole country; nationwide

text: 这是全国的消息，不只是一个小组。
pinyin: zhè shì quán guó de xiāo xī , bù zhǐ shì yī gè xiǎo zǔ .
meaning: This is nationwide news, not just one small group.

text: 全年
pinyin: quán nián
meaning: the entire year

text: 这是全年的安排，不只是周末。
pinyin: zhè shì quán nián de ān pái , bù zhǐ shì zhōu mò .
meaning: This is a whole-year arrangement, not just this weekend.

text: 春节
pinyin: chūn jié
meaning: Spring Festival; Lunar New Year festival

text: 春节的活动还要看通知。
pinyin: chūn jié de huó dòng hái yào kàn tōng zhī .
meaning: The Spring Festival activity still needs checking against the notice.

text: 过年
pinyin: guò nián
meaning: to celebrate the New Year

text: 今年想和朋友一起过年。
pinyin: jīn nián xiǎng hé péng you yì qǐ guò nián .
meaning: This year I would like to celebrate the New Year with friends.

text: 节日
pinyin: jié rì
meaning: festival; holiday

text: 节日的安排可以先问朋友。
pinyin: jié rì de ān pái kě yǐ xiān wèn péng you .
meaning: You can ask friends about holiday plans first.

text: 晚会
pinyin: wǎn huì
meaning: evening gathering; evening show

text: 晚会以后再讨论读书计划。
pinyin: wǎn huì yǐ hòu zài tǎo lùn dú shū jì huà .
meaning: Discuss the reading plan after the evening gathering.

text: 午睡
pinyin: wǔ shuì
meaning: afternoon nap; to nap

text: 她正在午睡，我们晚点儿再联系。
pinyin: tā zhèng zài wǔ shuì , wǒ men wǎn diǎn ér zài lián xì .
meaning: She is taking an afternoon nap; we will contact her later.

text: 晚安
pinyin: wǎn ān
meaning: good night

text: 睡觉前说晚安。
pinyin: shuì jiào qián shuō wǎn ān .
meaning: Say good night before sleeping.

text: 晚报
pinyin: wǎn bào
meaning: evening newspaper

text: 晚报是报纸，不是晚会。
pinyin: wǎn bào shì bào zhǐ , bù shì wǎn huì .
meaning: An evening newspaper is a newspaper, not an evening gathering.

text: 日报
pinyin: rì bào
meaning: daily newspaper

text: 日报每天发，不是全年的一本书。
pinyin: rì bào měi tiān fā , bù shì quán nián de yī běn shū .
meaning: A daily newspaper is issued daily, not one book for the whole year.

text: 报纸
pinyin: bào zhǐ
meaning: newspaper

text: 我带报纸和书，读完再聊。
pinyin: wǒ dài bào zhǐ hé shū , dú wán zài liáo .
meaning: I bring a newspaper and a book; we will talk after reading.

text: 带书、笔什么的就行。
pinyin: dài shū , bǐ shén me de jiù xíng .
meaning: Things like books and pens are enough.

text: 我想读报纸。你呢？
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng dú bào zhǐ . nǐ ne ?
meaning: I want to read a newspaper. What about you?

text: 怎么称呼你？
pinyin: zěn me chēng hū nǐ ?
meaning: How should I address you?

text: 你是问我想读什么吗？
pinyin: nǐ shì wèn wǒ xiǎng dú shén me ma ?
meaning: Are you asking what I would like to read?

text: 院长
pinyin: yuàn zhǎng
meaning: head of an institute or hospital

text: 院长不在这里，我们先问联系人。
pinyin: yuàn zhǎng bù zài zhè lǐ , wǒ men xiān wèn lián xì rén .
meaning: The head is not here; first ask the contact person.

text: 住院
pinyin: zhù yuàn
meaning: to be hospitalized

text: 朋友住院了，探望时间要先问。
pinyin: péng you zhù yuàn le , tàn wàng shí jiān yào xiān wèn .
meaning: My friend is in hospital; visiting times should be asked about first.

text: 出院
pinyin: chū yuàn
meaning: to be discharged from hospital

text: 她已经出院，今天在家休息。
pinyin: tā yǐ jīng chū yuàn , jīn tiān zài jiā xiū xī .
meaning: She has been discharged and is resting at home today.

text: 健康
pinyin: jiàn kāng
meaning: healthy; health

text: 关心健康，也尊重她不想说的事。
pinyin: guān xīn jiàn kāng , yě zūn zhòng tā bù xiǎng shuō de shì .
meaning: Care about health and respect what she does not wish to discuss.

text: 西医
pinyin: xī yī
meaning: Western medicine; practitioner of it

text: 她说问过西医，我们不替医生判断。
pinyin: tā shuō wèn guò xī yī , wǒ men bù tì yī shēng pàn duàn .
meaning: She says she has consulted a Western-medicine clinician; we do not judge in the clinician’s place.

text: 中医
pinyin: zhōng yī
meaning: Chinese medicine; practitioner of it

text: 中医是她提到的词，不是我给的建议。
pinyin: zhōng yī shì tā tí dào de cí , bù shì wǒ gěi de jiàn yì .
meaning: Chinese medicine is a term she mentions, not a recommendation from me.

text: 药店
pinyin: yào diàn
meaning: pharmacy

text: 药店的位置可以问，怎么用药要问专业人员。
pinyin: yào diàn de wèi zhì kě yǐ wèn , zěn me yòng yào yào wèn zhuān yè rén yuán .
meaning: You can ask a pharmacy’s location; medication use should be asked of a professional.

text: 药片
pinyin: yào piàn
meaning: tablet; pill

text: 她说有药片，但没有说怎么服用。
pinyin: tā shuō yǒu yào piàn , dàn méi yǒu shuō zěn me fú yòng .
meaning: She says she has tablets but has not said how they are taken.

text: 药水
pinyin: yào shuǐ
meaning: liquid medicine

text: 瓶上写药水，不是饮料。
pinyin: píng shàng xiě yào shuǐ , bù shì yǐn liào .
meaning: The bottle is labelled liquid medicine, not a drink.

text: 养
pinyin: yǎng
meaning: to raise; keep; maintain

text: 她想养一只猫，现在还没有养。
pinyin: tā xiǎng yǎng yī zhǐ māo , xiàn zài hái méi yǒu yǎng .
meaning: She wants to keep a cat but does not yet have one.

text: 全身
pinyin: quán shēn
meaning: the whole body

text: 她说全身累，想先休息。
pinyin: tā shuō quán shēn lèi , xiǎng xiān xiū xī .
meaning: She says her whole body feels tired and wants to rest first.

text: 闻
pinyin: wén
meaning: to smell; sniff; hear of

text: 闻到饭的味道，不等于现在想吃。
pinyin: wén dào fàn de wèi dào , bù děng yú xiàn zài xiǎng chī .
meaning: Smelling food does not mean wanting to eat now.

text: 空气
pinyin: kōng qì
meaning: air

text: 她想去院子呼吸空气，但还要问自己方便不方便。
pinyin: tā xiǎng qù yuàn zi hū xī kōng qì , dàn hái yào wèn zì jǐ fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
meaning: She wants some air in the courtyard, but still needs to consider whether it is convenient for her.

text: 地球
pinyin: dì qiú
meaning: Earth

text: 书里讲地球，不是今天的天气预报。
pinyin: shū lǐ jiǎng dì qiú , bù shì jīn tiān de tiān qì yù bào .
meaning: The book discusses Earth, not today’s weather forecast.

text: 太阳
pinyin: tài yáng
meaning: sun

text: 太阳出来了，但她还在休息。
pinyin: tài yáng chū lái le , dàn tā hái zài xiū xī .
meaning: The sun has come out, but she is still resting.

text: 月亮
pinyin: yuè liang
meaning: moon

text: 晚上窗外有月亮。
pinyin: wǎn shang chuāng wài yǒu yuè liang .
meaning: The moon is outside the window at night.

text: 星星
pinyin: xīng xing
meaning: star

text: 她喜欢看星星，不一定想出门。
pinyin: tā xǐ huān kàn xīng xing , bù yí dìng xiǎng chū mén .
meaning: She likes looking at stars but does not necessarily want to go out.

text: 夜
pinyin: yè
meaning: night

text: 夜里我们不再打电话。
pinyin: yè lǐ wǒ men bù zài dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: We do not call again at night.

text: 天上
pinyin: tiān shàng
meaning: in the sky

text: 天上有云，不是室内有云。
pinyin: tiān shàng yǒu yún , bù shì shì nèi yǒu yún .
meaning: There are clouds in the sky, not indoors.

text: 月份
pinyin: yuè fèn
meaning: month; month of the year

text: 预约的月份还没说，不能猜。
pinyin: yù yuē de yuè fèn hái méi shuō , bù néng cāi .
meaning: The appointment month has not been stated and cannot be guessed.

text: 一生
pinyin: yī shēng
meaning: one’s whole life; lifetime

text: 一生的习惯不是一晚就能知道。
pinyin: yī shēng de xí guàn bù shì yī wǎn jiù néng zhī dào .
meaning: A person’s lifelong habits cannot be known in one evening.

text: 永远
pinyin: yǒng yuǎn
meaning: forever; always

text: 永远尊重朋友，也包括让她休息。
pinyin: yǒng yuǎn zūn zhòng péng you , yě bāo kuò ràng tā xiū xī .
meaning: Always respecting a friend includes letting her rest.

text: 方便的话，我来坐一会儿。
pinyin: fāng biàn de huà , wǒ lái zuò yī huì er .
meaning: If convenient, I will come and sit a while.

text: 不一会儿，她回了消息。
pinyin: bù yī huì er , tā huí le xiāo xī .
meaning: A little later, she replied to the message.

text: 喂，你好，我是小王。
pinyin: wèi , nǐ hǎo , wǒ shì xiǎo wáng .
meaning: Hello, this is Xiao Wang.

text: 好，五点我就走。
pinyin: hǎo , wǔ diǎn wǒ jiù zǒu .
meaning: Okay, I will leave at five.

text: 越
pinyin: yuè
meaning: the more; to exceed

text: 越练习，越清楚。
pinyin: yuè liàn xí , yuè qīng chǔ .
meaning: The more you practise, the clearer it becomes.

text: 越来越
pinyin: yuè lái yuè
meaning: more and more; increasingly

text: 这段话越来越清楚。
pinyin: zhè duàn huà yuè lái yuè qīng chǔ .
meaning: This passage is becoming clearer.

text: 成
pinyin: chéng
meaning: to become; complete

text: 先把这件事做成。
pinyin: xiān bǎ zhè jiàn shì zuò chéng .
meaning: First get this task done.

text: 成为
pinyin: chéng wéi
meaning: to become

text: 她想成为画家。
pinyin: tā xiǎng chéng wéi huà jiā .
meaning: She wants to become a painter.

text: 实现
pinyin: shí xiàn
meaning: to realize; achieve

text: 这个理想还没有实现。
pinyin: zhè gè lǐ xiǎng hái méi yǒu shí xiàn .
meaning: This aspiration has not yet been achieved.

text: 早就
pinyin: zǎo jiù
meaning: long since; already long ago

text: 我早就想参加，现在才有空。
pinyin: wǒ zǎo jiù xiǎng cān jiā , xiàn zài cái yǒu kōng .
meaning: I have wanted to join for a long time; only now am I free.

text: 才
pinyin: cái
meaning: only then; only

text: 读了三遍，才明白。
pinyin: dú le sān biàn , cái míng bái .
meaning: Only after reading three times did I understand.

text: 同时
pinyin: tóng shí
meaning: at the same time

text: 两个人同时说，我没听清。
pinyin: liǎng gè rén tóng shí shuō , wǒ méi tīng qīng .
meaning: Two people spoke at once and I did not hear clearly.

text: 今后
pinyin: jīn hòu
meaning: from now on; in the future

text: 今后每周记一次。
pinyin: jīn hòu měi zhōu jì yī cì .
meaning: From now on, make a record once a week.

text: 广告
pinyin: guǎng gào
meaning: advertisement

text: 广告说得好，不等于已经做到。
pinyin: guǎng gào shuō de hǎo , bù děng yú yǐ jīng zuò dào .
meaning: An appealing advertisement does not mean the claim has been fulfilled.

text: 网站
pinyin: wǎng zhàn
meaning: website

text: 网站上有我们的记录。

pinyin: dà jiā bǎ zhè gè zǔ chēng wéi zhōu mò dú shū zǔ .
meaning: Everyone calls this the Weekend Reading Group.

text: 认得
pinyin: rèn de
meaning: to recognize; know by sight

text: 我认得她，但不知道姓名。
pinyin: wǒ rèn de tā , dàn bù zhī dào xìng míng .
meaning: I recognize her but do not know her full name.

text: 认出
pinyin: rèn chū
meaning: to recognize; identify successfully

text: 听到声音，我认出她了。
pinyin: tīng dào shēng yīn , wǒ rèn chū tā le .
meaning: I recognized her on hearing her voice.

text: 亲人
pinyin: qīn rén
meaning: relative; loved one

text: 亲人不是所有熟人。
pinyin: qīn rén bù shì suǒ yǒu shú rén .
meaning: Relatives and loved ones are not all acquaintances.

text: 亲切
pinyin: qīn qiè
meaning: warm; friendly

text: 她说得很亲切，但没有说自己的家庭。
pinyin: tā shuō de hěn qīn qiè , dàn méi yǒu shuō zì jǐ de jiā tíng .
meaning: She speaks warmly but has not described her family.

text: 父母
pinyin: fù mǔ
meaning: parents

text: 父母今天没来，不要替他们答应。
pinyin: fù mǔ jīn tiān méi lái , bú yào tì tā men dā yìng .
meaning: The parents did not come today; do not agree on their behalf.

text: 父亲
pinyin: fù qīn
meaning: father

text: 她的父亲喜欢看书。
pinyin: tā de fù qīn xǐ huān kàn shū .
meaning: Her father likes reading.

text: 母亲
pinyin: mǔ qīn
meaning: mother

text: 她的母亲住在家乡。
pinyin: tā de mǔ qīn zhù zài jiā xiāng .
meaning: Her mother lives in her hometown.

text: 子女
pinyin: zǐ nǚ
meaning: sons and daughters; children

text: 这张表问子女，不是问所有亲人。
pinyin: zhè zhāng biǎo wèn zǐ nǚ , bù shì wèn suǒ yǒu qīn rén .
meaning: This form asks about sons and daughters, not every relative.

text: 家属
pinyin: jiā shǔ
meaning: family member; dependent

text: 家属可以陪同，但不是活动成员。
pinyin: jiā shǔ kě yǐ péi tóng , dàn bù shì huó dòng chéng yuán .
meaning: A family member may accompany someone without being an activity member.

text: 家乡
pinyin: jiā xiāng
meaning: hometown; native place

text: 家乡在南方，现在住北方。
pinyin: jiā xiāng zài nán fāng , xiàn zài zhù běi fāng .
meaning: The hometown is in the south; the current home is in the north.

text: 故乡
pinyin: gù xiāng
meaning: native place; hometown

text: 她很想念故乡。
pinyin: tā hěn xiǎng niàn gù xiāng .
meaning: She misses her hometown.

text: 年纪
pinyin: nián jì
meaning: age

text: 年纪还没说，不能看照片就猜。
pinyin: nián jì hái méi shuō , bù néng kàn zhào piān jiù cāi .
meaning: The age has not been given; a photo does not establish it.

text: 男子
pinyin: nán zi
meaning: man; male

text: 这位男子是成员，不是她的父亲。
pinyin: zhè wèi nán zi shì chéng yuán , bù shì tā de fù qīn .
meaning: This man is a member, not her father.

text: 女子
pinyin: nǚ zǐ
meaning: woman; female

text: 报道写一位女子，没有写她的姓名。
pinyin: bào dào xiě yī wèi nǚ zǐ , méi yǒu xiě tā de xìng míng .
meaning: The report says a woman without giving her name.

text: 关系
pinyin: guān xì
meaning: relationship; connection

text: 他们是朋友，不是父子关系。
pinyin: tā men shì péng you , bù shì fù zǐ guān xì .
meaning: They are friends, not father and son.

text: 人员
pinyin: rén yuán
meaning: personnel; people involved

text: 先看人员名单，再问谁还没到。
pinyin: xiān kàn rén yuán míng dān , zài wèn shéi hái méi dào .
meaning: Check the personnel list before asking who has not arrived.

text: 成员
pinyin: chéng yuán
meaning: member

text: 她是小组成员，不代表所有家属。
pinyin: tā shì xiǎo zǔ chéng yuán , bù dài biǎo suǒ yǒu jiā shǔ .
meaning: She is a group member and does not represent every family member.

text: 第三位成员还没到。
pinyin: dì sān wèi chéng yuán hái méi dào .
meaning: The third member has not arrived.

text: 朋友们先看名单。
pinyin: péng you men xiān kàn míng dān .
meaning: The friends look at the list first.

text: 怎么称呼你比较合适？
pinyin: zěn me chēng hū nǐ bǐ jiào hé shì ?
meaning: What form of address suits you?

text: 没关系，我们聊别的。
pinyin: méi guān xì , wǒ men liáo bié de .
meaning: That is fine; let us discuss something else.

text: 群
pinyin: qún
meaning: group; crowd

text: 这群人先看要求。
pinyin: zhè qún rén xiān kàn yāo qiú .
meaning: This group first checks the requirements.

text: 各
pinyin: gè
meaning: each; every

text: 各组先选一个联系人。
pinyin: gè zǔ xiān xuǎn yī gè lián xì rén .
meaning: Each group first chooses a contact person.

text: 每
pinyin: měi
meaning: every; each

text: 每个人先听一遍。
pinyin: měi gè rén xiān tīng yī biàn .
meaning: Each person listens once first.

text: 任何
pinyin: rèn hé
meaning: any; whatever

text: 任何人都可以先来听。
pinyin: rèn hé rén dōu kě yǐ xiān lái tīng .
meaning: Anyone may come and listen first.

text: 敢
pinyin: gǎn
meaning: to dare

text: 我有点儿害怕，但敢试一次。
pinyin: wǒ yǒu diǎn ér hài pà , dàn gǎn shì yī cì .
meaning: I am a little afraid but dare to try once.

text: 害怕
pinyin: hài pà
meaning: to be afraid; fear

text: 害怕说错，可以先慢慢说。
pinyin: hài pà shuō cuò , kě yǐ xiān màn màn shuō .
meaning: If afraid of a mistake, start by speaking slowly.

text: 这次怕不能马上开始。
pinyin: zhè cì pà bù néng mǎ shàng kāi shǐ .
meaning: I am afraid we probably cannot start immediately this time.

text: 好奇
pinyin: hào qí
meaning: curious

text: 我很好奇，想先听听。
pinyin: wǒ hěn hào qí , xiǎng xiān tīng tīng .
meaning: I am curious and would like to listen first.

text: 容易
pinyin: róng yì
meaning: easy

text: 第一段容易，不等于所有段都容易。
pinyin: dì yī duàn róng yì , bù děng yú suǒ yǒu duàn dōu róng yì .
meaning: The first passage is easy, but not necessarily all passages.

text: 难度
pinyin: nán dù
meaning: difficulty level

text: 难度不同，可以先选适合的。
pinyin: nán dù bù tóng , kě yǐ xiān xuǎn shì hé de .
meaning: The difficulty varies; start by choosing what suits you.

text: 能力
pinyin: néng lì
meaning: ability

text: 能力要看实际表现，不是看年纪。
pinyin: néng lì yào kàn shí jì biǎo xiàn , bù shì kàn nián jì .
meaning: Ability depends on actual performance, not age.

text: 才能
pinyin: cái néng
meaning: talent; ability

text: 才能不能只从一张照片判断。
pinyin: cái néng bù néng zhǐ cóng yī zhāng zhào piān pàn duàn .
meaning: Talent cannot be judged from one photograph.

text: 资格
pinyin: zī gé
meaning: qualification; eligibility

text: 来听不等于已经有比赛资格。
pinyin: lái tīng bù děng yú yǐ jīng yǒu bǐ sài zī gé .
meaning: Attending to listen does not mean being eligible for the competition.

text: 足够
pinyin: zú gòu
meaning: enough; sufficient

text: 时间足够，先把要求看完。
pinyin: shí jiān zú gòu , xiān bǎ yāo qiú kàn wán .
meaning: There is enough time; finish reading the requirements first.

text: 标准
pinyin: biāo zhǔn
meaning: standard; criterion

text: 标准写在通知上。
pinyin: biāo zhǔn xiě zài tōng zhī shàng .
meaning: The criteria are written on the notice.

text: 公开
pinyin: gōng kāi
meaning: public; to make public

text: 这是公开活动，但报名还有要求。
pinyin: zhè shì gōng kāi huó dòng , dàn bào míng hái yǒu yāo qiú .
meaning: It is a public event, but registration still has requirements.

text: 开放
pinyin: kāi fàng
meaning: open; to open

text: 今天开放旁听，不是开放所有比赛。
pinyin: jīn tiān kāi fàng páng tīng , bù shì kāi fàng suǒ yǒu bǐ sài .
meaning: Listening attendance is open today, not every competition.

text: 各地
pinyin: gè dì
meaning: various places

text: 各地的朋友都来听。
pinyin: gè dì de péng you dōu lái tīng .
meaning: Friends from various places come to listen.

text: 各位
pinyin: gè wèi
meaning: everyone; all of you

text: 各位先坐，再看通知。
pinyin: gè wèi xiān zuò , zài kàn tōng zhī .
meaning: Everyone, sit first and then look at the notice.

text: 各种
pinyin: gè zhǒng
meaning: various kinds

text: 各种难度都有，不必都选。
pinyin: gè zhǒng nán dù dōu yǒu , bù bì dōu xuǎn .
meaning: There are various difficulties; you need not choose them all.

text: 各自
pinyin: gè zì
meaning: each on their own

text: 大家各自选一段。
pinyin: dà jiā gè zì xuǎn yī duàn .
meaning: Each person chooses a passage independently.

text: 范围
pinyin: fàn wéi
meaning: range; scope

text: 开放的范围是旁听。
pinyin: kāi fàng de fàn wéi shì páng tīng .
meaning: The scope of openness is listening attendance.

text: 我不敢说，但听得懂。
pinyin: wǒ bù gǎn shuō , dàn tīng de dǒng .
meaning: I do not dare speak, but can understand.

text: 谁都可以先来听。
pinyin: shéi dōu kě yǐ xiān lái tīng .
meaning: Anyone may come and listen first.

text: 有点儿害怕，但想先试一句。
pinyin: yǒu diǎn ér hài pà , dàn xiǎng xiān shì yī jù .
meaning: I am a little afraid, but want to try one sentence first.

text: 谁都可以听，比赛要另看标准，对吗？
pinyin: shéi dōu kě yǐ tīng , bǐ sài yào lìng kàn biāo zhǔn , duì ma ?
meaning: Anyone may listen, but competition has separate criteria, right?

text: 需要
pinyin: xū yào
meaning: to need; require

text: 需要两个人，不是说你必须答应。
pinyin: xū yào liǎng gè rén , bù shì shuō nǐ bì xū dā yìng .
meaning: Two people are needed; that does not mean you must agree.

text: 需求
pinyin: xū qiú
meaning: need; demand

text: 先写实际需求，再招募。
pinyin: xiān xiě shí jì xū qiú , zài zhāo mù .
meaning: Write the actual needs before recruiting.

text: 志愿
pinyin: zhì yuàn
meaning: aspiration; voluntary intention

text: 志愿不是别人替我决定的。
pinyin: zhì yuàn bù shì bié ren tì wǒ jué dìng de .
meaning: Voluntary intention is not something another person decides for me.

text: 志愿者
pinyin: zhì yuàn zhě
meaning: volunteer

text: 志愿者可以先问工作内容。
pinyin: zhì yuàn zhě kě yǐ xiān wèn gōng zuò nèi róng .
meaning: A volunteer may first ask about the work.

text: 者
pinyin: zhě
meaning: suffix for a person who acts or has a role

text: 志愿者里的者说的是人。
pinyin: zhì yuàn zhě lǐ de zhě shuō de shì rén .
meaning: 者 in 志愿者 refers to a person.

text: 员
pinyin: yuán
meaning: suffix for a member or worker

text: 服务员里的员不是一个独立的名字。
pinyin: fú wù yuán lǐ de yuán bù shì yī gè dú lì de míng zi .
meaning: 员 in 服务员 is not an independent name.

text: 员工
pinyin: yuán gōng
meaning: employee

text: 员工和值班志愿者的安排不同。
pinyin: yuán gōng hé zhí bān zhì yuàn zhě de ān pái bù tóng .
meaning: Employees and volunteers on duty have different arrangements.

text: 任务
pinyin: rèn wù
meaning: task; assignment

text: 任务是搬两把椅子，不是搬所有东西。
pinyin: rèn wù shì bān liǎng bǎ yǐ zi , bù shì bān suǒ yǒu dōng xi .
meaning: The task is moving two chairs, not every object.

text: 责任
pinyin: zé rèn
meaning: responsibility

text: 先说清楚责任，再答应。
pinyin: xiān shuō qīng chǔ zé rèn , zài dā yìng .
meaning: Clarify responsibilities before agreeing.

text: 负责
pinyin: fù zé
meaning: to be responsible for

text: 她负责入口，我负责名单。
pinyin: tā fù zé rù kǒu , wǒ fù zé míng dān .
meaning: She handles the entrance and I handle the list.

text: 安排
pinyin: ān pái
meaning: to arrange; arrangement

text: 时间由大家一起安排。
pinyin: shí jiān yóu dà jiā yì qǐ ān pái .
meaning: Everyone arranges the time together.

text: 分配
pinyin: fēn pèi
meaning: to distribute; allocate

text: 先分配任务，不要两个人重复做。
pinyin: xiān fēn pèi rèn wù , bú yào liǎng gè rén chóng fù zuò .
meaning: Allocate tasks first so two people do not duplicate them.

text: 分组
pinyin: fēn zǔ
meaning: to form groups

text: 先分组，每组两个人。
pinyin: xiān fēn zǔ , měi zǔ liǎng gè rén .
meaning: Form groups first, with two people per group.

text: 集体
pinyin: jí tǐ
meaning: collective; group

text: 集体决定，也要听每个人的意见。
pinyin: jí tǐ jué dìng , yě yào tīng měi gè rén de yì jiàn .
meaning: A group decision still needs each person’s views heard.

text: 共同
pinyin: gòng tóng
meaning: shared; jointly

text: 这是共同任务，不是谁一个人的。
pinyin: zhè shì gòng tóng rèn wù , bù shì shéi yī gè rén de .
meaning: This is a shared task, not one person’s alone.

text: 共有
pinyin: gòng yǒu
meaning: to have in total; share possession

text: 我们共有四把椅子。
pinyin: wǒ men gòng yǒu sì bǎ yǐ zi .
meaning: Together we have four chairs.

text: 合作
pinyin: hé zuò
meaning: to cooperate

text: 合作前，先说谁做什么。
pinyin: hé zuò qián , xiān shuō shéi zuò shén me .
meaning: Before cooperating, specify who does what.

text: 积极
pinyin: jī jí
meaning: active; enthusiastic

text: 积极参加，也可以说自己时间不够。
pinyin: jī jí cān jiā , yě kě yǐ shuō zì jǐ shí jiān bù gòu .
meaning: Participating enthusiastically does not prevent saying time is limited.

text: 支持
pinyin: zhī chí
meaning: to support

text: 支持活动，不一定能全程参加。
pinyin: zhī chí huó dòng , bù yí dìng néng quán chéng cān jiā .
meaning: Supporting the event does not guarantee attending throughout.

text: 主动
pinyin: zhǔ dòng
meaning: on one’s initiative; proactive

text: 她主动问需要什么。
pinyin: tā zhǔ dòng wèn xū yào shén me .
meaning: She proactively asks what is needed.

text: 团体
pinyin: tuán tǐ
meaning: group; organization

text: 团体名单上有各位成员。
pinyin: tuán tǐ míng dān shàng yǒu gè wèi chéng yuán .
meaning: The organization’s list names its members.

text: 队员
pinyin: duì yuán
meaning: team member

text: 每位队员先确认任务。
pinyin: měi wèi duì yuán xiān què rèn rèn wù .
meaning: Each team member confirms the task first.

text: 活动需要两个人。
pinyin: huó dòng xū yào liǎng gè rén .
meaning: The event needs two people.

text: 各组先确认时间。
pinyin: gè zǔ xiān què rèn shí jiān .
meaning: Each group confirms the time first.

text: 我愿意，但只能来一小时。
pinyin: wǒ yuàn yì , dàn zhǐ néng lái yī xiǎo shí .
meaning: I am willing, but can come for only one hour.

text: 只搬这四把椅子，对吗？
pinyin: zhǐ bān zhè sì bǎ yǐ zi , duì ma ?
meaning: Only these four chairs, right?

text: 互相
pinyin: hù xiāng
meaning: mutually; each other

text: 我们互相帮忙，不是只让你做。
pinyin: wǒ men hù xiāng bāng máng , bù shì zhǐ ràng nǐ zuò .
meaning: We help each other, rather than leave all the work to you.

text: 相互
pinyin: xiāng hù
meaning: mutually; reciprocal

text: 相互尊重，也包括听到拒绝。
pinyin: xiāng hù zūn zhòng , yě bāo kuò tīng dào jù jué .
meaning: Mutual respect includes hearing a refusal.

text: 联系
pinyin: lián xì
meaning: to contact; connection

text: 我先联系她，再约时间。
pinyin: wǒ xiān lián xì tā , zài yuē shí jiān .
meaning: I contact her before arranging a time.

text: 另外
pinyin: lìng wài
meaning: another; in addition

text: 另外一位还没回消息。
pinyin: lìng wài yī wèi hái méi huí xiāo xī .
meaning: Another person has not replied.

text: 麻烦
pinyin: má fan
meaning: troublesome; to trouble

text: 麻烦你帮我问一下，可以吗？
pinyin: má fan nǐ bāng wǒ wèn yī xià , kě yǐ ma ?
meaning: Could I trouble you to ask for me?

text: 请教
pinyin: qǐng jiào
meaning: to ask for advice

text: 这个问题想请教你。
pinyin: zhè gè wèn tí xiǎng qǐng jiào nǐ .
meaning: I would like to ask your advice on this question.

text: 打听
pinyin: dǎ tīng
meaning: to ask around; inquire

text: 先打听时间，不问私人信息。
pinyin: xiān dǎ tīng shí jiān , bù wèn sī rén xìn xī .
meaning: Ask about the time first, not private details.

text: 访问
pinyin: fǎng wèn
meaning: to visit; interview

text: 访问前先联系对方。
pinyin: fǎng wèn qián xiān lián xì duì fāng .
meaning: Contact the other party before a visit or interview.

text: 接待
pinyin: jiē dài
meaning: to receive guests; host

text: 她负责接待，不是负责所有安排。
pinyin: tā fù zé jiē dài , bù shì fù zé suǒ yǒu ān pái .
meaning: She handles reception, not every arrangement.

text: 及时
pinyin: jí shí
meaning: in time; timely

text: 改了时间，要及时告诉朋友。
pinyin: gǎi le shí jiān , yào jí shí gào sù péng you .
meaning: Tell friends promptly if the time changes.

text: 提前
pinyin: tí qián
meaning: ahead of time; beforehand

text: 提前问清楚，不是提前替她答应。
pinyin: tí qián wèn qīng chǔ , bù shì tí qián tì tā dā yìng .
meaning: Ask clearly beforehand, rather than agree on her behalf.

text: 约
pinyin: yuē
meaning: to arrange a meeting; invite

text: 我想约她见面，时间还没定。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yuē tā jiàn miàn , shí jiān hái méi dìng .
meaning: I want to arrange a meeting with her; the time is not settled.

text: 告别
pinyin: gào bié
meaning: to say farewell

text: 告别前，再确认明天的时间。
pinyin: gào bié qián , zài què rèn míng tiān de shí jiān .
meaning: Confirm tomorrow’s time again before saying goodbye.

text: 理发
pinyin: lǐ fà
meaning: to have a haircut; cut hair

text: 她去理发，下午才能回消息。
pinyin: tā qù lǐ fà , xià wǔ cái néng huí xiāo xī .
meaning: She goes for a haircut and can reply only in the afternoon.

text: 结婚
pinyin: jié hūn
meaning: to marry

text: 朋友结婚了，不等于所有人都参加了婚礼。
pinyin: péng you jié hūn le , bù děng yú suǒ yǒu rén dōu cān jiā le hūn lǐ .
meaning: A friend married; that does not mean everyone attended the wedding.

text: 谈话
pinyin: tán huà
meaning: to talk; conversation

text: 谈话先问她现在方便不方便。
pinyin: tán huà xiān wèn tā xiàn zài fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
meaning: Before talking, ask whether now is convenient.

text: 建议
pinyin: jiàn yì
meaning: suggestion; to suggest

text: 这是建议，不是已经确认的时间。
pinyin: zhè shì jiàn yì , bù shì yǐ jīng què rèn de shí jiān .
meaning: This is a suggestion, not a confirmed time.

text: 补充
pinyin: bǔ chōng
meaning: to supplement; add

text: 最后补充一句，我只问时间。
pinyin: zuì hòu bǔ chōng yī jù , wǒ zhǐ wèn shí jiān .
meaning: Add one final detail: I ask only about the time.

text: 复印
pinyin: fù yìn
meaning: to photocopy

text: 我去办公室复印两页。
pinyin: wǒ qù bàn gōng shì fù yìn liǎng yè .
meaning: I go to the office to photocopy two pages.

text: 亲
pinyin: qīn
meaning: close; related by blood

text: 她们是亲姐妹，不是只看起来像。
pinyin: tā men shì qīn jiě mèi , bù shì zhǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng .
meaning: They are biological sisters, not just similar-looking.

text: 领导
pinyin: lǐng dǎo
meaning: leader; to lead

text: 领导不在，可以先问联系人。
pinyin: lǐng dǎo bù zài , kě yǐ xiān wèn lián xì rén .
meaning: The leader is absent; ask the contact person first.

text: 交往
pinyin: jiāo wǎng
meaning: to associate; interact

text: 交往要相互尊重，不替别人做决定。
pinyin: jiāo wǎng yào xiāng hù zūn zhòng , bù tì bié ren zuò jué dìng .
meaning: Interaction needs mutual respect; do not decide for others.

text: 能帮我一个忙吗？
pinyin: néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma ?
meaning: Could you do me a favour?

text: 只帮我问时间，不用替我答应。
pinyin: zhǐ bāng wǒ wèn shí jiān , bù yòng tì wǒ dā yìng .
meaning: Just ask the time for me; do not agree for me.

text: 不方便的话，我自己再联系。
pinyin: bù fāng biàn de huà , wǒ zì jǐ zài lián xì .
meaning: If inconvenient, I will contact her myself.

text: 存
pinyin: cún
meaning: to store; keep

text: 把文件存在这里，再查一次。
pinyin: bǎ wén jiàn cún zài zhè lǐ , zài chá yī cì .
meaning: Store the file here and then check again.

text: 保存
pinyin: bǎo cún
meaning: to save; preserve

text: 保存以后再打开看看。
pinyin: bǎo cún yǐ hòu zài dǎ kāi kàn kàn .
meaning: After saving, open it again to check.

text: 保留
pinyin: bǎo liú
meaning: to retain; keep

text: 先保留原件，不急着删。
pinyin: xiān bǎo liú yuán jiàn , bù jí zhe shān .
meaning: Keep the original first; do not rush to delete it.

text: 整理
pinyin: zhěng lǐ
meaning: to organize; tidy

text: 整理文件，不是随便改内容。
pinyin: zhěng lǐ wén jiàn , bù shì suí biàn gǎi nèi róng .
meaning: Organizing files does not mean changing their content arbitrarily.

text: 整齐
pinyin: zhěng qí
meaning: neat; orderly

text: 标题整齐，但还要查内容。
pinyin: biāo tí zhěng qí , dàn hái yào chá nèi róng .
meaning: The headings are neat, but the content still needs checking.

text: 完整
pinyin: wán zhěng
meaning: complete; intact

text: 这份文件完整，另一份少一页。
pinyin: zhè fèn wén jiàn wán zhěng , lìng yī fèn shǎo yī yè .
meaning: This file is complete; the other lacks a page.

text: 文件
pinyin: wén jiàn
meaning: document; file

text: 文件在第一个文件夹里。
pinyin: wén jiàn zài dì yī gè wén jiàn jiā lǐ .
meaning: The file is in the first folder.

text: 表格
pinyin: biǎo gé
meaning: form; table

text: 表格上的日期要核对。
pinyin: biǎo gé shàng de rì qī yào hé duì .
meaning: The date on the form needs checking.

text: 标题
pinyin: biāo tí
meaning: title; heading

text: 标题相同，内容不一定相同。
pinyin: biāo tí xiāng tóng , nèi róng bù yí dìng xiāng tóng .
meaning: Identical titles do not guarantee identical content.

text: 内容
pinyin: nèi róng
meaning: content

text: 先看内容，再判断版本。
pinyin: xiān kàn nèi róng , zài pàn duàn bǎn běn .
meaning: Read the content before judging the version.

text: 记录
pinyin: jì lù
meaning: to record; record

text: 记录写的是星期六，不是星期日。
pinyin: jì lù xiě de shì xīng qī liù , bù shì xīng qī rì .
meaning: The record says Saturday, not Sunday.

text: 证据
pinyin: zhèng jù
meaning: evidence

text: 找到文件是证据之一，不是所有结论。
pinyin: zhǎo dào wén jiàn shì zhèng jù zhī yī , bù shì suǒ yǒu jié lùn .
meaning: Finding the file is one piece of evidence, not every conclusion.

text: 证明
pinyin: zhèng míng
meaning: to prove; proof

text: 日期可以证明版本，不证明活动已经举行。
pinyin: rì qī kě yǐ zhèng míng bǎn běn , bù zhèng míng huó dòng yǐ jīng jǔ xíng .
meaning: A date may establish the version, not that an event already happened.

text: 具体
pinyin: jù tǐ
meaning: specific; concrete

text: 请说具体哪一页。
pinyin: qǐng shuō jù tǐ nǎ yī yè .
meaning: Please specify which page.

text: 明确
pinyin: míng què
meaning: clear; definite

text: 任务明确，才知道完成什么。
pinyin: rèn wù míng què , cái zhī dào wán chéng shén me .
meaning: A clear task tells us what needs completing.

text: 错误
pinyin: cuò wù
meaning: error; mistaken

text: 发现错误就先记下来。
pinyin: fā xiàn cuò wù jiù xiān jì xià lái .
meaning: Record an error when it is found.

text: 修改
pinyin: xiū gǎi
meaning: to revise; modify

text: 修改日期前先问原来的意思。
pinyin: xiū gǎi rì qī qián xiān wèn yuán lái de yì si .
meaning: Ask the intended meaning before revising the date.

text: 修
pinyin: xiū
meaning: to repair; fix

text: 先修好门，再搬文件。
pinyin: xiān xiū hǎo mén , zài bān wén jiàn .
meaning: Fix the door before moving the documents.

text: 处理
pinyin: chǔ lǐ
meaning: to handle; deal with

text: 处理问题，先看具体内容。
pinyin: chǔ lǐ wèn tí , xiān kàn jù tǐ nèi róng .
meaning: Before handling the problem, examine the details.

text: 解决
pinyin: jiě jué
meaning: to solve; resolve

text: 找到原因，不等于已经解决。
pinyin: zhǎo dào yuán yīn , bù děng yú yǐ jīng jiě jué .
meaning: Finding the cause does not mean solving it.

text: 达到
pinyin: dá dào
meaning: to reach; attain

text: 结果还没达到标准。
pinyin: jié guǒ hái méi dá dào biāo zhǔn .
meaning: The result has not yet reached the standard.

text: 结束
pinyin: jié shù
meaning: to end; finish

text: 时间结束了，任务还没完成。
pinyin: shí jiān jié shù le , rèn wù hái méi wán chéng .
meaning: The time is up, but the task is not finished.

text: 这份文件打得开。
pinyin: zhè fèn wén jiàn dǎ de kāi .
meaning: This file can be opened.

text: 找了十分钟，终于找到了。
pinyin: zhǎo le shí fēn zhōng , zhōng yú zhǎo dào le .
meaning: Searched for ten minutes and finally found it.

text: 文件找到了，日期还没核对。
pinyin: wén jiàn zhǎo dào le , rì qī hái méi hé duì .
meaning: The file is found; the date is not checked yet.

text: 请说具体哪一页有错误。
pinyin: qǐng shuō jù tǐ nǎ yī yè yǒu cuò wù .
meaning: Specify which page contains the error.

text: 把
pinyin: bǎ
meaning: classifier for handled objects and chairs

text: 桌边放着两把椅子。
pinyin: zhuō biān fàng zhe liǎng bǎ yǐ zi .
meaning: Two chairs stand beside the table.

text: 一行字
pinyin: yī háng zì .
meaning: classifier for lines of writing

text: 通知只有一行字。
pinyin: tōng zhī zhǐ yǒu yī háng zì .
meaning: The notice has only one line of writing.

text: 架
pinyin: jià
meaning: classifier for machines and framed objects

text: 那架钢琴不是今天要搬的。
pinyin: nà jià gāng qín bù shì jīn tiān yào bān de .
meaning: That piano is not to be moved today.

text: 束
pinyin: shù
meaning: classifier for bunches and bundles

text: 桌上有一束花。
pinyin: zhuō shàng yǒu yī shù huā .
meaning: There is a bunch of flowers on the table.

text: 双
pinyin: shuāng
meaning: pair; classifier for pairs

text: 我拿两双筷子。
pinyin: wǒ ná liǎng shuāng kuài zi .
meaning: I take two pairs of chopsticks.

text: 台
pinyin: tái
meaning: classifier for equipment

text: 一台电脑在门边。
pinyin: yī tái diàn nǎo zài mén biān .
meaning: One computer is beside the door.

text: 张
pinyin: zhāng
meaning: classifier for flat objects

text: 每人拿一张纸。
pinyin: měi rén ná yī zhāng zhǐ .
meaning: Each person takes one sheet of paper.

text: 支
pinyin: zhī
meaning: classifier for pens and slender objects

text: 纸边有一支笔。
pinyin: zhǐ biān yǒu yī zhī bǐ .
meaning: There is a pen beside the paper.

text: 一只猫
meaning: classifier for certain animals and individual objects

text: 门外有一只猫。
pinyin: mén wài yǒu yī zhī māo .
meaning: There is a cat outside the door.

text: 种
pinyin: zhǒng
meaning: kind; classifier for types

text: 只有两种饮料。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu liǎng zhǒng yǐn liào .
meaning: There are only two kinds of drink.

text: 顿
pinyin: dùn
meaning: classifier for meals and episodes

text: 今天只一起吃这一顿饭。
pinyin: jīn tiān zhǐ yì qǐ chī zhè yī dùn fàn .
meaning: Today we share only this one meal.

text: 红酒
pinyin: hóng jiǔ
meaning: red wine

text: 红酒是酒，不是果汁。
pinyin: hóng jiǔ shì jiǔ , bù shì guǒ zhī .
meaning: Red wine is alcohol, not fruit juice.

text: 红茶
pinyin: hóng chá
meaning: black tea

text: 红茶里不放糖。
pinyin: hóng chá lǐ bù fàng táng .
meaning: No sugar goes in the black tea.

text: 白菜
pinyin: bái cài
meaning: Chinese cabbage

text: 这一道菜有白菜。
pinyin: zhè yī dào cài yǒu bái cài .
meaning: This dish contains Chinese cabbage.

text: 食品
pinyin: shí pǐn
meaning: food; food products

text: 食品放在这里，餐具放另一边。
pinyin: shí pǐn fàng zài zhè lǐ , cān jù fàng lìng yī biān .
meaning: Food goes here and tableware on the other side.

text: 美食
pinyin: měi shí
meaning: delicious food; cuisine

text: 她喜欢美食，也可以只吃一点儿。
pinyin: tā xǐ huān měi shí , yě kě yǐ zhǐ chī yì diǎn ér .
meaning: She likes good food and may still eat just a little.

text: 汤
pinyin: tāng
meaning: soup

text: 汤还烫，先等一下。
pinyin: tāng hái tàng , xiān děng yī xià .
meaning: The soup is still hot; wait first.

text: 糖
pinyin: táng
meaning: sugar; sweets

text: 茶里不放糖。
pinyin: chá lǐ bù fàng táng .
meaning: No sugar goes in the tea.

text: 甜
pinyin: tián
meaning: sweet

text: 这杯很甜，我只喝一点儿。
pinyin: zhè bēi hěn tián , wǒ zhǐ hē yì diǎn ér .
meaning: This drink is sweet; I drink only a little.

text: 果汁
pinyin: guǒ zhī
meaning: fruit juice

text: 果汁一杯，不是每人一瓶。
pinyin: guǒ zhī yī bēi , bù shì měi rén yī píng .
meaning: One cup of juice, not a bottle per person.

text: 可乐
pinyin: kě lè
meaning: cola

text: 可乐和果汁是两种饮料。
pinyin: kě lè hé guǒ zhī shì liǎng zhǒng yǐn liào .
meaning: Cola and juice are two kinds of drink.

text: 啤酒
pinyin: pí jiǔ
meaning: beer

text: 她不喝啤酒，选水。
pinyin: tā bù hē pí jiǔ , xuǎn shuǐ .
meaning: She does not drink beer and chooses water.

text: 两把椅子，一束花。
pinyin: liǎng bǎ yǐ zi , yī shù huā .
meaning: Two chairs and a bunch of flowers.

text: 一起吃一顿饭。
pinyin: yì qǐ chī yī dùn fàn .
meaning: Share one meal.

text: 两双筷子是四根，对吗？
pinyin: liǎng shuāng kuài zi shì sì gēn , duì ma ?
meaning: Two pairs of chopsticks are four individual sticks, right?

text: 我不喝啤酒，水就好。
pinyin: wǒ bù hē pí jiǔ , shuǐ jiù hǎo .
meaning: I do not drink beer; water is fine.

text: 丰富
pinyin: fēng fù
meaning: rich; plentiful; varied

text: 内容丰富，也先选一段。
pinyin: nèi róng fēng fù , yě xiān xuǎn yī duàn .
meaning: The content is varied; still choose one passage first.

text: 富
pinyin: fù
meaning: rich; wealthy

text: 富不富不是我们分纸的标准。
pinyin: fù bù fù bù shì wǒ men fēn zhǐ de biāo zhǔn .
meaning: Wealth is not our criterion for distributing paper.

text: 缺
pinyin: quē
meaning: to lack; be short of

text: 还缺两张纸。
pinyin: hái quē liǎng zhāng zhǐ .
meaning: Two sheets are still missing.

text: 缺少
pinyin: quē shǎo
meaning: to lack; be short of

text: 缺少信息，先问清楚。
pinyin: quē shǎo xìn xī , xiān wèn qīng chǔ .
meaning: If information is missing, clarify it first.

text: 数量
pinyin: shù liàng
meaning: quantity; number

text: 数量是六张，不是每人六张。
pinyin: shù liàng shì liù zhāng , bù shì měi rén liù zhāng .
meaning: The quantity is six sheets, not six per person.

text: 满足
pinyin: mǎn zú
meaning: to satisfy; meet

text: 六张可以满足六个人的需要。
pinyin: liù zhāng kě yǐ mǎn zú liù gè rén de xū yào .
meaning: Six sheets can meet six people’s need.

text: 分别
pinyin: fēn bié
meaning: separately; respectively

text: 两组分别拿三张。
pinyin: liǎng zǔ fēn bié ná sān zhāng .
meaning: The two groups each take three sheets.

text: 方式
pinyin: fāng shì
meaning: way; method

text: 分的方式是一人一张。
pinyin: fēn de fāng shì shì yī rén yī zhāng .
meaning: The distribution method is one sheet per person.

text: 配
pinyin: pèi
meaning: to match; allocate; equip

text: 给每组配两支笔。
pinyin: gěi měi zǔ pèi liǎng zhī bǐ .
meaning: Equip each group with two pens.

text: 配合
pinyin: pèi hé
meaning: to cooperate; coordinate

text: 你递纸，我配合记数量。
pinyin: nǐ dì zhǐ , wǒ pèi hé jì shù liàng .
meaning: You pass the sheets; I cooperate by recording quantities.

text: 齐
pinyin: qí
meaning: complete; all present; even

text: 纸齐了，人数还没确认。
pinyin: zhǐ qí le , rén shù hái méi què rèn .
meaning: The sheets are all present; attendance is still unconfirmed.

text: 整
pinyin: zhěng
meaning: whole; entire

text: 整本书不是只看标题。
pinyin: zhěng běn shū bù shì zhǐ kàn biāo tí .
meaning: The whole book means more than reading the title.

text: 整个
pinyin: zhěng gè
meaning: the whole; entire

text: 整个小组有六个人。
pinyin: zhěng gè xiǎo zǔ yǒu liù gè rén .
meaning: The whole group has six people.

text: 整体
pinyin: zhěng tǐ
meaning: whole; overall entity

text: 看整体，也看每个人的需要。
pinyin: kàn zhěng tǐ , yě kàn měi gè rén de xū yào .
meaning: Consider the whole and each individual’s needs.

text: 全面
pinyin: quán miàn
meaning: comprehensive; all-round

text: 全面检查，不是只数纸。
pinyin: quán miàn jiǎn chá , bù shì zhǐ shù zhǐ .
meaning: A comprehensive check does not count only paper.

text: 人群
pinyin: rén qún
meaning: crowd; group of people

text: 人群在门外，名单还要核对。
pinyin: rén qún zài mén wài , míng dān hái yào hé duì .
meaning: The crowd is outside; the list still needs checking.

text: 双方
pinyin: shuāng fāng
meaning: both parties; both sides

text: 双方同意以后再安排。
pinyin: shuāng fāng tóng yì yǐ hòu zài ān pái .
meaning: Arrange it once both parties agree.

text: 人民币
pinyin: rén mín bì
meaning: renminbi; Chinese currency

text: 费用用人民币写。
pinyin: fèi yòng yòng rén mín bì xiě .
meaning: The fee is stated in renminbi.

text: 付
pinyin: fù
meaning: to pay; give

text: 我还没付，只是问价钱。
pinyin: wǒ hái méi fù , zhǐ shì wèn jià qián .
meaning: I have not paid; I only asked the price.

text: 支付
pinyin: zhī fù
meaning: to pay; make a payment

text: 支付以后要看记录。
pinyin: zhī fù yǐ hòu yào kàn jì lù .
meaning: Check the record after payment.

text: 交费
pinyin: jiāo fèi
meaning: to pay a fee

text: 交费的时间还没定。
pinyin: jiāo fèi de shí jiān hái méi dìng .
meaning: The fee-payment time is not settled.

text: 收费
pinyin: shōu fèi
meaning: to charge a fee

text: 这个活动不收费。
pinyin: zhè gè huó dòng bù shōu fèi .
meaning: This activity does not charge a fee.

text: 这六张纸，张张都有名字。
pinyin: zhè liù zhāng zhǐ , zhāng zhāng dōu yǒu míng zì .
meaning: Each of these six sheets bears a name.

text: 把六张纸一张一张递过来。
pinyin: bǎ liù zhāng zhǐ yī zhāng yī zhāng dì guò lái .
meaning: Pass the six sheets over one at a time.

text: 六个人一人一张，一共六张，对吗？
pinyin: liù gè rén yī rén yī zhāng , yī gòng liù zhāng , duì ma ?
meaning: Six people with one each: six total, right?

text: 纸齐了，还要核对人。
pinyin: zhǐ qí le , hái yào hé duì rén .
meaning: The sheets are all present; people still need checking.

text: 比较
pinyin: bǐ jiào
meaning: relatively; compare

text: 这一段比较容易。
pinyin: zhè yī duàn bǐ jiào róng yì .
meaning: This passage is relatively easy.

text: 更加
pinyin: gèng jiā
meaning: even more

text: 这次说得更加清楚。
pinyin: zhè cì shuō de gèng jiā qīng chǔ .
meaning: This time the speech is even clearer.

text: 相当
pinyin: xiāng dāng
meaning: quite; fairly; equivalent

text: 这一段相当难，先慢慢读。
pinyin: zhè yī duàn xiāng dāng nán , xiān màn màn dú .
meaning: This passage is quite difficult; read it slowly first.

text: 强
pinyin: qiáng
meaning: strong

text: 声音强，不一定意思清楚。
pinyin: shēng yīn qiáng , bù yí dìng yì si qīng chǔ .
meaning: A strong voice does not guarantee clear meaning.

text: 强大
pinyin: qiáng dà
meaning: powerful; strong

text: 团队强大，也要听每个人。
pinyin: tuán duì qiáng dà , yě yào tīng měi gè rén .

pinyin: bù zhǎng bù shì měi chǎng huó dòng de zhǔ chí rén .
meaning: The department head is not the host of every event.

text: 主任
pinyin: zhǔ rèn
meaning: director; head

text: 主任确认场地，不负责主持。
pinyin: zhǔ rèn què rèn chǎng dì , bù fù zé zhǔ chí .
meaning: The director confirms the venue and does not host.

text: 主持
pinyin: zhǔ chí
meaning: to host; chair

text: 活动由一位学生主持。
pinyin: huó dòng yóu yī wèi xué sheng zhǔ chí .
meaning: One student hosts the event.

text: 代表
pinyin: dài biǎo
meaning: representative; to represent

text: 每组派一位代表发言。
pinyin: měi zǔ pài yī wèi dài biǎo fā yán .
meaning: Each group sends one representative to speak.

text: 代表团
pinyin: dài biǎo tuán
meaning: delegation

text: 代表团来交流，不等于举办方。
pinyin: dài biǎo tuán lái jiāo liú , bù děng yú jǔ bàn fāng .
meaning: The delegation comes for an exchange; it is not necessarily the organizer.

text: 带领
pinyin: dài lǐng
meaning: to lead

text: 工作人员带领大家进场。
pinyin: gōng zuò rén yuán dài lǐng dà jiā jìn chǎng .
meaning: Staff lead everyone into the venue.

text: 管理
pinyin: guǎn lǐ
meaning: to manage; management

text: 场地由学校管理。
pinyin: chǎng dì yóu xué xiào guǎn lǐ .
meaning: The school manages the venue.

text: 集中
pinyin: jí zhōng
meaning: to concentrate; assemble

text: 大家先在门口集中。
pinyin: dà jiā xiān zài mén kǒu jí zhōng .
meaning: Everyone first assembles at the entrance.

text: 会议
pinyin: huì yì
meaning: meeting; conference

text: 会议结束后再交流。
pinyin: huì yì jié shù hòu zài jiāo liú .
meaning: Have the exchange after the meeting ends.

text: 会员
pinyin: huì yuán
meaning: member of an association

text: 不是会员也可以先听。
pinyin: bù shì huì yuán yě kě yǐ xiān tīng .
meaning: Even nonmembers may listen first.

text: 办理
pinyin: bàn lǐ
meaning: to handle; complete formalities

text: 报名手续在门口办理。
pinyin: bào míng shǒu xù zài mén kǒu bàn lǐ .
meaning: Registration formalities are handled at the entrance.

text: 手续
pinyin: shǒu xù
meaning: formalities; procedure

text: 办完手续再进场。
pinyin: bàn wán shǒu xù zài jìn chǎng .
meaning: Enter after completing the formalities.

text: 报到
pinyin: bào dào
meaning: to report for arrival; register on arrival

text: 到达后先报到。
pinyin: dào dá hòu xiān bào dào .
meaning: Report on arrival first.

text: 发言
pinyin: fā yán
meaning: to speak at a meeting

text: 代表发言两分钟。
pinyin: dài biǎo fā yán liǎng fēn zhōng .
meaning: The representative speaks for two minutes.

text: 派
pinyin: pài
meaning: to send; assign

text: 每组派一人，不是全组都上台。
pinyin: měi zǔ pài yī rén , bù shì quán zǔ dōu shàng tái .
meaning: Each group sends one person, not the whole group onto the stage.

text: 过程
pinyin: guò chéng
meaning: process; course of events

text: 活动过程写在通知里。
pinyin: huó dòng guò chéng xiě zài tōng zhī lǐ .
meaning: The event process is written in the notice.

text: 宣传
pinyin: xuān chuán
meaning: to publicize; publicity

text: 宣传前先确认时间。
pinyin: xuān chuán qián xiān què rèn shí jiān .
meaning: Confirm the time before publicizing it.

text: 活动由学生举办。
pinyin: huó dòng yóu xué sheng jǔ bàn .
meaning: Students organize the event.

text: 按名单分组。
pinyin: àn míng dān fēn zǔ .
meaning: Group according to the list.

text: 这次由谁举办？
pinyin: zhè cì yóu shéi jǔ bàn ?
meaning: Who organizes this event?

text: 按名单还是按到达时间？
pinyin: àn míng dān hái shi àn dào dá shí jiān ?
meaning: By the list or by arrival time?

text: 朝
pinyin: cháo
meaning: toward; face

text: 朝门口走，别朝楼梯走。
pinyin: cháo mén kǒu zǒu , bié cháo lóu tī zǒu .
meaning: Walk toward the doorway, not toward the stairs.

text: 搬
pinyin: bān
meaning: to move; carry objects

text: 把轻箱子搬到门口。
pinyin: bǎ qīng xiāng zi bān dào mén kǒu .
meaning: Move the light box to the doorway.

text: 搬家
pinyin: bān jiā
meaning: to move house

text: 搬家先确认新地址。
pinyin: bān jiā xiān què rèn xīn dì zhǐ .
meaning: Confirm the new address before moving house.

text: 背
pinyin: bēi
meaning: to carry on the back

text: 轻背包可以背起来。
pinyin: qīng bēi bāo kě yǐ bēi qǐ lái .
meaning: The light backpack can be carried on the back.

text: 背后
pinyin: bèi hòu
meaning: behind; at the back

text: 背后的门不要挡住。
pinyin: bèi hòu de mén bú yào dǎng zhù .
meaning: Do not block the door behind you.

text: 底下
pinyin: dǐ xià
meaning: underneath; below

text: 箱子底下没有轮子。
pinyin: xiāng zi dǐ xià méi yǒu lún zi .
meaning: The box has no wheels underneath.

text: 里面
pinyin: lǐ miàn
meaning: inside

text: 里面是书，先别倒过来。
pinyin: lǐ miàn shì shū , xiān bié dào guò lái .
meaning: There are books inside; do not turn it upside down.

text: 外面
pinyin: wài miàn
meaning: outside

text: 外面下雨，先别搬出去。
pinyin: wài miàn xià yǔ , xiān bié bān chū qù .
meaning: It is raining outside; do not move it out yet.

text: 上面
pinyin: shàng miàn
meaning: on top; above

text: 上面写着轻，不代表里面没有东西。
pinyin: shàng miàn xiě zhe qīng , bù dài biǎo lǐ miàn méi yǒu dōng xi .
meaning: Light is written on top; it does not mean nothing is inside.

text: 下面
pinyin: xià miàn
meaning: under; below

text: 下面的纸不要压住。
pinyin: xià miàn de zhǐ bú yào yā zhù .
meaning: Do not pin down the paper underneath.

text: 前面
pinyin: qián miàn
meaning: in front

text: 前面是入口，出口在后面。
pinyin: qián miàn shì rù kǒu , chū kǒu zài hòu miàn .
meaning: The entrance is in front; the exit is at the back.

text: 后面
pinyin: hòu miàn
meaning: behind; afterward

text: 后面的箱子比较重。
pinyin: hòu miàn de xiāng zi bǐ jiào zhòng .
meaning: The box behind is heavier.

text: 上来
pinyin: shàng lái
meaning: to come up

text: 你先上来，我在二楼。
pinyin: nǐ xiān shàng lái , wǒ zài èr lóu .
meaning: Come up first; I am on the second floor.

text: 上去
pinyin: shàng qù
meaning: to go up

text: 把箱子搬上去，我在一楼等。
pinyin: bǎ xiāng zi bān shàng qù , wǒ zài yī lóu děng .
meaning: Carry the box up; I will wait on the first floor.

text: 下来
pinyin: xià lái
meaning: to come down

text: 你下来吧，我在一楼。
pinyin: nǐ xià lái ba , wǒ zài yī lóu .
meaning: Come down; I am on the first floor.

text: 下去
pinyin: xià qù
meaning: to go down

text: 你先下去，我在二楼等。
pinyin: nǐ xiān xià qù , wǒ zài èr lóu děng .
meaning: Go down first; I will wait on the second floor.

text: 运输
pinyin: yùn shū
meaning: to transport; transportation

text: 运输前先把箱子装好。
pinyin: yùn shū qián xiān bǎ xiāng zi zhuāng hǎo .
meaning: Pack the boxes properly before transport.

text: 安装
pinyin: ān zhuāng
meaning: to install

text: 这张桌子还要安装。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi hái yào ān zhuāng .
meaning: This desk still needs installing.

text: 家具
pinyin: jiā jù
meaning: furniture

text: 家具搬完再整理书。
pinyin: jiā jù bān wán zài zhěng lǐ shū .
meaning: Organize the books after moving the furniture.

text: 工具
pinyin: gōng jù
meaning: tool

text: 安装工具在小箱子里。
pinyin: ān zhuāng gōng jù zài xiǎo xiāng zi lǐ .
meaning: The installation tools are in the small box.

text: 木头
pinyin: mù tou
meaning: wood

text: 这块木头不是座位。
pinyin: zhè kuài mù tou bù shì zuò wèi .
meaning: This piece of wood is not a seat.

text: 推开
pinyin: tuī kāi
meaning: to push open; push aside

text: 先推开门，再搬箱子。
pinyin: xiān tuī kāi mén , zài bān xiāng zi .
meaning: Push the door open before moving the box.

text: 朝门口走。
pinyin: cháo mén kǒu zǒu .
meaning: Walk toward the doorway.

text: 我在二楼，你上来。
pinyin: wǒ zài èr lóu , nǐ shàng lái .
meaning: I am on the second floor; come up.

text: 你在楼上还是楼下？
pinyin: nǐ zài lóu shàng hái shi lóu xià ?
meaning: Are you upstairs or downstairs?

text: 这个太重，等人一起抬。
pinyin: zhè gè tài zhòng , děng rén yì qǐ tái .
meaning: This is too heavy; wait for help lifting it.

text: 感情
pinyin: gǎn qíng
meaning: feeling; affection

text: 朋友之间的感情不能只看礼物价格。
pinyin: péng you zhī jiān de gǎn qíng bù néng zhǐ kàn lǐ wù jià gé .
meaning: Friendship cannot be judged only by gift prices.

text: 感受
pinyin: gǎn shòu
meaning: feeling; to feel

text: 先听对方的感受，再解释。
pinyin: xiān tīng duì fāng de gǎn shòu , zài jiě shì .
meaning: Listen to the other person’s feelings before explaining.

text: 情感
pinyin: qíng gǎn
meaning: emotion; emotional feeling

text: 这段话表达情感，不是活动规则。
pinyin: zhè duàn huà biǎo dá qíng gǎn , bù shì huó dòng guī zé .
meaning: This passage expresses emotion, not event rules.

text: 内心
pinyin: nèi xīn
meaning: inner feelings; heart

text: 她内心想参加，今天却太累。
pinyin: tā nèi xīn xiǎng cān jiā , jīn tiān què tài lèi .
meaning: Inside she wants to join, but today she is too tired.

text: 心
pinyin: xīn
meaning: heart; mind

text: 心里想去，也可以说今天不方便。
pinyin: xīn lǐ xiǎng qù , yě kě yǐ shuō jīn tiān bù fāng biàn .
meaning: Even if one wants to go, one can say today is inconvenient.

text: 思想
pinyin: sī xiǎng
meaning: thought; ideas

text: 交流思想，不必有完全一样的答案。
pinyin: jiāo liú sī xiǎng , bù bì yǒu wán quán yī yàng de dá àn .
meaning: Exchange ideas; identical answers are not required.

text: 价值
pinyin: jià zhí
meaning: value

text: 对我来说，实用比价格更有价值。
pinyin: duì wǒ lái shuō , shí yòng bǐ jià gé gèng yǒu jià zhí .
meaning: For me, usefulness has more value than price.

text: 意义
pinyin: yì yì
meaning: meaning; significance

text: 这个选择对她有自己的意义。
pinyin: zhè gè xuǎn zé duì tā yǒu zì jǐ de yì yì .
meaning: This choice has its own significance for her.

text: 个人
pinyin: gè rén
meaning: individual; personal

text: 个人需要不一定一样。
pinyin: gè rén xū yào bù yí dìng yī yàng .
meaning: Individual needs are not necessarily the same.

text: 自身
pinyin: zì shēn
meaning: oneself; one’s own

text: 先了解自身需要，再比较。
pinyin: xiān liǎo jiě zì shēn xū yào , zài bǐ jiào .
meaning: Understand one’s own needs before comparing.

text: 自主
pinyin: zì zhǔ
meaning: to act independently; autonomous

text: 她可以自主选择，不必替她决定。
pinyin: tā kě yǐ zì zhǔ xuǎn zé , bù bì tì tā jué dìng .
meaning: She can choose independently; there is no need to decide for her.

text: 理解
pinyin: lǐ jiě
meaning: to understand

text: 理解理由，不等于必须同意。
pinyin: lǐ jiě lǐ yóu , bù děng yú bì xū tóng yì .
meaning: Understanding the reason does not mean one must agree.

text: 对方
pinyin: duì fāng
meaning: the other person or party

text: 先问对方有没有空。
pinyin: xiān wèn duì fāng yǒu méi yǒu kōng .
meaning: Ask first whether the other person is free.

text: 对象
pinyin: duì xiàng
meaning: object; intended recipient

text: 这份说明的对象是新会员。
pinyin: zhè fèn shuō míng de duì xiàng shì xīn huì yuán .
meaning: This explanation is intended for new members.

text: 合理
pinyin: hé lǐ
meaning: reasonable

text: 按实际需要选择比较合理。
pinyin: àn shí jì xū yào xuǎn zé bǐ jiào hé lǐ .
meaning: Choosing according to actual needs is more reasonable.

text: 客观
pinyin: kè guān
meaning: objective

text: 客观记录价格，不代替别人判断价值。
pinyin: kè guān jì lù jià gé , bù dài tì bié ren pàn duàn jià zhí .
meaning: Record prices objectively without judging value for others.

text: 体会
pinyin: tǐ huì
meaning: to appreciate through experience; understanding

text: 听完她的理由，我能体会她的感受。
pinyin: tīng wán tā de lǐ yóu , wǒ néng tǐ huì tā de gǎn shòu .
meaning: After hearing her reasons, I can appreciate her feelings.

text: 体验
pinyin: tǐ yàn
meaning: to experience

text: 先体验一次，再决定要不要继续。
pinyin: xiān tǐ yàn yī cì , zài jué dìng yào bù yào jì xù .
meaning: Try it once before deciding whether to continue.

text: 体现
pinyin: tǐ xiàn
meaning: to reflect; embody

text: 这个安排体现对不同需要的尊重。
pinyin: zhè gè ān pái tǐ xiàn duì bù tóng xū yào de zūn zhòng .
meaning: This arrangement reflects respect for different needs.

text: 相似
pinyin: xiāng sì
meaning: similar

text: 需要相似，也不一定选同一个时间。
pinyin: xū yào xiāng sì , yě bù yí dìng xuǎn tóng yī gè shí jiān .
meaning: Similar needs do not necessarily mean choosing the same time.

text: 显然
pinyin: xiǎn rán
meaning: evidently; obviously

text: 她显然还没决定，别替她答应。
pinyin: tā xiǎn rán hái méi jué dìng , bié tì tā dā yìng .
meaning: She evidently has not decided; do not agree on her behalf.

text: 状况
pinyin: zhuàng kuàng
meaning: condition; situation

text: 今天身体状况不好，就先休息。
pinyin: jīn tiān shēn tǐ zhuàng kuàng bù hǎo , jiù xiān xiū xī .
meaning: If one feels unwell today, rest first.

text: 我为你高兴，但不替你决定。
pinyin: wǒ wèi nǐ gāo xìng , dàn bù tì nǐ jué dìng .
meaning: I am happy for you but do not decide for you.

text: 对我来说，安静很重要。
pinyin: duì wǒ lái shuō , ān jìng hěn zhòng yào .
meaning: For me, quiet matters.

text: 对你来说，什么最重要？
pinyin: duì nǐ lái shuō , shén me zuì zhòng yào ?
meaning: What matters most to you?

text: 我准备了选择，你自己决定。
pinyin: wǒ zhǔn bèi le xuǎn zé , nǐ zì jǐ jué dìng .
meaning: I prepared options; you decide.

text: 文化
pinyin: wén huà
meaning: culture

text: 了解文化，先问具体习俗。
pinyin: liǎo jiě wén huà , xiān wèn jù tǐ xí sú .
meaning: To learn about culture, ask about a specific custom first.

text: 文明
pinyin: wén míng
meaning: civilization; civilized

text: 文明交流也包括认真听不同意见。
pinyin: wén míng jiāo liú yě bāo kuò rèn zhēn tīng bù tóng yì jiàn .
meaning: Civil communication also includes listening to different opinions.

text: 民间
pinyin: mín jiān
meaning: among the people; folk

text: 民间故事有不同版本。
pinyin: mín jiān gù shì yǒu bù tóng bǎn běn .
meaning: Folk stories have different versions.

text: 民族
pinyin: mín zú
meaning: ethnic group; nation

text: 一个民族也有不同的生活习惯。
pinyin: yī gè mín zú yě yǒu bù tóng de shēng huó xí guàn .
meaning: An ethnic group can also have different everyday customs.

text: 华人
pinyin: huá rén
meaning: people of Chinese heritage

text: 华人的习惯不一定完全一样。
pinyin: huá rén de xí guàn bù yí dìng wán quán yī yàng .
meaning: People of Chinese heritage do not necessarily all share identical customs.

text: 中华民族
pinyin: zhōng huá mín zú
meaning: the Chinese nation

text: 文章讨论中华民族的文化，不代表每个人都一样。
pinyin: wén zhāng tǎo lùn zhōng huá mín zú de wén huà , bù dài biǎo měi gè rén dōu yī yàng .
meaning: The article discusses the culture of the Chinese nation; it does not mean every person is alike.

text: 社会
pinyin: shè huì
meaning: society

text: 社会变化，习俗也会变化。
pinyin: shè huì biàn huà , xí sú yě huì biàn huà .
meaning: As society changes, customs can change too.

text: 人民
pinyin: rén mín
meaning: the people

text: 人民的生活不能只看一张照片。
pinyin: rén mín de shēng huó bù néng zhǐ kàn yī zhāng zhào piān .
meaning: People’s lives cannot be understood from a single photo.

text: 世界
pinyin: shì jiè
meaning: world

text: 世界各地有不同习俗。
pinyin: shì jiè gè dì yǒu bù tóng xí sú .
meaning: Different places around the world have different customs.

text: 世纪
pinyin: shì jì
meaning: century

text: 上个世纪的照片不代表今天。
pinyin: shàng gè shì jì de zhào piān bù dài biǎo jīn tiān .
meaning: A photo from the last century does not represent today.

text: 时代
pinyin: shí dài
meaning: era; age

text: 不同的时代有不同的安排。
pinyin: bù tóng de shí dài yǒu bù tóng de ān pái .
meaning: Different eras have different arrangements.

text: 古代
pinyin: gǔ dài
meaning: ancient times

text: 古代的习俗不一定一直保留。
pinyin: gǔ dài de xí sú bù yí dìng yì zhí bǎo liú .
meaning: Ancient customs have not necessarily all been preserved.

text: 现代
pinyin: xiàn dài
meaning: modern times; modern

text: 现代生活中也有人保留旧习俗。
pinyin: xiàn dài shēng huó zhōng yě yǒu rén bǎo liú jiù xí sú .
meaning: Some people preserve older customs in modern life too.

text: 当地
pinyin: dāng dì
meaning: local; in that place

text: 向当地朋友问问，不要只猜。
pinyin: xiàng dāng dì péng you wèn wèn , bú yào zhǐ cāi .
meaning: Ask a local friend rather than merely guessing.

text: 国庆
pinyin: guó qìng
meaning: national day; national celebration

text: 国庆活动先看当地通知。
pinyin: guó qìng huó dòng xiān kàn dāng dì tōng zhī .
meaning: For National Day activities, check local notices first.

text: 庆祝
pinyin: qìng zhù
meaning: to celebrate

text: 每个人庆祝的方式可以不同。
pinyin: měi gè rén qìng zhù de fāng shì kě yǐ bù tóng .
meaning: Each person may celebrate in a different way.

text: 做客
pinyin: zuò kè
meaning: to visit as a guest

text: 做客前问清楚时间。
pinyin: zuò kè qián wèn qīng chǔ shí jiān .
meaning: Ask the time clearly before visiting as a guest.

text: 文学
pinyin: wén xué
meaning: literature
