pinyin: liǎng gè jié mù lèi sì , bù děng yú nèi róng xiāng tóng .
meaning: The two programmes are similar, not identical in content.

text: 区别
pinyin: qū bié
meaning: difference; to distinguish

text: 先说两种方式的区别。
pinyin: xiān shuō liǎng zhǒng fāng shì de qū bié .
meaning: Explain the difference between the two methods first.

text: 具有
pinyin: jù yǒu
meaning: to possess; have

text: 这个节目具有自己的特色。
pinyin: zhè gè jié mù jù yǒu zì jǐ de tè sè .
meaning: This programme has its own distinctive features.

text: 人生
pinyin: rén shēng
meaning: human life; life’s course

text: 这部故事讲人生，不是活动通知。
pinyin: zhè bù gù shì jiǎng rén shēng , bù shì huó dòng tōng zhī .
meaning: This story concerns a life, not an event notice.

text: 全场
pinyin: quán chǎng
meaning: the whole audience or venue

text: 全场都听见了，不等于每个人都同意。
pinyin: quán chǎng dōu tīng jiàn le , bù děng yú měi gè rén dōu tóng yì .
meaning: The whole venue heard it; that does not mean everyone agrees.

text: 观众
pinyin: guān zhòng
meaning: audience; viewer

text: 观众还没进场，门口有人等。
pinyin: guān zhòng hái méi jìn chǎng , mén kǒu yǒu rén děng .
meaning: The audience has not entered yet; people are waiting at the entrance.

text: 观看
pinyin: guān kàn
meaning: to watch; view

text: 我们一起观看节目。
pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ guān kàn jié mù .
meaning: We watch the programme together.

text: 收看
pinyin: shōu kàn
meaning: to watch a broadcast

text: 她晚上收看电视节目。
pinyin: tā wǎn shang shōu kàn diàn shì jié mù .
meaning: She watches a television programme in the evening.

text: 收听
pinyin: shōu tīng
meaning: to listen to a broadcast

text: 我早上收听广播。
pinyin: wǒ zǎo shàng shōu tīng guǎng bō .
meaning: I listen to the radio in the morning.

text: 听众
pinyin: tīng zhòng
meaning: listeners; radio audience

text: 听众的问题由主持人读出来。
pinyin: tīng zhòng de wèn tí yóu zhǔ chí rén dú chū lái .
meaning: The presenter reads listeners’ questions aloud.

text: 广播
pinyin: guǎng bō
meaning: radio broadcast; to broadcast

text: 广播没有画面，先听清名字。
pinyin: guǎng bō méi yǒu huà miàn , xiān tīng qīng míng zi .
meaning: The radio has no pictures; listen carefully to the names first.

text: 电台
pinyin: diàn tái
meaning: radio station

text: 这家电台今天播出什么？
pinyin: zhè jiā diàn tái jīn tiān bō chū shén me ?
meaning: What is this radio station broadcasting today?

text: 电视台
pinyin: diàn shì tái
meaning: television station

text: 电视台的新节目还没开始。
pinyin: diàn shì tái de xīn jié mù hái méi kāi shǐ .
meaning: The TV station’s new programme has not started yet.

text: 国内
pinyin: guó nèi
meaning: within the country; domestic

text: 国内有不同的节目，不是一种风格。
pinyin: guó nèi yǒu bù tóng de jié mù , bù shì yī zhǒng fēng gé .
meaning: There are different domestic programmes, not just one style.

text: 全球
pinyin: quán qiú
meaning: the whole world; global

text: 全球的观众不可能都有同一个习惯。
pinyin: quán qiú de guān zhòng bù kě néng dōu yǒu tóng yī gè xí guàn .
meaning: Viewers worldwide cannot all share the same habit.

text: 广大
pinyin: guǎng dà
meaning: broad; numerous

text: 通知面向广大观众，不只面向学生。
pinyin: tōng zhī miàn xiàng guǎng dà guān zhòng , bù zhǐ miàn xiàng xué sheng .
meaning: The notice addresses the broader audience, not just students.

text: 媒体
pinyin: méi tǐ
meaning: media

text: 不同媒体可以报道同一件事。
pinyin: bù tóng méi tǐ kě yǐ bào dào tóng yī jiàn shì .
meaning: Different media can report the same event.

text: 互联网
pinyin: hù lián wǎng
meaning: Internet

text: 我在互联网上查播出时间。
pinyin: wǒ zài hù lián wǎng shàng chá bō chū shí jiān .
meaning: I check the broadcast time on the Internet.

text: 联合
pinyin: lián hé
meaning: to unite; joint

text: 两个小组联合举办活动。
pinyin: liǎng gè xiǎo zǔ lián hé jǔ bàn huó dòng .
meaning: Two groups jointly organize the event.

text: 除了我，大家都来了。
pinyin: chú le wǒ , dà jiā dōu lái le .
meaning: Everyone except me came.

text: 除了广播，我还看电视节目。
pinyin: chú le guǎng bō , wǒ hái kàn diàn shì jié mù .
meaning: Besides the radio, I also watch TV programmes.

text: 除了你，我也没看过。
pinyin: chú le nǐ , wǒ yě méi kàn guò .
meaning: Besides you, I have not watched it either.

text: 这只是我们小组的选择。
pinyin: zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men xiǎo zǔ de xuǎn zé .
meaning: This is only our group’s choice.

text: 并且
pinyin: bìng qiě
meaning: and; moreover

text: 先确认场地，并且问清费用。
pinyin: xiān què rèn chǎng dì , bìng qiě wèn qīng fèi yòng .
meaning: Confirm the venue and clarify the expenses first.

text: 不光
pinyin: bù guāng
meaning: not only

text: 不光问时间，还要问地点。
pinyin: bù guāng wèn shí jiān , hái yào wèn dì diǎn .
meaning: Ask not only the time but also the location.

text: 不仅
pinyin: bù jǐn
meaning: not only

text: 不仅要公布，也要让大家看得懂。
pinyin: bù jǐn yào gōng bù , yě yào ràng dà jiā kàn de dǒng .
meaning: Not only publish it, but make it understandable too.

text: 要是
pinyin: yào shì
meaning: if

text: 要是有人不同意，先听原因。
pinyin: yào shì yǒu rén bù tóng yì , xiān tīng yuán yīn .
meaning: If someone disagrees, listen to the reasons first.

text: 只有
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu
meaning: only if; only

text: 只有大家同意，才公布新安排。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu dà jiā tóng yì , cái gōng bù xīn ān pái .
meaning: Announce the new arrangements only if everyone agrees.

text: 同意
pinyin: tóng yì
meaning: to agree; consent

text: 她还没同意，不要替她报名。
pinyin: tā hái méi tóng yì , bú yào tì tā bào míng .
meaning: She has not agreed; do not register on her behalf.

text: 反对
pinyin: fǎn duì
meaning: to oppose

text: 她反对这个时间，不是反对活动本身。
pinyin: tā fǎn duì zhè gè shí jiān , bù shì fǎn duì huó dòng běn shēn .
meaning: She opposes this time, not the event itself.

text: 坚决
pinyin: jiān jué
meaning: firm; resolute

text: 她坚决不同意公开私人地址。
pinyin: tā jiān jué bù tóng yì gōng kāi sī rén dì zhǐ .
meaning: She firmly opposes making the private address public.

text: 主张
pinyin: zhǔ zhāng
meaning: to advocate; position

text: 我主张先问所有参与者。
pinyin: wǒ zhǔ zhāng xiān wèn suǒ yǒu cān yù zhě .
meaning: I advocate asking all participants first.

text: 主意
pinyin: zhǔ yì
meaning: idea; plan

text: 这是一个主意，还不是决定。
pinyin: zhè shì yī gè zhǔ yì , hái bù shì jué dìng .
meaning: This is an idea, not a decision yet.

text: 制定
pinyin: zhì dìng
meaning: to formulate; draw up

text: 先讨论，再制定规则。
pinyin: xiān tǎo lùn , zài zhì dìng guī zé .
meaning: Discuss before drawing up the rules.

text: 制度
pinyin: zhì dù
meaning: system; rules

text: 这项制度还在讨论中。
pinyin: zhè xiàng zhì dù hái zài tǎo lùn zhōng .
meaning: This system of rules is still being discussed.

text: 规范
pinyin: guī fàn
meaning: standard; norm; standardize

text: 格式规范写在通知后面。
pinyin: gé shì guī fàn xiě zài tōng zhī hòu miàn .
meaning: The formatting standard is written after the notice.

text: 合法
pinyin: hé fǎ
meaning: lawful; legal

text: 合法不合法，要看实际规定。
pinyin: hé fǎ bù hé fǎ , yào kàn shí jì guī dìng .
meaning: Whether it is lawful depends on the actual rules.

text: 批准
pinyin: pī zhǔn
meaning: to approve; authorize

text: 场地申请还没批准。
pinyin: chǎng dì shēn qǐng hái méi pī zhǔn .
meaning: The venue application has not been approved.

text: 认可
pinyin: rèn kě
meaning: to recognize; accept

text: 我认可你的努力，不代表同意这个时间。
pinyin: wǒ rèn kě nǐ de nǔ lì , bù dài biǎo tóng yì zhè gè shí jiān .
meaning: I recognize your effort; that does not mean agreeing to this time.

text: 确保
pinyin: què bǎo
meaning: to ensure

text: 先确保每个人都收到通知。
pinyin: xiān què bǎo měi gè rén dōu shōu dào tōng zhī .
meaning: Make sure everyone receives the notice first.

text: 防止
pinyin: fáng zhǐ
meaning: to prevent

text: 核对日期，防止发旧消息。
pinyin: hé duì rì qī , fáng zhǐ fā jiù xiāo xī .
meaning: Check the date to prevent sending an old message.

text: 预防
pinyin: yù fáng
meaning: to take preventive measures

text: 预防问题，要先看入口是否够用。
pinyin: yù fáng wèn tí , yào xiān kàn rù kǒu shì fǒu gòu yòng .
meaning: To prevent problems, check whether the entrance is adequate first.

text: 情况
pinyin: qíng kuàng
meaning: situation; circumstances

text: 先了解情况，不急着反对。
pinyin: xiān liǎo jiě qíng kuàng , bù jí zhe fǎn duì .
meaning: Understand the situation before rushing to oppose it.

text: 如何
pinyin: rú hé
meaning: how

text: 如何报名，通知还没说明。
pinyin: rú hé bào míng , tōng zhī hái méi shuō míng .
meaning: The notice has not explained how to register.

text: 能不能
pinyin: néng bù néng
meaning: whether one can; can or cannot

text: 能不能用这个房间，还要问管理人员。
pinyin: néng bù néng yòng zhè gè fáng jiān , hái yào wèn guǎn lǐ rén yuán .
meaning: Ask the staff whether this room may be used.

text: 先确认地点，并且问清费用；另外，还要问人数。
pinyin: xiān què rèn dì diǎn , bìng qiě wèn qīng fèi yòng ; lìng wài , hái yào wèn rén shù .
meaning: Confirm the venue and expenses; additionally ask the number of people.

text: 谢谢你的安排，但这个时间我不行。
pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ de ān pái , dàn zhè gè shí jiān wǒ bù xíng .
meaning: Thanks for arranging it, but this time does not work for me.

text: 同意以后还要等批准。
pinyin: tóng yì yǐ hòu hái yào děng pī zhǔn .
meaning: Approval is still needed after agreement.

text: 哈哈
pinyin: hā hā
meaning: ha ha; laughter

text: 她写哈哈，是笑自己的玩笑。
pinyin: tā xiě hā hā , shì xiào zì jǐ de wán xiào .
meaning: She writes “ha ha,” laughing at her own joke.

text: 干吗
pinyin: gàn má
meaning: why; what for

text: 你干吗突然安静了？
pinyin: nǐ gàn má tū rán ān jìng le ?
meaning: Why did you suddenly go quiet?

text: 话题
pinyin: huà tí
meaning: topic

text: 这个话题还没说完。
pinyin: zhè gè huà tí hái méi shuō wán .
meaning: We have not finished discussing this topic.

text: 念
pinyin: niàn
meaning: to read aloud; recite

text: 请把这句话念出来。
pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhè jù huà niàn chū lái .
meaning: Please read this sentence aloud.

text: 突然
pinyin: tū rán
meaning: sudden; unexpected

text: 声音突然变大了。
pinyin: shēng yīn tū rán biàn dà le .
meaning: The voice suddenly became louder.

text: 快速
pinyin: kuài sù
meaning: fast; rapid

text: 快速回答不等于回答正确。
pinyin: kuài sù huí dá bù děng yú huí dá zhèng què .
meaning: A fast reply does not necessarily mean a correct reply.

text: 速度
pinyin: sù dù
meaning: speed

text: 速度慢一点，先说清楚。
pinyin: sù dù màn yī diǎn , xiān shuō qīng chǔ .
meaning: Slow down a little and speak clearly first.

text: 静
pinyin: jìng
meaning: quiet; still

text: 屋里很静，我听见她笑了。
pinyin: wū lǐ hěn jìng , wǒ tīng jiàn tā xiào le .
meaning: The room is quiet; I hear her laugh.

text: 紧张
pinyin: jǐn zhāng
meaning: nervous; tense

text: 她有点紧张，不是在生气。
pinyin: tā yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng , bù shì zài shēng qì .
meaning: She is a little nervous, not angry.

text: 乐
pinyin: lè
meaning: to enjoy; be amused

text: 听到这个玩笑，她乐了。
pinyin: tīng dào zhè gè wán xiào , tā lè le .
meaning: Hearing the joke amused her.

text: 乐观
pinyin: lè guān
meaning: optimistic

text: 她很乐观，也承认还有困难。
pinyin: tā hěn lè guān , yě chéng rèn hái yǒu kùn nán .
meaning: She is optimistic and also acknowledges remaining difficulties.

text: 欢乐
pinyin: huān lè
meaning: joyful; joyous

text: 现场很欢乐，不代表每个人都想大声说。
pinyin: xiàn chǎng hěn huān lè , bù dài biǎo měi gè rén dōu xiǎng dà shēng shuō .
meaning: The scene is joyful, but that does not mean everyone wants to speak loudly.

text: 活
pinyin: huó
meaning: alive; lively

text: 她说得很活，不是只把字念完。
pinyin: tā shuō de hěn huó , bù shì zhǐ bǎ zì niàn wán .
meaning: Her delivery is lively, not merely finishing the written words.

text: 生动
pinyin: shēng dòng
meaning: vivid; lively

text: 这个例子很生动，也要准确。
pinyin: zhè gè lì zi hěn shēng dòng , yě yào zhǔn què .
meaning: This example is vivid, and must also be accurate.

text: 动人
pinyin: dòng rén
meaning: moving; touching

text: 一句简单的感谢也很动人。
pinyin: yī jù jiǎn dān de gǎn xiè yě hěn dòng rén .
meaning: Even a simple thank-you can be moving.

text: 表现
pinyin: biǎo xiàn
meaning: performance; to display

text: 这次表现要看具体做了什么。
pinyin: zhè cì biǎo xiàn yào kàn jù tǐ zuò le shén me .
meaning: Judge this performance by what was actually done.

text: 表演
pinyin: biǎo yǎn
meaning: to perform; performance

text: 表演时可以夸张，教学时仍要说清。
pinyin: biǎo yǎn shí kě yǐ kuā zhāng , jiào xué shí réng yào shuō qīng .
meaning: Performance can be exaggerated; teaching still requires clear speech.

text: 明显
pinyin: míng xiǎn
meaning: obvious; clear

text: 她的笑意很明显，但意思还要看上下文。
pinyin: tā de xiào yì hěn míng xiǎn , dàn yì si hái yào kàn shàng xià wén .
meaning: Her amusement is obvious, but meaning still depends on context.

text: 很精神
meaning: lively; smart-looking

text: 她今天看着很精神。
pinyin: tā jīn tiān kàn zhe hěn jīng shen .
meaning: She looks lively and smart today.

text: 状态
pinyin: zhuàng tài
meaning: state; condition

text: 今天状态不一样，先慢慢来。
pinyin: jīn tiān zhuàng tài bù yī yàng , xiān màn màn lái .
meaning: Today’s condition is different; take it slowly first.

text: 自觉
pinyin: zì jué
meaning: self-motivated; conscious

text: 她很自觉，没听清就再问。
pinyin: tā hěn zì jué , méi tīng qīng jiù zài wèn .
meaning: She is conscientious and asks again when she has not heard clearly.

text: 好好
pinyin: hǎo hǎo
meaning: properly; carefully

text: 先好好听，再学她的玩笑。
pinyin: xiān hǎo hǎo tīng , zài xué tā de wán xiào .
meaning: Listen carefully before learning her joke.

text: 哈哈，我又把日期看错了。
pinyin: hā hā , wǒ yòu bǎ rì qī kàn cuò le .
meaning: Ha ha, I misread the date again.

text: 你今天也来参加这个活动？我确认一下。
pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān yě lái cān jiā zhè gè huó dòng ? wǒ què rèn yī xià .
meaning: Are you also joining this event today? Let me confirm.

text: 我笑的是自己，不是你。
pinyin: wǒ xiào de shì zì jǐ , bù shì nǐ .
meaning: I am laughing at myself, not at you.

text: 你今天也来参加活动？
pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān yě lái cān jiā huó dòng ?
meaning: Are you joining the event today too?

text: 本领
pinyin: běn lǐng
meaning: ability; skill

text: 她有组织活动的本领。
pinyin: tā yǒu zǔ zhī huó dòng de běn lǐng .
meaning: She has the ability to organize events.

text: 本事
pinyin: běn shi
meaning: ability; capability

text: 他修东西很有本事。
pinyin: tā xiū dōng xi hěn yǒu běn shi .
meaning: He is good at repairing things.

text: 长处
pinyin: cháng chù
meaning: strength; strong point

text: 她的长处是听得认真。
pinyin: tā de cháng chù shì tīng de rèn zhēn .
meaning: Her strength is listening carefully.

text: 短处
pinyin: duǎn chù
meaning: weakness; shortcoming

text: 我的短处是说得太急。
pinyin: wǒ de duǎn chù shì shuō de tài jí .
meaning: My weakness is speaking too hastily.

text: 成熟
pinyin: chéng shú
meaning: mature

text: 她处理问题很成熟。
pinyin: tā chǔ lǐ wèn tí hěn chéng shú .
meaning: She handles problems maturely.

text: 程度
pinyin: chéng dù
meaning: degree; extent

text: 我们练到的程度不同。
pinyin: wǒ men liàn dào de chéng dù bù tóng .
meaning: We have practised to different levels.

text: 表面
pinyin: biǎo miàn
meaning: surface; appearance

text: 表面安静，不代表没在想。
pinyin: biǎo miàn ān jìng , bù dài biǎo méi zài xiǎng .
meaning: A quiet appearance does not imply not thinking.

text: 表明
pinyin: biǎo míng
meaning: to show; indicate

text: 她的回答表明她看过通知。
pinyin: tā de huí dá biǎo míng tā kàn guò tōng zhī .
meaning: Her response indicates she read the notice.

text: 显得
pinyin: xiǎn de
meaning: to seem; appear

text: 换个说法，介绍显得自然一些。
pinyin: huàn gè shuō fǎ , jiè shào xiǎn de zì rán yī xiē .
meaning: A different phrasing makes the introduction seem more natural.

text: 显示
pinyin: xiǎn shì
meaning: to display; show

text: 屏幕显示的是文章标题。
pinyin: píng mù xiǎn shì de shì wén zhāng biāo tí .
meaning: The screen displays the article title.

text: 形象
pinyin: xíng xiàng
meaning: image; impression

text: 介绍不能只说外在形象。
pinyin: jiè shào bù néng zhǐ shuō wài zài xíng xiàng .
meaning: An introduction should not only describe outward image.

text: 形式
pinyin: xíng shì
meaning: form; format

text: 这篇介绍用对话的形式。
pinyin: zhè piān jiè shào yòng duì huà de xíng shì .
meaning: This introduction takes the form of dialogue.

text: 文字
pinyin: wén zì
meaning: written language; text

text: 文字写得简短，意思清楚。
pinyin: wén zì xiě de jiǎn duǎn , yì si qīng chǔ .
meaning: The written text is short and clear.

text: 文章
pinyin: wén zhāng
meaning: article; written piece

text: 这篇文章介绍一位朋友。
pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng jiè shào yī wèi péng you .
meaning: This article introduces a friend.

text: 读者
pinyin: dú zhě
meaning: reader

text: 读者不一定认识她。
pinyin: dú zhě bù yí dìng rèn shi tā .
meaning: Readers do not necessarily know her.

text: 写作
pinyin: xiě zuò
meaning: writing

text: 写作前先问她愿不愿意。
pinyin: xiě zuò qián xiān wèn tā yuàn bù yuàn yì .
meaning: Ask whether she agrees before writing.

text: 杂志
pinyin: zá zhì
meaning: magazine

text: 她给杂志写了短文。
pinyin: tā gěi zá zhì xiě le duǎn wén .
meaning: She wrote a short piece for the magazine.

text: 现实
pinyin: xiàn shí
meaning: reality; actual life

text: 现实里的朋友和故事人物不同。
pinyin: xiàn shí lǐ de péng you hé gù shì rén wù bù tóng .
meaning: Real-life friends differ from fictional characters.

text: 班级
pinyin: bān jí
meaning: class; class group

text: 我们在同一个班级认识。
pinyin: wǒ men zài tóng yī gè bān jí rèn shi .
meaning: We met in the same class.

text: 保安
pinyin: bǎo ān
meaning: security guard; security

text: 门口的保安帮我们找到了教室。
pinyin: mén kǒu de bǎo ān bāng wǒ men zhǎo dào le jiào shì .
meaning: The guard at the entrance helped us find the classroom.

text: 职业
pinyin: zhí yè
meaning: occupation

text: 她愿意介绍自己的职业。
pinyin: tā yuàn yì jiè shào zì jǐ de zhí yè .
meaning: She is willing to introduce her occupation.

text: 评价
pinyin: píng jià
meaning: assessment; to assess

text: 评价要说具体事情。
pinyin: píng jià yào shuō jù tǐ shì qíng .
meaning: An assessment should name concrete things.

text: 我跟朋友在教室里面见面。
pinyin: wǒ gēn péng you zài jiào shì lǐ miàn jiàn miàn .
meaning: I meet my friend inside the classroom.

text: 她汉语说得很流利。
pinyin: tā hàn yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì .
meaning: She speaks Chinese fluently.

text: 这句介绍，你愿意这样写吗？
pinyin: zhè jù jiè shào , nǐ yuàn yì zhè yàng xiě ma ?
meaning: Would you like this introduction written this way?

text: 这是我的印象，不一定完整。
pinyin: zhè shì wǒ de yìn xiàng , bù yí dìng wán zhěng .
meaning: This is my impression; it may be incomplete.

text: 完美
pinyin: wán měi
meaning: perfect

text: 这份计划还不完美。
pinyin: zhè fèn jì huà hái bù wán měi .
meaning: This plan is not perfect yet.

text: 优点
pinyin: yōu diǎn
meaning: advantage; good point

text: 优点是时间写得清楚。
pinyin: yōu diǎn shì shí jiān xiě de qīng chǔ .
meaning: Its good point is the clearly stated time.

text: 优势
pinyin: yōu shì
meaning: advantage; strength relative to others

text: 她熟悉路线，这是优势。
pinyin: tā shú xī lù xiàn , zhè shì yōu shì .
meaning: Knowing the route is her advantage.

text: 有利
pinyin: yǒu lì
meaning: beneficial; advantageous

text: 提前确认对大家有利。
pinyin: tí qián què rèn duì dà jiā yǒu lì .
meaning: Confirming early benefits everyone.

text: 相比
pinyin: xiāng bǐ
meaning: compared with

text: 相比旧版，新版更清楚。
pinyin: xiāng bǐ jiù bǎn , xīn bǎn gèng qīng chǔ .
meaning: Compared with the old version, the new one is clearer.

text: 必然
pinyin: bì rán
meaning: inevitable

text: 练习多不代表必然成功。
pinyin: liàn xí duō bù dài biǎo bì rán chéng gōng .
meaning: More practice does not imply inevitable success.

text: 不论
pinyin: bù lùn
meaning: regardless of; no matter

text: 不论谁写，都可以指出具体问题。
pinyin: bù lùn shéi xiě , dōu kě yǐ zhǐ chū jù tǐ wèn tí .
meaning: Whoever wrote it, specific problems can be identified.

text: 复杂
pinyin: fù zá
meaning: complex

text: 这次安排有点复杂。
pinyin: zhè cì ān pái yǒu diǎn fù zá .
meaning: This arrangement is rather complex.

text: 简单
pinyin: jiǎn dān
meaning: simple

text: 用简单的话说明不足。
pinyin: yòng jiǎn dān de huà shuō míng bù zú .
meaning: Explain shortcomings in simple words.

text: 可靠
pinyin: kě kào
meaning: reliable

text: 确认过的地址更可靠。
pinyin: què rèn guò de dì zhǐ gèng kě kào .
meaning: A confirmed address is more reliable.

text: 合格
pinyin: hé gé
meaning: meeting a standard; qualified

text: 合格要按明确的标准判断。
pinyin: hé gé yào àn míng què de biāo zhǔn pàn duàn .
meaning: Meeting the standard requires an explicit criterion.

text: 坚强
pinyin: jiān qiáng
meaning: strong; resilient

text: 她很坚强，也会说需要休息。
pinyin: tā hěn jiān qiáng , yě huì shuō xū yào xiū xī .
meaning: She is resilient and can still say she needs rest.

text: 批评
pinyin: pī píng
meaning: to criticize; criticism

text: 批评要针对具体做法。
pinyin: pī píng yào zhēn duì jù tǐ zuò fǎ .
meaning: Criticism should address specific actions.

text: 缺点
pinyin: quē diǎn
meaning: shortcoming; disadvantage

text: 缺点是地点还没确认。
pinyin: quē diǎn shì dì diǎn hái méi què rèn .
meaning: The shortcoming is the unconfirmed location.

text: 毛病
pinyin: máo bing
meaning: fault; problem

text: 这台机器的毛病还没找到。
pinyin: zhè tái jī qì de máo bing hái méi zhǎo dào .
meaning: The machine’s fault has not yet been located.

text: 面对
pinyin: miàn duì
meaning: to face

text: 面对不同意见，先问具体内容。
pinyin: miàn duì bù tóng yì jiàn , xiān wèn jù tǐ nèi róng .
meaning: Facing different opinions, ask for their specific content first.

text: 痛
pinyin: tòng
meaning: painful; to hurt

text: 脚痛就先休息。
pinyin: jiǎo tòng jiù xiān xiū xī .
meaning: If the foot hurts, rest first.

text: 痛苦
pinyin: tòng kǔ
meaning: pain; suffering

text: 这段经历让她感到痛苦。
pinyin: zhè duàn jīng lì ràng tā gǎn dào tòng kǔ .
meaning: This experience causes her suffering.

text: 命运
pinyin: mìng yùn
meaning: fate; destiny

text: 一次结果不能决定一个人的命运。
pinyin: yī cì jié guǒ bù néng jué dìng yī gè rén de mìng yùn .
meaning: One result cannot determine a person’s fate.

text: 没用
pinyin: méi yòng
meaning: useless; of no use

text: 只说加油对这次找地址没用。
pinyin: zhǐ shuō jiā yóu duì zhè cì zhǎo dì zhǐ méi yòng .
meaning: Merely cheering does not help find the address this time.

text: 考验
pinyin: kǎo yàn
meaning: test; to test

text: 这次合作是沟通的考验。
pinyin: zhè cì hé zuò shì gōu tōng de kǎo yàn .
meaning: This collaboration tests communication.

text: 精神力量
meaning: spirit; mental strength

text: 她愿意互相帮助的精神值得尊重。
pinyin: tā yuàn yì hù xiāng bāng zhù de jīng shén zhí de zūn zhòng .
meaning: Her spirit of mutual help merits respect.

text: 她不慌不忙地核对地址。
pinyin: tā bù huāng bù máng de hé duì dì zhǐ .
meaning: She checks the address unhurriedly.

text: 好是好，不过地点还没确认。
pinyin: hǎo shì hǎo , bù guò dì diǎn hái méi què rèn .
meaning: It is good, but the location is still unconfirmed.

text: 这个优点保留，地点再确认。
pinyin: zhè gè yōu diǎn bǎo liú , dì diǎn zài què rèn .
meaning: Keep this strength; confirm the place again.

text: 你说痛，我先听你说。
pinyin: nǐ shuō tòng , wǒ xiān tīng nǐ shuō .
meaning: You say it hurts; I will listen first.

text: 看起来
pinyin: kàn qi lái
meaning: to look; it seems

text: 照片看起来很亮。
pinyin: zhào piān kàn qi lái hěn liàng .
meaning: The photograph looks bright.

text: 看上去
pinyin: kàn shàng qu
meaning: to look; appear

text: 桥看上去很长。
pinyin: qiáo kàn shàng qu hěn zhǎng .
meaning: The bridge looks long.

text: 观察
pinyin: guān chá
meaning: to observe

text: 先观察光线，再说照片。
pinyin: xiān guān chá guāng xiàn , zài shuō zhào piān .
meaning: Observe the light before discussing the photograph.

text: 景色
pinyin: jǐng sè
meaning: scenery

text: 照片里的景色很美。
pinyin: zhào piān lǐ de jǐng sè hěn měi .
meaning: The scenery in the photograph is beautiful.

text: 美
pinyin: měi
meaning: beautiful

text: 这张照片很美。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhào piān hěn měi .
meaning: This photograph is beautiful.

text: 美好
pinyin: měi hǎo
meaning: pleasant; wonderful

text: 这张照片让我想到美好的周末。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhào piān ràng wǒ xiǎng dào měi hǎo de zhōu mò .
meaning: This photograph reminds me of a lovely weekend.

text: 美丽
pinyin: měi lì
meaning: beautiful

text: 天空的颜色很美丽。
pinyin: tiān kōng de yán sè hěn měi lì .
meaning: The sky’s colours are beautiful.

text: 天空
pinyin: tiān kōng
meaning: sky

text: 天空的颜色在照片里变了。
pinyin: tiān kōng de yán sè zài zhào piān lǐ biàn le .
meaning: The sky’s colour changed in the photograph.

text: 阳光
pinyin: yáng guāng
meaning: sunlight

text: 阳光照在桥边。
pinyin: yáng guāng zhào zài qiáo biān .
meaning: Sunlight shines beside the bridge.

text: 胖
pinyin: pàng
meaning: fat; stout

text: 模型看着胖，不代表真人也胖。
pinyin: mó xíng kàn zhe pàng , bù dài biǎo zhēn rén yě pàng .
meaning: The model looks stout; that does not imply the real person is too.

text: 拍
pinyin: pāi
meaning: to photograph; shoot

text: 拍之前先问她。
pinyin: pāi zhī qián xiān wèn tā .
meaning: Ask her before taking the photograph.

text: 图
pinyin: tú
meaning: picture; diagram

text: 这张图说明拍照的位置。
pinyin: zhè zhāng tú shuō míng pāi zhào de wèi zhì .
meaning: This diagram shows the photography position.

text: 图画
pinyin: tú huà
meaning: drawing; picture

text: 图画里的龙不是活的动物。
pinyin: tú huà lǐ de lóng bù shì huó de dòng wù .
meaning: The dragon in the drawing is not a living animal.

text: 沙子
pinyin: shā zi
meaning: sand

text: 沙子上有脚印。
pinyin: shā zi shàng yǒu jiǎo yìn .
meaning: There are footprints in the sand.

text: 石头
pinyin: shí tou
meaning: stone

text: 桥边放着一块石头。
pinyin: qiáo biān fàng zhe yī kuài shí tou .
meaning: A stone lies beside the bridge.

text: 桥
pinyin: qiáo
meaning: bridge

text: 桥就在图上的位置。
pinyin: qiáo jiù zài tú shàng de wèi zhì .
meaning: The bridge is at the position shown on the diagram.

text: 龙
pinyin: lóng
meaning: dragon

text: 墙上的图画画着一条龙。
pinyin: qiáng shàng de tú huà huà zhe yī tiáo lóng .
meaning: The wall picture depicts a dragon.

text: 牛
pinyin: niú
meaning: cow; cattle

text: 这张图里有一头牛。
pinyin: zhè zhāng tú lǐ yǒu yī tóu niú .
meaning: There is a cow in this picture.

text: 羊
pinyin: yáng
meaning: sheep; goat

text: 那只羊站在石头旁边。
pinyin: nà zhǐ yáng zhàn zài shí tou páng biān .
meaning: That sheep or goat stands beside the stone.

text: 猪
pinyin: zhū
meaning: pig

text: 猪的模型放在门边。
pinyin: zhū de mó xíng fàng zài mén biān .
meaning: A pig model stands by the door.

text: 香蕉
pinyin: xiāng jiāo
meaning: banana

text: 桌子上有一根香蕉。
pinyin: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gēn xiāng jiāo .
meaning: A banana is on the table.

text: 苹果
pinyin: píng guǒ
meaning: apple

text: 苹果放在香蕉旁边。
pinyin: píng guǒ fàng zài xiāng jiāo páng biān .
meaning: The apple is beside the banana.

text: 这张照片看起来很亮。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhào piān kàn qi lái hěn liàng .
meaning: This photograph looks bright.

text: 石头看上去很大。
pinyin: shí tou kàn shàng qu hěn dà .
meaning: The stone looks large.

text: 看起来是这样，实际还要确认。
pinyin: kàn qi lái shì zhè yàng , shí jì hái yào què rèn .
meaning: It looks that way; the actual situation needs checking.

text: 可以拍吗？可以公开吗？
pinyin: kě yǐ pāi ma ? kě yǐ gōng kāi ma ?
meaning: May I take it? May I publish it?

text: 开始
pinyin: kāi shǐ
meaning: to start; beginning

text: 新课程下周开始。
pinyin: xīn kè chéng xià zhōu kāi shǐ .
meaning: The new course starts next week.

text: 以来
pinyin: yǐ lái
meaning: since

text: 开课以来，她每次都做记录。
pinyin: kāi kè yǐ lái , tā měi cì dōu zuò jì lù .
meaning: Since the course began, she has recorded every session.

text: 后年
pinyin: hòu nián
meaning: the year after next

text: 后年的计划现在还没定。
pinyin: hòu nián de jì huà xiàn zài hái méi dìng .
meaning: The plan for the year after next is still undecided.

text: 教练
pinyin: jiào liàn
meaning: coach; trainer

text: 教练让她先放慢速度。
pinyin: jiào liàn ràng tā xiān fàng màn sù dù .
meaning: The coach asks her to slow down first.

text: 初
pinyin: chū
meaning: prefix for the first ten days of a lunar month

text: 农历初一、初二里的初用在日期前。
pinyin: nóng lì chū yī , chū èr lǐ de chū yòng zài rì qī qián .
meaning: The prefix 初 precedes the day number in lunar dates such as day one and day two.

text: 初步
pinyin: chū bù
meaning: preliminary; initial

text: 这只是初步安排。
pinyin: zhè zhǐ shì chū bù ān pái .
meaning: This is only a preliminary arrangement.

text: 初级
pinyin: chū jí
meaning: elementary; beginner level

text: 这门初级课程先练基础。
pinyin: zhè mén chū jí kè chéng xiān liàn jī chǔ .
meaning: This elementary course practises foundations first.

text: 初中
pinyin: chū zhōng
meaning: junior secondary school

text: 她初中时就开始记日记。
pinyin: tā chū zhōng shí jiù kāi shǐ jì rì jì .
meaning: She began keeping a diary in junior secondary school.

text: 将近
pinyin: jiāng jìn
meaning: almost; nearly

text: 等了将近十分钟。
pinyin: děng le jiāng jìn shí fēn zhōng .
meaning: We waited almost ten minutes.

text: 接近
pinyin: jiē jìn
meaning: to approach; be close to

text: 现在接近约定的时间。
pinyin: xiàn zài jiē jìn yuē dìng de shí jiān .
meaning: It is now near the agreed time.

text: 等待
pinyin: děng dài
meaning: to wait

text: 等待时先看通知。
pinyin: děng dài shí xiān kàn tōng zhī .
meaning: Read the notice while waiting.

text: 到达
pinyin: dào dá
meaning: to arrive; reach

text: 她已经到达教室。
pinyin: tā yǐ jīng dào dá jiào shì .
meaning: She has arrived at the classroom.

text: 赶
pinyin: gǎn
meaning: to hurry; rush

text: 她赶着去上课。
pinyin: tā gǎn zhe qù shàng kè .
meaning: She is hurrying to class.

text: 赶到
pinyin: gǎn dào
meaning: to reach in time; hurry to

text: 她下课前赶到了。
pinyin: tā xià kè qián gǎn dào le .
meaning: She arrived in time before class ended.

text: 前后
pinyin: qián hòu
meaning: approximately; before and after

text: 活动十点前后开始。
pinyin: huó dòng shí diǎn qián hòu kāi shǐ .
meaning: The event starts around ten.

text: 慢慢
pinyin: màn màn
meaning: slowly; gradually

text: 先慢慢熟悉路线。
pinyin: xiān màn màn shú xī lù xiàn .
meaning: Become familiar with the route gradually.

text: 时刻
pinyin: shí kè
meaning: moment; time

text: 到达的时刻记在这里。
pinyin: dào dá de shí kè jì zài zhè lǐ .
meaning: The arrival time is recorded here.

text: 时
pinyin: shí
meaning: when; time

text: 等待时可以看教材。
pinyin: děng dài shí kě yǐ kàn jiào cái .
meaning: You may read the material while waiting.

text: 纪录
pinyin: jì lù
meaning: record; documented result

text: 这是练习纪录，不是正式比赛纪录。
pinyin: zhè shì liàn xí jì lù , bù shì zhèng shì bǐ sài jì lù .
meaning: This is a practice record, not an official competition record.

text: 录
pinyin: lù
meaning: to record

text: 她想录一段自己的声音。
pinyin: tā xiǎng lù yī duàn zì jǐ de shēng yīn .
meaning: She wants to record her own voice.

text: 录音
pinyin: lù yīn
meaning: audio recording; to record audio

text: 这段录音只用于自己复习。
pinyin: zhè duàn lù yīn zhǐ yòng yú zì jǐ fù xí .
meaning: This recording is only for personal review.

text: 期
pinyin: qī
meaning: issue; period classifier

text: 她订了一期杂志。
pinyin: tā dìng le yī qī zá zhì .
meaning: She subscribed to one issue of the magazine.

text: 从下周起，每周练两次。
pinyin: cóng xià zhōu qǐ , měi zhōu liàn liǎng cì .
meaning: Starting next week, practise twice a week.

text: 她离开这里三天了。
pinyin: tā lí kāi zhè lǐ sān tiān le .
meaning: It has been three days since she left here.

text: 是上了半小时，还是下课半小时了？
pinyin: shì shàng le bàn xiǎo shí , hái shi xià kè bàn xiǎo shí le ?
meaning: Is it half an hour of class, or half an hour since class ended?

text: 接近了，还没到。
pinyin: jiē jìn le , hái méi dào .
meaning: Nearly there; not arrived yet.

text: 课程
pinyin: kè chéng
meaning: course

text: 课程先练听力，再练回答。
pinyin: kè chéng xiān liàn tīng lì , zài liàn huí dá .
meaning: The course practises listening before responding.

text: 教材
pinyin: jiào cái
meaning: teaching material; textbook

text: 教材里的例子要放回上下文。
pinyin: jiào cái lǐ de lì zi yào fàng huí shàng xià wén .
meaning: Put textbook examples back into context.

text: 基础
pinyin: jī chǔ
meaning: foundation; basics

text: 基础还不稳，先慢一点。
pinyin: jī chǔ hái bù wěn , xiān màn yī diǎn .
meaning: The foundations are not yet firm; slow down first.

text: 基本
pinyin: jī běn
meaning: basic; fundamental

text: 先看基本要求。
pinyin: xiān kàn jī běn yāo qiú .
meaning: Check the basic requirements first.

text: 基本上
pinyin: jī běn shàng
meaning: basically; mostly

text: 意思基本上懂了，细节还没确认。
pinyin: yì si jī běn shàng dǒng le , xì jié hái méi què rèn .

pinyin: shī wàng
meaning: disappointed

text: 没买到票，我有点失望。
pinyin: méi mǎi dào piào , wǒ yǒu diǎn shī wàng .
meaning: I’m a little disappointed I couldn’t get tickets.

text: 赞成
pinyin: zàn chéng
meaning: agree with; support an opinion

text: 我赞成先看完再讨论。
pinyin: wǒ zàn chéng xiān kàn wán zài tǎo lùn .
meaning: I agree we should finish watching before discussing it.

text: 你怎么评价这个演员？
pinyin: nǐ zěn me píng jià zhè gè yǎn yuán ?
meaning: How would you assess this actor?

text: 这个演员以前演过老师。
pinyin: zhè gè yǎn yuán yǐ qián yǎn guò lǎo shī .
meaning: This actor played a teacher before.

text: 导演没有把最后的答案说出来。
pinyin: dǎo yǎn méi yǒu bǎ zuì hòu de dá àn shuō chū lái .
meaning: The director didn’t give away the final answer.

text: 观众都安静下来，等演出开始。
pinyin: guān zhòng dōu ān jìng xià lái , děng yǎn chū kāi shǐ .
meaning: The audience grew quiet, waiting for the performance.

text: 尽管中间有点慢，但是最后一段很好。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn zhōng jiān yǒu diǎn màn , dàn shì zuì hòu yī duàn hěn hǎo .
meaning: Although the middle is slow, the final section is good.

text: 他不一定会回来。
pinyin: tā bù yí dìng huì huí lái .
meaning: He won’t necessarily return.

text: 我又没说整部都好。
pinyin: wǒ yòu méi shuō zhěng bù dōu hǎo .
meaning: I didn’t say the whole thing was good.

text: 把不同意见说具体，反而少争论了。
pinyin: bǎ bù tóng yì jiàn shuō jù tǐ , fǎn ér shǎo zhēng lùn le .
meaning: Making our different views specific actually reduced the arguing.

text: 这一段我看法不一样。
pinyin: zhè yī duàn wǒ kàn fǎ bù yī yàng .
meaning: I see this section differently.

text: 我喜欢最后一段，没说整部都好。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān zuì hòu yī duàn , méi shuō zhěng bù dōu hǎo .
meaning: I liked the last part; I did not say the whole film was good.

text: 航班
pinyin: háng bān
meaning: flight

text: 这个航班明天早上出发。
pinyin: zhè gè háng bān míng tiān zǎo shàng chū fā .
meaning: This flight departs tomorrow morning.

text: 航空
pinyin: háng kōng
meaning: aviation; air transport

text: 这家航空公司有晚上的航班。
pinyin: zhè jiā háng kōng gōng sī yǒu wǎn shang de háng bān .
meaning: This airline has evening flights.

text: 长途
pinyin: cháng tú
meaning: long-distance

text: 这次长途旅行，我们准备坐火车。
pinyin: zhè cì cháng tú lǚ xíng , wǒ men zhǔn bèi zuò huǒ chē .
meaning: We plan to take the train on this long trip.

text: 高铁
pinyin: gāo tiě
meaning: high-speed rail

text: 坐高铁到那里大约两小时。
pinyin: zuò gāo tiě dào nà lǐ dà yuē liǎng xiǎo shí .
meaning: It takes around two hours to get there by high-speed train.

text: 晚点
pinyin: wǎn diǎn
meaning: be delayed, of transport

text: 这趟车晚点了半小时。
pinyin: zhè tàng chē wǎn diǎn le bàn xiǎo shí .
meaning: This service is half an hour late.

text: 预订
pinyin: yù dìng
meaning: book in advance

text: 我想预订周六晚上的房间。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yù dìng zhōu liù wǎn shang de fáng jiān .
meaning: I’d like to book a room for Saturday night.

text: 确认
pinyin: què rèn
meaning: confirm

text: 你再确认一下车站名字。
pinyin: nǐ zài què rèn yī xià chē zhàn míng zi .
meaning: Check the station name once more.

text: 途中
pinyin: tú zhōng
meaning: on the way; en route

text: 我们途中休息了十分钟。
pinyin: wǒ men tú zhōng xiū xī le shí fēn zhōng .
meaning: We took a ten-minute break on the way.

text: 堵车
pinyin: dǔ chē
meaning: be held up in traffic

text: 路上堵车，我可能晚一点到。
pinyin: lù shàng dǔ chē , wǒ kě néng wǎn yī diǎn dào .
meaning: I’m stuck in traffic and may arrive a little late.

text: 距离
pinyin: jù lí
meaning: distance

text: 两个车站之间的距离有多远？
pinyin: liǎng gè chē zhàn zhī jiān de jù lí yǒu duō yuǎn ?
meaning: How far apart are the two stations?

text: 立即
pinyin: lì jí
meaning: immediately

text: 看到通知以后，我立即给她打了电话。
pinyin: kàn dào tōng zhī yǐ hòu , wǒ lì jí gěi tā dǎ le diàn huà .
meaning: I called her immediately after seeing the notice.

text: 期限
pinyin: qī xiàn
meaning: deadline; time limit

text: 申请期限到周四晚上。
pinyin: shēn qǐng qī xiàn dào zhōu sì wǎn shang .
meaning: The application deadline is Thursday evening.

text: 延期
pinyin: yán qī
meaning: postpone; extend a deadline

text: 这次活动延期到下周了。
pinyin: zhè cì huó dòng yán qī dào xià zhōu le .
meaning: This event has been postponed until next week.

text: 两点那趟车取消了。
pinyin: liǎng diǎn nà tàng chē qǔ xiāo le .
meaning: The two o’clock service has been cancelled.

text: 转告
pinyin: zhuǎn gào
meaning: pass a message on

text: 请转告陈宇，我会晚半小时。
pinyin: qǐng zhuǎn gào chén yǔ , wǒ huì wǎn bàn xiǎo shí .
meaning: Please tell Chen Yu I’ll be half an hour late.

text: 我们几点出发比较好？
pinyin: wǒ men jǐ diǎn chū fā bǐ jiào hǎo ?
meaning: What time should we set off?

text: 除非先办好新票，否则不能直接上这趟车。
pinyin: chú fēi xiān bàn hǎo xīn piào , fǒu zé bù néng zhí jiē shàng zhè tàng chē .
meaning: Unless the new ticket is processed first, you can’t board this service directly.

text: 万一来不及，我就先给你电话。
pinyin: wàn yī lái bù jí , wǒ jiù xiān gěi nǐ diàn huà .
meaning: If I happen to run out of time, I’ll call you first.

text: 我们三点十分才出发。
pinyin: wǒ men sān diǎn shí fēn cái chū fā .
meaning: We won’t depart until 3:10.

text: 把两张票分开放，免得拿错。
pinyin: bǎ liǎng zhāng piào fēn kāi fàng , miǎn de ná cuò .
meaning: Keep the tickets apart so you don’t take the wrong one.

text: 到了先找三号窗口，三点前要办好。
pinyin: dào le xiān zhǎo sān hào chuāng kǒu , sān diǎn qián yào bàn hǎo .
meaning: Find counter three when you arrive; it must be done before three.

text: 我说的是快到车站，还没到你家。
pinyin: wǒ shuō de shì kuài dào chē zhàn , hái méi dào nǐ jiā .
meaning: I meant nearly at the station, not at your home yet.

text: 原则
pinyin: yuán zé
meaning: principle

text: 先问本人，是我们做这件事的原则。
pinyin: xiān wèn běn rén , shì wǒ men zuò zhè jiàn shì de yuán zé .
meaning: Asking the person first is our principle for this.

text: 我不在乎坐哪里，只要能听清。
pinyin: wǒ bù zài hū zuò nǎ lǐ , zhǐ yào néng tīng qīng .
meaning: I don’t mind where I sit as long as I can hear.

text: 在乎
pinyin: zài hū
meaning: care about

text: 我在乎的是你愿不愿意来，不是礼物。
pinyin: wǒ zài hū de shì nǐ yuàn bù yuàn yì lái , bù shì lǐ wù .
meaning: What matters to me is whether you want to come, not the gift.

text: 相处
pinyin: xiāng chǔ
meaning: get along; spend time together

text: 和她相处很轻松，不用一直找话题。
pinyin: hé tā xiāng chǔ hěn qīng sōng , bù yòng yì zhí zhǎo huà tí .
meaning: Spending time with her is easy; I don’t have to keep finding topics.

text: 我可能误会了，你不是这个意思吧？
pinyin: wǒ kě néng wù huì le , nǐ bù shì zhè gè yì si ba ?
meaning: I may have misunderstood; that isn’t what you meant, is it?

text: 难免
pinyin: nán miǎn
meaning: hard to avoid; inevitably sometimes

text: 刚到新的地方，难免有点不习惯。
pinyin: gāng dào xīn de dì fāng , nán miǎn yǒu diǎn bù xí guàn .
meaning: It’s natural to feel a little unfamiliar in a new place.

text: 约会
pinyin: yuē huì
meaning: date; arranged meeting

text: 他们第一次约会是在这家咖啡店。
pinyin: tā men dì yī cì yuē huì shì zài zhè jiā kā fēi diàn .
meaning: Their first date was at this café.

text: 我承认自己回复得太晚了。
pinyin: wǒ chéng rèn zì jǐ huí fù de tài wǎn le .
meaning: I admit I replied too late.

text: 担心
pinyin: dān xīn
meaning: worry; be concerned

text: 我担心你以为我不想见你。
pinyin: wǒ dān xīn nǐ yǐ wéi wǒ bù xiǎng jiàn nǐ .
meaning: I’m worried you’ll think I don’t want to see you.

text: 考虑
pinyin: kǎo lǜ
meaning: consider

text: 我想考虑一下，明天回复你。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kǎo lǜ yī xià , míng tiān huí fù nǐ .
meaning: I’d like to think about it and reply tomorrow.

text: 回复
pinyin: huí fù
meaning: reply

text: 谢谢你这么快回复。
pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ zhè me kuài huí fù .
meaning: Thanks for replying so quickly.

text: 你可以直接告诉我，不用猜我想听什么。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē gào sù wǒ , bù yòng cāi wǒ xiǎng tīng shén me .
meaning: You can tell me directly; no need to guess what I want to hear.

text: 她的态度很认真，但说话不重。
pinyin: tā de tài dù hěn rèn zhēn , dàn shuō huà bù zhòng .
meaning: She takes it seriously without speaking harshly.

text: 我答应周二陪你吃饭。
pinyin: wǒ dā yìng zhōu èr péi nǐ chī fàn .
meaning: I agreed to have dinner with you on Tuesday.

text: 我想解释一下为什么没去。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me méi qù .
meaning: I’d like to explain why I didn’t go.

text: 她坚持每周给家里打电话。
pinyin: tā jiān chí měi zhōu gěi jiā lǐ dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: She keeps calling home every week.

text: 我不是不想见你，而是今天想早点回家。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng jiàn nǐ , ér shì jīn tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā .
meaning: It isn’t that I don’t want to see you; I want to go home early today.

text: 我怕你不高兴，才一直没说。
pinyin: wǒ pà nǐ bù gāo xìng , cái yì zhí méi shuō .
meaning: I kept quiet because I was worried you’d be upset.

text: 哪怕只坐十分钟，我也想见你一下。
pinyin: nǎ pà zhǐ zuò shí fēn zhōng , wǒ yě xiǎng jiàn nǐ yī xià .
meaning: Even if I can stay only ten minutes, I still want to see you.

text: 约好具体时间，比只说以后再约更有用。
pinyin: yuē hǎo jù tǐ shí jiān , bǐ zhǐ shuō yǐ hòu zài yuē gèng yǒu yòng .
meaning: Agreeing a specific time is more useful than just saying we’ll meet sometime.

text: 这次我不去，周二想单独和你吃饭。
pinyin: zhè cì wǒ bù qù , zhōu èr xiǎng dān dú hé nǐ chī fàn .
meaning: I will skip this one; I would like dinner with you on Tuesday.

text: 我回复晚了，让你不好算人数。
pinyin: wǒ huí fù wǎn le , ràng nǐ bù hǎo suàn rén shù .
meaning: I replied late, which made the headcount difficult.

text: 调皮
pinyin: tiáo pí
meaning: mischievous; playful

text: 这个孩子有点调皮，但不爱骗人。
pinyin: zhè gè hái zi yǒu diǎn tiáo pí , dàn bù ài piàn rén .
meaning: This child is a little mischievous but doesn’t like lying.

text: 过分
pinyin: guò fèn
meaning: excessive; go too far

text: 让一个人做完这些，太过分了。
pinyin: ràng yī gè rén zuò wán zhè xiē , tài guò fèn le .
meaning: Making one person do all this is too much.

text: 天真
pinyin: tiān zhēn
meaning: innocent; naive

text: 小时候我天真地以为月亮会跟着我走。
pinyin: xiǎo shí hòu wǒ tiān zhēn de yǐ wéi yuè liàng huì gēn zhe wǒ zǒu .
meaning: As a child I naively thought the moon followed me.

text: 得意
pinyin: dé yì
meaning: pleased with oneself; smug

text: 他赢了以后，笑得很得意。
pinyin: tā yíng le yǐ hòu , xiào de hěn dé yì .
meaning: After winning he smiled smugly.

text: 大方
pinyin: dà fāng
meaning: generous; at ease in manner

text: 她很大方，把自己的书借给大家。
pinyin: tā hěn dà fāng , bǎ zì jǐ de shū jiè gěi dà jiā .
meaning: She’s generous and lends everyone her books.

text: 看不起
pinyin: kàn bù qǐ
meaning: look down on

text: 他从来不因为工作不同就看不起别人。
pinyin: tā cóng lái bù yīn wèi gōng zuò bù tóng jiù kàn bù qǐ bié ren .
meaning: He never looks down on people for doing different work.

text: 自信
pinyin: zì xìn
meaning: self-confident; confidence

text: 准备以后，我比刚才自信多了。
pinyin: zhǔn bèi yǐ hòu , wǒ bǐ gāng cái zì xìn duō le .
meaning: After preparing I’m much more confident than before.

text: 亲密
pinyin: qīn mì
meaning: close; intimate

text: 他们从小一起长大，关系很亲密。
pinyin: tā men cóng xiǎo yì qǐ zhǎng dà , guān xì hěn qīn mì .
meaning: They grew up together and are very close.

text: 语法
pinyin: yǔ fǎ
meaning: grammar

text: 这句语法没错，但不适合这个场合。
pinyin: zhè jù yǔ fǎ méi cuò , dàn bù shì hé zhè gè chǎng hé .
meaning: The grammar is correct, but it doesn’t fit this situation.

text: 语音
pinyin: yǔ yīn
meaning: speech sounds; voice message

text: 这次课先练语音，再练对话。
pinyin: zhè cì kè xiān liàn yǔ yīn , zài liàn duì huà .
meaning: This class practises speech sounds before dialogue.

text: 形容
pinyin: xíng róng
meaning: describe

text: 你会怎么形容这个人的表情？
pinyin: nǐ huì zěn me xíng róng zhè gè rén de biǎo qíng ?
meaning: How would you describe this person’s expression?

text: 我把他的玩笑当真，误会了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ tā de wán xiào dàng zhēn , wù huì le .
meaning: I took his joke seriously and misunderstood.

text: 这个话题我们上次聊过。
pinyin: zhè gè huà tí wǒ men shàng cì liáo guò .
meaning: We talked about this topic last time.

text: 他们关系很好，但意见不总一样。
pinyin: tā men guān xì hěn hǎo , dàn yì jiàn bù zǒng yī yàng .
meaning: They have a good relationship but don’t always agree.

text: 他说话时表情很认真。
pinyin: tā shuō huà shí biǎo qíng hěn rèn zhēn .
meaning: His expression was serious as he spoke.

text: 放松
pinyin: fàng sōng
meaning: relax; loosen

text: 先坐一会儿，放松一下。
pinyin: xiān zuò yī huì er , fàng sōng yī xià .
meaning: Sit for a while and relax.

text: 你今天可真早。
pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān kě zhēn zǎo .
meaning: You’re really early today.

text: 这件外套怪好看的。
pinyin: zhè jiàn wài tào guài hǎo kàn de .
meaning: This coat is quite nice.

text: 我才不要这个奖呢。
pinyin: wǒ cái bú yào zhè gè jiǎng ne .
meaning: I don’t want this award.

text: 还没吃怎么夸味道？
pinyin: hái méi chī zěn me kuā wèi dào ?
meaning: How can I praise the taste before eating?

text: 我刚才开玩笑的，不过那句说得不合适。
pinyin: wǒ gāng cái kāi wán xiào de , bù guò nà jù shuō de bù hé shì .
meaning: I was joking, but that line was not well chosen.

text: 没关系，先坐吧，我告诉你刚才说到哪儿。
pinyin: méi guān xì , xiān zuò ba , wǒ gào sù nǐ gāng cái shuō dào nǎr .
meaning: It is okay; sit down and I will tell you where we got to.

text: 概括
pinyin: gài kuò
meaning: summarise; give the main points

text: 你能用两句话概括这个故事吗？
pinyin: nǐ néng yòng liǎng jù huà gài kuò zhè gè gù shì ma ?
meaning: Can you summarise this story in two sentences?

text: 先描述你看到的，再说你怎么想。
pinyin: xiān miáo shù nǐ kàn dào de , zài shuō nǐ zěn me xiǎng .
meaning: Describe what you saw before saying what you think.

text: 主题
pinyin: zhǔ tí
meaning: theme; main subject

text: 这篇文章的主题是离开家以后怎样交朋友。
pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng de zhǔ tí shì lí kāi jiā yǐ hòu zěn yàng jiāo péng yǒu .
meaning: This article is about making friends after leaving home.

text: 顺序
pinyin: shùn xù
meaning: order; sequence

text: 把这些事按发生的顺序讲。
pinyin: bǎ zhè xiē shì àn fā shēng de shùn xù jiǎng .
meaning: Tell these events in the order they happened.

text: 故事的背景是一座小城。
pinyin: gù shì de bèi jǐng shì yī zuò xiǎo chéng .
meaning: The story is set in a small town.

text: 这个角色一开始不愿意说实话。
pinyin: zhè gè jué sè yī kāi shǐ bù yuàn yì shuō shí huà .
meaning: This character doesn’t want to tell the truth at first.

text: 别忘了信放在桌上的那个细节。
pinyin: bié wàng le xìn fàng zài zhuō shàng de nà gè xì jié .
meaning: Don’t forget the detail about the letter on the table.

text: 我们现在还不能下这个结论。
pinyin: wǒ men xiàn zài hái bù néng xià zhè gè jié lùn .
meaning: We can’t draw that conclusion yet.

text: 他离开的原因是什么？
pinyin: tā lí kāi de yuán yīn shì shén me ?
meaning: Why did he leave?

text: 最后的结果和我想的不一样。
pinyin: zuì hòu de jié guǒ hé wǒ xiǎng de bù yī yàng .
meaning: The final outcome differs from what I expected.

text: 于是
pinyin: yú shì
meaning: so; thereupon

text: 雨突然大了，于是我们进了旁边的店。
pinyin: yǔ tū rán dà le , yú shì wǒ men jìn le páng biān de diàn .
meaning: The rain suddenly got heavier, so we went into the shop beside us.

text: 从此
pinyin: cóng cǐ
meaning: from then on

text: 从此，她每年都会回来看一次。
pinyin: cóng cǐ , tā měi nián dū huì huí lái kàn yī cì .
meaning: From then on she returned once a year.

text: 最初
pinyin: zuì chū
meaning: initially; at first

text: 我最初以为他不来了。
pinyin: wǒ zuì chū yǐ wéi tā bù lái le .
meaning: At first I thought he wasn’t coming.

text: 最后，你总结一下今天讨论的内容。
pinyin: zuì hòu , nǐ zǒng jié yī xià jīn tiān tǎo lùn de nèi róng .
meaning: At the end, sum up what we discussed today.

text: 哪一个画面给你的印象最深？
pinyin: nǎ yī gè huà miàn gěi nǐ de yìn xiàng zuì shēn ?
meaning: Which image made the strongest impression on you?

text: 这是我第一次一个人旅行的经历。
pinyin: zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì yī gè rén lǚ xíng de jīng lì .
meaning: This was my first experience of travelling alone.

text: 他看见身份证，于是给妹妹打电话。
pinyin: tā kàn jiàn shēn fèn zhèng , yú shì gěi mèi mei dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: He saw the ID and then called his sister.

text: 从此，她每年都去一次。
pinyin: cóng cǐ , tā měi nián dōu qù yī cì .
meaning: From then on she went once a year.

text: 他先看见纸条，又发现身份证，再给她打电话。
pinyin: tā xiān kàn jiàn zhǐ tiáo , yòu fā xiàn shēn fèn zhèng , zài gěi tā dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: He saw the note, found the ID and then called her.

text: 她不是不要帮助，只是不想每次都让哥哥送。
pinyin: tā bù shì bú yào bāng zhù , zhǐ shì bù xiǎng měi cì dōu ràng gē gē sòng .
meaning: She doesn’t reject help; she doesn’t want her brother to take her every time.

text: 我猜他可能担心，不过场景没有直接说。
pinyin: wǒ cāi tā kě néng dān xīn , bù guò chǎng jǐng méi yǒu zhí jiē shuō .
meaning: I guess he may be worried, but the scene does not directly say so.

text: 她忘了证件，哥哥送到车站，她仍然自己上了车。
pinyin: tā wàng le zhèng jiàn , gē gē sòng dào chē zhàn , tā réng rán zì jǐ shàng le chē .
meaning: She forgot her ID, her brother brought it to the station, and she still boarded on her own.

text: 冲突
pinyin: chōng tū
meaning: conflict; clash

text: 这两个安排有时间冲突。
pinyin: zhè liǎng gè ān pái yǒu shí jiān chōng tū .
meaning: These two arrangements clash in time.

text: 沟通
pinyin: gōu tōng
meaning: communicate

text: 有变化就早点沟通，别等到最后。
pinyin: yǒu biàn huà jiù zǎo diǎn gōu tōng , bié děng dào zuì hòu .
meaning: Communicate changes early rather than at the last moment.

text: 真诚
pinyin: zhēn chéng
meaning: sincere

text: 她的感谢很真诚，不是随口说的。
pinyin: tā de gǎn xiè hěn zhēn chéng , bù shì suí kǒu shuō de .
meaning: Her thanks are sincere, not just casual words.

text: 尊重
pinyin: zūn zhòng
meaning: respect

text: 我尊重你的决定，但想问清楚原因。
pinyin: wǒ zūn zhòng nǐ de jué dìng , dàn xiǎng wèn qīng chǔ yuán yīn .
meaning: I respect your decision but want to understand the reason.

text: 矛盾
pinyin: máo dùn
meaning: contradiction; conflict

text: 他说不在乎，却一直抱怨，这有点矛盾。
pinyin: tā shuō bù zài hū , què yì zhí bào yuàn , zhè yǒu diǎn máo dùn .
meaning: He says he doesn’t care but keeps complaining; that seems contradictory.

text: 抱怨
pinyin: bào yuàn
meaning: complain

text: 她抱怨等了很久，却没人告诉她原因。
pinyin: tā bào yuàn děng le hěn jiǔ , què méi rén gào sù tā yuán yīn .
meaning: She complained she’d waited a long time without anyone explaining why.

text: 偶然
pinyin: ǒu rán
meaning: by chance; accidental

text: 我们在车站偶然遇见了。
pinyin: wǒ men zài chē zhàn ǒu rán yù jiàn le .
meaning: We ran into each other at the station by chance.

text: 失误
pinyin: shī wù
meaning: mistake; error

text: 这次失误是我把时间记错了。
pinyin: zhè cì shī wù shì wǒ bǎ shí jiān jì cuò le .
meaning: My mistake this time was remembering the time incorrectly.

text: 无奈
pinyin: wú nài
meaning: helpless; having no good option

text: 她无奈地笑了，说车已经走了。
pinyin: tā wú nài de xiào le , shuō chē yǐ jīng zǒu le .
meaning: She smiled helplessly and said the bus had gone.

text: 消极
pinyin: xiāo jí
meaning: negative; passive

text: 一直等别人决定，太消极了。
pinyin: yì zhí děng bié ren jué dìng , tài xiāo jí le .
meaning: Waiting for others to decide is too passive.

text: 友谊
pinyin: yǒu yì
meaning: friendship

text: 我们的友谊不是靠每天见面维持的。
pinyin: wǒ men de yǒu yì bù shì kào měi tiān jiàn miàn wéi chí de .
meaning: Our friendship doesn’t depend on meeting every day.

text: 珍惜
pinyin: zhēn xī
meaning: cherish; value

text: 我很珍惜能一起做事的机会。
pinyin: wǒ hěn zhēn xī néng yì qǐ zuò shì de jī huì .
meaning: I value the chance to work together.

text: 联络
pinyin: lián luò
meaning: contact; keep in touch

text: 到了以后，我会和你联络。
pinyin: dào le yǐ hòu , wǒ huì hé nǐ lián luò .
meaning: I’ll contact you after arriving.

text: 指责
pinyin: zhǐ zé
meaning: accuse; criticise

text: 我想讨论这次安排，不是指责你这个人。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng tǎo lùn zhè cì ān pái , bù shì zhǐ zé nǐ zhè gè rén .
meaning: I want to discuss this arrangement, not attack you as a person.

text: 犹豫
pinyin: yóu yù
meaning: hesitate

text: 我犹豫了一下，还是给她打了电话。
pinyin: wǒ yóu yù le yī xià , hái shi gěi tā dǎ le diàn huà .
meaning: I hesitated briefly, then called her anyway.

text: 误解
pinyin: wù jiě
meaning: misunderstand; misunderstanding

text: 我担心你误解了那句话。
pinyin: wǒ dān xīn nǐ wù jiě le nà jù huà .
meaning: I’m worried you misunderstood that sentence.

text: 这次多出来的工作，我来承担。
pinyin: zhè cì duō chū lái de gōng zuò , wǒ lái chéng dān .
meaning: I’ll take on the extra work this time.

text: 我不能保证几点到，会再告诉你。
pinyin: wǒ bù néng bǎo zhèng jǐ diǎn dào , huì zài gào sù nǐ .
meaning: I can’t promise an arrival time; I’ll update you.

text: 她很可靠，有变化会主动说。
pinyin: tā hěn kě kào , yǒu biàn huà huì zhǔ dòng shuō .
meaning: She’s reliable and says when something changes.

text: 我信任你，才把这件事交给你。
pinyin: wǒ xìn rèn nǐ , cái bǎ zhè jiàn shì jiāo gěi nǐ .
meaning: I entrusted you with this because I trust you.

text: 我承认这次没有及时联系你。
pinyin: wǒ chéng rèn zhè cì méi yǒu jí shí lián xì nǐ .
meaning: I admit I didn’t contact you promptly this time.

text: 我等过以后，才体会到你的感受。
pinyin: wǒ děng guò yǐ hòu , cái tǐ huì dào nǐ de gǎn shòu .
meaning: After waiting myself, I understood how you felt.

text: 耐心
pinyin: nài xīn
meaning: patience; patient

text: 谢谢你耐心听我说完。
pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ nài xīn tīng wǒ shuō wán .
meaning: Thank you for patiently hearing me out.

text: 尊敬
pinyin: zūn jìng
meaning: respect; hold in esteem

text: 我很尊敬这位老师，她总会认真回答。
pinyin: wǒ hěn zūn jìng zhè wèi lǎo shī , tā zǒng huì rèn zhēn huí dá .
meaning: I respect this teacher; she always answers thoughtfully.

text: 我们毕竟约好了，他会等也正常。
pinyin: wǒ men bì jìng yuē hǎo le , tā huì děng yě zhèng cháng .
meaning: After all, we had made a plan; it makes sense he waited.

text: 我们明明约了两点，你却三点才来。
pinyin: wǒ men míng míng yuē le liǎng diǎn , nǐ què sān diǎn cái lái .
meaning: We agreed on two, yet you only came at three.

text: 他没来，邻居倒是主动帮了忙。
pinyin: tā méi lái , lín jū dǎo shì zhǔ dòng bāng le máng .
meaning: He did not come, but the neighbour unexpectedly offered help.

text: 尽管会议是临时的，但是我仍然该联系你。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn huì yì shì lín shí de , dàn shì wǒ réng rán gāi lián xì nǐ .
meaning: Although the meeting came up unexpectedly, I still should have contacted you.

text: 我不是抱怨你忙，而是想知道你来不来。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì bào yuàn nǐ máng , ér shì xiǎng zhī dào nǐ lái bù lái .
meaning: I am not complaining that you are busy; I want to know whether you are coming.

text: 我不知道你还来不来，所以一直没有找别人。
pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ hái lái bù lái , suǒ yǐ yì zhí méi yǒu zhǎo bié ren .
meaning: I did not know whether you were still coming, so I did not ask someone else.

text: 我四点可以到，三点以前不能保证。
pinyin: wǒ sì diǎn kě yǐ dào , sān diǎn yǐ qián bù néng bǎo zhèng .
meaning: I can arrive at four; I cannot guarantee before three.

text: 我没有及时联系你，让你不好改安排。
pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu jí shí lián xì nǐ , ràng nǐ bù hǎo gǎi ān pái .
meaning: I did not contact you promptly, which made changing plans difficult.

text: 安慰
pinyin: ān wèi
meaning: comfort; reassure

text: 谢谢你安慰我，不过我想先安静一会儿。
pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ ān wèi wǒ , bù guò wǒ xiǎng xiān ān jìng yī huì er .
meaning: Thanks for comforting me, but I’d like a quiet moment first.

text: 你能耐心听完，再说哪里要改吗？
pinyin: nǐ néng nài xīn tīng wán , zài shuō nǎ lǐ yào gǎi ma ?
meaning: Could you listen patiently to the end before saying what to change?

text: 心态
pinyin: xīn tài
meaning: mindset; attitude

text: 我想换个心态，把这次当作练习。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng huàn gè xīn tài , bǎ zhè cì dàng zuò liàn xí .
meaning: I’d like to treat this as practice with a different mindset.

text: 心疼
pinyin: xīn téng
meaning: feel for someone; feel distressed about

text: 看你忙了这么久，我有点心疼。
pinyin: kàn nǐ máng le zhè me jiǔ , wǒ yǒu diǎn xīn téng .
meaning: I feel for you after seeing how long you’ve been busy.

text: 鼓励
pinyin: gǔ lì
meaning: encourage

text: 老师鼓励我再试一次。
pinyin: lǎo shī gǔ lì wǒ zài shì yī cì .
meaning: The teacher encouraged me to try again.

text: 打击
pinyin: dǎ jī
meaning: blow; discourage; strike

text: 这次结果对他的打击很大。
pinyin: zhè cì jié guǒ duì tā de dǎ jī hěn dà .
meaning: This result was a major blow to him.

text: 我在第二句有一个失误。
pinyin: wǒ zài dì èr jù yǒu yī gè shī wù .
meaning: I made a mistake in the second line.

text: 没有达到自己的目标，我有点失望。
pinyin: méi yǒu dá dào zì jǐ de mù biāo , wǒ yǒu diǎn shī wàng .
meaning: I’m a little disappointed I didn’t reach my own goal.

text: 自豪
pinyin: zì háo
meaning: proud

text: 我为她坚持完成这件事感到自豪。
pinyin: wǒ wèi tā jiān chí wán chéng zhè jiàn shì gǎn dào zì háo .
meaning: I’m proud of her for seeing it through.

text: 勇气
pinyin: yǒng qì
meaning: courage

text: 第一次上台，我用了很大勇气。
pinyin: dì yī cì shàng tái , wǒ yòng le hěn dà yǒng qì .
meaning: It took courage for me to go on stage the first time.

text: 吃力
pinyin: chī lì
meaning: strenuous; have difficulty

text: 这段太快，我跟得很吃力。
pinyin: zhè duàn tài kuài , wǒ gēn de hěn chī lì .
meaning: This part is so fast I struggle to keep up.

text: 恢复
pinyin: huī fù
meaning: recover; restore

text: 休息以后，我恢复了一点精神。
pinyin: xiū xī yǐ hòu , wǒ huī fù le yī diǎn jīng shén .
meaning: After resting, I got some energy back.

text: 缺乏
pinyin: quē fá
meaning: lack

text: 我不是不想说，只是缺乏练习机会。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng shuō , zhǐ shì quē fá liàn xí jī huì .
meaning: I do want to speak; I just lack chances to practise.

text: 难以
pinyin: nán yǐ
meaning: difficult to

text: 第一次听，难以判断他是什么意思。
pinyin: dì yī cì tīng , nán yǐ pàn duàn tā shì shén me yì si .
meaning: On first hearing, it’s difficult to judge what he means.

text: 渴望
pinyin: kě wàng
meaning: long for; strongly desire

text: 她渴望有一次自己选择的机会。
pinyin: tā kě wàng yǒu yī cì zì jǐ xuǎn zé de jī huì .
meaning: She longs for a chance to choose for herself.

text: 他无奈地说，票已经卖完了。
pinyin: tā wú nài de shuō , piào yǐ jīng mài wán le .
meaning: He said helplessly that the tickets had sold out.

text: 受不了
pinyin: shòu bù liǎo
meaning: cannot bear

text: 我受不了大家同时说话，听不清。
pinyin: wǒ shòu bù liǎo dà jiā tóng shí shuō huà , tīng bù qīng .
meaning: I can’t cope with everyone talking at once; I can’t hear clearly.

text: 我担心自己又会漏掉第二句。
pinyin: wǒ dān xīn zì jǐ yòu huì lòu diào dì èr jù .
meaning: I’m worried I’ll miss the second line again.

text: 我还在适应台上的声音。
pinyin: wǒ hái zài shì yìng tái shàng de shēng yīn .
meaning: I’m still getting used to the sound on stage.

text: 依然
pinyin: yī rán
meaning: still; remain

text: 练完以后，我依然有点紧张。
pinyin: liàn wán yǐ hòu , wǒ yī rán yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng .
meaning: After practising I was still a little nervous.

text: 主观
pinyin: zhǔ guān
meaning: subjective

text: 这只是我的主观感受，你可以不一样。
pinyin: zhè zhǐ shì wǒ de zhǔ guān gǎn shòu , nǐ kě yǐ bù yī yàng .
meaning: This is only my subjective impression; yours may differ.

text: 预期
pinyin: yù qī
meaning: expectation; expected

text: 这次效果比我的预期好。
pinyin: zhè cì xiào guǒ bǐ wǒ de yù qī hǎo .
meaning: The result was better than I expected.

text: 情形
pinyin: qíng xíng
meaning: situation; circumstances

text: 当时是什么情形，你再说详细一点。
pinyin: dāng shí shì shén me qíng xíng , nǐ zài shuō xiáng xì yī diǎn .
meaning: Tell me more about what was happening at the time.

text: 鼓掌
pinyin: gǔ zhǎng
meaning: applaud; clap

text: 演出结束以后，大家一起鼓掌。
pinyin: yǎn chū jié shù yǐ hòu , dà jiā yì qǐ gǔ zhǎng .
meaning: Everyone applauded after the performance.

text: 紧张归紧张，你还是唱完了。
pinyin: jǐn zhāng guī jǐn zhāng , nǐ hái shi chàng wán le .
meaning: Nervous or not, you still finished.

text: 再紧张，我也想把它唱完。
pinyin: zài jǐn zhāng , wǒ yě xiǎng bǎ tā chàng wán .
meaning: However nervous I am, I still want to finish it.

text: 音乐快得我都跟不上了。
pinyin: yīn yuè kuài de wǒ dōu gēn bù shàng le .
meaning: The music is so fast I cannot keep up.

text: 在我看来，后面接上了也是进步。
pinyin: zài wǒ kàn lái , hòu miàn jiē shàng le yě shì jìn bù .
meaning: In my view, picking it up afterwards is progress too.

text: 现在听，还是吃完东西再听？
pinyin: xiàn zài tīng , hái shi chī wán dōng xi zài tīng ?
meaning: Listen now, or after eating?

text: 你想说说，还是先安静一会儿？
pinyin: nǐ xiǎng shuō shuō , hái shi xiān ān jìng yī huì er ?
meaning: Would you like to talk, or have a quiet moment first?

text: 我听见第二句停了一下，后来又接上了。
pinyin: wǒ tīng jiàn dì èr jù tíng le yī xià , hòu lái yòu jiē shàng le .
meaning: I heard a pause in the second line, followed by a recovery.

text: 我告诉大家你等会儿回去，行吗？
pinyin: wǒ gào sù dà jiā nǐ děng huì ér huí qù , xíng ma ?
meaning: May I tell the others you will be back later?

text: 诗歌
pinyin: shī gē
meaning: poetry; poem

text: 这首诗歌写的是离开家以后的生活。
pinyin: zhè shǒu shī gē xiě de shì lí kāi jiā yǐ hòu de shēng huó .
meaning: This poem is about life after leaving home.

text: 歌曲
pinyin: gē qǔ
meaning: song

text: 你想先练哪一首歌曲？
pinyin: nǐ xiǎng xiān liàn nǎ yī shǒu gē qǔ ?
meaning: Which song would you like to practise first?

text: 专辑
pinyin: zhuān jí
meaning: album

text: 这张专辑里有两首我很喜欢的歌。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhuān jí lǐ yǒu liǎng shǒu wǒ hěn xǐ huān de gē .
meaning: There are two songs I really like on this album.

text: 浪漫
pinyin: làng màn
meaning: romantic

text: 你觉得这个故事浪漫，我觉得有点难过。
pinyin: nǐ jué de zhè gè gù shì làng màn , wǒ jué de yǒu diǎn nán guò .
meaning: You find this story romantic; I find it a little sad.

text: 象征
pinyin: xiàng zhēng
meaning: symbolise; symbol

text: 这里的灯象征有人在等。
pinyin: zhè lǐ de dēng xiàng zhēng yǒu rén zài děng .
meaning: The light here symbolises someone waiting.

text: 联想
pinyin: lián xiǎng
meaning: association; associate

text: 这个声音让我联想到小时候的院子。
pinyin: zhè gè shēng yīn ràng wǒ lián xiǎng dào xiǎo shí hòu de yuàn zi .
meaning: This sound makes me think of my childhood courtyard.

text: 内在
pinyin: nèi zài
meaning: inner; intrinsic

text: 故事看起来很安静，内在的冲突却很强。
pinyin: gù shì kàn qǐ lái hěn ān jìng , nèi zài de chōng tū què hěn qiáng .
meaning: The story looks quiet but has a strong inner conflict.

text: 记忆
pinyin: jì yì
meaning: memory

text: 这件事一直留在我的记忆里。
pinyin: zhè jiàn shì yì zhí liú zài wǒ de jì yì lǐ .
meaning: This event has stayed in my memory.

text: 回忆
pinyin: huí yì
meaning: recall; memory

text: 我想回忆一下那天到底怎么说的。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng huí yì yī xià nà tiān dào dǐ zěn me shuō de .
meaning: I’d like to recall exactly what was said that day.

text: 时光
pinyin: shí guāng
meaning: time; a period of life

text: 我们一起练习的时光很短，但我记得很清楚。
pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ liàn xí de shí guāng hěn duǎn , dàn wǒ jì de hěn qīng chǔ .
meaning: Our time practising together was short, but I remember it clearly.

text: 岁月
pinyin: suì yuè
meaning: years; passage of time

text: 岁月过去，老屋的门已经换了。
pinyin: suì yuè guò qù , lǎo wū de mén yǐ jīng huàn le .
meaning: The years passed, and the old house has a new door.

text: 漫长
pinyin: màn cháng
meaning: long; prolonged

text: 等消息的那一晚很漫长。
pinyin: děng xiāo xī de nà yī wǎn hěn màn cháng .
meaning: That night waiting for news felt very long.

text: 舍不得
pinyin: shě bu de
meaning: be reluctant to part with or give up

text: 这件旧外套我一直舍不得扔。
pinyin: zhè jiàn jiù wài tào wǒ yì zhí shě bù de rēng .
meaning: I’ve never wanted to throw this old coat away.

text: 我想珍惜现在能见面的时间。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhēn xī xiàn zài néng jiàn miàn de shí jiān .
meaning: I want to value the time when we can meet now.

text: 他渴望再听见那个熟悉的声音。
pinyin: tā kě wàng zài tīng jiàn nà gè shú xī de shēng yīn .
meaning: He longs to hear that familiar voice again.

text: 散文
pinyin: sǎn wén
meaning: prose essay

text: 这篇散文把很小的事写得很有意思。
pinyin: zhè piān sǎn wén bǎ hěn xiǎo de shì xiě de hěn yǒu yì si .
meaning: This essay makes a small event interesting.

text: 感想
pinyin: gǎn xiǎng
meaning: thoughts; impressions after an experience

text: 看完以后，你有什么感想？
pinyin: kàn wán yǐ hòu , nǐ yǒu shén me gǎn xiǎng ?
meaning: What are your thoughts after watching?

text: 回顾
pinyin: huí gù
meaning: look back; review

text: 我们一起回顾了去年做过的事。
pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ huí gù le qù nián zuò guò de shì .
meaning: We looked back at what we’d done last year.

text: 情节
pinyin: qíng jié
meaning: plot; storyline

text: 我记不清每个情节，但记得最后的画面。
pinyin: wǒ jì bù qīng měi gè qíng jié , dàn jì de zuì hòu de huà miàn .
meaning: I can’t recall every plot detail but remember the final image.

text: 这段的主题不只是等一个人回来。
pinyin: zhè duàn de zhǔ tí bù zhǐ shì děng yī gè rén huí lái .
meaning: This section’s theme isn’t only waiting for someone to return.

text: 画面
pinyin: huà miàn
meaning: image; scene

text: 这句话让人想到很安静的画面。
pinyin: zhè jù huà ràng rén xiǎng dào hěn ān jìng de huà miàn .
meaning: This sentence suggests a very quiet image.

text: 模仿
pinyin: mó fǎng
meaning: imitate

text: 我可以模仿这个读法，再听哪里不同。
pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ mó fǎng zhè gè dú fǎ , zài tīng nǎ lǐ bù tóng .
meaning: I can imitate this reading and listen for differences.

text: 单看这句，含义还不清楚。
pinyin: dān kàn zhè jù , hán yì hái bù qīng chǔ .
meaning: The meaning isn’t clear from this line alone.

text: 你会用什么词形容这种感觉？
pinyin: nǐ huì yòng shén me cí xíng róng zhè zhǒng gǎn jué ?
meaning: What word would you use to describe this feeling?

text: 随着时间过去，纸上的颜色慢慢变淡。
pinyin: suí zhe shí jiān guò qù , zhǐ shàng de yán sè màn màn biàn dàn .
meaning: As time passes, the colours on the paper gradually fade.

text: 这里不是说路突然变长，而是说回去的感觉变了。
pinyin: zhè lǐ bù shì shuō lù tū rán biàn zhǎng , ér shì shuō huí qù de gǎn jué biàn le .
meaning: Here it is not a suddenly lengthened road but a changed feeling about returning.

text: 这段既写离开，也写舍不得。
pinyin: zhè duàn jì xiě lí kāi , yě xiě shě bù de .
meaning: This section describes both leaving and reluctance to part.

text: 这里的你不一定是恋人。
pinyin: zhè lǐ de nǐ bù yí dìng shì liàn rén .
meaning: The you here is not necessarily a lover.

text: 我把照片装进包里。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ zhào piān zhuāng jìn bāo lǐ .
meaning: I put the photograph in the bag.

text: 哪句话让你这样想？
pinyin: nǎ jù huà ràng nǐ zhè yàng xiǎng ?
meaning: Which line makes you think that?

text: 我先想到恋人，不过也可能是在想家。
pinyin: wǒ xiān xiǎng dào liàn rén , bù guò yě kě néng shì zài xiǎng jiā .
meaning: I thought of a lover first, but it might also be about missing home.

text: 你的读法也有道理，最后两句能支持。
pinyin: nǐ de dú fǎ yě yǒu dào lǐ , zuì hòu liǎng jù néng zhī chí .
meaning: Your reading makes sense too; the final lines support it.

text: 真相
pinyin: zhēn xiàng
meaning: what actually happened; truth

text: 真相和我开始想的完全不同。
pinyin: zhēn xiàng hé wǒ kāi shǐ xiǎng de wán quán bù tóng .
meaning: What actually happened was completely different from my first idea.

text: 线索
pinyin: xiàn suǒ
meaning: clue

text: 门上的纸是我们找到新地方的线索。
pinyin: mén shàng de zhǐ shì wǒ men zhǎo dào xīn dì fāng de xiàn suǒ .
meaning: The paper on the door is a clue to finding the new venue.

text: 关键
pinyin: guān jiàn
meaning: key; crucial

text: 关键是他当时还没有看到消息。
pinyin: guān jiàn shì tā dāng shí hái méi yǒu kàn dào xiāo xī .
meaning: The key is that he had not seen the message then.

text: 分析
pinyin: fēn xī
meaning: analyse; analysis

text: 先说发生了什么，再分析为什么。
pinyin: xiān shuō fā shēng le shén me , zài fēn xī wèi shén me .
meaning: First say what happened, then analyse why.

text: 逻辑
pinyin: luó jí
meaning: logic

text: 按这个逻辑，发过消息就等于对方看过，可这不对。
pinyin: àn zhè gè luó jí , fā guò xiāo xī jiù děng yú duì fāng kàn guò , kě zhè bú duì .
meaning: By that logic, sending a message means the other person read it, but that is wrong.

text: 这个误解来自两个人知道的事情不同。
pinyin: zhè gè wù jiě lái zì liǎng gè rén zhī dào de shì qíng bù tóng .
meaning: The misunderstanding comes from the two people knowing different things.

text: 暂时
pinyin: zàn shí
meaning: temporarily; for now

text: 我们暂时在小厅等。
pinyin: wǒ men zàn shí zài xiǎo tīng děng .
meaning: We are waiting in the small hall for now.

text: 总算
pinyin: zǒng suàn
meaning: finally; at last

text: 我总算找到你们了。
pinyin: wǒ zǒng suàn zhǎo dào nǐ men le .
meaning: I finally found you all.

text: 居然
pinyin: jū rán
meaning: unexpectedly; to one’s surprise

text: 我居然在门口等了这么久。
pinyin: wǒ jū rán zài mén kǒu děng le zhè me jiǔ .
meaning: I cannot believe I waited at the door so long.

text: 干脆
pinyin: gān cuì
meaning: simply; decisively

text: 手机没电，干脆借一个打电话吧。
pinyin: shǒu jī méi diàn , gān cuì jiè yī gè dǎ diàn huà ba .
meaning: The phone is dead; let’s simply borrow one to make a call.

text: 毕竟
pinyin: bì jìng
meaning: after all

text: 毕竟他没有看到消息，不能说他故意不来。
pinyin: bì jìng tā méi yǒu kàn dào xiāo xī , bù néng shuō tā gù yì bù lái .
meaning: After all, he did not see the message; we cannot say he deliberately stayed away.

text: 我偶然在门口看见那个通知。
pinyin: wǒ ǒu rán zài mén kǒu kàn jiàn nà gè tōng zhī .
meaning: I happened to notice the sign at the entrance.

text: 怀疑
pinyin: huái yí
meaning: suspect; doubt

text: 我怀疑自己是不是记错了地方。
pinyin: wǒ huái yí zì jǐ shì bú shì jì cuò le dì fāng .
meaning: I wondered whether I had remembered the wrong place.

text: 事实是两个人都到了，只是不在同一个地方。
pinyin: shì shí shì liǎng gè rén dōu dào le , zhǐ shì bù zài tóng yī gè dì fāng .
meaning: The fact is that both arrived, but at different places.

text: 你先解释一下为什么换了地方。
pinyin: nǐ xiān jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me huàn le dì fāng .
meaning: First explain why the venue changed.

text: 下次换地方，我们要确认对方收到。
pinyin: xià cì huàn dì fāng , wǒ men yào què rèn duì fāng shōu dào .
meaning: Next time we change venues, let’s confirm the other person received the update.

text: 他这个表情不一定是在生气。
pinyin: tā zhè gè biǎo qíng bù yí dìng shì zài shēng qì .
meaning: His expression does not necessarily mean he is angry.

text: 这个细节前面已经出现过。
pinyin: zhè gè xì jié qián miàn yǐ jīng chū xiàn guò .
meaning: This detail appeared earlier.

text: 期间
pinyin: qī jiān
meaning: during; period

text: 活动期间，你可以来小厅找我。
pinyin: huó dòng qī jiān , nǐ kě yǐ lái xiǎo tīng zhǎo wǒ .
meaning: During the event, you can find me in the small hall.

text: 之前
pinyin: zhī qián
meaning: before

text: 出门之前，我看过原来的地址。
pinyin: chū mén zhī qián , wǒ kàn guò yuán lái de dì zhǐ .
meaning: Before leaving, I checked the original address.

text: 之后
pinyin: zhī hòu
meaning: after

text: 接通电话之后，他才知道我们在小厅。
pinyin: jiē tōng diàn huà zhī hòu , tā cái zhī dào wǒ men zài xiǎo tīng .
meaning: Only after the call connected did he know we were in the small hall.

text: 只凭一个表情，很难判断他在想什么。
pinyin: zhǐ píng yī gè biǎo qíng , hěn nán pàn duàn tā zài xiǎng shén me .
meaning: It is hard to judge his thoughts from one expression.

text: 我们再观察一下他后面的动作。
pinyin: wǒ men zài guān chá yī xià tā hòu miàn de dòng zuò .
meaning: Let’s observe what he does afterwards.

text: 门口有一个换地方的通知。
pinyin: mén kǒu yǒu yī gè huàn dì fāng de tōng zhī .
meaning: There is a notice at the entrance about the venue change.

text: 直到电话接通，他才知道我在门口。
pinyin: zhí dào diàn huà jiē tōng , tā cái zhī dào wǒ zài mén kǒu .
meaning: Only when the call connected did he know I was at the entrance.

text: 原来你们换地方了。
pinyin: yuán lái nǐ men huàn dì fāng le .
meaning: So you changed venues.

text: 我再等，也看不到小厅里的人。
pinyin: wǒ zài děng , yě kàn bù dào xiǎo tīng lǐ de rén .
meaning: However long I wait, I cannot see the people in the small hall.

text: 幸好接了，不然你可能还在外面。
pinyin: xìng hǎo jiē le , bù rán nǐ kě néng hái zài wài miàn .
meaning: Good thing I answered; otherwise you might still be outside.

text: 我把发过消息当成对方看过。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ fā guò xiāo xī dàng chéng duì fāng kàn guò .
meaning: I treated sending the message as the other person having read it.

text: 我发了，但还没确认你看到。
pinyin: wǒ fā le , dàn hái méi què rèn nǐ kàn dào .
meaning: I sent it, but have not confirmed you saw it.

text: 你刚才是没看到，还是没办法回复？
pinyin: nǐ gāng cái shì méi kàn dào , hái shi méi bàn fǎ huí fù ?
meaning: Did you not see it, or were you unable to reply?

text: 他当时还不知道我的手机没电。
pinyin: tā dāng shí hái bù zhī dào wǒ de shǒu jī méi diàn .
meaning: He did not yet know my phone was dead.

text: 不利
pinyin: bù lì
meaning: unfavourable; disadvantageous

text: 每天睡得太晚，对第二天的学习不利。
pinyin: měi tiān shuì de tài wǎn , duì dì èr tiān de xué xí bù lì .
meaning: Sleeping too late every day is bad for the following day’s study.

text: 我犹豫要不要每次都参加。
pinyin: wǒ yóu yù yào bù yào měi cì dōu cān jiā .
meaning: I’m unsure whether to join every time.

text: 计划太满，结果常和预期不同。
pinyin: jì huà tài mǎn , jié guǒ cháng hé yù qī bù tóng .
meaning: When the plan is too full, the result often differs from expectations.

text: 充足
pinyin: chōng zú
meaning: sufficient; ample

text: 我需要留出充足的休息时间。
pinyin: wǒ xū yào liú chū chōng zú de xiū xī shí jiān .
meaning: I need to leave enough time to rest.

text: 不足
pinyin: bù zú
meaning: insufficient; shortcoming

text: 睡眠不足的时候，我很难听进去。
pinyin: shuì mián bù zú de shí hou , wǒ hěn nán tīng jìn qù .
meaning: When I haven’t slept enough, I struggle to take things in.

text: 减轻
pinyin: jiǎn qīng
meaning: reduce; ease

text: 少安排一个晚上，能减轻一点压力。
pinyin: shǎo ān pái yī gè wǎn shang , néng jiǎn qīng yī diǎn yā lì .
meaning: Scheduling one fewer evening can ease the pressure a little.

text: 效率
pinyin: xiào lǜ
meaning: efficiency

text: 不是坐得越久，效率就越高。
pinyin: bù shì zuò de yuè jiǔ , xiào lǜ jiù yuè gāo .
meaning: Spending longer seated doesn’t necessarily make you more efficient.

text: 精力
pinyin: jīng lì
meaning: energy

text: 我晚上没有那么多精力。
pinyin: wǒ wǎn shang méi yǒu nà me duō jīng lì .
meaning: I don’t have that much energy in the evening.

text: 节省
pinyin: jié shěng
meaning: save; economise

text: 早点把地点说清楚，能节省找路的时间。
pinyin: zǎo diǎn bǎ dì diǎn shuō qīng chǔ , néng jié shěng zhǎo lù de shí jiān .
meaning: Clarifying the location early can save time finding the way.

text: 投入
pinyin: tóu rù
meaning: put in; invest time or effort

text: 这段练习已经投入不少时间。
pinyin: zhè duàn liàn xí yǐ jīng tóu rù bù shǎo shí jiān .
meaning: I’ve already put quite a lot of time into practising this section.

text: 有限
pinyin: yǒu xiàn
meaning: limited

text: 时间有限，我得先选最想做的。
pinyin: shí jiān yǒu xiàn , wǒ děi xiān xuǎn zuì xiǎng zuò de .
meaning: With limited time, I need to choose what I most want to do first.

text: 我想找一个能长期继续的办法。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī gè néng cháng qī jì xù de bàn fǎ .
meaning: I want a method I can sustain long term.

text: 这是短期调整，不是以后都不去了。
pinyin: zhè shì duǎn qī tiáo zhěng , bù shì yǐ hòu dōu bù qù le .
meaning: This is a short-term adjustment, not never going again.

text: 今天先把练习范围缩小到两段。
pinyin: jīn tiān xiān bǎ liàn xí fàn wéi suō xiǎo dào liǎng duàn .
meaning: Let’s limit today’s practice to two sections.

text: 收获
pinyin: shōu huò
meaning: gain; what one gets from an experience

text: 我今天的收获是终于和新朋友聊起来了。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān de shōu huò shì zhōng yú hé xīn péng you liáo qǐ lái le .
meaning: My gain today was finally chatting with a new friend.

text: 试两周以后，我们再调整时间。
pinyin: shì liǎng zhōu yǐ hòu , wǒ men zài tiáo zhěng shí jiān .
meaning: After trying it for two weeks, we’ll adjust the schedule.

text: 规律
pinyin: guī lǜ
meaning: regular pattern; regularity

text: 我想把作息变得规律一点。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zuò xī biàn de guī lǜ yī diǎn .
meaning: I want a slightly more regular routine.

text: 没人提醒，我也会自觉记下没听懂的地方。
pinyin: méi rén tí xǐng , wǒ yě huì zì jué jì xià méi tīng dǒng de dì fāng .
meaning: Without a reminder, I note down the parts I don’t understand.

text: 我想坚持练，不是每次都练到没力气。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiān chí liàn , bù shì měi cì dōu liàn dào méi lì qì .
meaning: I want to keep practising, not exhaust myself each time.

text: 这个方案保留了周六见面的时间。
pinyin: zhè gè fāng àn bǎo liú le zhōu liù jiàn miàn de shí jiān .
meaning: This plan keeps Saturday available for meeting.

text: 把每个晚上都安排满，我反而有压力。
pinyin: bǎ měi gè wǎn shang dōu ān pái mǎn , wǒ fǎn ér yǒu yā lì .
meaning: Filling every evening actually puts pressure on me.

text: 独立
pinyin: dú lì
meaning: independent; independently

text: 有些内容我能独立练，有些需要一起聊。
pinyin: yǒu xiē nèi róng wǒ néng dú lì liàn , yǒu xiē xū yào yì qǐ liáo .
meaning: Some things I can practise independently; others need conversation.

text: 我的目标是能参加聊天，不只是做完题。
pinyin: wǒ de mù biāo shì néng cān jiā liáo tiān , bù zhǐ shì zuò wán tí .
meaning: My goal is joining conversations, not just finishing questions.

text: 这个安排听起来合理，但得试了才知道。
pinyin: zhè gè ān pái tīng qǐ lái hé lǐ , dàn děi shì le cái zhī dào .
meaning: This schedule sounds reasonable, but we’ll need to try it.

text: 既然周一有课，就先不加活动了。
pinyin: jì rán zhōu yī yǒu kè , jiù xiān bù jiā huó dòng le .
meaning: Since there is class on Monday, let us not add an activity then.

text: 除非临时加班，否则我周六会来。
pinyin: chú fēi lín shí jiā bān , fǒu zé wǒ zhōu liù huì lái .
meaning: Unless overtime comes up, I will come Saturday.

text: 我想用这个办法练下去。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yòng zhè gè bàn fǎ liàn xià qù .
meaning: I want to keep practising this way.

text: 我留出周六，为的是和大家聊起来。
pinyin: wǒ liú chū zhōu liù , wèi de shì hé dà jiā liáo qǐ lái .
meaning: I keep Saturday available in order to start talking with everyone.

text: 这两周的周四，我不是上课就是唱歌。
pinyin: zhè liǎng zhōu de zhōu sì , wǒ bù shì shàng kè jiù shì chàng gē .
meaning: On Thursdays these two weeks I am either at class or singing.

text: 这次先不去，下次有合适的再约。
pinyin: zhè cì xiān bù qù , xià cì yǒu hé shì de zài yuē .
meaning: I’ll skip this one; let’s arrange another suitable occasion.

text: 我想留出周六，和大家好好聊。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng liú chū zhōu liù , hé dà jiā hǎo hǎo liáo .
meaning: I want to keep Saturday free to have a proper chat.

text: 我先回去了，下次接着听你讲。
pinyin: wǒ xiān huí qù le , xià cì jiē zhe tīng nǐ jiǎng .
meaning: I’ll head home now; I’ll hear the rest next time.

text: 你不想说的部分，我会尊重。
pinyin: nǐ bù xiǎng shuō de bù fèn , wǒ huì zūn zhòng .
meaning: I’ll respect the parts you don’t want to discuss.

text: 你可以抱怨，不过我今天只能听一会儿。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ bào yuàn , bù guò wǒ jīn tiān zhǐ néng tīng yī huì er .
meaning: You can complain, but I can only listen briefly today.

text: 我有点无奈，不知道怎么把话接下去。
pinyin: wǒ yǒu diǎn wú nài , bù zhī dào zěn me bǎ huà jiē xià qù .
meaning: I feel rather stuck and don’t know how to continue.

text: 我想换个心态，不把每次没接电话都当成拒绝。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng huàn gè xīn tài , bù bǎ měi cì méi jiē diàn huà dōu dàng chéng jù jué .
meaning: I want to stop treating every unanswered call as rejection.

text: 打扰
pinyin: dǎ rǎo
meaning: disturb; interrupt

text: 这么晚打电话，是不是打扰你了？
pinyin: zhè me wǎn dǎ diàn huà , shì bú shì dǎ rǎo nǐ le ?
meaning: Am I disturbing you by calling so late?

text: 私人
pinyin: sī rén
meaning: private; personal

text: 这部分是私人的，我现在不想聊。
pinyin: zhè bù fèn shì sī rén de , wǒ xiàn zài bù xiǎng liáo .
meaning: That part is personal; I don’t want to discuss it now.

text: 坚定
pinyin: jiān dìng
meaning: firm; resolute

text: 她说得很平静，态度却很坚定。
pinyin: tā shuō de hěn píng jìng , tài dù què hěn jiān dìng .
meaning: She spoke calmly, but her position was firm.

text: 委托
pinyin: wěi tuō
meaning: entrust; commission

text: 他委托我把资料带给同事。
pinyin: tā wěi tuō wǒ bǎ zī liào dài gěi tóng shì .
meaning: He entrusted me to bring the materials to a colleague.

text: 我们需要沟通时间，不只是沟通内容。
pinyin: wǒ men xū yào gōu tōng shí jiān , bù zhǐ shì gōu tōng nèi róng .
meaning: We need to discuss timing as well as content.

text: 拒绝
pinyin: jù jué
meaning: refuse; reject

text: 我拒绝的是这个时间，不是以后都不见面。
pinyin: wǒ jù jué de shì zhè gè shí jiān , bù shì yǐ hòu dōu bú jiàn miàn .
meaning: I’m declining this time, not all future meetings.

text: 敏感
pinyin: mǐn gǎn
meaning: sensitive

text: 他对这个话题很敏感，我们先不追问。
pinyin: tā duì zhè gè huà tí hěn mǐn gǎn , wǒ men xiān bù zhuī wèn .
meaning: He's sensitive about this topic; let's not press him for now.

text: 我想真诚地说明，不想随便找个理由。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhēn chéng de shuō míng , bù xiǎng suí biàn zhǎo gè lǐ yóu .
meaning: I want to explain sincerely rather than invent an excuse.

text: 我直接说今天只能聊二十分钟。
pinyin: wǒ zhí jiē shuō jīn tiān zhǐ néng liáo èr shí fēn zhōng .
meaning: I said directly that I could talk for only twenty minutes today.

text: 我理解你想说，但今天不方便。
pinyin: wǒ lǐ jiě nǐ xiǎng shuō , dàn jīn tiān bù fāng biàn .
meaning: I understand you want to talk, but today isn’t convenient.

text: 听见不能继续聊，他有点失望。
pinyin: tīng jiàn bù néng jì xù liáo , tā yǒu diǎn shī wàng .
meaning: He was a little disappointed we couldn’t keep talking.

text: 这是我的个人安排，不要求你一样。
pinyin: zhè shì wǒ de gè rén ān pái , bú yào qiú nǐ yī yàng .
meaning: This is my own arrangement; I don’t expect yours to be identical.

text: 这次我坚决不把睡前的时间再排满。
pinyin: zhè cì wǒ jiān jué bù bǎ shuì qián de shí jiān zài pái mǎn .
meaning: This time I won’t fill the time before bed again.

text: 我想提一个请求，先问你有没有时间。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng tí yī gè qǐng qiú , xiān wèn nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān .
meaning: I’d like to ask something, but first whether you have time.

text: 我愿意帮一部分，不能全部承担。
pinyin: wǒ yuàn yì bāng yī bù fèn , bù néng quán bù chéng dān .
meaning: I’m willing to help with part, but can’t take on all of it.

text: 负担
pinyin: fù dān
meaning: burden

text: 每天都等电话，对我成了负担。
pinyin: měi tiān dōu děng diàn huà , duì wǒ chéng le fù dān .
meaning: Waiting for calls every day became a burden for me.

text: 朋友的每一个决定，不都是我的责任。
pinyin: péng you de měi yī gè jué dìng , bù dōu shì wǒ de zé rèn .
meaning: Not every decision a friend makes is my responsibility.

text: 我能体会他一个人在外面的感觉。
pinyin: wǒ néng tǐ huì tā yī gè rén zài wài miàn de gǎn jué .
meaning: I can understand how he feels alone away from home.

text: 他还在适应新的工作时间。
pinyin: tā hái zài shì yìng xīn de gōng zuò shí jiān .
meaning: He’s still adapting to his new work schedule.

text: 改善
pinyin: gǎi shàn
meaning: improve

text: 我们想改善联系的方式，不是结束联系。
pinyin: wǒ men xiǎng gǎi shàn lián xì de fāng shì , bù shì jié shù lián xì .
meaning: We want to improve how we keep in touch, not end contact.

text: 昨晚怎么打也接不通。
pinyin: zuó wǎn zěn me dǎ yě jiē bù tōng .
meaning: However I tried calling last night, it would not connect.

text: 失望归失望，我们还是得先约时间。
pinyin: shī wàng guī shī wàng , wǒ men hái shi děi xiān yuē shí jiān .
meaning: Disappointed or not, we still need to arrange a time first.

text: 吃饭的吃饭，聊天的聊天，大家各做各的。
pinyin: chī fàn de chī fàn , liáo tiān de liáo tiān , dà jiā gè zuò gè de .
meaning: Some eat, some chat; everyone does their own thing.

text: 先约时间，为的是能认真听，不是以后都不联系。
pinyin: xiān yuē shí jiān , wèi de shì néng rèn zhēn tīng , bù shì yǐ hòu dōu bù lián xì .
meaning: Arranging a time is so I can listen properly, not stop contact altogether.

text: 这个安排得改。
pinyin: zhè gè ān pái děi gǎi .
meaning: This arrangement needs changing.

text: 现在方便聊十分钟吗？
pinyin: xiàn zài fāng biàn liáo shí fēn zhōng ma ?
meaning: Is now a good time for a ten-minute chat?

text: 今天先到这里，没说完的再找时间。
pinyin: jīn tiān xiān dào zhè lǐ , méi shuō wán de zài zhǎo shí jiān .
meaning: Let’s stop here today and find another time for the rest.

text: 我今天没有时间，不是以后都不想聊。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān méi yǒu shí jiān , bù shì yǐ hòu dōu bù xiǎng liáo .
meaning: I don’t have time today; it doesn’t mean never wanting to chat again.

text: 成本
pinyin: chéng běn
meaning: cost

text: 这个方案的成本不只是买东西的钱。
pinyin: zhè gè fāng àn de chéng běn bù zhǐ shì mǎi dōng xi de qián .
meaning: The cost of this plan is not only the money for purchases.

text: 执行
pinyin: zhí xíng
meaning: carry out; execute

text: 安排写好了，还要问谁来执行。
pinyin: ān pái xiě hǎo le , hái yào wèn shéi lái zhí xíng .
meaning: The plan is written, but we need to ask who will carry it out.

text: 评估
pinyin: píng gū
