meaning: evaluate; assessment

text: 先试两周，再评估有没有帮助。
pinyin: xiān shì liǎng zhōu , zài píng gū yǒu méi yǒu bāng zhù .
meaning: Try it for two weeks, then assess whether it helps.

text: 依据
pinyin: yī jù
meaning: basis; grounds

text: 你选这个时间，有什么依据？
pinyin: nǐ xuǎn zhè gè shí jiān , yǒu shén me yī jù ?
meaning: On what grounds did you choose this time?

text: 总体
pinyin: zǒng tǐ
meaning: overall; as a whole

text: 总体看，大家想缩短会议，但不想少了解问题。
pinyin: zǒng tǐ kàn , dà jiā xiǎng suō duǎn huì yì , dàn bù xiǎng shǎo liǎo jiě wèn tí .
meaning: Overall, people want shorter meetings without learning less about problems.

text: 便于
pinyin: biàn yú
meaning: make convenient; facilitate

text: 提前写出问题，便于大家准备。
pinyin: tí qián xiě chū wèn tí , biàn yú dà jiā zhǔn bèi .
meaning: Writing the questions beforehand helps everyone prepare.

text: 变动
pinyin: biàn dòng
meaning: change; alteration

text: 时间有变动，请再确认一次。
pinyin: shí jiān yǒu biàn dòng , qǐng zài què rèn yī cì .
meaning: If the time changes, please confirm again.

text: 达成
pinyin: dá chéng
meaning: reach, e.g. agreement

text: 我们还没达成一致，先不要发通知。
pinyin: wǒ men hái méi dá chéng yí zhì , xiān bú yào fā tōng zhī .
meaning: We have not reached agreement; do not send the notice yet.

text: 成效
pinyin: chéng xiào
meaning: effectiveness; results

text: 会开得短，不一定代表有成效。
pinyin: huì kāi de duǎn , bù yí dìng dài biǎo yǒu chéng xiào .
meaning: A short meeting does not necessarily mean it is effective.

text: 答复
pinyin: dá fù
meaning: reply; response

text: 我还在等另外三个人的答复。
pinyin: wǒ hái zài děng lìng wài sān gè rén de dá fù .
meaning: I am still waiting for three other people’s replies.

text: 传达
pinyin: chuán dá
meaning: convey; pass on information

text: 你帮我传达一下这次的变动。
pinyin: nǐ bāng wǒ chuán dá yī xià zhè cì de biàn dòng .
meaning: Please pass on this change for me.

text: 传递
pinyin: chuán dì
meaning: pass; transmit

text: 这张纸从前排传递到后排。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhǐ cóng qián pái chuán dì dào hòu pái .
meaning: The paper was passed from the front row to the back.

text: 不易
pinyin: bù yì
meaning: not easy

text: 六个人都方便的时间不易找到。
pinyin: liù gè rén dōu fāng biàn de shí jiān bù yì zhǎo dào .
meaning: A time convenient for all six is hard to find.

text: 出于
pinyin: chū yú
meaning: out of; motivated by

text: 我出于方便客户的考虑，想把会议提前。
pinyin: wǒ chū yú fāng biàn kè hù de kǎo lǜ , xiǎng bǎ huì yì tí qián .
meaning: I want to move the meeting earlier for the customers' convenience.

text: 从而
pinyin: cóng ér
meaning: thereby; as a result

text: 先写清需要谁回答，从而减少来回找人的时间。
pinyin: xiān xiě qīng xū yào shéi huí dá , cóng ér jiǎn shǎo lái huí zhǎo rén de shí jiān .
meaning: Identify who should answer first, thereby reducing time spent looking for people.

text: 单一
pinyin: dān yī
meaning: single; one-dimensional

text: 只看时间，这个标准太单一。
pinyin: zhǐ kàn shí jiān , zhè gè biāo zhǔn tài dān yī .
meaning: Looking only at time is too one-dimensional a criterion.

text: 初期
pinyin: chū qī
meaning: initial stage

text: 初期先用简单的表，不急着加功能。
pinyin: chū qī xiān yòng jiǎn dān de biǎo , bù jí zhe jiā gōng néng .
meaning: Use a simple form initially rather than rushing to add functions.

text: 差距
pinyin: chā jù
meaning: gap; disparity

text: 计划和实际时间还有差距。
pinyin: jì huà hé shí jì shí jiān hái yǒu chā jù .
meaning: There is still a gap between planned and actual time.

text: 采购
pinyin: cǎi gòu
meaning: purchase; procurement

text: 采购之前，先确认数量和价格。
pinyin: cǎi gòu zhī qián , xiān què rèn shù liàng hé jià gé .
meaning: Confirm quantity and price before purchasing.

text: 补贴
pinyin: bǔ tiē
meaning: subsidy; allowance

text: 这次活动有交通补贴，具体金额写在通知里。
pinyin: zhè cì huó dòng yǒu jiāo tōng bǔ tiē , jù tǐ jīn é xiě zài tōng zhī lǐ .
meaning: This event has a travel allowance; the exact amount is in the notice.

text: 层次
pinyin: céng cì
meaning: level; layer; organisation of ideas

text: 把原因和办法分开说，层次会清楚一些。
pinyin: bǎ yuán yīn hé bàn fǎ fēn kāi shuō , céng cì huì qīng chǔ yī xiē .
meaning: Separating reasons and solutions gives the explanation clearer structure.

text: 代价
pinyin: dài jià
meaning: price paid; cost or sacrifice

text: 如果少开会的代价是大家不知道该做什么，就要再改。
pinyin: rú guǒ shǎo kāi huì de dài jià shì dà jiā bù zhī dào gāi zuò shén me , jiù yào zài gǎi .
meaning: If fewer meetings leave people unsure what to do, we need another revision.

text: 大致
pinyin: dà zhì
meaning: roughly; approximately

text: 我们先说大致安排，具体时间等答复。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān shuō dà zhì ān pái , jù tǐ shí jiān děng dá fù .
meaning: We will give the rough plan first and await replies for exact times.

text: 尝试
pinyin: cháng shì
meaning: try; attempt

text: 我们可以尝试两周，不必一次定一年。
pinyin: wǒ men kě yǐ cháng shì liǎng zhōu , bù bì yī cì dìng yī nián .
meaning: We can try for two weeks rather than fixing a whole year at once.

text: 拿第二次会议来说，准备时间也增加了。
pinyin: ná dì èr cì huì yì lái shuō , zhǔn bèi shí jiān yě zēng jiā le .
meaning: Take the second meeting: preparation time increased too.

text: 请提前写出问题，以便大家准备。
pinyin: qǐng tí qián xiě chū wèn tí , yǐ biàn dà jiā zhǔn bèi .
meaning: Please write the questions ahead so everyone can prepare.

text: 尽管会议短了，但是准备可能更长。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn huì yì duǎn le , dàn shì zhǔn bèi kě néng gèng zhǎng .
meaning: Although the meeting is shorter, preparation may be longer.

text: 一旦时间有变动，就重新确认。
pinyin: yí dàn shí jiān yǒu biàn dòng , jiù chóng xīn què rèn .
meaning: Once the time changes, confirm again.

text: 时间定下来以后再发通知。
pinyin: shí jiān dìng xià lái yǐ hòu zài fā tōng zhī .
meaning: Send notice after the time is settled.

text: 你担心的是时间，还是准备材料？
pinyin: nǐ dān xīn de shì shí jiān , hái shi zhǔn bèi cái liào ?
meaning: Are you concerned about timing or preparing the notes?

text: 对，这个时间也应该算进去。
pinyin: duì , zhè gè shí jiān yě yīng gāi suàn jìn qù .
meaning: Yes, that time should be included too.

text: 先试两周，再根据记录调整。
pinyin: xiān shì liǎng zhōu , zài gēn jù jì lù tiáo zhěng .
meaning: Try two weeks first, then adjust using the record.

text: 预备
pinyin: yù bèi
meaning: prepare; get ready

text: 我们预备了两个地点，最后还要确认。
pinyin: wǒ men yù bèi le liǎng gè dì diǎn , zuì hòu hái yào què rèn .
meaning: We have prepared two possible venues but still need confirmation.

text: 展览
pinyin: zhǎn lǎn
meaning: exhibition; exhibit

text: 旁边有一个旧书封面的展览。
pinyin: páng biān yǒu yī gè jiù shū fēng miàn de zhǎn lǎn .
meaning: There is an exhibition of old book covers beside us.

text: 展示
pinyin: zhǎn shì
meaning: display; show

text: 先展示自己带的书，再说想换什么。
pinyin: xiān zhǎn shì zì jǐ dài de shū , zài shuō xiǎng huàn shén me .
meaning: Show the books you brought first, then say what you want to exchange for.

text: 自愿
pinyin: zì yuàn
meaning: voluntarily; voluntary

text: 帮忙是自愿的，不是每个人都必须留下。
pinyin: bāng máng shì zì yuàn de , bù shì měi gè rén dōu bì xū liú xià .
meaning: Helping is voluntary; not everyone has to stay.

text: 负责人
pinyin: fù zé rén
meaning: person in charge

text: 换房间以前，先联系负责人。
pinyin: huàn fáng jiān yǐ qián , xiān lián xì fù zé rén .
meaning: Contact the person in charge before changing rooms.

text: 暂停
pinyin: zàn tíng
meaning: pause; suspend temporarily

text: 换房间时，先暂停拿书。
pinyin: huàn fáng jiān shí , xiān zàn tíng ná shū .
meaning: Pause taking books while we change rooms.

text: 终止
pinyin: zhōng zhǐ
meaning: terminate; bring to an end

text: 通知说这次合作终止，不只是推迟。
pinyin: tōng zhī shuō zhè cì hé zuò zhōng zhǐ , bù zhǐ shì tuī chí .
meaning: The notice says this cooperation is ended, not merely delayed.

text: 当场
pinyin: dāng chǎng
meaning: on the spot; then and there

text: 他当场问清楚这本书能不能换。
pinyin: tā dāng chǎng wèn qīng chǔ zhè běn shū néng bù néng huàn .
meaning: He checked on the spot whether this book could be exchanged.

text: 等候
pinyin: děng hòu
meaning: wait

text: 请在桌子旁边等候，不要堵住门口。
pinyin: qǐng zài zhuō zi páng biān děng hòu , bú yào dǔ zhù mén kǒu .
meaning: Please wait beside the table without blocking the entrance.

text: 分类
pinyin: fēn lèi
meaning: classify; sort into categories

text: 书先按内容分类，不是按颜色。
pinyin: shū xiān àn nèi róng fēn lèi , bù shì àn yán sè .
meaning: Sort the books by content first, not colour.

text: 分享
pinyin: fēn xiǎng
meaning: share

text: 你可以分享读后的感想，不一定要讲完整故事。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ fēn xiǎng dú hòu de gǎn xiǎng , bù yí dìng yào jiǎng wán zhěng gù shì .
meaning: You can share your impressions without telling the whole story.

text: 发布
pinyin: fā bù
meaning: publish; release

text: 确认新房间以后，再发布公告。
pinyin: què rèn xīn fáng jiān yǐ hòu , zài fā bù gōng gào .
meaning: Publish the notice after confirming the new room.

text: 公告
pinyin: gōng gào
meaning: public notice; announcement

text: 公告上有时间和具体房间。
pinyin: gōng gào shàng yǒu shí jiān hé jù tǐ fáng jiān .
meaning: The notice has the time and exact room.

text: 共计
pinyin: gòng jì
meaning: total; amount to

text: 报名共计二十八人，包括四位组织的人。
pinyin: bào míng gòng jì èr shí bā rén , bāo kuò sì wèi zǔ zhī de rén .
meaning: Twenty-eight people registered in total, including four organisers.

text: 共享
pinyin: gòng xiǎng
meaning: share; shared access

text: 我们用同一份共享名单，改过的内容大家能看到。
pinyin: wǒ men yòng tóng yī fèn gòng xiǎng míng dān , gǎi guò de nèi róng dà jiā néng kàn dào .
meaning: We use one shared list so everyone can see changes.

text: 附件
pinyin: fù jiàn
meaning: attachment

text: 地图在邮件附件里，不在正文里。
pinyin: dì tú zài yóu jiàn fù jiàn lǐ , bù zài zhèng wén lǐ .
meaning: The map is in the email attachment, not the main text.

text: 二维码
pinyin: èr wéi mǎ
meaning: QR code

text: 扫这个二维码，可以看活动安排。
pinyin: sǎo zhè gè èr wéi mǎ , kě yǐ kàn huó dòng ān pái .
meaning: Scan this QR code to view the event schedule.

text: 环节
pinyin: huán jié
meaning: stage; part of a process or event

text: 交换以后还有分享环节。
pinyin: jiāo huàn yǐ hòu hái yǒu fēn xiǎng huán jié .
meaning: There is a sharing session after the exchange.

text: 回收
pinyin: huí shōu
meaning: collect for reuse or recycling

text: 没有用上的纸，最后一起回收。
pinyin: méi yǒu yòng shàng de zhǐ , zuì hòu yì qǐ huí shōu .
meaning: Collect the unused paper together at the end for reuse or recycling.

text: 更换
pinyin: gēng huàn
meaning: replace; change

text: 房间更换了，时间不变。
pinyin: fáng jiān gēng huàn le , shí jiān bù biàn .
meaning: The room has changed but the time remains the same.

text: 递给
pinyin: dì gěi
meaning: hand to

text: 把这本书递给后面的朋友。
pinyin: bǎ zhè běn shū dì gěi hòu miàn de péng you .
meaning: Hand this book to the friend behind you.

text: 返回
pinyin: fǎn huí
meaning: return; go back

text: 找不到新地方，就返回原来的门口看通知。
pinyin: zhǎo bù dào xīn dì fāng , jiù fǎn huí yuán lái de mén kǒu kàn tōng zhī .
meaning: If you cannot find the new venue, go back to the original entrance and check the notice.

text: 桌子摆好以后，交换恢复了。
pinyin: zhuō zi bǎi hǎo yǐ hòu , jiāo huàn huī fù le .
meaning: The exchange resumed after the tables were arranged.

text: 干扰
pinyin: gān rǎo
meaning: interfere; disturbance

text: 搬东西的时候，别干扰旁边的活动。
pinyin: bān dōng xi de shí hou , bié gān rǎo páng biān de huó dòng .
meaning: Avoid disturbing the neighbouring event while moving things.

text: 除非房间确认了，我们才发新公告。
pinyin: chú fēi fáng jiān què rèn le , wǒ men cái fā xīn gōng gào .
meaning: Only if the room is confirmed will we publish a new notice.

text: 我们把地图改好，从而减少找错房间的情况。
pinyin: wǒ men bǎ dì tú gǎi hǎo , cóng ér jiǎn shǎo zhǎo cuò fáng jiān de qíng kuàng .
meaning: We update the map, thereby reducing wrong-room visits.

text: 一确认房间，我就通知大家。
pinyin: yī què rèn fáng jiān , wǒ jiù tōng zhī dà jiā .
meaning: As soon as the room is confirmed, I will notify everyone.

text: 你可以介绍一本，或是先听别人讲。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ jiè shào yī běn , huò shì xiān tīng bié ren jiǎng .
meaning: You can introduce a book or first listen to others.

text: 共计二十八人，包括四位组织的人。
pinyin: gòng jì èr shí bā rén , bāo kuò sì wèi zǔ zhī de rén .
meaning: Twenty-eight people in total, including four organisers.

text: 这本是想换的，还是只想展示？
pinyin: zhè běn shì xiǎng huàn de , hái shi zhǐ xiǎng zhǎn shì ?
meaning: Is this one for exchange or just display?

text: 改到一楼这个房间，开始时间不变。
pinyin: gǎi dào yī lóu zhè gè fáng jiān , kāi shǐ shí jiān bù biàn .
meaning: It has moved to this downstairs room; the start time is unchanged.

text: 下次我想试登记，先确认日期。
pinyin: xià cì wǒ xiǎng shì dēng jì , xiān què rèn rì qī .
meaning: I’d like to try registration next time, after checking the date.

text: 接触
pinyin: jiē chù
meaning: come into contact with

text: 我第一次接触这个读书小组，是朋友带我来的。
pinyin: wǒ dì yī cì jiē chù zhè gè dú shū xiǎo zǔ , shì péng you dài wǒ lái de .
meaning: My first contact with this reading group was through a friend.

text: 这次见面是偶然的，我们没有提前约。
pinyin: zhè cì jiàn miàn shì ǒu rán de , wǒ men méi yǒu tí qián yuē .
meaning: This meeting happened by chance; we hadn’t arranged it.

text: 偶尔
pinyin: ǒu ěr
meaning: occasionally

text: 我偶尔来一次，不是每周都来。
pinyin: wǒ ǒu ěr lái yī cì , bù shì měi zhōu dōu lái .
meaning: I come occasionally, not every week.

text: 有人找不到页，我们耐心等他一下。
pinyin: yǒu rén zhǎo bù dào yè , wǒ men nài xīn děng tā yī xià .
meaning: When someone cannot find the page, we patiently wait a moment.

text: 困扰
pinyin: kùn rǎo
meaning: trouble; bother

text: 人多以后，谁先说这个问题一直困扰我。
pinyin: rén duō yǐ hòu , shéi xiān shuō zhè gè wèn tí yì zhí kùn rǎo wǒ .
meaning: As attendance grew, deciding who speaks first kept troubling me.

text: 看待
pinyin: kàn dài
meaning: view; regard

text: 你怎么看待有人只听不说？
pinyin: nǐ zěn me kàn dài yǒu rén zhǐ tīng bù shuō ?
meaning: How do you view people who listen without speaking?

text: 技能
pinyin: jì néng
meaning: skill

text: 安排大家轮流说，也是一种需要练习的技能。
pinyin: ān pái dà jiā lún liú shuō , yě shì yī zhǒng xū yào liàn xí de jì néng .
meaning: Arranging turns is also a skill that needs practice.

text: 年龄
pinyin: nián líng
meaning: age

text: 我们不按年龄决定谁先说。
pinyin: wǒ men bù àn nián líng jué dìng shéi xiān shuō .
meaning: We do not decide speaking order by age.

text: 日期变了，我会和报名的人联络。
pinyin: rì qī biàn le , wǒ huì hé bào míng de rén lián luò .
meaning: If the date changes, I will contact the registered participants.

text: 加上
pinyin: jiā shàng
meaning: in addition to; plus

text: 读半小时，加上交流半小时，一共一个小时。
pinyin: dú bàn xiǎo shí , jiā shàng jiāo liú bàn xiǎo shí , yī gòng yī gè xiǎo shí .
meaning: Half an hour reading plus half an hour discussion totals one hour.

text: 近来
pinyin: jìn lái
meaning: recently; lately

text: 近来每次来的人比刚开始多。
pinyin: jìn lái měi cì lái de rén bǐ gāng kāi shǐ duō .
meaning: Recently attendance has been higher than at the beginning.

text: 难得
pinyin: nán dé
meaning: rare; hard to come by

text: 大家难得在同一天下午都有空。
pinyin: dà jiā nán dé zài tóng yī tiān xià wǔ dōu yǒu kōng .
meaning: It is rare for everyone to be free on the same afternoon.

text: 只凭一次活动，难以判断以后会不会一直来。
pinyin: zhǐ píng yī cì huó dòng , nán yǐ pàn duàn yǐ hòu huì bù huì yì zhí lái .
meaning: One visit alone makes it hard to judge whether someone will keep coming.

text: 她很坚定地说，读不完也可以来。
pinyin: tā hěn jiān dìng de shuō , dú bù wán yě kě yǐ lái .
meaning: She firmly said people could come without finishing the book.

text: 先说一句就行，这样能减轻一些压力。
pinyin: xiān shuō yī jù jiù xíng , zhè yàng néng jiǎn qīng yī xiē yā lì .
meaning: Starting with one sentence can ease some pressure.

text: 启发
pinyin: qǐ fā
meaning: inspire; give an insight

text: 那位只听的朋友，后来给了我一个启发。
pinyin: nà wèi zhǐ tīng de péng you , hòu lái gěi le wǒ yī gè qǐ fā .
meaning: The friend who initially only listened later gave me an idea.

text: 前提
pinyin: qián tí
meaning: premise; prerequisite

text: 能参加的前提是有空，不是必须讲得好。
pinyin: néng cān jiā de qián tí shì yǒu kōng , bù shì bì xū jiǎng de hǎo .
meaning: The prerequisite for attending is availability, not speaking well.

text: 社区
pinyin: shè qū
meaning: community; neighbourhood

text: 这个社区的小厅每周六下午可以用。
pinyin: zhè gè shè qū de xiǎo tīng měi zhōu liù xià wǔ kě yǐ yòng .
meaning: This community’s small hall is available on Saturday afternoons.

text: 收集
pinyin: shōu jí
meaning: collect

text: 活动以后，我收集大家想读的书名。
pinyin: huó dòng yǐ hòu , wǒ shōu jí dà jiā xiǎng dú de shū míng .
meaning: After the event I collect titles people want to read.

text: 说法
pinyin: shuō fǎ
meaning: wording; account; view

text: 我不太同意“没说话就是没参加”这个说法。
pinyin: wǒ bù tài tóng yì méi shuō huà jiù shì méi cān jiā zhè gè shuō fǎ .
meaning: I disagree with the view that not speaking means not participating.

text: 频繁
pinyin: pín fán
meaning: frequent

text: 最近联络太频繁，有人希望只收一次通知。
pinyin: zuì jìn lián luò tài pín fán , yǒu rén xī wàng zhǐ shōu yī cì tōng zhī .
meaning: Recent contact was too frequent; someone wanted just one notification.

text: 入门
pinyin: rù mén
meaning: begin; introductory

text: 这本是入门的书，例子比较短。
pinyin: zhè běn shì rù mén de shū , lì zi bǐ jiào duǎn .
meaning: This is an introductory book with fairly short examples.

text: 书柜
pinyin: shū guì
meaning: bookcase

text: 小厅里的书柜，不是所有书都可以借走。
pinyin: xiǎo tīng lǐ de shū guì , bù shì suǒ yǒu shū dōu kě yǐ jiè zǒu .
meaning: Not every book in the hall’s bookcase can be borrowed.

text: 来信
pinyin: lái xìn
meaning: letter received; incoming letter

text: 这封来信问，下次能不能先听再决定要不要说。
pinyin: zhè fēng lái xìn wèn , xià cì néng bù néng xiān tīng zài jué dìng yào bù yào shuō .
meaning: This letter asks whether one can listen first and decide later whether to speak.

text: 拿第一次来说，那天一共六个人。
pinyin: ná dì yī cì lái shuō , nà tiān yī gòng liù gè rén .
meaning: Take the first meeting: six people came.

text: 尽管人数多了，我们还是要问大家的感受。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn rén shù duō le , wǒ men hái shi yào wèn dà jiā de gǎn shòu .
meaning: Despite higher attendance, we still need to ask people how it felt.

text: 在她看来，安静不一定是没兴趣。
pinyin: zài tā kàn lái , ān jìng bù yí dìng shì méi xìng qù .
meaning: In her view, silence does not necessarily mean no interest.

text: 只凭一次到场，难以判断以后会不会再来。
pinyin: zhǐ píng yī cì dào chǎng , nán yǐ pàn duàn yǐ hòu huì bù huì zài lái .
meaning: Attendance once is insufficient to judge whether someone will return.

text: 我想先听，再决定要不要说。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng xiān tīng , zài jué dìng yào bù yào shuō .
meaning: I want to listen first and then decide whether to speak.

text: 你说人数多了，大家的感受也变了吗？
pinyin: nǐ shuō rén shù duō le , dà jiā de gǎn shòu yě biàn le ma ?
meaning: You said attendance increased; did people’s experience change too?

text: 能不能讲一次具体的情况？
pinyin: néng bù néng jiǎng yī cì jù tǐ de qíng kuàng ?
meaning: Could you describe a particular occasion?

text: 她说这个办法对一些人有帮助。
pinyin: tā shuō zhè gè bàn fǎ duì yī xiē rén yǒu bāng zhù .
meaning: She says this approach helped some people.

text: 我喜欢晚上读，但这是主观感受。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān wǎn shang dú , dàn zhè shì zhǔ guān gǎn shòu .
meaning: I like evening reading, but that is a subjective experience.

text: 立场
pinyin: lì chǎng
meaning: position; standpoint

text: 我的立场是先继续试，不是马上每天延长。
pinyin: wǒ de lì chǎng shì xiān jì xù shì , bù shì mǎ shàng měi tiān yán cháng .
meaning: My position is to continue the trial, not extend every day immediately.

text: 从有人来跳到人人需要，这个逻辑不成立。
pinyin: cóng yǒu rén lái tiào dào rén rén xū yào , zhè gè luó jí bù chéng lì .
meaning: The logic of jumping from some attendance to universal need doesn’t hold.

text: 想安静读和想聊天，在同一个小厅里有矛盾。
pinyin: xiǎng ān jìng dú hé xiǎng liáo tiān , zài tóng yī gè xiǎo tīng lǐ yǒu máo dùn .
meaning: Quiet reading and conversation conflict in the same small hall.

text: 间接
pinyin: jiàn jiē
meaning: indirect

text: 报名表间接告诉我们有人有兴趣，不说明一定到场。
pinyin: bào míng biǎo jiàn jiē gào sù wǒ men yǒu rén yǒu xìng qù , bù shuō míng yí dìng dào chǎng .
meaning: Registration indirectly indicates interest, not certain attendance.

text: 排除
pinyin: pái chú
meaning: rule out; remove

text: 还不能排除天气影响人数。
pinyin: hái bù néng pái chú tiān qì yǐng xiǎng rén shù .
meaning: We cannot yet rule out the weather affecting attendance.

text: 控制
pinyin: kòng zhì
meaning: control

text: 可以控制一次试办的时长，不能控制谁一定来。
pinyin: kě yǐ kòng zhì yī cì shì bàn de shí zhǎng , bù néng kòng zhì shéi yí dìng lái .
meaning: We can control a trial’s duration, not who will definitely attend.

text: 加以
pinyin: jiā yǐ
meaning: give; apply, before a verb

text: 这些意见要加以讨论，不是直接删掉。
pinyin: zhè xiē yì jiàn yào jiā yǐ tǎo lùn , bù shì zhí jiē shān diào .
meaning: These views need to be discussed, not simply deleted.

text: 人数是一个依据，但不是全部。
pinyin: rén shù shì yī gè yī jù , dàn bù shì quán bù .
meaning: Attendance is one basis, not the whole picture.

text: 我不同意“少来一次就是不需要”这个说法。
pinyin: wǒ bù tóng yì shǎo lái yī cì jiù shì bù xū yào zhè gè shuō fǎ .
meaning: I disagree with the claim that missing one visit means no need.

text: 继续试办的前提是有人能负责关门。
pinyin: jì xù shì bàn de qián tí shì yǒu rén néng fù zé guān mén .
meaning: Continuing the pilot requires someone to close up.

text: 四周以后，再评估延长时间的安排。
pinyin: sì zhōu yǐ hòu , zài píng gū yán cháng shí jiān de ān pái .
meaning: Evaluate the extended hours after four weeks.

text: 评论
pinyin: píng lùn
meaning: comment; commentary

text: 这条评论提出了安静的问题。
pinyin: zhè tiáo píng lùn tí chū le ān jìng de wèn tí .
meaning: This comment raises the issue of quiet.

text: 期望
pinyin: qī wàng
meaning: expect; expectation

text: 我期望方便一些，不是要求随时开门。
pinyin: wǒ qī wàng fāng biàn yī xiē , bù shì yāo qiú suí shí kāi mén .
meaning: I hope for more convenience, not opening at any time.

text: 局面
pinyin: jú miàn
meaning: situation; state of affairs

text: 我们想改变下班以后无处读书的局面。
pinyin: wǒ men xiǎng gǎi biàn xià bān yǐ hòu wú chù dú shū de jú miàn .
meaning: We want to change the lack of a reading place after work.

text: 没有问不来的人，记录就缺乏他们的意见。
pinyin: méi yǒu wèn bù lái de rén , jì lù jiù quē fá tā men de yì jiàn .
meaning: Without asking non-attendees, the record lacks their views.

text: 群体
pinyin: qún tǐ
meaning: group of people

text: 不同群体需要的时间可能不同。
pinyin: bù tóng qún tǐ xū yào de shí jiān kě néng bù tóng .
meaning: Different groups may need different hours.

text: 比重
pinyin: bǐ zhòng
meaning: proportion; relative share

text: 不知道总人数，就算不出这个比重。
pinyin: bù zhī dào zǒng rén shù , jiù suàn bù chū zhè gè bǐ zhòng .
meaning: Without the total population we cannot calculate this proportion.

text: 多开两小时，也有整理和关门的成本。
pinyin: duō kāi liǎng xiǎo shí , yě yǒu zhěng lǐ hé guān mén de chéng běn .
meaning: Two additional hours also involve tidying and closing costs.

text: 有人找到读书时间，是一个成效，但还要继续看。
pinyin: yǒu rén zhǎo dào dú shū shí jiān , shì yī gè chéng xiào , dàn hái yào jì xù kàn .
meaning: Some finding time to read is a benefit, but further observation is needed.

text: 我先大致介绍四周的记录。
pinyin: wǒ xiān dà zhì jiè shào sì zhōu de jì lù .
meaning: I will first give a broad account of the four-week records.

text: 只看总人数，这个依据太单一。
pinyin: zhǐ kàn zǒng rén shù , zhè gè yī jù tài dān yī .
meaning: Total attendance alone is too one-dimensional a basis.

text: 想来的时间和开放时间有差距。
pinyin: xiǎng lái de shí jiān hé kāi fàng shí jiān yǒu chā jù .
meaning: There is a gap between desired visiting times and opening hours.

text: 检验
pinyin: jiǎn yàn
meaning: test; examine

text: 再试四周，可以检验这个安排能不能持续。
pinyin: zài shì sì zhōu , kě yǐ jiǎn yàn zhè gè ān pái néng bù néng chí xù .
meaning: Another four-week trial can test whether this arrangement can continue.

text: 没有到场，并不说明没有需要。
pinyin: méi yǒu dào chǎng , bìng bù shuō míng méi yǒu xū yào .
meaning: Not attending does not establish no need.

text: 即使再试四周，也要先确认人手。
pinyin: jí shǐ zài shì sì zhōu , yě yào xiān què rèn rén shǒu .
meaning: Even if we trial another four weeks, we still need to confirm staffing.

text: 没有总人数，就没有计算比重的依据。
pinyin: méi yǒu zǒng rén shù , jiù méi yǒu jì suàn bǐ zhòng de yī jù .
meaning: Without a total population there is no basis for the proportion.

text: 尽管有人到场，但还不知道多少是第一次来。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn yǒu rén dào chǎng , dàn hái bù zhī dào duō shao shì dì yī cì lái .
meaning: Although people attended, we don’t know how many were first-time visitors.

text: 凭这四周的记录，还不能决定所有日子。
pinyin: píng zhè sì zhōu de jì lù , hái bù néng jué dìng suǒ yǒu rì zi .
meaning: These four weeks’ records do not settle every day.

text: 这个记录能说明有人来，还不能说明人人需要。
pinyin: zhè gè jì lù néng shuō míng yǒu rén lái , hái bù néng shuō míng rén rén xū yào .
meaning: This record shows attendance, but not that everyone needs it.

text: 我赞成再试四周，前提是先确认人手。
pinyin: wǒ zàn chéng zài shì sì zhōu , qián tí shì xiān què rèn rén shǒu .
meaning: I favour another four-week trial, provided staffing is confirmed.

text: 你说比重，比较的总人数是多少？
pinyin: nǐ shuō bǐ zhòng , bǐ jiào de zǒng rén shù shì duō shao ?
meaning: You mention a proportion; what is the total population being compared?

text: 幽默
pinyin: yōu mò
meaning: humour; humorous

text: 他想用幽默缓解尴尬，可是新朋友没听懂。
pinyin: tā xiǎng yòng yōu mò huǎn jiě gān gà , kě shì xīn péng you méi tīng dǒng .
meaning: He tried humour to ease the awkwardness, but the newcomer didn’t understand.

text: 神情
pinyin: shén qíng
meaning: expression; look

text: 她的神情变了，我才发现她没有跟着笑。
pinyin: tā de shén qíng biàn le , wǒ cái fā xiàn tā méi yǒu gēn zhe xiào .
meaning: Her expression changed, and I realised she wasn’t laughing with us.

text: 脸色
pinyin: liǎn sè
meaning: facial complexion; expression

text: 她脸色不好，我先问是不是累了。
pinyin: tā liǎn sè bù hǎo , wǒ xiān wèn shì bú shì lèi le .
meaning: She looked unwell, so I first asked whether she was tired.

text: 脾气
pinyin: pí qì
meaning: temper; temperament

text: 别把一次生气，就说成她脾气一直不好。
pinyin: bié bǎ yī cì shēng qì , jiù shuō chéng tā pí qì yì zhí bù hǎo .
meaning: Don’t turn one angry moment into a claim she always has a bad temper.

text: 别这么客气，多吃一点。
pinyin: bié zhè me kè qì , duō chī yī diǎn .
meaning: Don’t be so formal—have a little more to eat.

text: 面子
pinyin: miàn zi
meaning: face; social dignity

text: 我想给他留点面子，就没有当众重复那件事。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gěi tā liú diǎn miàn zi , jiù méi yǒu dāng zhòng chóng fù nà jiàn shì .
meaning: To spare him embarrassment, I didn’t repeat it in front of everyone.

text: 她是在解释，不是在骂我。
pinyin: tā shì zài jiě shì , bù shì zài mà wǒ .
meaning: She is explaining, not scolding me.

text: 傻
pinyin: shǎ
meaning: foolish; silly

text: 他觉得自己的做法有点傻，不是在说别人都傻。
pinyin: tā jué de zì jǐ de zuò fǎ yǒu diǎn shǎ , bù shì zài shuō bié ren dōu shǎ .
meaning: He thought his own action a little silly, not that others were all foolish.

text: 我居然把盐放了两次。
pinyin: wǒ jū rán bǎ yán fàng le liǎng cì .
meaning: I somehow put salt in twice.

text: 明明
pinyin: míng míng
meaning: clearly; obviously, contrary to a claim

text: 明明尝着很咸，他还说你真会放盐。
pinyin: míng míng cháng zhe hěn xián , tā hái shuō nǐ zhēn huì fàng yán .
meaning: It clearly tasted salty, yet he said I was good at adding salt.

text: 可
pinyin: kě
meaning: emphatic adverb in context

text: 这句话可不一定是在夸。
pinyin: zhè jù huà kě bù yí dìng shì zài kuā .
meaning: This sentence certainly isn’t necessarily praise.

text: 厉害
pinyin: lì hài
meaning: impressive; severe; formidable

text: 你能一边做饭一边接电话，真厉害。
pinyin: nǐ néng yī biān zuò fàn yī biān jiē diàn huà , zhēn lì hài .
meaning: Cooking while taking calls is impressive.

text: 可怜
pinyin: kě lián
meaning: pitiful; unfortunate

text: 他说这碗汤太可怜了，盐全进去了。
pinyin: tā shuō zhè wǎn tāng tài kě lián le , yán quán jìn qù le .
meaning: He joked the soup was unfortunate: all the salt went into it.

text: 忍不住
pinyin: rěn bú zhù
meaning: cannot help doing

text: 听见那句，我忍不住笑了一下。
pinyin: tīng jiàn nà jù , wǒ rěn bú zhù xiào le yī xià .
meaning: I couldn’t help a brief laugh at that line.

text: 忍受
pinyin: rěn shòu
meaning: endure; put up with

text: 不喜欢那样叫，就不用一直忍受。
pinyin: bù xǐ huān nà yàng jiào , jiù bù yòng yì zhí rěn shòu .
meaning: You needn’t keep putting up with a name you dislike.

text: 强迫
pinyin: qiǎng pò
meaning: force; compel

text: 我不想强迫你跟着笑。
pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng qiǎng pò nǐ gēn zhe xiào .
meaning: I don’t want to force you to laugh along.

text: 讨厌
pinyin: tǎo yàn
meaning: dislike; annoying

text: 我讨厌一直拿同一件事来说。
pinyin: wǒ tǎo yàn yì zhí ná tóng yī jiàn shì lái shuō .
meaning: I dislike having the same matter brought up repeatedly.

text: 他模仿自己找盐的样子，大家才笑了。
pinyin: tā mó fǎng zì jǐ zhǎo yán de yàng zi , dà jiā cái xiào le .
meaning: He imitated himself searching for salt, and people laughed.

text: 模样
pinyin: mú yàng
meaning: appearance; look

text: 我没看见他当时的模样，只看了文字。
pinyin: wǒ méi kàn jiàn tā dāng shí de mú yàng , zhǐ kàn le wén zì .
meaning: I didn’t see his expression at the time; I only read the text.

text: 目光
pinyin: mù guāng
meaning: gaze; look

text: 她把目光移到汤上，没有看我。
pinyin: tā bǎ mù guāng yí dào tāng shàng , méi yǒu kàn wǒ .
meaning: She shifted her gaze to the soup instead of looking at me.

text: 瞧
pinyin: qiáo
meaning: look; see, conversational

text: 你瞧，我又拿起盐了。
pinyin: nǐ qiáo , wǒ yòu ná qǐ yán le .
meaning: Look, I’ve picked the salt up again.

text: 悄悄
pinyin: qiāo qiāo
meaning: quietly; secretly

text: 她悄悄问我，那句话是不是在生气。
pinyin: tā qiāo qiāo wèn wǒ , nà jù huà shì bú shì zài shēng qì .
meaning: She quietly asked whether the sentence showed anger.

text: 随意
pinyin: suí yì
meaning: casually; at will

text: 不熟的人之间，称呼别太随意。
pinyin: bù shú de rén zhī jiān , chēng hū bié tài suí yì .
meaning: Don’t use overly casual forms of address with people you barely know.

text: 我放盐时出了点失误，汤太咸了。
pinyin: wǒ fàng yán shí chū le diǎn shī wù , tāng tài xián le .
meaning: I made a mistake adding salt; the soup was too salty.

text: 明明汤很咸，他还说真会放盐。
pinyin: míng míng tāng hěn xián , tā hái shuō zhēn huì fàng yán .
meaning: The soup is clearly salty, yet he says I’m good at adding salt.

text: 我可没答应一直来。
pinyin: wǒ kě méi dā yìng yì zhí lái .
meaning: I certainly didn’t promise to keep coming.

text: 真有你的，这么快就修好了。
pinyin: zhēn yǒu nǐ de , zhè me kuài jiù xiū hǎo le .
meaning: Impressive—you fixed it so quickly.

text: 笑什么笑，先尝了再说。
pinyin: xiào shén me xiào , xiān cháng le zài shuō .
meaning: What are you laughing at? Taste it before commenting.

text: 你是在笑这次放多了，不是在生气，对吗？
pinyin: nǐ shì zài xiào zhè cì fàng duō le , bù shì zài shēng qì , duì ma ?
meaning: You’re teasing about adding too much this time, not angry, right?

text: 这件事别再说了，我们先吃吧。
pinyin: zhè jiàn shì bié zài shuō le , wǒ men xiān chī ba .
meaning: Please stop repeating this one; let’s eat.

text: 对不起，我刚才又说了一句。现在停。
pinyin: duì bù qǐ , wǒ gāng cái yòu shuō le yī jù . xiàn zài tíng .
meaning: Sorry, I added another line. I’ll stop now.

text: 情节里先收好旧信，后来才走向窗边。
pinyin: qíng jié lǐ xiān shōu hǎo jiù xìn , hòu lái cái zǒu xiàng chuāng biān .
meaning: The plot first has the old letters put away, then a move towards the window.

text: 剧本
pinyin: jù běn
meaning: script

text: 剧本只写打开窗，没有写是谁回来。
pinyin: jù běn zhǐ xiě dǎ kāi chuāng , méi yǒu xiě shì shéi huí lái .
meaning: The script says to open the window, not who returns.

text: 这段诗歌把灯和等待放在一起。
pinyin: zhè duàn shī gē bǎ dēng hé děng dài fàng zài yì qǐ .
meaning: This poem connects a light with waiting.

text: 手法
pinyin: shǒu fǎ
meaning: technique; artistic device

text: 重复同一句是一种手法，不是忘了换词。
pinyin: chóng fù tóng yī jù shì yī zhǒng shǒu fǎ , bù shì wàng le huàn cí .
meaning: Repeating the same line is a device, not forgetting to change words.

text: 窗边的灯让我联想到有人等着。
pinyin: chuāng biān de dēng ràng wǒ lián xiǎng dào yǒu rén děng zhe .
meaning: The light at the window makes me think of someone waiting.

text: 最后他的目光从盒子移到窗外。
pinyin: zuì hòu tā de mù guāng cóng hé zi yí dào chuāng wài .
meaning: Finally his gaze shifts from the box to outside the window.

text: 他的神情放松了一点，没有立刻笑。
pinyin: tā de shén qíng fàng sōng le yī diǎn , méi yǒu lì kè xiào .
meaning: His expression relaxed a little without an immediate smile.

text: 频道
pinyin: pín dào
meaning: channel

text: 这个频道放了完整表演，不只有一小段。
pinyin: zhè gè pín dào fàng le wán zhěng biǎo yǎn , bù zhǐ yǒu yī xiǎo duàn .
meaning: This channel posted the full performance, not just a short extract.

text: 视频
pinyin: shì pín
meaning: video

text: 我先看完整视频，再比较朋友发来的短版。
pinyin: wǒ xiān kàn wán zhěng shì pín , zài bǐ jiào péng you fā lái de duǎn bǎn .
meaning: I watch the full video before comparing the short version from a friend.

text: 拍摄
pinyin: pāi shè
meaning: film; shoot

text: 这段拍摄只对着上半身，没拍到窗边的动作。
pinyin: zhè duàn pāi shè zhǐ duì zhe shàng bàn shēn , méi pāi dào chuāng biān de dòng zuò .
meaning: This recording frames only the upper body, missing the action at the window.

text: 摄影师
pinyin: shè yǐng shī
meaning: photographer; camera operator

text: 摄影师问，最后要不要把窗也放进画面。
pinyin: shè yǐng shī wèn , zuì hòu yào bù yào bǎ chuāng yě fàng jìn huà miàn .
meaning: The camera operator asked whether to include the window in the final frame.

text: 朗读
pinyin: lǎng dú
meaning: read aloud

text: 先朗读两句，看看停在哪里。
pinyin: xiān lǎng dú liǎng jù , kàn kàn tíng zài nǎ lǐ .
meaning: Read two lines aloud first and consider where to pause.

text: 弹
pinyin: tán
meaning: play a stringed or keyboard instrument

text: 他一开始弹得轻，后来慢慢响起来。
pinyin: tā yī kāi shǐ tán de qīng , hòu lái màn màn xiǎng qǐ lái .
meaning: He plays quietly at first, then gradually louder.

text: 琴
pinyin: qín
meaning: stringed or keyboard instrument

text: 琴放在窗边，不在门口。
pinyin: qín fàng zài chuāng biān , bù zài mén kǒu .
meaning: The instrument is beside the window, not the door.

text: 声
pinyin: shēng
meaning: sound; classifier for sounds

text: 我听见一声响，才注意到盒子关了。
pinyin: wǒ tīng jiàn yī shēng xiǎng , cái zhù yì dào hé zi guān le .
meaning: I heard a sound and noticed the box had closed.

text: 只听录音和看现场，是不同的情形。
pinyin: zhǐ tīng lù yīn hé kàn xiàn chǎng , shì bù tóng de qíng xíng .
meaning: Hearing a recording and seeing it live are different circumstances.

text: 仍旧
pinyin: réng jiù
meaning: still; as before

text: 收好信以后，那个人仍旧记得过去。
pinyin: shōu hǎo xìn yǐ hòu , nà gè rén réng jiù jì de guò qù .
meaning: After putting the letters away, the person still remembers the past.

text: 如同
pinyin: rú tóng
meaning: like; as if

text: 这里的灯如同一个还没说出的邀请。
pinyin: zhè lǐ de dēng rú tóng yī gè hái méi shuō chū de yāo qǐng .
meaning: The light here resembles an invitation not yet spoken.

text: 深度
pinyin: shēn dù
meaning: depth

text: 讲清细节，比只说有深度更能解释我的看法。
pinyin: jiǎng qīng xì jié , bǐ zhǐ shuō yǒu shēn dù gèng néng jiě shì wǒ de kàn fǎ .
meaning: Explaining details conveys my view better than merely saying it has depth.

text: 旧信让他想起一起住过的时光。
pinyin: jiù xìn ràng tā xiǎng qǐ yì qǐ zhù guò de shí guāng .
meaning: The old letters remind him of their time living together.

text: 岁月过去，信上的字还在。
pinyin: suì yuè guò qù , xìn shàng de zì hái zài .
meaning: Years pass, but the writing on the letters remains.

text: 人物
pinyin: rén wù
meaning: character; person portrayed

text: 我说的是剧里的人物，不知道表演者自己的经历。
pinyin: wǒ shuō de shì jù lǐ de rén wù , bù zhī dào biǎo yǎn zhě zì jǐ de jīng lì .
meaning: I mean the character; I don’t know the performer’s own experience.

text: 节目先朗读一段散文，再唱这几句。
pinyin: jié mù xiān lǎng dú yī duàn sǎn wén , zài chàng zhè jǐ jù .
meaning: The programme reads a prose passage aloud before singing these lines.

text: 展现
pinyin: zhǎn xiàn
meaning: show; present; reveal

text: 最后的动作展现了一点变化，没有把未来说死。
pinyin: zuì hòu de dòng zuò zhǎn xiàn le yī diǎn biàn huà , méi yǒu bǎ wèi lái shuō sǐ .
meaning: The final action shows some change without fixing the future.

text: 随着相邻内容改变，同一句带出的意思也变了。
pinyin: suí zhe xiāng lín nèi róng gǎi biàn , tóng yī jù dài chū de yì si yě biàn le .
meaning: As neighbouring wording changes, the same line’s implications change too.

text: 收好信不一定是不想再见。
pinyin: shōu hǎo xìn bù yí dìng shì bù xiǎng zài jiàn .
meaning: Putting letters away does not necessarily mean refusing another meeting.

text: 我把关盒子当成关灯了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ guān hé zi dàng chéng guān dēng le .
meaning: I mistook closing the box for switching off the light.

text: 这里既有难过，也有一点希望。
pinyin: zhè lǐ jì yǒu nán guò , yě yǒu yī diǎn xī wàng .
meaning: There is both sadness and some hope here.

text: 跟短版相比，完整版多了开窗的动作。
pinyin: gēn duǎn bǎn xiāng bǐ , wán zhěng bǎn duō le kāi chuāng de dòng zuò .
meaning: Compared with the short version, the full version adds the window action.

text: 我这样理解，是因为最后又打开了窗。
pinyin: wǒ zhè yàng lǐ jiě , shì yīn wèi zuì hòu yòu dǎ kāi le chuāng .
meaning: I read it this way because the window opens again at the end.

text: 我还觉得有点难过，不过你说的那一点也有依据。
pinyin: wǒ hái jué de yǒu diǎn nán guò , bù guò nǐ shuō de nà yī diǎn yě yǒu yī jù .
meaning: I still find it somewhat sad, but your point has support too.

text: 你说收信还是关灯？我最后两个字没听清。
pinyin: nǐ shuō shōu xìn hái shi guān dēng ? wǒ zuì hòu liǎng gè zì méi tīng qīng .
meaning: Did you say put letters away or turn off the light? I missed the last two words.

text: 承诺
pinyin: chéng nuò
meaning: promise; commitment

text: 我承诺提前确认，不承诺以后永远不会有变化。
pinyin: wǒ chéng nuò tí qián què rèn , bù chéng nuò yǐ hòu yǒng yuǎn bù huì yǒu biàn huà .
meaning: I promise to confirm ahead, not that nothing will ever change.

text: 道歉
pinyin: dào qiàn
meaning: apologise

text: 我要为刚才说得太重道歉。
pinyin: wǒ yào wèi gāng cái shuō de tài zhòng dào qiàn .
meaning: I need to apologise for speaking too harshly.

text: 抱歉
pinyin: bào qiàn
meaning: sorry

text: 抱歉，我刚才没有看完整条消息。
pinyin: bào qiàn , wǒ gāng cái méi yǒu kàn wán zhěng tiáo xiāo xī .
meaning: Sorry, I didn’t read the whole message.

text: 当作
pinyin: dàng zuò
meaning: treat as; take for

text: 我把两点下班当作两点到场了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ liǎng diǎn xià bān dàng zuò liǎng diǎn dào chǎng le .
meaning: I took finishing work at two to mean arriving at two.

text: 打断
pinyin: dǎ duàn
meaning: interrupt

text: 我先让她说完，没有马上打断。
pinyin: wǒ xiān ràng tā shuō wán , méi yǒu mǎ shàng dǎ duàn .
meaning: I let her finish without interrupting immediately.

text: 错过
pinyin: cuò guò
meaning: miss

text: 我错过的是两点一起准备，不是整个下午。
pinyin: wǒ cuò guò de shì liǎng diǎn yì qǐ zhǔn bèi , bù shì zhěng gè xià wǔ .
meaning: I missed preparing together at two, not the whole afternoon.

text: 不至于
pinyin: bù zhì yú
meaning: not go so far as; not necessarily reach

text: 这次没说清，不至于说明每次都故意迟到。
pinyin: zhè cì méi shuō qīng , bù zhì yú shuō míng měi cì dōu gù yì chí dào .
meaning: This unclear arrangement doesn’t establish deliberate lateness every time.

text: 从不
pinyin: cóng bù
meaning: never, for a habit

text: 他说我从不看消息，可他只提了这一次。
pinyin: tā shuō wǒ cóng bù kàn xiāo xī , kě tā zhǐ tí le zhè yī cì .
meaning: He said I never read messages, but cited only this occasion.

text: 从没
pinyin: cóng méi
meaning: have never

text: 我从没答应两点到，只说两点下班。
pinyin: wǒ cóng méi dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào , zhǐ shuō liǎng diǎn xià bān .
meaning: I never promised to arrive at two, only to finish work then.

text: 原谅
pinyin: yuán liàng
meaning: forgive

text: 我想请你原谅那句太重的话。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ yuán liàng nà jù tài zhòng de huà .
meaning: I want to ask you to forgive that harsh remark.

text: 依赖
pinyin: yī lài
meaning: depend on; rely on

text: 我们太依赖自己记得的时间，没有再确认。
pinyin: wǒ men tài yī lài zì jǐ jì de de shí jiān , méi yǒu zài què rèn .
meaning: We relied too much on remembered times without checking again.

text: 缘故
pinyin: yuán gù
meaning: reason; cause

text: 你迟一点答复，是工作还没结束的缘故吗？
pinyin: nǐ chí yī diǎn dá fù , shì gōng zuò hái méi jié shù de yuán gù ma ?
meaning: Did unfinished work cause your later reply?

text: 约定
pinyin: yuē dìng
meaning: agree; agreed arrangement

text: 下次把约定写成到场时间，不只写下班时间。
pinyin: xià cì bǎ yuē dìng xiě chéng dào chǎng shí jiān , bù zhǐ xiě xià bān shí jiān .
meaning: Next time state the agreed arrival, not just finishing work.

text: 查看
pinyin: chá kàn
meaning: check; look at

text: 我重新查看了周五的整段消息。
pinyin: wǒ chóng xīn chá kàn le zhōu wǔ de zhěng duàn xiāo xī .
meaning: I checked the full Friday exchange again.

text: 此前
pinyin: cǐ qián
meaning: before this; previously

text: 此前我一直记成两点，所以先到了。
pinyin: cǐ qián wǒ yì zhí jì chéng liǎng diǎn , suǒ yǐ xiān dào le .
meaning: Before this I had remembered two, so I arrived first.

text: 此事
pinyin: cǐ shì
meaning: this matter

text: 我想先把此事说清，不翻出所有旧争论。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng xiān bǎ cǐ shì shuō qīng , bù fān chū suǒ yǒu jiù zhēng lùn .
meaning: I want to clarify this matter first without reopening every old argument.

text: 表面上
pinyin: biǎo miàn shàng
meaning: on the surface

text: 表面上是半小时，真正难受的是以为被放下不管。
pinyin: biǎo miàn shàng shì bàn xiǎo shí , zhēn zhèng nán shòu de shì yǐ wéi bèi fàng xià bù guǎn .
meaning: On the surface it is half an hour; the hurt is feeling abandoned.

text: 长久
pinyin: cháng jiǔ
meaning: lasting; long-term

text: 我们想长久来往，不能每次都靠猜。
pinyin: wǒ men xiǎng cháng jiǔ lái wǎng , bù néng měi cì dōu kào cāi .
meaning: We want a lasting friendship, not guesses on every occasion.

text: 采纳
pinyin: cǎi nà
meaning: adopt; accept a suggestion

text: 我采纳了她提前写清时间的建议。
pinyin: wǒ cǎi nà le tā tí qián xiě qīng shí jiān de jiàn yì .
meaning: I adopted her suggestion to state the time ahead.

text: 不便
pinyin: bù biàn
meaning: inconvenient; not convenient

text: 她那时不便看手机，并不是故意不理。
pinyin: tā nà shí bù biàn kàn shǒu jī , bìng bù shì gù yì bù lǐ .
meaning: It wasn’t convenient for her to look at her phone then, not deliberate ignoring.

text: 不料
pinyin: bù liào
meaning: unexpectedly; contrary to expectation

text: 我想解释，不料那句话又让她生气了。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiě shì , bù liào nà jù huà yòu ràng tā shēng qì le .
meaning: I wanted to explain, but that sentence unexpectedly upset her again.

text: 拨打
pinyin: bō dǎ
meaning: dial; make a phone call

text: 真有急事，可以拨打电话，别只等消息。
pinyin: zhēn yǒu jí shì , kě yǐ bō dǎ diàn huà , bié zhǐ děng xiāo xī .
meaning: For something urgent, you can call instead of only waiting for a message.

text: 偏
pinyin: piān
meaning: contrary to expectation; insistently

text: 我想冷静，他偏在这时候又提一次。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng lěng jìng , tā piān zài zhè shí hòu yòu tí yī cì .
meaning: I wanted to calm down, but he brought it up again just then.

text: 恰好
pinyin: qià hǎo
meaning: just; happen to

text: 他回复时，我恰好已经走到小厅。
pinyin: tā huí fù shí , wǒ qià hǎo yǐ jīng zǒu dào xiǎo tīng .
meaning: When he replied I had just reached the hall.

text: 特意
pinyin: tè yì
meaning: specially; deliberately for a purpose

text: 我特意早点来，想先把桌子摆好。
pinyin: wǒ tè yì zǎo diǎn lái , xiǎng xiān bǎ zhuō zi bǎi hǎo .
meaning: I came early specially to arrange the tables.

text: 亲眼
pinyin: qīn yǎn
meaning: with one’s own eyes

text: 我亲眼看见她到了，没有看到她前面的路程。
pinyin: wǒ qīn yǎn kàn jiàn tā dào le , méi yǒu kàn dào tā qián miàn de lù chéng .
meaning: I saw her arrive myself, not her earlier journey.

text: 仿佛
pinyin: fǎng fú
meaning: as if; seem like

text: 没收到答复时，我仿佛觉得只有自己在等。
pinyin: méi shōu dào dá fù shí , wǒ fǎng fú jué de zhǐ yǒu zì jǐ zài děng .
meaning: Without a reply I felt as if I alone was waiting.

text: 不再
pinyin: bù zài
meaning: no longer

text: 解释清楚以后，我不再坚持说他每次都迟到。
pinyin: jiě shì qīng chǔ yǐ hòu , wǒ bù zài jiān chí shuō tā měi cì dōu chí dào .
meaning: After clarification I no longer insisted he was late every time.

text: 不怎么
pinyin: bù zěn me
meaning: not very; not much

text: 那天我不怎么想聊天，只想先把安排弄清楚。
pinyin: nà tiān wǒ bù zěn me xiǎng liáo tiān , zhǐ xiǎng xiān bǎ ān pái nòng qīng chǔ .
meaning: I wasn’t very keen to chat that day; I wanted to clarify the arrangement first.

text: 本身
pinyin: běn shēn
meaning: itself

text: 等待本身已经让她累了，后来又听到很重的话。
pinyin: děng dài běn shēn yǐ jīng ràng tā lèi le , hòu lái yòu tīng dào hěn zhòng de huà .
meaning: The waiting itself had tired her, before the harsh remarks.

text: 次数
pinyin: cì shù
meaning: number of occurrences

text: 我们没有核对以前的次数，就说成每次。
pinyin: wǒ men méi yǒu hé duì yǐ qián de cì shù , jiù shuō chéng měi cì .
meaning: We said every time without checking how many earlier occurrences there were.

text: 挨着
pinyin: āi zhe
meaning: next to

text: 我们挨着桌子坐，把手机放在中间一起看。
pinyin: wǒ men āi zhe zhuō zi zuò , bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhōng jiān yì qǐ kàn .
meaning: We sat beside the table with the phone between us to check together.

text: 虽已看清消息，但等待时的难受还在。
pinyin: suī yǐ kàn qīng xiāo xī , dàn děng dài shí de nán shòu hái zài .
meaning: Although the message is clear now, the hurt from waiting remains.

text: 就算这次迟了，也不能直接说每次都迟。
pinyin: jiù suàn zhè cì chí le , yě bù néng zhí jiē shuō měi cì dōu chí .
meaning: Even if late this time, that does not establish lateness every time.

text: 那句解释不但没有让她放心，反而让她更生气。
pinyin: nà jù jiě shì bù dàn méi yǒu ràng tā fàng xīn , fǎn ér ràng tā gèng shēng qì .
meaning: That explanation not only failed to reassure her but upset her further.

text: 你两点半到了，也没解决前面的等待。那倒也是。
pinyin: nǐ liǎng diǎn bàn dào le , yě méi jiě jué qián miàn de děng dài . nà dào yě shì .
meaning: Arriving at 2:30 doesn’t remove the waiting. That is true.

text: 改就改吧，先把新的时间说清。
pinyin: gǎi jiù gǎi ba , xiān bǎ xīn de shí jiān shuō qīng .
meaning: Fine, change it; tell me the new time first.

text: 看完消息，我慢慢平静下来。
pinyin: kàn wán xiāo xī , wǒ màn màn píng jìng xià lái .
meaning: After checking the message I gradually calmed down.

text: 你说的是这次，还是以前还有几次？
pinyin: nǐ shuō de shì zhè cì , hái shi yǐ qián hái yǒu jǐ cì ?
meaning: Do you mean this occasion, or several earlier ones too?

text: 我没看完整，也不该说每次。抱歉。
pinyin: wǒ méi kàn wán zhěng , yě bù gāi shuō měi cì . bào qiàn .
meaning: I didn’t read it all and shouldn’t have said every time. Sorry.

text: 六点到小厅，五点半再确认，对吗？
pinyin: liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǔ diǎn bàn zài què rèn , duì ma ?
meaning: Six at the hall, with a 5:30 check, right?

text: 意愿
pinyin: yì yuàn
meaning: willingness; wish

text: 愿意来听，不等于有意愿负责整个活动。
pinyin: yuàn yì lái tīng , bù děng yú yǒu yì yuàn fù zé zhěng gè huó dòng .
meaning: Wanting to listen doesn’t mean wanting to run the whole event.

text: 能否
pinyin: néng fǒu
meaning: whether someone can

text: 请问能否在周五下午送到？
pinyin: qǐng wèn néng fǒu zài zhōu wǔ xià wǔ sòng dào ?
meaning: Could you deliver it Friday afternoon?

text: 协助
pinyin: xié zhù
meaning: assist

text: 我能协助开头的介绍，不能负责全场。
pinyin: wǒ néng xié zhù kāi tóu de jiè shào , bù néng fù zé quán chǎng .
meaning: I can assist with the opening introduction, not the entire event.

text: 协商
pinyin: xié shāng
meaning: discuss to reach an agreement

text: 时间不合适，我们再协商。
pinyin: shí jiān bù hé shì , wǒ men zài xié shāng .
meaning: If the time doesn’t work, we can discuss it again.

text: 协调
pinyin: xié tiáo
meaning: coordinate

text: 谁来协调借东西和归还东西的时间？
pinyin: shéi lái xié tiáo jiè dōng xi hé guī huán dōng xi de shí jiān ?
meaning: Who will coordinate borrowing and returning the items?

text: 分工
pinyin: fēn gōng
meaning: divide responsibilities

text: 把分工写清，别都叫帮一下。
pinyin: bǎ fēn gōng xiě qīng , bié dōu jiào bāng yī xià .
meaning: Write out the division of work instead of calling everything a little help.

text: 职责
pinyin: zhí zé
meaning: responsibilities of a role

text: 保管设备不在我这次的职责里。
pinyin: bǎo guǎn shè bèi bù zài wǒ zhè cì de zhí zé lǐ .
meaning: Looking after the equipment isn’t my responsibility this time.

text: 物品
pinyin: wù pǐn
meaning: items; belongings

text: 借来的物品不能直接留给下一组。
pinyin: jiè lái de wù pǐn bù néng zhí jiē liú gěi xià yī zǔ .
meaning: Borrowed items can’t simply be left to the next group.

text: 专用
pinyin: zhuān yòng
meaning: for a specific use

text: 这条线是音箱专用的，不能换成手机的。
pinyin: zhè tiáo xiàn shì yīn xiāng zhuān yòng de , bù néng huàn chéng shǒu jī de .
meaning: This cable is specifically for the speaker, not interchangeable with the phone cable.

text: 指定
pinyin: zhǐ dìng
meaning: designate; specify

text: 通知指定的是小厅，不是大礼堂。
pinyin: tōng zhī zhǐ dìng de shì xiǎo tīng , bù shì dà lǐ táng .
meaning: The notice specifies the small hall, not the main auditorium.

text: 允许
pinyin: yǔn xǔ
meaning: permit

text: 主人允许带走，不代表允许转借。
pinyin: zhǔ rén yǔn xǔ dài zǒu , bù dài biǎo yǔn xǔ zhuǎn jiè .
meaning: The owner permits taking it away, not necessarily lending it on.

text: 到期
pinyin: dào qī
meaning: reach the end of an agreed period

text: 借用时间周六五点到期。
pinyin: jiè yòng shí jiān zhōu liù wǔ diǎn dào qī .
meaning: The borrowing period ends Saturday at five.

text: 变更
pinyin: biàn gēng
meaning: change an arrangement formally

text: 要变更归还时间，先问物品的主人。
pinyin: yào biàn gēng guī huán shí jiān , xiān wèn wù pǐn de zhǔ rén .
meaning: To change the return time, ask the owner first.

text: 提交
pinyin: tí jiāo
meaning: submit

text: 周五中午以前提交最终的分工。
pinyin: zhōu wǔ zhōng wǔ yǐ qián tí jiāo zuì zhōng de fēn gōng .
meaning: Submit the final division of work before noon Friday.

text: 此次
pinyin: cǐ cì
meaning: this occasion

text: 此次我只负责开头十五分钟。
pinyin: cǐ cì wǒ zhǐ fù zé kāi tóu shí wǔ fēn zhōng .
meaning: This time I am only responsible for the first fifteen minutes.

text: 有关
pinyin: yǒu guān
meaning: related; concerning

text: 有关音箱的问题，请直接联系陈宇。
pinyin: yǒu guān yīn xiāng de wèn tí , qǐng zhí jiē lián xì chén yǔ .
meaning: For questions about the speaker, contact Chen Yu directly.

text: 音量
pinyin: yīn liàng
meaning: sound volume

text: 先试音量，别一开就太大声。
pinyin: xiān shì yīn liàng , bié yī kāi jiù tài dà shēng .
meaning: Test the volume first instead of starting too loud.

text: 通话
pinyin: tōng huà
meaning: have a phone conversation

text: 我们通话时，把几点到和几点走都说了。
pinyin: wǒ men tōng huà shí , bǎ jǐ diǎn dào hé jǐ diǎn zǒu dōu shuō le .
meaning: In the call we stated both arrival and departure times.

text: 名额
pinyin: míng é
meaning: available places; quota

text: 二十个名额已经满了，先别加人。
pinyin: èr shí gè míng é yǐ jīng mǎn le , xiān bié jiā rén .
meaning: The twenty places are filled; don’t add people yet.

text: 场地
pinyin: chǎng dì
meaning: venue; space used for an activity

text: 场地五点关闭，所以四点半开始收。
pinyin: chǎng dì wǔ diǎn guān bì , suǒ yǐ sì diǎn bàn kāi shǐ shōu .
meaning: The venue closes at five, so we begin packing at 4:30.

text: 免得
pinyin: miǎn de
meaning: so as to avoid

text: 先把时间写下来，免得又记成一整天。
pinyin: xiān bǎ shí jiān xiě xià lái , miǎn de yòu jì chéng yī zhěng tiān .
meaning: Write down the times so it isn’t remembered as a whole day again.

text: 只顾
pinyin: zhǐ gù
meaning: focus only on, overlooking something else

text: 我只顾问谁能来，忘了问能待多久。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ gù wèn shéi néng lái , wàng le wèn néng dài duō jiǔ .
meaning: I only asked who could come and forgot to ask how long.

text: 只管
pinyin: zhǐ guǎn
meaning: go ahead and do, without worrying

text: 不懂的地方只管问，不用装懂。
pinyin: bù dǒng de dì fāng zhǐ guǎn wèn , bù yòng zhuāng dǒng .
meaning: Go ahead and ask about anything you don’t understand.

text: 只得
pinyin: zhǐ dé
meaning: have no alternative but to

text: 五点必须还回去，我们只得提前收好。
pinyin: wǔ diǎn bì xū huán huí qù , wǒ men zhǐ dé tí qián shōu hǎo .
meaning: We must return it at five, so we have to pack up ahead.

text: 再说
pinyin: zài shuō
meaning: leave until later; besides

text: 借不借等问过主人再说。
pinyin: jiè bù jiè děng wèn guò zhǔ rén zài shuō .
meaning: We’ll decide about borrowing after asking the owner.

text: 算了
pinyin: suàn le
meaning: let it go; never mind

text: 她这周不方便，那就算了，别再追问。
pinyin: tā zhè zhōu bù fāng biàn , nà jiù suàn le , bié zài zhuī wèn .
meaning: She can’t this week, so let it go instead of asking repeatedly.

text: 周六下午不便到场，我可以周五先介绍。
pinyin: zhōu liù xià wǔ bù biàn dào chǎng , wǒ kě yǐ zhōu wǔ xiān jiè shào .
meaning: I can’t attend Saturday afternoon, but can make an introduction Friday.

text: 若
pinyin: ruò
meaning: if, in a formal or written condition

text: 若时间有变，请提前通知。
pinyin: ruò shí jiān yǒu biàn , qǐng tí qián tōng zhī .
meaning: If the time changes, please notify us ahead.

text: 凡是
pinyin: fán shì
meaning: all those that; whenever

text: 凡是借来的物品，都要按约定归还。
pinyin: fán shì jiè lái de wù pǐn , dōu yào àn yuē dìng guī huán .
meaning: All borrowed items must be returned as agreed.

text: 罢了
pinyin: bà le
meaning: merely; that is all

text: 我只说可以介绍一下罢了，没有答应全程负责。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shuō kě yǐ jiè shào yī xià bà le , méi yǒu dā yìng quán chéng fù zé .
meaning: I only offered an introduction; I didn’t agree to manage everything.

text: 问题本身不难，难的是大家想的范围不同。
pinyin: wèn tí běn shēn bù nán , nán de shì dà jiā xiǎng de fàn wéi bù tóng .
meaning: The issue itself isn’t hard; the assumed scope differs.

text: 听取
pinyin: tīng qǔ
meaning: hear and consider someone’s views

text: 先听取她的安排，再决定怎么分工。
pinyin: xiān tīng qǔ tā de ān pái , zài jué dìng zěn me fēn gōng .
meaning: Hear her availability before deciding responsibilities.

text: 至于音箱，你直接跟主人联系。
pinyin: zhì yú yīn xiāng , nǐ zhí jiē gēn zhǔ rén lián xì .
meaning: As for the speaker, contact the owner directly.

text: 要么减少书的数量，要么另找人接后面。
pinyin: yào me jiǎn shǎo shū de shù liàng , yào me lìng zhǎo rén jiē hòu miàn .
meaning: Either reduce the number of books or find someone for the rest.

text: 我只是说可以介绍一下罢了。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shì shuō kě yǐ jiè shào yī xià bà le .
meaning: I only said I could make an introduction.

text: 帮哪一段？大概需要多久？
pinyin: bāng nǎ yī duàn ? dà gài xū yào duō jiǔ ?
meaning: Which part? Roughly how long?

text: 我能介绍十五分钟，不能一直待到五点。
pinyin: wǒ néng jiè shào shí wǔ fēn zhōng , bù néng yì zhí dài dào wǔ diǎn .
meaning: I can introduce things for fifteen minutes, but can’t stay until five.

text: 我先问问，有回复再告诉你。
pinyin: wǒ xiān wèn wèn , yǒu huí fù zài gào sù nǐ .
meaning: I’ll ask first and tell you once there is a reply.

text: 响声
pinyin: xiǎng shēng
meaning: a sound; noise

text: 杯子落地的响声，把我吓了一跳。
pinyin: bēi zi luò dì de xiǎng shēng , bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào .
meaning: The sound of the glass falling startled me.

text: 地板
pinyin: dì bǎn
meaning: floor surface

text: 地板湿了，店员先让大家停一下。
pinyin: dì bǎn shī le , diàn yuán xiān ràng dà jiā tíng yī xià .
meaning: The floor was wet, so the worker asked everyone to stop.

text: 踩
pinyin: cǎi
meaning: step on

text: 我没看清，差点踩到碎片。
pinyin: wǒ méi kàn qīng , chà diǎn cǎi dào suì piàn .
meaning: I almost stepped on a fragment without seeing it.

text: 捡
pinyin: jiǎn
meaning: pick up something from the ground

text: 我想捡，她说先别动。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiǎn , tā shuō xiān bié dòng .
meaning: I wanted to pick it up, but she said not to move yet.

text: 裂
pinyin: liè
meaning: split; crack

text: 杯子已经裂了，不能继续用。
pinyin: bēi zi yǐ jīng liè le , bù néng jì xù yòng .
meaning: The glass was cracked and couldn’t be used.

text: 侧
pinyin: cè
meaning: side

text: 我坐在门的另一侧，没看到桌边。
pinyin: wǒ zuò zài mén de lìng yī cè , méi kàn dào zhuō biān .
meaning: I sat on the other side of the door and didn’t see the table edge.

text: 两侧
pinyin: liǎng cè
meaning: both sides

text: 通道两侧都有人，店员请他们让开。
pinyin: tōng dào liǎng cè dōu yǒu rén , diàn yuán qǐng tā men ràng kāi .
meaning: People stood on both sides of the passage and were asked to clear it.

text: 前方
pinyin: qián fāng
meaning: ahead; in front

text: 前方有人停下，我也没有往前走。
pinyin: qián fāng yǒu rén tíng xià , wǒ yě méi yǒu wǎng qián zǒu .
meaning: Someone ahead stopped, and I stopped too.

text: 脚印
pinyin: jiǎo yìn
meaning: footprint

text: 地上的脚印不能说明是谁碰倒杯子。
pinyin: dì shang de jiǎo yìn bù néng shuō míng shì shéi pèng dào bēi zi .
meaning: Footprints on the floor don’t establish who knocked over the glass.

text: 区分
pinyin: qū fēn
meaning: distinguish

text: 先区分我看到的和听别人说的。
pinyin: xiān qū fēn wǒ kàn dào de hé tīng bié ren shuō de .
meaning: First distinguish what I saw from what others told me.

text: 我亲眼看见的是杯子落地，没看见前一刻。
pinyin: wǒ qīn yǎn kàn jiàn de shì bēi zi luò dì , méi kàn jiàn qián yī kè .
meaning: I saw the glass fall, not the moment before.

text: 杯子落地时，我恰好低头拿包。
pinyin: bēi zi luò dì shí , wǒ qià hǎo dī tóu ná bāo .
meaning: As the glass fell I happened to be looking down for my bag.

text: 事后
pinyin: shì hòu
meaning: after the event

text: 事后我才听到完整的经过。
pinyin: shì hòu wǒ cái tīng dào wán zhěng de jīng guò .
meaning: Only afterwards did I hear the full account.

text: 此前我只看过那张没有桌面的照片。
pinyin: cǐ qián wǒ zhǐ kàn guò nà zhāng méi yǒu zhuō miàn de zhào piān .
meaning: Before this I had only seen the photo with the table cropped out.

text: 同一
pinyin: tóng yī
meaning: the same

text: 两个人说的是同一声提醒，理解却不同。
pinyin: liǎng gè rén shuō de shì tóng yī shēng tí xǐng , lǐ jiě què bù tóng .
meaning: They refer to the same warning but interpret it differently.

text: 传言
pinyin: chuán yán
meaning: rumour; an unconfirmed circulating account

text: 传言说店员跟客人吵架，原来的消息没有这样写。
pinyin: chuán yán shuō diàn yuán gēn kè rén chǎo jià , yuán lái de xiāo xī méi yǒu zhè yàng xiě .
meaning: A rumour said the worker argued with a guest; the original message didn’t say that.

text: 传出
pinyin: chuán chū
meaning: come out; spread from a source

text: 门里传出别动两个字，我没听见后面。
pinyin: mén lǐ chuán chū bié dòng liǎng gè zì , wǒ méi tīng jiàn hòu miàn .
meaning: “Don’t move” came from inside; I missed what followed.

text: 回应
pinyin: huí yìng
meaning: respond; response

text: 店员回应时，先解释她在提醒地上的碎片。
pinyin: diàn yuán huí yìng shí , xiān jiě shì tā zài tí xǐng dì shang de suì piàn .
meaning: In response the worker first explained the fragments on the floor.

text: 接收
pinyin: jiē shōu
meaning: receive

text: 我接收了照片，却还没看原来的文字。
pinyin: wǒ jiē shōu le zhào piān , què hái méi kàn yuán lái de wén zì .
meaning: I received the photo without yet reading the original text.

text: 我们查看原图，才看到桌边和地面。
pinyin: wǒ men chá kàn yuán tú , cái kàn dào zhuō biān hé dì miàn .
meaning: Checking the original photo revealed the table edge and floor.

text: 据
pinyin: jù
meaning: according to; based on

text: 据店员的说明，是她自己的袖子碰到了杯子。
pinyin: jù diàn yuán de shuō míng , shì tā zì jǐ de xiù zi pèng dào le bēi zi .
meaning: According to the worker, her own sleeve caught the glass.

text: 超出
pinyin: chāo chū
meaning: go beyond

text: 说客人故意闹事，已经超出我看到的内容。
pinyin: shuō kè rén gù yì nào shì , yǐ jīng chāo chū wǒ kàn dào de nèi róng .
meaning: Claiming deliberate trouble by a guest exceeds what I saw.

text: 忽略
pinyin: hū lüè
meaning: overlook

text: 我忽略了照片没有拍到前一刻。
pinyin: wǒ hū lüè le zhào piān méi yǒu pāi dào qián yī kè .
meaning: I overlooked that the photo didn’t show the preceding moment.

text: 倾向
pinyin: qīng xiàng
meaning: tendency; inclination

text: 我原来有把大声当成生气的倾向。
pinyin: wǒ yuán lái yǒu bǎ dà shēng dàng chéng shēng qì de qīng xiàng .
meaning: I tended to equate loudness with anger.

text: 本地
pinyin: běn dì
meaning: local; this area

text: 照片被发进一个本地群，后来传得很快。
pinyin: zhào piān bèi fā jìn yī gè běn dì qún , hòu lái chuán de hěn kuài .
meaning: The photo spread quickly after being posted in a local group.

text: 冷水
pinyin: lěng shuǐ
meaning: cold water

text: 杯子里装的是冷水，不是热茶。
pinyin: bēi zi lǐ zhuāng de shì lěng shuǐ , bù shì rè chá .
meaning: The glass contained cold water, not hot tea.

text: 壶
pinyin: hú
meaning: pot; kettle

text: 桌上的壶没有倒，倒的是旁边的杯子。
pinyin: zhuō shàng de hú méi yǒu dào , dào de shì páng biān de bēi zi .
meaning: The pot remained upright; the glass beside it fell.

text: 厨师
pinyin: chú shī
meaning: cook; chef

text: 厨师在后面工作，没有看到杯子怎么倒。
pinyin: chú shī zài hòu miàn gōng zuò , méi yǒu kàn dào bēi zi zěn me dào .
meaning: The chef was working at the back and didn’t see the glass fall.

text: 孩子挨着窗边坐，听见声音就站起来。
pinyin: hái zi āi zhe chuāng biān zuò , tīng jiàn shēng yīn jiù zhàn qǐ lái .
meaning: The child sat by the window and stood on hearing the sound.

text: 对抗
pinyin: duì kàng
meaning: oppose; confrontation

text: 我们没有对抗，只是在请大家别走过来。
pinyin: wǒ men méi yǒu duì kàng , zhǐ shì zài qǐng dà jiā bié zǒu guò lái .
meaning: We weren’t confronting anyone, just asking people not to come closer.

text: 足以
pinyin: zú yǐ
meaning: be enough to

text: 一张照片不足以说明之前发生了什么。
pinyin: yī zhāng zhào piān bù zú yǐ shuō míng zhī qián fā shēng le shén me .
meaning: One photo isn’t enough to establish what happened beforehand.

text: 此处
pinyin: cǐ chù
meaning: here; this place

text: 此处暂时不能通行，请从另一边走。
pinyin: cǐ chù zàn shí bù néng tōng xíng , qǐng cóng lìng yī biān zǒu .
meaning: This area is temporarily blocked; use the other side.

text: 据店员的说明，是她的袖子碰到了杯子。
pinyin: jù diàn yuán de shuō míng , shì tā de xiù zi pèng dào le bēi zi .
meaning: According to the worker, her sleeve caught the glass.

text: 剪掉地面不但没有说明清楚，反而让人误会。
pinyin: jiǎn diào dì miàn bù dàn méi yǒu shuō míng qīng chǔ , fǎn ér ràng rén wù huì .
meaning: Cropping out the floor did not clarify things; it caused misunderstanding.

text: 她时而看门口，时而看窗边。
pinyin: tā shí ér kàn mén kǒu , shí ér kàn chuāng biān .
meaning: She looked towards the entrance at times and towards the window at others.

text: 连前一刻都没看见，更不能说全程亲眼看到。
pinyin: lián qián yī kè dōu méi kàn jiàn , gèng bù néng shuō quán chéng qīn yǎn kàn dào .
meaning: I didn’t even see the previous moment, still less the whole event.

text: 我没看到前一刻。就是说，你只能讲后面看到的部分？
pinyin: wǒ méi kàn dào qián yī kè . jiù shì shuō , nǐ zhǐ néng jiǎng hòu miàn kàn dào de bù fèn ?
meaning: I missed the prior moment. So you can only describe what you saw afterwards?

text: 声音大，或是生气，或是提醒远处的人。
pinyin: shēng yīn dà , huò shì shēng qì , huò shì tí xǐng yuǎn chù de rén .
meaning: Loudness may be anger or a warning to people farther away.

text: 据她的说明，是袖子碰到了杯子。
pinyin: jù tā de shuō míng , shì xiù zi pèng dào le bēi zi .
meaning: According to her, the sleeve caught the glass.

text: 照片没拍到前一刻，这一部分我不知道。
pinyin: zhào piān méi pāi dào qián yī kè , zhè yī bù fèn wǒ bù zhī dào .
meaning: The photo misses the preceding moment; I don’t know that part.

text: 杯子确实碎了，但说我们吵架没有依据。
pinyin: bēi zi què shí suì le , dàn shuō wǒ men chǎo jià méi yǒu yī jù .
meaning: The glass did break, but there is no basis for saying we argued.

text: 稿子
pinyin: gǎo zi
meaning: written draft; script pages

text: 我拿的是改过的稿子，最后一句已经换了。
pinyin: wǒ ná de shì gǎi guò de gǎo zi , zuì hòu yī jù yǐ jīng huàn le .
meaning: I have the revised pages; the last line has changed.

text: 台灯
pinyin: tái dēng
meaning: desk lamp

text: 台灯照着桌面，门口看不清纸上的字。
pinyin: tái dēng zhào zhe zhuō miàn , mén kǒu kàn bù qīng zhǐ shàng de zì .
meaning: The lamp lights the desk; the writing isn’t visible from the door.

text: 收藏
pinyin: shōu cáng
meaning: collect; keep as a collection

text: 我想收藏这张节目单，记住最后一次。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng shōu cáng zhè zhāng jié mù dān , jì zhù zuì hòu yī cì .
meaning: I want to keep the programme as a memory of the final performance.

text: 歌词里说等，不说明等的人一定会回来。
pinyin: gē cí lǐ shuō děng , bù shuō míng děng de rén yí dìng huì huí lái .
meaning: The lyrics mention waiting, not a guarantee of someone’s return.

text: 演奏
pinyin: yǎn zòu
meaning: perform music, usually with an instrument

text: 最后一段由陈宇演奏，我不唱。
pinyin: zuì hòu yī duàn yóu chén yǔ yǎn zòu , wǒ bù chàng .
meaning: Chen Yu plays the last section; I don’t sing.

text: 掌声
pinyin: zhǎng shēng
meaning: applause

text: 掌声停下以后，我们才说最后的告别。
pinyin: zhǎng shēng tíng xià yǐ hòu , wǒ men cái shuō zuì hòu de gào bié .
meaning: We say our final farewell after the applause stops.

text: 上台
pinyin: shàng tái
meaning: go onto the stage

text: 上台以前，我还没决定最后那句话。
pinyin: shàng tái yǐ qián , wǒ hái méi jué dìng zuì hòu nà jù huà .
meaning: Before going onstage I still hadn’t decided the final words.

text: 上演
pinyin: shàng yǎn
meaning: be performed; be staged

text: 这段短剧只在周日上演一次。
pinyin: zhè duàn duǎn jù zhǐ zài zhōu rì shàng yǎn yī cì .
meaning: This short play is performed once on Sunday.

text: 主角
pinyin: zhǔ jué
meaning: central character; lead role

text: 主角说别找我，下一场却回头等。
pinyin: zhǔ jué shuō bié zhǎo wǒ , xià yī chǎng què huí tóu děng .
meaning: The lead says not to look for them, then waits in the next scene.

text: 看管
pinyin: kān guǎn
meaning: look after; supervise

text: 排练时请他看管门口的设备。
pinyin: pái liàn shí qǐng tā kān guǎn mén kǒu de shè bèi .
meaning: Ask him to supervise the equipment by the door during rehearsal.

text: 截止
pinyin: jié zhǐ
meaning: close; reach a stated deadline

text: 报名周五中午截止，演出在周日。
pinyin: bào míng zhōu wǔ zhōng wǔ jié zhǐ , yǎn chū zài zhōu rì .
meaning: Registration closes Friday noon; the performance is Sunday.

text: 隐藏
pinyin: yǐn cáng
meaning: hide; conceal

text: 她没有隐藏明天要走，只是还没想好怎么告别。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu yǐn cáng míng tiān yào zǒu , zhǐ shì hái méi xiǎng hǎo zěn me gào bié .
meaning: She isn’t hiding tomorrow’s departure; she hasn’t settled on a farewell.

text: 透露
pinyin: tòu lù
meaning: disclose; reveal

text: 她只透露新工作在邻城，没有说住哪里。
pinyin: tā zhǐ tòu lù xīn gōng zuò zài lín chéng , méi yǒu shuō zhù nǎ lǐ .
meaning: She only revealed that the new job was in the neighbouring city, not where she would live.

text: 名义
pinyin: míng yì
meaning: name; stated capacity or purpose

text: 别以送行的名义，把整晚都排成我的讲话。
pinyin: bié yǐ sòng xíng de míng yì , bǎ zhěng wǎn dōu pái chéng wǒ de jiǎng huà .
meaning: Don’t use a send-off as a reason to schedule speeches from me all evening.

text: 情绪
pinyin: qíng xù
meaning: mood; emotion

text: 台词里的情绪重，不等于排练的人真的在吵。
pinyin: tái cí lǐ de qíng xù zhòng , bù děng yú pái liàn de rén zhēn de zài chǎo .
meaning: The line carries strong emotion, not necessarily a real quarrel between performers.

text: 遗憾
pinyin: yí hàn
meaning: regret; a disappointing lack

text: 没能每个人都说一句，是这晚的小遗憾。
pinyin: méi néng měi gè rén dōu shuō yī jù , shì zhè wǎn de xiǎo yí hàn .
meaning: Not everyone getting a turn was a small regret that evening.

text: 心愿
pinyin: xīn yuàn
meaning: wish from the heart

text: 我的心愿是再一起排一次，不是办一场大送行。
pinyin: wǒ de xīn yuàn shì zài yì qǐ pái yī cì , bù shì bàn yī chǎng dà sòng xíng .
meaning: I wish for one more shared rehearsal, not a grand send-off.

text: 孤独
pinyin: gū dú
meaning: lonely; loneliness

text: 诗里的孤独不一定等于写诗人此刻的心情。
pinyin: shī lǐ de gū dú bù yí dìng děng yú xiě shī rén cǐ kè de xīn qíng .
meaning: The poem’s loneliness needn’t equal the writer’s current feeling.

text: 增进
pinyin: zēng jìn
meaning: promote; deepen a relationship or understanding

text: 一起排练增进了了解，也让我们发现不同习惯。
pinyin: yì qǐ pái liàn zēng jìn le liǎo jiě , yě ràng wǒ men fā xiàn bù tóng xí guàn .
meaning: Rehearsal deepened understanding and revealed differing habits.

text: 平衡
pinyin: píng héng
meaning: balance

text: 想感谢朋友，也想保留安静的时间，需要平衡。
pinyin: xiǎng gǎn xiè péng you , yě xiǎng bǎo liú ān jìng de shí jiān , xū yào píng héng .
meaning: Thanking friends and keeping quiet time need balancing.

text: 一番
pinyin: yì fān
meaning: one sustained instance of words or effort

text: 一番讨论以后，我们决定把最后的歌留短。
pinyin: yì fān tǎo lùn yǐ hòu , wǒ men jué dìng bǎ zuì hòu de gē liú duǎn .
meaning: After some discussion we decided to keep the last song short.

text: 场景
pinyin: chǎng jǐng
meaning: scene; setting

text: 这个场景里有一扇门和一盏台灯。
pinyin: zhè gè chǎng jǐng lǐ yǒu yī shàn mén hé yī zhǎn tái dēng .
meaning: The scene contains a door and a desk lamp.

text: 场馆
pinyin: chǎng guǎn
meaning: venue building or complex

text: 场馆十点关门，我们九点半开始收。
pinyin: chǎng guǎn shí diǎn guān mén , wǒ men jiǔ diǎn bàn kāi shǐ shōu .
meaning: The venue closes at ten; we start packing at 9:30.

text: 送行
pinyin: sòng xíng
meaning: see someone off

text: 明天我自己去车站，今晚就算送行。
pinyin: míng tiān wǒ zì jǐ qù chē zhàn , jīn wǎn jiù suàn sòng xíng .
meaning: I’ll go to the station myself tomorrow; tonight can be our send-off.

text: 送礼
pinyin: sòng lǐ
meaning: give a gift

text: 不用再送礼，这张一起写的卡已经够了。
pinyin: bù yòng zài sòng lǐ , zhè zhāng yì qǐ xiě de kǎ yǐ jīng gòu le .
meaning: No extra gift is needed; this jointly written card is enough.

text: 难忘
pinyin: nán wàng
meaning: unforgettable; memorable

text: 这次难忘，不只是因为有人离开。
pinyin: zhè cì nán wàng , bù zhǐ shì yīn wèi yǒu rén lí kāi .
meaning: This is memorable for more than someone leaving.

text: 过后
pinyin: guò hòu
meaning: after something has passed

text: 掌声过后，灯又亮了一点。
pinyin: zhǎng shēng guò hòu , dēng yòu liàng le yī diǎn .
meaning: After the applause the lights brightened a little.

text: 我不再每周来这里，也还可以跟你们联系。
pinyin: wǒ bù zài měi zhōu lái zhè lǐ , yě hái kě yǐ gēn nǐ men lián xì .
meaning: I won’t come here weekly any longer, but can stay in touch.

text: 时而
pinyin: shí ér
meaning: at times, alternating with another state

text: 她时而看稿子，时而望向门口。
pinyin: tā shí ér kàn gǎo zi , shí ér wàng xiàng mén kǒu .
meaning: She alternates between the pages and the doorway.

text: 盼望
pinyin: pàn wàng
meaning: look forward to; hope for

text: 我盼望下次再见，不保证哪天就能回来。
pinyin: wǒ pàn wàng xià cì zài jiàn , bù bǎo zhèng nǎ tiān jiù néng huí lái .
meaning: I look forward to meeting again, without guaranteeing a return date.

text: 录像
pinyin: lù xiàng
meaning: record video; video recording

text: 录像在最后一句以前停了，不能说已经拍完整。
pinyin: lù xiàng zài zuì hòu yī jù yǐ qián tíng le , bù néng shuō yǐ jīng pāi wán zhěng .
meaning: The recording stops before the final line, so it isn’t complete.

text: 开头
pinyin: kāi tóu
meaning: beginning; opening

text: 开头像在生气，后面才知道是排练。
pinyin: kāi tóu xiàng zài shēng qì , hòu miàn cái zhī dào shì pái liàn .
meaning: The opening seems angry; later we learn it is rehearsal.

text: 热闹是热闹，不过我明早想自己去车站。
pinyin: rè nào shì rè nào , bù guò wǒ míng zǎo xiǎng zì jǐ qù chē zhàn .
meaning: It is lively, but tomorrow morning I want to go to the station myself.

text: 早不问，晚不问，偏偏上台前问我车票。
pinyin: zǎo bù wèn , wǎn bù wèn , piān piān shàng tái qián wèn wǒ chē piào .
meaning: Of all times, you ask about my ticket just before I go onstage.

text: 放着稿子不看，只看那张截图。
pinyin: fàng zhe gǎo zi bù kàn , zhǐ kàn nà zhāng jié tú .
meaning: You have the script available but only look at the screenshot.

text: 为了让台词接上而停半拍。
pinyin: wèi le ràng tái cí jiē shàng ér tíng bàn pāi .
meaning: Pause half a beat to let the next line connect.

text: 这是台词，还是她刚才对你说的？
pinyin: zhè shì tái cí , hái shi tā gāng cái duì nǐ shuō de ?
meaning: Is that a script line or something she just said to you?

text: 我想开始新生活，也舍不得这一晚。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kāi shǐ xīn shēng huó , yě shě bu de zhè yī wǎn .
meaning: I want to start a new life and am reluctant to leave this evening.

text: 我也盼望再见，哪天还没定。
pinyin: wǒ yě pàn wàng zài jiàn , nǎ tiān hái méi dìng .
meaning: I look forward to meeting again too; no date is set.

text: 歌词没有变，第二遍唱时我想到的人变了。
pinyin: gē cí méi yǒu biàn , dì èr biàn chàng shí wǒ xiǎng dào de rén biàn le .
meaning: The lyrics stayed the same; on the second singing I imagined a different person.

text: 古典
pinyin: gǔ diǎn
meaning: classical

text: 这段配乐有古典的感觉，不等于歌词是古人写的。
pinyin: zhè duàn pèi lè yǒu gǔ diǎn de gǎn jué , bù děng yú gē cí shì gǔ rén xiě de .
meaning: The accompaniment feels classical, not proof the words are ancient.

text: 民歌
pinyin: mín gē
meaning: folk song

text: 我们听过民歌的唱法，再试自己的新歌。
pinyin: wǒ men tīng guò mín gē de chàng fǎ , zài shì zì jǐ de xīn gē .
meaning: We listened to a folk-song style before trying our new song.

text: 戏曲
pinyin: xì qǔ
meaning: traditional Chinese opera

text: 戏曲里的长音给了我们一个想法，不是照搬整段。
pinyin: xì qǔ lǐ de zhǎng yīn gěi le wǒ men yī gè xiǎng fǎ , bù shì zhào bān zhěng duàn .
meaning: A held note in Chinese opera gave us an idea; we didn’t copy a whole section.

text: 乐曲
pinyin: yuè qǔ
meaning: musical composition; piece

text: 这首乐曲没有歌词，可以只听节奏。
pinyin: zhè shǒu yuè qǔ méi yǒu gē cí , kě yǐ zhǐ tīng jié zòu .
meaning: This piece has no lyrics, so we can attend to its rhythm.

text: 节奏
pinyin: jié zòu
meaning: rhythm; pace

text: 先跟上节奏，不要把没听清的字跳过去。
pinyin: xiān gēn shàng jié zòu , bú yào bǎ méi tīng qīng de zì tiào guò qù .
meaning: Follow the rhythm without skipping words you haven’t caught.

text: 她演奏时，我先小声读歌词。
pinyin: tā yǎn zòu shí , wǒ xiān xiǎo shēng dú gē cí .
meaning: While she plays I first read the words quietly.

text: 歌唱
pinyin: gē chàng
meaning: sing; singing

text: 歌唱把一个音拉长，字本身还是那个字。
pinyin: gē chàng bǎ yī gè yīn lā zhǎng , zì běn shēn hái shi nà gè zì .
meaning: Singing stretches a sound, but the word remains that word.

text: 屏幕
pinyin: píng mù
meaning: screen

text: 屏幕上一行消失了，我还没唱到最后。
pinyin: píng mù shàng yī xíng xiāo shī le , wǒ hái méi chàng dào zuì hòu .
meaning: The screen line vanished before I sang its end.

text: 音量小一点，才能听见自己在哪个字停。
pinyin: yīn liàng xiǎo yī diǎn , cái néng tīng jiàn zì jǐ zài nǎ gè zì tíng .
meaning: A lower volume lets me hear which word I pause on.

text: 音像
pinyin: yīn xiàng
meaning: audio and video material

text: 课程的音像资料按单元放在一起。
pinyin: kè chéng de yīn xiàng zī liào àn dān yuán fàng zài yì qǐ .
meaning: The course’s audio-video materials are grouped by unit.

text: 多媒体
pinyin: duō méi tǐ
meaning: multimedia

text: 多媒体课件同时有画面、文字和声音。
pinyin: duō méi tǐ kè jiàn tóng shí yǒu huà miàn , wén zì hé shēng yīn .
meaning: The multimedia lesson contains images, text and sound.

text: 黑夜
pinyin: hēi yè
meaning: dark night

text: 黑夜里的灯可以像等候，也可以像一个方向。
pinyin: hēi yè lǐ de dēng kě yǐ xiàng děng hòu , yě kě yǐ xiàng yī gè fāng xiàng .
meaning: A lamp in the night can suggest waiting or a direction.

text: 海浪
pinyin: hǎi làng
meaning: sea wave

text: 海浪没有替人物回答，歌里仍留着空白。
pinyin: hǎi làng méi yǒu tì rén wù huí dá , gē lǐ réng liú zhe kòng bái .
meaning: The sea waves don’t answer for the character; the song leaves an opening.

text: 海洋
pinyin: hǎi yáng
meaning: ocean

text: 歌里的海洋很宽，房间里的声音却很近。
pinyin: gē lǐ de hǎi yáng hěn kuān , fáng jiān lǐ de shēng yīn què hěn jìn .
meaning: The song’s ocean is broad, but the room’s voice is close.

text: 波浪
pinyin: bō làng
meaning: wave; waves

text: 波浪是一幅流动的画面，不是一个人的姓名。
pinyin: bō làng shì yī fú liú dòng de huà miàn , bù shì yī gè rén de xìng míng .
meaning: Waves form a moving image, not a person’s name.

text: 渡
pinyin: dù
meaning: cross a stretch of water

text: 人物说想渡过河，还没说已经到了对岸。
pinyin: rén wù shuō xiǎng dù guò hé , hái méi shuō yǐ jīng dào le duì àn .
meaning: The character wants to cross the river, not says they already reached the far bank.

text: 船只
pinyin: chuán zhī
meaning: boats; vessels

text: 船只离开岸边，我想的是距离在变化。
pinyin: chuán zhī lí kāi àn biān , wǒ xiǎng de shì jù lí zài biàn huà .
meaning: As vessels leave the bank, I think of changing distance.

text: 远方
pinyin: yuǎn fāng
meaning: a distant place

text: 远方是一个方向，没有写具体城市。
pinyin: yuǎn fāng shì yī gè fāng xiàng , méi yǒu xiě jù tǐ chéng shì .
meaning: The distant place is a direction without a named city.

text: 远离
pinyin: yuǎn lí
meaning: become or stay far from

text: 远离旧房间，不一定远离所有朋友。
pinyin: yuǎn lí jiù fáng jiān , bù yí dìng yuǎn lí suǒ yǒu péng you .
meaning: Leaving the old room needn’t mean leaving every friend behind.

text: 远远
pinyin: yuǎn yuǎn
meaning: far, as an intensifier

text: 第二遍的速度远远超过我能读清的速度。
pinyin: dì èr biàn de sù dù yuǎn yuǎn chāo guò wǒ néng dú qīng de sù dù .
meaning: The second pass is far faster than I can read clearly.

text: 一代
pinyin: yí dài
meaning: a generation

text: 一代人熟悉的唱法，不一定下一代也常听。
pinyin: yí dài rén shú xī de chàng fǎ , bù yí dìng xià yí dài yě cháng tīng .
meaning: A style familiar to one generation may not be common listening for the next.

text: 时节
pinyin: shí jié
meaning: season; particular time of year

text: 这段写雨的时节，不一定是作者今天的天气。
pinyin: zhè duàn xiě yǔ de shí jié , bù yí dìng shì zuò zhě jīn tiān de tiān qì .
meaning: This describes a rainy season, not necessarily the writer’s weather today.

text: 阴影
pinyin: yīn yǐng
meaning: shadow

text: 窗边的阴影在动，我把它听成没有说完的话。
pinyin: chuāng biān de yīn yǐng zài dòng , wǒ bǎ tā tīng chéng méi yǒu shuō wán de huà .
meaning: The moving window shadow suggests unfinished words to me.

text: 一时
pinyin: yī shí
meaning: for the moment; temporarily

text: 我一时没跟上，停下来再读。
pinyin: wǒ yī shí méi gēn shàng , tíng xià lái zài dú .
meaning: I momentarily lost pace and stopped to reread.

text: 重复的那句仿佛换了一个说话的人。
pinyin: chóng fù de nà jù fǎng fú huàn le yī gè shuō huà de rén .
meaning: The repeated line seems to have a different speaker.

text: 好似
pinyin: hǎo sì
meaning: seem like; resemble

text: 那盏灯好似一个没回答的问题。
pinyin: nà zhǎn dēng hǎo sì yī gè méi huí dá de wèn tí .
meaning: That lamp seems like an unanswered question.

text: 幻想
pinyin: huàn xiǎng
meaning: imagine an unreal or hoped-for situation

text: 我幻想过再次见面，歌里没有把它写成事实。
pinyin: wǒ huàn xiǎng guò zài cì jiàn miàn , gē lǐ méi yǒu bǎ tā xiě chéng shì shí .
meaning: I imagined meeting again; the song doesn’t make it a fact.

text: 这一段唱得孤独，下一段又多了一点希望。
pinyin: zhè yī duàn chàng de gū dú , xià yī duàn yòu duō le yī diǎn xī wàng .
meaning: This verse sounds lonely; the next adds some hope.

text: 心灵
pinyin: xīn líng
meaning: inner emotional life; mind or spirit

text: 这首歌让我想起心灵里还没有说出的感受。
pinyin: zhè shǒu gē ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ xīn líng lǐ hái méi yǒu shuō chū de gǎn shòu .
meaning: This song recalls feelings within me that I haven’t yet expressed.

text: 融合
pinyin: róng hé
meaning: blend; integrate

text: 新歌融合两种唱法，但词和旋律都是我们新写的。
pinyin: xīn gē róng hé liǎng zhǒng chàng fǎ , dàn cí hé xuán lǜ dōu shì wǒ men xīn xiě de .
meaning: The new song blends two styles, with newly written words and melody.

text: 元素
pinyin: yuán sù
meaning: element; component

text: 门、灯和风是反复出现的元素。
pinyin: mén , dēng hé fēng shì fǎn fù chū xiàn de yuán sù .
meaning: Door, lamp and wind are recurring elements.

text: 你或是门外的朋友，或是镜中的自己。
pinyin: nǐ huò shì mén wài de péng you , huò shì jìng zhōng de zì jǐ .
meaning: “You” may be the friend outside or the self in the mirror.

text: 你不是已经看过歌词了吗，还漏了那个留字？
pinyin: nǐ bù shì yǐ jīng kàn guò gē cí le ma , hái lòu le nà gè liú zì ?
meaning: Haven’t you already read the lyrics? You still missed that 留?

text: 唱来唱去，都是这几个词在不同地方出现。
pinyin: chàng lái chàng qù , dōu shì zhè jǐ gè cí zài bù tóng dì fāng chū xiàn .
meaning: Across repeated singing the same words appear in different places.

text: 除了漏掉的留字，其他字这遍都唱出来了。
pinyin: chú le lòu diào de liú zì , qí tā zì zhè biàn dōu chàng chū lái le .
meaning: Apart from the omitted 留, the other words were sung this pass.

text: 我这样听，是因为后面有镜子里的我。
pinyin: wǒ zhè yàng tīng , shì yīn wèi hòu miàn yǒu jìng zi lǐ de wǒ .
meaning: I hear it this way because of the later self-in-the-mirror line.

text: 这里是不是少了一个留？我们看一下原稿。
pinyin: zhè lǐ shì bú shì shǎo le yī gè liú ? wǒ men kàn yī xià yuán gǎo .
meaning: Is 留 missing here? Let’s check the page.

text: 这遍先确认词，下一遍再试停顿。
pinyin: zhè biàn xiān què rèn cí , xià yī biàn zài shì tíng dùn .
meaning: Check the words on this pass; try pauses on the next.

text: 百分点
pinyin: bǎi fēn diǎn
meaning: percentage point

text: 百分之二十到百分之三十，增加十个百分点。
pinyin: bǎi fēn zhī èr shí dào bǎi fēn zhī sān shí , zēng jiā shí gè bǎi fēn diǎn .
meaning: Twenty percent to thirty percent is an increase of ten percentage points.

text: 办公
pinyin: bàn gōng
meaning: work in an office; handle office work

text: 我们周二在小厅办公，把两次记录放在一起看。
pinyin: wǒ men zhōu èr zài xiǎo tīng bàn gōng , bǎ liǎng cì jì lù fàng zài yì qǐ kàn .
meaning: We work in the hall Tuesday and compare the two sets of records.

text: 团队
pinyin: tuán duì
meaning: team

text: 团队可以意见不同，不用先找一个输赢。
pinyin: tuán duì kě yǐ yì jiàn bù tóng , bù yòng xiān zhǎo yī gè shū yíng .
meaning: A team can disagree without first declaring a winner.

text: 岗位
pinyin: gǎng wèi
meaning: job position; assigned post

text: 负责联系的岗位还在，不是换封信就不用人了。
pinyin: fù zé lián xì de gǎng wèi hái zài , bù shì huàn fēng xìn jiù bù yòng rén le .
meaning: The contact role is still needed; a new letter doesn’t remove it.

text: 策划
pinyin: cè huà
meaning: plan an event or project

text: 我在策划试点，先写清范围。
pinyin: wǒ zài cè huà shì diǎn , xiān xiě qīng fàn wéi .
meaning: I am planning the trial and first state its scope.

text: 策略
pinyin: cè lüè
meaning: strategy; approach

text: 先小范围试，是这次的策略。
pinyin: xiān xiǎo fàn wéi shì , shì zhè cì de cè lüè .
meaning: Testing on a small scale first is our strategy.

text: 决策
pinyin: jué cè
meaning: make a decision; decision-making

text: 这次决策只同意两周试点，不是永久更换。
pinyin: zhè cì jué cè zhǐ tóng yì liǎng zhōu shì diǎn , bù shì yǒng jiǔ gēng huàn .
meaning: This decision approves only a two-week trial, not a permanent change.

text: 定价
pinyin: dìng jià
meaning: set a price; pricing

text: 定价不在这次讨论范围里，我们先看联系方法。
pinyin: dìng jià bù zài zhè cì tǎo lùn fàn wéi lǐ , wǒ men xiān kàn lián xì fāng fǎ .
meaning: Pricing isn’t in this discussion; we’re examining contact methods.

text: 金额
pinyin: jīn é
meaning: amount of money

text: 记录里没有金额，不能推成收入增加。
pinyin: jì lù lǐ méi yǒu jīn é , bù néng tuī chéng shōu rù zēng jiā .
meaning: The record has no monetary amounts, so it doesn’t establish increased revenue.

text: 试点
pinyin: shì diǎn
meaning: limited pilot or trial

text: 两周试点以后，再决定要不要继续。
pinyin: liǎng zhōu shì diǎn yǐ hòu , zài jué dìng yào bù yào jì xù .
meaning: Decide whether to continue after the two-week trial.

text: 调研
pinyin: diào yán
meaning: investigate needs or circumstances

text: 先做一点调研，问大家为什么没回复。
pinyin: xiān zuò yī diǎn diào yán , wèn dà jiā wèi shén me méi huí fù .
meaning: First investigate why people didn’t reply.

text: 监测
pinyin: jiān cè
meaning: monitor

text: 监测回复数时，也记录发送对象和时间。
pinyin: jiān cè huí fù shù shí , yě jì lù fā sòng duì xiàng hé shí jiān .
meaning: When monitoring replies, record recipients and sending time too.

text: 差异
pinyin: chā yì
meaning: difference

text: 两组人的差异可能影响回复。
pinyin: liǎng zǔ rén de chā yì kě néng yǐng xiǎng huí fù .
meaning: Differences between the groups may affect replies.

text: 衡量
pinyin: héng liáng
meaning: assess; measure against a criterion

text: 衡量工作量，不能只数回复的人。
pinyin: héng liáng gōng zuò liàng , bù néng zhǐ shù huí fù de rén .
meaning: Assessing workload requires more than counting respondents.

text: 因素
pinyin: yīn sù
meaning: factor

text: 发送日期也是一个因素。
pinyin: fā sòng rì qī yě shì yī gè yīn sù .
meaning: The sending date is also a factor.

text: 应对
pinyin: yìng duì
meaning: respond to; deal with

text: 临时改时间，我们要有应对办法。
pinyin: lín shí gǎi shí jiān , wǒ men yào yǒu yìng duì bàn fǎ .
