text: 现在还不知道，明天告诉你，可以吗？
pinyin: xiàn zài hái bù zhī dào , míng tiān gào sù nǐ , kě yǐ ma ?
meaning: I do not know yet; may I tell you tomorrow?

text: 可以，放心。今晚先休息，明天再定。
pinyin: kě yǐ , fàng xīn . jīn wǎn xiān xiū xī , míng tiān zài dìng .

text: 我怕太晚回家，明天会累，所以没有答应今晚去。

text: 我请求换一天，说还是星期六见吧。这是我的想法，不是已经定好的时间。
pinyin: wǒ qǐng qiú huàn yī tiān , shuō hái shi xīng qī liù jiàn ba . zhè shì wǒ de xiǎng fa , bù shì yǐ jīng dìng hǎo de shí jiān .

text: 朋友有点难过，但相信我不是不愿意。她说星期六休假，也许方便。
pinyin: péng you yǒu diǎn nán guò , dàn xiāng xìn wǒ bù shì bù yuàn yì . tā shuō xīng qī liù xiū jià , yě xǔ fāng biàn .

text: 假期的计划还没定，我也不一定知道几点方便。我们先商量，听对方的意见。
pinyin: jià qī de jì huà hái méi dìng , wǒ yě bù yí dìng zhī dào jǐ diǎn fāng biàn . wǒ men xiān shāng liang , tīng duì fāng de yì jian .

text: 我打算先休息，心情好一点再见朋友。她改变了原来的计划。

text: 她让我放心：今晚不来，没有关系；明天告诉她，再改时间。
pinyin: tā ràng wǒ fàng xīn : jīn wǎn bù lái , méi yǒu guān xì ; míng tiān gào sù tā , zài gǎi shí jiān .
meaning: She reassured me: not coming tonight is okay; tell her tomorrow, then change the time.

text: 我没有说一定星期六六点见。我们答应明天再定，不能把一个想法当成最后的计划。
pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu shuō yí dìng xīng qī liù liù diǎn jiàn . wǒ men dā ying míng tiān zài dìng , bù néng bǎ yī gè xiǎng fa dàng chéng zuì hòu de jì huà .
meaning: I did not promise Saturday at six. We agreed to decide tomorrow; an idea is not the final plan.

text: 午餐吃了快餐，昨天还吃方便面。今天想慢慢吃。

meaning: I want to go out for a walk and find a quiet place to chat.

text: 你的看法是什么？这家怎么样？
pinyin: nǐ de kàn fa shì shén me ? zhè jiā zěn me yàng ?
meaning: What is your view? How about this place?

text: 我认为合适。饭馆不大，桌子和碗很干净，服务也热情。
pinyin: wǒ rèn wéi hé shì . fàn guǎn bù dà , zhuō zi hé wǎn hěn gān jìng , fú wù yě rè qíng .
meaning: I think it is suitable. The restaurant is small, its tables and bowls are clean, and the service is welcoming.

text: 味道怎么样？比如这个鸡蛋辣吗？
pinyin: wèi dao zěn me yàng ? bǐ rú zhè gè jī dàn là ma ?
meaning: How does the food taste? Is this egg dish spicy, for example?

text: 不辣。我们的口味不同，可以点不同的菜。
pinyin: bù là . wǒ men de kǒu wèi bù tóng , kě yǐ diǎn bù tóng de cài .
meaning: Not spicy. Our tastes differ, so we can order different dishes.

text: 有什么好处和坏处？顾客多，要等多久？
pinyin: yǒu shén me hǎo chù hé huài chù ? gù kè duō , yào děng duō jiǔ ?

text: 好处是离家近，坏处是要等二十分钟。我对菜满意，对等很久有点不满。
pinyin: hǎo chù shì lí jiā jìn , huài chù shì yào děng èr shí fēn zhōng . wǒ duì cài mǎn yì , duì děng hěn jiǔ yǒu diǎn bù mǎn .
meaning: It is close to home, but the drawback is a twenty-minute wait. I am satisfied with the food but a little dissatisfied with a long wait.

text: 怎样去？什么时候出发？
pinyin: zěn yàng qù ? shén me shí hou chū fā ?

text: 坐车十分钟，再走五分钟。六点出发吧。选这里的原因是方便聊天。

text: 一百二十分成三份，正好每人四十。今天每人花四十块。

text: 收入不多也可以先定预算。这次一百五十够付，付完还剩三十。
pinyin: shōu rù bù duō yě kě yǐ xiān dìng yù suàn . zhè cì yī bǎi wǔ shí gòu fù , fù wán hái shèng sān shí .
meaning: Even with a modest income we can set a budget. One hundred and fifty is enough, leaving thirty after payment.

text: 店里卖水果，我们买一公斤，也就是两斤。五角是半块钱。
pinyin: diàn lǐ mài shuǐ guǒ , wǒ men mǎi yī gōng jīn , yě jiù shì liǎng jīn . wǔ jiǎo shì bàn kuài qián .

text: 我带了银行卡和现金，卡能不能用，还要问店里。
pinyin: wǒ dài le yín háng kǎ hé xiàn jīn , kǎ néng bù néng yòng , hái yào wèn diàn lǐ .
meaning: I brought a bank card and cash; I still need to ask whether the shop accepts the card.

text: 一千、一万、一亿是练习读数字，不是今天的费用。要买的东西不少，但没有花一万。
pinyin: yī qiān , yī wàn , yī yì shì liàn xí dú shù zì , bù shì jīn tiān de fèi yòng . yào mǎi de dōng xi bù shǎo , dàn méi yǒu huā yī wàn .

text: 十多个人是概数，一个多小时也是概数。记账时，不能拿它们代替准确的总数。

text: 包裹先放下吧。你写了几封信？
pinyin: bāo guǒ xiān fàng xià ba . nǐ xiě le jǐ fēng xìn ?

text: 两封。一封给照顾我的朋友，一封给老师。

text: 那位朋友住三层，对吗？
pinyin: nà wèi péng you zhù sān céng , duì ma ?

text: 对，但这个包裹送到学校。地址在笔记本里。
pinyin: duì , dàn zhè gè bāo guǒ sòng dào xué xiào . dì zhǐ zài bǐ jì běn lǐ .

text: 纸和笔在这儿。你准备了什么礼物？

text: 一条围巾、一件衣服，还有一套笔记本和笔。

text: 哪一份送给老师？
pinyin: nǎ yī fèn sòng gěi lǎo shī ?

text: 笔记本和笔。我送朋友围巾，衣服留给自己。
pinyin: bǐ jì běn hé bǐ . wǒ sòng péng you wéi jīn , yī fú liú gěi zì jǐ .
meaning: The notebooks and pens. I give my friend the scarf and keep the clothing for myself.

text: 她接受了吗？
pinyin: tā jiē shòu le ma ?

text: 她说谢谢，还说看了信很感动。我也感谢她的帮助。

text: 信要交给谁？

pinyin: péng you zhù sān céng , dàn zhè gè bāo guǒ yào sòng dào xué xiào . xué xiào dì zhǐ zài wǒ de bǐ jì lǐ .
meaning: My friend lives on the third floor, but this parcel goes to the school. The school address is in my notes.

text: 我先把包裹放下，拿纸和笔写地址，再检查收件人。
pinyin: wǒ xiān bǎ bāo guǒ fàng xià , ná zhǐ hé bǐ xiě dì zhǐ , zài jiǎn chá shōu jiàn rén .
meaning: I put the parcel down, take paper and a pen to write the address, and then check the recipient.

text: 接到服务台的通知后，老师可以去拿。我请朋友把另一封信交给她。
pinyin: jiē dào fú wù tái de tōng zhī hòu , lǎo shī kě yǐ qù ná . wǒ qǐng péng you bǎ lìng yī fēng xìn jiāo gěi tā .
meaning: After receiving the service desk’s notice, the teacher can collect it. I ask my friend to hand her the other letter.

text: 别人不方便接受礼物，也可以说不用了。感谢不一定要靠送东西。
pinyin: bié ren bù fāng biàn jiē shòu lǐ wù , yě kě yǐ shuō bù yòng le . gǎn xiè bù yí dìng yào kào sòng dōng xi .
meaning: Someone who finds accepting a gift inconvenient can decline it. Gratitude does not have to depend on giving things.

text: 地址写好了，就交给快递吧。
pinyin: dì zhǐ xiě hǎo le , jiù jiāo gěi kuài dì ba .
meaning: The address is written; let us give it to the delivery service.

text: 等一下，这张纸上只有学校，没有收件人的名字。
pinyin: děng yī xià , zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng zhǐ yǒu xué xiào , méi yǒu shōu jiàn rén de míng zi .
meaning: Wait: this sheet has only the school name, not the recipient’s name.

text: 我刚才只看三层，忘了补写。
pinyin: wǒ gāng cái zhǐ kàn sān céng , wàng le bǔ xiě .
meaning: I only checked the third floor and forgot to add it.

text: 楼层不是名字。是送给老师的那一份吗？
pinyin: lóu céng bù shì míng zi . shì sòng gěi lǎo shī de nà yī fèn ma ?
meaning: The floor is not a name. Is this the gift for the teacher?

text: 对。写上名字，再检查一遍。
pinyin: duì . xiě shàng míng zi , zài jiǎn chá yī biàn .
meaning: Yes. Add the name and check once more.

text: 这样才清楚。谢谢你照顾我的包裹。
pinyin: zhè yàng cái qīng chǔ . xiè xiè nǐ zhào gù wǒ de bāo guǒ .
meaning: Now it is clear. Thank you for looking after my parcel.

text: 你刚到吗？我早晨看了通知，说六点半集合。
pinyin: nǐ gāng dào ma ? wǒ zǎo chén kàn le tōng zhī , shuō liù diǎn bàn jí hé .
meaning: Did you just arrive? I read a notice this morning saying to meet at half past six.

text: 先停一下。新通知刚刚发来，集合改成六点四十。
pinyin: xiān tíng yī xià . xīn tōng zhī gāng gāng fā lái , jí hé gǎi chéng liù diǎn sì shí .
meaning: Wait. The new notice has just arrived; the meeting time changed to six forty.

text: 节目也改了吗？
pinyin: jié mù yě gǎi le ma ?
meaning: Did the programme time change too?

text: 没有，还是七点。开场以前先检票，六点四十集合就好。
pinyin: méi yǒu , hái shi qī diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , liù diǎn sì shí jí hé jiù hǎo .
meaning: No, still seven. Tickets are checked before the start; meeting at six forty is fine.

text: 那我们有二十分钟。刚才收到的是什么？
pinyin: nà wǒ men yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng . gāng cái shōu dào de shì shén me ?
meaning: Then we have twenty minutes. What did we receive just now?

text: 刚才是旧的。上周的图片也别当成今天的。
pinyin: gāng cái shì jiù de . shàng zhōu de tú piàn yě bié dàng chéng jīn tiān de .
meaning: That was the old one. Do not treat last week’s image as today’s either.

text: 这时灯还亮着，节目还没开始吧？
pinyin: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe , jié mù hái méi kāi shǐ ba ?
meaning: The lights are still on now; it has not started yet, right?

text: 对，快要七点了。灯暗了以后先别走，节目就要开始了。
pinyin: duì , kuài yào qī diǎn le . dēng àn le yǐ hòu xiān bié zǒu , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .
meaning: Right, nearly seven. Stay seated after the lights dim; the programme is about to begin.

text: 散场后喝茶？夜里还有车吗？
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá ? yè lǐ hái yǒu chē ma ?
meaning: Tea after the show? Will transport still be running at night?

text: 先确认，别到半夜才问。不一会儿，另一位朋友也会到。
pinyin: xiān què rèn , bié dào bàn yè cái wèn . bù yí huìr , lìng yī wèi péng you yě huì dào .
meaning: Check first; do not wait until midnight to ask. Another friend will arrive shortly too.

text: 学校十周年，这个学期节目不少。下周还有？
pinyin: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī jié mù bù shǎo . xià zhōu hái yǒu ?
meaning: It is the school’s tenth anniversary; quite a few programmes this term. Another next week?

text: 有，不久以后再发通知。今天先看这一场。
pinyin: yǒu , bù jiǔ yǐ hòu zài fā tōng zhī . jīn tiān xiān kàn zhè yī chǎng .
meaning: Yes, another notice will be sent before long. Today let us watch this one first.

meaning: The image received just now was old. We only saw the new message afterwards and stopped to check it.

text: 从六点四十到七点有二十分钟，不是二十点。开场以前先检票，再入场。
pinyin: cóng liù diǎn sì shí dào qī diǎn yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng , bù shì èr shí diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , zài rù chǎng .
meaning: There are twenty minutes from six forty to seven, not twenty o’clock. Have tickets checked before the start, then enter.

text: 这时灯还亮着。快要七点了，节目要开始了，但还没有开始。
pinyin: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe . kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù yào kāi shǐ le , dàn hái méi yǒu kāi shǐ .
meaning: The lights are still on now. It is nearly seven and the programme is about to begin, but it has not started yet.

text: 灯暗了以后，先坐好。散场后再喝茶，回家前先确认夜里有没有车。
pinyin: dēng àn le yǐ hòu , xiān zuò hǎo . sàn chǎng hòu zài hē chá , huí jiā qián xiān què rèn yè lǐ yǒu méi yǒu chē .
meaning: When the lights dim, stay seated. Have tea after the show and check night transport before going home.

text: 不一会儿，朋友也来了。我们没有等到半夜才问回家的办法。
pinyin: bù yí huìr , péng you yě lái le . wǒ men méi yǒu děng dào bàn yè cái wèn huí jiā de bàn fǎ .
meaning: Our friend arrived in a little while too. We did not wait until the middle of the night to ask how to get home.

text: 学校十周年，这个学期每周都有活动。上周去过一次，下周还想再去。
pinyin: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī měi zhōu dōu yǒu huó dòng . shàng zhōu qù guò yī cì , xià zhōu hái xiǎng zài qù .
meaning: For the school’s tenth anniversary there is an activity every week this term. We went once last week and want to go again next week.

text: 不久以后会发下周的通知。今天这一张不能拿来确定下周的时间。
pinyin: bù jiǔ yǐ hòu huì fā xià zhōu de tōng zhī . jīn tiān zhè yī zhāng bù néng ná lái què dìng xià zhōu de shí jiān .

刚才收到的图片是旧的。后来我们才看到新消息，先停下来检查了一遍。
从六点四十到七点有二十分钟，不是二十点。开场以前先检票，再入场。
这时灯还亮着。快要七点了，节目要开始了，但还没有开始。
灯暗了以后，先坐好。散场后再喝茶，回家前先确认夜里有没有车。
不一会儿，朋友也来了。我们没有等到半夜才问回家的办法。
学校十周年，这个学期每周都有活动。上周去过一次，下周还想再去。
不久以后会发下周的通知。今天这一张不能拿来确定下周的时间。

text: 刚到门口，先停一停。旧图放下，新消息看清。
pinyin: gāng dào mén kǒu , xiān tíng yī tíng . jiù tú fàng xià , xīn xiāo xī kàn qīng .
meaning: Just at the door, pause a moment. Put down the old image; read the new message clearly.

text: 六点四十，一起集合。二十分钟以后，七点开场。
pinyin: liù diǎn sì shí , yì qǐ jí hé . èr shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu , qī diǎn kāi chǎng .
meaning: Meet together at six forty. Twenty minutes later, start at seven.

text: 开场前检票，灯暗后坐好。要开始了，不是已经散场。
pinyin: kāi chǎng qián jiǎn piào , dēng àn hòu zuò hǎo . yào kāi shǐ le , bù shì yǐ jīng sàn chǎng .
meaning: Check tickets before the start; sit when the lights dim. About to begin does not mean already ended.

text: 散场后喝茶，回家前看车。不等半夜，才想办法。
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá , huí jiā qián kàn chē . bù děng bàn yè , cái xiǎng bàn fǎ .
meaning: Tea after the show; check transport before heading home. Do not leave planning until midnight.

text: 上周是上周，下周等通知。今天的时间，别送给明天。
pinyin: shàng zhōu shì shàng zhōu , xià zhōu děng tōng zhī . jīn tiān de shí jiān , bié sòng gěi míng tiān .
meaning: Last week is last week; wait for next week’s notice. Do not give today’s times to tomorrow.

text: 一周又一周，朋友还会见。周年有节目，我们慢慢看。
pinyin: yī zhōu yòu yī zhōu , péng you hái huì jiàn . zhōu nián yǒu jié mù , wǒ men màn màn kàn .
meaning: Week after week, we will meet friends again. Anniversary programmes: we can take our time watching.

text: 好久没见！你明天也有空儿吗？
pinyin: hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn ! nǐ míng tiān yě yǒu kòngr ma ?
meaning: Long time no see! Are you free tomorrow too?

text: 明天还不知道。今天门口有一点儿响，我们先看里面吧。
pinyin: míng tiān hái bù zhī dào . jīn tiān mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr xiǎng , wǒ men xiān kàn lǐ miàn ba .
meaning: I do not know about tomorrow yet. The entrance is a little loud today; let us check inside first.

text: 里面好多座位，没满。这里比门口更安静。
pinyin: lǐ miàn hǎo duō zuò wèi , méi mǎn . zhè lǐ bǐ mén kǒu gèng ān jìng .
meaning: There are many seats inside, not all occupied. It is quieter than the entrance.

text: 挺舒服的，但灯十分亮，我不太喜欢。
pinyin: tǐng shū fú de , dàn dēng shí fēn liàng , wǒ bù tài xǐ huān .
meaning: Quite comfortable, but the lights are very bright; I do not particularly like that.

text: 后面没有这么亮，也离音箱更远。
pinyin: hòu miàn méi yǒu zhè me liàng , yě lí yīn xiāng gèng yuǎn .
meaning: It is not this bright farther back, and it is farther from the speaker.

text: 好，那边读书的人不少，我们小声说。
pinyin: hǎo , nà biān dú shū de rén bù shǎo , wǒ men xiǎo shēng shuō .
meaning: Good. Quite a few people are reading there; let us speak quietly.

text: 门口四十，里面五十，贵十块。费用不超过五十，行吗？
pinyin: mén kǒu sì shí , lǐ miàn wǔ shí , guì shí kuài . fèi yòng bù chāo guò wǔ shí , xíng ma ?
meaning: The entrance is forty and inside fifty, ten more. At most fifty, okay?

text: 行。门口不如里面安静，十块是差价，不是全部。
pinyin: xíng . mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng , shí kuài shì chà jià , bù shì quán bù .
meaning: Okay. The entrance is not as quiet as inside. Ten is the difference, not the total.

text: 两边温度不同，里面比门口低三度。
pinyin: liǎng biān wēn dù bù tóng , lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu dī sān dù .
meaning: The temperatures differ; inside is three degrees lower than the entrance.

text: 但我没量声音，不能说低了多少分贝。只觉得这里更合适。
pinyin: dàn wǒ méi liáng shēng yīn , bù néng shuō dī le duō shao fēn bèi . zhǐ jué de zhè lǐ gèng hé shì .
meaning: But I did not measure the sound; I cannot say how many decibels lower it is. I only feel it is more suitable.

text: 音箱的声音有点儿难听，要不要再大声说？
pinyin: yīn xiāng de shēng yīn yǒu diǎn ér nán tīng , yào bù yào zài dà shēng shuō ?
meaning: The speaker sounds a little unpleasant. Should we speak louder?

text: 不用大声。我听得见，音量小一点点就好。
pinyin: bù yòng dà shēng . wǒ tīng de jiàn , yīn liàng xiǎo yì diǎn diǎn jiù hǎo .
meaning: No need to speak loudly. I can hear; just lower the volume a tiny bit.

text: 我和朋友好久没见。今天见面，明天有没有空儿还不知道。

meaning: My friend and I have not met for a long time. We meet today; we do not yet know whether tomorrow is free.

text: 门口有一点儿响，也不够安静。里面更安静，座位还没满。

text: 里面有好多座位，挺舒服的。前面的灯十分亮，我不太喜欢，所以选后面。
pinyin: lǐ miàn yǒu hǎo duō zuò wèi , tǐng shū fú de . qián miàn de dēng shí fēn liàng , wǒ bù tài xǐ huān , suǒ yǐ xuǎn hòu miàn .
meaning: Inside has many seats and is quite comfortable. The front lights are very bright and I do not particularly like them, so we choose farther back.

text: 后面离音箱远，灯也没有前面这么亮。有人读书，我们就小声说。
pinyin: hòu miàn lí yīn xiāng yuǎn , dēng yě méi yǒu qián miàn zhè me liàng . yǒu rén dú shū , wǒ men jiù xiǎo shēng shuō .
meaning: Farther back is away from the speaker, and the lights are not as bright as at the front. People are reading, so we speak quietly.

meaning: The entrance costs forty and inside fifty. Inside is ten more, but the cost does not exceed fifty.

text: 门口不如里面安静。这是我们的感受，不是测出来的声音数字。
pinyin: mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng . zhè shì wǒ men de gǎn shòu , bù shì cè chū lái de shēng yīn shù zì .
meaning: The entrance is not as quiet as inside. This is our impression, not a measured sound figure.

text: 温度表显示，里面比门口低三度。这个三度说的是温度，不是音量。

meaning: The thermometer shows that inside is three degrees lower than the entrance. These three degrees refer to temperature, not volume.

text: 音箱有点儿难听，不过不用大声说。音量小一点点就好，我们也没有要求别人离开。

text: 那怎么说？
pinyin: nà zěn me shuō ?

text: 说有一点儿响就好。你想小一点儿，可以直接问。
pinyin: shuō yǒu yì diǎnr xiǎng jiù hǎo . nǐ xiǎng xiǎo yì diǎn ér , kě yǐ zhí jiē wèn .

text: 这样清楚多了。我们也小声说吧。
pinyin: zhè yàng qīng chǔ duō le . wǒ men yě xiǎo shēng shuō ba .

text: 我有点儿急。朋友说快点儿，我还是先注意安全，不让司机开快。

text: 停车场离学校近，但停车场不是公交站。我等到车停好才下，不在路边下。

meaning: My friend was previously hospitalized, has been discharged, and is resting at home today.

text: 我先打电话，喂，你好，现在方便吗？
pinyin: wǒ xiān dǎ diàn huà , wèi , nǐ hǎo , xiàn zài fāng biàn ma ?
meaning: I phone first: hello, is now convenient?

text: 方便的话我再去，不方便就改天。
pinyin: fāng biàn de huà wǒ zài qù , bù fāng biàn jiù gǎi tiān .
meaning: I will go if convenient; if not, another day.

text: 她答应今天四点半见，五点结束。
pinyin: tā dā yìng jīn tiān sì diǎn bàn jiàn , wǔ diǎn jié shù .
meaning: She agrees to meet today at half past four and finish at five.

text: 不一会儿回消息只说短时间，不给准确分钟。
pinyin: bù yī huì er huí xiāo xī zhǐ shuō duǎn shí jiān , bù gěi zhǔn què fēn zhōng .
meaning: Replying shortly afterward describes a short interval without exact minutes.

text: 太阳出来，天上有云，她还是想休息。
pinyin: tài yáng chū lái , tiān shàng yǒu yún , tā hái shi xiǎng xiū xī .
meaning: The sun is out and clouds are in the sky; she still wants to rest.

text: 我不问全身哪里疼，也不替她诊断和安排药。
pinyin: wǒ bù wèn quán shēn nǎ lǐ téng , yě bù tì tā zhěn duàn hé ān pái yào .
meaning: I do not question which parts hurt or diagnose and arrange medication on her behalf.

text: 她没说预约月份，我们不猜；问候后按时离开。
pinyin: tā méi shuō yù yuē yuè fèn , wǒ men bù cāi ; wèn hòu hòu àn shí lí kāi .
meaning: She has not given the appointment month, so we do not guess; after greeting her, we leave on time.

text: 我只来一会儿，天上的云都还没走。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ lái yī huì er , tiān shàng de yún dōu hái méi zǒu .
meaning: I will visit briefly; even the clouds have not gone.

text: 云没有约定，我有。五点休息。
pinyin: yún méi yǒu yuē dìng , wǒ yǒu . wǔ diǎn xiū xī .
meaning: The clouds have no agreement; I do. I rest at five.

text: 好，五点走，不跟月亮一起坐。
pinyin: hǎo , wǔ diǎn zǒu , bù gēn yuè liang yì qǐ zuò .
meaning: Okay, leave at five; I will not stay sitting with the moon.

text: 谢谢。问候到了，时间也要到。
pinyin: xiè xiè . wèn hòu dào le , shí jiān yě yào dào .
meaning: Thanks. Your greeting arrived; the end time should too.

text: 晚安，今天不再打扰。
pinyin: wǎn ān , jīn tiān bù zài dǎ rǎo .
meaning: Good night; no more disturbance today.

text: 好，明天有空再聊。
pinyin: hǎo , míng tiān yǒu kōng zài liáo .
meaning: Okay; talk tomorrow if there is time.

text: 院长今天不在，通知由办公室发。
pinyin: yuàn zhǎng jīn tiān bù zài , tōng zhī yóu bàn gōng shì fā .
meaning: The hospital director is absent today; the office issues the notice.

text: 关心朋友的健康，也要尊重她不想说的事。
pinyin: guān xīn péng you de jiàn kāng , yě yào zūn zhòng tā bù xiǎng shuō de shì .
meaning: Care about a friend’s health and respect things she does not want to discuss.

text: 她想找西医，先问能不能预约。
pinyin: tā xiǎng zhǎo xī yī , xiān wèn néng bù néng yù yuē .
meaning: She wants to consult a practitioner of Western medicine; first ask whether an appointment is available.

text: 她问中医门诊几点开，不是在问药店。
pinyin: tā wèn zhōng yī mén zhěn jǐ diǎn kāi , bù shì zài wèn yào diàn .
meaning: She asks when the Chinese medicine clinic opens, not the pharmacy.

text: 药店地址变了，先看新通知。
pinyin: yào diàn dì zhǐ biàn le , xiān kàn xīn tōng zhī .
meaning: The pharmacy has changed address; read the new notice first.

text: 我闻到饭香了，不过还没问吃什么。
pinyin: wǒ wén dào fàn xiāng le , bù guò hái méi wèn chī shén me .
meaning: I smell food cooking, but have not asked what we will eat.

text: 屋里空气不好，我们先出去。
pinyin: wū lǐ kōng qì bù hǎo , wǒ men xiān chū qù .
meaning: The indoor air is unpleasant; let us go outside first.

text: 这段话讲地球，不是在讲某个城市。
pinyin: zhè duàn huà jiǎng dì qiú , bù shì zài jiǎng mǒu gè chéng shì .
meaning: This passage concerns Earth, not a particular city.

text: 今天云很多，看不到星星。
pinyin: jīn tiān yún hěn duō , kàn bù dào xīng xing .
meaning: There are many clouds today; the stars are not visible.

text: 这篇故事写一个人的一生，不只写一天。
pinyin: zhè piān gù shì xiě yī gè rén de yī shēng , bù zhǐ xiě yī tiān .
meaning: This story describes a person’s lifetime, not just one day.

text: 我不能答应永远不改时间，但改了会告诉你。
pinyin: wǒ bù néng dā yìng yǒng yuǎn bù gǎi shí jiān , dàn gǎi le huì gào sù nǐ .
meaning: I cannot promise never to change the time, but will tell you if it changes.

text: 院长不在这里，我们先问联系人。院长今天不在，通知由办公室发。关心健康，也尊重她不想说的事。关心朋友的健康，也要尊重她不想说的事。她说问过西医，我们不替医生判断。她想找西医，先问能不能预约。中医是她提到的词，不是我给的建议。她问中医门诊几点开，不是在问药店。药店的位置可以问，怎么用药要问专业人员。药店地址变了，先看新通知。她想养一只猫，现在还没有养。她说全身累，想先休息。闻到饭的味道，不等于现在想吃。我闻到饭香了，不过还没问吃什么。她想去院子呼吸空气，但还要问自己方便不方便。屋里空气不好，我们先出去。书里讲地球，不是今天的天气预报。这段话讲地球，不是在讲某个城市。晚上窗外有月亮。她喜欢看星星，不一定想出门。今天云很多，看不到星星。夜里我们不再打电话。一生的习惯不是一晚就能知道。这篇故事写一个人的一生，不只写一天。永远尊重朋友，也包括让她休息。我不能答应永远不改时间，但改了会告诉你。
pinyin: yuàn zhǎng bù zài zhè lǐ , wǒ men xiān wèn lián xì rén . yuàn zhǎng jīn tiān bù zài , tōng zhī yóu bàn gōng shì fā . guān xīn jiàn kāng , yě zūn zhòng tā bù xiǎng shuō de shì . guān xīn péng you de jiàn kāng , yě yào zūn zhòng tā bù xiǎng shuō de shì . tā shuō wèn guò xī yī , wǒ men bù tì yī shēng pàn duàn . tā xiǎng zhǎo xī yī , xiān wèn néng bù néng yù yuē . zhōng yī shì tā tí dào de cí , bù shì wǒ gěi de jiàn yì . tā wèn zhōng yī mén zhěn jǐ diǎn kāi , bù shì zài wèn yào diàn . yào diàn de wèi zhì kě yǐ wèn , zěn me yòng yào yào wèn zhuān yè rén yuán . yào diàn dì zhǐ biàn le , xiān kàn xīn tōng zhī . tā xiǎng yǎng yī zhǐ māo , xiàn zài hái méi yǒu yǎng . tā shuō quán shēn lèi , xiǎng xiān xiū xī . wén dào fàn de wèi dào , bù děng yú xiàn zài xiǎng chī . wǒ wén dào fàn xiāng le , bù guò hái méi wèn chī shén me . tā xiǎng qù yuàn zi hū xī kōng qì , dàn hái yào wèn zì jǐ fāng biàn bù fāng biàn . wū lǐ kōng qì bù hǎo , wǒ men xiān chū qù . shū lǐ jiǎng dì qiú , bù shì jīn tiān de tiān qì yù bào . zhè duàn huà jiǎng dì qiú , bù shì zài jiǎng mǒu gè chéng shì . wǎn shang chuāng wài yǒu yuè liang . tā xǐ huān kàn xīng xing , bù yí dìng xiǎng chū mén . jīn tiān yún hěn duō , kàn bù dào xīng xing . yè lǐ wǒ men bù zài dǎ diàn huà . yī shēng de xí guàn bù shì yī wǎn jiù néng zhī dào . zhè piān gù shì xiě yī gè rén de yī shēng , bù zhǐ xiě yī tiān . yǒng yuǎn zūn zhòng péng you , yě bāo kuò ràng tā xiū xī . wǒ bù néng dā yìng yǒng yuǎn bù gǎi shí jiān , dàn gǎi le huì gào sù nǐ .
meaning: The head is not here; first ask the contact person. The hospital director is absent today; the office issues the notice. Care about health and respect what she does not wish to discuss. Care about a friend’s health and respect things she does not want to discuss. She says she has consulted a Western-medicine clinician; we do not judge in the clinician’s place. She wants to consult a practitioner of Western medicine; first ask whether an appointment is available. Chinese medicine is a term she mentions, not a recommendation from me. She asks when the Chinese medicine clinic opens, not the pharmacy. You can ask a pharmacy’s location; medication use should be asked of a professional. The pharmacy has changed address; read the new notice first. She wants to keep a cat but does not yet have one. She says her whole body feels tired and wants to rest first. Smelling food does not mean wanting to eat now. I smell food cooking, but have not asked what we will eat. She wants some air in the courtyard, but still needs to consider whether it is convenient for her. The indoor air is unpleasant; let us go outside first. The book discusses Earth, not today’s weather forecast. This passage concerns Earth, not a particular city. The moon is outside the window at night. She likes looking at stars but does not necessarily want to go out. There are many clouds today; the stars are not visible. We do not call again at night. A person’s lifelong habits cannot be known in one evening. This story describes a person’s lifetime, not just one day. Always respecting a friend includes letting her rest. I cannot promise never to change the time, but will tell you if it changes.

text: 上周这一段，我读了三遍才明白。
pinyin: shàng zhōu zhè yī duàn , wǒ dú le sān biàn cái míng bái .
meaning: Last week I understood this passage only after reading it three times.

text: 这周呢？
pinyin: zhè zhōu ne ?
meaning: What about this week?

text: 这周读两遍就明白了，而且能说给你听。
pinyin: zhè zhōu dú liǎng biàn jiù míng bái le , ér qiě néng shuō gěi nǐ tīng .
meaning: This week I understood after two readings, and I can explain it to you.

text: 越来越清楚了。不但能读，还能说。
pinyin: yuè lái yuè qīng chǔ le . bù dàn néng dú , hái néng shuō .
meaning: It is getting clearer: not only reading but also speaking.

text: 别把我写成网站广告里的明星。
pinyin: bié bǎ wǒ xiě chéng wǎng zhàn guǎng gào lǐ de míng xīng .
meaning: Do not turn me into the celebrity in a website advertisement.

text: 没说完美。只是把两次记录放在一起看。
pinyin: méi shuō wán měi . zhǐ shì bǎ liǎng cì jì lù fàng zài yì qǐ kàn .
meaning: I did not say perfect; just compare the two records.

text: 那今后每周记一次，画儿也留着。
pinyin: nà jīn hòu měi zhōu jì yī cì , huàr yě liú zhe .
meaning: Then record it once a week from now on and keep the drawing too.

text: 好，先看事实，再说进步。
pinyin: hǎo , xiān kàn shì shí , zài shuō jìn bù .
meaning: Okay; look at facts first, then talk about progress.

text: 两个人不要同时说，先听完一位。
pinyin: liǎng gè rén bú yào tóng shí shuō , xiān tīng wán yī wèi .
meaning: The two should not speak simultaneously; hear one person out first.

text: 画里有不同颜色，她先用蓝色，再用红色颜料。
pinyin: huà lǐ yǒu bù tóng yán sè , tā xiān yòng lán sè , zài yòng hóng sè yán liào .
meaning: The drawing has different colours: blue first, then red paint.

text: 她想成为画家，也喜欢作家的小说。
pinyin: tā xiǎng chéng wéi huà jiā , yě xǐ huān zuò jiā de xiǎo shuō .
meaning: She wants to become a painter and also likes the writer’s fiction.

text: 科学家是另一个身份，不是画家的高级名字。
pinyin: kē xué jiā shì lìng yī gè shēn fèn , bù shì huà jiā de gāo jí míng zi .
meaning: Scientist is another role, not an advanced title for painter.

text: 网站的广告不是成绩记录；流行也不是质量的保证。
pinyin: wǎng zhàn de guǎng gào bù shì chéng jì jì lù ; liú xíng yě bù shì zhì liàng de bǎo zhèng .

text: 要是下雨，就在室内见；室内地点也要先确认。

text: 恐怕有下雨的风险，先准备另一个地点比较保险。

text: 发生了错误，消息消失也不能假装没发生。

text: 旧通知需要修正，不能宣布一个未经确认的新地点。
pinyin: jiù tōng zhī xū yào xiū zhèng , bù néng xuān bù yī gè wèi jīng què rèn de xīn dì diǎn .

text: 我把信息弄乱了，就要认真对待修正，不急着说信任已经恢复。

pinyin: wèi le fāng biàn péng you dài shū , wǒ xuǎn le yī gè bù dài , xiān què rèn dà xiǎo . bù dài de shè jì shí yòng , gōng néng shì zhuāng shū , bù shì biǎo shì xiāo fèi duō shao . wèi le jié yuē cái liào , wǒ lì yòng yǐ yǒu de zhǐ chuàng zuò cǎi sè hè kǎ . zhào piān shì péng you de zuò pǐn , kǎ piàn shuō míng zuò zhě , bù bǎ bié ren de zuò pǐn dàng chéng zì jǐ chuàng zuò . wèi le jì niàn dì yī cì jiàn miàn , xuǎn zhào piān ; wèi le biǎo dá zhù fú , xiě yī jù hàn yǔ . jīn sè hé yín sè shì yán sè shuō míng , bù bǎo zhèng cái liào lǐ yǒu jīn huò yín . cái liào fù le èr shí kuài xiàn jīn , méi yǒu chāo guò yù suàn ; guò duō bāo zhuāng huì làng fèi . bǎ zhī shi yìng yòng dào shí jì biǎo dá , chuàng zào huí yì , bù bì yòng jià gé zhèng míng ài xīn .
meaning: To make carrying books easier, I chose a cloth bag and checked the size first. The bag’s design is practical; its function is carrying books, not displaying spending. To commemorate the first meeting, choose a photo; to express good wishes, write a Mandarin sentence. Gold and silver colour describe appearance; they do not guarantee gold or silver content. Materials cost twenty yuan cash within budget; excessive packaging would waste resources. Apply knowledge to real expression and create memories; no need to prove care through price.

text: 请把包裹放在门边，别放沙发上。

text: 从下周起，这门初级课程每周上两次。
pinyin: cóng xià zhōu qǐ , zhè mén chū jí kè chéng měi zhōu shàng liǎng cì .
meaning: Starting next week, this elementary course meets twice a week.

text: 是初步安排吗？几点开始？
pinyin: shì chū bù ān pái ma ? jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ ?
meaning: Is this a preliminary arrangement? When does it start?

text: 对，时间还要确认。你已经到达了吗？
pinyin: duì , shí jiān hái yào què rèn . nǐ yǐ jīng dào dá le ma ?
meaning: Yes; the time still needs confirmation. Have you arrived?

text: 我接近教室了，赶时间也先看地址。
pinyin: wǒ jiē jìn jiào shì le , gǎn shí jiān yě xiān kàn dì zhǐ .
meaning: I am near the classroom; even in a hurry I check the address.

text: 上一节下课半小时了，老师还在等待。
pinyin: shàng yī jié xià kè bàn xiǎo shí le , lǎo shī hái zài děng dài .
meaning: The previous class ended half an hour ago; the teacher is still waiting.

text: 我赶到了，先慢慢看通知，不把着急当准备好。
pinyin: wǒ gǎn dào le , xiān màn màn kàn tōng zhī , bù bǎ zháo jí dāng zhǔn bèi hǎo .
meaning: I arrived in time; read the notice slowly first rather than treating urgency as readiness.

text: 录音可以自己复习，分享要另问。

meaning: The recording can be used for personal review; ask separately about sharing.

text: 好，记录开始和结束的时刻，纪录别写成正式成绩。

text: 初到这里，她先找教室；初中时写日记的习惯后来帮助她做记录。
pinyin: chū dào zhè lǐ , tā xiān zhǎo jiào shì ; chū zhōng shí xiě rì jì de xí guàn hòu lái bāng zhù tā zuò jì lù .
meaning: On first arriving she found the classroom; her junior-school diary habit later helped her keep records.

text: 从下周起开初级课程，是初步计划，后年的安排还没定。
pinyin: cóng xià zhōu qǐ kāi chū jí kè chéng , shì chū bù jì huà , hòu nián de ān pái hái méi dìng .
meaning: The elementary course starting next week is a preliminary plan; arrangements for the year after next are undecided.

text: 开课以来的练习都有日期，但开始了不代表已经学会。

meaning: Practice since opening is dated, but starting does not mean already having learned it.

text: 接近上课时间，等待将近十分钟后，她终于到达并赶到了最后一次说明。

meaning: Near class time, after waiting almost ten minutes, she arrived in time for the final explanation.

text: 上课前后分别记录；下课半小时了，指下课到现在的间隔。

text: 截至今天仍然只有初步安排，等待时能问进展，不能把建议当确认。

text: 初到这里，她先找教室；初中时写日记的习惯后来帮助她做记录。从下周起开初级课程，是初步计划，后年的安排还没定。开课以来的练习都有日期，但开始了不代表已经学会。接近上课时间，等待将近十分钟后，她终于到达并赶到了最后一次说明。上课前后分别记录；下课半小时了，指下课到现在的间隔。她慢慢核对时刻，录自己的声音，录音只供个人复习，练习纪录不冒充正式成绩。她订阅一期杂志，每期日期另查；农历初一也不等于公历一号。截至今天仍然只有初步安排，等待时能问进展，不能把建议当确认。

text: 那先慢一点。教练说过，用力不等于实力。

text: 头两次先熟悉内容，花工夫把两句连起来。

text: 得分只计算实际答案，输入错了就承认。

text: 好，理论和练习结合，别没完没了地赶速度。

meaning: Great! I'll buy her a coffee first. I may have quite a few questions.

pinyin: nǐ bù shì yì zhí xiǎng chuàng yè ma ? xiàn zài yǒu xiǎng fǎ le ? yǒu . wǒ xiǎng kāi yī jiā xiǎo shū diàn , zhōu mò kāi zhǎn dú shū huó dòng . guāng mài shū , shēng yì huì bù huì bù tài hǎo ? suǒ yǐ wǒ yě xiǎng mài kā fēi , bìng qiě liú jǐ zhāng zhuō zi gěi dà jiā liáo tiān . nà shǒu xiān děi zhǎo dì fāng ba ? duì , qí cì cái shì mǎi shū . wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào hé shì de diàn . xué xiào páng biān yǒu yī jiā diàn guān le . yào bù míng tiān yì qǐ qù kàn kàn ? hǎo . nǐ yǒu péng you cóng shì zhè zhǒng gōng zuò ma ? wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng tā men de yì jiàn . yǒu , wǒ jiě jie jīng yíng yī jiā xiǎo diàn . wǒ jīn wǎn wèn wèn tā . tài hǎo le ! xiān qǐng tā hē bēi kā fēi , wǒ de wèn tí kě néng yǒu diǎn duō .
meaning: Haven't you always wanted to start a business? Do you have an idea now? Yes. I'd like to open a small bookshop and hold reading events at weekends. Would business be slow if you only sold books? That's why I'd also sell coffee and leave a few tables for people to chat. Then finding a space comes first, right? Right, and buying books comes next. I haven't found a suitable place yet. A shop near the school has closed. Shall we go and look tomorrow? Sure. Do you know anyone who works in this field? I'd like their advice. Yes, my sister runs a small shop. I'll ask her tonight. Great! I'll buy her a coffee first. I may have quite a few questions.

有。我想开一家小书店，周末开展读书活动。
光卖书，生意会不会不太好？
所以我也想卖咖啡，并且留几张桌子给大家聊天。
那首先得找地方吧？
对，其次才是买书。我还没找到合适的店。
学校旁边有一家店关了。要不明天一起去看看？
好。你有朋友从事这种工作吗？我想听听他们的意见。
有，我姐姐经营一家小店。我今晚问问她。
太好了！先请她喝杯咖啡，我的问题可能有点多。

text: 去年，我和朋友在学校附近开了一家书店。我们都没有经营经验，最初只想到书和咖啡。
pinyin: qù nián , wǒ hé péng you zài xué xiào fù jìn kāi le yī jiā shū diàn . wǒ men dōu méi yǒu jīng yíng jīng yàn , zuì chū zhǐ xiǎng dào shū hé kā fēi .
meaning: Last year a friend and I opened a bookshop near the school. Neither of us had experience running a business; initially we only thought about books and coffee.

text: 看了几个地方以后，我们发现每个月的钱比想象的多。首先要交房租，其次要买材料，还得给职工发工资。
pinyin: kàn le jǐ gè dì fāng yǐ hòu , wǒ men fā xiàn měi gè yuè de qián bǐ xiǎng xiàng de duō . shǒu xiān yào jiāo fáng zū , qí cì yào mǎi cái liào , hái děi gěi zhí gōng fā gōng zī .
meaning: After looking at a few spaces, we found the monthly costs were higher than expected: rent first, then supplies, and wages for staff.

text: 朋友的姐姐从事餐饮工作。她把我们的计划展开在桌上，一项一项地问。我们回答不上来，就一起去了解。
pinyin: péng you de jiě jie cóng shì cān yǐn gōng zuò . tā bǎ wǒ men de jì huà zhǎn kāi zài zhuō shàng , yī xiàng yī xiàng de wèn . wǒ men huí dá bù shàng lái , jiù yì qǐ qù liǎo jiě .
meaning: My friend's sister works in catering. She spread our plan on the table and went through it item by item. When we couldn't answer, we went to find out together.

text: 小店开门后，生意并不是每天都好。有时一下午只卖出两本书，但读书活动慢慢有了固定的朋友。
pinyin: xiǎo diàn kāi mén hòu , shēng yì bìng bù shì měi tiān dōu hǎo . yǒu shí yī xià wǔ zhǐ mài chū liǎng běn shū , dàn dú shū huó dòng màn màn yǒu le gù dìng de péng you .
meaning: After we opened, business wasn't good every day. Sometimes we sold only two books all afternoon, but our reading events slowly attracted a regular group.

text: 我们没有急着扩大店面，而是先建立自己的读书小组，每周开展一次活动，并且听大家想读什么。
pinyin: wǒ men méi yǒu jí zhe kuò dà diàn miàn , ér shì xiān jiàn lì zì jǐ de dú shū xiǎo zǔ , měi zhōu kāi zhǎn yī cì huó dòng , bìng qiě tīng dà jiā xiǎng dú shén me .
meaning: Instead of rushing to expand, we set up our own reading group, met weekly and listened to what people wanted to read.

text: 现在我仍然喜欢这份事业。不过，喜欢书和经营书店是两回事，后者每天都有很多小事要做。
pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ réng rán xǐ huān zhè fèn shì yè . bù guò , xǐ huān shū hé jīng yíng shū diàn shì liǎng huí shì , hòu zhě měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō xiǎo shì yào zuò .
meaning: I still love this work. But loving books and running a bookshop are different things: the latter comes with lots of small daily tasks.

text: 这张桌子也算我们的事业吗？
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi yě suàn wǒ men de shì yè ma ?
meaning: Does this table count as part of our business too?

text: 算啊。先别笑，帮我把它搬过去。
pinyin: suàn a . xiān bié xiào , bāng wǒ bǎ tā bān guò qù .
meaning: Of course. Stop laughing and help me move it.

text: 你不是说今天只看地方，不干活吗？
pinyin: nǐ bù shì shuō jīn tiān zhǐ kàn dì fāng , bù gàn huó ma ?
meaning: Didn't you say we were only looking at spaces today, not working?

text: 是，可老板明天要清空这里。我怕来晚了桌子就没了。
pinyin: shì , kě lǎo bǎn míng tiān yào qīng kōng zhè lǐ . wǒ pà lái wǎn le zhuō zi jiù méi le .
meaning: Yes, but the owner is clearing this place tomorrow. I'm worried the table will be gone if we come late.

text: 好吧。首先搬桌子，其次请我吃饭。
pinyin: hǎo ba . shǒu xiān bān zhuō zi , qí cì qǐng wǒ chī fàn .
meaning: Fine. First we move the table, then you buy me dinner.

text: 没问题。并且我会记住你今天帮了我。
pinyin: méi wèn tí . bìng qiě wǒ huì jì zhù nǐ jīn tiān bāng le wǒ .
meaning: Deal. And I'll remember that you helped me today.

text: 首先买票，然后找座位。
pinyin: shǒu xiān mǎi piào , rán hòu zhǎo zuò wèi .
meaning: First buy a ticket, then find a seat.

text: 我喜欢这家店，首先是因为近，其次是因为安静。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān zhè jiā diàn , shǒu xiān shì yīn wèi jìn , qí cì shì yīn wèi ān jìng .
meaning: I like this place first because it is nearby, and secondly because it is quiet.

text: 我们准备开展一次旧书交换活动。
pinyin: wǒ men zhǔn bèi kāi zhǎn yī cì jiù shū jiāo huàn huó dòng .
meaning: We're planning a second-hand book exchange.

text: 她展开地图，指了指北边的小路。
pinyin: tā zhǎn kāi dì tú , zhǐ le zhǐ běi biān de xiǎo lù .
meaning: She spread out the map and pointed at a small road to the north.

text: 他们在河上建了一座桥。
pinyin: tā men zài hé shàng jiàn le yī zuò qiáo .
meaning: They built a bridge over the river.

text: 新图书馆建成以后，我几乎每天都去。
pinyin: xīn tú shū guǎn jiàn chéng yǐ hòu , wǒ jī hū měi tiān dōu qù .
meaning: After the new library was completed, I went almost every day.

text: 我们在第一次活动后建立了一个群。
pinyin: wǒ men zài dì yī cì huó dòng hòu jiàn lì le yī gè qún .
meaning: We set up a group chat after the first event.

text: 附近正在建设新的地铁站。
pinyin: fù jìn zhèng zài jiàn shè xīn de dì tiě zhàn .
meaning: A new underground station is being built nearby.

text: 这个读书小组成立三年了。
pinyin: zhè gè dú shū xiǎo zǔ chéng lì sān nián le .
meaning: This reading group was founded three years ago.

text: 图书馆设立了儿童阅读区。
pinyin: tú shū guǎn shè lì le ér tóng yuè dú qū .
meaning: The library set up a reading area for children.

text: 那家厂现在不生产汽车了。
pinyin: nà jiā chǎng xiàn zài bù shēng chǎn qì chē le .
meaning: That factory no longer makes cars.

text: 她毕业后和朋友一起创业。
pinyin: tā bì yè hòu hé péng you yì qǐ chuàng yè .
meaning: After graduating she started a business with a friend.

text: 我姐姐从事翻译工作。
pinyin: wǒ jiě jie cóng shì fān yì gōng zuò .
meaning: My sister works as a translator.

text: 他们一家经营这家店十多年了。
pinyin: tā men yī jiā jīng yíng zhè jiā diàn shí duō nián le .
meaning: Their family has run this shop for over ten years.

text: 周末生意很好，老板忙得没时间吃饭。
pinyin: zhōu mò shēng yì hěn hǎo , lǎo bǎn máng de méi shí jiān chī fàn .
meaning: Business is good at weekends; the owner is too busy to eat.

text: 她用第一份工资给妈妈买了礼物。
pinyin: tā yòng dì yī fèn gōng zī gěi mā mā mǎi le lǐ wù .
meaning: She bought her mum a gift with her first pay.

text: 所有职工都可以参加周五的活动。
pinyin: suǒ yǒu zhí gōng dōu kě yǐ cān jiā zhōu wǔ de huó dòng .
meaning: All employees can join the Friday event.

text: 学校周六有就业介绍会。
pinyin: xué xiào zhōu liù yǒu jiù yè jiè shào huì .
meaning: The school has a careers event on Saturday.

text: 她把大部分时间都用在自己的事业上。
pinyin: tā bǎ dà bù fèn shí jiān dōu yòng zài zì jǐ de shì yè shàng .
meaning: She spends most of her time on her career.

text: 这家公司需要会两种语言的人才。
pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī xū yào huì liǎng zhǒng yǔ yán de rén cái .
meaning: This company needs talented people who speak two languages.

text: 朋友的鼓励推动我完成了这个计划。
pinyin: péng you de gǔ lì tuī dòng wǒ wán chéng le zhè gè jì huà .
meaning: My friend's encouragement helped me complete the plan.

text: 我们先解决最急的问题，再推进其他工作。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān jiě jué zuì jí de wèn tí , zài tuī jìn qí tā gōng zuò .
meaning: We'll solve the most urgent problem first, then move the other work forward.

text: 新体育馆已经建成，下个月就能用了。
pinyin: xīn tǐ yù guǎn yǐ jīng jiàn chéng , xià gè yuè jiù néng yòng le .
meaning: The new sports hall is complete and will be usable next month.

text: 这条路还在建设，公交车得绕一下。
pinyin: zhè tiáo lù hái zài jiàn shè , gōng jiāo chē děi rào yī xià .
meaning: This road is still under construction, so buses have to take a detour.

text: 我们三年前成立了这个乐队。
pinyin: wǒ men sān nián qián chéng lì le zhè gè yuè duì .
meaning: We formed this band three years ago.

text: 医院在门口设立了临时咨询点。
pinyin: yī yuàn zài mén kǒu shè lì le lín shí zī xún diǎn .
meaning: The hospital set up a temporary information point at the entrance.

text: 这家厂以前生产自行车。
pinyin: zhè jiā chǎng yǐ qián shēng chǎn zì xíng chē .
meaning: This factory used to make bicycles.

text: 毕业前，老师给我们介绍了几种就业机会。
pinyin: bì yè qián , lǎo shī gěi wǒ men jiè shào le jǐ zhǒng jiù yè jī huì .
meaning: Before graduation, our teacher told us about several job opportunities.

text: 我们公司正在找设计方面的人才。
pinyin: wǒ men gōng sī zhèng zài zhǎo shè jì fāng miàn de rén cái .
meaning: Our company is looking for talented designers.

text: 这次合作推动了两个小组的交流。
pinyin: zhè cì hé zuò tuī dòng le liǎng gè xiǎo zǔ de jiāo liú .
meaning: This collaboration encouraged exchange between the two groups.

text: 材料到了，我们终于能推进下一步工作了。
pinyin: cái liào dào le , wǒ men zhōng yú néng tuī jìn xià yī bù gōng zuò le .
meaning: The materials have arrived, so we can finally move the next stage forward.

We'll solve the most urgent problem first, then move the other work forward. The new sports hall is complete and will be usable next month. text: 你留学的材料准备好了吗？
pinyin: nǐ liú xué de cái liào zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma ?
meaning: Have you prepared your study-abroad documents?

text: 差不多了。现在最难的是选专业。
pinyin: chà bu duō le . xiàn zài zuì nán de shì xuǎn zhuān yè .
meaning: Almost. The hardest part now is choosing a subject.

text: 你不是想学中文吗？
pinyin: nǐ bù shì xiǎng xué zhōng wén ma ?
meaning: Didn't you want to study Chinese?

text: 对，但我也想学设计。中文系的课不仅多，还要写很多作业。
pinyin: duì , dàn wǒ yě xiǎng xué shè jì . zhōng wén xì de kè bù jǐn duō , hái yào xiě hěn duō zuò yè .
meaning: Yes, but I also want to study design. The Chinese department has lots of classes and a lot of written work.

text: 能把两个专业结合起来吗？
pinyin: néng bǎ liǎng gè zhuān yè jié hé qǐ lái ma ?
meaning: Could you combine the two subjects?

text: 我问过老师，可以先学中文，再选几门设计课。
pinyin: wǒ wèn guò lǎo shī , kě yǐ xiān xué zhōng wén , zài xuǎn jǐ mén shè jì kè .
meaning: I asked a teacher. I can start with Chinese and take a few design classes later.

text: 那学费会增加吗？
pinyin: nà xué fèi huì zēng jiā ma ?
meaning: Would the tuition go up?

text: 不会。但是我刚过去，可能需要时间适应。
pinyin: bù huì . dàn shì wǒ gāng guò qù , kě néng xū yào shí jiān shì yìng .
meaning: No, but I'll probably need time to settle in when I first arrive.

text: 你现在不是上班就是上课，确实够忙的。
pinyin: nǐ xiàn zài bù shì shàng bān jiù shì shàng kè , què shí gòu máng de .
meaning: You're always either working or in class now. You really are busy.

text: 所以我想先少选一点。有空再和同学交流，别每天只赶作业。
pinyin: suǒ yǐ wǒ xiǎng xiān shǎo xuǎn yī diǎn . yǒu kōng zài hé tóng xué jiāo liú , bié měi tiān zhǐ gǎn zuò yè .
meaning: That's why I want to take fewer classes at first, and have time to talk with classmates rather than just rush through assignments.

text: 到新的学校以后，我本来想把每个晚上都安排成学习时间。周一和周三上中文课，周二和周四去设计室，周五参加交流活动。
pinyin: dào xīn de xué xiào yǐ hòu , wǒ běn lái xiǎng bǎ měi gè wǎn shang dōu ān pái chéng xué xí shí jiān . zhōu yī hé zhōu sān shàng zhōng wén kè , zhōu èr hé zhōu sì qù shè jì shì , zhōu wǔ cān jiā jiāo liú huó dòng .
meaning: When I arrived at my new school, I initially planned to study every evening: Chinese on Mondays and Wednesdays, the design studio on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and an exchange event on Fridays.

text: 第一周，我不是在教室就是在路上。回到住处已经很晚，连朋友发来的消息都没有时间看。
pinyin: dì yī zhōu , wǒ bù shì zài jiào shì jiù shì zài lù shàng . huí dào zhù chù yǐ jīng hěn wǎn , lián péng you fā lái de xiāo xī dōu méi yǒu shí jiān kàn .
meaning: In the first week I was either in a classroom or on the road. I got home so late I didn't even have time to read friends' messages.

text: 后来，老师让我写下自己真正想做的事。我想不仅看懂外文材料，还能和同学讨论自己的作品。
pinyin: hòu lái , lǎo shī ràng wǒ xiě xià zì jǐ zhēn zhèng xiǎng zuò de shì . wǒ xiǎng bù jǐn kàn dǒng wài wén cái liào , hái néng hé tóng xué tǎo lùn zì jǐ de zuò pǐn .
meaning: Later my teacher asked me to write down what I really wanted to do. I wanted to read material in another language and discuss my work with classmates.

text: 我发现一门课同时包括这两部分，而且教室离住处只有几百米。教室面积较小，但每个人都能说话。
pinyin: wǒ fā xiàn yī mén kè tóng shí bāo kuò zhè liǎng bù fèn , ér qiě jiào shì lí zhù chù zhǐ yǒu jǐ bǎi mǐ . jiào shì miàn jī jiào xiǎo , dàn měi gè rén dōu néng shuō huà .
meaning: I found a class covering both parts, with a classroom just a few hundred metres from home. The room was relatively small, but everyone got a chance to speak.

text: 我于是减少了晚上的课程。两周内，我认识了几位新朋友，也渐渐适应了课堂的节奏。
pinyin: wǒ yú shì jiǎn shǎo le wǎn shang de kè chéng . liǎng zhōu nèi , wǒ rèn shi le jǐ wèi xīn péng you , yě jiàn jiàn shì yìng le kè táng de jié zòu .
meaning: So I reduced my evening classes. Within two weeks I had met some new friends and gradually adjusted to the pace of class.

text: 现在我仍然学得很认真，不过周五晚上有时只和朋友散步。能坚持下去的安排，比满满一张表更适合我。

text: 今晚又上课？
pinyin: jīn wǎn yòu shàng kè ?
meaning: Class again tonight?

text: 不上。我终于有空一起吃饭了。
pinyin: bù shàng . wǒ zhōng yú yǒu kōng yì qǐ chī fàn le .
meaning: No. I finally have time to have dinner with you.

text: 真难得。你上个月不是上课就是写作业。

text: 我少选了一门。学习不是把日历填满就行。
pinyin: wǒ shǎo xuǎn le yī mén . xué xí bù shì bǎ rì lì tián mǎn jiù xíng .
meaning: I dropped one class. Filling my calendar isn't all there is to learning.

text: 那太好了。你选饭馆，我请客。
pinyin: nà tài hǎo le . nǐ xuǎn fàn guǎn , wǒ qǐng kè .
meaning: Great. You choose the restaurant; dinner's on me.

text: 等等，选课我想了两周，选饭馆你给我几分钟？
pinyin: děng děng , xuǎn kè wǒ xiǎng le liǎng zhōu , xuǎn fàn guǎn nǐ gěi wǒ jǐ fēn zhōng ?
meaning: Wait. I spent two weeks choosing a class. How many minutes do I get to choose a restaurant?

text: 今晚又上课？不上。我终于有空一起吃饭了。真难得。你上个月不是上课就是写作业。我少选了一门。学习不是把日历填满就行。那太好了。你选饭馆，我请客。等等，选课我想了两周，选饭馆你给我几分钟？
pinyin: jīn wǎn yòu shàng kè ? bù shàng . wǒ zhōng yú yǒu kōng yì qǐ chī fàn le . zhēn nán dé . nǐ shàng gè yuè bù shì shàng kè jiù shì xiě zuò yè . wǒ shǎo xuǎn le yī mén . xué xí bù shì bǎ rì lì tián mǎn jiù xíng . nà tài hǎo le . nǐ xuǎn fàn guǎn , wǒ qǐng kè . děng děng , xuǎn kè wǒ xiǎng le liǎng zhōu , xuǎn fàn guǎn nǐ gěi wǒ jǐ fēn zhōng ?
meaning: Class again tonight? No. I finally have time to have dinner with you. What a rare occasion! Last month you were always either in class or doing homework. I dropped one class. Filling my calendar isn't all there is to learning. Great. You choose the restaurant; dinner's on me. Wait. I spent two weeks choosing a class. How many minutes do I get to choose a restaurant?

text: 她把语言学习和设计结合起来。
pinyin: tā bǎ yǔ yán xué xí hé shè jì jié hé qǐ lái .

text: 我想和不同专业的同学交流。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng hé bù tóng zhuān yè de tóng xué jiāo liú .

text: 我姐姐去年去北京留学了。
pinyin: wǒ jiě jie qù nián qù běi jīng liú xué le .

text: 学费可以分两次交。
pinyin: xué fèi kě yǐ fēn liǎng cì jiāo .

text: 他每天读半小时外文报纸。
pinyin: tā měi tiān dú bàn xiǎo shí wài wén bào zhǐ .
meaning: He reads a foreign-language newspaper for half an hour every day.

text: 中文系的办公室在三楼。
pinyin: zhōng wén xì de bàn gōng shì zài sān lóu .
meaning: The Chinese department's office is on the third floor.

text: 你的专业是设计还是中文？
pinyin: nǐ de zhuān yè shì shè jì hái shi zhōng wén ?
meaning: Is your subject design or Chinese?

text: 请到会议室等我。
pinyin: qǐng dào huì yì shì děng wǒ .
meaning: Please wait for me in the meeting room.

text: 这所学校有五百名学生。
pinyin: zhè suǒ xué xiào yǒu wǔ bǎi míng xué sheng .
meaning: This school has five hundred students.

text: 所长今天不在办公室。
pinyin: suǒ zhǎng jīn tiān bù zài bàn gōng shì .
meaning: The institute director is not in the office today.

text: 她很快适应了这里的生活。
pinyin: tā hěn kuài shì yìng le zhè lǐ de shēng huó .
meaning: She quickly adjusted to life here.

text: 这个房间的光线较好。
pinyin: zhè gè fáng jiān de guāng xiàn jiào hǎo .
meaning: This room has comparatively good light.

text: 选这门课的学生中，女生的比例较高。
pinyin: xuǎn zhè mén kè de xué sheng zhōng , nǚ shēng de bǐ lì jiào gāo .
meaning: A relatively high proportion of the students choosing this class are women.

text: 房间面积不大，但住起来很舒服。
pinyin: fáng jiān miàn jī bù dà , dàn zhù qǐ lái hěn shū fú .
meaning: The room has a small area but is comfortable to live in.

text: 先向北走两百米，再向右转。
pinyin: xiān xiàng běi zǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ , zài xiàng yòu zhuǎn .
meaning: Go north two hundred metres, then turn right.

text: 请在三天内给我回复。
pinyin: qǐng zài sān tiān nèi gěi wǒ huí fù .
meaning: Please reply within three days.

text: 这些人当中，有几个是我的老朋友。
pinyin: zhè xiē rén dāng zhōng , yǒu jǐ gè shì wǒ de lǎo péng yǒu .
meaning: Several people among this group are old friends of mine.

text: 你周五有空儿吗？
pinyin: nǐ zhōu wǔ yǒu kòngr ma ?
meaning: Are you free on Friday?

text: 那位老太太经常坐在这里看书。
pinyin: nà wèi lǎo tài tài jīng cháng zuò zài zhè lǐ kàn shū .
meaning: That elderly woman often sits here reading.

text: 我爷爷笑着说，他就是一个爱唱歌的老头儿。
pinyin: wǒ yé ye xiào zhe shuō , tā jiù shì yī gè ài chàng gē de lǎo tou er .
meaning: My grandpa laughs and says he's just an old man who loves singing.

text: 这条路方便了附近的老百姓。
pinyin: zhè tiáo lù fāng biàn le fù jìn de lǎo bǎi xìng .
meaning: This road made life easier for ordinary people nearby.

text: 每个公民都有自己的权利和义务。
pinyin: měi gè gōng mín dōu yǒu zì jǐ de quán lì hé yì wù .
meaning: Every citizen has rights and responsibilities.

text: 所长今天不在，明天才回来。
pinyin: suǒ zhǎng jīn tiān bù zài , míng tiān cái huí lái .
meaning: The institute director is away today and returns tomorrow.

text: 这张地图的比例不对，学校看起来比城市还大。
pinyin: zhè zhāng dì tú de bǐ lì bú duì , xué xiào kàn qǐ lái bǐ chéng shì hái dà .
meaning: The scale of this map is wrong; the school looks bigger than the city.

text: 我们当中有三个人会开车。
pinyin: wǒ men dāng zhōng yǒu sān gè rén huì kāi chē .
meaning: Three of us can drive.

text: 周五有空儿的话，一起吃饭吧。
pinyin: zhōu wǔ yǒu kòngr de huà , yì qǐ chī fàn ba .
meaning: If you have some free time on Friday, let’s have dinner.

text: 门口那位老太太是我邻居。
pinyin: mén kǒu nà wèi lǎo tài tài shì wǒ lín jū .
meaning: The elderly lady at the door is my neighbour.

text: 那个老头儿每天都来这里喝茶。
pinyin: nà gè lǎo tou er měi tiān dōu lái zhè lǐ hē chá .
meaning: That old man comes here for tea every day.

text: 老百姓买菜比以前方便多了。
pinyin: lǎo bǎi xìng mǎi cài bǐ yǐ qián fāng biàn duō le .
meaning: Buying groceries is much more convenient for ordinary people now.

text: 每个公民都有自己的权利，也有义务。
pinyin: měi gè gōng mín dōu yǒu zì jǐ de quán lì , yě yǒu yì wù .

text: 昨天的车费你算好了吗？
pinyin: zuó tiān de chē fèi nǐ suàn hǎo le ma ?
meaning: Have you worked out yesterday's fares?

text: 算了。四个人一共一百二十，每人三十。
pinyin: suàn le . sì gè rén yī gòng yī bǎi èr shí , měi rén sān shí .
meaning: Yes. A hundred and twenty for four people, so thirty each.

text: 那饭钱呢？我记得大约两百。
pinyin: nà fàn qián ne ? wǒ jì de dà yuē liǎng bǎi .
meaning: What about dinner? I remember it being about two hundred.

text: 实际是一百八十。你们把钱转给我，我收到了就发收据。
pinyin: shí jì shì yī bǎi bā shí . nǐ men bǎ qián zhuǎn gěi wǒ , wǒ shōu dào le jiù fā shōu jù .
meaning: It was actually a hundred and eighty. Transfer me the money and I'll send the receipt when I get it.

text: 所以每人一共七十五？
pinyin: suǒ yǐ měi rén yī gòng qī shí wǔ ?
meaning: So seventy-five each in total?

text: 对。比上次增加了十块，主要是车费涨了。
pinyin: duì . bǐ shàng cì zēng jiā le shí kuài , zhǔ yào shì chē fèi zhǎng le .
meaning: Right. Ten more than last time, mainly because fares went up.

text: 不过那个市场挺值得去的，小吃很有特色。
pinyin: bù guò nà gè shì chǎng tǐng zhí de qù de , xiǎo chī hěn yǒu tè sè .
meaning: Still, that market was worth visiting. The snacks were distinctive.

text: 我也觉得值。下次早一点去，坐公交车能省一点。
pinyin: wǒ yě jué de zhí . xià cì zǎo yī diǎn qù , zuò gōng jiāo chē néng shěng yī diǎn .
meaning: I think it was worth it too. Next time let's go earlier; taking the bus would save a bit.

text: 行，我转完钱就把照片发群里。
pinyin: xíng , wǒ zhuǎn wán qián jiù bǎ zhào piān fā qún lǐ .
meaning: Okay. I'll send the photos to the group after transferring the money.

text: 先把我闭着眼的那张删了，求你了。

meaning: Please delete the one where my eyes are shut first. I'm begging you.

text: 周六，我们四个人去了城南的市场。出发前，大家预计每人花七十块左右，车费和饭钱都算在里面。
pinyin: zhōu liù , wǒ men sì gè rén qù le chéng nán de shì chǎng . chū fā qián , dà jiā yù jì měi rén huā qī shí kuài zuǒ yòu , chē fèi hé fàn qián dōu suàn zài lǐ miàn .
meaning: On Saturday four of us went to the market in the south of town. Before leaving we estimated around seventy yuan each, including transport and dinner.

text: 那天起床晚了，到了车站才发现公交车刚走。我们等了一会儿，就决定一起打车。
pinyin: nà tiān qǐ chuáng wǎn le , dào le chē zhàn cái fā xiàn gōng jiāo chē gāng zǒu . wǒ men děng le yī huì er , jiù jué dìng yì qǐ dǎ chē .
meaning: We got up late and discovered at the station that the bus had just left. After waiting a while, we decided to share a taxi.

text: 市场比照片上热闹。当地的小吃很有特色，同一种商品在不同店里的价格也不一样。
pinyin: shì chǎng bǐ zhào piān shàng rè nào . dāng dì de xiǎo chī hěn yǒu tè sè , tóng yī zhǒng shāng pǐn zài bù tóng diàn lǐ de jià gé yě bù yī yàng .
meaning: The market was livelier than in the photographs. The local snacks were distinctive, and the same goods had different prices in different shops.

text: 朋友买完东西就去问路，我们在旁边等她。老板介绍了一家饭馆，四个人吃饭一共花了一百八十。
pinyin: péng you mǎi wán dōng xi jiù qù wèn lù , wǒ men zài páng biān děng tā . lǎo bǎn jiè shào le yī jiā fàn guǎn , sì gè rén chī fàn yī gòng huā le yī bǎi bā shí .
meaning: Once my friend had finished shopping she asked for directions while we waited nearby. A shopkeeper recommended a restaurant, where dinner for four cost a hundred and eighty.

text: 回家以后，我们把每一笔钱加起来。车费一百二十，饭钱一百八十，购物的钱各自付。最后每人七十五，比预计多了五块。
pinyin: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ men bǎ měi yī bǐ qián jiā qǐ lái . chē fèi yī bǎi èr shí , fàn qián yī bǎi bā shí , gòu wù de qián gè zì fù . zuì hòu měi rén qī shí wǔ , bǐ yù jì duō le wǔ kuài .
meaning: Back home we added up the shared expenses: a hundred and twenty for fares and a hundred and eighty for dinner, with shopping paid separately. Each person owed seventy-five, five more than estimated.

text: 虽然多花了一点，我仍然觉得这次出门值得。下次早点出发，不仅能少等一会儿，也能坐公交车省钱。
pinyin: suī rán duō huā le yī diǎn , wǒ réng rán jué de zhè cì chū mén zhí de . xià cì zǎo diǎn chū fā , bù jǐn néng shǎo děng yī huì er , yě néng zuò gōng jiāo chē shěng qián .
meaning: Although we spent a little more, I still thought the trip was worthwhile. Leaving earlier next time would mean less waiting and saving money by taking the bus.

text: 周六，我们四个人去了城南的市场。出发前，大家预计每人花七十块左右，车费和饭钱都算在里面。那天起床晚了，到了车站才发现公交车刚走。我们等了一会儿，就决定一起打车。市场比照片上热闹。当地的小吃很有特色，同一种商品在不同店里的价格也不一样。朋友买完东西就去问路，我们在旁边等她。老板介绍了一家饭馆，四个人吃饭一共花了一百八十。回家以后，我们把每一笔钱加起来。车费一百二十，饭钱一百八十，购物的钱各自付。最后每人七十五，比预计多了五块。虽然多花了一点，我仍然觉得这次出门值得。下次早点出发，不仅能少等一会儿，也能坐公交车省钱。

meaning: On Saturday four of us went to the market in the south of town. Before leaving we estimated around seventy yuan each, including transport and dinner. We got up late and discovered at the station that the bus had just left. After waiting a while, we decided to share a taxi. The market was livelier than in the photographs. The local snacks were distinctive, and the same goods had different prices in different shops. Once my friend had finished shopping she asked for directions while we waited nearby. A shopkeeper recommended a restaurant, where dinner for four cost a hundred and eighty. Back home we added up the shared expenses: a hundred and twenty for fares and a hundred and eighty for dinner, with shopping paid separately. Each person owed seventy-five, five more than estimated. Although we spent a little more, I still thought the trip was worthwhile. Leaving earlier next time would mean less waiting and saving money by taking the bus.

text: 最后七十五，差五块。

text: 这位老师被大家称为老朋友。

text: 某个周末，我们可以一起去海边。

text: 排队买票太费时间了。

meaning: Queuing for tickets takes too much time.

text: 这件商品可以退吗？

text: 学校旁边有一个商业中心。

text: 这个市场周一不开放。

text: 她在大学学经济。

text: 春天到了，气温逐渐上升。

text: 我们又增加了两个座位。

text: 小店的收入每年都在增长。

text: 这种原料来自石油。

text: 这个环可以挂钥匙。

text: 学校举办了一次环保活动。

text: 窗外的环境很安静。

text: 这篇文章讲的是当地的经济。

text: 都十一点了，我们是不是该走了？
pinyin: dōu shí yī diǎn le , wǒ men shì bú shì gāi zǒu le ?
meaning: It's already eleven. Shouldn't we get going?

text: 再坐一会儿吧。我爸退休以后，就喜欢家里热闹。
pinyin: zài zuò yī huì er ba . wǒ bà tuì xiū yǐ hòu , jiù xǐ huān jiā lǐ rè nào .
meaning: Stay a little longer. Since my dad retired, he loves having people around.

text: 我也想多聊，可明天还要早起。
pinyin: wǒ yě xiǎng duō liáo , kě míng tiān hái yào zǎo qǐ .
meaning: I'd like to keep talking too, but I have to get up early tomorrow.

text: 那我送你到楼下。路上慢一点。
pinyin: nà wǒ sòng nǐ dào lóu xià . lù shàng màn yī diǎn .
meaning: Then I'll walk you downstairs. Take your time on the way.

text: 刚才空调开得太冷了，我手指都凉了。
pinyin: gāng cái kōng tiáo kāi de tài lěng le , wǒ shǒu zhǐ dōu liáng le .
meaning: The air conditioning was so cold earlier that even my fingers feel cold.

text: 怪不得你一直抱着杯子。我还以为你特别喜欢那杯水。
pinyin: guài bù de nǐ yì zhí bào zhe bēi zi . wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ tè bié xǐ huān nà bēi shuǐ .
meaning: That explains why you kept holding your cup. I thought you really liked that water.

text: 凉水我怎么会一直想喝啊？
pinyin: liáng shuǐ wǒ zěn me huì yì zhí xiǎng hē a ?
meaning: Why would I keep wanting cold water?

text: 是我忘了关。下次你直接告诉我。
pinyin: shì wǒ wàng le guān . xià cì nǐ zhí jiē gào sù wǒ .
meaning: I forgot to turn it off. Tell me directly next time.

text: 好。对了，周六的聚会我可能晚一点到。
pinyin: hǎo . duì le , zhōu liù de jù huì wǒ kě néng wǎn yī diǎn dào .
meaning: Okay. By the way, I might arrive a little late on Saturday.

text: 晚就晚点吧，你来了就好。到时候再聊。
pinyin: wǎn jiù wǎn diǎn ba , nǐ lái le jiù hǎo . dào shí hou zài liáo .
meaning: A little late is fine. I'm happy as long as you come. We'll talk then.

text: 星期五晚上，我们去朋友家给她爸爸庆祝退休。他以前是大夫，工作忙的时候常常很晚才回家。
pinyin: xīng qī wǔ wǎn shang , wǒ men qù péng you jiā gěi tā bà bà qìng zhù tuì xiū . tā yǐ qián shì dà fū , gōng zuò máng de shí hou cháng cháng hěn wǎn cái huí jiā .
meaning: On Friday evening we visited a friend to celebrate her dad's retirement. He used to be a doctor and often got home very late when work was busy.

text: 那天他给大家讲以前的事：一次紧急电话、一个多年后又见到的病人，还有一个怕打针的孩子。大家听着听着都笑了。
pinyin: nà tiān tā gěi dà jiā jiǎng yǐ qián de shì : yī cì jǐn jí diàn huà , yī gè duō nián hòu yòu jiàn dào de bìng rén , hái yǒu yī gè pà dǎ zhēn de hái zi . dà jiā tīng zhe tīng zhe dōu xiào le .
meaning: That evening he told us stories: an urgent phone call, a patient he met again years later, and a child afraid of injections. As we listened, we all started laughing.

text: 饭后，他拿出照片。最旧的一张已经看不清了，他却还记得照片上每个人的名字。
pinyin: fàn hòu , tā ná chū zhào piān . zuì jiù de yī zhāng yǐ jīng kàn bù qīng le , tā què hái jì de zhào piān shàng měi gè rén de míng zi .
meaning: After dinner he brought out photographs. The oldest one had faded, but he still remembered everyone in it.

text: 十一点多，我看了一眼墙上的钟。朋友说明天可以晚起，我却还有早上的课，只好先告别。
pinyin: shí yī diǎn duō , wǒ kàn le yī yǎn qiáng shàng de zhōng . péng you shuō míng tiān kě yǐ wǎn qǐ , wǒ què hái yǒu zǎo shàng de kè , zhǐ hǎo xiān gào bié .
meaning: After eleven I glanced at the wall clock. My friend said we could get up late the next day, but I had a morning class and had to say goodbye first.

text: 他送我们到门口，说慢就慢点吧，别急，下次再来。我答应周六带自己做的点心来。
pinyin: tā sòng wǒ men dào mén kǒu , shuō màn jiù màn diǎn ba , bié jí , xià cì zài lái . wǒ dā yìng zhōu liù dài zì jǐ zuò de diǎn xīn lái .
meaning: He walked us to the door and said to take our time and visit again. I promised to bring homemade snacks on Saturday.

text: 走到楼下，我才发现外套还在椅子上。都告别两次了，我又得回去一次。朋友打开门，笑着问我是不是又饿了。
pinyin: zǒu dào lóu xià , wǒ cái fā xiàn wài tào hái zài yǐ zi shàng . dōu gào bié liǎng cì le , wǒ yòu děi huí qù yī cì . péng you dǎ kāi mén , xiào zhe wèn wǒ shì bú shì yòu è le .
meaning: Downstairs I realised my coat was still on a chair. I'd already said goodbye twice, and now I had to go back again. My friend opened the door and laughed, asking if I was hungry again.

text: 你怎么又回来了？
pinyin: nǐ zěn me yòu huí lái le ?
meaning: Why are you back again?

text: 外套忘了。
pinyin: wài tào wàng le .
meaning: I forgot my coat.

text: 都说了三次再见了，这回真的走？
pinyin: dōu shuō le sān cì zài jiàn le , zhè huí zhēn de zǒu ?
meaning: We've said goodbye three times now. Are you really leaving this time?

text: 真的。慢就慢点吧，我总会到家的。
pinyin: zhēn de . màn jiù màn diǎn ba , wǒ zǒng huì dào jiā de .
meaning: Yes. I'll get home eventually, even if I take my time.

text: 等等，你的手机呢？
pinyin: děng děng , nǐ de shǒu jī ne ?
meaning: Wait. Where's your phone?

text: 别吓我！在口袋里。
pinyin: bié xià wǒ ! zài kǒu dài lǐ .
meaning: Don't scare me! It's in my pocket.

meaning: That doctor is patient with everyone.

text: 她考上了公务员，准备回老家工作。
pinyin: tā kǎo shàng le gōng wù yuán , zhǔn bèi huí lǎo jiā gōng zuò .
meaning: She passed the civil service exam and is preparing to work in her hometown.

text: 他去年调到北京工作了。
pinyin: tā qù nián diào dào běi jīng gōng zuò le .
meaning: He transferred to Beijing for work last year.

text: 学校在调查学生想选哪些课。
pinyin: xué xiào zài diào chá xué sheng xiǎng xuǎn nǎ xiē kè .
meaning: The school is surveying which classes students want to take.

text: 这次失败不等于否定以前的努力。
pinyin: zhè cì shī bài bù děng yú fǒu dìng yǐ qián de nǔ lì .
meaning: This failure doesn't negate the earlier effort.

text: 她否认拿过那本书。
pinyin: tā fǒu rèn ná guò nà běn shū .
meaning: She denies having taken that book.

text: 他接到紧急电话，马上离开了。
pinyin: tā jiē dào jǐn jí diàn huà , mǎ shàng lí kāi le .
meaning: He received an urgent call and left immediately.

text: 交警让我从另一个路口走。
pinyin: jiāo jǐng ràng wǒ cóng lìng yī gè lù kǒu zǒu .
meaning: The traffic officer told me to use another junction.

text: 警察帮孩子找到了妈妈。
pinyin: jǐng chá bāng hái zi zhǎo dào le mā mā .
meaning: The police helped the child find their mum.

text: 他从河里救了一只狗。
pinyin: tā cóng hé lǐ jiù le yī zhǐ gǒu .
meaning: He rescued a dog from the river.

text: 污染会危害人和动物。
pinyin: wū rǎn huì wēi hài rén hé dòng wù .
meaning: Pollution harms people and animals.

text: 这家饭馆很注意卫生。
pinyin: zhè jiā fàn guǎn hěn zhù yì wèi shēng .
meaning: This restaurant pays close attention to hygiene.

text: 卫生间在走廊尽头。
pinyin: wèi shēng jiān zài zǒu láng jìn tóu .
meaning: The bathroom is at the end of the corridor.

text: 她看到血就有点害怕。
pinyin: tā kàn dào xuè jiù yǒu diǎn hài pà .
meaning: She gets a little scared when she sees blood.

text: 阳台上的花死了，我又种了一棵。
pinyin: yáng tái shàng de huā sǐ le , wǒ yòu zhǒng le yī kē .
meaning: The plant on the balcony died, so I planted another.

text: 我爸爸退休以后开始学画画。
pinyin: wǒ bà bà tuì xiū yǐ hòu kāi shǐ xué huà huà .
meaning: My dad started learning to paint after retiring.

text: 电影里那对夫妻最后离婚了。
pinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ nà duì fū qī zuì hòu lí hūn le .
meaning: The couple in the film divorced at the end.

text: 房间太冷，先把空调关了吧。
pinyin: fáng jiān tài lěng , xiān bǎ kōng tiáo guān le ba .
meaning: It's too cold in here. Let's turn the air conditioning off.

text: 杯子里的凉水已经喝完了。
pinyin: bēi zi lǐ de liáng shuǐ yǐ jīng hē wán le .
meaning: The cool water in the cup has all been drunk.

text: 她用手指在地图上画了一条路。
pinyin: tā yòng shǒu zhǐ zài dì tú shàng huà le yī tiáo lù .
meaning: She traced a route on the map with her finger.

text: 书太重，把盒子压坏了。
pinyin: shū tài zhòng , bǎ hé zi yā huài le .
meaning: The books were so heavy that they crushed the box.

text: 墙上的钟比手机快五分钟。
pinyin: qiáng shàng de zhōng bǐ shǒu jī kuài wǔ fēn zhōng .
meaning: The wall clock is five minutes ahead of the phone.

text: 她考上了公务员，明年开始上班。
pinyin: tā kǎo shàng le gōng wù yuán , míng nián kāi shǐ shàng bān .
meaning: She passed the civil-service recruitment exam and starts work next year.

text: 调查结果出来以后，学校决定延长图书馆的开放时间。
pinyin: diào chá jié guǒ chū lái yǐ hòu , xué xiào jué dìng yán cháng tú shū guǎn de kāi fàng shí jiān .
meaning: After the survey results came out, the school decided to extend library opening hours.

text: 老师没有否定我的想法，只让我再改一改。
pinyin: lǎo shī méi yǒu fǒu dìng wǒ de xiǎng fǎ , zhǐ ràng wǒ zài gǎi yī gǎi .
meaning: The teacher didn’t reject my idea, just asked me to revise it.

text: 他否认拿过这本书，但我还没找到它。
pinyin: tā fǒu rèn ná guò zhè běn shū , dàn wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào tā .
meaning: He denies taking this book, but I haven’t found it yet.

text: 交警站在路口，让车先停下来。
pinyin: jiāo jǐng zhàn zài lù kǒu , ràng chē xiān tíng xià lái .

text: 我在车站找不到包，就去找警察帮忙。

text: 昨晚我和朋友看一部连续剧。她看过前两集，我是第一次看。
pinyin: zuó wǎn wǒ hé péng you kàn yī bù lián xù jù . tā kàn guò qián liǎng jí , wǒ shì dì yī cì kàn .
meaning: Last night I watched a drama with a friend. She'd seen the first two episodes; it was my first time.

text: 开头，一个人抓住门口的牌子，把它转过来，露出背面的地址。
pinyin: kāi tóu , yī gè rén zhuā zhù mén kǒu de pái zi , bǎ tā zhuǎn guò lái , lù chū bèi miàn de dì zhǐ .
meaning: At the start someone grabs the sign by the door and turns it around, revealing an address on the back.

text: 我没看清那个地址，就问朋友：这是她要去的地方吗？朋友让我先看下去。
pinyin: wǒ méi kàn qīng nà gè dì zhǐ , jiù wèn péng you : zhè shì tā yào qù de dì fāng ma ? péng you ràng wǒ xiān kàn xià qù .
meaning: I couldn't make out the address, so I asked whether that was where she was going. My friend told me to keep watching.

text: 过了一会儿，老师指出信上的日期错了。她马上打电话，叫姐姐别出发。
pinyin: guò le yī huì er , lǎo shī zhǐ chū xìn shàng de rì qī cuò le . tā mǎ shàng dǎ diàn huà , jiào jiě jie bié chū fā .
meaning: A little later a teacher points out that the date on the letter is wrong. She immediately calls her sister and tells her not to leave.

text: 这时我才明白，旧地址造成了误会。我倒回开头再看一次，终于把两件事连起来了。
pinyin: zhè shí wǒ cái míng bái , jiù dì zhǐ zào chéng le wù huì . wǒ dào huí kāi tóu zài kàn yī cì , zhōng yú bǎ liǎng jiàn shì lián qǐ lái le .
meaning: Then I understood: the old address had caused the misunderstanding. I went back to the start and finally connected the two events.

meaning: Our language club practises a song we wrote ourselves on Friday evenings. None of us is a professional singer; when we make a mistake, we try again.

text: 我管材料，把歌词按顺序排好。朋友拿着吉他，用简单的节拍带动大家。
pinyin: wǒ guǎn cái liào , bǎ gē cí àn shùn xù pái hǎo . péng you ná zhe jí tā , yòng jiǎn dān de jié pāi dài dòng dà jiā .
meaning: I'm in charge of the materials and put the lyrics in order. A friend plays guitar and gets everyone going with a simple beat.

text: 第一段讲一个人划船回家，第二段写他追着岸边的灯光。最后，他终于看见家门。
pinyin: dì yī duàn jiǎng yī gè rén huá chuán huí jiā , dì èr duàn xiě tā zhuī zhe àn biān de dēng guāng . zuì hòu , tā zhōng yú kàn jiàn jiā mén .
meaning: The first verse is about someone rowing home; the second follows him chasing the lights on shore. At the end he finally sees his front door.

text: 唱到这里，我总想唱快一点。朋友说别急，这个人走了很远，现在才到家。

text: 我重新读了一遍，慢慢唱。字清楚了，大家也更容易跟上。

meaning: I read it again and sang slowly. The words were clearer, and everyone found it easier to join in.

meaning: The owner had replaced the old sign. The new one showed the opening time, and a few photographs hung by the door.

text: 我们把包放在椅子旁边，点了三碗面。朋友说这家店让他想起小时候的学校门口。
pinyin: wǒ men bǎ bāo fàng zài yǐ zi páng biān , diǎn le sān wǎn miàn . péng you shuō zhè jiā diàn ràng tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu de xué xiào mén kǒu .
meaning: We put our bags beside the chairs and ordered three bowls of noodles. A friend said the place reminded him of the entrance to his school when he was young.

text: 八点多，小周终于到了。我们又点了一碗，听她讲今天发生的事，一直聊到店快关门。
pinyin: bā diǎn duō , xiǎo zhōu zhōng yú dào le . wǒ men yòu diǎn le yī wǎn , tīng tā jiǎng jīn tiān fā shēng de shì , yì zhí liáo dào diàn kuài guān mén .
meaning: Xiaozhou finally arrived after eight. We ordered another bowl and listened to her day, chatting until the shop was almost closing.

text: 这本教材一共有十个单元。
pinyin: zhè běn jiào cái yī gòng yǒu shí gè dān yuán .
meaning: This textbook has ten units in total.

text: 她发动朋友一起打扫小区。
pinyin: tā fā dòng péng you yì qǐ dǎ sǎo xiǎo qū .
meaning: She rallied her friends to clean the neighbourhood together.

text: 他相信自己会有一个光明的未来。
pinyin: tā xiāng xìn zì jǐ huì yǒu yī gè guāng míng de wèi lái .
meaning: He believes he will have a bright future.

text: 这把椅子很结实，坐两个人也没问题。
pinyin: zhè bǎ yǐ zi hěn jiē shí , zuò liǎng gè rén yě méi wèn tí .
meaning: This chair is sturdy; it can even hold two people.

text: 她读了一篇关于联合国的报道。
pinyin: tā dú le yī piān guān yú lián hé guó de bào dào .
meaning: She read a report about the United Nations.

text: 这座城市的气候很适合我。
pinyin: zhè zuò chéng shì de qì hòu hěn shì hé wǒ .
meaning: This city's climate suits me very well.

text: 她的爷爷前年去世了。
pinyin: tā de yé ye qián nián qù shì le .
meaning: Her grandfather passed away the year before last.

text: 这些变化影响着人类的生活。
pinyin: zhè xiē biàn huà yǐng xiǎng zhe rén lèi de shēng huó .
meaning: These changes affect human life.

text: 我以为她不喜欢这首歌，实际上她每天都听。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi tā bù xǐ huān zhè shǒu gē , shí jì shàng tā měi tiān dōu tīng .
meaning: I thought she didn't like this song, but actually she listens to it every day.

text: 他属牛，我属马。
pinyin: tā shǔ niú , wǒ shǔ mǎ .
meaning: His Chinese zodiac sign is the Ox; mine is the Horse.

text: 这辆自行车属于我姐姐。
pinyin: zhè liàng zì xíng chē shǔ yú wǒ jiě jie .
meaning: This bicycle belongs to my sister.

text: 双方谈判了三天，终于签了合同。
pinyin: shuāng fāng tán pàn le sān tiān , zhōng yú qiān le hé tóng .
meaning: The two sides negotiated for three days and finally signed the contract.

text: 见面时，他微笑着和我握手。
pinyin: jiàn miàn shí , tā wēi xiào zhe hé wǒ wò shǒu .
meaning: He smiled and shook my hand when we met.

text: 这个游戏可以四个人一起玩。
pinyin: zhè gè yóu xì kě yǐ sì gè rén yì qǐ wán .
meaning: Four people can play this game together.

text: 我照着朋友给的地址找到了这家店。
pinyin: wǒ zhào zhe péng you gěi de dì zhǐ zhǎo dào le zhè jiā diàn .
meaning: I found the shop using the address my friend gave me.

text: 把这三种颜色组合起来，试试看。
pinyin: bǎ zhè sān zhǒng yán sè zǔ hé qǐ lái , shì shì kàn .
meaning: Try combining these three colours.

text: 你今晚也去林安家的聚会吗？
pinyin: nǐ jīn wǎn yě qù lín ān jiā de jù huì ma ?
meaning: Are you going to the get-together at Lin An’s tonight too?

text: 去，不过除了你，我谁都不认识。
pinyin: qù , bù guò chú le nǐ , wǒ shéi dōu bù rèn shi .
meaning: Yes, but I don’t know anyone except you.

text: 别担心，我先介绍你们认识。你几点能到？
pinyin: bié dān xīn , wǒ xiān jiè shào nǐ men rèn shi . nǐ jǐ diǎn néng dào ?
meaning: Don’t worry, I’ll introduce you first. What time can you get there?

text: 六点吧。我得先回家拿蛋糕。
pinyin: liù diǎn ba . wǒ děi xiān huí jiā ná dàn gāo .
meaning: Around six. I have to go home and pick up the cake first.

text: 你还做了蛋糕？人家肯定很高兴。
pinyin: nǐ hái zuò le dàn gāo ? rén jiā kěn dìng hěn gāo xìng .
meaning: You made a cake too? They’ll be delighted.

text: 别先称赞我，可能没有上次那么好吃。
pinyin: bié xiān chēng zàn wǒ , kě néng méi yǒu shàng cì nà me hǎo chī .
meaning: Don’t compliment me yet. It might not be as good as last time.

text: 好，那我吃完再说。对了，有个朋友也喜欢你说的那个乐队。
pinyin: hǎo , nà wǒ chī wán zài shuō . duì le , yǒu gè péng you yě xǐ huān nǐ shuō de nà gè yuè duì .
meaning: Fine, I’ll say something after I try it. By the way, one of the friends likes that band you mentioned too.

text: 真的？那我们至少有个共同话题了。
pinyin: zhēn de ? nà wǒ men zhì shǎo yǒu gè gòng tóng huà tí le .
meaning: Really? Then we’ve got at least one topic in common.

text: 你不想说话的时候，安静听着也行，不用一直找话题。
pinyin: nǐ bù xiǎng shuō huà de shí hou , ān jìng tīng zhe yě xíng , bù yòng yì zhí zhǎo huà tí .
meaning: When you don’t feel like talking, it’s fine to just listen. You don’t have to keep finding topics.

text: 你越这么说，我反而越紧张。
pinyin: nǐ yuè zhè me shuō , wǒ fǎn ér yuè jǐn zhāng .
meaning: The more you say that, the more nervous I get.

text: 行，我不说了。你按时来就好，我在门口等你。
pinyin: xíng , wǒ bù shuō le . nǐ àn shí lái jiù hǎo , wǒ zài mén kǒu děng nǐ .
meaning: Okay, I’ll stop. Just come on time; I’ll wait at the door.

text: 好。蛋糕要是不好吃，你可别当着大家的面说。
pinyin: hǎo . dàn gāo yào shì bù hǎo chī , nǐ kě bié dāng zhe dà jiā de miàn shuō .
meaning: Okay. If the cake tastes bad, don’t say so in front of everyone.

text: 搬到新城市以后，我最不适应的是下班后的安静。以前想吃饭，随时都能找到朋友。现在手机里有很多名字，却不知道该联系谁。
pinyin: bān dào xīn chéng shì yǐ hòu , wǒ zuì bù shì yīng de shì xià bān hòu de ān jìng . yǐ qián xiǎng chī fàn , suí shí dōu néng zhǎo dào péng you . xiàn zài shǒu jī lǐ yǒu hěn duō míng zi , què bù zhī dào gāi lián xì shéi .
meaning: After moving to a new city, I struggled most with the quiet evenings after work. I used to be able to find friends for dinner whenever I wanted. Now there were lots of names in my phone, but I didn’t know whom to contact.

text: 星期五，邻居问我要不要去她家的聚会。我答应了，到了门口却有点紧张：如果大家没有共同话题，怎么办？
pinyin: xīng qī wǔ , lín jū wèn wǒ yào bù yào qù tā jiā de jù huì . wǒ dā yìng le , dào le mén kǒu què yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng : rú guǒ dà jiā méi yǒu gòng tóng huà tí , zěn me bàn ?
meaning: On Friday my neighbour invited me to a get-together at her place. I accepted, but at the door I felt nervous: what if we had nothing in common to talk about?

text: 她先介绍我认识另一个新搬来的朋友。我们都带了一盒自己做的点心，看见对方手里的盒子，反而一起笑了。
pinyin: tā xiān jiè shào wǒ rèn shi lìng yī gè xīn bān lái de péng you . wǒ men dōu dài le yī hé zì jǐ zuò de diǎn xīn , kàn jiàn duì fāng shǒu lǐ de hé zi , fǎn ér yì qǐ xiào le .
meaning: She introduced me to another friend who’d recently moved here. We’d both brought a box of homemade snacks. When we saw each other’s boxes, we laughed.

text: 一开始，我们聊家乡的天气和吃的东西。后来，他说自己周末常去听音乐，我才发现我们喜欢同一个乐队。
pinyin: yī kāi shǐ , wǒ men liáo jiā xiāng de tiān qì hé chī de dōng xi . hòu lái , tā shuō zì jǐ zhōu mò cháng qù tīng yīn yuè , wǒ cái fā xiàn wǒ men xǐ huān tóng yī gè yuè duì .
meaning: At first we talked about the weather and food in our hometowns. Then he said he often went to hear music at weekends, and I discovered we liked the same band.

text: 那天我没有和每个人都聊很久。有一段时间，我只是坐着听。主人没催我说话，也没有问我为什么沉默。
pinyin: nà tiān wǒ méi yǒu hé měi gè rén dōu liáo hěn jiǔ . yǒu yī duàn shí jiān , wǒ zhǐ shì zuò zhe tīng . zhǔ rén méi cuī wǒ shuō huà , yě méi yǒu wèn wǒ wèi shén me chén mò .
meaning: I didn’t talk at length with everyone that day. For a while I simply sat and listened. The host didn’t push me to speak or ask why I was quiet.

text: 走的时候，我们互相留了号码，约好下周去听音乐。回家的路上，我突然觉得这座城市没那么陌生了。
pinyin: zǒu de shí hou , wǒ men hù xiāng liú le hào mǎ , yuē hǎo xià zhōu qù tīng yīn yuè . huí jiā de lù shàng , wǒ tū rán jué de zhè zuò chéng shì méi nà me mò shēng le .
meaning: Before leaving, we exchanged numbers and arranged to hear music together the following week. On the way home, the city suddenly felt less unfamiliar.

text: 后来我主动请邻居来吃饭。她称赞我的菜，我解释说是照着妈妈教的做的。我们又多了一个能聊的话题。
pinyin: hòu lái wǒ zhǔ dòng qǐng lín jū lái chī fàn . tā chēng zàn wǒ de cài , wǒ jiě shì shuō shì zhào zhe mā mā jiào de zuò de . wǒ men yòu duō le yī gè néng liáo de huà tí .
meaning: Later I invited my neighbour to dinner. She complimented my food, and I explained that I’d made it the way my mum taught me. We had another topic to talk about.

text: 现在我知道，交朋友未必需要很多漂亮的话。按时赴约，记住对方说过的小事，有时候比不停地说更重要。
pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ zhī dào , jiāo péng yǒu wèi bì xū yào hěn duō piào liàng de huà . àn shí fù yuē , jì zhù duì fāng shuō guò de xiǎo shì , yǒu shí hou bǐ bù tíng de shuō gèng zhòng yào .
meaning: Now I know that making friends doesn’t necessarily require lots of impressive words. Showing up on time and remembering little things someone told you can matter more than talking nonstop.

text: 这盒也是蛋糕？
pinyin: zhè hé yě shì dàn gāo ?
meaning: Is that box a cake too?

text: 对。你不会也带了吧？
pinyin: duì . nǐ bù huì yě dài le ba ?
meaning: Yes. Don’t tell me you brought one too?

text: 带了。我做了两个小时，路上还怕没人喜欢。
pinyin: dài le . wǒ zuò le liǎng gè xiǎo shí , lù shàng hái pà méi rén xǐ huān .
meaning: I did. I spent two hours making it and worried on the way that nobody would like it.

text: 那正好，我们互相称赞一下。
pinyin: nà zhèng hǎo , wǒ men hù xiāng chēng zàn yī xià .
meaning: Perfect. We can compliment each other’s.

text: 还没吃呢，你这称赞也太早了。
pinyin: hái méi chī ne , nǐ zhè chēng zàn yě tài zǎo le .
meaning: We haven’t eaten yet. That’s a bit early for compliments.

text: 我先称赞你的盒子。挺漂亮的。
pinyin: wǒ xiān chēng zàn nǐ de hé zi . tǐng piào liàng de .
meaning: I’ll compliment your box first. It’s pretty.

text: 谢谢。这是昨天买的。蛋糕才是今天做的。
pinyin: xiè xiè . zhè shì zuó tiān mǎi de . dàn gāo cái shì jīn tiān zuò de .
meaning: Thanks. I bought it yesterday. The cake’s the part I made today.

text: 那我们先找把刀。再不切，大家只能看盒子了。
pinyin: nà wǒ men xiān zhǎo bǎ dāo . zài bù qiè , dà jiā zhǐ néng kàn hé zi le .
meaning: Then let’s find a knife. If we don’t cut them, people can only admire the boxes.

text: 聚会结束后，我和新朋友交换了号码。
pinyin: jù huì jié shù hòu , wǒ hé xīn péng you jiāo huàn le hào mǎ .
meaning: After the get-together I exchanged numbers with a new friend.

text: 老师称赞了我们的表演。
pinyin: lǎo shī chēng zàn le wǒ men de biǎo yǎn .
meaning: The teacher praised our performance.

text: 大家忽然都沉默了，我不知道该说什么。
pinyin: dà jiā hū rán dōu chén mò le , wǒ bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me .
meaning: Everyone suddenly fell silent and I didn’t know what to say.

text: 他的表情很认真，可他说的其实是玩笑话。
pinyin: tā de biǎo qíng hěn rèn zhēn , kě tā shuō de qí shí shì wán xiào huà .
meaning: He looked serious, but what he said was actually a joke.

text: 这次误会说开以后，我们反而更了解彼此了。
pinyin: zhè cì wù huì shuō kāi yǐ hòu , wǒ men fǎn ér gèng liǎo jiě bǐ cǐ le .
meaning: Once we cleared up this misunderstanding, we understood each other better.

text: 她解释了半天，我才发现是自己看错了日期。
pinyin: tā jiě shì le bàn tiān , wǒ cái fā xiàn shì zì jǐ kàn cuò le rì qī .
meaning: After she explained for ages, I realised I’d read the date wrong.

text: 他没有生气，反而笑了。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu shēng qì , fǎn ér xiào le .
meaning: He didn’t get angry; he laughed instead.

text: 我今天按时到了，主人却还没回来。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān àn shí dào le , zhǔ rén què hái méi huí lái .
meaning: I arrived on time today, but the host wasn’t back yet.

text: 她的性格和她姐姐很不一样。
pinyin: tā de xìng gé hé tā jiě jie hěn bù yī yàng .
meaning: Her personality is very different from her sister’s.

text: 下课后，他主动过来跟我打招呼。
pinyin: xià kè hòu , tā zhǔ dòng guò lái gēn wǒ dǎ zhāo hū .
meaning: After class he came over to say hello first.

text: 我们从天气聊到了音乐，话题越来越多。
pinyin: wǒ men cóng tiān qì liáo dào le yīn yuè , huà tí yuè lái yuè duō .
meaning: We went from weather to music and found more and more to talk about.

text: 这个决定是大家共同作出的。
pinyin: zhè gè jué dìng shì dà jiā gòng tóng zuò chū de .
meaning: Everyone made this decision together.

text: 我对他的印象变了：他比我想的热情。
pinyin: wǒ duì tā de yìn xiàng biàn le : tā bǐ wǒ xiǎng de rè qíng .
meaning: My impression of him changed: he’s friendlier than I thought.

text: 搬家那天，邻居们互相帮忙。
pinyin: bān jiā nà tiān , lín jū men hù xiāng bāng máng .
meaning: On moving day, the neighbours helped each other.

text: 我花了两个月才适应这里的天气。
pinyin: wǒ huā le liǎng gè yuè cái shì yìng zhè lǐ de tiān qì .
meaning: It took me two months to get used to the weather here.

text: 大家对这个计划很热情，马上开始讨论。
pinyin: dà jiā duì zhè gè jì huà hěn rè qíng , mǎ shàng kāi shǐ tǎo lùn .
meaning: Everyone was enthusiastic about the plan and immediately started discussing it.

text: 周末的聚会在我家。聚会结束后，我和新朋友交换了号码。她称赞我做的蛋糕，说还想再吃一块。老师称赞了我们的表演。他沉默了一会儿，才说起昨天的事。大家忽然都沉默了，我不知道该说什么。看你的表情，你是不是不喜欢这道菜？他的表情很认真，可他说的其实是玩笑话。我误会你的意思了，对不起。这次误会说开以后，我们反而更了解彼此了。你能解释一下为什么要换地方吗？她解释了半天，我才发现是自己看错了日期。我原来怕冷场，见面以后反而聊个不停。他没有生气，反而笑了。请按时到，大家一起做饭。我今天按时到了，主人却还没回来。我们性格不太一样，但都喜欢看电影。她的性格和她姐姐很不一样。我主动问她要不要一起去买菜。下课后，他主动过来跟我打招呼。刚才那个话题我不太了解。我们从天气聊到了音乐，话题越来越多。我们有一个共同的朋友。这个决定是大家共同作出的。这座城市给我的第一印象是很安静。我对他的印象变了：他比我想的热情。我们互相介绍了自己的家乡。搬家那天，邻居们互相帮忙。刚搬到这里，我还在适应新的生活。我花了两个月才适应这里的天气。她很热情，一进门就问我要不要喝茶。大家对这个计划很热情，马上开始讨论。
pinyin: zhōu mò de jù huì zài wǒ jiā . jù huì jié shù hòu , wǒ hé xīn péng you jiāo huàn le hào mǎ . tā chēng zàn wǒ zuò de dàn gāo , shuō hái xiǎng zài chī yī kuài . lǎo shī chēng zàn le wǒ men de biǎo yǎn . tā chén mò le yī huì er , cái shuō qǐ zuó tiān de shì . dà jiā hū rán dōu chén mò le , wǒ bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me . kàn nǐ de biǎo qíng , nǐ shì bú shì bù xǐ huān zhè dào cài ? tā de biǎo qíng hěn rèn zhēn , kě tā shuō de qí shí shì wán xiào huà . wǒ wù huì nǐ de yì si le , duì bù qǐ . zhè cì wù huì shuō kāi yǐ hòu , wǒ men fǎn ér gèng liǎo jiě bǐ cǐ le . nǐ néng jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me yào huàn dì fāng ma ? tā jiě shì le bàn tiān , wǒ cái fā xiàn shì zì jǐ kàn cuò le rì qī . wǒ yuán lái pà lěng chǎng , jiàn miàn yǐ hòu fǎn ér liáo gè bù tíng . tā méi yǒu shēng qì , fǎn ér xiào le . qǐng àn shí dào , dà jiā yì qǐ zuò fàn . wǒ jīn tiān àn shí dào le , zhǔ rén què hái méi huí lái . wǒ men xìng gé bù tài yī yàng , dàn dōu xǐ huān kàn diàn yǐng . tā de xìng gé hé tā jiě jie hěn bù yī yàng . wǒ zhǔ dòng wèn tā yào bù yào yì qǐ qù mǎi cài . xià kè hòu , tā zhǔ dòng guò lái gēn wǒ dǎ zhāo hū . gāng cái nà gè huà tí wǒ bù tài liǎo jiě . wǒ men cóng tiān qì liáo dào le yīn yuè , huà tí yuè lái yuè duō . wǒ men yǒu yī gè gòng tóng de péng you . zhè gè jué dìng shì dà jiā gòng tóng zuò chū de . zhè zuò chéng shì gěi wǒ de dì yī yìn xiàng shì hěn ān jìng . wǒ duì tā de yìn xiàng biàn le : tā bǐ wǒ xiǎng de rè qíng . wǒ men hù xiāng jiè shào le zì jǐ de jiā xiāng . bān jiā nà tiān , lín jū men hù xiāng bāng máng . gāng bān dào zhè lǐ , wǒ hái zài shì yìng xīn de shēng huó . wǒ huā le liǎng gè yuè cái shì yìng zhè lǐ de tiān qì . tā hěn rè qíng , yī jìn mén jiù wèn wǒ yào bù yào hē chá . dà jiā duì zhè gè jì huà hěn rè qíng , mǎ shàng kāi shǐ tǎo lùn .
meaning: The get-together this weekend is at my place. After the get-together I exchanged numbers with a new friend. She complimented my cake and said she wanted another slice. The teacher praised our performance. He was silent for a moment before talking about yesterday. Everyone suddenly fell silent and I didn’t know what to say. Judging by your expression, don’t you like this dish? He looked serious, but what he said was actually a joke. I misunderstood you. Sorry. Once we cleared up this misunderstanding, we understood each other better. Could you explain why we need to change the venue? After she explained for ages, I realised I’d read the date wrong. I’ve just moved here and I’m still adjusting to my new life. It took me two months to get used to the weather here. She was very welcoming and offered me tea as soon as I came in.
