text: 你刚才说我的外套很特别，究竟是什么意思？
pinyin: nǐ gāng cái shuō wǒ de wài tào hěn tè bié , jiū jìng shì shén me yì si ?
meaning: When you said my coat was unusual, what exactly did you mean?

text: 就是颜色很好看。怎么了？
pinyin: jiù shì yán sè hěn hǎo kàn . zěn me le ?
meaning: Just that the colour is lovely. What’s wrong?

text: 你的表情太认真了，我以为你在说不好看。
pinyin: nǐ de biǎo qíng tài rèn zhēn le , wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ zài shuō bù hǎo kàn .
meaning: You looked so serious that I thought you meant it looked bad.

text: 我真是在称赞你。我这个人一紧张就不太会笑。
pinyin: wǒ zhēn shì zài chēng zàn nǐ . wǒ zhè gè rén yī jǐn zhāng jiù bù tài huì xiào .
meaning: I really was complimenting you. I find it hard to smile when I’m nervous.

text: 你也紧张？我还以为只有我这样。
pinyin: nǐ yě jǐn zhāng ? wǒ hái yǐ wéi zhǐ yǒu wǒ zhè yàng .
meaning: You get nervous too? I thought it was just me.

text: 当然。刚才我差点叫错你的名字。
pinyin: dāng rán . gāng cái wǒ chà diǎn jiào cuò nǐ de míng zi .
meaning: Of course. I almost called you by the wrong name just now.

text: 好吧，那是我误会了。谢谢你的称赞。
pinyin: hǎo ba , nà shì wǒ wù huì le . xiè xiè nǐ de chēng zàn .
meaning: Okay, I misunderstood. Thanks for the compliment.

text: 不要紧。说实话，你不喜欢别人评论你的衣服吗？
pinyin: bú yào jǐn . shuō shí huà , nǐ bù xǐ huān bié ren píng lùn nǐ de yī fú ma ?
meaning: No problem. Honestly, do you dislike people commenting on your clothes?

text: 不在乎，只是我今天自己也觉得这个颜色太亮了。
pinyin: bù zài hū , zhǐ shì wǒ jīn tiān zì jǐ yě jué de zhè gè yán sè tài liàng le .
meaning: I don’t mind. It’s just that I already thought the colour was too bright today.

text: 是挺亮的。我刚到门口，一下就找到你了。
pinyin: shì tǐng liàng de . wǒ gāng dào mén kǒu , yī xià jiù zhǎo dào nǐ le .
meaning: It is bright. I spotted you as soon as I arrived at the door.

text: 你这次是在开玩笑，对吧？
pinyin: nǐ zhè cì shì zài kāi wán xiào , duì ba ?

text: 对。不过你的确很好找。我们先进去吧。

meaning: Yes. But you really are easy to spot. Let’s go in.

text: 以前，朋友说“你可真行”，我总以为是在表扬我。后来有一天，我把大家的车票忘在家里，他又说了这句话。
pinyin: yǐ qián , péng you shuō nǐ kě zhēn xíng , wǒ zǒng yǐ wéi shì zài biǎo yáng wǒ . hòu lái yǒu yī tiān , wǒ bǎ dà jiā de chē piào wàng zài jiā lǐ , tā yòu shuō le zhè jù huà .
meaning: When friends used to say “You’re really something,” I always thought it was praise. Then one day I left everyone’s tickets at home, and a friend said it again.

text: 我先笑了，看到他手里的空袋子才发现不对。原来，同样几个字，在不同的情况下，含义可能完全不同。
pinyin: wǒ xiān xiào le , kàn dào tā shǒu lǐ de kōng dài zi cái fā xiàn bú duì . yuán lái , tóng yàng jǐ gè zì , zài bù tóng de qíng kuàng xià , hán yì kě néng wán quán bù tóng .
meaning: I smiled at first, then noticed the empty bag in his hand and realised something was wrong. The same few words can mean quite different things in different situations.

text: 他没有发火，只问我究竟把票放在哪里。我承认自己出门前没检查，马上打车回去拿。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu fā huǒ , zhǐ wèn wǒ jiū jìng bǎ piào fàng zài nǎ lǐ . wǒ chéng rèn zì jǐ chū mén qián méi jiǎn chá , mǎ shàng dǎ chē huí qù ná .
meaning: He didn’t lose his temper, just asked where exactly I’d put the tickets. I admitted I hadn’t checked before leaving and immediately took a taxi home to collect them.

text: 回来以后，我想解释自己为什么会忘，朋友却先递给我一瓶水，说：“先喝口水，我们还有时间。”
pinyin: huí lái yǐ hòu , wǒ xiǎng jiě shì zì jǐ wèi shén me huì wàng , péng you què xiān dì gěi wǒ yī píng shuǐ , shuō : xiān hē kǒu shuǐ , wǒ men hái yǒu shí jiān .
meaning: When I got back, I wanted to explain why I’d forgotten, but my friend handed me some water first and said, “Have a drink first. We still have time.”

text: 这次我没有急着猜他是不是生气。我先道歉，再问他刚才那句话是不是在开玩笑。他笑着说，一半是玩笑，一半是真的着急。
pinyin: zhè cì wǒ méi yǒu jí zhe cāi tā shì bú shì shēng qì . wǒ xiān dào qiàn , zài wèn tā gāng cái nà jù huà shì bú shì zài kāi wán xiào . tā xiào zhe shuō , yí bàn shì wán xiào , yí bàn shì zhēn de zháo jí .
meaning: This time I didn’t rush to guess whether he was angry. I apologised first, then asked whether his earlier remark was a joke. He laughed and said it was half a joke and half genuine worry.

text: 对于不太了解的表达，我现在会看前后的事情，也会直接问。不明白未必是自己的中文太差，有时连熟悉的人也会听错。
pinyin: duì yú bù tài liǎo jiě de biǎo dá , wǒ xiàn zài huì kàn qián hòu de shì qíng , yě huì zhí jiē wèn . bù míng bái wèi bì shì zì jǐ de zhōng wén tài chà , yǒu shí lián shú xī de rén yě huì tīng cuò .
meaning: When I don’t understand an expression well, I now look at the surrounding events and ask directly. Not understanding doesn’t necessarily mean my Chinese is poor; even people who know each other can mishear things.

回来以后，我想解释自己为什么会忘，朋友却先递给我一瓶水，说：“先喝口水，我们还有时间。”
这次我没有急着猜他是不是生气。我先道歉，再问他刚才那句话是不是在开玩笑。他笑着说，一半是玩笑，一半是真的着急。
对于不太了解的表达，我现在会看前后的事情，也会直接问。不明白未必是自己的中文太差，有时连熟悉的人也会听错。

text: 你可真行，票呢？

meaning: You’re really something. Where are the tickets?

text: 在……等一下，我包里怎么没有？
pinyin: zài děng yī xià , wǒ bāo lǐ zěn me méi yǒu ?
meaning: In… hang on, why aren’t they in my bag?

text: 你别告诉我，它们还在桌上。
pinyin: nǐ bié gào sù wǒ , tā men hái zài zhuō shàng .
meaning: Don’t tell me they’re still on the table.

text: 我承认，应该还在桌上。你等我一下。
pinyin: wǒ chéng rèn , yīng gāi hái zài zhuō shàng . nǐ děng wǒ yī xià .
meaning: I admit they’re probably still on the table. Wait a moment.

text: 先别跑，车还有半小时才开。我们一起想想办法。

meaning: Don’t run off yet. The train doesn’t leave for another half hour. Let’s work out what to do.

text: 你不生气？
pinyin: nǐ bù shēng qì ?

text: 生气也不能把票变出来啊。你先打电话问问家里有人没有。
pinyin: shēng qì yě bù néng bǎ piào biàn chū lái a . nǐ xiān dǎ diàn huà wèn wèn jiā lǐ yǒu rén méi yǒu .

meaning: He wasn’t used to being praised and immediately blushed.

text: 她不在乎输赢，只想跟朋友一起玩。

meaning: She doesn’t care about winning or losing; she just wants to play with friends.

meaning: You broke the cup? It’s all right. Are you hurt?

text: 我问问。不管下不下雨，时间都不变，对吧？

text: 吃的东西谁准备？上次你一个人做太多了。

meaning: Who’s getting the food ready? Last time you did too much on your own.

text: 这次每个人带一道菜。我带面包，你替我买点水果行吗？

对。今天晚上尽快告诉我，我好发消息给大家。
吃的东西谁准备？上次你一个人做太多了。
这次每个人带一道菜。我带面包，你替我买点水果行吗？
行。买完把钱告诉你，我们四个人一起分。
好。费用包括水果和饮料，自己做的菜就别算了。
那我买完再来帮你布置，别又一个人忙。
知道了。这次我只负责带面包，以及提醒你别迟到。

text: 星期六的天气比预报的还差。三点半，我看见窗外下着大雨，赶紧问群里是不是要取消。
pinyin: xīng qī liù de tiān qì bǐ yù bào de hái chà . sān diǎn bàn , wǒ kàn jiàn chuāng wài xià zhe dà yǔ , gǎn jǐn wèn qún lǐ shì bú shì yào qǔ xiāo .
meaning: Saturday’s weather was even worse than forecast. At half past three I saw heavy rain outside and quickly asked the group whether we should cancel.

text: 林安回复说：“不用取消，我们改在活动室见，还是四点。门口有一把伞，谁先到谁先用。”
pinyin: lín ān huí fù shuō : bù yòng qǔ xiāo , wǒ men gǎi zài huó dòng shì jiàn , hái shi sì diǎn . mén kǒu yǒu yī bǎ sǎn , shéi xiān dào shéi xiān yòng .
meaning: Lin An replied, “No need to cancel. We’re meeting in the activity room instead, still at four. There’s an umbrella at the door; whoever arrives first can use it.”

text: 我到的时候，陈宇已经把桌子布置好了。桌上除了水果和饮料，还有每个人自己做的菜。
pinyin: wǒ dào de shí hou , chén yǔ yǐ jīng bǎ zhuō zi bù zhì hǎo le . zhuō shàng chú le shuǐ guǒ hé yǐn liào , hái yǒu měi gè rén zì jǐ zuò de cài .
meaning: When I arrived, Chen Yu had already set the table. Besides fruit and drinks, it held dishes each person had made.

text: 大家先吃东西，后来把桌子搬到一边，一起玩游戏。四个人当中，只有我不懂规则，他们就先玩了一轮给我看。
pinyin: dà jiā xiān chī dōng xi , hòu lái bǎ zhuō zi bān dào yī biān , yì qǐ wán yóu xì . sì gè rén dāng zhōng , zhǐ yǒu wǒ bù dǒng guī zé , tā men jiù xiān wán le yī lún gěi wǒ kàn .
meaning: We ate first, then moved the table aside and played a game together. I was the only one of the four who didn’t know the rules, so they played a round to show me.

text: 水果和饮料一共花了一百四十块。我们按四个人分，每人三十五块。陈宇说钱不用急着转，回家以后有空再转就行。
pinyin: shuǐ guǒ hé yǐn liào yī gòng huā le yī bǎi sì shí kuài . wǒ men àn sì gè rén fēn , měi rén sān shí wǔ kuài . chén yǔ shuō qián bù yòng jí zhe zhuǎn , huí jiā yǐ hòu yǒu kōng zài zhuǎn jiù xíng .
meaning: The fruit and drinks cost 140 yuan altogether. Divided among four people, that was 35 each. Chen Yu said there was no rush to transfer it; we could do it after getting home.

text: 后来，一个朋友临时要回去照顾孩子，先走了。我们没把她留下，也没因为少了一个人就提前结束。
pinyin: hòu lái , yī gè péng you lín shí yào huí qù zhào gù hái zi , xiān zǒu le . wǒ men méi bǎ tā liú xià , yě méi yīn wèi shǎo le yī gè rén jiù tí qián jié shù .
meaning: Later, something came up and one friend had to go home to look after her child. We didn’t make her stay or end early just because one person had left.

text: 那天没有去成公园，但我没有失望。大家根据天气换了地方，也把准备工作分开承担了，谁都没忙得吃不上饭。
pinyin: nà tiān méi yǒu qù chéng gōng yuán , dàn wǒ méi yǒu shī wàng . dà jiā gēn jù tiān qì huàn le dì fāng , yě bǎ zhǔn bèi gōng zuò fēn kāi chéng dān le , shéi dōu méi máng de chī bù shàng fàn .
meaning: We didn’t get to the park that day, but I wasn’t disappointed. We changed venue because of the weather and shared the preparation, so nobody was too busy to eat.

text: 你再三说别迟到，自己怎么还没到？
pinyin: nǐ zài sān shuō bié chí dào , zì jǐ zěn me hái méi dào ?
meaning: You kept telling us not to be late. How come you’re not here yet?

text: 我到楼下了，面包太多，电梯还坏了。
pinyin: wǒ dào lóu xià le , miàn bāo tài duō , diàn tī hái huài le .
meaning: I’m downstairs. There’s too much bread, and the lift is broken.

text: 你不是说只带一点吗？
pinyin: nǐ bù shì shuō zhǐ dài yī diǎn ma ?
meaning: Didn’t you say you’d only bring a little?

text: 买的时候饿了，越买越多。
pinyin: mǎi de shí hou è le , yuè mǎi yuè duō .
meaning: I was hungry while shopping and kept buying more.

text: 别爬楼了，我下来替你拿一半。
pinyin: bié pá lóu le , wǒ xià lái tì nǐ ná yí bàn .
meaning: Don’t start climbing. I’ll come down and carry half for you.

text: 那你带把伞，门外雨可大了。
pinyin: nà nǐ dài bǎ sǎn , mén wài yǔ kě dà le .
meaning: Then bring an umbrella. It’s really raining outside the entrance.

text: 好。今天谁都不许说“就一点”。
pinyin: hǎo . jīn tiān shéi dōu bù xǔ shuō jiù yī diǎn .
meaning: Okay. Today nobody’s allowed to say “just a little.”

text: 等你看到面包再说吧，的确不少。
pinyin: děng nǐ kàn dào miàn bāo zài shuō ba , dí què bù shǎo .
meaning: Wait until you see the bread. There really is quite a lot.

text: 他根据大家的意见改了菜单。

meaning: He changed the menu based on everyone’s comments.

text: 既然票都买好了，我们就早点出发。
pinyin: jì rán piào dōu mǎi hǎo le , wǒ men jiù zǎo diǎn chū fā .
meaning: Since the tickets are bought, let’s set off early.

text: 这封邮件写了时间、地点以及需要带的东西。
pinyin: zhè fēng yóu jiàn xiě le shí jiān , dì diǎn yǐ jí xū yào dài de dōng xi .
meaning: This email gives the time, place and what to bring.

text: 先把名字写好，否则容易拿错。
pinyin: xiān bǎ míng zi xiě hǎo , fǒu zé róng yì ná cuò .
meaning: Label the names first or people may take the wrong thing.

text: 我们找了一个临时放行李的地方。
pinyin: wǒ men zhǎo le yī gè lín shí fàng xíng lǐ de dì fāng .
meaning: We found a temporary place for our luggage.

text: 我会尽快把照片发给你。
pinyin: wǒ huì jǐn kuài bǎ zhào piān fā gěi nǐ .
meaning: I’ll send you the photos as soon as I can.

text: 我再三确认了地址，还是走错了门。
pinyin: wǒ zài sān què rèn le dì zhǐ , hái shi zǒu cuò le mén .
meaning: I checked the address repeatedly and still went to the wrong door.

text: 她也想参与讨论，但还没想好怎么说。
pinyin: tā yě xiǎng cān yù tǎo lùn , dàn hái méi xiǎng hǎo zěn me shuō .
meaning: She wants to join the discussion too but hasn’t worked out what to say.

text: 他不想一个人承担所有工作。
pinyin: tā bù xiǎng yī gè rén chéng dān suǒ yǒu gōng zuò .
meaning: He doesn’t want to take on all the work alone.

text: 参加的人包括老师和学生。
pinyin: cān jiā de rén bāo kuò lǎo shī hé xué sheng .
meaning: Participants include teachers and students.

text: 无论你选哪一件，我都觉得好看。
pinyin: wú lùn nǐ xuǎn nǎ yī jiàn , wǒ dōu jué de hǎo kàn .
meaning: Whichever one you choose, I think it looks good.

text: 桌子已经布置好了，就差花了。
pinyin: zhuō zi yǐ jīng bù zhì hǎo le , jiù chà huā le .
meaning: The table is arranged; only the flowers are missing.

text: 我不想取消，只想换一个时间。
pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng qǔ xiāo , zhǐ xiǎng huàn yī gè shí jiān .
meaning: I don’t want to cancel, just change the time.

text: 演出推迟到下周六了。
pinyin: yǎn chū tuī chí dào xià zhōu liù le .
meaning: The performance has been postponed to next Saturday.

meaning: Could you collect the tickets for me? She covered a day of work for her colleague. We’ll decide where to go based on the weather. He changed the menu based on everyone’s comments. text: 她说那封信不是给她的，而是给她姐姐的。

text: 这个角色到最后才说出自己的名字。
pinyin: zhè gè jué sè dào zuì hòu cái shuō chū zì jǐ de míng zi .
meaning: This character reveals their name only at the end.

text: 不了解当时的背景，很难懂这句话。
pinyin: bù liǎo jiě dāng shí de bèi jǐng , hěn nán dǒng zhè jù huà .
meaning: Without the background at that time, this remark is hard to understand.

text: 信里描述了他们第一次见面的地方。
pinyin: xìn lǐ miáo shù le tā men dì yī cì jiàn miàn de dì fāng .
meaning: The letter describes where they first met.

text: 他们准备给朋友过生日，暂时要保守秘密。
pinyin: tā men zhǔn bèi gěi péng you guò shēng rì , zàn shí yào bǎo shǒu mì mì .
meaning: They’re preparing a birthday celebration for their friend and need to keep it secret for now.

text: 这段话很难，我甚至听了五遍。
pinyin: zhè duàn huà hěn nán , wǒ shèn zhì tīng le wǔ biàn .
meaning: This passage is so difficult I listened to it five times.

text: 请替我保密，我想给他一个惊喜。
pinyin: qǐng tì wǒ bǎo mì , wǒ xiǎng gěi tā yī gè jīng xǐ .
meaning: Please keep this secret for me; I want to surprise him.

text: 他出色地完成了第一次演出。
pinyin: tā chū sè de wán chéng le dì yī cì yǎn chū .
meaning: He did an excellent job in his first performance.

text: 他带着沉重的心情离开了医院。
pinyin: tā dài zhe chén zhòng de xīn qíng lí kāi le yī yuàn .
meaning: He left the hospital feeling weighed down.

text: 上回你说这家店关了，现在又开了吗？
pinyin: shàng huí nǐ shuō zhè jiā diàn guān le , xiàn zài yòu kāi le ma ?
meaning: Last time you said this shop had closed. Has it reopened?

text: 把最后一段再放一遍吧。
pinyin: bǎ zuì hòu yī duàn zài fàng yī biàn ba .
meaning: Please play the last section again.

text: 我的反应慢了一点，没接上他的玩笑。
pinyin: wǒ de fǎn yìng màn le yī diǎn , méi jiē shàng tā de wán xiào .
meaning: I reacted a little slowly and missed his joke.

text: 她没有表现出不高兴。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu biǎo xiàn chū bù gāo xìng .
meaning: She didn’t show that she was unhappy.

text: 观众最想知道的是信里写了什么。
pinyin: guān zhòng zuì xiǎng zhī dào de shì xìn lǐ xiě le shén me .
meaning: What the audience most wants to know is what the letter says.

text: 标题很短，内容却有好几页。
pinyin: biāo tí hěn duǎn , nèi róng què yǒu hǎo jǐ yè .
meaning: The title is short, but the content runs to several pages.

text: 这个误会到最后才解释清楚。
pinyin: zhè gè wù huì dào zuì hòu cái jiě shì qīng chǔ .
meaning: This misunderstanding is only cleared up at the end.

text: 这个镜头一直对着门口。最后一个镜头里，桌上多了一封信。她在剧里演一个医生的角色。这个角色到最后才说出自己的名字。故事的背景是一座小城市。不了解当时的背景，很难懂这句话。你能描述一下她最后的表情吗？信里描述了他们第一次见面的地方。她把这个秘密告诉了姐姐。他们准备给朋友过生日，暂时要保守秘密。他太忙了，甚至忘了今天是星期几。这段话很难，我甚至听了五遍。这件事先保密，周五再告诉她。请替我保密，我想给他一个惊喜。她在这部电影里的表演很出色。他出色地完成了第一次演出。这个故事的后半段很沉重。他带着沉重的心情离开了医院。这回我终于听懂她为什么笑了。上回你说这家店关了，现在又开了吗？这一段只有两个人说话。把最后一段再放一遍吧。她听到名字以后，反应很奇怪。我的反应慢了一点，没接上他的玩笑。他在比赛中的表现比上次好多了。她没有表现出不高兴。演出结束，观众都站起来鼓掌。观众最想知道的是信里写了什么。这两封信的内容不一样。标题很短，内容却有好几页。她以为信是给自己的，结果闹了个误会。这个误会到最后才解释清楚。
pinyin: zhè gè jìng tóu yì zhí duì zhe mén kǒu . zuì hòu yī gè jìng tóu lǐ , zhuō shàng duō le yī fēng xìn . tā zài jù lǐ yǎn yī gè yī shēng de jué sè . zhè gè jué sè dào zuì hòu cái shuō chū zì jǐ de míng zi . gù shì de bèi jǐng shì yī zuò xiǎo chéng shì . bù liǎo jiě dāng shí de bèi jǐng , hěn nán dǒng zhè jù huà . nǐ néng miáo shù yī xià tā zuì hòu de biǎo qíng ma ? xìn lǐ miáo shù le tā men dì yī cì jiàn miàn de dì fāng . tā bǎ zhè gè mì mì gào sù le jiě jie . tā men zhǔn bèi gěi péng you guò shēng rì , zàn shí yào bǎo shǒu mì mì . tā tài máng le , shèn zhì wàng le jīn tiān shì xīng qī jǐ . zhè duàn huà hěn nán , wǒ shèn zhì tīng le wǔ biàn . zhè jiàn shì xiān bǎo mì , zhōu wǔ zài gào sù tā . qǐng tì wǒ bǎo mì , wǒ xiǎng gěi tā yī gè jīng xǐ . tā zài zhè bù diàn yǐng lǐ de biǎo yǎn hěn chū sè . tā chū sè de wán chéng le dì yī cì yǎn chū . zhè gè gù shì de hòu bàn duàn hěn chén zhòng . tā dài zhe chén zhòng de xīn qíng lí kāi le yī yuàn . zhè huí wǒ zhōng yú tīng dǒng tā wèi shén me xiào le . shàng huí nǐ shuō zhè jiā diàn guān le , xiàn zài yòu kāi le ma ? zhè yī duàn zhǐ yǒu liǎng gè rén shuō huà . bǎ zuì hòu yī duàn zài fàng yī biàn ba . tā tīng dào míng zi yǐ hòu , fǎn yìng hěn qí guài . wǒ de fǎn yìng màn le yī diǎn , méi jiē shàng tā de wán xiào . tā zài bǐ sài zhōng de biǎo xiàn bǐ shàng cì hǎo duō le . tā méi yǒu biǎo xiàn chū bù gāo xìng . yǎn chū jié shù , guān zhòng dōu zhàn qǐ lái gǔ zhǎng . guān zhòng zuì xiǎng zhī dào de shì xìn lǐ xiě le shén me . zhè liǎng fēng xìn de nèi róng bù yī yàng . biāo tí hěn duǎn , nèi róng què yǒu hǎo jǐ yè . tā yǐ wéi xìn shì gěi zì jǐ de , jié guǒ nào le gè wù huì . zhè gè wù huì dào zuì hòu cái jiě shì qīng chǔ .
meaning: This shot keeps the doorway in view. In the final shot, there is an extra letter on the table. She plays a doctor in the drama. This character reveals their name only at the end. The story is set in a small city. Without the background at that time, this remark is hard to understand. Could you describe her final expression? The letter describes where they first met. She told her sister this secret. They’re preparing a birthday celebration for their friend and need to keep it secret for now. He was so busy he even forgot what day it was. This passage is so difficult I listened to it five times. Keep this quiet for now; we’ll tell her on Friday. Please keep this secret for me; I want to surprise him. Her performance in this film is excellent. He did an excellent job in his first performance. The second half of this story is emotionally heavy. He left the hospital feeling weighed down. This time I finally understood why she laughed. Last time you said this shop had closed. Has it reopened? Only two people speak in this section. Please play the last section again. Her reaction after hearing the name was strange. I reacted a little slowly and missed his joke. His performance in the competition was much better than last time. She didn’t show that she was unhappy. At the end of the performance, the audience stood and applauded. What the audience most wants to know is what the letter says. The contents of these two letters differ. The title is short, but the content runs to several pages. She thought the letter was for her, which caused a misunderstanding. This misunderstanding is only cleared up at the end.

text: 这两句你已经重复好多遍了，还没唱顺？

meaning: You’ve repeated those two lines so many times. Still not smooth?

text: 字我都认识，可是一跟音乐就来不及。
pinyin: zì wǒ dōu rèn shi , kě shì yī gēn yīn yuè jiù lái bù jí .
meaning: I know all the words, but I can’t keep up with the music.

text: 先别放音乐。把它当成一句话，读给我听。
pinyin: xiān bié fàng yīn yuè . bǎ tā dàng chéng yī jù huà , dú gěi wǒ tīng .
meaning: Leave the music off for now. Treat it as a sentence and read it to me.

text: “把歌声留在窗边，把明天带回来。”明天怎么带回来？
pinyin: bǎ gē shēng liú zài chuāng biān , bǎ míng tiān dài huí lái . míng tiān zěn me dài huí lái ?
meaning: “Leave the song by the window; bring tomorrow back.” How can you bring tomorrow back?

text: 我觉得是在说想再见到那个人。不是有人真的拿着一个明天。
pinyin: wǒ jué de shì zài shuō xiǎng zài jiàn dào nà gè rén . bù shì yǒu rén zhēn de ná zhe yī gè míng tiān .
meaning: I think it means wanting to see someone again. Nobody’s literally carrying a tomorrow.

text: 所以这句不是在讲一个动作？
pinyin: suǒ yǐ zhè jù bù shì zài jiǎng yī gè dòng zuò ?
meaning: So it isn’t describing an actual action?

text: 有动作的样子，但意思得连着前面的“等你”看。
pinyin: yǒu dòng zuò de yàng zi , dàn yì si děi lián zhe qián miàn de děng nǐ kàn .
meaning: It looks like an action, but you need to read it with the earlier “waiting for you.”

text: 懂了。那我先读清楚，再试着唱，行吗？
pinyin: dǒng le . nà wǒ xiān dú qīng chǔ , zài shì zhe chàng , xíng ma ?
meaning: Got it. I’ll read it clearly first, then try singing. Okay?

text: 行。录一小段就好，别一开始就从头唱到尾。
pinyin: xíng . lù yī xiǎo duàn jiù hǎo , bié yī kāi shǐ jiù cóng tóu chàng dào wěi .
meaning: Sure. Just record a short part. Don’t try the whole thing from the start.

text: 你听的时候不许笑。
pinyin: nǐ tīng de shí hou bù xǔ xiào .
meaning: You’re not allowed to laugh when you listen.

text: 那要看你唱什么了。我只能保证认真听。
pinyin: nà yào kàn nǐ chàng shén me le . wǒ zhǐ néng bǎo zhèng rèn zhēn tīng .
meaning: That depends on what you sing. I can only promise to listen properly.

text: 好吧，认真听也行。先帮我看看这两个字。
pinyin: hǎo ba , rèn zhēn tīng yě xíng . xiān bāng wǒ kàn kàn zhè liǎng gè zì .
meaning: Fine, listening properly will do. Help me check these two characters first.

text: 第一次练这段歌时，我以为只要每个字都认识，就能跟着唱。结果音乐一响，我连第一句都没唱完，后面的字已经来了。
pinyin: dì yī cì liàn zhè duàn gē shí , wǒ yǐ wéi zhǐ yào měi gè zì dōu rèn shi , jiù néng gēn zhe chàng . jié guǒ yīn yuè yī xiǎng , wǒ lián dì yī jù dōu méi chàng wán , hòu miàn de zì yǐ jīng lái le .
meaning: When I first practised this verse, I thought knowing every character would let me sing along. Once the music started, I hadn’t finished the first line before the next words arrived.

text: 我关掉音乐，先读歌词。里面有窗边的灯、雨后的影子，还有一个人在等朋友回来。那些东西不难理解，可是最后两句不能只按字面看。
pinyin: wǒ guān diào yīn yuè , xiān dú gē cí . lǐ miàn yǒu chuāng biān de dēng , yǔ hòu de yǐng zi , hái yǒu yī gè rén zài děng péng you huí lái . nà xiē dōng xi bù nán lǐ jiě , kě shì zuì hòu liǎng jù bù néng zhǐ àn zì miàn kàn .
meaning: I switched off the music and read the words. There was a light by a window, a shadow after rain and someone waiting for a friend. Those details were clear, but the last two lines needed more than a literal reading.

text: 朋友问我：“前面谁在等谁？”我才发现自己一直注意快不快，没有想过这段到底在说什么。
pinyin: péng you wèn wǒ : qián miàn shéi zài děng shéi ? wǒ cái fā xiàn zì jǐ yì zhí zhù yì kuài bù kuài , méi yǒu xiǎng guò zhè duàn dào dǐ zài shuō shén me .
meaning: My friend asked, “Who is waiting for whom earlier?” I realised I’d only been thinking about speed, not what the verse was saying.

text: 我们把八句分成四小段。我先读一句，讲清意思，再跟着音乐试一次。遇到连在一起的几个字，就单独重复，而不是每次都从头开始。
pinyin: wǒ men bǎ bā jù fēn chéng sì xiǎo duàn . wǒ xiān dú yī jù , jiǎng qīng yì si , zài gēn zhe yīn yuè shì yī cì . yù dào lián zài yì qǐ de jǐ gè zì , jiù dān dú chóng fù , ér bù shì měi cì dōu cóng tóu kāi shǐ .
meaning: We divided the eight lines into four short sections. I read a line, explained its meaning and then tried it with the music. I practised difficult clusters separately instead of restarting each time.

text: 后来我录了两次。第一次声音太小，第二次字清楚了，速度却还是有点慢。朋友没有说我已经唱好了，只指出我这次没有漏掉“等你”。
pinyin: hòu lái wǒ lù le liǎng cì . dì yī cì shēng yīn tài xiǎo , dì èr cì zì qīng chǔ le , sù dù què hái shi yǒu diǎn màn . péng you méi yǒu shuō wǒ yǐ jīng chàng hǎo le , zhǐ zhǐ chū wǒ zhè cì méi yǒu lòu diào děng nǐ .
meaning: Later I made two recordings. The first was too quiet; in the second the words were clear but still a little slow. My friend didn’t say I’d mastered it, just that I hadn’t missed “waiting for you” this time.

text: 现在我仍然会错，不过知道下一次要练哪一小段了。先懂意思再练速度，比把不懂的声音唱得很快更有用。
pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ réng rán huì cuò , bù guò zhī dào xià yī cì yào liàn nǎ yī xiǎo duàn le . xiān dǒng yì si zài liàn sù dù , bǐ bǎ bù dǒng de shēng yīn chàng de hěn kuài gèng yǒu yòng .
meaning: I still make mistakes, but I know which short section to practise next. Understanding first and then practising speed is more useful than singing unclear sounds quickly.

text: 第一次练这段歌时，我以为只要每个字都认识，就能跟着唱。结果音乐一响，我连第一句都没唱完，后面的字已经来了。我关掉音乐，先读歌词。里面有窗边的灯、雨后的影子，还有一个人在等朋友回来。那些东西不难理解，可是最后两句不能只按字面看。朋友问我：“前面谁在等谁？”我才发现自己一直注意快不快，没有想过这段到底在说什么。我们把八句分成四小段。我先读一句，讲清意思，再跟着音乐试一次。遇到连在一起的几个字，就单独重复，而不是每次都从头开始。后来我录了两次。第一次声音太小，第二次字清楚了，速度却还是有点慢。朋友没有说我已经唱好了，只指出我这次没有漏掉“等你”。现在我仍然会错，不过知道下一次要练哪一小段了。先懂意思再练速度，比把不懂的声音唱得很快更有用。
pinyin: dì yī cì liàn zhè duàn gē shí , wǒ yǐ wéi zhǐ yào měi gè zì dōu rèn shi , jiù néng gēn zhe chàng . jié guǒ yīn yuè yī xiǎng , wǒ lián dì yī jù dōu méi chàng wán , hòu miàn de zì yǐ jīng lái le . wǒ guān diào yīn yuè , xiān dú gē cí . lǐ miàn yǒu chuāng biān de dēng , yǔ hòu de yǐng zi , hái yǒu yī gè rén zài děng péng you huí lái . nà xiē dōng xi bù nán lǐ jiě , kě shì zuì hòu liǎng jù bù néng zhǐ àn zì miàn kàn . péng you wèn wǒ : qián miàn shéi zài děng shéi ? wǒ cái fā xiàn zì jǐ yì zhí zhù yì kuài bù kuài , méi yǒu xiǎng guò zhè duàn dào dǐ zài shuō shén me . wǒ men bǎ bā jù fēn chéng sì xiǎo duàn . wǒ xiān dú yī jù , jiǎng qīng yì si , zài gēn zhe yīn yuè shì yī cì . yù dào lián zài yì qǐ de jǐ gè zì , jiù dān dú chóng fù , ér bù shì měi cì dōu cóng tóu kāi shǐ . hòu lái wǒ lù le liǎng cì . dì yī cì shēng yīn tài xiǎo , dì èr cì zì qīng chǔ le , sù dù què hái shi yǒu diǎn màn . péng you méi yǒu shuō wǒ yǐ jīng chàng hǎo le , zhǐ zhǐ chū wǒ zhè cì méi yǒu lòu diào děng nǐ . xiàn zài wǒ réng rán huì cuò , bù guò zhī dào xià yī cì yào liàn nǎ yī xiǎo duàn le . xiān dǒng yì si zài liàn sù dù , bǐ bǎ bù dǒng de shēng yīn chàng de hěn kuài gèng yǒu yòng .
meaning: When I first practised this verse, I thought knowing every character would let me sing along. Once the music started, I hadn’t finished the first line before the next words arrived. I switched off the music and read the words. There was a light by a window, a shadow after rain and someone waiting for a friend. Those details were clear, but the last two lines needed more than a literal reading. My friend asked, “Who is waiting for whom earlier?” I realised I’d only been thinking about speed, not what the verse was saying. We divided the eight lines into four short sections. I read a line, explained its meaning and then tried it with the music. I practised difficult clusters separately instead of restarting each time. Later I made two recordings. The first was too quiet; in the second the words were clear but still a little slow. My friend didn’t say I’d mastered it, just that I hadn’t missed “waiting for you” this time. I still make mistakes, but I know which short section to practise next. Understanding first and then practising speed is more useful than singing unclear sounds quickly.

text: 把明天带回来。

text: 我不想每天重复同样的错误。

text: 这个方法的效果要过几天才能看出来。

text: 你不是想报名吗？怎么还在看课程介绍？

text: 一个班练口语，一个班读文章。我两个都想选。
pinyin: yī gè bān liàn kǒu yǔ , yī gè bān dú wén zhāng . wǒ liǎng gè dōu xiǎng xuǎn .
meaning: One class practises speaking; the other reads articles. I want both.

text: 时间不一样？
pinyin: shí jiān bù yī yàng ?

text: 都在周三晚上。选阅读的话，周末还能参加免费的口语活动。

text: 那听起来挺适合你。你不是说平时没机会读长一点的东西？

meaning: Right, but enrolment requires a foundation course. I don’t know whether my earlier class counts.

text: 先问老师，别自己猜。申请什么时候结束？

text: 行。不过先说好，你不能只在旁边点头。
pinyin: xíng . bù guò xiān shuō hǎo , nǐ bù néng zhǐ zài páng biān diǎn tóu .
meaning: Sure. But let’s be clear: you can’t just stand there nodding.

text: 你不是想报名吗？怎么还在看课程介绍？一个班练口语，一个班读文章。我两个都想选。时间不一样？都在周三晚上。选阅读的话，周末还能参加免费的口语活动。那听起来挺适合你。你不是说平时没机会读长一点的东西？对。不过报名条件写着要先完成基础课程，我不知道以前的课算不算。先问老师，别自己猜。申请什么时候结束？周五前要交齐材料。今天才周一，还有时间。费用呢？别看见免费活动就忘了课程的钱。一千二，包括课本。我已经问清楚了。不错，这次准备得比我充分。选好了周末叫我一起去。行。不过先说好，你不能只在旁边点头。
pinyin: nǐ bù shì xiǎng bào míng ma ? zěn me hái zài kàn kè chéng jiè shào ? yī gè bān liàn kǒu yǔ , yī gè bān dú wén zhāng . wǒ liǎng gè dōu xiǎng xuǎn . shí jiān bù yī yàng ? dōu zài zhōu sān wǎn shang . xuǎn yuè dú de huà , zhōu mò hái néng cān jiā miǎn fèi de kǒu yǔ huó dòng . nà tīng qǐ lái tǐng shì hé nǐ . nǐ bù shì shuō píng shí méi jī huì dú zhǎng yī diǎn de dōng xi ? duì . bù guò bào míng tiáo jiàn xiě zhe yào xiān wán chéng jī chǔ kè chéng , wǒ bù zhī dào yǐ qián de kè suàn bù suàn . xiān wèn lǎo shī , bié zì jǐ cāi . shēn qǐng shén me shí hou jié shù ? zhōu wǔ qián yào jiāo qí cái liào . jīn tiān cái zhōu yī , hái yǒu shí jiān . fèi yòng ne ? bié kàn jiàn miǎn fèi huó dòng jiù wàng le kè chéng de qián . yī qiān èr , bāo kuò kè běn . wǒ yǐ jīng wèn qīng chǔ le . bù cuò , zhè cì zhǔn bèi de bǐ wǒ chōng fèn . xuǎn hǎo le zhōu mò jiào wǒ yì qǐ qù . xíng . bù guò xiān shuō hǎo , nǐ bù néng zhǐ zài páng biān diǎn tóu .
meaning: Weren’t you going to enrol? Why are you still reading the descriptions? One class practises speaking; the other reads articles. I want both. Are they at different times? They’re both on Wednesday evenings. If I choose reading, I can join a free speaking activity at the weekend. That sounds like a good fit. Didn’t you say you rarely get to read anything longer? Right, but enrolment requires a foundation course. I don’t know whether my earlier class counts. Ask the teacher first rather than guessing. When do applications close? All documents have to be in before Friday. It’s only Monday today, so there’s time. What about the fee? Don’t forget the course costs just because the activity’s free. Twelve hundred, including the textbook. I’ve already checked. Good, you’re better prepared than I am this time. Once you’ve chosen, invite me along at the weekend. Sure. But let’s be clear: you can’t just stand there nodding.

pinyin: wǒ yǐ qián xuǎn kè chéng , zǒng shì xiān kàn shí jiān hé jià gé . zhǐ yào yǒu kōng , fèi yòng bù gāo , jiù jué de kě yǐ shì shì . shàng le jǐ cì yǐ hòu , cái fā xiàn yǒu xiē kè bìng bù shì hé zì jǐ de mù dì .
meaning: I used to choose courses mainly by time and price. If I was free and the fee wasn’t high, I’d try one. After a few classes, I sometimes found it didn’t fit my goals.

text: 这次我先写了两件想做的事：读懂朋友推荐的短文章，和新认识的人聊得久一点。考试当然也重要，但我不想只会选答案。
pinyin: zhè cì wǒ xiān xiě le liǎng jiàn xiǎng zuò de shì : dú dǒng péng you tuī jiàn de duǎn wén zhāng , hé xīn rèn shi de rén liáo de jiǔ yī diǎn . kǎo shì dāng rán yě zhòng yào , dàn wǒ bù xiǎng zhǐ huì xuǎn dá àn .
meaning: This time I wrote down two things I wanted to do: understand short articles friends recommended and talk longer with people I’d just met. Exams mattered too, but I wanted more than choosing answers.

text: 我参考了课程介绍，也给老师写了邮件。老师说，阅读班每周读一篇文章，再讨论不同的看法；周末的口语活动没有作业，不过参加的人水平不完全一样。
pinyin: wǒ cān kǎo le kè chéng jiè shào , yě gěi lǎo shī xiě le yóu jiàn . lǎo shī shuō , yuè dú bān měi zhōu dú yī piān wén zhāng , zài tǎo lùn bù tóng de kàn fǎ ; zhōu mò de kǒu yǔ huó dòng méi yǒu zuò yè , bù guò cān jiā de rén shuǐ píng bù wán quán yī yàng .
meaning: I consulted the descriptions and emailed the teacher. The reading class uses one article a week with discussion of different views. The weekend speaking activity has no homework, but participants have different levels.

text: 老师看过我以前的学习材料以后，说我可以报名阅读班。她还提醒我，申请不是交一张表就结束，周五前要交齐两份材料。
pinyin: lǎo shī kàn guò wǒ yǐ qián de xué xí cái liào yǐ hòu , shuō wǒ kě yǐ bào míng yuè dú bān . tā hái tí xǐng wǒ , shēn qǐng bù shì jiāo yī zhāng biǎo jiù jié shù , zhōu wǔ qián yào jiāo qí liǎng fèn cái liào .
meaning: After looking at my previous study material, the teacher said I could enrol in reading. She reminded me that applying meant more than submitting a form: both documents were due before Friday.

text: 我没有同时报第二门课。每周读完一篇文章、准备讨论，再加一次口语活动，已经需要不少时间。先把这个安排坚持四周，再决定要不要增加。
pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu tóng shí bào dì èr mén kè . měi zhōu dú wán yī piān wén zhāng , zhǔn bèi tǎo lùn , zài jiā yī cì kǒu yǔ huó dòng , yǐ jīng xū yào bù shǎo shí jiān . xiān bǎ zhè gè ān pái jiān chí sì zhōu , zài jué dìng yào bù yào zēng jiā .
meaning: I didn’t enrol in a second course as well. Reading an article, preparing for discussion and joining one speaking activity each week already took time. I’d keep that routine for four weeks before deciding whether to add more.

text: 报名成功那天，朋友问我能不能马上看懂整部电影。我说还不能，不过下周见到新同学，至少知道该从什么话题开始了。
pinyin: bào míng chéng gōng nà tiān , péng you wèn wǒ néng bù néng mǎ shàng kàn dǒng zhěng bù diàn yǐng . wǒ shuō hái bù néng , bù guò xià zhōu jiàn dào xīn tóng xué , zhì shǎo zhī dào gāi cóng shén me huà tí kāi shǐ le .
meaning: When my enrolment was confirmed, a friend asked whether I could immediately understand a whole film. I said no, but at least I’d know how to start talking to my new classmates next week.

text: 你把表交了？
pinyin: nǐ bǎ biǎo jiāo le ?
meaning: Did you submit the form?

text: 交了，课本也拿到了。老师说下周带一篇自己喜欢的短文章。
pinyin: jiāo le , kè běn yě ná dào le . lǎo shī shuō xià zhōu dài yī piān zì jǐ xǐ huān de duǎn wén zhāng .
meaning: Yes, and I’ve got the textbook. The teacher asked us to bring a short article we like next week.

text: 你打算带什么？
pinyin: nǐ dǎ suàn dài shén me ?
meaning: What will you bring?

text: 还没决定。你上次发我的那篇挺有意思。
pinyin: hái méi jué dìng . nǐ shàng cì fā wǒ de nà piān tǐng yǒu yì si .
meaning: I haven’t decided. That one you sent me was interesting.

text: 那篇太长了，你不是说带短文章吗？
pinyin: nà piān tài zhǎng le , nǐ bù shì shuō dài duǎn wén zhāng ma ?
meaning: That one’s too long. Didn’t you say a short article?

text: 所以我想问问你，有没有同一个作者写的短一点的。
pinyin: suǒ yǐ wǒ xiǎng wèn wèn nǐ , yǒu méi yǒu tóng yī gè zuò zhě xiě de duǎn yī diǎn de .
meaning: That’s why I wanted to ask whether the same writer has anything shorter.

text: 有，我找给你。你可别把我的回复也当文章交了。
pinyin: yǒu , wǒ zhǎo gěi nǐ . nǐ kě bié bǎ wǒ de huí fù yě dāng wén zhāng jiāo le .
meaning: Yes, I’ll find one. Just don’t submit my reply as the article.

text: 那得看你回复多长。
pinyin: nà děi kàn nǐ huí fù duō zhǎng .
meaning: That depends on how long your reply is.

text: 课程结束以后，我们还会一起练习。
pinyin: kè chéng jié shù yǐ hòu , wǒ men hái huì yì qǐ liàn xí .
meaning: We’ll keep practising together after the course ends.

text: 这只是参考价格，实际费用还没定。
pinyin: zhè zhǐ shì cān kǎo jià gé , shí jì fèi yòng hái méi dìng .
meaning: This is only an indicative price; the actual fee isn’t fixed yet.

text: 这次有三种选择，不用马上决定。
pinyin: zhè cì yǒu sān zhǒng xuǎn zé , bù yòng mǎ shàng jué dìng .
meaning: There are three options this time; you don’t need to decide immediately.

text: 申请通过以后，学校会发邮件通知你。
pinyin: shēn qǐng tōng guò yǐ hòu , xué xiào huì fā yóu jiàn tōng zhī nǐ .
meaning: The school will email you after your application is approved.

text: 本科毕业以后，他先工作了两年。
pinyin: běn kē bì yè yǐ hòu , tā xiān gōng zuò le liǎng nián .
meaning: He worked for two years after completing his undergraduate degree.

text: 毕业前，我们想再一起去一次海边。
pinyin: bì yè qián , wǒ men xiǎng zài yì qǐ qù yī cì hǎi biān .
meaning: Before graduation, we’d like one more trip to the sea together.

text: 准备充分以后，我说话没那么紧张了。
pinyin: zhǔn bèi chōng fèn yǐ hòu , wǒ shuō huà méi nà me jǐn zhāng le .
meaning: After preparing thoroughly, I felt less nervous speaking.

text: 这些材料太重，一次拿不完。
pinyin: zhè xiē cái liào tài zhòng , yī cì ná bù wán .
meaning: These materials are too heavy to carry in one trip.

text: 这里条件不错，但离家有点远。
pinyin: zhè lǐ tiáo jiàn bù cuò , dàn lí jiā yǒu diǎn yuǎn .
meaning: The facilities here are good, but it’s a little far from home.

text: 这本书让我对历史产生了兴趣。
pinyin: zhè běn shū ràng wǒ duì lì shǐ chǎn shēng le xìng qù .
meaning: This book sparked my interest in history.

text: 这次见面的目的不是讨论钱。
pinyin: zhè cì jiàn miàn de mù dì bù shì tǎo lùn qián .
meaning: The purpose of this meeting isn’t to discuss money.

text: 这家店的服务水平一直不错。
pinyin: zhè jiā diàn de fú wù shuǐ píng yì zhí bù cuò .
meaning: This shop’s service has consistently been good.

text: 老师已经安排了两次讨论。
pinyin: lǎo shī yǐ jīng ān pái le liǎng cì tǎo lùn .
meaning: The teacher has arranged two discussions.

text: 交通费用由我们三个人分。
pinyin: jiāo tōng fèi yòng yóu wǒ men sān gè rén fēn .
meaning: The three of us will split the transport costs.

text: 这双鞋不适合走很远的路。
pinyin: zhè shuāng xié bù shì hé zǒu hěn yuǎn de lù .
meaning: These shoes aren’t suitable for long walks.

text: 我们决定周六在车站见。

text: 这门课程每周上两次。课程结束以后，我们还会一起练习。你可以参考去年的课程表。这只是参考价格，实际费用还没定。你为什么选择晚上的班？这次有三种选择，不用马上决定。我准备申请下个月的课程。申请通过以后，学校会发邮件通知你。她本科读的是中文。本科毕业以后，他先工作了两年。我姐姐去年毕业了。毕业前，我们想再一起去一次海边。我还没充分了解这门课，想先问问。准备充分以后，我说话没那么紧张了。申请材料要在周五前交齐。这些材料太重，一次拿不完。报名条件是什么？这里条件不错，但离家有点远。我对电影里的日常对话很有兴趣。这本书让我对历史产生了兴趣。你来上课的目的是什么？这次见面的目的不是讨论钱。我的阅读水平比听力好一点。这家店的服务水平一直不错。我想先安排好周末的时间。老师已经安排了两次讨论。这个费用包括材料吗？交通费用由我们三个人分。这门课适合已经学过基础的人。这双鞋不适合走很远的路。我想看完介绍再决定。我们决定周六在车站见。
pinyin: zhè mén kè chéng měi zhōu shàng liǎng cì . kè chéng jié shù yǐ hòu , wǒ men hái huì yì qǐ liàn xí . nǐ kě yǐ cān kǎo qù nián de kè chéng biǎo . zhè zhǐ shì cān kǎo jià gé , shí jì fèi yòng hái méi dìng . nǐ wèi shén me xuǎn zé wǎn shang de bān ? zhè cì yǒu sān zhǒng xuǎn zé , bù yòng mǎ shàng jué dìng . wǒ zhǔn bèi shēn qǐng xià gè yuè de kè chéng . shēn qǐng tōng guò yǐ hòu , xué xiào huì fā yóu jiàn tōng zhī nǐ . tā běn kē dú de shì zhōng wén . běn kē bì yè yǐ hòu , tā xiān gōng zuò le liǎng nián . wǒ jiě jie qù nián bì yè le . bì yè qián , wǒ men xiǎng zài yì qǐ qù yī cì hǎi biān . wǒ hái méi chōng fèn liǎo jiě zhè mén kè , xiǎng xiān wèn wèn . zhǔn bèi chōng fèn yǐ hòu , wǒ shuō huà méi nà me jǐn zhāng le . shēn qǐng cái liào yào zài zhōu wǔ qián jiāo qí . zhè xiē cái liào tài zhòng , yī cì ná bù wán . bào míng tiáo jiàn shì shén me ? zhè lǐ tiáo jiàn bù cuò , dàn lí jiā yǒu diǎn yuǎn . wǒ duì diàn yǐng lǐ de rì cháng duì huà hěn yǒu xìng qù . zhè běn shū ràng wǒ duì lì shǐ chǎn shēng le xìng qù . nǐ lái shàng kè de mù dì shì shén me ? zhè cì jiàn miàn de mù dì bù shì tǎo lùn qián . wǒ de yuè dú shuǐ píng bǐ tīng lì hǎo yī diǎn . zhè jiā diàn de fú wù shuǐ píng yì zhí bù cuò . wǒ xiǎng xiān ān pái hǎo zhōu mò de shí jiān . lǎo shī yǐ jīng ān pái le liǎng cì tǎo lùn . zhè gè fèi yòng bāo kuò cái liào ma ? jiāo tōng fèi yòng yóu wǒ men sān gè rén fēn . zhè mén kè shì hé yǐ jīng xué guò jī chǔ de rén . zhè shuāng xié bù shì hé zǒu hěn yuǎn de lù . wǒ xiǎng kàn wán jiè shào zài jué dìng . wǒ men jué dìng zhōu liù zài chē zhàn jiàn .

text: 你那边做好了吗？我把手机带来了。
pinyin: nǐ nà biān zuò hǎo le ma ? wǒ bǎ shǒu jī dài lái le .
meaning: Have you finished your part? I’ve brought the phone.

text: 差不多了。不过这个架子一放手机就往后倒。
pinyin: chà bu duō le . bù guò zhè gè jià zi yī fàng shǒu jī jiù wǎng hòu dào .
meaning: Almost, but the stand falls backwards as soon as I put the phone on it.

text: 我看看。你是不是只测量了手机的宽度？
pinyin: wǒ kàn kàn . nǐ shì bú shì zhǐ cè liáng le shǒu jī de kuān dù ?
meaning: Let me see. Did you measure only the width of the phone?

text: 对。尺寸放得下，我就以为没问题了。
pinyin: duì . chǐ cùn fàng de xià , wǒ jiù yǐ wéi méi wèn tí le .
meaning: Yes. It fit, so I thought it was fine.

text: 放得下是一回事，站不站得住是另一回事。先别改外面的样子。
pinyin: fàng de xià shì yī huí shì , zhàn bù zhàn de zhù shì lìng yī huí shì . xiān bié gǎi wài miàn de yàng zi .
meaning: Fitting is one thing; staying upright is another. Don’t change the appearance yet.

text: 那你帮我拿一下，我把后面这一块加宽。
pinyin: nà nǐ bāng wǒ ná yī xià , wǒ bǎ hòu miàn zhè yī kuài jiā kuān .
meaning: Then hold it for me while I widen this piece at the back.

text: 好。材料够吗？
pinyin: hǎo . cái liào gòu ma ?
meaning: Okay. Do we have enough material?

text: 还有一张厚的，够做两个。我们可以先试一个。
pinyin: hái yǒu yī zhāng hòu de , gòu zuò liǎng gè . wǒ men kě yǐ xiān shì yī gè .
meaning: There’s one thick sheet left, enough for two. We can try one first.

text: 做完再放手机，看看能不能站住。两次测试的数据都留下。
pinyin: zuò wán zài fàng shǒu jī , kàn kàn néng bù néng zhàn zhù . liǎng cì cè shì de shù jù dōu liú xià .
meaning: Put the phone on it after finishing and see whether it stays upright. Keep the data from both tests.

text: 你负责记录，我负责做？
pinyin: nǐ fù zé jì lù , wǒ fù zé zuò ?
meaning: You’ll record it and I’ll make it?

text: 对。要是第二个也不行，我们就换个方案。
pinyin: duì . yào shì dì èr gè yě bù xíng , wǒ men jiù huàn gè fāng àn .
meaning: Right. If the second one doesn’t work either, we’ll try a different plan.

text: 行。我先把这个扶住，别让你的手机也跟着倒。
pinyin: xíng . wǒ xiān bǎ zhè gè fú zhù , bié ràng nǐ de shǒu jī yě gēn zhe dào .
meaning: Okay. I’ll hold this one steady first so your phone doesn’t fall with it.

text: 小组要做一个放在桌上的手机架。我负责做，陈宇负责测试和记录。我们一开始只讨论了颜色和外形，觉得好看就够了。
pinyin: xiǎo zǔ yào zuò yī gè fàng zài zhuō shàng de shǒu jī jià . wǒ fù zé zuò , chén yǔ fù zé cè shì hé jì lù . wǒ men yī kāi shǐ zhǐ tǎo lùn le yán sè hé wài xíng , jué de hǎo kàn jiù gòu le .
meaning: Our group was making a desktop phone stand. I made it, and Chen Yu tested it and recorded results. At first we discussed only colour and shape, thinking appearance was enough.

text: 第一次做完以后，手机放得进去，架子却站不住。我把尺寸写在纸上：前面宽十二厘米，后面只有六厘米。陈宇让我先保留这个设计，再做一个后面更宽的。
pinyin: dì yī cì zuò wán yǐ hòu , shǒu jī fàng de jìn qù , jià zi què zhàn bù zhù . wǒ bǎ chǐ cùn xiě zài zhǐ shàng : qián miàn kuān shí èr lí mǐ , hòu miàn zhǐ yǒu liù lí mǐ . chén yǔ ràng wǒ xiān bǎo liú zhè gè shè jì , zài zuò yī gè hòu miàn gèng kuān de .
meaning: The phone fit in the first version, but the stand wouldn’t stay upright. I wrote down the measurements: twelve centimetres wide in front, just six at the back. Chen Yu asked me to keep that version and make another with a wider back.

text: 我们没有同时换材料和尺寸。第二个仍然用同一种厚纸，只把后面的宽度改成十厘米。这样再测试时，比较的条件会少一点。
pinyin: wǒ men méi yǒu tóng shí huàn cái liào hé chǐ cùn . dì èr gè réng rán yòng tóng yī zhǒng hòu zhǐ , zhǐ bǎ hòu miàn de kuān dù gǎi chéng shí lí mǐ . zhè yàng zài cè shì shí , bǐ jiào de tiáo jiàn huì shǎo yī diǎn .
meaning: We didn’t change both material and size at once. The second used the same thick paper, with just the back widened to ten centimetres. That reduced the changes being compared in the next test.

text: 第二个放上这部手机以后能站住了。不过我换了一部更重的手机，它又倒了。陈宇把两次的情况写下来，没有把“这部能用”写成“所有手机都能用”。
pinyin: dì èr gè fàng shàng zhè bù shǒu jī yǐ hòu néng zhàn zhù le . bù guò wǒ huàn le yī bù gèng zhòng de shǒu jī , tā yòu dào le . chén yǔ bǎ liǎng cì de qíng kuàng xiě xià lái , méi yǒu bǎ zhè bù néng yòng xiě chéng suǒ yǒu shǒu jī dōu néng yòng .
meaning: The second stood upright with this phone. But when I tried a heavier phone, it fell again. Chen Yu wrote down both results instead of turning “works with this phone” into “works with every phone.”

text: 老师看过以后，让我们把适用的尺寸和重量写清楚，再讨论能不能改成正式产品。我们还没走到那一步，先把这次结果说明白。
pinyin: lǎo shī kàn guò yǐ hòu , ràng wǒ men bǎ shì yòng de chǐ cùn hé zhòng liàng xiě qīng chǔ , zài tǎo lùn néng bù néng gǎi chéng zhèng shì chǎn pǐn . wǒ men hái méi zǒu dào nà yī bù , xiān bǎ zhè cì jié guǒ shuō míng bái .
meaning: After checking it, the teacher asked us to state which dimensions and weight it worked with before discussing a finished product. We weren’t at that stage yet; first we needed a clear account of this trial.

text: 下次合作，我想早点问清楚怎么测试。把问题说得具体一点，比快做一个看起来完成了的东西更有用。
pinyin: xià cì hé zuò , wǒ xiǎng zǎo diǎn wèn qīng chǔ zěn me cè shì . bǎ wèn tí shuō de jù tǐ yī diǎn , bǐ kuài zuò yī gè kàn qǐ lái wán chéng le de dōng xi gèng yǒu yòng .
meaning: Next time, I want to ask earlier how we’ll test it. Describing the problem specifically is more useful than quickly producing something that merely looks finished.

Chen Yu wrote down both results instead of turning “works with this phone” into “works with every phone.” After checking it, the teacher asked us to state which dimensions and weight it worked with before discussing a finished product. We weren’t at that stage yet; first we needed a clear account of this trial. Next time, I want to ask earlier how we’ll test it. Describing the problem specifically is more useful than quickly producing something that merely looks finished.

parts.text: 小组要做一个放在桌上的手机架。我负责做，陈宇负责测试和记录。我们一开始只讨论了颜色和外形，觉得好看就够了。
第一次做完以后，手机放得进去，架子却站不住。我把尺寸写在纸上：前面宽十二厘米，后面只有六厘米。陈宇让我先保留这个设计，再做一个后面更宽的。
我们没有同时换材料和尺寸。第二个仍然用同一种厚纸，只把后面的宽度改成十厘米。这样再测试时，比较的条件会少一点。
第二个放上这部手机以后能站住了。不过我换了一部更重的手机，它又倒了。陈宇把两次的情况写下来，没有把“这部能用”写成“所有手机都能用”。
老师看过以后，让我们把适用的尺寸和重量写清楚，再讨论能不能改成正式产品。我们还没走到那一步，先把这次结果说明白。
下次合作，我想早点问清楚怎么测试。把问题说得具体一点，比快做一个看起来完成了的东西更有用。

She’d said what she needed to; they didn’t necessarily have to meet again. But she kept talking about waiting for him earlier, and we never got an answer. The answer isn’t only whether he returned. At the end she went to the station herself instead of staying home waiting. I missed that. I was only looking at the train, thinking he’d get off. We can go back and watch. Her expression is already different when she reaches the station. Okay, but I still think the middle was too slow. I agree with that. I almost gave up during two sections too. So you didn’t like everything either. I thought you were going to explain every minute on the director’s behalf. Of course not. I liked the last part; I didn’t say the whole thing was good. Then let’s rewatch the last part and get dinner. I am sure of just one thing right now: I am hungry.

parts.text: 看完了？你怎么一句话都不说？
我在想最后那个人到底回来没有。电影就这么结束了，有点失望。
我倒挺喜欢。她已经把该说的话说了，不一定非要再见面。
可前面一直说等他，最后也没给个答案。
答案不只是回没回来吧。她最后自己去了车站，没有再留在家里等。
这点我没注意。我光看火车了，以为他会下来。
可以倒回去看看。她走到车站的时候，表情已经不一样了。
好。不过我还是觉得中间太慢。
这个我同意。有两段我也差点没看下去。
原来你也不是都喜欢。我还以为你要替导演解释每一分钟。
哪有。我喜欢最后一段，又没说整部都好。
那先看最后一段，再去吃饭。我现在只确定一件事：我饿了。

text: 我和朋友看完同一部电影，第一句话却完全不同。我说“终于结束了”，她说“最后那一段真好”。我们忍不住笑了，原来坐在一起也不代表期待一样。
pinyin: wǒ hé péng you kàn wán tóng yī bù diàn yǐng , dì yī jù huà què wán quán bù tóng . wǒ shuō zhōng yú jié shù le , tā shuō zuì hòu nà yī duàn zhēn hǎo . wǒ men rěn bú zhù xiào le , yuán lái zuò zài yì qǐ yě bù dài biǎo qī dài yī yàng .
meaning: My friend and I watched the same film but reacted differently. I said, “Finally over”; she said, “The last part was great.” We laughed: sitting together hadn’t made our expectations the same.

text: 我想看的是两个人最后有没有再见。朋友注意的是女孩怎样从等别人回来，变成自己决定去哪里。我们看的不是两部电影，只是注意了不同的细节。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kàn de shì liǎng gè rén zuì hòu yǒu méi yǒu zài jiàn . péng you zhù yì de shì nǚ hái zěn yàng cóng děng bié ren huí lái , biàn chéng zì jǐ jué dìng qù nǎ lǐ . wǒ men kàn de bù shì liǎng bù diàn yǐng , zhǐ shì zhù yì le bù tóng de xì jié .
meaning: I wanted to know whether the two people met again. My friend noticed how the girl changed from waiting for someone to deciding where to go herself. We’d watched one film but focused on different details.

text: 回看最后一段以后，我发现她说得有道理。女孩走进车站时没有拿那封一直留着的信。这个动作在前面出现过，所以不是随便加的一下。
pinyin: huí kàn zuì hòu yī duàn yǐ hòu , wǒ fā xiàn tā shuō de yǒu dào lǐ . nǚ hái zǒu jìn chē zhàn shí méi yǒu ná nà fēng yì zhí liú zhe de xìn . zhè gè dòng zuò zài qián miàn chū xiàn guò , suǒ yǐ bù shì suí biàn jiā de yī xià .
meaning: After rewatching the last section, I saw her point. The girl entered the station without the letter she’d kept. That action had appeared earlier, so it wasn’t just an arbitrary extra gesture.

text: 不过这没有让我突然喜欢整部电影。中间几段依然很慢，朋友也同意。我们把“有一个好细节”和“整部都好看”分开说，反而不用争论那么久。
pinyin: bù guò zhè méi yǒu ràng wǒ tū rán xǐ huān zhěng bù diàn yǐng . zhōng jiān jǐ duàn yī rán hěn màn , péng you yě tóng yì . wǒ men bǎ yǒu yī gè hǎo xì jié hé zhěng bù dōu hǎo kàn fēn kāi shuō , fǎn ér bù yòng zhēng lùn nà me jiǔ .
meaning: That didn’t suddenly make me love the whole film. Some middle sections were still slow, and my friend agreed. Distinguishing one good detail from enjoying the whole film actually shortened the argument.

text: 后来我写了几句话推荐给同学，没有只写“你一定喜欢”。我说它节奏慢，最后没有直接回答两个人是否再见，但人物的变化值得注意。喜欢明确结果的人，可能会和我一样失望。
pinyin: hòu lái wǒ xiě le jǐ jù huà tuī jiàn gěi tóng xué , méi yǒu zhǐ xiě nǐ yí dìng xǐ huān . wǒ shuō tā jié zòu màn , zuì hòu méi yǒu zhí jiē huí dá liǎng gè rén shì fǒu zài jiàn , dàn rén wù de biàn huà zhí de zhù yì . xǐ huān míng què jié guǒ de rén , kě néng huì hé wǒ yī yàng shī wàng .
meaning: Later I wrote a short recommendation for a classmate rather than simply saying, “You’ll definitely like it.” I said it was slow, didn’t directly answer whether they met again and had a character change worth noticing. People who want a definite outcome might be disappointed, as I was.

text: 朋友说这个评价比我刚开始那句“没意思”诚实多了。我还是不想马上再看一遍，不过愿意听听其他观众看到了什么。
pinyin: péng you shuō zhè gè píng jià bǐ wǒ gāng kāi shǐ nà jù méi yì si chéng shí duō le . wǒ hái shi bù xiǎng mǎ shàng zài kàn yī biàn , bù guò yuàn yì tīng tīng qí tā guān zhòng kàn dào le shén me .
meaning: My friend said that assessment was much more honest than my initial “boring.” I still didn’t want an immediate rewatch, but I was willing to hear what other viewers had noticed.

text: 你还是带着那封信？
pinyin: nǐ hái shi dài zhe nà fēng xìn ?
meaning: Are you still carrying that letter?

text: 今天没带。
pinyin: jīn tiān méi dài .
meaning: Not today.

text: 那你来车站做什么？
pinyin: nà nǐ lái chē zhàn zuò shén me ?
meaning: Then why have you come to the station?

text: 买票，去我姐姐那儿。
pinyin: mǎi piào , qù wǒ jiě jie nàr .
meaning: To buy a ticket to visit my sister.

text: 你不等他了？
pinyin: nǐ bù děng tā le ?
meaning: You’re not waiting for him anymore?

text: 他知道怎么找我。我不能一直坐在家里。
pinyin: tā zhī dào zěn me zhǎo wǒ . wǒ bù néng yì zhí zuò zài jiā lǐ .
meaning: He knows how to find me. I can’t stay at home forever.

text: 那我陪你买票。
pinyin: nà wǒ péi nǐ mǎi piào .
meaning: Then I’ll come with you to buy the ticket.

text: 好，顺便帮我看看几点还有车。
pinyin: hǎo , shùn biàn bāng wǒ kàn kàn jǐ diǎn hái yǒu chē .
meaning: Okay. Help me check which trains are still available while we’re there.

text: 你还是带着那封信？今天没带。那你来车站做什么？买票，去我姐姐那儿。你不等他了？他知道怎么找我。我不能一直坐在家里。那我陪你买票。好，顺便帮我看看几点还有车。

text: 我们在辩论中先说明自己的理由。
pinyin: wǒ men zài biàn lùn zhōng xiān shuō míng zì jǐ de lǐ yóu .
meaning: We explain our reasons first in the debate.

text: 他承认自己看错了，很诚实。
pinyin: tā chéng rèn zì jǐ kàn cuò le , hěn chéng shí .
meaning: He honestly admitted he’d misread it.

text: 我想避免在大家忙的时候打电话。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bì miǎn zài dà jiā máng de shí hou dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: I want to avoid calling when everyone’s busy.

text: 这篇介绍只说优点，比较片面。
pinyin: zhè piān jiè shào zhǐ shuō yōu diǎn , bǐ jiào piàn miàn .
meaning: This introduction is rather one-sided; it only mentions advantages.

text: 我们得到的结论不一样。
pinyin: wǒ men dé dào de jié lùn bù yī yàng .
meaning: We reached different conclusions.

text: 他记得见面时的很多细节。
pinyin: tā jì de jiàn miàn shí de hěn duō xì jié .
meaning: He remembers many details of their meeting.

text: 她不喜欢这家店的装修风格。
pinyin: tā bù xǐ huān zhè jiā diàn de zhuāng xiū fēng gé .
meaning: She doesn’t like this shop’s decorating style.

text: 我已经向学校反映了这个问题。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng xiàng xué xiào fǎn yìng le zhè gè wèn tí .
meaning: I’ve reported this problem to the school.

text: 先别争论，听听他怎么说。
pinyin: xiān bié zhēng lùn , tīng tīng tā zěn me shuō .
meaning: Don’t argue yet; hear what he has to say.

text: 大家对新电影的期待不一样。
pinyin: dà jiā duì xīn diàn yǐng de qī dài bù yī yàng .
meaning: People have different expectations of the new film.

text: 我以为会再见到他，没想到又失望了。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi huì zài jiàn dào tā , méi xiǎng dào yòu shī wàng le .
meaning: I thought I’d see him again, but I was disappointed once more.

text: 他不赞成把时间改到周一。
pinyin: tā bù zàn chéng bǎ shí jiān gǎi dào zhōu yī .
meaning: He doesn’t agree with moving it to Monday.

text: 她的评价很具体，不只是说好看。
pinyin: tā de píng jià hěn jù tǐ , bù zhǐ shì shuō hǎo kàn .
meaning: Her assessment is specific, not just “it’s good.”

text: 我记得演员的脸，却想不起名字。
pinyin: wǒ jì de yǎn yuán de liǎn , què xiǎng bù qǐ míng zi .
meaning: I remember the actor’s face but can’t recall the name.

text: 我们看过同一个导演的两部电影。
pinyin: wǒ men kàn guò tóng yī gè dǎo yǎn de liǎng bù diàn yǐng .
meaning: We’ve seen two films by the same director.

text: 有些观众喜欢最后那一段，有些不喜欢。
pinyin: yǒu xiē guān zhòng xǐ huān zuì hòu nà yī duàn , yǒu xiē bù xǐ huān .
meaning: Some viewers like the final section; others don’t.

text: 这次辩论的题目是城市生活。我们在辩论中先说明自己的理由。你诚实地告诉我，不喜欢也没关系。他承认自己看错了，很诚实。先问清楚，可以避免误会。我想避免在大家忙的时候打电话。只看价格来评价，太片面了。这篇介绍只说优点，比较片面。看完前面的部分，再下结论吧。我们得到的结论不一样。我想再看一遍这个细节。他记得见面时的很多细节。这个导演的风格比较安静。她不喜欢这家店的装修风格。这部电影反映了小城里普通人的生活。我已经向学校反映了这个问题。我们为最后那句话争论了半天。先别争论，听听他怎么说。我很期待下周的演出。大家对新电影的期待不一样。没买到票，我有点失望。我以为会再见到他，没想到又失望了。我赞成先看完再讨论。他不赞成把时间改到周一。你怎么评价这个演员？她的评价很具体，不只是说好看。这个演员以前演过老师。我记得演员的脸，却想不起名字。导演没有把最后的答案说出来。我们看过同一个导演的两部电影。观众都安静下来，等演出开始。有些观众喜欢最后那一段，有些不喜欢。
pinyin: zhè cì biàn lùn de tí mù shì chéng shì shēng huó . wǒ men zài biàn lùn zhōng xiān shuō míng zì jǐ de lǐ yóu . nǐ chéng shí de gào sù wǒ , bù xǐ huān yě méi guān xì . tā chéng rèn zì jǐ kàn cuò le , hěn chéng shí . xiān wèn qīng chǔ , kě yǐ bì miǎn wù huì . wǒ xiǎng bì miǎn zài dà jiā máng de shí hou dǎ diàn huà . zhǐ kàn jià gé lái píng jià , tài piàn miàn le . zhè piān jiè shào zhǐ shuō yōu diǎn , bǐ jiào piàn miàn . kàn wán qián miàn de bù fèn , zài xià jié lùn ba . wǒ men dé dào de jié lùn bù yī yàng . wǒ xiǎng zài kàn yī biàn zhè gè xì jié . tā jì de jiàn miàn shí de hěn duō xì jié . zhè gè dǎo yǎn de fēng gé bǐ jiào ān jìng . tā bù xǐ huān zhè jiā diàn de zhuāng xiū fēng gé . zhè bù diàn yǐng fǎn yìng le xiǎo chéng lǐ pǔ tōng rén de shēng huó . wǒ yǐ jīng xiàng xué xiào fǎn yìng le zhè gè wèn tí . wǒ men wèi zuì hòu nà jù huà zhēng lùn le bàn tiān . xiān bié zhēng lùn , tīng tīng tā zěn me shuō . wǒ hěn qī dài xià zhōu de yǎn chū . dà jiā duì xīn diàn yǐng de qī dài bù yī yàng . méi mǎi dào piào , wǒ yǒu diǎn shī wàng . wǒ yǐ wéi huì zài jiàn dào tā , méi xiǎng dào yòu shī wàng le . wǒ zàn chéng xiān kàn wán zài tǎo lùn . tā bù zàn chéng bǎ shí jiān gǎi dào zhōu yī . nǐ zěn me píng jià zhè gè yǎn yuán ? tā de píng jià hěn jù tǐ , bù zhǐ shì shuō hǎo kàn . zhè gè yǎn yuán yǐ qián yǎn guò lǎo shī . wǒ jì de yǎn yuán de liǎn , què xiǎng bù qǐ míng zi . dǎo yǎn méi yǒu bǎ zuì hòu de dá àn shuō chū lái . wǒ men kàn guò tóng yī gè dǎo yǎn de liǎng bù diàn yǐng . guān zhòng dōu ān jìng xià lái , děng yǎn chū kāi shǐ . yǒu xiē guān zhòng xǐ huān zuì hòu nà yī duàn , yǒu xiē bù xǐ huān .
meaning: This debate is about city life. We explain our reasons first in the debate. Tell me honestly; it’s okay if you don’t like it. He honestly admitted he’d misread it. Asking first can avoid misunderstandings. I want to avoid calling when everyone’s busy. Judging only by price is too one-sided. This introduction is rather one-sided; it only mentions advantages. Watch the earlier parts before drawing a conclusion. We reached different conclusions. I’d like to watch this detail again. He remembers many details of their meeting. This director has a fairly quiet style. She doesn’t like this shop’s decorating style. This film reflects ordinary life in a small town. I’ve reported this problem to the school. We argued for ages about that final sentence. Don’t argue yet; hear what he has to say. I’m really looking forward to next week’s performance. People have different expectations of the new film. I’m a little disappointed I couldn’t get tickets. I thought I’d see him again, but I was disappointed once more. I agree we should finish watching before discussing it. He doesn’t agree with moving it to Monday. How would you assess this actor? Her assessment is specific, not just “it’s good.” This actor played a teacher before. I remember the actor’s face but can’t recall the name. The director didn’t give away the final answer. We’ve seen two films by the same director. The audience grew quiet, waiting for the performance. Some viewers like the final section; others don’t.

text: 你到哪儿了？我们已经到车站了。
pinyin: nǐ dào nǎr le ? wǒ men yǐ jīng dào chē zhàn le .
meaning: Where are you? We’re already at the station.

text: 还在公交车上，路上堵车。你先看看两点那趟还在不在。
pinyin: hái zài gōng jiāo chē shàng , lù shàng dǔ chē . nǐ xiān kàn kàn liǎng diǎn nà tàng hái zài bù zài .
meaning: Still on the bus, stuck in traffic. Check whether the two o’clock service is still running.

text: 刚看到通知，两点那趟取消了。可以申请换到三点十分那趟。
pinyin: gāng kàn dào tōng zhī , liǎng diǎn nà tàng qǔ xiāo le . kě yǐ shēn qǐng huàn dào sān diǎn shí fēn nà tàng .
meaning: I’ve just seen a notice: the two o’clock service is cancelled. We can apply to switch to the 3:10 service.

text: 直接拿原来的票上车吗？
pinyin: zhí jiē ná yuán lái de piào shàng chē ma ?
meaning: Can we board with the original tickets?

text: 不行，通知写着要先去窗口，三点之前办好。
pinyin: bù xíng , tōng zhī xiě zhe yào xiān qù chuāng kǒu , sān diǎn zhī qián bàn hǎo .
meaning: No. The notice says we need to go to the counter and finish before three.

text: 那我先别着急下车。你能问问我没到，能不能先办你的？
pinyin: nà wǒ xiān bié zháo jí xià chē . nǐ néng wèn wèn wǒ méi dào , néng bù néng xiān bàn nǐ de ?
meaning: Then I shouldn’t rush off the bus. Could you ask whether you can arrange your ticket before I arrive?

text: 问过了，可以各自办。你到了直接找三号窗口。
pinyin: wèn guò le , kě yǐ gè zì bàn . nǐ dào le zhí jiē zhǎo sān hào chuāng kǒu .
meaning: I’ve asked; we can each do it separately. Go straight to counter three when you arrive.

text: 好。我大约二点四十到，还有二十分钟。
pinyin: hǎo . wǒ dà yuē èr diǎn sì shí dào , hái yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng .
meaning: Okay. I’ll arrive around 2:40, so I’ll have twenty minutes.

text: 时间不多，到了先办票，再买水。
pinyin: shí jiān bù duō , dào le xiān bàn piào , zài mǎi shuǐ .
meaning: That’s not much time. Sort out the ticket before buying water.

text: 知道了。你转告林安，我们到她那儿可能比原来晚一个小时。
pinyin: zhī dào le . nǐ zhuǎn gào lín ān , wǒ men dào tā nàr kě néng bǐ yuán lái wǎn yī gè xiǎo shí .
meaning: Got it. Tell Lin An we may get to her place an hour later than planned.

text: 我来说。她不用现在就出门等我们。
pinyin: wǒ lái shuō . tā bù yòng xiàn zài jiù chū mén děng wǒ men .
meaning: I’ll tell her. She doesn’t need to go out and wait now.

text: 谢谢。早知道这样，我早上就多吃点了。
pinyin: xiè xiè . zǎo zhī dào zhè yàng , wǒ zǎo shàng jiù duō chī diǎn le .
meaning: Thanks. If I’d known, I’d have eaten more this morning.

text: 通知：原定今日十四点出发的长途汽车取消。已购票的乘客可以到三号窗口申请改乘十五点十分的汽车。办理期限为十五点前。原车票不能直接用于新班次。
pinyin: tōng zhī : yuán dìng jīn rì shí sì diǎn chū fā de cháng tú qì chē qǔ xiāo . yǐ gòu piào de chéng kè kě yǐ dào sān hào chuāng kǒu shēn qǐng gǎi chéng shí wǔ diǎn shí fēn de qì chē . bàn lǐ qī xiàn wèi shí wǔ diǎn qián . yuán chē piào bù néng zhí jiē yòng yú xīn bān cì .
meaning: Notice: the long-distance bus scheduled for 14:00 today is cancelled. Ticket holders may request transfer to the 15:10 service at counter three. This must be processed before 15:00. Original tickets cannot be used directly on the new service.

text: 我看到通知的时候是二点二十，朋友还在去车站的公交车上。我先确认了窗口的位置，再问工作人员能不能各自办理。他说可以，不用等所有人到齐。
pinyin: wǒ kàn dào tōng zhī de shí hou shì èr diǎn èr shí , péng you hái zài qù chē zhàn de gōng jiāo chē shàng . wǒ xiān què rèn le chuāng kǒu de wèi zhì , zài wèn gōng zuò rén yuán néng bù néng gè zì bàn lǐ . tā shuō kě yǐ , bù yòng děng suǒ yǒu rén dào qí .
meaning: It was 2:20 when I saw the notice, and my friend was still on a city bus to the station. I found the counter and asked whether we could process our tickets separately. The staff member said yes; we didn’t need everyone present.

text: 我办完以后给朋友发了两条消息。第一条是三号窗口的位置，第二条是期限。我没有只说“车改时间了”，因为他还需要知道先做什么。
pinyin: wǒ bàn wán yǐ hòu gěi péng you fā le liǎng tiáo xiāo xī . dì yī tiáo shì sān hào chuāng kǒu de wèi zhì , dì èr tiáo shì qī xiàn . wǒ méi yǒu zhǐ shuō chē gǎi shí jiān le , yīn wèi tā hái xū yào zhī dào xiān zuò shén me .
meaning: After sorting mine out, I sent my friend two messages: the counter’s location and the deadline. I didn’t just say “the bus time changed,” because he also needed to know what to do first.

text: 朋友二点四十到了。我在门口接他，一起去窗口。办好票还有一点时间，他买了水和面包，终于不再一直问车上有没有吃的。
pinyin: péng you èr diǎn sì shí dào le . wǒ zài mén kǒu jiē tā , yì qǐ qù chuāng kǒu . bàn hǎo piào hái yǒu yī diǎn shí jiān , tā mǎi le shuǐ hé miàn bāo , zhōng yú bù zài yì zhí wèn chē shàng yǒu méi yǒu chī de .
meaning: My friend arrived at 2:40. I met him at the entrance and went with him to the counter. After the tickets were ready there was time for water and bread, and he finally stopped asking whether there was food on the bus.

text: 我们又给林安确认了新的到达时间。她说会晚一点出门，还把饭馆的预订推迟了。一个人知道变化不够，等我们的人也要知道。
pinyin: wǒ men yòu gěi lín ān què rèn le xīn de dào dá shí jiān . tā shuō huì wǎn yī diǎn chū mén , hái bǎ fàn guǎn de yù dìng tuī chí le . yī gè rén zhī dào biàn huà bù gòu , děng wǒ men de rén yě yào zhī dào .
meaning: We confirmed our new arrival time with Lin An. She said she’d leave home later and postponed the restaurant booking. It wasn’t enough for us to know the change; the person waiting needed it too.

text: 这次没有按原计划出发，不过该办的都办好了。我把通知保存下来，也把新车票和原来的放在不同地方，免得上车时拿错。
pinyin: zhè cì méi yǒu àn yuán jì huà chū fā , bù guò gāi bàn de dōu bàn hǎo le . wǒ bǎ tōng zhī bǎo cún xià lái , yě bǎ xīn chē piào hé yuán lái de fàng zài bù tóng dì fāng , miǎn de shàng chē shí ná cuò .
meaning: We didn’t depart as originally planned, but everything was arranged. I saved the notice and kept the new and original tickets apart so I wouldn’t take the wrong one when boarding.

pinyin: tōng zhī : yuán dìng jīn rì shí sì diǎn chū fā de cháng tú qì chē qǔ xiāo . yǐ gòu piào de chéng kè kě yǐ dào sān hào chuāng kǒu shēn qǐng gǎi chéng shí wǔ diǎn shí fēn de qì chē . bàn lǐ qī xiàn wèi shí wǔ diǎn qián . yuán chē piào bù néng zhí jiē yòng yú xīn bān cì . wǒ kàn dào tōng zhī de shí hou shì èr diǎn èr shí , péng you hái zài qù chē zhàn de gōng jiāo chē shàng . wǒ xiān què rèn le chuāng kǒu de wèi zhì , zài wèn gōng zuò rén yuán néng bù néng gè zì bàn lǐ . tā shuō kě yǐ , bù yòng děng suǒ yǒu rén dào qí . wǒ bàn wán yǐ hòu gěi péng you fā le liǎng tiáo xiāo xī . dì yī tiáo shì sān hào chuāng kǒu de wèi zhì , dì èr tiáo shì qī xiàn . wǒ méi yǒu zhǐ shuō chē gǎi shí jiān le , yīn wèi tā hái xū yào zhī dào xiān zuò shén me . péng you èr diǎn sì shí dào le . wǒ zài mén kǒu jiē tā , yì qǐ qù chuāng kǒu . bàn hǎo piào hái yǒu yī diǎn shí jiān , tā mǎi le shuǐ hé miàn bāo , zhōng yú bù zài yì zhí wèn chē shàng yǒu méi yǒu chī de . wǒ men yòu gěi lín ān què rèn le xīn de dào dá shí jiān . tā shuō huì wǎn yī diǎn chū mén , hái bǎ fàn guǎn de yù dìng tuī chí le . yī gè rén zhī dào biàn huà bù gòu , děng wǒ men de rén yě yào zhī dào . zhè cì méi yǒu àn yuán jì huà chū fā , bù guò gāi bàn de dōu bàn hǎo le . wǒ bǎ tōng zhī bǎo cún xià lái , yě bǎ xīn chē piào hé yuán lái de fàng zài bù tóng dì fāng , miǎn de shàng chē shí ná cuò .
meaning: Notice: the long-distance bus scheduled for 14:00 today is cancelled. Ticket holders may request transfer to the 15:10 service at counter three. This must be processed before 15:00. Original tickets cannot be used directly on the new service. It was 2:20 when I saw the notice, and my friend was still on a city bus to the station. I found the counter and asked whether we could process our tickets separately. The staff member said yes; we didn’t need everyone present. After sorting mine out, I sent my friend two messages: the counter’s location and the deadline. I didn’t just say “the bus time changed,” because he also needed to know what to do first. My friend arrived at 2:40. I met him at the entrance and went with him to the counter. After the tickets were ready there was time for water and bread, and he finally stopped asking whether there was food on the bus. We confirmed our new arrival time with Lin An. She said she’d leave home later and postponed the restaurant booking. It wasn’t enough for us to know the change; the person waiting needed it too. We didn’t depart as originally planned, but everything was arranged. I saved the notice and kept the new and original tickets apart so I wouldn’t take the wrong one when boarding.

我看到通知的时候是二点二十，朋友还在去车站的公交车上。我先确认了窗口的位置，再问工作人员能不能各自办理。他说可以，不用等所有人到齐。
我办完以后给朋友发了两条消息。第一条是三号窗口的位置，第二条是期限。我没有只说“车改时间了”，因为他还需要知道先做什么。
朋友二点四十到了。我在门口接他，一起去窗口。办好票还有一点时间，他买了水和面包，终于不再一直问车上有没有吃的。

text: 你发消息说快到了，现在又说晚点？
pinyin: nǐ fā xiāo xī shuō kuài dào le , xiàn zài yòu shuō wǎn diǎn ?
meaning: You messaged that you were almost here, and now you’re delayed?

text: 我说的是快到车站，不是快到你家。
pinyin: wǒ shuō de shì kuài dào chē zhàn , bù shì kuài dào nǐ jiā .
meaning: I meant almost at the station, not almost at your place.

text: 下次把地方一起说。我都穿好鞋了。
pinyin: xià cì bǎ dì fāng yì qǐ shuō . wǒ dōu chuān hǎo xié le .
meaning: Name the place next time. I’ve already put my shoes on.

text: 那先坐一会儿吧。我们三点十分才出发。
pinyin: nà xiān zuò yī huì er ba . wǒ men sān diǎn shí fēn cái chū fā .
meaning: Then sit down for a while. We won’t depart until 3:10.

text: 好，到了附近再给我电话，别只说快到了。
pinyin: hǎo , dào le fù jìn zài gěi wǒ diàn huà , bié zhǐ shuō kuài dào le .
meaning: Okay. Call when you’re nearby rather than just saying almost there.

text: 这次说清楚：快到你家楼下时，我打电话。
pinyin: zhè cì shuō qīng chǔ : kuài dào nǐ jiā lóu xià shí , wǒ dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: I’ll make it clear this time: I’ll call when we’re nearly downstairs at your place.

text: 总算听懂了。你饿不饿？
pinyin: zǒng suàn tīng dǒng le . nǐ è bù è ?
meaning: Now I understand. Are you hungry?

text: 已经买了面包，终于能等了。
pinyin: yǐ jīng mǎi le miàn bāo , zhōng yú néng děng le .
meaning: I’ve bought bread, so I can finally manage the wait.

text: 航空运输比以前方便多了。

meaning: Air transport is much more convenient than before.

text: 长途汽车站在城北。
pinyin: cháng tú qì chē zhàn zài chéng běi .
meaning: The long-distance bus station is in the north of the city.

text: 高铁票已经买好了，不用再订。
pinyin: gāo tiě piào yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo le , bù yòng zài dìng .
meaning: The high-speed train tickets are already bought; no need to book again.

text: 广播说列车晚点，时间还没确定。
pinyin: guǎng bō shuō liè chē wǎn diǎn , shí jiān hái méi què dìng .
meaning: The announcement says the train is delayed, with no time fixed yet.

text: 预订成功以后，记得保存号码。
pinyin: yù dìng chéng gōng yǐ hòu , jì de bǎo cún hào mǎ .
meaning: Keep the number once the booking is confirmed.

text: 他已经确认周五能来。
pinyin: tā yǐ jīng què rèn zhōu wǔ néng lái .
meaning: He’s confirmed he can come on Friday.

text: 途中下雨了，我们就放慢了速度。
pinyin: tú zhōng xià yǔ le , wǒ men jiù fàng màn le sù dù .
meaning: It rained on the way, so we slowed down.

text: 这边早上容易堵车，最好早点走。
pinyin: zhè biān zǎo shàng róng yì dǔ chē , zuì hǎo zǎo diǎn zǒu .
meaning: Traffic often backs up here in the morning; it’s best to leave early.

text: 我想找距离学校近一点的房间。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo jù lí xué xiào jìn yī diǎn de fáng jiān .
meaning: I’d like a room closer to the school.

text: 不用立即决定，今晚回复也可以。
pinyin: bù yòng lì jí jué dìng , jīn wǎn huí fù yě kě yǐ .
meaning: No need to decide immediately; you can reply tonight.

text: 这个期限能不能延长两天？
pinyin: zhè gè qī xiàn néng bù néng yán cháng liǎng tiān ?
meaning: Could this deadline be extended by two days?

text: 我想申请延期交材料。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng shēn qǐng yán qī jiāo cái liào .
meaning: I’d like to request more time to submit the documents.

text: 他取消了房间预订，准备当天回家。
pinyin: tā qǔ xiāo le fáng jiān yù dìng , zhǔn bèi dàng tiān huí jiā .

pinyin: chū fā zhī qián , wǒ yòu jiǎn chá le yī biàn dì zhǐ .

pinyin: hǎo , wǒ dā yìng nǐ . bù guò nǐ shēng rì nà tiān , wǒ hái shi huì gěi nǐ diàn huà .
meaning: Yes, I promise. I’ll still call you on your birthday too.

text: 行。我刚才还真有点误会了。你以后直接说就好。
pinyin: xíng . wǒ gāng cái hái zhēn yǒu diǎn wù huì le . nǐ yǐ hòu zhí jiē shuō jiù hǎo .
meaning: Okay. I really did misunderstand a little just now. Tell me directly next time.

text: 我也是怕你不高兴，才拖到今天说。下次早点回复。

meaning: I was worried you’d be upset, which is why I put it off until today. I’ll reply earlier next time.

text: 早点说我就不用一直问。礼物可别忘了。
pinyin: zǎo diǎn shuō wǒ jiù bù yòng yì zhí wèn . lǐ wù kě bié wàng le .
meaning: If you say it sooner, I don’t have to keep asking. Don’t forget the present, though.

text: 你不是说不在乎礼物吗？

meaning: Didn’t you say you didn’t care about presents?

text: 周六聚会以后，陈宇给我发了一张照片。照片里有十几个人，大家围着桌子唱生日歌。我替他高兴，也知道自己那晚确实没有精力参加。
pinyin: zhōu liù jù huì yǐ hòu , chén yǔ gěi wǒ fā le yī zhāng zhào piān . zhào piān lǐ yǒu shí jǐ gè rén , dà jiā wéi zhe zhuō zi chàng shēng rì gē . wǒ tì tā gāo xìng , yě zhī dào zì jǐ nà wǎn què shí méi yǒu jīng lì cān jiā .
meaning: After Saturday’s gathering, Chen Yu sent me a photo. More than ten people were singing around the table. I was happy for him and knew I really hadn’t had the energy to join that night.

text: 以前我遇到这种邀请，常常先答应，到当天才说去不了。朋友没时间重新安排，我也觉得不好意思。这次我在人数确定之前就回复了。
pinyin: yǐ qián wǒ yù dào zhè zhǒng yāo qǐng , cháng cháng xiān dā yìng , dào dàng tiān cái shuō qù bù le . péng you méi shí jiān chóng xīn ān pái , wǒ yě jué de bù hǎo yì sī . zhè cì wǒ zài rén shù què dìng zhī qián jiù huí fù le .
meaning: I used to accept this sort of invitation and then cancel on the day. That left friends no time to adjust and made me feel bad. This time I replied before the headcount was fixed.

text: 一开始他以为我不想见他，我就把两件事分开解释：我不想参加大聚会，但想和他单独吃饭。我们约了下周二七点，他不用为了我改变周六的活动。
pinyin: yī kāi shǐ tā yǐ wéi wǒ bù xiǎng jiàn tā , wǒ jiù bǎ liǎng jiàn shì fēn kāi jiě shì : wǒ bù xiǎng cān jiā dà jù huì , dàn xiǎng hé tā dān dú chī fàn . wǒ men yuē le xià zhōu èr qī diǎn , tā bù yòng wèi le wǒ gǎi biàn zhōu liù de huó dòng .
meaning: At first he thought I didn’t want to see him. I explained the two things separately: I didn’t want the big gathering but did want dinner with him. We arranged Tuesday at seven, without changing Saturday’s event for me.

text: 生日当天，我给他打了电话。没说很多话，只问聚会准备得怎么样，祝他生日快乐。他说饭已经够了，让我下次别又带一大盒点心。
pinyin: shēng rì dàng tiān , wǒ gěi tā dǎ le diàn huà . méi shuō hěn duō huà , zhǐ wèn jù huì zhǔn bèi de zěn me yàng , zhù tā shēng rì kuài lè . tā shuō fàn yǐ jīng gòu le , ràng wǒ xià cì bié yòu dài yī dà hé diǎn xīn .
meaning: On his birthday I called, asked how preparations were going and wished him a happy birthday. He said there was enough food and told me not to bring another huge box of pastries next time.

text: 周二见面时，我带了一小盒。他看了看，说“这回你真的听进去了”。我们吃完饭，又聊了周六的照片，没有再争论我为什么没去。
pinyin: zhōu èr jiàn miàn shí , wǒ dài le yī xiǎo hé . tā kàn le kàn , shuō zhè huí nǐ zhēn de tīng jìn qù le . wǒ men chī wán fàn , yòu liáo le zhōu liù de zhào piān , méi yǒu zài zhēng lùn wǒ wèi shén me méi qù .
meaning: When we met Tuesday, I brought a small box. He looked and said, “You really listened this time.” After dinner we talked about the photos without returning to the argument about my absence.

text: 我发现说清楚一个具体安排，比反复说“以后再约”有用。当然，有时别人还是会失望。解释并不能让所有人立刻高兴，但至少让这次决定少一点误会。
pinyin: wǒ fā xiàn shuō qīng chǔ yī gè jù tǐ ān pái , bǐ fǎn fù shuō yǐ hòu zài yuē yǒu yòng . dāng rán , yǒu shí bié ren hái shi huì shī wàng . jiě shì bìng bù néng ràng suǒ yǒu rén lì kè gāo xìng , dàn zhì shǎo ràng zhè cì jué dìng shǎo yī diǎn wù huì .
meaning: I found that a concrete plan was more useful than repeatedly saying, “Let’s meet sometime.” People can still feel disappointed. An explanation doesn’t instantly please everyone, but it can reduce misunderstanding about this decision.

text: 对，上次那个盒子有这么大。

text: 你拿手比也没用，我记得上次的。

text: 今天这个真的小了。你不在乎礼物，还在乎盒子大小？

text: 我在乎冰箱能不能放下。

text: 那我们现在吃掉一半，就放得下了。

text: 他的原则是不借别人的账号。
pinyin: tā de yuán zé shì bù jiè bié ren de zhàng hào .
meaning: His principle is not to borrow someone else’s account.

text: 她不在乎礼物贵不贵，更喜欢自己做的。
pinyin: tā bù zài hū lǐ wù guì bù guì , gèng xǐ huān zì jǐ zuò de .
meaning: She doesn’t care whether a gift is expensive; she prefers homemade ones.

text: 他很在乎朋友的意见。
pinyin: tā hěn zài hū péng you de yì jiàn .
meaning: He cares a lot about his friends' opinions.

text: 我们相处了一年，才发现喜欢同一种音乐。
pinyin: wǒ men xiāng chǔ le yī nián , cái fā xiàn xǐ huān tóng yī zhǒng yīn yuè .
meaning: We spent a year together before realising we liked the same music.

text: 这个误会解释清楚以后，我们都笑了。
pinyin: zhè gè wù huì jiě shì qīng chǔ yǐ hòu , wǒ men dōu xiào le .
meaning: We both laughed once the misunderstanding was cleared up.

text: 两个人一起做事，难免会有不同意见。
pinyin: liǎng gè rén yì qǐ zuò shì , nán miǎn huì yǒu bù tóng yì jiàn .
meaning: When two people work together, disagreements are hard to avoid.

text: 我今晚有约会，不能参加聚会。
pinyin: wǒ jīn wǎn yǒu yuē huì , bù néng cān jiā jù huì .
meaning: I have a date tonight, so I can’t join the gathering.

text: 他终于承认把地址看错了。
pinyin: tā zhōng yú chéng rèn bǎ dì zhǐ kàn cuò le .
meaning: He finally admitted he’d misread the address.

text: 别担心，我到家以后会给你消息。
pinyin: bié dān xīn , wǒ dào jiā yǐ hòu huì gěi nǐ xiāo xī .
meaning: Don’t worry; I’ll message you when I get home.

text: 你不用只考虑我的时间。
pinyin: nǐ bù yòng zhǐ kǎo lǜ wǒ de shí jiān .
meaning: You don’t need to consider only my schedule.

text: 我还没有收到他的回复。
pinyin: wǒ hái méi yǒu shōu dào tā de huí fù .
meaning: I haven’t received his reply yet.

text: 这班车可以直接到学校。
pinyin: zhè bān chē kě yǐ zhí jiē dào xué xiào .
meaning: This service goes straight to the school.

text: 你刚才的态度让我以为你生气了。
pinyin: nǐ gāng cái de tài dù ràng wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ shēng qì le .
meaning: Your manner just now made me think you were angry.

text: 他答应的事都会记下来。
pinyin: tā dā yìng de shì dū huì jì xià lái .
meaning: He writes down the things he promises to do.

text: 这段介绍解释了活动怎么报名。
pinyin: zhè duàn jiè shào jiě shì le huó dòng zěn me bào míng .
meaning: This introduction explains how to sign up for the event.

text: 他坚持自己去，不想让我陪。
pinyin: tā jiān chí zì jǐ qù , bù xiǎng ràng wǒ péi .
meaning: He insists on going himself and doesn’t want me to accompany him.

text: 先问本人，是我们做这件事的原则。他的原则是不借别人的账号。我不在乎坐哪里，只要能听清。她不在乎礼物贵不贵，更喜欢自己做的。我在乎的是你愿不愿意来，不是礼物。他很在乎朋友的意见。和她相处很轻松，不用一直找话题。我们相处了一年，才发现喜欢同一种音乐。我可能误会了，你不是这个意思吧？这个误会解释清楚以后，我们都笑了。刚到新的地方，难免有点不习惯。两个人一起做事，难免会有不同意见。他们第一次约会是在这家咖啡店。我今晚有约会，不能参加聚会。我承认自己回复得太晚了。他终于承认把地址看错了。我担心你以为我不想见你。别担心，我到家以后会给你消息。我想考虑一下，明天回复你。你不用只考虑我的时间。谢谢你这么快回复。我还没有收到他的回复。你可以直接告诉我，不用猜我想听什么。这班车可以直接到学校。她的态度很认真，但说话不重。你刚才的态度让我以为你生气了。我答应周二陪你吃饭。他答应的事都会记下来。我想解释一下为什么没去。这段介绍解释了活动怎么报名。她坚持每周给家里打电话。他坚持自己去，不想让我陪。
pinyin: xiān wèn běn rén , shì wǒ men zuò zhè jiàn shì de yuán zé . tā de yuán zé shì bù jiè bié ren de zhàng hào . wǒ bù zài hū zuò nǎ lǐ , zhǐ yào néng tīng qīng . tā bù zài hū lǐ wù guì bù guì , gèng xǐ huān zì jǐ zuò de . wǒ zài hū de shì nǐ yuàn bù yuàn yì lái , bù shì lǐ wù . tā hěn zài hū péng you de yì jiàn . hé tā xiāng chǔ hěn qīng sōng , bù yòng yì zhí zhǎo huà tí . wǒ men xiāng chǔ le yī nián , cái fā xiàn xǐ huān tóng yī zhǒng yīn yuè . wǒ kě néng wù huì le , nǐ bù shì zhè gè yì si ba ? zhè gè wù huì jiě shì qīng chǔ yǐ hòu , wǒ men dōu xiào le . gāng dào xīn de dì fāng , nán miǎn yǒu diǎn bù xí guàn . liǎng gè rén yì qǐ zuò shì , nán miǎn huì yǒu bù tóng yì jiàn . tā men dì yī cì yuē huì shì zài zhè jiā kā fēi diàn . wǒ jīn wǎn yǒu yuē huì , bù néng cān jiā jù huì . wǒ chéng rèn zì jǐ huí fù de tài wǎn le . tā zhōng yú chéng rèn bǎ dì zhǐ kàn cuò le . wǒ dān xīn nǐ yǐ wéi wǒ bù xiǎng jiàn nǐ . bié dān xīn , wǒ dào jiā yǐ hòu huì gěi nǐ xiāo xī . wǒ xiǎng kǎo lǜ yī xià , míng tiān huí fù nǐ . nǐ bù yòng zhǐ kǎo lǜ wǒ de shí jiān . xiè xiè nǐ zhè me kuài huí fù . wǒ hái méi yǒu shōu dào tā de huí fù . nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē gào sù wǒ , bù yòng cāi wǒ xiǎng tīng shén me . zhè bān chē kě yǐ zhí jiē dào xué xiào . tā de tài dù hěn rèn zhēn , dàn shuō huà bù zhòng . nǐ gāng cái de tài dù ràng wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ shēng qì le . wǒ dā yìng zhōu èr péi nǐ chī fàn . tā dā yìng de shì dū huì jì xià lái . wǒ xiǎng jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me méi qù . zhè duàn jiè shào jiě shì le huó dòng zěn me bào míng . tā jiān chí měi zhōu gěi jiā lǐ dǎ diàn huà . tā jiān chí zì jǐ qù , bù xiǎng ràng wǒ péi .
meaning: Asking the person first is our principle for this. His principle is not to borrow someone else’s account. I don’t mind where I sit as long as I can hear. She doesn’t care whether a gift is expensive; she prefers homemade ones. What matters to me is whether you want to come, not the gift. He cares a lot about his friends' opinions. Spending time with her is easy; I don’t have to keep finding topics. We spent a year together before realising we liked the same music. I may have misunderstood; that isn’t what you meant, is it? We both laughed once the misunderstanding was cleared up. It’s natural to feel a little unfamiliar in a new place. When two people work together, disagreements are hard to avoid. Their first date was at this café. I have a date tonight, so I can’t join the gathering. I admit I replied too late. He finally admitted he’d misread the address. I’m worried you’ll think I don’t want to see you. Don’t worry; I’ll message you when I get home. I’d like to think about it and reply tomorrow. You don’t need to consider only my schedule. Thanks for replying so quickly. I haven’t received his reply yet. You can tell me directly; no need to guess what I want to hear. This service goes straight to the school. She takes it seriously without speaking harshly. Your manner just now made me think you were angry. I agreed to have dinner with you on Tuesday. He writes down the things he promises to do. I’d like to explain why I didn’t go. This introduction explains how to sign up for the event. She keeps calling home every week. He insists on going himself and doesn’t want me to accompany him.

text: 早？我不是晚了十分钟吗？
pinyin: zǎo ? wǒ bù shì wǎn le shí fēn zhōng ma ?
meaning: Early? Aren’t I ten minutes late?

text: 对，我的咖啡都快喝完了。
pinyin: duì , wǒ de kā fēi dōu kuài hē wán le .
meaning: Exactly. I’ve almost finished my coffee.

text: 懂了，你在笑我。对不起，刚才走错出口了。
pinyin: dǒng le , nǐ zài xiào wǒ . duì bù qǐ , gāng cái zǒu cuò chū kǒu le .
meaning: Got it. You’re teasing me. Sorry, I took the wrong exit.

text: 先坐吧。怎么穿这么正式？你等会儿还要去开会？
pinyin: xiān zuò ba . zěn me chuān zhè me zhèng shì ? nǐ děng huì ér hái yào qù kāi huì ?
meaning: Sit down first. Why so formal? Do you have a meeting later?

text: 没有，今天第一次穿这件外套。不好看吗？
pinyin: méi yǒu , jīn tiān dì yī cì chuān zhè jiàn wài tào . bù hǎo kàn ma ?
meaning: No, it’s my first time wearing this coat. Doesn’t it look good?

text: 怪好看的。我刚才还以为你要去领奖。
pinyin: guài hǎo kàn de . wǒ gāng cái hái yǐ wéi nǐ yào qù lǐng jiǎng .
meaning: It looks pretty good. I thought you were going to collect an award.

text: 那你快给我颁一个，别只有咖啡。
pinyin: nà nǐ kuài gěi wǒ bān yī gè , bié zhǐ yǒu kā fēi .
meaning: Then hurry up and give me one instead of just coffee.

text: 给你一个“终于找到出口”的奖，行不行？
pinyin: gěi nǐ yī gè zhōng yú zhǎo dào chū kǒu de jiǎng , xíng bù xíng ?
meaning: An award for “finally finding the exit”—will that do?

text: 才不要呢。你上次还让我去错了车站。
pinyin: cái bú yào ne . nǐ shàng cì hái ràng wǒ qù cuò le chē zhàn .
meaning: No thanks. You sent me to the wrong station last time.

text: 好好好，这个话题跳过。想吃什么？
pinyin: hǎo hǎo hǎo , zhè gè huà tí tiào guò . xiǎng chī shén me ?
meaning: All right, all right, let’s skip that topic. What would you like to eat?

text: 先来点甜的。听你说完，我现在需要点安慰。
pinyin: xiān lái diǎn tián de . tīng nǐ shuō wán , wǒ xiàn zài xū yào diǎn ān wèi .
meaning: Something sweet first. After hearing you out, I could use some comfort.

text: 我第一次听到“你今天可真早”，是在迟到十分钟以后。按字面看，朋友像是在夸我；看他已经喝完半杯咖啡的样子，就知道不是这个意思。
pinyin: wǒ dì yī cì tīng dào nǐ jīn tiān kě zhēn zǎo , shì zài chí dào shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu . àn zì miàn kàn , péng you xiàng shì zài kuā wǒ ; kàn tā yǐ jīng hē wán bàn bēi kā fēi de yàng zi , jiù zhī dào bù shì zhè gè yì si .
meaning: The first time I heard “you’re really early today” was after arriving ten minutes late. Literally it sounded like praise, but seeing my friend with half his coffee gone made the intention clear.

text: 那天我们笑了几句，很快开始点吃的。我认识他很久，知道他会拿我的迟到开玩笑，也知道说一句对不起就能把事情接过去。
pinyin: nà tiān wǒ men xiào le jǐ jù , hěn kuài kāi shǐ diǎn chī de . wǒ rèn shi tā hěn jiǔ , zhī dào tā huì ná wǒ de chí dào kāi wán xiào , yě zhī dào shuō yī jù duì bù qǐ jiù néng bǎ shì qíng jiē guò qù .
meaning: We joked briefly and soon started ordering food. I’d known him a long time and knew he teased me about lateness; a quick apology let us move on.

text: 后来我在活动里看到一个新同学迟到，差点也说同样的话。她进门时很紧张，一直解释公交车改了路线。我最后只说“没关系，先坐吧”，没有照搬朋友的说法。
pinyin: hòu lái wǒ zài huó dòng lǐ kàn dào yī gè xīn tóng xué chí dào , chà diǎn yě shuō tóng yàng de huà . tā jìn mén shí hěn jǐn zhāng , yì zhí jiě shì gōng jiāo chē gǎi le lù xiàn . wǒ zuì hòu zhǐ shuō méi guān xì , xiān zuò ba , méi yǒu zhào bān péng you de shuō fǎ .
meaning: Later, at an event, a new classmate arrived late and I almost used the same phrase. She was nervous and kept explaining that her bus route had changed. I just said, “It’s okay, sit down,” rather than copying my friend’s line.

text: 活动结束后，她问我刚才是不是错过了重要内容。我把前面的安排说给她听，我们后来聊了喜欢的音乐。熟悉以后，也会开玩笑，但不是一开始就拿她着急的事来笑。
pinyin: huó dòng jié shù hòu , tā wèn wǒ gāng cái shì bú shì cuò guò le zhòng yào nèi róng . wǒ bǎ qián miàn de ān pái shuō gěi tā tīng , wǒ men hòu lái liáo le xǐ huān de yīn yuè . shú xī yǐ hòu , yě huì kāi wán xiào , dàn bù shì yī kāi shǐ jiù ná tā zháo jí de shì lái xiào .
meaning: Afterwards she asked whether she’d missed anything important. I explained the plans, and we later talked about music we liked. Once we knew each other we joked too, but I didn’t start by teasing her about something that was worrying her.

text: 我给自己记下的不是一句固定的“友好表达”，而是三个问题：刚才发生了什么？两个人熟不熟？对方现在什么表情？同样一句话，答案变了，听起来也会变。
pinyin: wǒ gěi zì jǐ jì xià de bù shì yī jù gù dìng de yǒu hǎo biǎo dá , ér shì sān gè wèn tí : gāng cái fā shēng le shén me ? liǎng gè rén shú bù shú ? duì fāng xiàn zài shén me biǎo qíng ? tóng yàng yī jù huà , dá àn biàn le , tīng qǐ lái yě huì biàn .
meaning: I didn’t note a fixed “friendly phrase,” but three questions: what just happened, how well do the people know each other, and what expression does the other person have? When those answers change, the same sentence can sound different.

text: 现在看剧时，我会留意说话前后发生的事。人物说“真不错”，可能是真心称赞，也可能是对刚发生的问题作出反应。我先找线索，不只找一个词的翻译。
pinyin: xiàn zài kàn jù shí , wǒ huì liú yì shuō huà qián hòu fā shēng de shì . rén wù shuō zhēn bù cuò , kě néng shì zhēn xīn chēng zàn , yě kě néng shì duì gāng fā shēng de wèn tí zuò chū fǎn yìng . wǒ xiān zhǎo xiàn suǒ , bù zhǐ zhǎo yī gè cí de fān yì .
meaning: Now when watching dramas I notice what happens before and after a line. “Really good” may be sincere praise or a reaction to a problem. I look for clues rather than just the translation of one word.
