pinyin: wǒ dì yī cì tīng dào nǐ jīn tiān kě zhēn zǎo , shì zài chí dào shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu . àn zì miàn kàn , péng you xiàng shì zài kuā wǒ ; kàn tā yǐ jīng hē wán bàn bēi kā fēi de yàng zi , jiù zhī dào bù shì zhè gè yì si . nà tiān wǒ men xiào le jǐ jù , hěn kuài kāi shǐ diǎn chī de . wǒ rèn shi tā hěn jiǔ , zhī dào tā huì ná wǒ de chí dào kāi wán xiào , yě zhī dào shuō yī jù duì bù qǐ jiù néng bǎ shì qíng jiē guò qù . hòu lái wǒ zài huó dòng lǐ kàn dào yī gè xīn tóng xué chí dào , chà diǎn yě shuō tóng yàng de huà . tā jìn mén shí hěn jǐn zhāng , yì zhí jiě shì gōng jiāo chē gǎi le lù xiàn . wǒ zuì hòu zhǐ shuō méi guān xì , xiān zuò ba , méi yǒu zhào bān péng you de shuō fǎ . huó dòng jié shù hòu , tā wèn wǒ gāng cái shì bú shì cuò guò le zhòng yào nèi róng . wǒ bǎ qián miàn de ān pái shuō gěi tā tīng , wǒ men hòu lái liáo le xǐ huān de yīn yuè . shú xī yǐ hòu , yě huì kāi wán xiào , dàn bù shì yī kāi shǐ jiù ná tā zháo jí de shì lái xiào . wǒ gěi zì jǐ jì xià de bù shì yī jù gù dìng de yǒu hǎo biǎo dá , ér shì sān gè wèn tí : gāng cái fā shēng le shén me ? liǎng gè rén shú bù shú ? duì fāng xiàn zài shén me biǎo qíng ? tóng yàng yī jù huà , dá àn biàn le , tīng qǐ lái yě huì biàn . xiàn zài kàn jù shí , wǒ huì liú yì shuō huà qián hòu fā shēng de shì . rén wù shuō zhēn bù cuò , kě néng shì zhēn xīn chēng zàn , yě kě néng shì duì gāng fā shēng de wèn tí zuò chū fǎn yìng . wǒ xiān zhǎo xiàn suǒ , bù zhǐ zhǎo yī gè cí de fān yì .
meaning: The first time I heard “you’re really early today” was after arriving ten minutes late. Literally it sounded like praise, but seeing my friend with half his coffee gone made the intention clear. We joked briefly and soon started ordering food. I’d known him a long time and knew he teased me about lateness; a quick apology let us move on. Later, at an event, a new classmate arrived late and I almost used the same phrase. She was nervous and kept explaining that her bus route had changed. I just said, “It’s okay, sit down,” rather than copying my friend’s line. Afterwards she asked whether she’d missed anything important. I explained the plans, and we later talked about music we liked. Once we knew each other we joked too, but I didn’t start by teasing her about something that was worrying her. I didn’t note a fixed “friendly phrase,” but three questions: what just happened, how well do the people know each other, and what expression does the other person have? When those answers change, the same sentence can sound different. Now when watching dramas I notice what happens before and after a line. “Really good” may be sincere praise or a reaction to a problem. I look for clues rather than just the translation of one word.

text: 还没吃怎么夸？

text: 也是。吃完再说，别只说“不难吃”。

text: 要求还挺高。好，我认真吃。

text: 妹妹明天第一次独自坐火车去外地。哥哥以前总会替她拿行李，陪她找到座位，再站在窗外挥手。这次她提前把票和地址确认好了，想自己完成这些事。
pinyin: mèi mei míng tiān dì yī cì dú zì zuò huǒ chē qù wài dì . gē gē yǐ qián zǒng huì tì tā ná xíng lǐ , péi tā zhǎo dào zuò wèi , zài zhàn zài chuāng wài huī shǒu . zhè cì tā tí qián bǎ piào hé dì zhǐ què rèn hǎo le , xiǎng zì jǐ wán chéng zhè xiē shì .
meaning: The younger sister was taking her first solo train trip away from home the next day. Her brother usually carried her luggage, found her seat and waved through the window. This time she had checked her ticket and address and wanted to manage those things herself.

text: 早上哥哥还没醒，她在桌上留了一张纸条：“这次我自己走，到站给你电话。”她拿起包就出门了，却把身份证留在昨晚整理材料的地方。
pinyin: zǎo shàng gē gē hái méi xǐng , tā zài zhuō shàng liú le yī zhāng zhǐ tiáo : zhè cì wǒ zì jǐ zǒu , dào zhàn gěi nǐ diàn huà . tā ná qǐ bāo jiù chū mén le , què bǎ shēn fèn zhèng liú zài zuó wǎn zhěng lǐ cái liào de dì fāng .
meaning: In the morning, before her brother woke, she left a note: “I’ll go alone this time and call when I arrive.” She picked up her bag and left, but her ID remained where she’d sorted her documents the night before.

text: 哥哥醒来先看见纸条，又发现桌上的身份证。他没有立刻说妹妹不能独自去，而是给她打电话，确认她还在车站附近，再把东西送过去。
pinyin: gē gē xǐng lái xiān kàn jiàn zhǐ tiáo , yòu fā xiàn zhuō shàng de shēn fèn zhèng . tā méi yǒu lì kè shuō mèi mei bù néng dú zì qù , ér shì gěi tā dǎ diàn huà , què rèn tā hái zài chē zhàn fù jìn , zài bǎ dōng xi sòng guò qù .
meaning: Her brother woke, saw the note and then the ID on the table. Instead of immediately saying she couldn’t travel alone, he called, checked she was still near the station and brought it to her.

text: 妹妹接过身份证，有点不好意思：“看来我还是需要你。”哥哥说：“忘了东西就拿给你，这和你能不能自己走是两回事。”他帮她把包关好，但没有像以前一样一路陪到座位。
pinyin: mèi mei jiē guò shēn fèn zhèng , yǒu diǎn bù hǎo yì sī : kàn lái wǒ hái shi xū yào nǐ . gē gē shuō : wàng le dōng xi jiù ná gěi nǐ , zhè hé nǐ néng bù néng zì jǐ zǒu shì liǎng huí shì . tā bāng tā bǎ bāo guān hǎo , dàn méi yǒu xiàng yǐ qián yī yàng yī lù péi dào zuò wèi .
meaning: She took the ID, a little embarrassed: “Looks like I still need you.” He replied, “Bringing you something you forgot is separate from whether you can go yourself.” He closed her bag but didn’t accompany her all the way to her seat as before.

text: 车开以后，她发了一张窗外的照片。哥哥回复：“到了再打电话。”照片里没有哥哥，也没有车站，只有早上的光和沿途的树。
pinyin: chē kāi yǐ hòu , tā fā le yī zhāng chuāng wài de zhào piān . gē gē huí fù : dào le zài dǎ diàn huà . zhào piān lǐ méi yǒu gē gē , yě méi yǒu chē zhàn , zhǐ yǒu zǎo shàng de guāng hé yán tú de shù .
meaning: After the train left, she sent a photo through the window. Her brother replied, “Call when you arrive.” The photo contained neither him nor the station, just morning light and trees along the route.

text: 这个故事没有说妹妹从此不需要帮助。她漏了一样东西，接受了帮助，仍然完成了自己想试的旅行。概括时如果只说“哥哥追到车站”，就会漏掉为什么去、去了以后做了什么。
pinyin: zhè gè gù shì méi yǒu shuō mèi mei cóng cǐ bù xū yào bāng zhù . tā lòu le yī yàng dōng xi , jiē shòu le bāng zhù , réng rán wán chéng le zì jǐ xiǎng shì de lǚ xíng . gài kuò shí rú guǒ zhǐ shuō gē gē zhuī dào chē zhàn , jiù huì lòu diào wèi shén me qù , qù le yǐ hòu zuò le shén me .
meaning: The story doesn’t say she never needed help again. She forgot an item, accepted help and still made the trip she wanted to try. A summary saying only “her brother followed her to the station” would leave out why he went and what he did there.

知道了。你也别只回复一个“好”。
那我换一句：“到了吗？”
还没出发呢，你倒先问上了。

text: 她概括了大家的意见，没有重复每个人的话。
pinyin: tā gài kuò le dà jiā de yì jiàn , méi yǒu chóng fù měi gè rén de huà .
meaning: She summarised everyone’s views without repeating each person’s words.

text: 他把那天的情况描述得很清楚。
pinyin: tā bǎ nà tiān de qíng kuàng miáo shù de hěn qīng chǔ .
meaning: He described that day’s events clearly.

text: 我们先定主题，再选材料。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān dìng zhǔ tí , zài xuǎn cái liào .
meaning: Let’s choose the theme before selecting material.

text: 你说的顺序和照片里的不一样。
pinyin: nǐ shuō de shùn xù hé zhào piān lǐ de bù yī yàng .
meaning: Your sequence differs from the one in the photos.

text: 不了解背景，很容易误会这句话。
pinyin: bù liǎo jiě bèi jǐng , hěn róng yì wù huì zhè jù huà .
meaning: Without the background, it’s easy to misunderstand this sentence.

text: 她在活动中的角色是主持人。
pinyin: tā zài huó dòng zhōng de jué sè shì zhǔ chí rén .
meaning: Her role at the event is host.

text: 这个细节前面也出现过。
pinyin: zhè gè xì jié qián miàn yě chū xiàn guò .
meaning: This detail appeared earlier too.

text: 你的结论有哪一句话支持？
pinyin: nǐ de jié lùn yǒu nǎ yī jù huà zhī chí ?
meaning: Which sentence supports your conclusion?

text: 我想知道迟到的真正原因。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhī dào chí dào de zhēn zhèng yuán yīn .
meaning: I’d like to know the real reason for the delay.

text: 等结果出来以后再通知大家。
pinyin: děng jié guǒ chū lái yǐ hòu zài tōng zhī dà jiā .
meaning: Tell everyone after the results come out.

text: 他没接电话，于是我发了消息。
pinyin: tā méi jiē diàn huà , yú shì wǒ fā le xiāo xī .
meaning: He didn’t answer, so I sent a message.

text: 我们在车站认识，从此成了朋友。
pinyin: wǒ men zài chē zhàn rèn shi , cóng cǐ chéng le péng you .
meaning: We met at the station and became friends from then on.

text: 最初的计划是一起坐公交车。
pinyin: zuì chū de jì huà shì yì qǐ zuò gōng jiāo chē .
meaning: The initial plan was to take the bus together.

text: 这篇日记总结了我一个月的经历。
pinyin: zhè piān rì jì zǒng jié le wǒ yī gè yuè de jīng lì .
meaning: This diary entry sums up my experiences over a month.

text: 我对这家店的第一印象很好。
pinyin: wǒ duì zhè jiā diàn de dì yī yìn xiàng hěn hǎo .
meaning: My first impression of this shop was good.

text: 经历了这件事以后，她更愿意直接问了。
pinyin: jīng lì le zhè jiàn shì yǐ hòu , tā gèng yuàn yì zhí jiē wèn le .
meaning: After going through this, she became more willing to ask directly.

text: 你终于来了。我们说的是两点，现在三点了。
pinyin: nǐ zhōng yú lái le . wǒ men shuō de shì liǎng diǎn , xiàn zài sān diǎn le .
meaning: You’re finally here. We agreed on two, and now it’s three.

text: 对不起，临时被叫去开会了，手机还放在桌上。
pinyin: duì bù qǐ , lín shí bèi jiào qù kāi huì le , shǒu jī hái fàng zài zhuō shàng .
meaning: Sorry. I was called into a meeting at short notice, and my phone was still on the desk.

text: 我给你打了两次，以为你在路上。司机两点半就走了。
pinyin: wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ le liǎng cì , yǐ wéi nǐ zài lù shàng . sī jī liǎng diǎn bàn jiù zǒu le .
meaning: I called you twice and thought you were on the way. The driver left at half past two.

text: 东西都搬上去了？
pinyin: dōng xi dōu bān shàng qù le ?
meaning: Is everything upstairs?

text: 邻居帮我把重的搬好了，还有两箱书没整理。
pinyin: lín jū bāng wǒ bǎ zhòng de bān hǎo le , hái yǒu liǎng xiāng shū méi zhěng lǐ .
meaning: A neighbour helped carry the heavy things up. There are two boxes of books left to unpack.

text: 那我现在来整理，你先休息一下。
pinyin: nà wǒ xiàn zài lái zhěng lǐ , nǐ xiān xiū xī yī xià .
meaning: Then I’ll unpack them now while you rest.

text: 先等一下。我不是只想听你说现在能做什么。
pinyin: xiān děng yī xià . wǒ bù shì zhǐ xiǎng tīng nǐ shuō xiàn zài néng zuò shén me .
meaning: Wait a moment. I don’t only want to hear what you can do now.

text: 我知道，你等了一个小时。
pinyin: wǒ zhī dào , nǐ děng le yī gè xiǎo shí .
meaning: I know. You waited an hour.

text: 不只是等。我不知道你来不来，就没找别人，最后才去敲邻居的门。
pinyin: bù zhǐ shì děng . wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ lái bù lái , jiù méi zhǎo bié ren , zuì hòu cái qù qiāo lín jū de mén .
meaning: Not just waiting. I didn’t know whether you’d come, so I didn’t ask anyone else until I knocked on the neighbour’s door at the last moment.

text: 是我的问题。我以为开完会再告诉你就行，没想到你还在等。
pinyin: shì wǒ de wèn tí . wǒ yǐ wéi kāi wán huì zài gào sù nǐ jiù xíng , méi xiǎng dào nǐ hái zài děng .
meaning: That’s my fault. I thought I could tell you after the meeting; I didn’t realise you were still waiting.

text: 我们约好了，我当然会等。你早点说，我就能改安排。
pinyin: wǒ men yuē hǎo le , wǒ dāng rán huì děng . nǐ zǎo diǎn shuō , wǒ jiù néng gǎi ān pái .
meaning: We’d made a plan, so of course I’d wait. If you’d told me sooner, I could’ve changed it.

text: 对，我不该让你自己猜。今天晚点还需要帮忙吗？
pinyin: duì , wǒ bù gāi ràng nǐ zì jǐ cāi . jīn tiān wǎn diǎn hái xū yào bāng máng ma ?
meaning: Right, I shouldn’t have left you guessing. Do you still need help later today?

text: 这两箱先放书架上。不过不用把所有书都按颜色排。
pinyin: zhè liǎng xiāng xiān fàng shū jià shàng . bù guò bù yòng bǎ suǒ yǒu shū dōu àn yán sè pái .
meaning: Put these books on the shelf first. But don’t arrange every book by colour.

text: 为什么？你不是说想让房间好看一点？
pinyin: wèi shén me ? nǐ bù shì shuō xiǎng ràng fáng jiān hǎo kàn yī diǎn ?
meaning: Why? Didn’t you say you wanted the room to look nicer?

text: 好看是一回事，找得到书是另一回事。我上次找那本字典找了半天。
pinyin: hǎo kàn shì yī huí shì , zhǎo de dào shū shì lìng yī huí shì . wǒ shàng cì zhǎo nà běn zì diǎn zhǎo le bàn tiān .
meaning: Looking nice is one thing; finding books is another. Last time it took me ages to find that dictionary.

text: 好，按你写的顺序放。我先问清楚，不自己决定。
pinyin: hǎo , àn nǐ xiě de shùn xù fàng . wǒ xiān wèn qīng chǔ , bù zì jǐ jué dìng .
meaning: Okay, I’ll use the order you’ve written down. I’ll ask first rather than decide myself.

text: 这样就好。下次有变化，哪怕只发一句话，也早点告诉我。
pinyin: zhè yàng jiù hǎo . xià cì yǒu biàn huà , nǎ pà zhǐ fā yī jù huà , yě zǎo diǎn gào sù wǒ .
meaning: That’s fine. Next time something changes, even a short message is enough—tell me early.

text: 记住了。现在请指挥，我今天不负责猜。
pinyin: jì zhù le . xiàn zài qǐng zhǐ huī , wǒ jīn tiān bù fù zé cāi .
meaning: Got it. Tell me what to do; today I’m not in charge of guessing.

好，按你写的顺序放。我先问清楚，不自己决定。
这样就好。下次有变化，哪怕只发一句话，也早点告诉我。
记住了。现在请指挥，我今天不负责猜。

text: 搬家前一天，我和朋友约好下午两点见。他来帮我搬几个重箱子，我已经订好了车，司机说两点半以前要出发去下一个地方。我把时间发给朋友，他回复“没问题”，于是没有再找第二个人。
pinyin: bān jiā qián yī tiān , wǒ hé péng you yuē hǎo xià wǔ liǎng diǎn jiàn . tā lái bāng wǒ bān jǐ gè zhòng xiāng zi , wǒ yǐ jīng dìng hǎo le chē , sī jī shuō liǎng diǎn bàn yǐ qián yào chū fā qù xià yī gè dì fāng . wǒ bǎ shí jiān fā gěi péng you , tā huí fù méi wèn tí , yú shì méi yǒu zài zhǎo dì èr gè rén .
meaning: The day before moving, a friend and I agreed to meet at two. He’d help with the heavy boxes. I’d booked a vehicle whose driver had to leave for another job by half past two. My friend replied “no problem” to the time, so I didn’t ask anyone else.

text: 第二天，两点过了，门外还没人。我给他打电话，没有接。我最初以为他在路上，不方便看手机，就先整理小东西。到了两点二十，我不能再等，去问邻居能不能帮十分钟。邻居把重箱子搬上楼，我送司机离开时，才松了一口气。
pinyin: dì èr tiān , liǎng diǎn guò le , mén wài hái méi rén . wǒ gěi tā dǎ diàn huà , méi yǒu jiē . wǒ zuì chū yǐ wéi tā zài lù shàng , bù fāng biàn kàn shǒu jī , jiù xiān zhěng lǐ xiǎo dōng xi . dào le liǎng diǎn èr shí , wǒ bù néng zài děng , qù wèn lín jū néng bù néng bāng shí fēn zhōng . lín jū bǎ zhòng xiāng zi bān shàng lóu , wǒ sòng sī jī lí kāi shí , cái sōng le yì kǒu qì .
meaning: At two the next day, nobody arrived. I called, but he didn’t answer. At first I thought he was travelling and couldn’t check his phone, so I sorted smaller items. At twenty past two I couldn’t wait longer and asked a neighbour for ten minutes of help. Once the heavy boxes were upstairs and the driver left, I finally breathed easier.

text: 三点，朋友终于来了。他说临时开会，手机留在桌上，没有机会看到电话。我相信那场会议不是他故意安排的，但还是生气。既然他已经答应了两点到，我就在根据这个答复做安排。没有新消息，我不知道原来的安排还算不算。
pinyin: sān diǎn , péng you zhōng yú lái le . tā shuō lín shí kāi huì , shǒu jī liú zài zhuō shàng , méi yǒu jī huì kàn dào diàn huà . wǒ xiāng xìn nà chǎng huì yì bù shì tā gù yì ān pái de , dàn hái shi shēng qì . jì rán tā yǐ jīng dā yìng le liǎng diǎn dào , wǒ jiù zài gēn jù zhè gè dá fù zuò ān pái . méi yǒu xīn xiāo xī , wǒ bù zhī dào yuán lái de ān pái hái suàn bù suàn .
meaning: My friend finally arrived at three. He said a meeting had come up and his phone had stayed on his desk. I believed he hadn’t deliberately scheduled it, but I was still angry. His agreement to arrive at two had shaped my plans. Without an update, I didn’t know whether that agreement still held.

text: 他想马上开始做事，我请他先听我说完。两次电话没人接的时候，我还在楼下等，以为他过一会儿就到。司机已经把车停在门口，我却不知道该让司机再等，还是去找邻居。他听完，低头看了看那两个未接电话，说下次开会以前就联系我。
pinyin: tā xiǎng mǎ shàng kāi shǐ zuò shì , wǒ qǐng tā xiān tīng wǒ shuō wán . liǎng cì diàn huà méi rén jiē de shí hou , wǒ hái zài lóu xià děng , yǐ wéi tā guò yī huì er jiù dào . sī jī yǐ jīng bǎ chē tíng zài mén kǒu , wǒ què bù zhī dào gāi ràng sī jī zài děng , hái shi qù zhǎo lín jū . tā tīng wán , dī tóu kàn le kàn nà liǎng gè wèi jiē diàn huà , shuō xià cì kāi huì yǐ qián jiù lián xì wǒ .
meaning: He wanted to start helping straight away, but I asked him to hear me out. When my two calls went unanswered, I was still downstairs expecting him soon. The driver was waiting outside, and I didn't know whether to ask him to wait longer or fetch a neighbour. My friend looked at the missed calls and said he'd contact me before the meeting next time.

text: 后来，我们一起把剩下的书放上书架。他先问我按什么顺序放，没有像上次那样只按颜色排。我把字典和常用的几本放在手边，其余的按书名排好。最后一箱打开时，里面竟然还有一杯没喝完的水。他笑我搬家连水都不肯扔，我才想起那是早上随手放进去的。
pinyin: hòu lái , wǒ men yì qǐ bǎ shèng xià de shū fàng shàng shū jià . tā xiān wèn wǒ àn shén me shùn xù fàng , méi yǒu xiàng shàng cì nà yàng zhǐ àn yán sè pái . wǒ bǎ zì diǎn hé cháng yòng de jǐ běn fàng zài shǒu biān , qí yú de àn shū míng pái hǎo . zuì hòu yī xiāng dǎ kāi shí , lǐ miàn jìng rán hái yǒu yī bēi méi hē wán de shuǐ . tā xiào wǒ bān jiā lián shuǐ dōu bù kěn rēng , wǒ cái xiǎng qǐ nà shì zǎo shàng suí shǒu fàng jìn qù de .
meaning: Later we put the remaining books on the shelves together. He asked how I wanted them arranged, rather than sorting by colour as he'd done before. I kept the dictionary and a few frequently used books within reach and sorted the others by title. The last box contained a half-finished cup of water. He laughed that I wouldn't even throw water away when moving; I'd put it there absent-mindedly that morning.

text: 晚上，我给邻居发消息谢谢他，也把借来的工具还了。朋友问下周还需要他做什么，我看了看空了一半的房间，说先让我把今天这些东西放好吧。他说行，周末有空一起吃饭。我答应了，又提醒他别到时候直接来旧地址。他拿起手机，马上把新地址存好了。
pinyin: wǎn shang , wǒ gěi lín jū fā xiāo xī xiè xiè tā , yě bǎ jiè lái de gōng jù huán le . péng you wèn xià zhōu hái xū yào tā zuò shén me , wǒ kàn le kàn kōng le yí bàn de fáng jiān , shuō xiān ràng wǒ bǎ jīn tiān zhè xiē dōng xi fàng hǎo ba . tā shuō xíng , zhōu mò yǒu kōng yì qǐ chī fàn . wǒ dā yìng le , yòu tí xǐng tā bié dào shí hou zhí jiē lái jiù dì zhǐ . tā ná qǐ shǒu jī , mǎ shàng bǎ xīn dì zhǐ cún hǎo le .
meaning: That evening I thanked the neighbour by message and returned the borrowed tools. My friend asked what I needed next week. Looking at the half-empty room, I said to let me put today's things away first. He suggested dinner at the weekend. I agreed and reminded him not to turn up at my old address. He took out his phone and saved the new one immediately.

text: 几天以后，朋友发来周末吃饭的时间。这次他先说星期六下午还要上班，六点以后才方便。我回他六点半见，又把饭馆门口的照片发过去。到了那天，他下班时给我打电话，说车站人有点多，可能晚十分钟。我先进去找座位，等他到了再点菜，没有像搬家那天一样站在门外猜。
pinyin: jǐ tiān yǐ hòu , péng you fā lái zhōu mò chī fàn de shí jiān . zhè cì tā xiān shuō xīng qī liù xià wǔ hái yào shàng bān , liù diǎn yǐ hòu cái fāng biàn . wǒ huí tā liù diǎn bàn jiàn , yòu bǎ fàn guǎn mén kǒu de zhào piān fā guò qù . dào le nà tiān , tā xià bān shí gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà , shuō chē zhàn rén yǒu diǎn duō , kě néng wǎn shí fēn zhōng . wǒ xiān jìn qù zhǎo zuò wèi , děng tā dào le zài diǎn cài , méi yǒu xiàng bān jiā nà tiān yī yàng zhàn zài mén wài cāi .
meaning: A few days later he messaged about weekend dinner. This time he said he was working on Saturday afternoon and was free after six. I suggested half past six and sent a photo of the restaurant entrance. On the day he called after work: the station was busy, and he might be ten minutes late. I went in to find a table and waited to order with him, instead of standing outside guessing as I had on moving day.

text: 第二层，和其他字典放一起。

text: 这么多字典，你都看过？

meaning: You’ve read all these dictionaries?

text: 字典不是从头看到尾的，想查什么就找什么。
pinyin: zì diǎn bù shì cóng tóu kàn dào wěi de , xiǎng chá shén me jiù zhǎo shén me .
meaning: You don’t read a dictionary cover to cover. You look up what you need.

text: 那我上次按颜色排，确实不太方便。
pinyin: nà wǒ shàng cì àn yán sè pái , què shí bù tài fāng biàn .
meaning: Then arranging them by colour last time really wasn’t convenient.

text: 你还把一本菜谱放进去了。
pinyin: nǐ hái bǎ yī běn cài pǔ fàng jìn qù le .
meaning: You even put a cookbook among them.

text: 里面有很多我不认识的字，我以为也算。
pinyin: lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō wǒ bù rèn shi de zì , wǒ yǐ wéi yě suàn .
meaning: It had lots of characters I didn’t know, so I thought it counted.

text: 那你这次先看书名，别只看自己认不认识。
pinyin: nà nǐ zhè cì xiān kàn shū míng , bié zhǐ kàn zì jǐ rèn bù rèn shi .
meaning: Read the titles this time, not just whether you know the characters.

text: 好。这本我认识，写着面条。
pinyin: hǎo . zhè běn wǒ rèn shi , xiě zhe miàn tiáo .
meaning: Okay, I know this one. It says noodles.

text: 对，放下面。整理完我们就去吃。
pinyin: duì , fàng xià miàn . zhěng lǐ wán wǒ men jiù qù chī .
meaning: Right, put it below. We’ll get food after tidying.

text: 现在我很有动力了。
pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ hěn yǒu dòng lì le .
meaning: Now I’m motivated.

text: 早知道，刚才先给你看这本。
pinyin: zǎo zhī dào , gāng cái xiān gěi nǐ kàn zhè běn .
meaning: If I’d known, I’d have shown you that one first.

text: 这本放在哪里？第二层，和其他字典放一起。这么多字典，你都看过？字典不是从头看到尾的，想查什么就找什么。那我上次按颜色排，确实不太方便。你还把一本菜谱放进去了。里面有很多我不认识的字，我以为也算。那你这次先看书名，别只看自己认不认识。好。这本我认识，写着面条。对，放下面。整理完我们就去吃。现在我很有动力了。早知道，刚才先给你看这本。
pinyin: zhè běn fàng zài nǎ lǐ ? dì èr céng , hé qí tā zì diǎn fàng yì qǐ . zhè me duō zì diǎn , nǐ dōu kàn guò ? zì diǎn bù shì cóng tóu kàn dào wěi de , xiǎng chá shén me jiù zhǎo shén me . nà wǒ shàng cì àn yán sè pái , què shí bù tài fāng biàn . nǐ hái bǎ yī běn cài pǔ fàng jìn qù le . lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō wǒ bù rèn shi de zì , wǒ yǐ wéi yě suàn . nà nǐ zhè cì xiān kàn shū míng , bié zhǐ kàn zì jǐ rèn bù rèn shi . hǎo . zhè běn wǒ rèn shi , xiě zhe miàn tiáo . duì , fàng xià miàn . zhěng lǐ wán wǒ men jiù qù chī . xiàn zài wǒ hěn yǒu dòng lì le . zǎo zhī dào , gāng cái xiān gěi nǐ kàn zhè běn .
meaning: Where does this book go? On the second shelf with the other dictionaries. You’ve read all these dictionaries? You don’t read a dictionary cover to cover. You look up what you need. Then arranging them by colour last time really wasn’t convenient. You even put a cookbook among them. It had lots of characters I didn’t know, so I thought it counted. Read the titles this time, not just whether you know the characters. Okay, I know this one. It says noodles. Right, put it below. We’ll get food after tidying. Now I’m motivated. If I’d known, I’d have shown you that one first.

text: 我们有意见冲突，但还能一起做事。
pinyin: wǒ men yǒu yì jiàn chōng tū , dàn hái néng yì qǐ zuò shì .
meaning: We disagree, but can still work together.

text: 我们沟通以后，发现想解决的是同一个问题。
pinyin: wǒ men gōu tōng yǐ hòu , fā xiàn xiǎng jiě jué de shì tóng yī gè wèn tí .
meaning: After talking, we found we wanted to solve the same problem.

text: 我想真诚地说明自己的想法。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhēn chéng de shuō míng zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ .
meaning: I’d like to explain my thoughts sincerely.

text: 尊重别人的时间，也包括早点告诉他变化。
pinyin: zūn zhòng bié ren de shí jiān , yě bāo kuò zǎo diǎn gào sù tā biàn huà .
meaning: Respecting someone’s time includes telling them about changes early.

text: 我们之间的矛盾不是今天才有的。
pinyin: wǒ men zhī jiān de máo dùn bù shì jīn tiān cái yǒu de .
meaning: The conflict between us didn’t begin today.

text: 我不是抱怨你忙，我是想知道你来不来。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì bào yuàn nǐ máng , wǒ shì xiǎng zhī dào nǐ lái bù lái .
meaning: I’m not complaining that you’re busy; I want to know whether you’ll come.

text: 这不是偶然，每次他都提前准备。
pinyin: zhè bù shì ǒu rán , měi cì tā dōu tí qián zhǔn bèi .
meaning: This isn’t a coincidence; he prepares in advance every time.

text: 发现失误以后，先把结果改正。
pinyin: fā xiàn shī wù yǐ hòu , xiān bǎ jié guǒ gǎi zhèng .
meaning: Correct the result once you’ve found the mistake.

text: 我也很无奈，但不能让你一直等。
pinyin: wǒ yě hěn wú nài , dàn bù néng ràng nǐ yì zhí děng .
meaning: I have few options too, but I can’t keep you waiting.

text: 他今天有点消极，觉得怎么做都没用。
pinyin: tā jīn tiān yǒu diǎn xiāo jí , jué de zěn me zuò dōu méi yòng .
meaning: He’s feeling negative today and thinks nothing he does will help.

text: 这次旅行让我们的友谊更深了。
pinyin: zhè cì lǚ xíng ràng wǒ men de yǒu yì gèng shēn le .
meaning: This trip strengthened our friendship.

text: 珍惜朋友，也要认真对待答应的事。
pinyin: zhēn xī péng you , yě yào rèn zhēn duì dài dā yìng de shì .
meaning: Valuing friends includes taking your commitments seriously.

text: 毕业以后，我们还保持联络。
pinyin: bì yè yǐ hòu , wǒ men hái bǎo chí lián luò .
meaning: We kept in touch after graduation.

text: 他没有指责谁，只说明哪里出了问题。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu zhǐ zé shéi , zhǐ shuō míng nǎ lǐ chū le wèn tí .
meaning: He didn’t accuse anyone; he just explained where the problem arose.

text: 你还在犹豫，是担心时间不够吗？
pinyin: nǐ hái zài yóu yù , shì dān xīn shí jiān bù gòu ma ?
meaning: Are you hesitating because you’re worried about time?

text: 这次误解和前面少说了一句有关。
pinyin: zhè cì wù jiě hé qián miàn shǎo shuō le yī jù yǒu guān .
meaning: This misunderstanding has to do with a missing sentence earlier.

text: 他愿意承担自己决定的结果。
pinyin: tā yuàn yì chéng dān zì jǐ jué dìng de jié guǒ .
meaning: He’s willing to bear the consequences of his decision.

text: 你保证的事，要先看看能不能做到。
pinyin: nǐ bǎo zhèng de shì , yào xiān kàn kàn néng bù néng zuò dào .
meaning: Check whether you can do something before promising it.

text: 我想找一个可靠的办法保存这些照片。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī gè kě kào de bàn fǎ bǎo cún zhè xiē zhào piān .
meaning: I’d like a reliable way to save these photos.

text: 信任不是从来不问，而是可以把问题说清楚。
pinyin: xìn rèn bù shì cóng lái bù wèn , ér shì kě yǐ bǎ wèn tí shuō qīng chǔ .
meaning: Trust doesn’t mean never asking; it means being able to clarify problems.

text: 她承认自己只听了一半。
pinyin: tā chéng rèn zì jǐ zhǐ tīng le yí bàn .
meaning: She admits she heard only half of it.

text: 这次经历让我体会到提前准备的好处。
pinyin: zhè cì jīng lì ràng wǒ tǐ huì dào tí qián zhǔn bèi de hǎo chù .
meaning: This experience showed me the benefit of preparing ahead.

text: 她教新同学时很有耐心。
pinyin: tā jiào xīn tóng xué shí hěn yǒu nài xīn .
meaning: She’s patient when teaching new classmates.

text: 大家尊敬他，不只是因为他的职位。
pinyin: dà jiā zūn jìng tā , bù zhǐ shì yīn wèi tā de zhí wèi .
meaning: People respect him for more than his position.

text: 这两个安排有时间冲突。我们有意见冲突，但还能一起做事。有变化就早点沟通，别等到最后。我们沟通以后，发现想解决的是同一个问题。她的感谢很真诚，不是随口说的。我想真诚地说明自己的想法。我尊重你的决定，但想问清楚原因。尊重别人的时间，也包括早点告诉他变化。他说不在乎，却一直抱怨，这有点矛盾。我们之间的矛盾不是今天才有的。她抱怨等了很久，却没人告诉她原因。我不是抱怨你忙，我是想知道你来不来。我们在车站偶然遇见了。这不是偶然，每次他都提前准备。这次失误是我把时间记错了。发现失误以后，先把结果改正。她无奈地笑了，说车已经走了。我也很无奈，但不能让你一直等。一直等别人决定，太消极了。他今天有点消极，觉得怎么做都没用。我们的友谊不是靠每天见面维持的。这次旅行让我们的友谊更深了。我很珍惜能一起做事的机会。珍惜朋友，也要认真对待答应的事。到了以后，我会和你联络。毕业以后，我们还保持联络。我想讨论这次安排，不是指责你这个人。他没有指责谁，只说明哪里出了问题。我犹豫了一下，还是给她打了电话。你还在犹豫，是担心时间不够吗？我担心你误解了那句话。这次误解和前面少说了一句有关。这次多出来的工作，我来承担。他愿意承担自己决定的结果。我不能保证几点到，会再告诉你。你保证的事，要先看看能不能做到。她很可靠，有变化会主动说。我想找一个可靠的办法保存这些照片。我信任你，才把这件事交给你。信任不是从来不问，而是可以把问题说清楚。我承认这次没有及时联系你。她承认自己只听了一半。我等过以后，才体会到你的感受。这次经历让我体会到提前准备的好处。谢谢你耐心听我说完。她教新同学时很有耐心。我很尊敬这位老师，她总会认真回答。大家尊敬他，不只是因为他的职位。
pinyin: zhè liǎng gè ān pái yǒu shí jiān chōng tū . wǒ men yǒu yì jiàn chōng tū , dàn hái néng yì qǐ zuò shì . yǒu biàn huà jiù zǎo diǎn gōu tōng , bié děng dào zuì hòu . wǒ men gōu tōng yǐ hòu , fā xiàn xiǎng jiě jué de shì tóng yī gè wèn tí . tā de gǎn xiè hěn zhēn chéng , bù shì suí kǒu shuō de . wǒ xiǎng zhēn chéng de shuō míng zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ . wǒ zūn zhòng nǐ de jué dìng , dàn xiǎng wèn qīng chǔ yuán yīn . zūn zhòng bié ren de shí jiān , yě bāo kuò zǎo diǎn gào sù tā biàn huà . tā shuō bù zài hū , què yì zhí bào yuàn , zhè yǒu diǎn máo dùn . wǒ men zhī jiān de máo dùn bù shì jīn tiān cái yǒu de . tā bào yuàn děng le hěn jiǔ , què méi rén gào sù tā yuán yīn . wǒ bù shì bào yuàn nǐ máng , wǒ shì xiǎng zhī dào nǐ lái bù lái . wǒ men zài chē zhàn ǒu rán yù jiàn le . zhè bù shì ǒu rán , měi cì tā dōu tí qián zhǔn bèi . zhè cì shī wù shì wǒ bǎ shí jiān jì cuò le . fā xiàn shī wù yǐ hòu , xiān bǎ jié guǒ gǎi zhèng . tā wú nài de xiào le , shuō chē yǐ jīng zǒu le . wǒ yě hěn wú nài , dàn bù néng ràng nǐ yì zhí děng . yì zhí děng bié ren jué dìng , tài xiāo jí le . tā jīn tiān yǒu diǎn xiāo jí , jué de zěn me zuò dōu méi yòng . wǒ men de yǒu yì bù shì kào měi tiān jiàn miàn wéi chí de . zhè cì lǚ xíng ràng wǒ men de yǒu yì gèng shēn le . wǒ hěn zhēn xī néng yì qǐ zuò shì de jī huì . zhēn xī péng you , yě yào rèn zhēn duì dài dā yìng de shì . dào le yǐ hòu , wǒ huì hé nǐ lián luò . bì yè yǐ hòu , wǒ men hái bǎo chí lián luò . wǒ xiǎng tǎo lùn zhè cì ān pái , bù shì zhǐ zé nǐ zhè gè rén . tā méi yǒu zhǐ zé shéi , zhǐ shuō míng nǎ lǐ chū le wèn tí . wǒ yóu yù le yī xià , hái shi gěi tā dǎ le diàn huà . nǐ hái zài yóu yù , shì dān xīn shí jiān bù gòu ma ? text: 那天进门以后，我看见箱子都到了楼上，刚要说“看来已经弄好了”，朋友就指了指地上的两箱书。她的外套搭在椅子上，袖口有一块灰，手里的水也已经凉了。我问重箱子是谁搬的，她说邻居帮了十分钟，司机刚才已经走了。我把包放下，才发现自己来得有多晚。
pinyin: nà tiān jìn mén yǐ hòu , wǒ kàn jiàn xiāng zi dōu dào le lóu shàng , gāng yào shuō kàn lái yǐ jīng nòng hǎo le , péng you jiù zhǐ le zhǐ dì shang de liǎng xiāng shū . tā de wài tào dā zài yǐ zi shàng , xiù kǒu yǒu yī kuài huī , shǒu lǐ de shuǐ yě yǐ jīng liáng le . wǒ wèn zhòng xiāng zi shì shéi bān de , tā shuō lín jū bāng le shí fēn zhōng , sī jī gāng cái yǐ jīng zǒu le . wǒ bǎ bāo fàng xià , cái fā xiàn zì jǐ lái de yǒu duō wǎn .
meaning: When I walked in, the boxes were already upstairs. I was about to say, 'Looks like it's done,' when my friend pointed to two boxes of books on the floor. Her coat was on a chair, its sleeve dusty, and the water in her hand had gone cold. A neighbour had helped for ten minutes, she said, and the driver had just left. Putting down my bag, I realised how late I was.

text: 临时开会的时候，我的手机还在桌上。同事叫我过去，我以为只要说几句话，结果一坐下就讨论了很久。中间我想到朋友可能在等，却总觉得下一句说完就能走。直到会议结束拿起手机，看见两个未接电话，我才赶紧出门。一路上我想好了一堆解释，见到她却只说出对不起。
pinyin: lín shí kāi huì de shí hou , wǒ de shǒu jī hái zài zhuō shàng . tóng shì jiào wǒ guò qù , wǒ yǐ wéi zhǐ yào shuō jǐ jù huà , jié guǒ yī zuò xià jiù tǎo lùn le hěn jiǔ . zhōng jiān wǒ xiǎng dào péng you kě néng zài děng , què zǒng jué de xià yī jù shuō wán jiù néng zǒu . zhí dào huì yì jié shù ná qǐ shǒu jī , kàn jiàn liǎng gè wèi jiē diàn huà , wǒ cái gǎn jǐn chū mén . yī lù shàng wǒ xiǎng hǎo le yī duī jiě shì , jiàn dào tā què zhǐ shuō chū duì bù qǐ .
meaning: My phone was on my desk when the unexpected meeting began. I thought my colleague needed a quick word, but the discussion went on. I kept thinking my friend might be waiting, then telling myself I could leave after the next point. Only after the meeting, seeing two missed calls, did I hurry out. I prepared plenty of explanations on the way; face to face, all I managed was sorry.

text: 她把没接到电话以后的情况讲完，我才知道，她一直以为我已经在路上。司机在楼下问还有多久，她没法回答；到了两点二十，才去敲邻居的门。邻居本来在做饭，关了火下来帮忙。我问能不能去谢谢他，她说工具晚上要还，到时候一起过去。我先接过她手里那杯凉水，重新倒了一杯。
pinyin: tā bǎ méi jiē dào diàn huà yǐ hòu de qíng kuàng jiǎng wán , wǒ cái zhī dào , tā yì zhí yǐ wéi wǒ yǐ jīng zài lù shàng . sī jī zài lóu xià wèn hái yǒu duō jiǔ , tā méi fǎ huí dá ; dào le liǎng diǎn èr shí , cái qù qiāo lín jū de mén . lín jū běn lái zài zuò fàn , guān le huǒ xià lái bāng máng . wǒ wèn néng bù néng qù xiè xiè tā , tā shuō gōng jù wǎn shang yào hái , dào shí hou yì qǐ guò qù . wǒ xiān jiē guò tā shǒu lǐ nà bēi liáng shuǐ , chóng xīn dào le yī bēi .
meaning: When she told me what had happened after the unanswered calls, I learned she'd thought I was already on the way. She couldn't tell the driver how much longer I'd be. At 2:20 she knocked on the neighbour's door; he'd stopped cooking to help. I asked if we could thank him. We could return his tools together that evening, she said. First I took her cold water and poured a fresh cup.

text: 我本来想说以后绝不迟到，话到了嘴边，又想起单位下次也可能临时开会。最后我说，下次会先看安排再答应，有变化就提前打电话。她问手机又留在桌上怎么办，我说向同事借一个。她看了我一会儿，说那就这样吧，先把地上的书放好。我蹲下来打开箱子，这才知道她想按什么顺序排。
pinyin: wǒ běn lái xiǎng shuō yǐ hòu jué bù chí dào , huà dào le zuǐ biān , yòu xiǎng qǐ dān wèi xià cì yě kě néng lín shí kāi huì . zuì hòu wǒ shuō , xià cì huì xiān kàn ān pái zài dā yìng , yǒu biàn huà jiù tí qián dǎ diàn huà . tā wèn shǒu jī yòu liú zài zhuō shàng zěn me bàn , wǒ shuō xiàng tóng shì jiè yī gè . tā kàn le wǒ yī huì er , shuō nà jiù zhè yàng ba , xiān bǎ dì shang de shū fàng hǎo . wǒ dūn xià lái dǎ kāi xiāng zi , zhè cái zhī dào tā xiǎng àn shén me shùn xù pái .
meaning: I almost promised never to be late again, then remembered work might spring another meeting on me. I said I'd check my schedule before agreeing and call ahead if anything changed. What if my phone was on the desk again? I'd borrow a colleague's. She looked at me, then said okay: first put away the books on the floor. I crouched to open a box and finally asked how she wanted them arranged.

text: 两周后，朋友请我一起去整理活动室。这次我先看了工作安排，说下午四点可以到，四点以前不能保证。她说需要三点开始，我就没有接下那一段，只答应四点以后整理留下的材料。我们把不能做的部分说在前面，反而没有再发生同样的误会。
pinyin: liǎng zhōu hòu , péng you qǐng wǒ yì qǐ qù zhěng lǐ huó dòng shì . zhè cì wǒ xiān kàn le gōng zuò ān pái , shuō xià wǔ sì diǎn kě yǐ dào , sì diǎn yǐ qián bù néng bǎo zhèng . tā shuō xū yào sān diǎn kāi shǐ , wǒ jiù méi yǒu jiē xià nà yī duàn , zhǐ dā yìng sì diǎn yǐ hòu zhěng lǐ liú xià de cái liào . wǒ men bǎ bù néng zuò de bù fèn shuō zài qián miàn , fǎn ér méi yǒu zài fā shēng tóng yàng de wù huì .
meaning: Two weeks later she asked me to help organise an activity room. I checked my work schedule and said I could arrive at four, with no guarantee before then. She needed a three-o’clock start, so I didn’t accept that part, only the remaining materials after four. Stating the limit first prevented the same misunderstanding.

text: 那天中午，我又发了一条消息，确认四点仍然可以到。她回复说，三点开始搬桌子的人已经找好了，让我到时直接整理最后留下的材料。我把工作做完，带上胶带和剪刀，出门前再看了一眼地址。那是活动室，不是她的新家，我上次存好的地址今天还用不上。
pinyin: nà tiān zhōng wǔ , wǒ yòu fā le yī tiáo xiāo xī , què rèn sì diǎn réng rán kě yǐ dào . tā huí fù shuō , sān diǎn kāi shǐ bān zhuō zi de rén yǐ jīng zhǎo hǎo le , ràng wǒ dào shí zhí jiē zhěng lǐ zuì hòu liú xià de cái liào . wǒ bǎ gōng zuò zuò wán , dài shàng jiāo dài hé jiǎn dāo , chū mén qián zài kàn le yī yǎn dì zhǐ . nà shì huó dòng shì , bù shì tā de xīn jiā , wǒ shàng cì cún hǎo de dì zhǐ jīn tiān hái yòng bù shàng .
meaning: At midday I confirmed I could still arrive at four. She'd found someone for the tables at three; I should sort the remaining materials. I finished work and packed tape and scissors, checking the address before leaving. It was the activity room, not her new home, so the address I'd saved last time wouldn't help today.

text: 四点到了，我发消息说自己已在门口。她出来开门，说还剩两张桌子没收，材料先放在右边。我卷起袖子，和她把桌子抬回墙边，再把纸按下次要用的顺序收好。快做完时，她问我要不要一起吃点东西。我看了看手机，没有新电话，就说好，这回我真的不赶时间。
pinyin: sì diǎn dào le , wǒ fā xiāo xī shuō zì jǐ yǐ zài mén kǒu . tā chū lái kāi mén , shuō hái shèng liǎng zhāng zhuō zi mò shōu , cái liào xiān fàng zài yòu biān . wǒ juǎn qǐ xiù zi , hé tā bǎ zhuō zi tái huí qiáng biān , zài bǎ zhǐ àn xià cì yào yòng de shùn xù shōu hǎo . kuài zuò wán shí , tā wèn wǒ yào bù yào yì qǐ chī diǎn dōng xi . wǒ kàn le kàn shǒu jī , méi yǒu xīn diàn huà , jiù shuō hǎo , zhè huí wǒ zhēn de bù gǎn shí jiān .
meaning: At four I messaged that I was at the door. She opened it: two tables were still out, and the materials should go on the right. We carried the tables to the wall, then sorted the papers for next time. Near the end she suggested something to eat. I checked my phone—no new calls—and said yes: this time I really wasn't in a hurry.

我本来想说以后绝不迟到，话到了嘴边，又想起单位下次也可能临时开会。最后我说，下次会先看安排再答应，有变化就提前打电话。她问手机又留在桌上怎么办，我说向同事借一个。她看了我一会儿，说那就这样吧，先把地上的书放好。我蹲下来打开箱子，这才知道她想按什么顺序排。
两周后，朋友请我一起去整理活动室。这次我先看了工作安排，说下午四点可以到，四点以前不能保证。她说需要三点开始，我就没有接下那一段，只答应四点以后整理留下的材料。我们把不能做的部分说在前面，反而没有再发生同样的误会。
那天中午，我又发了一条消息，确认四点仍然可以到。她回复说，三点开始搬桌子的人已经找好了，让我到时直接整理最后留下的材料。我把工作做完，带上胶带和剪刀，出门前再看了一眼地址。那是活动室，不是她的新家，我上次存好的地址今天还用不上。
四点到了，我发消息说自己已在门口。她出来开门，说还剩两张桌子没收，材料先放在右边。我卷起袖子，和她把桌子抬回墙边，再把纸按下次要用的顺序收好。快做完时，她问我要不要一起吃点东西。我看了看手机，没有新电话，就说好，这回我真的不赶时间。

text: 你怎么一个人坐在这里？大家还在里面聊天。
pinyin: nǐ zěn me yī gè rén zuò zài zhè lǐ ? dà jiā hái zài lǐ miàn liáo tiān .
meaning: Why are you sitting here alone? Everyone’s still chatting inside.

text: 我想先出来一会儿。刚才第二句唱错了，后面差点接不上。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng xiān chū lái yī huì er . gāng cái dì èr jù chàng cuò le , hòu miàn chà diǎn jiē bù shàng .
meaning: I wanted a moment outside. I got the second line wrong and nearly lost the next part.

text: 我听见你停了一下，不过后来接上了。
pinyin: wǒ tīng jiàn nǐ tíng le yī xià , bù guò hòu lái jiē shàng le .
meaning: I heard you pause, but you picked it up again.

text: 你不用安慰我，我知道和练的时候不一样。
pinyin: nǐ bù yòng ān wèi wǒ , wǒ zhī dào hé liàn de shí hou bù yī yàng .
meaning: You don’t need to reassure me. I know it wasn’t like rehearsal.

text: 我没说没有错。我是说你没停在那里，后面唱完了。
pinyin: wǒ méi shuō méi yǒu cuò . wǒ shì shuō nǐ méi tíng zài nà lǐ , hòu miàn chàng wán le .
meaning: I’m not saying there was no mistake. I’m saying you didn’t stop there; you finished the rest.

text: 这点倒是。可我准备了那么久，还是有点失望。
pinyin: zhè diǎn dǎo shì . kě wǒ zhǔn bèi le nà me jiǔ , hái shi yǒu diǎn shī wàng .
meaning: That’s true, but I prepared so long and I’m still a little disappointed.

text: 紧张归紧张，你还是站上去了。你第一次来，只在后面听呢。
pinyin: jǐn zhāng guī jǐn zhāng , nǐ hái shi zhàn shàng qù le . nǐ dì yī cì lái , zhǐ zài hòu miàn tīng ne .
meaning: Nervous or not, you still went on stage. The first time you came you only listened at the back.

text: 别从我第一次来开始讲了。我就想知道第二句怎么改。
pinyin: bié cóng wǒ dì yī cì lái kāi shǐ jiǎng le . wǒ jiù xiǎng zhī dào dì èr jù zěn me gǎi .
meaning: Don’t start from the first time I came. I just want to know how to fix the second line.

text: 好，现在听录音，还是吃完东西再听？
pinyin: hǎo , xiàn zài tīng lù yīn , hái shi chī wán dōng xi zài tīng ?
meaning: Okay. Listen to the recording now, or after some food?

text: 吃完再听吧。我现在一听见自己的声音就想关掉。
pinyin: chī wán zài tīng ba . wǒ xiàn zài yī tīng jiàn zì jǐ de shēng yīn jiù xiǎng guān diào .
meaning: After food. Right now hearing my own voice makes me want to switch it off.

text: 行。等会儿只听那两句，不用把整段一直重复。
pinyin: xíng . děng huì ér zhǐ tīng nà liǎng jù , bù yòng bǎ zhěng duàn yì zhí chóng fù .
meaning: Sure. Later we’ll listen only to those two lines, not keep repeating the whole thing.

text: 你觉得是字没读准，还是跟音乐太急？
pinyin: nǐ jué de shì zì méi dú zhǔn , hái shi gēn yīn yuè tài jí ?
meaning: Do you think the word was wrong, or I rushed with the music?

text: 我得再听一次才敢说。刚才只是听见你漏了两个字。
pinyin: wǒ děi zài tīng yī cì cái gǎn shuō . gāng cái zhǐ shì tīng jiàn nǐ lòu le liǎng gè zì .
meaning: I need another listen before saying. I only heard you miss two characters.

text: 这样说我反而放心。你要是说全部都完美，我才不信。
pinyin: zhè yàng shuō wǒ fǎn ér fàng xīn . nǐ yào shì shuō quán bù dōu wán měi , wǒ cái bù xìn .
meaning: That actually reassures me. If you said everything was perfect, I wouldn’t believe it.

text: 放心，我没那么会夸人。
pinyin: fàng xīn , wǒ méi nà me huì kuā rén .
meaning: Don’t worry; I’m not that good at lavish praise.

text: 这个不用练。你先帮我拿点水吧。
pinyin: zhè gè bù yòng liàn . nǐ xiān bāng wǒ ná diǎn shuǐ ba .
meaning: No need to practise that. Get me some water first.

text: 好。要不要我跟大家说你等会儿回去？
pinyin: hǎo . yào bù yào wǒ gēn dà jiā shuō nǐ děng huì ér huí qù ?
meaning: Okay. Shall I tell the others you’ll be back later?

text: 说一下吧，别让他们以为我直接走了。
pinyin: shuō yī xià ba , bié ràng tā men yǐ wéi wǒ zhí jiē zǒu le .
meaning: Yes, so they don’t think I’ve left altogether.

text: 去唱歌活动以前，我在家练了十几次。音乐放慢时，每一句都能接上，我就以为到了现场也会一样。那天轮到我，站到前面才发现，听见的声音和房间里不太一样，手里拿着话筒，也不知道该看哪里。
pinyin: qù chàng gē huó dòng yǐ qián , wǒ zài jiā liàn le shí jǐ cì . yīn yuè fàng màn shí , měi yī jù dōu néng jiē shàng , wǒ jiù yǐ wéi dào le xiàn chǎng yě huì yī yàng . nà tiān lún dào wǒ , zhàn dào qián miàn cái fā xiàn , tīng jiàn de shēng yīn hé fáng jiān lǐ bù tài yī yàng , shǒu lǐ ná zhe huà tǒng , yě bù zhī dào gāi kàn nǎ lǐ .
meaning: Before the singing event I rehearsed more than ten times at home. I could keep up with every line when the music was slowed, so I expected the same at the event. Standing at the front, I found the sound different from my room and didn’t know where to look while holding the microphone.

text: 第二句里有两个字，我还没唱完，音乐已经往下走了。我停了一下，差点接不上下一句。幸好前面的朋友用手给我指了开始的位置，我又跟了上去，最后唱完了整段。坐下以后，我只记得那两秒，觉得前面准备的都没有用。
pinyin: dì èr jù lǐ yǒu liǎng gè zì , wǒ hái méi chàng wán , yīn yuè yǐ jīng wǎng xià zǒu le . wǒ tíng le yī xià , chà diǎn jiē bù shàng xià yī jù . xìng hǎo qián miàn de péng you yòng shǒu gěi wǒ zhǐ le kāi shǐ de wèi zhì , wǒ yòu gēn le shàng qù , zuì hòu chàng wán le zhěng duàn . zuò xià yǐ hòu , wǒ zhǐ jì de nà liǎng miǎo , jué de qián miàn zhǔn bèi de dōu méi yǒu yòng .
meaning: Two characters in the second line fell behind the music. I paused and nearly missed the next line. A friend pointed to where I should restart, and I picked it up and finished the section. Afterwards I remembered only those two seconds and felt all my preparation had been useless.

text: 我到门外坐了一会儿，朋友跟出来问怎么了。他说我后来接上了，我却以为他只是安慰。我们说了几句，我才听清楚：他并没有说我唱得完美，只说出了一个我自己没注意的事实。我确实没有在失误的地方结束。
pinyin: wǒ dào mén wài zuò le yī huì er , péng you gēn chū lái wèn zěn me le . tā shuō wǒ hòu lái jiē shàng le , wǒ què yǐ wéi tā zhǐ shì ān wèi . wǒ men shuō le jǐ jù , wǒ cái tīng qīng chǔ : tā bìng méi yǒu shuō wǒ chàng de wán měi , zhǐ shuō chū le yī gè wǒ zì jǐ méi zhù yì de shì shí . wǒ què shí méi yǒu zài shī wù de dì fāng jié shù .
meaning: I sat outside briefly, and a friend came to ask what was wrong. When he said I’d picked it up again, I thought he was merely comforting me. After talking I understood: he hadn’t called it perfect, just named a fact I’d overlooked. I hadn’t ended at the mistake.

text: 我们先去吃东西。我不想刚坐下就反复听自己的录音，他也没有催我。吃完以后，我们找了个安静的地方，只听第二句和后面接上的一句。听的时候，我发现那两个字没跟上，但后面并不像自己记得的那么乱。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān qù chī dōng xi . wǒ bù xiǎng gāng zuò xià jiù fǎn fù tīng zì jǐ de lù yīn , tā yě méi yǒu cuī wǒ . chī wán yǐ hòu , wǒ men zhǎo le gè ān jìng de dì fāng , zhǐ tīng dì èr jù hé hòu miàn jiē shàng de yī jù . tīng de shí hou , wǒ fā xiàn nà liǎng gè zì méi gēn shàng , dàn hòu miàn bìng bù xiàng zì jǐ jì de de nà me luàn .
meaning: We ate first. I didn’t want to keep hearing my recording immediately, and he didn’t rush me. Afterwards we found a quiet place and listened only to the second line and the next one. The two characters had fallen behind, but the following line wasn’t as chaotic as I remembered.

text: 朋友让我先按普通说话的方式读那两句，再试着跟音乐。我把快的地方分开练，没有每次从头开始。录音里哪里少了字，我们就停在哪里；不是所有地方都用同一个办法重做。这样练十分钟以后，我至少知道下一次要注意哪个位置。
pinyin: péng you ràng wǒ xiān àn pǔ tōng shuō huà de fāng shì dú nà liǎng jù , zài shì zhe gēn yīn yuè . wǒ bǎ kuài de dì fāng fēn kāi liàn , méi yǒu měi cì cóng tóu kāi shǐ . lù yīn lǐ nǎ lǐ shǎo le zì , wǒ men jiù tíng zài nǎ lǐ ; bù shì suǒ yǒu dì fāng dōu yòng tóng yī gè bàn fǎ zhòng zuò . zhè yàng liàn shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu , wǒ zhì shǎo zhī dào xià yī cì yào zhù yì nǎ gè wèi zhì .
meaning: My friend suggested reading the lines as ordinary speech first, then trying with the music. I practised the fast part separately instead of restarting every time. We stopped where the recording had missing characters rather than redoing every part the same way. After ten minutes I knew which spot to focus on next.

text: 回去时，活动还没结束。有个新朋友问我是不是下次也来。我没有马上说一定会唱得更好，只说想再试一次，也问他平时怎么练。他说自己第一次更紧张，拿着话筒还忘了音乐已经开始。听见这个，我终于笑了，不是因为他的失误好笑，而是觉得自己不那么孤单了。
pinyin: huí qù shí , huó dòng hái méi jié shù . yǒu gè xīn péng you wèn wǒ shì bú shì xià cì yě lái . wǒ méi yǒu mǎ shàng shuō yí dìng huì chàng de gèng hǎo , zhǐ shuō xiǎng zài shì yī cì , yě wèn tā píng shí zěn me liàn . tā shuō zì jǐ dì yī cì gèng jǐn zhāng , ná zhe huà tǒng hái wàng le yīn yuè yǐ jīng kāi shǐ . tīng jiàn zhè gè , wǒ zhōng yú xiào le , bù shì yīn wèi tā de shī wù hǎo xiào , ér shì jué de zì jǐ bù nà me gū dān le .
meaning: The event was still going when we returned. A new friend asked whether I’d come next time. I said I’d like another try and asked how he practised. He said he’d been even more nervous his first time, forgetting the music had started while holding the microphone. I finally laughed—not at his mistake, but because I felt less alone.

text: 那天回家，我把第二句要练的位置在纸上圈出来，又存下新朋友的联系方式。他已经发来一条消息，说下次别忘了先唱再问听不听得见。我一边看一边笑，回他你也别忘了听音乐。我还是想把那两个字练好，不过想到下次进去已经有认识的人，心里没有刚出门时那么紧了。
pinyin: nà tiān huí jiā , wǒ bǎ dì èr jù yào liàn de wèi zhì zài zhǐ shàng quān chū lái , yòu cún xià xīn péng you de lián xì fāng shì . tā yǐ jīng fā lái yī tiáo xiāo xī , shuō xià cì bié wàng le xiān chàng zài wèn tīng bù tīng de jiàn . wǒ yī biān kàn yī biān xiào , huí tā nǐ yě bié wàng le tīng yīn yuè . wǒ hái shi xiǎng bǎ nà liǎng gè zì liàn hǎo , bù guò xiǎng dào xià cì jìn qù yǐ jīng yǒu rèn shi de rén , xīn lǐ méi yǒu gāng chū mén shí nà me jǐn le .
meaning: At home I circled the spot in the second line that needed practice and saved my new friend's contact details. He'd already messaged: next time, sing before asking if anyone could hear me. Laughing, I told him not to forget to listen for the music either. I still wanted to get those two words right, but knowing I'd recognise someone next time made me less anxious.

text: 去唱歌活动以前，我在家练了十几次。音乐放慢时，每一句都能接上，我就以为到了现场也会一样。那天轮到我，站到前面才发现，听见的声音和房间里不太一样，手里拿着话筒，也不知道该看哪里。第二句里有两个字，我还没唱完，音乐已经往下走了。我停了一下，差点接不上下一句。幸好前面的朋友用手给我指了开始的位置，我又跟了上去，最后唱完了整段。坐下以后，我只记得那两秒，觉得前面准备的都没有用。我到门外坐了一会儿，朋友跟出来问怎么了。他说我后来接上了，我却以为他只是安慰。我们说了几句，我才听清楚：他并没有说我唱得完美，只说出了一个我自己没注意的事实。我确实没有在失误的地方结束。我们先去吃东西。我不想刚坐下就反复听自己的录音，他也没有催我。吃完以后，我们找了个安静的地方，只听第二句和后面接上的一句。听的时候，我发现那两个字没跟上，但后面并不像自己记得的那么乱。朋友让我先按普通说话的方式读那两句，再试着跟音乐。我把快的地方分开练，没有每次从头开始。录音里哪里少了字，我们就停在哪里；不是所有地方都用同一个办法重做。这样练十分钟以后，我至少知道下一次要注意哪个位置。回去时，活动还没结束。有个新朋友问我是不是下次也来。我没有马上说一定会唱得更好，只说想再试一次，也问他平时怎么练。他说自己第一次更紧张，拿着话筒还忘了音乐已经开始。听见这个，我终于笑了，不是因为他的失误好笑，而是觉得自己不那么孤单了。那天回家，我把第二句要练的位置在纸上圈出来，又存下新朋友的联系方式。他已经发来一条消息，说下次别忘了先唱再问听不听得见。我一边看一边笑，回他你也别忘了听音乐。我还是想把那两个字练好，不过想到下次进去已经有认识的人，心里没有刚出门时那么紧了。
pinyin: qù chàng gē huó dòng yǐ qián , wǒ zài jiā liàn le shí jǐ cì . yīn yuè fàng màn shí , měi yī jù dōu néng jiē shàng , wǒ jiù yǐ wéi dào le xiàn chǎng yě huì yī yàng . nà tiān lún dào wǒ , zhàn dào qián miàn cái fā xiàn , tīng jiàn de shēng yīn hé fáng jiān lǐ bù tài yī yàng , shǒu lǐ ná zhe huà tǒng , yě bù zhī dào gāi kàn nǎ lǐ . dì èr jù lǐ yǒu liǎng gè zì , wǒ hái méi chàng wán , yīn yuè yǐ jīng wǎng xià zǒu le . wǒ tíng le yī xià , chà diǎn jiē bù shàng xià yī jù . xìng hǎo qián miàn de péng you yòng shǒu gěi wǒ zhǐ le kāi shǐ de wèi zhì , wǒ yòu gēn le shàng qù , zuì hòu chàng wán le zhěng duàn . zuò xià yǐ hòu , wǒ zhǐ jì de nà liǎng miǎo , jué de qián miàn zhǔn bèi de dōu méi yǒu yòng . wǒ dào mén wài zuò le yī huì er , péng you gēn chū lái wèn zěn me le . tā shuō wǒ hòu lái jiē shàng le , wǒ què yǐ wéi tā zhǐ shì ān wèi . wǒ men shuō le jǐ jù , wǒ cái tīng qīng chǔ : tā bìng méi yǒu shuō wǒ chàng de wán měi , zhǐ shuō chū le yī gè wǒ zì jǐ méi zhù yì de shì shí . wǒ què shí méi yǒu zài shī wù de dì fāng jié shù . wǒ men xiān qù chī dōng xi . wǒ bù xiǎng gāng zuò xià jiù fǎn fù tīng zì jǐ de lù yīn , tā yě méi yǒu cuī wǒ . chī wán yǐ hòu , wǒ men zhǎo le gè ān jìng de dì fāng , zhǐ tīng dì èr jù hé hòu miàn jiē shàng de yī jù . tīng de shí hou , wǒ fā xiàn nà liǎng gè zì méi gēn shàng , dàn hòu miàn bìng bù xiàng zì jǐ jì de de nà me luàn . péng you ràng wǒ xiān àn pǔ tōng shuō huà de fāng shì dú nà liǎng jù , zài shì zhe gēn yīn yuè . wǒ bǎ kuài de dì fāng fēn kāi liàn , méi yǒu měi cì cóng tóu kāi shǐ . lù yīn lǐ nǎ lǐ shǎo le zì , wǒ men jiù tíng zài nǎ lǐ ; bù shì suǒ yǒu dì fāng dōu yòng tóng yī gè bàn fǎ zhòng zuò . zhè yàng liàn shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu , wǒ zhì shǎo zhī dào xià yī cì yào zhù yì nǎ gè wèi zhì . huí qù shí , huó dòng hái méi jié shù . yǒu gè xīn péng you wèn wǒ shì bú shì xià cì yě lái . wǒ méi yǒu mǎ shàng shuō yí dìng huì chàng de gèng hǎo , zhǐ shuō xiǎng zài shì yī cì , yě wèn tā píng shí zěn me liàn . tā shuō zì jǐ dì yī cì gèng jǐn zhāng , ná zhe huà tǒng hái wàng le yīn yuè yǐ jīng kāi shǐ . tīng jiàn zhè gè , wǒ zhōng yú xiào le , bù shì yīn wèi tā de shī wù hǎo xiào , ér shì jué de zì jǐ bù nà me gū dān le . nà tiān huí jiā , wǒ bǎ dì èr jù yào liàn de wèi zhì zài zhǐ shàng quān chū lái , yòu cún xià xīn péng you de lián xì fāng shì . tā yǐ jīng fā lái yī tiáo xiāo xī , shuō xià cì bié wàng le xiān chàng zài wèn tīng bù tīng de jiàn . wǒ yī biān kàn yī biān xiào , huí tā nǐ yě bié wàng le tīng yīn yuè . wǒ hái shi xiǎng bǎ nà liǎng gè zì liàn hǎo , bù guò xiǎng dào xià cì jìn qù yǐ jīng yǒu rèn shi de rén , xīn lǐ méi yǒu gāng chū mén shí nà me jǐn le .
meaning: Before the singing event I rehearsed more than ten times at home. I could keep up with every line when the music was slowed, so I expected the same at the event. Standing at the front, I found the sound different from my room and didn’t know where to look while holding the microphone. Two characters in the second line fell behind the music. I paused and nearly missed the next line. A friend pointed to where I should restart, and I picked it up and finished the section. Afterwards I remembered only those two seconds and felt all my preparation had been useless. I sat outside briefly, and a friend came to ask what was wrong. When he said I’d picked it up again, I thought he was merely comforting me. After talking I understood: he hadn’t called it perfect, just named a fact I’d overlooked. I hadn’t ended at the mistake. We ate first. I didn’t want to keep hearing my recording immediately, and he didn’t rush me. Afterwards we found a quiet place and listened only to the second line and the next one. The two characters had fallen behind, but the following line wasn’t as chaotic as I remembered. My friend suggested reading the lines as ordinary speech first, then trying with the music. I practised the fast part separately instead of restarting every time. We stopped where the recording had missing characters rather than redoing every part the same way. After ten minutes I knew which spot to focus on next. The event was still going when we returned. A new friend asked whether I’d come next time. I said I’d like another try and asked how he practised. He said he’d been even more nervous his first time, forgetting the music had started while holding the microphone. I finally laughed—not at his mistake, but because I felt less alone. At home I circled the spot in the second line that needed practice and saved my new friend's contact details. He'd already messaged: next time, sing before asking if anyone could hear me. Laughing, I told him not to forget to listen for the music either. I still wanted to get those two words right, but knowing I'd recognise someone next time made me less anxious.

text: 你第一次真的忘了音乐已经开始？
pinyin: nǐ dì yī cì zhēn de wàng le yīn yuè yǐ jīng kāi shǐ ?
meaning: Did you really forget the music had started your first time?

text: 真的。我还在问大家能不能听见我。
pinyin: zhēn de . wǒ hái zài wèn dà jiā néng bù néng tīng jiàn wǒ .
meaning: Really. I was still asking if everyone could hear me.

text: 大家怎么说？
pinyin: dà jiā zěn me shuō ?
meaning: What did they say?

text: 有人说听见了，还说音乐也听见了。
pinyin: yǒu rén shuō tīng jiàn le , hái shuō yīn yuè yě tīng jiàn le .
meaning: Someone said yes—and that they could hear the music too.

text: 这个提醒挺清楚的。
pinyin: zhè gè tí xǐng tǐng qīng chǔ de .
meaning: That was a pretty clear reminder.

text: 我当时没听懂，还问是不是太大声。
pinyin: wǒ dāng shí méi tīng dǒng , hái wèn shì bú shì tài dà shēng .
meaning: I didn’t understand then and asked if it was too loud.

text: 所以后来呢？
pinyin: suǒ yǐ hòu lái ne ?
meaning: So what happened then?

text: 后来有人把音乐停了，说重新来。我才明白。
pinyin: hòu lái yǒu rén bǎ yīn yuè tíng le , shuō chóng xīn lái . wǒ cái míng bái .
meaning: Someone stopped the music and said we’d restart. Only then did I understand.

text: 你还能笑着讲，看来已经不怕了。
pinyin: nǐ hái néng xiào zhe jiǎng , kàn lái yǐ jīng bù pà le .
meaning: You can laugh about it now. Looks like you’re not afraid anymore.

text: 谁说不怕？讲以前的很容易，等会儿轮到我还是怕。
pinyin: shéi shuō bù pà ? jiǎng yǐ qián de hěn róng yì , děng huì ér lún dào wǒ hái shi pà .
meaning: Who says I’m not afraid? Talking about the past is easy; I’m still scared when my turn comes.

text: 那我等会儿提醒你音乐开始了。
pinyin: nà wǒ děng huì ér tí xǐng nǐ yīn yuè kāi shǐ le .
meaning: Then I’ll remind you when the music starts.

text: 好，这次我先唱，唱完再问听不听得见。
pinyin: hǎo , zhè cì wǒ xiān chàng , chàng wán zài wèn tīng bù tīng de jiàn .
meaning: Okay. This time I’ll sing first and ask if they can hear me afterwards.

text: 她没有急着安慰，只问我想不想说。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu jí zhe ān wèi , zhǐ wèn wǒ xiǎng bù xiǎng shuō .
meaning: She didn’t rush to reassure me; she just asked if I wanted to talk.

text: 他很有耐心，同一句教了我三次。
pinyin: tā hěn yǒu nài xīn , tóng yī jù jiào le wǒ sān cì .
meaning: He was patient and taught me the same sentence three times.

text: 比赛前，她的心态比以前平稳。
pinyin: bǐ sài qián , tā de xīn tài bǐ yǐ qián píng wěn .
meaning: Her mindset was steadier than before the competition.

text: 她很心疼那只受伤的小猫。
pinyin: tā hěn xīn téng nà zhǐ shòu shāng de xiǎo māo .
meaning: She felt sorry for the injured kitten.

text: 你的鼓励让我愿意把话说完。
pinyin: nǐ de gǔ lì ràng wǒ yuàn yì bǎ huà shuō wán .
meaning: Your encouragement made me willing to finish what I was saying.

text: 我不是想打击你，只是提醒时间不够。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì xiǎng dǎ jī nǐ , zhǐ shì tí xǐng shí jiān bù gòu .
meaning: I’m not trying to discourage you; I’m pointing out there isn’t enough time.

text: 这次失误没有改变最后的结果。
pinyin: zhè cì shī wù méi yǒu gǎi biàn zuì hòu de jié guǒ .
meaning: This error didn’t change the final outcome.

text: 她失望地把没用上的票收起来。
pinyin: tā shī wàng de bǎ méi yòng shàng de piào shōu qǐ lái .
meaning: She put away the unused ticket in disappointment.

text: 这座城市的居民为自己的传统自豪。
pinyin: zhè zuò chéng shì de jū mín wèi zì jǐ de chuán tǒng zì háo .
meaning: Residents of this city are proud of their traditions.

text: 我终于有勇气问那个问题了。
pinyin: wǒ zhōng yú yǒu yǒng qì wèn nà gè wèn tí le .
meaning: I finally had the courage to ask that question.

text: 他一个人搬这个箱子很吃力。
pinyin: tā yī gè rén bān zhè gè xiāng zi hěn chī lì .
meaning: He struggles to carry this box alone.

text: 丢掉的文件能恢复吗？
pinyin: diū diào de wén jiàn néng huī fù ma ?
meaning: Can the lost file be restored?

text: 这个计划缺乏具体的时间安排。
pinyin: zhè gè jì huà quē fá jù tǐ de shí jiān ān pái .
meaning: This plan lacks a specific schedule.

text: 我难以接受只凭一句话就下结论。
pinyin: wǒ nán yǐ jiē shòu zhǐ píng yī jù huà jiù xià jié lùn .
meaning: I find it hard to accept a conclusion based on one sentence.

text: 我很渴望和大家自然地聊起来。
pinyin: wǒ hěn kě wàng hé dà jiā zì rán de liáo qǐ lái .
meaning: I really want to start chatting naturally with everyone.

text: 我有点无奈，只好等下一班。
pinyin: wǒ yǒu diǎn wú nài , zhǐ hǎo děng xià yī bān .
meaning: I had no good option but to wait for the next service.

text: 她受不了屋里这么热，打开了窗。
pinyin: tā shòu bù liǎo wū lǐ zhè me rè , dǎ kāi le chuāng .
meaning: She couldn’t bear the heat in the room and opened the window.

text: 他担心朋友找不到地方，就发了地图。
pinyin: tā dān xīn péng you zhǎo bù dào dì fāng , jiù fā le dì tú .
meaning: He worried his friend wouldn’t find the place and sent a map.

text: 她花了一周才适应新的时间表。
pinyin: tā huā le yī zhōu cái shì yìng xīn de shí jiān biǎo .
meaning: It took her a week to adapt to the new schedule.

text: 天气变了，他的计划依然没有变。
pinyin: tiān qì biàn le , tā de jì huà yī rán méi yǒu biàn .
meaning: The weather changed but his plan stayed the same.

text: 只凭第一印象判断，容易太主观。
pinyin: zhǐ píng dì yī yìn xiàng pàn duàn , róng yì tài zhǔ guān .
meaning: Judging only by a first impression can be too subjective.

text: 预期太高，有时更容易失望。
pinyin: yù qī tài gāo , yǒu shí gèng róng yì shī wàng .
meaning: Sometimes high expectations make disappointment more likely.

text: 换一种情形，同一句话可能不同。
pinyin: huàn yī zhǒng qíng xíng , tóng yī jù huà kě néng bù tóng .
meaning: In a different situation the same sentence may mean something else.

text: 他还没说完，后面已经有人鼓掌了。
pinyin: tā hái méi shuō wán , hòu miàn yǐ jīng yǒu rén gǔ zhǎng le .
meaning: Someone at the back started clapping before he’d finished speaking.

text: 谢谢你安慰我，不过我想先安静一会儿。她没有急着安慰，只问我想不想说。你能耐心听完，再说哪里要改吗？他很有耐心，同一句教了我三次。我想换个心态，把这次当作练习。比赛前，她的心态比以前平稳。看你忙了这么久，我有点心疼。她很心疼那只受伤的小猫。老师鼓励我再试一次。你的鼓励让我愿意把话说完。这次结果对他的打击很大。我不是想打击你，只是提醒时间不够。我在第二句有一个失误。这次失误没有改变最后的结果。没有达到自己的目标，我有点失望。她失望地把没用上的票收起来。我为她坚持完成这件事感到自豪。这座城市的居民为自己的传统自豪。第一次上台，我用了很大勇气。我终于有勇气问那个问题了。这段太快，我跟得很吃力。他一个人搬这个箱子很吃力。休息以后，我恢复了一点精神。丢掉的文件能恢复吗？我不是不想说，只是缺乏练习机会。这个计划缺乏具体的时间安排。第一次听，难以判断他是什么意思。我难以接受只凭一句话就下结论。她渴望有一次自己选择的机会。我很渴望和大家自然地聊起来。他无奈地说，票已经卖完了。我有点无奈，只好等下一班。我受不了大家同时说话，听不清。她受不了屋里这么热，打开了窗。我担心自己又会漏掉第二句。他担心朋友找不到地方，就发了地图。我还在适应台上的声音。她花了一周才适应新的时间表。练完以后，我依然有点紧张。天气变了，他的计划依然没有变。这只是我的主观感受，你可以不一样。只凭第一印象判断，容易太主观。这次效果比我的预期好。预期太高，有时更容易失望。当时是什么情形，你再说详细一点。换一种情形，同一句话可能不同。演出结束以后，大家一起鼓掌。他还没说完，后面已经有人鼓掌了。
pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ ān wèi wǒ , bù guò wǒ xiǎng xiān ān jìng yī huì er . tā méi yǒu jí zhe ān wèi , zhǐ wèn wǒ xiǎng bù xiǎng shuō . nǐ néng nài xīn tīng wán , zài shuō nǎ lǐ yào gǎi ma ? tā hěn yǒu nài xīn , tóng yī jù jiào le wǒ sān cì . wǒ xiǎng huàn gè xīn tài , bǎ zhè cì dàng zuò liàn xí . bǐ sài qián , tā de xīn tài bǐ yǐ qián píng wěn . kàn nǐ máng le zhè me jiǔ , wǒ yǒu diǎn xīn téng . tā hěn xīn téng nà zhǐ shòu shāng de xiǎo māo . lǎo shī gǔ lì wǒ zài shì yī cì . nǐ de gǔ lì ràng wǒ yuàn yì bǎ huà shuō wán . zhè cì jié guǒ duì tā de dǎ jī hěn dà . wǒ bù shì xiǎng dǎ jī nǐ , zhǐ shì tí xǐng shí jiān bù gòu . wǒ zài dì èr jù yǒu yī gè shī wù . zhè cì shī wù méi yǒu gǎi biàn zuì hòu de jié guǒ . méi yǒu dá dào zì jǐ de mù biāo , wǒ yǒu diǎn shī wàng . tā shī wàng de bǎ méi yòng shàng de piào shōu qǐ lái . wǒ wèi tā jiān chí wán chéng zhè jiàn shì gǎn dào zì háo . zhè zuò chéng shì de jū mín wèi zì jǐ de chuán tǒng zì háo . dì yī cì shàng tái , wǒ yòng le hěn dà yǒng qì . wǒ zhōng yú yǒu yǒng qì wèn nà gè wèn tí le . zhè duàn tài kuài , wǒ gēn de hěn chī lì . tā yī gè rén bān zhè gè xiāng zi hěn chī lì . xiū xī yǐ hòu , wǒ huī fù le yī diǎn jīng shén . diū diào de wén jiàn néng huī fù ma ? wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng shuō , zhǐ shì quē fá liàn xí jī huì . zhè gè jì huà quē fá jù tǐ de shí jiān ān pái . dì yī cì tīng , nán yǐ pàn duàn tā shì shén me yì si . wǒ nán yǐ jiē shòu zhǐ píng yī jù huà jiù xià jié lùn . tā kě wàng yǒu yī cì zì jǐ xuǎn zé de jī huì . wǒ hěn kě wàng hé dà jiā zì rán de liáo qǐ lái . tā wú nài de shuō , piào yǐ jīng mài wán le . wǒ yǒu diǎn wú nài , zhǐ hǎo děng xià yī bān . wǒ shòu bù liǎo dà jiā tóng shí shuō huà , tīng bù qīng . tā shòu bù liǎo wū lǐ zhè me rè , dǎ kāi le chuāng . wǒ dān xīn zì jǐ yòu huì lòu diào dì èr jù . tā dān xīn péng you zhǎo bù dào dì fāng , jiù fā le dì tú . wǒ hái zài shì yìng tái shàng de shēng yīn . tā huā le yī zhōu cái shì yìng xīn de shí jiān biǎo . liàn wán yǐ hòu , wǒ yī rán yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng . tiān qì biàn le , tā de jì huà yī rán méi yǒu biàn . zhè zhǐ shì wǒ de zhǔ guān gǎn shòu , nǐ kě yǐ bù yī yàng . zhǐ píng dì yī yìn xiàng pàn duàn , róng yì tài zhǔ guān . zhè cì xiào guǒ bǐ wǒ de yù qī hǎo . yù qī tài gāo , yǒu shí gèng róng yì shī wàng . dāng shí shì shén me qíng xíng , nǐ zài shuō xiáng xì yī diǎn . huàn yī zhǒng qíng xíng , tóng yī jù huà kě néng bù tóng . yǎn chū jié shù yǐ hòu , dà jiā yì qǐ gǔ zhǎng . tā hái méi shuō wán , hòu miàn yǐ jīng yǒu rén gǔ zhǎng le .
meaning: Thanks for comforting me, but I’d like a quiet moment first. She didn’t rush to reassure me; she just asked if I wanted to talk. Could you listen patiently to the end before saying what to change? He was patient and taught me the same sentence three times. I’d like to treat this as practice with a different mindset. Her mindset was steadier than before the competition. I feel for you after seeing how long you’ve been busy. She felt sorry for the injured kitten. The teacher encouraged me to try again. Your encouragement made me willing to finish what I was saying. This result was a major blow to him. I’m not trying to discourage you; I’m pointing out there isn’t enough time. I made a mistake in the second line. This error didn’t change the final outcome. I’m a little disappointed I didn’t reach my own goal. She put away the unused ticket in disappointment. I’m proud of her for seeing it through. Residents of this city are proud of their traditions. It took courage for me to go on stage the first time. I finally had the courage to ask that question. This part is so fast I struggle to keep up. He struggles to carry this box alone. After resting, I got some energy back. Can the lost file be restored? I do want to speak; I just lack chances to practise. This plan lacks a specific schedule. On first hearing, it’s difficult to judge what he means. I find it hard to accept a conclusion based on one sentence. She longs for a chance to choose for herself. I really want to start chatting naturally with everyone. He said helplessly that the tickets had sold out. I had no good option but to wait for the next service. I can’t cope with everyone talking at once; I can’t hear clearly. She couldn’t bear the heat in the room and opened the window. I’m worried I’ll miss the second line again. He worried his friend wouldn’t find the place and sent a map. I’m still getting used to the sound on stage. It took her a week to adapt to the new schedule. After practising I was still a little nervous. The weather changed but his plan stayed the same. This is only my subjective impression; yours may differ. Judging only by a first impression can be too subjective. The result was better than I expected. Sometimes high expectations make disappointment more likely. Tell me more about what was happening at the time. In a different situation the same sentence may mean something else. Everyone applauded after the performance. Someone at the back started clapping before he’d finished speaking.

text: 这次活动由我负责安排顺序，一共有十二个人准备上台。有些人认识很久，有些第一次来。开始以前，我问大家想完整唱一段，还是只试自己选的几句。两个人选了短的部分，其他人选了整段，我们照着他们的选择安排，没有要求每个人一样长。
pinyin: zhè cì huó dòng yóu wǒ fù zé ān pái shùn xù , yī gòng yǒu shí èr gè rén zhǔn bèi shàng tái . yǒu xiē rén rèn shi hěn jiǔ , yǒu xiē dì yī cì lái . kāi shǐ yǐ qián , wǒ wèn dà jiā xiǎng wán zhěng chàng yī duàn , hái shi zhǐ shì zì jǐ xuǎn de jǐ jù . liǎng gè rén xuǎn le duǎn de bù fèn , qí tā rén xuǎn le zhěng duàn , wǒ men zhào zhe tā men de xuǎn zé ān pái , méi yǒu yāo qiú měi gè rén yī yàng zhǎng .
meaning: I arranged the order for twelve people at this event. Some were familiar faces and others were new. Before starting, I asked whether they wanted a full section or a few selected lines. Two chose short parts, and the others chose full sections. We used their choices rather than requiring identical lengths.

text: 一个第一次上台的朋友唱到第二句时停了一下，前排的人指了开始的位置。他后来接上了，但走下来时看着地面，没有和旁边的人说话。我过去问他要不要喝水。他说先出去一会儿，另一个熟悉他的朋友陪他走了。我就告诉大家，下一位准备，不把所有人的注意都留在他身上。
pinyin: yī gè dì yī cì shàng tái de péng you chàng dào dì èr jù shí tíng le yī xià , qián pái de rén zhǐ le kāi shǐ de wèi zhì . tā hòu lái jiē shàng le , dàn zǒu xià lái shí kàn zhe dì miàn , méi yǒu hé páng biān de rén shuō huà . wǒ guò qù wèn tā yào bù yào hē shuǐ . tā shuō xiān chū qù yī huì er , lìng yī gè shú xī tā de péng you péi tā zǒu le . wǒ jiù gào sù dà jiā , xià yī wèi zhǔn bèi , bù bǎ suǒ yǒu rén de zhù yì dōu liú zài tā shēn shàng .
meaning: A first-time performer paused in the second line, then restarted after someone in front pointed to the entry. He looked down afterwards and didn’t talk. I asked if he’d like water. He wanted a moment outside, and a friend went with him. I moved to the next performer rather than keeping everyone’s attention on him.

text: 后来有人问，刚才鼓掌是不是让他别再唱。我说不是，我是在他唱完以后鼓掌，谢谢他参加。那个人说自己坐在后面，只听见一阵掌声，没看见他已经放下话筒。我指了指旁边的空椅子，让他下次坐近一点。他笑着说好，上次也是没看清，回来以后自己想了半天。
pinyin: hòu lái yǒu rén wèn , gāng cái gǔ zhǎng shì bú shì ràng tā bié zài chàng . wǒ shuō bù shì , wǒ shì zài tā chàng wán yǐ hòu gǔ zhǎng , xiè xiè tā cān jiā . nà gè rén shuō zì jǐ zuò zài hòu miàn , zhǐ tīng jiàn yī zhèn zhǎng shēng , méi kàn jiàn tā yǐ jīng fàng xià huà tǒng . wǒ zhǐ le zhǐ páng biān de kōng yǐ zi , ràng tā xià cì zuò jìn yī diǎn . tā xiào zhe shuō hǎo , shàng cì yě shì méi kàn qīng , huí lái yǐ hòu zì jǐ xiǎng le bàn tiān .
meaning: Someone later asked whether the applause meant he should stop singing. No, I said: I clapped after he finished, to thank him. Sitting at the back, the questioner had heard applause but hadn't seen the microphone lowered. I pointed to an empty chair nearby and suggested sitting closer next time. He laughed: last time he'd missed something too and spent ages wondering about it afterwards.

text: 吃东西的时候，几个朋友开始讲自己的第一次。有个人说，他本来想表现得很自然，一拿起话筒却把介绍自己的句子忘了。另一个说，她练得最多的地方没有错，平时觉得最容易的一句反而漏了。大家没有照着一种经历来安慰，而是把自己的具体情况说出来，话题就从一个人的失误变成了共同经历。
pinyin: chī dōng xi de shí hou , jǐ gè péng you kāi shǐ jiǎng zì jǐ de dì yī cì . yǒu gè rén shuō , tā běn lái xiǎng biǎo xiàn de hěn zì rán , yī ná qǐ huà tǒng què bǎ jiè shào zì jǐ de jù zi wàng le . lìng yī gè shuō , tā liàn de zuì duō de dì fāng méi yǒu cuò , píng shí jué de zuì róng yì de yī jù fǎn ér lòu le . dà jiā méi yǒu zhào zhe yī zhǒng jīng lì lái ān wèi , ér shì bǎ zì jǐ de jù tǐ qíng kuàng shuō chū lái , huà tí jiù cóng yī gè rén de shī wù biàn chéng le gòng tóng jīng lì .
meaning: Over food, people shared their first attempts. One had wanted to seem natural but forgot his introduction on picking up the microphone. Another made no error in the most-practised section but missed an apparently easy line. Their specific accounts shifted the conversation from one person’s mistake to shared experiences.

text: 我想起自己以前带活动，常说“别紧张，一定没问题”。有时这句话能让气氛轻松一点，有时对方还是会紧张，甚至不知道出了问题该怎么办。这次我试着多说一点实际安排：可以选短的部分；忘了可以重新找开始的位置；结束以后，可以自己决定什么时候听录音。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ yǐ qián dài huó dòng , cháng shuō bié jǐn zhāng , yí dìng méi wèn tí . yǒu shí zhè jù huà néng ràng qì fēn qīng sōng yī diǎn , yǒu shí duì fāng hái shi huì jǐn zhāng , shèn zhì bù zhī dào chū le wèn tí gāi zěn me bàn . zhè cì wǒ shì zhe duō shuō yī diǎn shí jì ān pái : kě yǐ xuǎn duǎn de bù fèn ; wàng le kě yǐ chóng xīn zhǎo kāi shǐ de wèi zhì ; jié shù yǐ hòu , kě yǐ zì jǐ jué dìng shén me shí hou tīng lù yīn .
meaning: I remembered telling people, “Don’t be nervous; it’ll definitely be fine.” Sometimes that relaxed the atmosphere; sometimes they remained nervous and didn’t know what to do if something went wrong. This time I gave practical options: a shorter part, finding an entry again if they forgot, and choosing when to listen to the recording afterwards.

text: 活动结束前，那位出去休息的朋友回来了，手里拿着刚买的面包。他问下次还能不能带同一段，又说已经找到了要练的位置。我把日期发给他，请他想好唱哪几句以后告诉我。旁边的人凑过来看，说这首他也在练，两个人很快交换了联系方式，约好先把第二句一起读清楚。
pinyin: huó dòng jié shù qián , nà wèi chū qù xiū xī de péng you huí lái le , shǒu lǐ ná zhe gāng mǎi de miàn bāo . tā wèn xià cì hái néng bù néng dài tóng yī duàn , yòu shuō yǐ jīng zhǎo dào le yào liàn de wèi zhì . wǒ bǎ rì qī fā gěi tā , qǐng tā xiǎng hǎo chàng nǎ jǐ jù yǐ hòu gào sù wǒ . páng biān de rén còu guò lái kàn , shuō zhè shǒu tā yě zài liàn , liǎng gè rén hěn kuài jiāo huàn le lián xì fāng shì , yuē hǎo xiān bǎ dì èr jù yì qǐ dú qīng chǔ .
meaning: Before the event ended, the friend who'd stepped outside returned with a newly bought bread roll. He wanted to bring the same section next time and knew what needed practice. I sent the date and asked him to tell me which lines he chose. Someone beside him leaned over: he was practising that song too. They exchanged details and agreed to read the second line together first.

text: 收好东西以后，我在群里发了今天的照片。有一张拍到两个人低头看同一页歌词，另一张里，第一次拿话筒的朋友正在笑。第二天，群里有人问下一次的时间，也有人发来自己在家练的短录音。我把报名的位置留在消息最后，写了完整唱和只试几句两种选择，没想到最先回复的还是昨天出去休息的那位。

zhěng chàng yī duàn , hái shi zhǐ shì zì jǐ xuǎn de jǐ jù . liǎng gè rén xuǎn le duǎn de bù fèn , qí tā rén xuǎn le zhěng duàn , wǒ men zhào zhe tā men de xuǎn zé ān pái , méi yǒu yāo qiú měi gè rén yī yàng zhǎng . yī gè dì yī cì shàng tái de péng you chàng dào dì èr jù shí tíng le yī xià , qián pái de rén zhǐ le kāi shǐ de wèi zhì . tā hòu lái jiē shàng le , dàn zǒu xià lái shí kàn zhe dì miàn , méi yǒu hé páng biān de rén shuō huà . wǒ guò qù wèn tā yào bù yào hē shuǐ . tā shuō xiān chū qù yī huì er , lìng yī gè shú xī tā de péng you péi tā zǒu le . wǒ jiù gào sù dà jiā , xià yī wèi zhǔn bèi diǎn . tā xiào zhe shuō hǎo , shàng cì yě shì méi kàn qīng , huí lái yǐ hòu zì jǐ xiǎng le bàn tiān . chī dōng xi de shí hou , jǐ gè péng you kāi shǐ jiǎng zì jǐ de dì yī cì . yǒu gè rén shuō , tā běn lái xiǎng biǎo xiàn de hěn zì rán , yī ná qǐ huà tǒng què bǎ jiè shào zì jǐ de jù zi wàng le . lìng yī gè shuō , tā liàn de zuì duō de dì fāng méi yǒu cuò , píng shí jué de zuì róng yì de yī jù fǎn ér jiāo huàn le lián xì fāng shì , yuē hǎo xiān bǎ dì èr jù yì qǐ dú qīng chǔ . shōu hǎo dōng xi yǐ hòu , wǒ zài qún lǐ fā le jīn tiān de zhào piān . yǒu yī zhāng pāi dào liǎng gè rén dī tóu kàn tóng yī yè gē cí , lìng yī zhāng lǐ , dì yī cì ná huà tǒng de péng you zhèng zài xiào . dì èr tiān , qún lǐ yǒu rén wèn xià yī cì de shí jiān , yě yǒu rén fā lái zì jǐ zài jiā liàn de duǎn lù yīn . wǒ bǎ bào míng de wèi zhì liú zài xiāo xī zuì hòu , xiě le wán zhěng chàng hé zhǐ shì jǐ jù liǎng zhǒng xuǎn zé , méi xiǎng dào zuì xiān huí fù de hái shi zuó tiān chū qù xiū xī de nà wèi .
meaning: I arranged the order for twelve people at this event. Some were familiar faces and others were new. Before starting, I asked whether they wanted a full section or a few selected lines. Two chose short parts, and the others chose full sections. We used their choices rather than requiring identical lengths. A first-time performer paused in the second line, then restarted after someone in front pointed to the entry. He looked down afterwards and didn’t talk. I asked if he’d like water. He wanted a moment outside, and a friend went with him. I moved to the next performer rather than keeping everyone’s attention on him. Someone later asked whether the applause meant he should stop singing. No, I said: I clapped after he finished, to thank him. Sitting at the back, the questioner had heard applause but hadn't seen the microphone lowered. I pointed to an empty chair nearby and suggested sitting closer next time. He laughed: last time he'd missed something too and spent ages wondering about it afterwards. Over food, people shared their first attempts. One had wanted to seem natural but forgot his introduction on picking up the microphone. Another made no error in the most-practised section but missed an apparently easy line. Their specific accounts shifted the conversation from one person’s mistake to shared experiences. I remembered telling people, “Don’t be nervous; it’ll definitely be fine.” Sometimes that relaxed the atmosphere; sometimes they remained nervous and didn’t know what to do if something went wrong. This time I gave practical options: a shorter part, finding an entry again if they forgot, and choosing when to listen to the recording afterwards. Before the event ended, the friend who'd stepped outside returned with a newly bought bread roll. He wanted to bring the same section next time and knew what needed practice. I sent the date and asked him to tell me which lines he chose. Someone beside him leaned over: he was practising that song too. They exchanged details and agreed to read the second line together first. After packing up I posted the photos to our group. One showed two people studying the same lyric sheet; another caught the first-time microphone holder laughing. The next day people asked about the next date and shared short practice recordings. At the end of the message I offered full sections or just a few lines. To my surprise, yesterday's friend who'd gone out for a rest replied first.

text: 这段你说很浪漫，我怎么觉得是在想家？
pinyin: zhè duàn nǐ shuō hěn làng màn , wǒ zěn me jué de shì zài xiǎng jiā ?
meaning: You called this section romantic. Why does it feel like homesickness to me?

text: 我一开始看见“等你”，就以为是等一个喜欢的人。
pinyin: wǒ yī kāi shǐ kàn jiàn děng nǐ , jiù yǐ wéi shì děng yī gè xǐ huān de rén .
meaning: At first I saw “waiting for you” and assumed a loved person was coming.

text: 可后面说院子的树、门上的旧画，这不像只在讲恋爱。
pinyin: kě hòu miàn shuō yuàn zi de shù , mén shàng de jiù huà , zhè bù xiàng zhǐ zài jiǎng liàn ài .
meaning: But then there are the courtyard tree and the old drawing on the door. It doesn’t seem to be only about romance.

text: 你这么说也有道理。“你”可能是家里的人。
pinyin: nǐ zhè me shuō yě yǒu dào lǐ . nǐ kě néng shì jiā lǐ de rén .
meaning: That’s a fair point. “You” could be someone at home.

text: 也可能不是某一个人。最后写“把声音带走”，不像真的有人跟着走。
pinyin: yě kě néng bù shì mǒu yī gè rén . zuì hòu xiě bǎ shēng yīn dài zǒu , bù xiàng zhēn de yǒu rén gēn zhe zǒu .
meaning: It may not be one particular person. “Carry the sound away” at the end doesn’t look like an actual person leaving with them.

text: 那你觉得“门还在，路已经远了”是什么意思？
pinyin: nà nǐ jué de mén hái zài , lù yǐ jīng yuǎn le shì shén me yì si ?
meaning: What do you think “the door is still there, but the road has become distant” means?

text: 门没消失，可说话的人离开很久，回去的感觉不一样了。
pinyin: mén méi xiāo shī , kě shuō huà de rén lí kāi hěn jiǔ , huí qù de gǎn jué bù yī yàng le .
meaning: The door hasn’t disappeared, but the speaker has been away a long time, so returning feels different.

text: 所以不是地图上的路突然变长？
pinyin: suǒ yǐ bù shì dì tú shàng de lù tū rán biàn zhǎng ?
meaning: So the road on the map hasn’t suddenly lengthened?

text: 我觉得不是。前面一直在讲时间，岁月、旧画、以前的声音。
pinyin: wǒ jué de bù shì . qián miàn yì zhí zài jiǎng shí jiān , suì yuè , jiù huà , yǐ qián de shēng yīn .
meaning: I don’t think so. The earlier lines keep referring to time: years, an old drawing, earlier sounds.

text: 我光注意“等你”了，别的都看得太快。
pinyin: wǒ guāng zhù yì děng nǐ le , bié de dōu kàn de tài kuài .
meaning: I focused on “waiting for you” and read everything else too quickly.

text: 那我们各说一个读法，看看哪些句子支持。
pinyin: nà wǒ men gè shuō yī gè dú fǎ , kàn kàn nǎ xiē jù zi zhī chí .
meaning: Let’s each explain a reading and see which lines support it.

text: 我的读法是恋人分开以后，还保留一起生活的东西。
pinyin: wǒ de dú fǎ shì liàn rén fēn kāi yǐ hòu , hái bǎo liú yì qǐ shēng huó de dōng xi .
meaning: Mine is that after lovers separate, the speaker keeps reminders of their shared life.

text: 可以。不过“门上的旧画”也可能是小时候画的，不一定只和恋人有关。
pinyin: kě yǐ . bù guò mén shàng de jiù huà yě kě néng shì xiǎo shí hòu huà de , bù yí dìng zhǐ hé liàn rén yǒu guān .
meaning: That could work, but the old drawing on the door could be from childhood, not necessarily a partner.

text: 你的读法呢？
pinyin: nǐ de dú fǎ ne ?
meaning: What’s yours?

text: 人去了新地方，想家，但也想带着那些记忆继续走。

pinyin: zhè duàn nǐ shuō hěn làng màn , wǒ zěn me jué de shì zài xiǎng jiā ? wǒ yī kāi shǐ kàn jiàn děng nǐ , jiù yǐ wéi shì děng yī gè xǐ huān de rén . kě hòu miàn shuō yuàn zi de shù , mén shàng de jiù huà , zhè bù xiàng zhǐ zài jiǎng liàn ài . nǐ zhè me shuō yě yǒu dào lǐ . nǐ kě néng shì jiā lǐ de rén . yě kě néng bù shì mǒu yī gè rén . zuì hòu xiě bǎ shēng yīn dài zǒu , bù xiàng zhēn de yǒu rén gēn zhe zǒu . nà nǐ jué de mén hái zài , lù yǐ jīng yuǎn le shì shén me yì si ? mén méi xiāo shī , kě shuō huà de rén lí kāi hěn jiǔ , huí qù de gǎn jué bù yī yàng le . suǒ yǐ bù shì dì tú shàng de lù tū rán biàn zhǎng ? wǒ jué de bù shì . qián miàn yì zhí zài jiǎng shí jiān , suì yuè , jiù huà , yǐ qián de shēng yīn . wǒ guāng zhù yì děng nǐ le , bié de dōu kàn de tài kuài . nà wǒ men gè shuō yī gè dú fǎ , kàn kàn nǎ xiē jù zi zhī chí . wǒ de dú fǎ shì liàn rén fēn kāi yǐ hòu , hái bǎo liú yì qǐ shēng huó de dōng xi . kě yǐ . bù guò mén shàng de jiù huà yě kě néng shì xiǎo shí hòu huà de , bù yí dìng zhǐ hé liàn rén yǒu guān . nǐ de dú fǎ ne ? rén qù le xīn dì fāng , xiǎng jiā , dàn yě xiǎng dài zhe nà xiē jì yì jì xù zǒu . zuì hòu de míng zǎo chū fā dǎo shì zhī chí zhè gè . xiān bǎ nǐ de yě xiě xià lái . xiě wán zài shì zhe gēn yīn yuè , bié zhǐ bǎ zì chàng de kuài . hǎo . wǒ jīn tiān xiān liàn zhè liǎng jù , shèng xià de míng tiān zài shuō .
meaning: You called this section romantic. Why does it feel like homesickness to me? At first I saw “waiting for you” and assumed a loved person was coming. But then there are the courtyard tree and the old drawing on the door. It doesn’t seem to be only about romance. That’s a fair point. “You” could be someone at home. It may not be one particular person. “Carry the sound away” at the end doesn’t look like an actual person leaving with them. What do you think “the door is still there, but the road has become distant” means? The door hasn’t disappeared, but the speaker has been away a long time, so returning feels different. So the road on the map hasn’t suddenly lengthened? I don’t think so. The earlier lines keep referring to time: years, an old drawing, earlier sounds. I focused on “waiting for you” and read everything else too quickly. Let’s each explain a reading and see which lines support it. Mine is that after lovers separate, the speaker keeps reminders of their shared life. That could work, but the old drawing on the door could be from childhood, not necessarily a partner. What’s yours? Someone moves somewhere new, misses home and wants to carry those memories forward. “Depart tomorrow morning” at the end supports that. Write yours down too. After writing it down, let’s try with the music rather than just rushing the words. Okay. I’ll practise these two lines today and leave the rest until tomorrow.
