text: 第一次读这首诗歌，我只注意到“你说回来”和“我却数着”。我想到两个人分开以后，一个说回来很容易，另一个却一直等。于是我告诉朋友，这是一首有点难过的情歌。他没有马上反对，只问我，院子的树和门上的画在这里做什么。我又往前读了一遍，才发现自己把这些句子当成了没有意思的背景。
pinyin: dì yī cì dú zhè shǒu shī gē , wǒ zhǐ zhù yì dào nǐ shuō huí lái hé wǒ què shù zhe . wǒ xiǎng dào liǎng gè rén fēn kāi yǐ hòu , yī gè shuō huí lái hěn róng yì , lìng yī gè què yì zhí děng . yú shì wǒ gào sù péng you , zhè shì yī shǒu yǒu diǎn nán guò de qíng gē . tā méi yǒu mǎ shàng fǎn duì , zhǐ wèn wǒ , yuàn zi de shù hé mén shàng de huà zài zhè lǐ zuò shén me . wǒ yòu wǎng qián dú le yī biàn , cái fā xiàn zì jǐ bǎ zhè xiē jù zi dàng chéng le méi yǒu yì si de bèi jǐng .
meaning: On the first reading I noticed only “you said to return” and “yet I counted”. I imagined two people separating: one making returning sound easy and the other waiting. I called it a sad love song. My friend asked what the tree and drawing were doing there. Reading again, I realised I had treated those lines as meaningless background.

text: 树长高，纸上的画变淡，都需要时间。歌词没有写两个人到底分开了几年，却把时间放在这些东西上。门上的画是一张贴在门上的纸画，并不是画在木头上。读到后面“放回原来的地方”，我想到说话的人把纸画拿下来看看，又贴回去。这个动作很小，却让我觉得他舍不得真的离开。
pinyin: shù zhǎng gāo , zhǐ shàng de huà biàn dàn , dōu xū yào shí jiān . gē cí méi yǒu xiě liǎng gè rén dào dǐ fēn kāi le jǐ nián , què bǎ shí jiān fàng zài zhè xiē dōng xi shàng . mén shàng de huà shì yī zhāng tiē zài mén shàng de zhǐ huà , bìng bù shì huà zài mù tou shàng . dú dào hòu miàn fàng huí yuán lái de dì fāng , wǒ xiǎng dào shuō huà de rén bǎ zhǐ huà ná xià lái kàn kàn , yòu tiē huí qù . zhè gè dòng zuò hěn xiǎo , què ràng wǒ jué de tā shě bù de zhēn de lí kāi .
meaning: A tree growing and a paper drawing fading both take time. The lyric gives no exact number of years but shows time through objects. The drawing is on paper attached to the door, not painted on wood. Putting it back suggests taking it down to look at it, then returning it. That small action made me feel the speaker was reluctant to leave.

text: 朋友说，这些也可能是小时候留在家里的东西。院子里的树越来越高，自己却在外面生活；回来时，房子还能认出来，心里的感觉已经变了。他问我小时候有没有把画贴在门上。我说有，而且以前觉得非常好看，现在再看，连自己画的是什么都不太确定。我们笑了一会儿，话题从歌词变成了以前的家。
pinyin: péng you shuō , zhè xiē yě kě néng shì xiǎo shí hòu liú zài jiā lǐ de dōng xi . yuàn zi lǐ de shù yuè lái yuè gāo , zì jǐ què zài wài miàn shēng huó ; huí lái shí , fáng zi hái néng rèn chū lái , xīn lǐ de gǎn jué yǐ jīng biàn le . tā wèn wǒ xiǎo shí hòu yǒu méi yǒu bǎ huà tiē zài mén shàng . wǒ shuō yǒu , ér qiě yǐ qián jué de fēi cháng hǎo kàn , xiàn zài zài kàn , lián zì jǐ huà de shì shén me dōu bù tài què dìng . wǒ men xiào le yī huì er , huà tí cóng gē cí biàn chéng le yǐ qián de jiā .
meaning: My friend suggested childhood things left at home: a taller tree while someone lives elsewhere, a recognisable house but a changed feeling. He asked whether I had put drawings on doors as a child. I had thought mine wonderful then, but now could barely tell what I had drawn. We laughed and moved from the lyric to memories of home.

text: “门还在，路已经远了”最让我犹豫。如果只把它当作出门的路，前面没有修路，也没有搬走房子的情节，突然说路变远就不容易接上。但如果“路”让人联想到离开的岁月、和家里的人越来越少的见面，前后的画面就连起来了。这不等于只有一种解释，只是后一种读法有更多句子能支持。
pinyin: mén hái zài , lù yǐ jīng yuǎn le zuì ràng wǒ yóu yù . rú guǒ zhǐ bǎ tā dàng zuò chū mén de lù , qián miàn méi yǒu xiū lù , yě méi yǒu bān zǒu fáng zi de qíng jié , tū rán shuō lù biàn yuǎn jiù bù róng yì jiē shàng . dàn rú guǒ lù ràng rén lián xiǎng dào lí kāi de suì yuè , hé jiā lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo de jiàn miàn , qián hòu de huà miàn jiù lián qǐ lái le . zhè bù děng yú zhǐ yǒu yī zhǒng jiě shì , zhǐ shì hòu yī zhǒng dú fǎ yǒu gèng duō jù zi néng zhī chí .
meaning: I hesitated over “the door is still there, but the road has become distant”. There is no road construction or moved house, so a literal longer road is hard to connect. If the road suggests years away and fewer meetings with family, the images fit together. That does not make it the only interpretation, just one supported by more lines.

text: 最后两句又改变了我对整首诗的感想。说话的人明早还要出发，并没有决定永远住在老屋里。“不把过去关上”也不一定是不关门；把声音装进行囊，更不是把一个人装进包里。这些话让我想到，离开和珍惜并不总是相反的。人可以去新的地方，也可以把旧日的记忆带进新的生活。
pinyin: zuì hòu liǎng jù yòu gǎi biàn le wǒ duì zhěng shǒu shī de gǎn xiǎng . shuō huà de rén míng zǎo hái yào chū fā , bìng méi yǒu jué dìng yǒng yuǎn zhù zài lǎo wū lǐ . bù bǎ guò qù guān shang yě bù yí dìng shì bù guān mén ; bǎ shēng yīn zhuāng jìn xíng náng , gèng bù shì bǎ yī gè rén zhuāng jìn bāo lǐ . zhè xiē huà ràng wǒ xiǎng dào , lí kāi hé zhēn xī bìng bù zǒng shì xiāng fǎn de . rén kě yǐ qù xīn de dì fāng , yě kě yǐ bǎ jiù rì de jì yì dài jìn xīn de shēng huó .
meaning: The final lines changed my impression. The speaker leaves tomorrow, rather than deciding to stay forever. Not shutting away the past need not mean leaving a physical door open; packing a voice is not packing a person. Leaving and cherishing need not be opposites. Someone can move somewhere new and carry old memories into that life.

text: 我仍然觉得这首诗可以读出恋人分开的意思。朋友说那就把你喜欢的两句留下，我也选两句，我们交换着读。我写到“肯定是恋人”时，他指了指旁边的树和旧画，问这两样怎么放进去。我想了一会儿，把肯定改成也可能。轮到读他的笔记，我发现他说家里的那一段，也让我想起了很久没回去的院子。
pinyin: wǒ réng rán jué de zhè shǒu shī kě yǐ dú chū liàn rén fēn kāi de yì si . péng you shuō nà jiù bǎ nǐ xǐ huān de liǎng jù liú xià , wǒ yě xuǎn liǎng jù , wǒ men jiāo huàn zhe dú . wǒ xiě dào kěn dìng shì liàn rén shí , tā zhǐ le zhǐ páng biān de shù hé jiù huà , wèn zhè liǎng yàng zěn me fàng jìn qù . wǒ xiǎng le yī huì er , bǎ kěn dìng gǎi chéng yě kě néng . lún dào dú tā de bǐ jì , wǒ fā xiàn tā shuō jiā lǐ de nà yī duàn , yě ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ le hěn jiǔ méi huí qù de yuàn zi .
meaning: I still heard a story of separated lovers. My friend suggested we each keep two favourite lines and swap notes. When I wrote 'definitely lovers,' he pointed to the tree and old drawing: how did those fit? After thinking, I changed 'definitely' to 'possibly.' Reading his note about home then reminded me of a courtyard I hadn't visited for years.

text: 准备跟唱时，我先按说话的方式读了最后四句。以前我一快就把“到了新地方”里的“了”漏掉，意思也没来得及想。这次我先把画面讲给朋友，再把两句连起来读。音乐还没有放，我已经知道哪里要停一下。能解释自己为什么喜欢，不会直接让我唱得好，却让我不再只是追着声音跑。
pinyin: zhǔn bèi gēn chàng shí , wǒ xiān àn shuō huà de fāng shì dú le zuì hòu sì jù . yǐ qián wǒ yī kuài jiù bǎ dào le xīn dì fāng lǐ de le lòu diào , yì si yě méi lái de jí xiǎng . zhè cì wǒ xiān bǎ huà miàn jiǎng gěi péng you , zài bǎ liǎng jù lián qǐ lái dú . yīn yuè hái méi yǒu fàng , wǒ yǐ jīng zhī dào nǎ lǐ yào tíng yī xià . néng jiě shì zì jǐ wèi shén me xǐ huān , bù huì zhí jiē ràng wǒ chàng de hǎo , què ràng wǒ bù zài zhǐ shì zhuī zhe shēng yīn pǎo .
meaning: Before singing along, I read the final four lines as speech. At speed I used to omit 了 from “when I reach the new place”, without thinking about the meaning. This time I explained the image and connected two lines. Before playing music I knew where to pause. Explaining why I liked it did not automatically improve my singing, but I was no longer only chasing sounds.

huí lái shí , fáng zi hái néng rèn chū lái , xīn lǐ de gǎn jué yǐ jīng biàn le . tā wèn wǒ xiǎo shí hòu yǒu méi yǒu bǎ huà tiē zài mén shàng . wǒ shuō yǒu , ér qiě yǐ qián jué de fēi cháng hǎo kàn , xiàn zài zài kàn , lián zì jǐ huà de shì shén me dōu bù tài què dìng . wǒ men xiào le yī huì er , huà tí cóng gē cí biàn chéng le yǐ qián de jiā . mén hái zài , lù yǐ jīng yuǎn le zuì ràng wǒ yóu yù . rú guǒ zhǐ bǎ tā dàng zuò chū mén de lù , qián miàn méi yǒu xiū lù , yě méi yǒu bān zǒu fáng zi de qíng jié , tū rán shuō lù biàn yuǎn jiù bù róng yì jiē shàng . dàn rú guǒ lù ràng rén lián xiǎng dào lí kāi de suì yuè , hé jiā lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo de jiàn miàn , qián hòu de huà miàn jiù lián qǐ lái le . zhè bù děng yú zhǐ yǒu yī zhǒng jiě shì , zhǐ shì hòu yī zhǒng dú fǎ yǒu gèng duō jù zi néng zhī chí . zuì hòu liǎng jù yòu gǎi biàn le wǒ duì zhěng shǒu shī de gǎn xiǎng . shuō huà de rén míng zǎo hái yào chū fā , bìng méi yǒu jué dìng yǒng yuǎn zhù zài lǎo wū lǐ . bù bǎ guò qù guān shang yě bù yí dìng shì bù guān mén ; bǎ shēng yīn zhuāng jìn xíng náng , gèng bù shì bǎ yī gè rén zhuāng jìn bāo lǐ . zhè xiē huà ràng wǒ xiǎng dào , lí kāi hé zhēn xī bìng bù zǒng shì xiāng fǎn de . rén kě yǐ qù xīn de dì fāng , yě kě yǐ bǎ jiù rì de jì yì dài jìn xīn de shēng huó . wǒ réng rán jué de zhè shǒu shī kě yǐ dú chū liàn rén fēn kāi de yì si . péng you shuō nà jiù bǎ nǐ xǐ huān de liǎng jù liú xià , wǒ yě xuǎn liǎng jù , wǒ men jiāo huàn zhe dú . wǒ xiě dào kěn dìng shì liàn rén shí , tā zhǐ le zhǐ páng biān de shù hé jiù huà , wèn zhè liǎng yàng zěn me fàng jìn qù . wǒ xiǎng le yī huì er , bǎ kěn dìng gǎi chéng yě kě néng . lún dào dú tā de bǐ jì , wǒ fā xiàn tā shuō jiā lǐ de nà yī duàn , yě ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ le hěn jiǔ méi huí qù de yuàn zi . zhǔn bèi gēn chàng shí , wǒ xiān àn shuō huà de fāng shì dú le zuì hòu sì jù . yǐ qián wǒ yī kuài jiù bǎ dào le xīn dì fāng lǐ de le lòu diào , yì si yě méi lái de jí xiǎng . zhè cì wǒ xiān bǎ huà miàn jiǎng gěi péng you , zài bǎ liǎng jù lián qǐ lái dú . yīn yuè hái méi yǒu fàng , wǒ yǐ jīng zhī dào nǎ lǐ yào tíng yī xià . néng jiě shì zì jǐ wèi shén me xǐ huān , bù huì zhí jiē ràng wǒ chàng de hǎo , què ràng wǒ bù zài zhǐ shì zhuī zhe shēng yīn pǎo .
meaning: On the first reading I noticed only “you said to return” and “yet I counted”. I imagined two people separating: one making returning sound easy and the other waiting. I called it a sad love song. My friend asked what the tree and drawing were doing there. Reading again, I realised I had treated those lines as meaningless background. A tree growing and a paper drawing fading both take time. The lyric gives no exact number of years but shows time through objects. The drawing is on paper attached to the door, not painted on wood. Putting it back suggests taking it down to look at it, then returning it. That small action made me feel the speaker was reluctant to leave. My friend suggested childhood things left at home: a taller tree while someone lives elsewhere, a recognisable house but a changed feeling. He asked whether I had put drawings on doors as a child. I had thought mine wonderful then, but now could barely tell what I had drawn. We laughed and moved from the lyric to memories of home. I hesitated over “the door is still there, but the road has become distant”. There is no road construction or moved house, so a literal longer road is hard to connect. If the road suggests years away and fewer meetings with family, the images fit together. That does not make it the only interpretation, just one supported by more lines. The final lines changed my impression. The speaker leaves tomorrow, rather than deciding to stay forever. Not shutting away the past need not mean leaving a physical door open; packing a voice is not packing a person. Leaving and cherishing need not be opposites. Someone can move somewhere new and carry old memories into that life. I still heard a story of separated lovers. My friend suggested we each keep two favourite lines and swap notes. When I wrote 'definitely lovers,' he pointed to the tree and old drawing: how did those fit? After thinking, I changed 'definitely' to 'possibly.' Reading his note about home then reminded me of a courtyard I hadn't visited for years. Before singing along, I read the final four lines as speech. At speed I used to omit 了 from “when I reach the new place”, without thinking about the meaning. This time I explained the image and connected two lines. Before playing music I knew where to pause. Explaining why I liked it did not automatically improve my singing, but I was no longer only chasing sounds.

text: 院子的树，又长高一点。
pinyin: yuàn zi de shù , yòu zhǎng gāo yī diǎn .
meaning: The courtyard tree is a little taller again.

text: 门上的画，淡了半边。
pinyin: mén shàng de huà , dàn le bàn biān .
meaning: Half the drawing on the door has faded.

text: 你说回来，不用挑哪一天。
pinyin: nǐ shuō huí lái , bù yòng tiāo nǎ yī tiān .
meaning: You said there was no need to choose a special day to return.

text: 我却数着，一年又一年。
pinyin: wǒ què shù zhe , yī nián yòu yī nián .
meaning: Yet I counted one year after another.

text: 窗外的雨，把黄昏拉长。
pinyin: chuāng wài de yǔ , bǎ huáng hūn lā zhǎng .
meaning: The rain outside stretches the dusk.

text: 屋里的钟，还照常地响。
pinyin: wū lǐ de zhōng , hái zhào cháng de xiǎng .
meaning: The clock inside keeps ticking as usual.

text: 门还在，路已经远了。
pinyin: mén hái zài , lù yǐ jīng yuǎn le .
meaning: The door is still there, but the road has become distant.

text: 有些声音，还留在身旁。
pinyin: yǒu xiē shēng yīn , hái liú zài shēn páng .
meaning: Some voices still remain beside me.

text: 我把旧画，放回原来的地方。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ jiù huà , fàng huí yuán lái de dì fāng .
meaning: I put the old drawing back where it was.

text: 把你的声音，轻轻装进行囊。
pinyin: bǎ nǐ de shēng yīn , qīng qīng zhuāng jìn xíng náng .
meaning: I gently pack your voice in my travelling bag.

text: 明早出发，不把过去关上。
pinyin: míng zǎo chū fā , bù bǎ guò qù guān shang .
meaning: I leave tomorrow morning without shutting away the past.

text: 到了新地方，再唱给你听。
pinyin: dào le xīn dì fāng , zài chàng gěi nǐ tīng .
meaning: When I reach the new place, I’ll sing it to you again.

text: 院子的树，又长高一点。门上的画，淡了半边。你说回来，不用挑哪一天。我却数着，一年又一年。窗外的雨，把黄昏拉长。屋里的钟，还照常地响。门还在，路已经远了。有些声音，还留在身旁。我把旧画，放回原来的地方。把你的声音，轻轻装进行囊。明早出发，不把过去关上。到了新地方，再唱给你听。
pinyin: yuàn zi de shù , yòu zhǎng gāo yī diǎn . mén shàng de huà , dàn le bàn biān . nǐ shuō huí lái , bù yòng tiāo nǎ yī tiān . wǒ què shù zhe , yī nián yòu yī nián . chuāng wài de yǔ , bǎ huáng hūn lā zhǎng . wū lǐ de zhōng , hái zhào cháng de xiǎng . mén hái zài , lù yǐ jīng yuǎn le . yǒu xiē shēng yīn , hái liú zài shēn páng . wǒ bǎ jiù huà , fàng huí yuán lái de dì fāng . bǎ nǐ de shēng yīn , qīng qīng zhuāng jìn xíng náng . míng zǎo chū fā , bù bǎ guò qù guān shang . dào le xīn dì fāng , zài chàng gěi nǐ tīng .
meaning: The courtyard tree is a little taller again. Half the drawing on the door has faded. You said there was no need to choose a special day to return. Yet I counted one year after another. The rain outside stretches the dusk. The clock inside keeps ticking as usual. The door is still there, but the road has become distant. Some voices still remain beside me. I put the old drawing back where it was. I gently pack your voice in my travelling bag. I leave tomorrow morning without shutting away the past. When I reach the new place, I’ll sing it to you again.

text: 读诗歌时，我会先找反复出现的画面。
pinyin: dú shī gē shí , wǒ huì xiān zhǎo fǎn fù chū xiàn de huà miàn .
meaning: When reading poetry I first look for recurring images.

text: 这些歌曲让我想起以前的朋友。
pinyin: zhè xiē gē qǔ ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián de péng you .
meaning: These songs remind me of old friends.

text: 她的第一张专辑去年发行了。
pinyin: tā de dì yī zhāng zhuān jí qù nián fā xíng le .
meaning: Her first album was released last year.

text: 他们在雨里散步，看起来很浪漫。
pinyin: tā men zài yǔ lǐ sàn bù , kàn qǐ lái hěn làng màn .
meaning: Their walk in the rain looks romantic.

text: 树在这篇文章里是时间的象征。
pinyin: shù zài zhè piān wén zhāng lǐ shì shí jiān de xiàng zhēng .
meaning: The tree symbolises time in this article.

text: 看到旧车站，我联想起第一次出门旅行。
pinyin: kàn dào jiù chē zhàn , wǒ lián xiǎng qǐ dì yī cì chū mén lǚ xíng .
meaning: The old station brings my first trip away to mind.

text: 我想了解这个角色内在的变化。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng liǎo jiě zhè gè jué sè nèi zài de biàn huà .
meaning: I’d like to understand this character’s inner change.

text: 照片和记忆里的样子不完全一样。
pinyin: zhào piān hé jì yì lǐ de yàng zi bù wán quán yī yàng .
meaning: The photo doesn’t quite match how I remember it.

text: 这些回忆不是每次想起都一样。
pinyin: zhè xiē huí yì bù shì měi cì xiǎng qǐ dōu yī yàng .
meaning: These memories don’t feel identical every time they return.

text: 她很怀念在小城生活的时光。
pinyin: tā hěn huái niàn zài xiǎo chéng shēng huó de shí guāng .
meaning: She misses the time she spent in the small town.

text: 这些照片记录了大家一起工作的岁月。
pinyin: zhè xiē zhào piān jì lù le dà jiā yì qǐ gōng zuò de suì yuè .
meaning: These photos record their years of working together.

text: 这是一段漫长的旅程。
pinyin: zhè shì yī duàn màn cháng de lǚ chéng .
meaning: This is a long journey.

text: 她舍不得离开，所以又坐了一会儿。
pinyin: tā shě bù de lí kāi , suǒ yǐ yòu zuò le yī huì er .
meaning: She was reluctant to leave and stayed a little longer.

text: 这张照片很普通，我却很珍惜。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhào piān hěn pǔ tōng , wǒ què hěn zhēn xī .
meaning: This photo is ordinary, but I treasure it.

text: 她渴望有人认真听她讲完。
pinyin: tā kě wàng yǒu rén rèn zhēn tīng tā jiǎng wán .
meaning: She longs for someone to hear her out properly.

text: 我先读了一篇散文，再读同一个作者的诗。
pinyin: wǒ xiān dú le yī piān sǎn wén , zài dú tóng yī gè zuò zhě de shī .
meaning: I read an essay and then a poem by the same writer.

text: 她把旅行的感想写在日记里。
pinyin: tā bǎ lǚ xíng de gǎn xiǎng xiě zài rì jì lǐ .
meaning: She wrote her thoughts about the trip in her diary.

text: 回顾这段经历，我才明白为什么会误会。
pinyin: huí gù zhè duàn jīng lì , wǒ cái míng bái wèi shén me huì wù huì .
meaning: Looking back on this experience, I understood why the misunderstanding arose.

text: 这个情节前面已经出现过一次。
pinyin: zhè gè qíng jié qián miàn yǐ jīng chū xiàn guò yī cì .
meaning: This plot point has appeared once before.

text: 我们选同一个主题，写出来的故事却不同。
pinyin: wǒ men xuǎn tóng yī gè zhǔ tí , xiě chū lái de gù shì què bù tóng .
meaning: We chose the same theme but wrote different stories.

text: 我忘了台词，却记得那个画面。
pinyin: wǒ wàng le tái cí , què jì de nà gè huà miàn .
meaning: I’ve forgotten the dialogue but remember the scene.

text: 他小时候喜欢模仿老师说话。
pinyin: tā xiǎo shí hòu xǐ huān mó fǎng lǎo shī shuō huà .
meaning: As a child he liked imitating how teachers spoke.

text: 前面那句话改变了这里的含义。
pinyin: qián miàn nà jù huà gǎi biàn le zhè lǐ de hán yì .
meaning: The earlier line changes the meaning here.

text: 我不知道怎么形容，只觉得很熟悉。
pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào zěn me xíng róng , zhǐ jué de hěn shú xī .
meaning: I don’t know how to describe it; it just feels familiar.

text: 这首诗歌写的是离开家以后的生活。读诗歌时，我会先找反复出现的画面。你想先练哪一首歌曲？这些歌曲让我想起以前的朋友。这张专辑里有两首我很喜欢的歌。她的第一张专辑去年发行了。你觉得这个故事浪漫，我觉得有点难过。他们在雨里散步，看起来很浪漫。这里的灯象征有人在等。树在这篇文章里是时间的象征。这个声音让我联想到小时候的院子。看到旧车站，我联想起第一次出门旅行。故事看起来很安静，内在的冲突却很强。我想了解这个角色内在的变化。这件事一直留在我的记忆里。照片和记忆里的样子不完全一样。我想回忆一下那天到底怎么说的。这些回忆不是每次想起都一样。我们一起练习的时光很短，但我记得很清楚。她很怀念在小城生活的时光。岁月过去，老屋的门已经换了。这些照片记录了大家一起工作的岁月。等消息的那一晚很漫长。这是一段漫长的旅程。这件旧外套我一直舍不得扔。她舍不得离开，所以又坐了一会儿。我想珍惜现在能见面的时间。这张照片很普通，我却很珍惜。他渴望再听见那个熟悉的声音。她渴望有人认真听她讲完。这篇散文把很小的事写得很有意思。我先读了一篇散文，再读同一个作者的诗。看完以后，你有什么感想？她把旅行的感想写在日记里。我们一起回顾了去年做过的事。回顾这段经历，我才明白为什么会误会。我记不清每个情节，但记得最后的画面。这个情节前面已经出现过一次。这段的主题不只是等一个人回来。我们选同一个主题，写出来的故事却不同。这句话让人想到很安静的画面。我忘了台词，却记得那个画面。我可以模仿这个读法，再听哪里不同。他小时候喜欢模仿老师说话。单看这句，含义还不清楚。前面那句话改变了这里的含义。你会用什么词形容这种感觉？我不知道怎么形容，只觉得很熟悉。
pinyin: zhè shǒu shī gē xiě de shì lí kāi jiā yǐ hòu de shēng huó . dú shī gē shí , wǒ huì xiān zhǎo fǎn fù chū xiàn de huà miàn . nǐ xiǎng xiān liàn nǎ yī shǒu gē qǔ ? zhè xiē gē qǔ ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián de péng you . zhè zhāng zhuān jí lǐ yǒu liǎng shǒu wǒ hěn xǐ huān de gē . tā de dì yī zhāng zhuān jí qù nián fā xíng le . nǐ jué de zhè gè gù shì làng màn , wǒ jué de yǒu diǎn nán guò . tā men zài yǔ lǐ sàn bù , kàn qǐ lái hěn làng màn . zhè lǐ de dēng xiàng zhēng yǒu rén zài děng . shù zài zhè piān wén zhāng lǐ shì shí jiān de xiàng zhēng . zhè gè shēng yīn ràng wǒ lián xiǎng dào xiǎo shí hòu de yuàn zi . kàn dào jiù chē zhàn , wǒ lián xiǎng qǐ dì yī cì chū mén lǚ xíng . gù shì kàn qǐ lái hěn ān jìng , nèi zài de chōng tū què hěn qiáng . wǒ xiǎng liǎo jiě zhè gè jué sè nèi zài de biàn huà . zhè jiàn shì yì zhí liú zài wǒ de jì yì lǐ . zhào piān hé jì yì lǐ de yàng zi bù wán quán yī yàng . wǒ xiǎng huí yì yī xià nà tiān dào dǐ zěn me shuō de . zhè xiē huí yì bù shì měi cì xiǎng qǐ dōu yī yàng . wǒ men yì qǐ liàn xí de shí guāng hěn duǎn , dàn wǒ jì de hěn qīng chǔ . tā hěn huái niàn zài xiǎo chéng shēng huó de shí guāng . suì yuè guò qù , lǎo wū de mén yǐ jīng huàn le . zhè xiē zhào piān jì lù le dà jiā yì qǐ gōng zuò de suì yuè . děng xiāo xī de nà yī wǎn hěn màn cháng . zhè shì yī duàn màn cháng de lǚ chéng . zhè jiàn jiù wài tào wǒ yì zhí shě bù de rēng . tā shě bù de lí kāi , suǒ yǐ yòu zuò le yī huì er . wǒ xiǎng zhēn xī xiàn zài néng jiàn miàn de shí jiān . zhè zhāng zhào piān hěn pǔ tōng , wǒ què hěn zhēn xī . tā kě wàng zài tīng jiàn nà gè shú xī de shēng yīn . tā kě wàng yǒu rén rèn zhēn tīng tā jiǎng wán . zhè piān sǎn wén bǎ hěn xiǎo de shì xiě de hěn yǒu yì si . wǒ xiān dú le yī piān sǎn wén , zài dú tóng yī gè zuò zhě de shī . kàn wán yǐ hòu , nǐ yǒu shén me gǎn xiǎng ? tā bǎ lǚ xíng de gǎn xiǎng xiě zài rì jì lǐ . wǒ men yì qǐ huí gù le qù nián zuò guò de shì . huí gù zhè duàn jīng lì , wǒ cái míng bái wèi shén me huì wù huì . wǒ jì bù qīng měi gè qíng jié , dàn jì de zuì hòu de huà miàn . zhè gè qíng jié qián miàn yǐ jīng chū xiàn guò yī cì . zhè duàn de zhǔ tí bù zhǐ shì děng yī gè rén huí lái . wǒ men xuǎn tóng yī gè zhǔ tí , xiě chū lái de gù shì què bù tóng . zhè jù huà ràng rén xiǎng dào hěn ān jìng de huà miàn . wǒ wàng le tái cí , què jì de nà gè huà miàn . wǒ kě yǐ mó fǎng zhè gè dú fǎ , zài tīng nǎ lǐ bù tóng . tā xiǎo shí hòu xǐ huān mó fǎng lǎo shī shuō huà . dān kàn zhè jù , hán yì hái bù qīng chǔ . qián miàn nà jù huà gǎi biàn le zhè lǐ de hán yì . nǐ huì yòng shén me cí xíng róng zhè zhǒng gǎn jué ? wǒ bù zhī dào zěn me xíng róng , zhǐ jué de hěn shú xī .
meaning: This poem is about life after leaving home. When reading poetry I first look for recurring images. Which song would you like to practise first? These songs remind me of old friends. There are two songs I really like on this album. Her first album was released last year. You find this story romantic; I find it a little sad. Their walk in the rain looks romantic. The light here symbolises someone waiting. The tree symbolises time in this article. This sound makes me think of my childhood courtyard. The old station brings my first trip away to mind. The story looks quiet but has a strong inner conflict. I’d like to understand this character’s inner change. This event has stayed in my memory. The photo doesn’t quite match how I remember it. I’d like to recall exactly what was said that day. These memories don’t feel identical every time they return. Our time practising together was short, but I remember it clearly. She misses the time she spent in the small town. The years passed, and the old house has a new door. These photos record their years of working together. That night waiting for news felt very long. This is a long journey. I’ve never wanted to throw this old coat away. She was reluctant to leave and stayed a little longer. I want to value the time when we can meet now. This photo is ordinary, but I treasure it. He longs to hear that familiar voice again. She longs for someone to hear her out properly. This essay makes a small event interesting. I read an essay and then a poem by the same writer. What are your thoughts after watching? She wrote her thoughts about the trip in her diary. We looked back at what we’d done last year. Looking back on this experience, I understood why the misunderstanding arose. I can’t recall every plot detail but remember the final image. This plot point has appeared once before. This section’s theme isn’t only waiting for someone to return. We chose the same theme but wrote different stories. This sentence suggests a very quiet image. I’ve forgotten the dialogue but remember the scene. I can imitate this reading and listen for differences. As a child he liked imitating how teachers spoke. The meaning isn’t clear from this line alone. The earlier line changes the meaning here. What word would you use to describe this feeling? I don’t know how to describe it; it just feels familiar.

text: 朋友读完这首原创歌词，说里面的人一定在等恋人。我先问他最喜欢哪一句。他选了“我却数着，一年又一年”，说这种漫长的等待很浪漫。我能理解他的联想，不过我第一次读时，想到的是一个在外地工作的人，回家看见小时候留下的纸画。我们没有急着决定谁对，先把整首读完。
pinyin: péng you dú wán zhè shǒu yuán chuàng gē cí , shuō lǐ miàn de rén yí dìng zài děng liàn rén . wǒ xiān wèn tā zuì xǐ huān nǎ yī jù . tā xuǎn le wǒ què shù zhe , yī nián yòu yī nián , shuō zhè zhǒng màn cháng de děng dài hěn làng màn . wǒ néng lǐ jiě tā de lián xiǎng , bù guò wǒ dì yī cì dú shí , xiǎng dào de shì yī gè zài wài dì gōng zuò de rén , huí jiā kàn jiàn xiǎo shí hòu liú xià de zhǐ huà . wǒ men méi yǒu jí zhe jué dìng shéi duì , xiān bǎ zhěng shǒu dú wán .
meaning: My friend called the person in this original lyric someone waiting for a lover. His favourite line counted year after year; he found the long wait romantic. I understood that association, though I had imagined someone working away and returning to a childhood paper drawing. We read the whole lyric before deciding who was right.

text: 我小时候也把画贴在门上。家里换门的时候，母亲把那张纸收起来了。后来我从外地回来，她又拿给我看，所以我读到旧画，马上想到这个经历。朋友没有一样的记忆，他想到的是两个人一起住过的房间。原来我们不只是看见同样的字，也把自己的回忆带进了这些字里。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu yě bǎ huà tiē zài mén shàng . jiā lǐ huàn mén de shí hou , mǔ qīn bǎ nà zhāng zhǐ shōu qǐ lái le . hòu lái wǒ cóng wài dì huí lái , tā yòu ná gěi wǒ kàn , suǒ yǐ wǒ dú dào jiù huà , mǎ shàng xiǎng dào zhè gè jīng lì . péng you méi yǒu yī yàng de jì yì , tā xiǎng dào de shì liǎng gè rén yì qǐ zhù guò de fáng jiān . yuán lái wǒ men bù zhǐ shì kàn jiàn tóng yàng de zì , yě bǎ zì jǐ de huí yì dài jìn le zhè xiē zì lǐ .
meaning: I had put a drawing on a door as a child. My mother saved the paper when the door was replaced and showed it to me when I returned from elsewhere. That was my immediate association. My friend imagined a room shared by a couple. We were bringing different memories to the same words.

text: 但有自己的经历，不等于能替歌词加上所有情节。我不能因为母亲留过画，就说诗里一定有母亲；他也不能因为自己等过喜欢的人，就说这里一定是恋爱。我们把这些区别写下来：歌词提到门、树、时间和出发；母亲、工作和恋人的身份，是我们各自想到的。写到这里，争谁更懂已经没什么意思了。
pinyin: dàn yǒu zì jǐ de jīng lì , bù děng yú néng tì gē cí jiā shàng suǒ yǒu qíng jié . wǒ bù néng yīn wèi mǔ qīn liú guò huà , jiù shuō shī lǐ yí dìng yǒu mǔ qīn ; tā yě bù néng yīn wèi zì jǐ děng guò xǐ huān de rén , jiù shuō zhè lǐ yí dìng shì liàn ài . wǒ men bǎ zhè xiē qū bié xiě xià lái : gē cí tí dào mén , shù , shí jiān hé chū fā ; mǔ qīn , gōng zuò hé liàn rén de shēn fèn , shì wǒ men gè zì xiǎng dào de . xiě dào zhè lǐ , zhēng shéi gèng dǒng yǐ jīng méi shén me yì si le .
meaning: Our experiences did not allow us to add any plot we wished. My mother keeping a drawing did not prove a mother appeared in the lyric, and his waiting for someone did not prove romance. We separated the door, tree, time and departure named in the text from identities we supplied. Arguing about who understood more became less useful.

text: 我把“门还在，路已经远了”和“明早出发”放在一起看。一个画面像回头，一个动作向前，这让我想到舍不得离开，却还是要走。朋友说，也可能是结束一段关系以后，终于愿意继续自己的生活。我们都能找到支持，不过最后一句“再唱给你听”又留下联系，没有说以后永远不见。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ mén hái zài , lù yǐ jīng yuǎn le hé míng zǎo chū fā fàng zài yì qǐ kàn . yī gè huà miàn xiàng huí tóu , yī gè dòng zuò xiàng qián , zhè ràng wǒ xiǎng dào shě bù de lí kāi , què hái shi yào zǒu . péng you shuō , yě kě néng shì jié shù yī duàn guān xì yǐ hòu , zhōng yú yuàn yì jì xù zì jǐ de shēng huó . wǒ men dōu néng zhǎo dào zhī chí , bù guò zuì hòu yī jù zài chàng gěi nǐ tīng yòu liú xià lián xì , méi yǒu shuō yǐ hòu yǒng yuǎn bú jiàn .
meaning: I connected the door and distant road with tomorrow’s departure: looking back while moving forward, reluctant but leaving. My friend suggested moving on after a relationship. Both readings had support, yet “sing it to you again” retained a connection and did not establish a permanent farewell.

text: 谈到那一句，我们发现自己又猜得太满。我说去了新地方一定会回来唱，他说一定会在手机里发歌，可歌词没有说怎么唱给对方听。于是我们只留下共同能确定的部分：说话的人想到了以后的联系。用手机还是见面、什么时候、对方是谁，都没有写出来。这些空的地方让人继续联想，也让我们需要少说几个“一定”。
pinyin: tán dào nà yī jù , wǒ men fā xiàn zì jǐ yòu cāi de tài mǎn . wǒ shuō qù le xīn dì fāng yí dìng huì huí lái chàng , tā shuō yí dìng huì zài shǒu jī lǐ fā gē , kě gē cí méi yǒu shuō zěn me chàng gěi duì fāng tīng . yú shì wǒ men zhǐ liú xià gòng tóng néng què dìng de bù fèn : shuō huà de rén xiǎng dào le yǐ hòu de lián xì . yòng shǒu jī hái shi jiàn miàn , shén me shí hou , duì fāng shì shéi , dōu méi yǒu xiě chū lái . zhè xiē kōng de dì fāng ràng rén jì xù lián xiǎng , yě ràng wǒ men xū yào shǎo shuō jǐ gè yí dìng .
meaning: We noticed more excessive certainty: I predicted returning to sing; he predicted sending a song by phone. The lyric gave neither method. We kept the shared observation that the speaker imagined future contact. How, when and with whom remained unstated, inviting associations but requiring fewer claims of certainty.

text: 朋友要练这首歌，问我能不能把他的读法也留在笔记里。我说当然可以，只要把支持的句子写在旁边。我们各写了一段，没有把两个版本拼成一个复杂的新故事。我读他的笔记时，觉得自己以前忽略了等待的人；他读我的，也注意到树长高和纸画变淡，都不只是房间里的装饰。
pinyin: péng you yào liàn zhè shǒu gē , wèn wǒ néng bù néng bǎ tā de dú fǎ yě liú zài bǐ jì lǐ . wǒ shuō dāng rán kě yǐ , zhǐ yào bǎ zhī chí de jù zi xiě zài páng biān . wǒ men gè xiě le yī duàn , méi yǒu bǎ liǎng gè bǎn běn pīn chéng yī gè fù zá de xīn gù shì . wǒ dú tā de bǐ jì shí , jué de zì jǐ yǐ qián hū lüè le děng dài de rén ; tā dú wǒ de , yě zhù yì dào shù zhǎng gāo hé zhǐ huà biàn dàn , dōu bù zhǐ shì fáng jiān lǐ de zhuāng shì .
meaning: He asked to keep his interpretation in our notes. I agreed, with supporting lines beside it. We wrote separate accounts rather than merging them into a complicated new story. His notes made me notice the waiting person; mine drew his attention to the tree and fading drawing as more than decoration.

text: 后来再听同一个片段，我还是先想到家，他还是先想到恋人。我们并没有变成完全一样的读者，却更容易说清楚哪里相同、哪里不同。练唱以前，他先问我想把哪句话读得轻一点。我选了“还留在身旁”，因为那种声音不像真的有人在旁边说话，更像一段会跟着人走的记忆。
pinyin: hòu lái zài tīng tóng yī gè piàn duàn , wǒ hái shi xiān xiǎng dào jiā , tā hái shi xiān xiǎng dào liàn rén . wǒ men bìng méi yǒu biàn chéng wán quán yī yàng de dú zhě , què gèng róng yì shuō qīng chǔ nǎ lǐ xiāng tóng , nǎ lǐ bù tóng . liàn chàng yǐ qián , tā xiān wèn wǒ xiǎng bǎ nǎ jù huà dú de qīng yī diǎn . wǒ xuǎn le hái liú zài shēn páng , yīn wèi nà zhǒng shēng yīn bù xiàng zhēn de yǒu rén zài páng biān shuō huà , gèng xiàng yī duàn huì gēn zhe rén zǒu de jì yì .

text: 朋友读完这首原创歌词，说里面的人一定在等恋人。我先问他最喜欢哪一句。他选了“我却数着，一年又一年”，说这种漫长的等待很浪漫。我能理解他的联想，不过我第一次读时，想到的是一个在外地工作的人，回家看见小时候留下的纸画。我们没有急着决定谁对，先把整首读完。我小时候也把画贴在门上。家里换门的时候，母亲把那张纸收起来了。后来我从外地回来，她又拿给我看，所以我读到旧画，马上想到这个经历。朋友没有一样的记忆，他想到的是两个人一起住过的房间。原来我们不只是看见同样的字，也把自己的回忆带进了这些字里。但有自己的经历，不等于能替歌词加上所有情节。我不能因为母亲留过画，就说诗里一定有母亲；他也不能因为自己等过喜欢的人，就说这里一定是恋爱。我们把这些区别写下来：歌词提到门、树、时间和出发；母亲、工作和恋人的身份，是我们各自想到的。写到这里，争谁更懂已经没什么意思了。我把“门还在，路已经远了”和“明早出发”放在一起看。一个画面像回头，一个动作向前，这让我想到舍不得离开，却还是要走。朋友说，也可能是结束一段关系以后，终于愿意继续自己的生活。我们都能找到支持，不过最后一句“再唱给你听”又留下联系，没有说以后永远不见。谈到那一句，我们发现自己又猜得太满。我说去了新地方一定会回来唱，他说一定会在手机里发歌，可歌词没有说怎么唱给对方听。于是我们只留下共同能确定的部分：说话的人想到了以后的联系。用手机还是见面、什么时候、对方是谁，都没有写出来。这些空的地方让人继续联想，也让我们需要少说几个“一定”。朋友要练这首歌，问我能不能把他的读法也留在笔记里。我说当然可以，只要把支持的句子写在旁边。我们各写了一段，没有把两个版本拼成一个复杂的新故事。我读他的笔记时，觉得自己以前忽略了等待的人；他读我的，也注意到树长高和纸画变淡，都不只是房间里的装饰。后来再听同一个片段，我还是先想到家，他还是先想到恋人。我们并没有变成完全一样的读者，却更容易说清楚哪里相同、哪里不同。练唱以前，他先问我想把哪句话读得轻一点。我选了“还留在身旁”，因为那种声音不像真的有人在旁边说话，更像一段会跟着人走的记忆。
pinyin: péng you dú wán zhè shǒu yuán chuàng gē cí , shuō lǐ miàn de rén yí dìng zài děng liàn rén . wǒ xiān wèn tā zuì xǐ huān nǎ yī jù . tā xuǎn le wǒ què shù zhe , yī nián yòu yī nián , shuō zhè zhǒng màn cháng de děng dài hěn làng màn . wǒ néng lǐ jiě tā de lián xiǎng , bù guò wǒ dì yī cì dú shí , xiǎng dào de shì yī gè zài wài dì gōng zuò de rén , huí jiā kàn jiàn xiǎo shí hòu liú xià de zhǐ huà . wǒ men méi yǒu jí zhe jué dìng shéi duì , xiān bǎ zhěng shǒu dú wán . wǒ xiǎo shí hòu yě bǎ huà tiē zài mén shàng . jiā lǐ huàn mén de shí hou , mǔ qīn bǎ nà zhāng zhǐ shōu qǐ lái le . hòu lái wǒ cóng wài dì huí lái , tā yòu ná gěi wǒ kàn , suǒ yǐ wǒ dú dào jiù huà , mǎ shàng xiǎng dào zhè gè jīng lì . péng you méi yǒu yī yàng de jì yì , tā xiǎng dào de shì liǎng gè rén yì qǐ zhù guò de fáng jiān . yuán lái wǒ men bù zhǐ shì kàn jiàn tóng yàng de zì , yě bǎ zì jǐ de huí yì dài jìn le zhè xiē zì lǐ . dàn yǒu zì jǐ de jīng lì , bù děng yú néng tì gē cí jiā shàng suǒ yǒu qíng jié . wǒ bù néng yīn wèi mǔ qīn liú guò huà , jiù shuō shī lǐ yí dìng yǒu mǔ qīn ; tā yě bù néng yīn wèi zì jǐ děng guò xǐ huān de rén , jiù shuō zhè lǐ yí dìng shì liàn ài . wǒ men bǎ zhè xiē qū bié xiě xià lái : gē cí tí dào mén , shù , shí jiān hé chū fā ; mǔ qīn , gōng zuò hé liàn rén de shēn fèn , shì wǒ men gè zì xiǎng dào de . xiě dào zhè lǐ , zhēng shéi gèng dǒng yǐ jīng méi shén me yì si le . wǒ bǎ mén hái zài , lù yǐ jīng yuǎn le hé míng zǎo chū fā fàng zài yì qǐ kàn . yī gè huà miàn xiàng huí tóu , yī gè dòng zuò xiàng qián , zhè ràng wǒ xiǎng dào shě bù de lí kāi , què hái shi yào zǒu . péng you shuō , yě kě néng shì jié shù yī duàn guān xì yǐ hòu , zhōng yú yuàn yì jì xù zì jǐ de shēng huó . wǒ men dōu néng zhǎo dào zhī chí , bù guò zuì hòu yī jù zài chàng gěi nǐ tīng yòu liú xià lián xì , méi yǒu shuō yǐ hòu yǒng yuǎn bú jiàn . tán dào nà yī jù , wǒ men fā xiàn zì jǐ yòu cāi de tài mǎn . wǒ shuō qù le xīn dì fāng yí dìng huì huí lái chàng , tā shuō yí dìng huì zài shǒu jī lǐ fā gē , kě gē cí méi yǒu shuō zěn me chàng gěi duì fāng tīng . yú shì wǒ men zhǐ liú xià gòng tóng néng què dìng de bù fèn : shuō huà de rén xiǎng dào le yǐ hòu de lián xì . yòng shǒu jī hái shi jiàn miàn , shén me shí hou , duì fāng shì shéi , dōu méi yǒu xiě chū lái . zhè xiē kōng de dì fāng ràng rén jì xù lián xiǎng , yě ràng wǒ men xū yào shǎo shuō jǐ gè yí dìng . péng you yào liàn zhè shǒu gē , wèn wǒ néng bù néng bǎ tā de dú fǎ yě liú zài bǐ jì lǐ . wǒ shuō dāng rán kě yǐ , zhǐ yào bǎ zhī chí de jù zi xiě zài páng biān . wǒ men gè xiě le yī duàn , méi yǒu bǎ liǎng gè bǎn běn pīn chéng yī gè fù zá de xīn gù shì . wǒ dú tā de bǐ jì shí , jué de zì jǐ yǐ qián hū lüè le děng dài de rén ; tā dú wǒ de , yě zhù yì dào shù zhǎng gāo hé zhǐ huà biàn dàn , dōu bù zhǐ shì fáng jiān lǐ de zhuāng shì . hòu lái zài tīng tóng yī gè piàn duàn , wǒ hái shi xiān xiǎng dào jiā , tā hái shi xiān xiǎng dào liàn rén . wǒ men bìng méi yǒu biàn chéng wán quán yī yàng de dú zhě , què gèng róng yì shuō qīng chǔ nǎ lǐ xiāng tóng , nǎ lǐ bù tóng . liàn chàng yǐ qián , tā xiān wèn wǒ xiǎng bǎ nǎ jù huà dú de qīng yī diǎn . wǒ xuǎn le hái liú zài shēn páng , yīn wèi nà zhǒng shēng yīn bù xiàng zhēn de yǒu rén zài páng biān shuō huà , gèng xiàng yī duàn huì gēn zhe rén zǒu de jì yì .
meaning: My friend called the person in this original lyric someone waiting for a lover. His favourite line counted year after year; he found the long wait romantic. I understood that association, though I had imagined someone working away and returning to a childhood paper drawing. We read the whole lyric before deciding who was right. I had put a drawing on a door as a child. My mother saved the paper when the door was replaced and showed it to me when I returned from elsewhere. That was my immediate association. My friend imagined a room shared by a couple. We were bringing different memories to the same words. Our experiences did not allow us to add any plot we wished. My mother keeping a drawing did not prove a mother appeared in the lyric, and his waiting for someone did not prove romance. We separated the door, tree, time and departure named in the text from identities we supplied. Arguing about who understood more became less useful. I connected the door and distant road with tomorrow’s departure: looking back while moving forward, reluctant but leaving. My friend suggested moving on after a relationship. Both readings had support, yet “sing it to you again” retained a connection and did not establish a permanent farewell. We noticed more excessive certainty: I predicted returning to sing; he predicted sending a song by phone. The lyric gave neither method. We kept the shared observation that the speaker imagined future contact. How, when and with whom remained unstated, inviting associations but requiring fewer claims of certainty. He asked to keep his interpretation in our notes. I agreed, with supporting lines beside it. We wrote separate accounts rather than merging them into a complicated new story. His notes made me notice the waiting person; mine drew his attention to the tree and fading drawing as more than decoration. Hearing it again, I still thought of home and he of a lover. We had not become identical readers, but could explain our agreements and differences. Before singing, he asked which line I wanted to read more lightly. I chose the voices remaining beside me, as a travelling memory rather than someone literally speaking there.

text: 你总算来了，我还以为你不来了。
pinyin: nǐ zǒng suàn lái le , wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ bù lái le .
meaning: You finally made it. I thought you weren’t coming.

text: 我在大门口等了半个小时。你们怎么全在这儿？
pinyin: wǒ zài dà mén kǒu děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí . nǐ men zěn me quán zài zhèr ?
meaning: I waited at the main entrance for half an hour. Why are you all here?

text: 大房间的灯坏了，十点零五分才决定换到小厅。
pinyin: dà fáng jiān de dēng huài le , shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn cái jué dìng huàn dào xiǎo tīng .
meaning: The large room’s light broke. We only decided to move to the small hall at 10:05.

text: 你为什么没告诉我？
pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me méi gào sù wǒ ?
meaning: Why didn’t you tell me?

text: 我发了消息，就在决定以后。你没看到？
pinyin: wǒ fā le xiāo xī , jiù zài jué dìng yǐ hòu . nǐ méi kàn dào ?
meaning: I sent a message just after the decision. Didn’t you see it?

text: 没看到。我十点上车，手机就没电了。
pinyin: méi kàn dào . wǒ shí diǎn shàng chē , shǒu jī jiù méi diàn le .
meaning: No. My phone died when I boarded at ten.

text: 我以为你收到，也以为你会从另一边进来。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ shōu dào , yě yǐ wéi nǐ huì cóng lìng yī biān jìn lái .
meaning: I thought you’d received it and would enter from the other side.

text: 你以为，我还以为你忘了今天的活动呢。
pinyin: nǐ yǐ wéi , wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ wàng le jīn tiān de huó dòng ne .
meaning: You thought that, and I thought you’d forgotten today’s event.

text: 门口不是也贴了通知吗？
pinyin: mén kǒu bù shì yě tiē le tōng zhī ma ?
meaning: Wasn’t there a notice at the entrance too?

text: 我看见一张纸，风把它吹起来了，没看清。
pinyin: wǒ kàn jiàn yī zhāng zhǐ , fēng bǎ tā chuī qǐ lái le , méi kàn qīng .
meaning: I saw a sheet of paper, but the wind blew it up and I couldn’t read it.

text: 我应该再等你回一句，不能发完就算了。
pinyin: wǒ yīng gāi zài děng nǐ huí yī jù , bù néng fā wán jiù suàn le .
meaning: I should have waited for a reply rather than treating sending as enough.

text: 我也应该早一点借电话，别一直在门外猜。
pinyin: wǒ yě yīng gāi zǎo yī diǎn jiè diàn huà , bié yì zhí zài mén wài cāi .
meaning: I should have borrowed a phone sooner rather than guessing outside.

text: 刚才是谁的电话？我没认出号码。
pinyin: gāng cái shì shéi de diàn huà ? wǒ méi rèn chū hào mǎ .
meaning: Whose phone was that just now? I didn’t recognise the number.

text: 门口那家店的老板。他说可以打一个电话。
pinyin: mén kǒu nà jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn . tā shuō kě yǐ dǎ yī gè diàn huà .
meaning: The owner of the shop at the entrance. He said I could make a call.

text: 是啊。从门口走过来才五分钟，我倒等了三十分钟。
pinyin: shì a . cóng mén kǒu zǒu guò lái cái wǔ fēn zhōng , wǒ dào děng le sān shí fēn zhōng .
meaning: Yes. The walk here took only five minutes, yet I waited thirty.

text: 进来喝点水吧。我们刚摆好椅子，还没开始。
pinyin: jìn lái hē diǎn shuǐ ba . wǒ men gāng bǎi hǎo yǐ zi , hái méi kāi shǐ .
meaning: Come in and have some water. We’ve just set up the chairs and haven’t started.

text: 下次先告诉我是哪一扇门，我今天已经把大门看够了。
pinyin: xià cì xiān gào sù wǒ shì nǎ yī shàn mén , wǒ jīn tiān yǐ jīng bǎ dà mén kàn gòu le .
meaning: Next time tell me which entrance. I’ve seen quite enough of the main one today.

text: 你总算来了，我还以为你不来了。我在大门口等了半个小时。你们怎么全在这儿？大房间的灯坏了，十点零五分才决定换到小厅。你为什么没告诉我？我发了消息，就在决定以后。你没看到？没看到。我十点上车，手机就没电了。我以为你收到，也以为你会从另一边进来。你以为，我还以为你忘了今天的活动呢。门口不是也贴了通知吗？我看见一张纸，风把它吹起来了，没看清。我应该再等你回一句，不能发完就算了。我也应该早一点借电话，别一直在门外猜。刚才是谁的电话？我没认出号码。门口那家店的老板。他说可以打一个电话。幸好接了，不然你可能还在外面。是啊。从门口走过来才五分钟，我倒等了三十分钟。进来喝点水吧。我们刚摆好椅子，还没开始。下次先告诉我是哪一扇门，我今天已经把大门看够了。
pinyin: nǐ zǒng suàn lái le , wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ bù lái le . wǒ zài dà mén kǒu děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí . nǐ men zěn me quán zài zhèr ? dà fáng jiān de dēng huài le , shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn cái jué dìng huàn dào xiǎo tīng . nǐ wèi shén me méi gào sù wǒ ? wǒ fā le xiāo xī , jiù zài jué dìng yǐ hòu . nǐ méi kàn dào ? méi kàn dào . wǒ shí diǎn shàng chē , shǒu jī jiù méi diàn le . wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ shōu dào , yě yǐ wéi nǐ huì cóng lìng yī biān jìn lái . nǐ yǐ wéi , wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ wàng le jīn tiān de huó dòng ne . mén kǒu bù shì yě tiē le tōng zhī ma ? wǒ kàn jiàn yī zhāng zhǐ , fēng bǎ tā chuī qǐ lái le , méi kàn qīng . wǒ yīng gāi zài děng nǐ huí yī jù , bù néng fā wán jiù suàn le . wǒ yě yīng gāi zǎo yī diǎn jiè diàn huà , bié yì zhí zài mén wài cāi . gāng cái shì shéi de diàn huà ? wǒ méi rèn chū hào mǎ . mén kǒu nà jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn . tā shuō kě yǐ dǎ yī gè diàn huà . xìng hǎo jiē le , bù rán nǐ kě néng hái zài wài miàn . shì a . cóng mén kǒu zǒu guò lái cái wǔ fēn zhōng , wǒ dào děng le sān shí fēn zhōng . jìn lái hē diǎn shuǐ ba . wǒ men gāng bǎi hǎo yǐ zi , hái méi kāi shǐ . xià cì xiān gào sù wǒ shì nǎ yī shàn mén , wǒ jīn tiān yǐ jīng bǎ dà mén kàn gòu le .
meaning: You finally made it. I thought you weren’t coming. I waited at the main entrance for half an hour. Why are you all here? The large room’s light broke. We only decided to move to the small hall at 10:05. Why didn’t you tell me? I sent a message just after the decision. Didn’t you see it? No. My phone died when I boarded at ten. I thought you’d received it and would enter from the other side. You thought that, and I thought you’d forgotten today’s event. Wasn’t there a notice at the entrance too? I saw a sheet of paper, but the wind blew it up and I couldn’t read it. I should have waited for a reply rather than treating sending as enough. I should have borrowed a phone sooner rather than guessing outside. Whose phone was that just now? I didn’t recognise the number. The owner of the shop at the entrance. He said I could make a call. Good thing I answered. Otherwise you might still be outside. Yes. The walk here took only five minutes, yet I waited thirty. Come in and have some water. We’ve just set up the chairs and haven’t started. Next time tell me which entrance. I’ve seen quite enough of the main one today.

text: 这段短剧从林安走进小厅开始。陈宇说“你总算来了”，林安没有回答问候，先问为什么大家全在这里。只看开头，我以为林安迟到，陈宇已经等得不耐烦。可第二句提到大门口等了半个小时，我又把字幕往回拖了一点。原来林安早就来了，只是一直站在另一扇门外，难怪进来就问大家怎么都换了地方。
pinyin: zhè duàn duǎn jù cóng lín ān zǒu jìn xiǎo tīng kāi shǐ . chén yǔ shuō nǐ zǒng suàn lái le , lín ān méi yǒu huí dá wèn hòu , xiān wèn wèi shén me dà jiā quán zài zhè lǐ . zhǐ kàn kāi tóu , wǒ yǐ wéi lín ān chí dào , chén yǔ yǐ jīng děng de bù nài fán . kě dì èr jù tí dào dà mén kǒu děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí , wǒ yòu bǎ zì mù wǎng huí tuō le yī diǎn . yuán lái lín ān zǎo jiù lái le , zhǐ shì yì zhí zhàn zài lìng yī shàn mén wài , nán guài jìn lái jiù wèn dà jiā zěn me dōu huàn le dì fāng .
meaning: The short scene opens with Lin An entering the small hall. Chen Yu says, 'You're finally here,' but she asks why everyone is there. At first I thought she was late and he'd grown impatient. Then she mentions waiting at the main entrance for half an hour, so I dragged the subtitles back a little. She'd arrived earlier but stood outside another door, which explained her first question.

text: 陈宇解释，大房间的灯坏了，大家十点零五分才决定换到小厅。他在决定以后发了消息，以为林安会从另一边进来。镜头没有让我们看见林安的手机，所以到这里，我们只能知道陈宇发过，不能直接知道她收到了。他说“你没看到”，也是在问，并不是已经知道答案。
pinyin: chén yǔ jiě shì , dà fáng jiān de dēng huài le , dà jiā shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn cái jué dìng huàn dào xiǎo tīng . tā zài jué dìng yǐ hòu fā le xiāo xī , yǐ wéi lín ān huì cóng lìng yī biān jìn lái . jìng tóu méi yǒu ràng wǒ men kàn jiàn lín ān de shǒu jī , suǒ yǐ dào zhè lǐ , wǒ men zhǐ néng zhī dào chén yǔ fā guò , bù néng zhí jiē zhī dào tā shōu dào le . tā shuō nǐ méi kàn dào , yě shì zài wèn , bìng bù shì yǐ jīng zhī dào dá àn .
meaning: Chen explains that a broken light prompted the move at 10:05. He sent a message and expected Lin to use the other entrance. We have not seen her phone, so know only that he sent it, not that she received it. His question about seeing it is a question, not prior knowledge of the answer.

text: 林安说，自己十点上车的时候，手机已经没电。这个时间比换地方早了五分钟，也比消息发出早。她出门之前看的是原来的地址，到门口时自然还在找大房间。她没有看见大家，就怀疑陈宇忘了活动。这里可以理解她为什么这样想，却不能把她的怀疑当成陈宇真的忘了。
pinyin: lín ān shuō , zì jǐ shí diǎn shàng chē de shí hou , shǒu jī yǐ jīng méi diàn . zhè gè shí jiān bǐ huàn dì fāng zǎo le wǔ fēn zhōng , yě bǐ xiāo xī fā chū zǎo . tā chū mén zhī qián kàn de shì yuán lái de dì zhǐ , dào mén kǒu shí zì rán hái zài zhǎo dà fáng jiān . tā méi yǒu kàn jiàn dà jiā , jiù huái yí chén yǔ wàng le huó dòng . zhè lǐ kě yǐ lǐ jiě tā wèi shén me zhè yàng xiǎng , què bù néng bǎ tā de huái yí dàng chéng chén yǔ zhēn de wàng le .
meaning: Lin’s phone died on boarding at ten, five minutes before the venue change and message. She had checked the original address before leaving, so still looked for the large room. Seeing nobody, she suspected Chen had forgotten. We can understand the suspicion without treating it as fact.

text: 门口的通知是第三个线索。陈宇以为贴了纸，后来到的人就能找到小厅。林安确实看见了纸，可风把纸吹起来，她没看清内容。如果我们只听“看见一张纸”，就会漏掉后半句。看见纸和读到通知不是同一件事，就像发过消息和对方看过消息也不是同一件事。
pinyin: mén kǒu de tōng zhī shì dì sān gè xiàn suǒ . chén yǔ yǐ wéi tiē le zhǐ , hòu lái dào de rén jiù néng zhǎo dào xiǎo tīng . lín ān què shí kàn jiàn le zhǐ , kě fēng bǎ zhǐ chuī qǐ lái , tā méi kàn qīng nèi róng . rú guǒ wǒ men zhǐ tīng kàn jiàn yī zhāng zhǐ , jiù huì lòu diào hòu bàn jù . kàn jiàn zhǐ hé dú dào tōng zhī bù shì tóng yī jiàn shì , jiù xiàng fā guò xiāo xī hé duì fāng kàn guò xiāo xī yě bù shì tóng yī jiàn shì .
meaning: The entrance notice is a third clue. Chen expected later arrivals to find the small hall from it. Lin saw the paper, but the wind lifted it and she could not read the contents. Seeing paper differs from reading a notice, just as sending a message differs from the other person reading it.

text: 等到十点四十分，林安向门口一家店的老板借了电话。陈宇不认识这个号码，但还是接了，这才听见她在大门口。电话接通以后，两个人知道的内容才接上。他告诉她从哪里走，她走了五分钟到了小厅。前面的等待很长，并不是因为路很远，而是因为她没有新地址。
pinyin: děng dào shí diǎn sì shí fēn , lín ān xiàng mén kǒu yī jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn jiè le diàn huà . chén yǔ bù rèn shi zhè gè hào mǎ , dàn hái shi jiē le , zhè cái tīng jiàn tā zài dà mén kǒu . diàn huà jiē tōng yǐ hòu , liǎng gè rén zhī dào de nèi róng cái jiē shàng . tā gào sù tā cóng nǎ lǐ zǒu , tā zǒu le wǔ fēn zhōng dào le xiǎo tīng . qián miàn de děng dài hěn zhǎng , bìng bù shì yīn wèi lù hěn yuǎn , ér shì yīn wèi tā méi yǒu xīn dì zhǐ .
meaning: At 10:40 Lin borrowed a shopkeeper’s phone. Chen answered an unfamiliar number and learned she was at the main entrance. Only then did their information connect. His directions brought her to the small hall in five minutes. The long wait resulted from lacking the new location, not a long walk.

text: 后面陈宇说，下次应该再等她回一句，不能发完就算了。林安也说应该早点借电话，别一直站在门外猜。我把这两句抄下来，又看了一遍前面的消息和通知：陈宇一直以为她已经知道，林安却以为大家忘了。朋友问哪一句可以改得早一点，我指了指“你没看到”，说换成先问她在哪里，也许那时就能找到人。
pinyin: hòu miàn chén yǔ shuō , xià cì yīng gāi zài děng tā huí yī jù , bù néng fā wán jiù suàn le . lín ān yě shuō yīng gāi zǎo diǎn jiè diàn huà , bié yì zhí zhàn zài mén wài cāi . wǒ bǎ zhè liǎng jù chāo xià lái , yòu kàn le yī biàn qián miàn de xiāo xī hé tōng zhī : chén yǔ yì zhí yǐ wéi tā yǐ jīng zhī dào , lín ān què yǐ wéi dà jiā wàng le . péng you wèn nǎ yī jù kě yǐ gǎi de zǎo yī diǎn , wǒ zhǐ le zhǐ nǐ méi kàn dào , shuō huàn chéng xiān wèn tā zài nǎ lǐ , yě xǔ nà shí jiù néng zhǎo dào rén .
meaning: Chen Yu says next time he should wait for her reply instead of assuming sending a message is enough. Lin An says she should have borrowed a phone earlier. I copied those lines and reread the message and notice: Chen thought she knew; she thought everyone had forgotten. Asked which earlier line I'd change, I pointed to 'Didn't you see it?' Asking where she was might have helped them find her sooner.

text: 最后林安说，她今天已经把大门看够了。陈宇邀请她进来喝水，活动还没有开始。我觉得这句话有一点抱怨，也有一点开玩笑：她不想再等，可也没有直接离开。如果换一种语气读，它可能更生气。我们讨论时先保留这两种可能，再听前后的声音，而不是凭一个词替整段关系下结论。
pinyin: zuì hòu lín ān shuō , tā jīn tiān yǐ jīng bǎ dà mén kàn gòu le . chén yǔ yāo qǐng tā jìn lái hē shuǐ , huó dòng hái méi yǒu kāi shǐ . wǒ jué de zhè jù huà yǒu yī diǎn bào yuàn , yě yǒu yī diǎn kāi wán xiào : tā bù xiǎng zài děng , kě yě méi yǒu zhí jiē lí kāi . rú guǒ huàn yī zhǒng yǔ qì dú , tā kě néng gèng shēng qì . wǒ men tǎo lùn shí xiān bǎo liú zhè liǎng zhǒng kě néng , zài tīng qián hòu de shēng yīn , ér bù shì píng yī gè cí tì zhěng duàn guān xì xià jié lùn .
meaning: Finally Lin jokes that she has seen enough of the main entrance. Chen invites her for water; the event has not started. Her line could combine complaint and humour: she does not want more waiting but does not leave. Different delivery could sound angrier. We retain possibilities and hear the context rather than judging the whole relationship from one word.

kǒu . diàn huà jiē tōng yǐ hòu , liǎng gè rén zhī dào de nèi róng cái jiē shàng . tā gào sù tā cóng nǎ lǐ zǒu , tā zǒu le wǔ fēn zhōng dào le xiǎo tīng . qián miàn de děng dài hěn zhǎng , bìng bù shì yīn wèi lù hěn yuǎn , ér shì yīn wèi tā méi yǒu xīn dì zhǐ . hòu miàn chén yǔ shuō , xià cì yīng gāi zài děng tā huí yī jù , bù néng fā wán jiù suàn le . lín ān yě shuō yīng gāi zǎo diǎn jiè diàn huà , bié yì zhí zhàn zài mén wài cāi . wǒ bǎ zhè liǎng jù chāo xià lái , yòu kàn le yī biàn qián miàn de xiāo xī hé tōng zhī : chén yǔ yì zhí yǐ wéi tā yǐ jīng zhī dào , lín ān què yǐ wéi dà jiā wàng le . péng you wèn nǎ yī jù kě yǐ gǎi de zǎo yī diǎn , wǒ zhǐ le zhǐ nǐ méi kàn dào , shuō huàn chéng xiān wèn tā zài nǎ lǐ , yě xǔ nà shí jiù néng zhǎo dào rén . zuì hòu lín ān shuō , tā jīn tiān yǐ jīng bǎ dà mén kàn gòu le . chén yǔ yāo qǐng tā jìn lái hē shuǐ , huó dòng hái méi yǒu kāi shǐ . wǒ jué de zhè jù huà yǒu yī diǎn bào yuàn , yě yǒu yī diǎn kāi wán xiào : tā bù xiǎng zài děng , kě yě méi yǒu zhí jiē lí kāi . rú guǒ huàn yī zhǒng yǔ qì dú , tā kě néng gèng shēng qì . wǒ men tǎo lùn shí xiān bǎo liú zhè liǎng zhǒng kě néng , zài tīng qián hòu de shēng yīn , ér bù shì píng yī gè cí tì zhěng duàn guān xì xià jié lùn .
meaning: The short scene opens with Lin An entering the small hall. Chen Yu says, 'You're finally here,' but she asks why everyone is there. At first I thought she was late and he'd grown impatient. Then she mentions waiting at the main entrance for half an hour, so I dragged the subtitles back a little. She'd arrived earlier but stood outside another door, which explained her first question. Chen explains that a broken light prompted the move at 10:05. He sent a message and expected Lin to use the other entrance. We have not seen her phone, so know only that he sent it, not that she received it. His question about seeing it is a question, not prior knowledge of the answer. Lin’s phone died on boarding at ten, five minutes before the venue change and message. She had checked the original address before leaving, so still looked for the large room. Seeing nobody, she suspected Chen had forgotten. We can understand the suspicion without treating it as fact. The entrance notice is a third clue. Chen expected later arrivals to find the small hall from it. Lin saw the paper, but the wind lifted it and she could not read the contents. Seeing paper differs from reading a notice, just as sending a message differs from the other person reading it. At 10:40 Lin borrowed a shopkeeper’s phone. Chen answered an unfamiliar number and learned she was at the main entrance. Only then did their information connect. His directions brought her to the small hall in five minutes. The long wait resulted from lacking the new location, not a long walk. Chen Yu says next time he should wait for her reply instead of assuming sending a message is enough. Lin An says she should have borrowed a phone earlier. I copied those lines and reread the message and notice: Chen thought she knew; she thought everyone had forgotten. Asked which earlier line I'd change, I pointed to 'Didn't you see it?' Asking where she was might have helped them find her sooner. Finally Lin jokes that she has seen enough of the main entrance. Chen invites her for water; the event has not started. Her line could combine complaint and humour: she does not want more waiting but does not leave. Different delivery could sound angrier. We retain possibilities and hear the context rather than judging the whole relationship from one word.

parts.text: 这段短剧从林安走进小厅开始。陈宇说“你总算来了”，林安没有回答问候，先问为什么大家全在这里。只看开头，我以为林安迟到，陈宇已经等得不耐烦。可第二句提到大门口等了半个小时，我又把字幕往回拖了一点。原来林安早就来了，只是一直站在另一扇门外，难怪进来就问大家怎么都换了地方。
陈宇解释，大房间的灯坏了，大家十点零五分才决定换到小厅。他在决定以后发了消息，以为林安会从另一边进来。镜头没有让我们看见林安的手机，所以到这里，我们只能知道陈宇发过，不能直接知道她收到了。他说“你没看到”，也是在问，并不是已经知道答案。
林安说，自己十点上车的时候，手机已经没电。这个时间比换地方早了五分钟，也比消息发出早。她出门之前看的是原来的地址，到门口时自然还在找大房间。她没有看见大家，就怀疑陈宇忘了活动。这里可以理解她为什么这样想，却不能把她的怀疑当成陈宇真的忘了。
门口的通知是第三个线索。陈宇以为贴了纸，后来到的人就能找到小厅。林安确实看见了纸，可风把纸吹起来，她没看清内容。如果我们只听“看见一张纸”，就会漏掉后半句。看见纸和读到通知不是同一件事，就像发过消息和对方看过消息也不是同一件事。
等到十点四十分，林安向门口一家店的老板借了电话。陈宇不认识这个号码，但还是接了，这才听见她在大门口。电话接通以后，两个人知道的内容才接上。他告诉她从哪里走，她走了五分钟到了小厅。前面的等待很长，并不是因为路很远，而是因为她没有新地址。
后面陈宇说，下次应该再等她回一句，不能发完就算了。林安也说应该早点借电话，别一直站在门外猜。我把这两句抄下来，又看了一遍前面的消息和通知：陈宇一直以为她已经知道，林安却以为大家忘了。朋友问哪一句可以改得早一点，我指了指“你没看到”，说换成先问她在哪里，也许那时就能找到人。
最后林安说，她今天已经把大门看够了。陈宇邀请她进来喝水，活动还没有开始。我觉得这句话有一点抱怨，也有一点开玩笑：她不想再等，可也没有直接离开。如果换一种语气读，它可能更生气。我们讨论时先保留这两种可能，再听前后的声音，而不是凭一个词替整段关系下结论。

text: 我以为你已经收到。

meaning: I thought you had received it.

text: 你发的时候，我手机已经没电了。
pinyin: nǐ fā de shí hou , wǒ shǒu jī yǐ jīng méi diàn le .
meaning: My phone was already dead when you sent it.

text: 我只看见消息发出去了。

text: 那就不是看见我读过了。

text: 对，我把这两件事当成一件了。

text: 我也把没看见你，当成你没有来。

text: 下次别看了，直接打电话。

gè dǎ diàn huà ba . tā gān cuì bǎ wèn tí dāng miàn wèn qīng chǔ . bì jìng tā méi yǒu kàn dào xiāo xī , bù néng shuō tā gù yì bù lái . bì jìng dì yī cì jiàn miàn , wǒ men xiān bǎ dì fāng shuō qīng chǔ . wǒ ǒu rán zài mén kǒu kàn jiàn nà gè tōng zhī . zhè cì ǒu rán de xiāng yù ràng tā men chóng xīn lián xì . wǒ huái yí zì jǐ shì bú shì jì cuò le dì fāng . tā huái yí nà gè jiě shì , dàn yuàn yì xiān tīng wán . shì shí shì liǎng gè rén dōu dào le , zhǐ shì bù zài tóng yī gè dì fāng . wǒ xiǎng bǎ shì shí hé zì jǐ de pàn duàn fēn kāi . nǐ xiān jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me huàn le dì fāng . zhè gè jiě shì hái méi yǒu huí dá shí jiān de wèn tí . xià cì huàn dì fāng , wǒ men yào què rèn duì fāng shōu dào . tā dǎ diàn huà què rèn mén kǒu shì nǎ yī shàn mén . tā zhè gè biǎo qíng bù yí dìng shì zài shēng qì . wǒ zhǐ kàn jiàn biǎo qíng , méi tīng jiàn tā shuō shén me . zhè gè xì jié qián miàn yǐ jīng chū xiàn guò . tā bǔ le yī gè wǒ men méi zhù yì de xì jié . huó dòng qī jiān , nǐ kě yǐ lái xiǎo tīng zhǎo wǒ . fàng jià qī jiān , tā men jiàn le liǎng cì miàn . chū mén zhī qián , wǒ kàn guò yuán lái de dì zhǐ . nǐ zhī qián yǒu méi yǒu gào sù tā huàn dì fāng le ? jiē tōng diàn huà zhī hòu , tā cái zhī dào wǒ men zài xiǎo tīng . bǐ sài zhī hòu , tā cái jiě shì nà gè dòng zuò . zhǐ píng yī gè biǎo qíng , hěn nán pàn duàn tā zài xiǎng shén me . xiān tīng wán , zài zuò pàn duàn . wǒ men zài guān chá yī xià tā hòu miàn de dòng zuò . tā guān chá dào mén kǒu de zhǐ bèi fēng chuī qǐ lái le . mén kǒu yǒu yī gè huàn dì fāng de tōng zhī . tā tōng zhī le qún lǐ de rén , què méi yǒu děng huí fù .
meaning: What actually happened was completely different from my first idea. The story does not immediately tell the audience what happened. The paper on the door is a clue to finding the new venue. I looked back over the earlier clues. The key is that he had not seen the message then. This sentence is key to understanding the later reaction. First say what happened, then analyse why. We analysed what the two people knew. By that logic, sending a message means the other person read it, but that is wrong. The story’s logic needs to connect with the earlier facts. The misunderstanding comes from the two people knowing different things. She misunderstood the unfinished remark. We are waiting in the small hall for now. This section has not told us the result yet. I finally found you all. The final call finally connected. I cannot believe I waited at the door so long. Surprisingly he still remembered something said two years earlier. The phone is dead; let’s simply borrow one to make a call. She decided to ask directly and settle the question. After all, he did not see the message; we cannot say he deliberately stayed away. After all, it is the first meeting; let’s make the location clear. I happened to notice the sign at the entrance. This chance meeting brought them back in touch. I wondered whether I had remembered the wrong place. She doubted the explanation but was willing to hear it out. The fact is that both arrived, but at different places. I want to separate the facts from my judgment. First explain why the venue changed. This explanation has not answered the timing question. Next time we change venues, let’s confirm the other person received the update. He called to confirm which entrance was meant. His expression does not necessarily mean he is angry. I saw the expression but did not hear his words. This detail appeared earlier. She added a detail we had missed. During the event, you can find me in the small hall. They met twice during the holiday. Before leaving, I checked the original address. Had you told him about the venue change before that? Only after the call connected did he know we were in the small hall. Only after the competition did she explain that gesture. It is hard to judge his thoughts from one expression. Listen to the end before making a judgment. Let’s observe what he does afterwards. She noticed the paper at the entrance blowing in the wind. There is a notice at the entrance about the venue change. He notified the group but did not wait for replies.

门上的纸是我们找到新地方的线索。
我把前面的线索重新看了一遍。
关键是他当时还没有看到消息。

先说发生了什么，再分析为什么。
我们分析了两个人知道的内容。
按这个逻辑，发过消息就等于对方看过，可这不对。
故事的逻辑要和前面的事实接上。
这个误解来自两个人知道的事情不同。
她误解了那句没说完的话。
我们暂时在小厅等。

我总算找到你们了。
最后一次电话总算接通了。

他居然还记得两年前说过的话。
手机没电，干脆借一个打电话吧。

毕竟他没有看到消息，不能说他故意不来。

我偶然在门口看见那个通知。

他这个表情不一定是在生气。

这个细节前面已经出现过。

活动期间，你可以来小厅找我。

你之前有没有告诉他换地方了？
接通电话之后，他才知道我们在小厅。
比赛之后，她才解释那个动作。
只凭一个表情，很难判断他在想什么。

text: 看这段短剧时，我把纸分成三栏：观众知道什么，陈宇知道什么，林安知道什么。不是每一栏都要写满。有些信息后来才出现，有些一直没有说明。这样记下来，我发现开头最容易犯的错误，是把后来听到的解释放回前面，以为人物从一开始就应该知道。
pinyin: kàn zhè duàn duǎn jù shí , wǒ bǎ zhǐ fēn chéng sān lán : guān zhòng zhī dào shén me , chén yǔ zhī dào shén me , lín ān zhī dào shén me . bù shì měi yī lán dōu yào xiě mǎn . yǒu xiē xìn xī hòu lái cái chū xiàn , yǒu xiē yì zhí méi yǒu shuō míng . zhè yàng jì xià lái , wǒ fā xiàn kāi tóu zuì róng yì fàn de cuò wù , shì bǎ hòu lái tīng dào de jiě shì fàng huí qián miàn , yǐ wéi rén wù cóng yī kāi shǐ jiù yīng gāi zhī dào .
meaning: I divided my notes into what the audience, Chen and Lin knew. Not every column needed filling: some facts appeared later and others remained unspecified. The common mistake was putting a later explanation back into the beginning and assuming the characters should always have known it.

text: 在陈宇说发了消息的时候，他知道灯坏了，也知道活动换地方。他不知道林安的手机十点已经没电，更不知道她正站在大门口。林安知道原来的地址，知道自己等了很久，却不知道小厅里的人刚摆好椅子。两个人都不是毫无原因地生气，只是各自看到的事情不完整。
pinyin: zài chén yǔ shuō fā le xiāo xī de shí hou , tā zhī dào dēng huài le , yě zhī dào huó dòng huàn dì fāng . tā bù zhī dào lín ān de shǒu jī shí diǎn yǐ jīng méi diàn , gèng bù zhī dào tā zhèng zhàn zài dà mén kǒu . lín ān zhī dào yuán lái de dì zhǐ , zhī dào zì jǐ děng le hěn jiǔ , què bù zhī dào xiǎo tīng lǐ de rén gāng bǎi hǎo yǐ zi . liǎng gè rén dōu bù shì háo wú yuán yīn de shēng qì , zhǐ shì gè zì kàn dào de shì qíng bù wán zhěng .
meaning: When Chen mentions his message, he knows about the light and move, but not Lin’s dead phone or waiting position. Lin knows the old address and her long wait, but not that the others are just setting up chairs. Their reactions have reasons, but each has incomplete information.

text: 观众也不是从开头就比所有人知道得多。我们先看见林安走进来，听见陈宇说“总算”，容易跟着他觉得她来晚了。等她说在门口等，又容易立刻站到她那边。我暂停了一次，问自己前一个判断有没有被后面的事实改变。陈宇忘了活动这个说法，并没有在后面得到证明。
pinyin: guān zhòng yě bù shì cóng kāi tóu jiù bǐ suǒ yǒu rén zhī dào de duō . wǒ men xiān kàn jiàn lín ān zǒu jìn lái , tīng jiàn chén yǔ shuō zǒng suàn , róng yì gēn zhe tā jué de tā lái wǎn le . děng tā shuō zài mén kǒu děng , yòu róng yì lì kè zhàn dào tā nà biān . wǒ zàn tíng le yī cì , wèn zì jǐ qián yī gè pàn duàn yǒu méi yǒu bèi hòu miàn de shì shí gǎi biàn . chén yǔ wàng le huó dòng zhè gè shuō fǎ , bìng méi yǒu zài hòu miàn dé dào zhèng míng .
meaning: The audience does not know everything from the start. Seeing Lin enter and hearing finally can lead us to side with Chen; hearing about her wait can reverse that. I paused to ask whether later facts changed my earlier judgment. The claim that Chen forgot the event was never confirmed.

text: 把时间写清楚以后，事情更容易理解。十点手机没电，十点零五分换地方并发消息，十点四十分借电话，五分钟后到小厅。林安说等了半个小时，所以她到大门口是在十点十分左右，不是十点半。这个时间来自电话和等待一起计算，不是她在对话里直接报了到达时间。
pinyin: bǎ shí jiān xiě qīng chǔ yǐ hòu , shì qíng gèng róng yì lǐ jiě . shí diǎn shǒu jī méi diàn , shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn huàn dì fāng bìng fā xiāo xī , shí diǎn sì shí fēn jiè diàn huà , wǔ fēn zhōng hòu dào xiǎo tīng . lín ān shuō děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí , suǒ yǐ tā dào dà mén kǒu shì zài shí diǎn shí fēn zuǒ yòu , bù shì shí diǎn bàn . zhè gè shí jiān lái zì diàn huà hé děng dài yì qǐ jì suàn , bù shì tā zài duì huà lǐ zhí jiē bào le dào dá shí jiān .
meaning: A timeline helps: phone dead at ten, move and message at 10:05, borrowed call at 10:40, arrival five minutes later. A half-hour wait puts Lin at the main entrance around 10:10, not 10:30. That is an inference from the call and waiting duration, not an explicitly announced arrival time.

text: 不过我也注意到，人物口中的“半个小时”可能是大概的时间。我们能确定她等待很久，不能因此说她一定在十点十分零秒到达。讨论故事时，计算能帮我们发现顺序，但不应该把日常说话的大概数字变成不存在的准确记录。朋友说，他以前看字幕也常把“等了一百年”当成实际很久，其实那是在夸张。
pinyin: bù guò wǒ yě zhù yì dào , rén wù kǒu zhōng de bàn gè xiǎo shí kě néng shì dà gài de shí jiān . wǒ men néng què dìng tā děng dài hěn jiǔ , bù néng yīn cǐ shuō tā yí dìng zài shí diǎn shí fēn líng miǎo dào dá . tǎo lùn gù shì shí , jì suàn néng bāng wǒ men fā xiàn shùn xù , dàn bù yīng gāi bǎ rì cháng shuō huà de dà gài shù zì biàn chéng bù cún zài de zhǔn què jì lù . péng you shuō , tā yǐ qián kàn zì mù yě cháng bǎ děng le yī bǎi nián dàng chéng shí jì hěn jiǔ , qí shí nà shì zài kuā zhāng .
meaning: Half an hour may be approximate. We know she waited a long time, not that she arrived at precisely 10:10:00. Calculations can clarify sequence without turning conversational estimates into exact records. My friend recalled exaggerations such as waiting a hundred years, not literal durations.

text: 再读最后几句，我发现解释已经从过去转向下一次。等回复、说清是哪扇门、发现不对就借电话，都比简单说“下次别迟到”更符合这段经历。因为迟到这个词没有说明为什么找错地方，也没有说明消息没有读到。我们给这一段取了个自己的名字：两个人都来了，信息却没见面。
pinyin: zài dú zuì hòu jǐ jù , wǒ fā xiàn jiě shì yǐ jīng cóng guò qù zhuǎn xiàng xià yī cì . děng huí fù , shuō qīng shì nǎ shàn mén , fā xiàn bú duì jiù jiè diàn huà , dōu bǐ jiǎn dān shuō xià cì bié chí dào gèng fú hé zhè duàn jīng lì . yīn wèi chí dào zhè gè cí méi yǒu shuō míng wèi shén me zhǎo cuò dì fāng , yě méi yǒu shuō míng xiāo xī méi yǒu dú dào . wǒ men gěi zhè yī duàn qǔ le gè zì jǐ de míng zi : liǎng gè rén dōu lái le , xìn xī què méi jiàn miàn .
meaning: The ending turns from the past to next time: wait for a reply, specify the entrance, borrow a phone if things seem wrong. These fit the incident better than don’t be late, which misses the venue and unread message. We gave it our own title: both people arrived, but their information never met.

text: 朋友让我再讲一遍，不要照着每句字幕翻译。我先讲换地方的原因，再讲手机没电，最后讲那通电话怎样解决了问题。他提醒我，按事情发生的顺序讲和按短剧告诉观众的顺序讲不一样。我试了两个版本，听起来确实不同，但手机没电在消息之前这一点，在两个版本里都没有变。
pinyin: péng you ràng wǒ zài jiǎng yī biàn , bú yào zhào zhe měi jù zì mù fān yì . wǒ xiān jiǎng huàn dì fāng de yuán yīn , zài jiǎng shǒu jī méi diàn , zuì hòu jiǎng nà tōng diàn huà zěn yàng jiě jué le wèn tí . tā tí xǐng wǒ , àn shì qíng fā shēng de shùn xù jiǎng hé àn duǎn jù gào sù guān zhòng de shùn xù jiǎng bù yī yàng . wǒ shì le liǎng gè bǎn běn , tīng qǐ lái què shí bù tóng , dàn shǒu jī méi diàn zài xiāo xī zhī qián zhè yī diǎn , zài liǎng gè bǎn běn lǐ dōu méi yǒu biàn .
meaning: My friend asked for a retelling without translating each subtitle. I described the venue change, dead phone and resolving call. He noted the difference between chronological events and the order the drama reveals them. I tried both; they sounded different, but the phone dying before the message remained true in each.

yǔ shuō zǒng suàn , róng yì gēn zhe tā jué de tā lái wǎn le . děng tā shuō zài mén kǒu děng , yòu róng yì lì kè zhàn dào tā nà biān . wǒ zàn tíng le yī cì , wèn zì jǐ qián yī gè pàn duàn yǒu méi yǒu bèi hòu miàn de shì shí gǎi biàn . chén yǔ wàng le huó dòng zhè gè shuō fǎ , bìng méi yǒu zài hòu miàn dé dào zhèng míng . bǎ shí jiān xiě qīng chǔ yǐ hòu , shì qíng gèng róng yì lǐ jiě . shí diǎn shǒu jī méi diàn , shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn huàn dì fāng bìng fā xiāo xī , shí diǎn sì shí fēn jiè diàn huà , wǔ fēn zhōng hòu dào xiǎo tīng . lín ān shuō děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí , suǒ yǐ tā dào dà mén kǒu shì zài shí diǎn shí fēn zuǒ yòu , bù shì shí diǎn bàn . zhè gè shí jiān lái zì diàn huà hé děng dài yì qǐ jì suàn , bù shì tā zài duì huà lǐ zhí jiē bào le dào dá shí jiān . bù guò wǒ yě zhù yì dào , rén wù kǒu zhōng de bàn gè xiǎo shí kě néng shì dà gài de shí jiān . wǒ men néng què dìng tā děng dài hěn jiǔ , bù néng yīn cǐ shuō tā yí dìng zài shí diǎn shí fēn líng miǎo dào dá . tǎo lùn gù shì shí , jì suàn néng bāng wǒ men fā xiàn shùn xù , dàn bù yīng gāi bǎ rì cháng shuō huà de dà gài shù zì biàn chéng bù cún zài de zhǔn què jì lù . péng you shuō , tā yǐ qián kàn zì mù yě cháng bǎ děng le yī bǎi nián dàng chéng shí jì hěn jiǔ , qí shí nà shì zài kuā zhāng . zài dú zuì hòu jǐ jù , wǒ fā xiàn jiě shì yǐ jīng cóng guò qù zhuǎn xiàng xià yī cì . děng huí fù , shuō qīng shì nǎ shàn mén , fā xiàn bú duì jiù jiè diàn huà , dōu bǐ jiǎn dān shuō xià cì bié chí dào gèng fú hé zhè duàn jīng lì . yīn wèi chí dào zhè gè cí méi yǒu shuō míng wèi shén me zhǎo cuò dì fāng , yě méi yǒu shuō míng xiāo xī méi yǒu dú dào . wǒ men gěi zhè yī duàn qǔ le gè zì jǐ de míng zi : liǎng gè rén dōu lái le , xìn xī què méi jiàn miàn . péng you ràng wǒ zài jiǎng yī biàn , bú yào zhào zhe měi jù zì mù fān yì . wǒ xiān jiǎng huàn dì fāng de yuán yīn , zài jiǎng shǒu jī méi diàn , zuì hòu jiǎng nà tōng diàn huà zěn yàng jiě jué le wèn tí . tā tí xǐng wǒ , àn shì qíng fā shēng de shùn xù jiǎng hé àn duǎn jù gào sù guān zhòng de shùn xù jiǎng bù yī yàng . wǒ shì le liǎng gè bǎn běn , tīng qǐ lái què shí bù tóng , dàn shǒu jī méi diàn zài xiāo xī zhī qián zhè yī diǎn , zài liǎng gè bǎn běn lǐ dōu méi yǒu biàn .
meaning: I divided my notes into what the audience, Chen and Lin knew. Not every column needed filling: some facts appeared later and others remained unspecified. The common mistake was putting a later explanation back into the beginning and assuming the characters should always have known it. When Chen mentions his message, he knows about the light and move, but not Lin’s dead phone or waiting position. Lin knows the old address and her long wait, but not that the others are just setting up chairs. Their reactions have reasons, but each has incomplete information. The audience does not know everything from the start. Seeing Lin enter and hearing finally can lead us to side with Chen; hearing about her wait can reverse that. I paused to ask whether later facts changed my earlier judgment. The claim that Chen forgot the event was never confirmed. A timeline helps: phone dead at ten, move and message at 10:05, borrowed call at 10:40, arrival five minutes later. A half-hour wait puts Lin at the main entrance around 10:10, not 10:30. That is an inference from the call and waiting duration, not an explicitly announced arrival time. Half an hour may be approximate. We know she waited a long time, not that she arrived at precisely 10:10:00. Calculations can clarify sequence without turning conversational estimates into exact records. My friend recalled exaggerations such as waiting a hundred years, not literal durations. The ending turns from the past to next time: wait for a reply, specify the entrance, borrow a phone if things seem wrong. These fit the incident better than don’t be late, which misses the venue and unread message. We gave it our own title: both people arrived, but their information never met. My friend asked for a retelling without translating each subtitle. I described the venue change, dead phone and resolving call. He noted the difference between chronological events and the order the drama reveals them. I tried both; they sounded different, but the phone dying before the message remained true in each.

parts.text: 看这段短剧时，我把纸分成三栏：观众知道什么，陈宇知道什么，林安知道什么。不是每一栏都要写满。有些信息后来才出现，有些一直没有说明。这样记下来，我发现开头最容易犯的错误，是把后来听到的解释放回前面，以为人物从一开始就应该知道。
在陈宇说发了消息的时候，他知道灯坏了，也知道活动换地方。他不知道林安的手机十点已经没电，更不知道她正站在大门口。林安知道原来的地址，知道自己等了很久，却不知道小厅里的人刚摆好椅子。两个人都不是毫无原因地生气，只是各自看到的事情不完整。
观众也不是从开头就比所有人知道得多。我们先看见林安走进来，听见陈宇说“总算”，容易跟着他觉得她来晚了。等她说在门口等，又容易立刻站到她那边。我暂停了一次，问自己前一个判断有没有被后面的事实改变。陈宇忘了活动这个说法，并没有在后面得到证明。
把时间写清楚以后，事情更容易理解。十点手机没电，十点零五分换地方并发消息，十点四十分借电话，五分钟后到小厅。林安说等了半个小时，所以她到大门口是在十点十分左右，不是十点半。这个时间来自电话和等待一起计算，不是她在对话里直接报了到达时间。
不过我也注意到，人物口中的“半个小时”可能是大概的时间。我们能确定她等待很久，不能因此说她一定在十点十分零秒到达。讨论故事时，计算能帮我们发现顺序，但不应该把日常说话的大概数字变成不存在的准确记录。朋友说，他以前看字幕也常把“等了一百年”当成实际很久，其实那是在夸张。
再读最后几句，我发现解释已经从过去转向下一次。等回复、说清是哪扇门、发现不对就借电话，都比简单说“下次别迟到”更符合这段经历。因为迟到这个词没有说明为什么找错地方，也没有说明消息没有读到。我们给这一段取了个自己的名字：两个人都来了，信息却没见面。
朋友让我再讲一遍，不要照着每句字幕翻译。我先讲换地方的原因，再讲手机没电，最后讲那通电话怎样解决了问题。他提醒我，按事情发生的顺序讲和按短剧告诉观众的顺序讲不一样。我试了两个版本，听起来确实不同，但手机没电在消息之前这一点，在两个版本里都没有变。

text: 这周三次活动你都来吗？
pinyin: zhè zhōu sān cì huó dòng nǐ dōu lái ma ?
meaning: Are you coming to all three activities this week?

text: 我想来，不过周一和周三已经有课，三个晚上再出门有点多。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng lái , bù guò zhōu yī hé zhōu sān yǐ jīng yǒu kè , sān gè wǎn shang zài chū mén yǒu diǎn duō .
meaning: I’d like to, but I already have classes Monday and Wednesday. Three more evenings out is a lot.

text: 周二看电影，周四唱歌，周六吃饭，你最想留哪个？
pinyin: zhōu èr kàn diàn yǐng , zhōu sì chàng gē , zhōu liù chī fàn , nǐ zuì xiǎng liú nǎ gè ?
meaning: Film Tuesday, singing Thursday, dinner Saturday. Which do you most want to keep?

text: 周六吧。我上次一直听，想这次跟大家聊起来。
pinyin: zhōu liù ba . wǒ shàng cì yì zhí tīng , xiǎng zhè cì gēn dà jiā liáo qǐ lái .
meaning: Saturday. Last time I mostly listened; I’d like to chat with everyone this time.

text: 那电影和唱歌都先不来了？
pinyin: nà diàn yǐng hé chàng gē dōu xiān bù lái le ?
meaning: So are you skipping both the film and singing for now?

text: 电影这周先不去，唱歌我隔周来一次，行不行？
pinyin: diàn yǐng zhè zhōu xiān bù qù , chàng gē wǒ gé zhōu lái yī cì , xíng bù xíng ?
meaning: I’ll skip the film this week and come to singing every other week. Would that work?

text: 当然。你不用每次都到。
pinyin: dāng rán . nǐ bù yòng měi cì dōu dào .
meaning: Of course. You don’t have to be there every time.

text: 我就是怕不常来，大家很快就不认识我了。
pinyin: wǒ jiù shì pà bù cháng lái , dà jiā hěn kuài jiù bù rèn shi wǒ le .
meaning: I’m worried that if I don’t come often, everyone will quickly forget me.

text: 上次那个来得最少的人，你还记得吧？
pinyin: shàng cì nà gè lái de zuì shǎo de rén , nǐ hái jì de ba ?
meaning: You remember the person who came least often last time, don’t you?

text: 记得，那个会给每道菜起名字的。
pinyin: jì de , nà gè huì gěi měi dào cài qǐ míng zi de .
meaning: Yes, the one who gave every dish a name.

text: 对，我们也记得你把辣椒当青菜的那次。
pinyin: duì , wǒ men yě jì de nǐ bǎ là jiāo dāng qīng cài de nà cì .
meaning: Right. And we remember the time you mistook the chilli for a green vegetable.

text: 这个记忆能不能删掉？
pinyin: zhè gè jì yì néng bù néng shān diào ?
meaning: Could you delete that memory?

text: 不能。不过下次我先提醒你。
pinyin: bù néng . bù guò xià cì wǒ xiān tí xǐng nǐ .
meaning: No. But next time I’ll warn you first.

text: 谢谢，终于有一点实际帮助。周六我六点到，八点半回去。
pinyin: xiè xiè , zhōng yú yǒu yī diǎn shí jì bāng zhù . zhōu liù wǒ liù diǎn dào , bā diǎn bàn huí qù .
meaning: Thanks, finally some practical help. I’ll arrive at six Saturday and head home at half eight.

text: 太早了吗？我们一般聊到九点。
pinyin: tài zǎo le ma ? wǒ men yì bān liáo dào jiǔ diǎn .
meaning: Is that too early? We usually talk until nine.

text: 我第二天想早点练，路上还要半小时。先试两周吧。
pinyin: wǒ dì èr tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn liàn , lù shàng hái yào bàn xiǎo shí . xiān shì liǎng zhōu ba .
meaning: I’d like to practise early the next day, and the journey takes half an hour. Let’s try it for two weeks.

text: 好，要走就说一声，不用等大家一起。
pinyin: hǎo , yào zǒu jiù shuō yī shēng , bù yòng děng dà jiā yì qǐ .

text: 朋友发来三次活动的时间，我看了一眼就想全部答应。周二有电影，周四唱歌，周六吃饭，都不是我讨厌的事情。而且我学中文本来就想和人聊，不想只在家做题。可是打开日历，周一和周三已经有课，如果另外三个晚上都出去，这周只剩一个工作日晚上没有安排。
pinyin: péng you fā lái sān cì huó dòng de shí jiān , wǒ kàn le yī yǎn jiù xiǎng quán bù dā yìng . zhōu èr yǒu diàn yǐng , zhōu sì chàng gē , zhōu liù chī fàn , dōu bù shì wǒ tǎo yàn de shì qíng . ér qiě wǒ xué zhōng wén běn lái jiù xiǎng hé rén liáo , bù xiǎng zhǐ zài jiā zuò tí . kě shì dǎ kāi rì lì , zhōu yī hé zhōu sān yǐ jīng yǒu kè , rú guǒ lìng wài sān gè wǎn shang dōu chū qù , zhè zhōu zhǐ shèng yī gè gōng zuò rì wǎn shang méi yǒu ān pái .
meaning: My friend sent three activities and I wanted to accept all of them: a Tuesday film, Thursday singing and Saturday dinner. I liked them all and was learning Chinese to talk with people, not just do exercises. But Monday and Wednesday already had classes; adding three evenings out would leave only one weekday evening free.

text: 上个月我试过把时间安排满。课前赶着吃饭，活动结束又在车上补练习，回家以后还觉得当天没做够。最晚的一次，我快十二点才睡，第二天看见熟悉的字也读得很慢。朋友在课上问我刚才讲到哪里，我翻了两页笔记，还没找到。他说昨晚玩得很晚吧，我说没有玩，只是把一天塞得太满了。
pinyin: shàng gè yuè wǒ shì guò bǎ shí jiān ān pái mǎn . kè qián gǎn zhe chī fàn , huó dòng jié shù yòu zài chē shàng bǔ liàn xí , huí jiā yǐ hòu hái jué de dàng tiān méi zuò gòu . zuì wǎn de yī cì , wǒ kuài shí èr diǎn cái shuì , dì èr tiān kàn jiàn shú xī de zì yě dú de hěn màn . péng you zài kè shàng wèn wǒ gāng cái jiǎng dào nǎ lǐ , wǒ fān le liǎng yè bǐ jì , hái méi zhǎo dào . tā shuō zuó wǎn wán de hěn wǎn ba , wǒ shuō méi yǒu wán , zhǐ shì bǎ yī tiān sāi de tài mǎn le .
meaning: Last month I tried filling my schedule. I rushed dinner before class and finished exercises on the bus after activities. One night I nearly reached midnight before sleeping; the next day even familiar characters were slow to read. Asked where we'd got to in class, I searched two pages of notes without finding it. A friend asked if I'd stayed out late having fun. No, I'd just crammed too much into a day.

text: 我跟朋友说，想先留下周六吃饭。上次我只跟熟悉的人说话，这次想问新朋友平时看什么、怎么选活动，再讲讲自己最近看的短剧。电影我也想看，就问他下个月还有没有一场。他发来另一张安排，说不急，先来吃饭吧。我把周六圈出来，旁边写了新朋友的名字，免得到时候又叫错。

Last time I'd spoken only to familiar people; now I wanted to ask newcomers what they watched and how they chose activities, and mention a short drama I'd seen. I asked about a film next month too. text: 唱歌活动我想隔周参加，空下来的那一周先在家把两句读清楚。朋友问我准备带哪首，我说还是上次没跟上的那首。他笑了，说这次给你找个会唱的一起练。我问是不是你，他马上说不是，我只能帮你找人。聊到这里，我又想去唱歌了，不过看一眼日历，还是把下周的日期先记下来。
pinyin: chàng gē huó dòng wǒ xiǎng gé zhōu cān jiā , kōng xià lái de nà yī zhōu xiān zài jiā bǎ liǎng jù dú qīng chǔ . péng you wèn wǒ zhǔn bèi dài nǎ shǒu , wǒ shuō hái shi shàng cì méi gēn shàng de nà shǒu . tā xiào le , shuō zhè cì gěi nǐ zhǎo gè huì chàng de yì qǐ liàn . wǒ wèn shì bú shì nǐ , tā mǎ shàng shuō bù shì , wǒ zhǐ néng bāng nǐ zhǎo rén . liáo dào zhè lǐ , wǒ yòu xiǎng qù chàng gē le , bù guò kàn yī yǎn rì lì , hái shi bǎ xià zhōu de rì qī xiān jì xià lái .
meaning: I wanted to attend singing every other week, practising two lines at home in between. Which song would I bring? The one I couldn't keep up with last time. text: 第一次照着这个安排去，我真的和一个新朋友聊了几句。她问我为什么最近看短剧，我说长的暂时跟不上，短的能再看一遍。她推荐了自己的方法，我先记下最想试的一点，说回家试试看。八点半时我说要走，她笑着问下周是不是也来。我说想来，不过先看看课表，又把刚才聊到的剧名记在手机里。
pinyin: dì yī cì zhào zhe zhè gè ān pái qù , wǒ zhēn de hé yī gè xīn péng you liáo le jǐ jù . tā wèn wǒ wèi shén me zuì jìn kàn duǎn jù , wǒ shuō zhǎng de zàn shí gēn bù shàng , duǎn de néng zài kàn yī biàn . tā tuī jiàn le zì jǐ de fāng fǎ , wǒ xiān jì xià zuì xiǎng shì de yī diǎn , shuō huí jiā shì shì kàn . bā diǎn bàn shí wǒ shuō yào zǒu , tā xiào zhe wèn xià zhōu shì bú shì yě lái . wǒ shuō xiǎng lái , bù guò xiān kàn kàn kè biǎo , yòu bǎ gāng cái liáo dào de jù míng jì zài shǒu jī lǐ .
meaning: The first time I tried this plan, I chatted with someone new. Why short dramas lately? I couldn't keep up with longer ones yet, and short ones were easier to replay. text: 上次连吃饭都写十五分钟。
pinyin: shàng cì lián chī fàn dōu xiě shí wǔ fēn zhōng .
meaning: Last time you allowed fifteen minutes even for dinner.

text: 我现在知道十五分钟不够听你给菜起名字。
pinyin: wǒ xiàn zài zhī dào shí wǔ fēn zhōng bù gòu tīng nǐ gěi cài qǐ míng zi .
meaning: Now I know fifteen minutes isn’t enough to hear your names for the dishes.

text: 那你给聊天留了多久？
pinyin: nà nǐ gěi liáo tiān liú le duō jiǔ ?
meaning: How long did you leave for chatting?

text: 两小时半，六点到八点半。
pinyin: liǎng xiǎo shí bàn , liù diǎn dào bā diǎn bàn .
meaning: Two and a half hours, six to half eight.

text: 要是讲到一半呢？
pinyin: yào shì jiǎng dào yí bàn ne ?
meaning: What if you’re halfway through a story?

text: 那我就说，下周再讲。
pinyin: nà wǒ jiù shuō , xià zhōu zài jiǎng .
meaning: Then I’ll say I’ll finish next week.

text: 你这样比短剧还会让人等。
pinyin: nǐ zhè yàng bǐ duǎn jù hái huì ràng rén děng .
meaning: You’re better than a short drama at making people wait.

text: 谢谢，这是我今天的收获。
pinyin: xiè xiè , zhè shì wǒ jīn tiān de shōu huò .
meaning: Thanks. That’s what I got out of today.

text: 不算表扬。
pinyin: bù suàn biǎo yáng .
meaning: That wasn’t praise.

text: 我知道，我也没放进成绩表。
pinyin: wǒ zhī dào , wǒ yě méi fàng jìn chéng jì biǎo .
meaning: I know. I didn’t put it in my marks sheet either.

text: 你又做时间表了？这次没有把每一分钟都填满。上次连吃饭都写十五分钟。我现在知道十五分钟不够听你给菜起名字。那你给聊天留了多久？两小时半，六点到八点半。要是讲到一半呢？那我就说，下周再讲。你这样比短剧还会让人等。谢谢，这是我今天的收获。不算表扬。我知道，我也没放进成绩表。
pinyin: nǐ yòu zuò shí jiān biǎo le ? zhè cì méi yǒu bǎ měi yī fēn zhōng dōu tián mǎn . shàng cì lián chī fàn dōu xiě shí wǔ fēn zhōng . wǒ xiàn zài zhī dào shí wǔ fēn zhōng bù gòu tīng nǐ gěi cài qǐ míng zi . nà nǐ gěi liáo tiān liú le duō jiǔ ? liǎng xiǎo shí bàn , liù diǎn dào bā diǎn bàn . yào shì jiǎng dào yí bàn ne ? nà wǒ jiù shuō , xià zhōu zài jiǎng . nǐ zhè yàng bǐ duǎn jù hái huì ràng rén děng . xiè xiè , zhè shì wǒ jīn tiān de shōu huò . bù suàn biǎo yáng . wǒ zhī dào , wǒ yě méi fàng jìn chéng jì biǎo .
meaning: You’ve made another timetable? This time I haven’t filled every minute. Last time you allowed fifteen minutes even for dinner. Now I know fifteen minutes isn’t enough to hear your names for the dishes. How long did you leave for chatting? Two and a half hours, six to half eight. What if you’re halfway through a story? Then I’ll say I’ll finish next week. You’re better than a short drama at making people wait. Thanks. That’s what I got out of today. That wasn’t praise. I know. I didn’t put it in my marks sheet either.
