I saw a page in the corridor; I don’t know how it fell out. Let's ask who moved the bag. I'll go and look too. The volunteer says the entrance was crowded, so he moved it upstairs with the boxes. So it’s still in the building. The pages should be there too? Let’s check. I only saw that one sheet, not the contents. Found it—this is mine. Which page is missing? Sort by page number, not just count sheets. Three is here; four is the corridor sheet, and five is here too. Good, they connect. The new section isn’t missing. I returned an empty bag this morning; I didn’t know you added pages later. I understand now. In my rush I sounded like I was asking where you lost it. You can ask. I also hadn’t written the location to you. The volunteer apologised; he thought it was exchange material. Then give personal bags a different spot, away from event boxes. Okay. Rehearse first; then I’ll hold the bag while you move the table. Now we know who has it. Don’t take my umbrella for script pages too.

parts.text: 蓝袋子你还给我了吗？
早上放门右边了，还是空的。
我后来把稿子放进去，现在袋子不见了。
你不是一直拿着？
没有，放完纸就去搬桌子了。
那我们先找刚才在门口的人。
有人说东西都搬地下室了。
那是猜的吧？今天没有用地下室。
我在楼道看到一张稿纸，不知道怎么掉出来的。
先问问谁搬过袋子吧，我也过去看看。
志愿者说门口太满，袋子和纸箱一起放到二楼了。
原来还在楼里。那稿子应该也在？
先去看。我只看到楼道那一张，还没看袋子里面。
找到啦，这就是我的。里面少了哪一页？
先按页码排，别只数张数。
三在这里，四就是楼道那张。后面五也在。
好，连上了。没有少新的那一段。
我早上放的是空袋子，你后面放纸，我真的不知道。
我现在知道了，刚才一着急像是在问你丢哪了。
你可以问，我也没把放的位置写给你。
志愿者道歉说以为是交换的东西。
那给个人袋子换个地方，不跟活动纸箱放一起。
行，先把这段排了。等会儿我拿着袋子，你搬桌子。
这回谁拿着说清了。别又把我的伞也当稿子。

text: 周五晚上我借了陈宇的蓝袋子，带几本书回家。周六上午到了换书活动，我先把书拿出来，再把空袋子放在一楼门右边，准备等他来搬东西时交还。门的两侧都堆着箱子，我把袋子往里挪了一点，免得挡住入口。我想发个消息，手里又有人递来一本书，问放哪儿。我转头帮他找桌子，就把消息忘了。等陈宇来了，我也没有再过去指给他看。
pinyin: zhōu wǔ wǎn shang wǒ jiè le chén yǔ de lán dài zi , dài jǐ běn shū huí jiā . zhōu liù shàng wǔ dào le huàn shū huó dòng , wǒ xiān bǎ shū ná chū lái , zài bǎ kōng dài zi fàng zài yī lóu mén yòu biān , zhǔn bèi děng tā lái bān dōng xi shí jiāo huán . mén de liǎng cè dōu duī zhe xiāng zi , wǒ bǎ dài zi wǎng lǐ nuó le yī diǎn , miǎn de dǎng zhù rù kǒu . wǒ xiǎng fā gè xiāo xī , shǒu lǐ yòu yǒu rén dì lái yī běn shū , wèn fàng nǎr . wǒ zhuǎn tóu bāng tā zhǎo zhuō zi , jiù bǎ xiāo xī wàng le . děng chén yǔ lái le , wǒ yě méi yǒu zài guò qù zhǐ gěi tā kàn .
meaning: I borrowed Chen Yu's blue bag on Friday to take some books home. At Saturday's book exchange I removed the books and put the empty bag to the right of the downstairs entrance, ready to return it when he arrived. Boxes lined both sides, so I moved it further in to keep the doorway clear. I meant to message him, but someone handed me a book and asked where it went. Helping them find a table, I forgot the message. When Chen Yu arrived, I didn't go back to show him either.

text: 陈宇来了以后先把蓝袋子找到，放进去五页新稿子，接着去搬桌子。我当时在活动桌旁帮人找书，只看到他从门口走过，没有看到他放纸。后来他问袋子在哪，我还说不是在你手里吗。他伸出两只空手给我看，又指向刚搬完的桌子。我这才想起来，早上还的时候是空袋子，他现在找的却已经装了今天要排的新段落。
pinyin: chén yǔ lái le yǐ hòu xiān bǎ lán dài zi zhǎo dào , fàng jìn qù wǔ yè xīn gǎo zi , jiē zhe qù bān zhuō zi . wǒ dāng shí zài huó dòng zhuō páng bāng rén zhǎo shū , zhǐ kàn dào tā cóng mén kǒu zǒu guò , méi yǒu kàn dào tā fàng zhǐ . hòu lái tā wèn dài zi zài nǎ , wǒ hái shuō bù shì zài nǐ shǒu lǐ ma . tā shēn chū liǎng zhǐ kōng shǒu gěi wǒ kàn , yòu zhǐ xiàng gāng bān wán de zhuō zi . wǒ zhè cái xiǎng qǐ lái , zǎo shàng huán de shí hou shì kōng dài zi , tā xiàn zài zhǎo de què yǐ jīng zhuāng le jīn tiān yào pái de xīn duàn luò .
meaning: Chen Yu found the blue bag, put five new manuscript pages inside and went to move tables. I was helping someone find a book and saw him pass, not insert the pages. Asked where the bag was, I thought he had it. He held out empty hands and pointed at the tables he'd moved. The bag I'd returned empty now held today's new rehearsal section.

text: 我们先问门口几个人，有人说不用的东西都到地下室去了。我正要过去，陈宇问他有没有见到蓝袋子。那个人说没有，只是以前活动常放在那里。我停下来给负责场地的人打电话，他说今天地下室没有开，先找楼上。陈宇已经走到楼道，叫我过去看，一张稿纸掉在地上，页码正好是四，上面还有他刚改过的字。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān wèn mén kǒu jǐ gè rén , yǒu rén shuō bù yòng de dōng xi dōu dào dì xià shì qù le . wǒ zhèng yào guò qù , chén yǔ wèn tā yǒu méi yǒu jiàn dào lán dài zi . nà gè rén shuō méi yǒu , zhǐ shì yǐ qián huó dòng cháng fàng zài nà lǐ . wǒ tíng xià lái gěi fù zé chǎng dì de rén dǎ diàn huà , tā shuō jīn tiān dì xià shì méi yǒu kāi , xiān zhǎo lóu shàng . chén yǔ yǐ jīng zǒu dào lóu dào , jiào wǒ guò qù kàn , yī zhāng gǎo zhǐ diào zài dì shang , yè mǎ zhèng hǎo shì sì , shàng miàn hái yǒu tā gāng gǎi guò de zì .
meaning: Someone near the entrance suggested the basement, where things had gone at previous events. Before I went, Chen asked if he'd seen the blue bag. He hadn't. The venue contact told me the basement was closed today and suggested upstairs. Chen called from the corridor: a page lay on the floor, numbered four, with his latest corrections on it.

text: 陈宇把第四页拿起来，指着最后一行给我看，说这一句昨晚才改。我问是不是他搬桌子时掉的，他摇头，说搬的是桌子，稿子早就放进袋里了。我让他先拿好这张，自己回门口问负责收东西的人。刚走到门边，就听见志愿者说蓝袋子也搬上去了。陈宇跟在后面，一听二楼两个字就跑了过来，问仓库的门现在开着没有。
pinyin: chén yǔ bǎ dì sì yè ná qǐ lái , zhǐ zhe zuì hòu yī xíng gěi wǒ kàn , shuō zhè yī jù zuó wǎn cái gǎi . wǒ wèn shì bú shì tā bān zhuō zi shí diào de , tā yáo tóu , shuō bān de shì zhuō zi , gǎo zi zǎo jiù fàng jìn dài lǐ le . wǒ ràng tā xiān ná hǎo zhè zhāng , zì jǐ huí mén kǒu wèn fù zé shōu dōng xi de rén . gāng zǒu dào mén biān , jiù tīng jiàn zhì yuàn zhě shuō lán dài zi yě bān shàng qù le . chén yǔ gēn zài hòu miàn , yī tīng èr lóu liǎng gè zì jiù pǎo le guò lái , wèn cāng kù de mén xiàn zài kāi zhe méi yǒu .
meaning: Chen Yu picked up page four and pointed to its last line, which he'd revised the night before. Had he dropped it while moving tables? No: he'd been carrying a table, with the pages already in the bag. I asked him to keep the sheet while I went back to the entrance. A volunteer said the blue bag had gone upstairs too. Hearing 'second floor,' Chen Yu hurried over to ask whether the storeroom was open.

text: 负责门口的志愿者说，他把蓝袋子和两只纸箱一起搬到二楼仓库了。门口越来越满，有人推着椅子过不去，他就先把这些东西移开，以为袋子也是活动待用的。他还记得上楼时有纸露在袋口。我问里面是不是放书，他说没打开看，放到纸箱旁就下来了。陈宇举起手里的第四页，问能不能带我们上去，志愿者马上放下正在整理的书，领我们往楼梯走。
pinyin: fù zé mén kǒu de zhì yuàn zhě shuō , tā bǎ lán dài zi hé liǎng zhǐ zhǐ xiāng yì qǐ bān dào èr lóu cāng kù le . mén kǒu yuè lái yuè mǎn , yǒu rén tuī zhe yǐ zi guò bù qù , tā jiù xiān bǎ zhè xiē dōng xi yí kāi , yǐ wéi dài zi yě shì huó dòng dài yòng de . tā hái jì de shàng lóu shí yǒu zhǐ lù zài dài kǒu . wǒ wèn lǐ miàn shì bú shì fàng shū , tā shuō méi dǎ kāi kàn , fàng dào zhǐ xiāng páng jiù xià lái le . chén yǔ jǔ qǐ shǒu lǐ de dì sì yè , wèn néng bù néng dài wǒ men shàng qù , zhì yuàn zhě mǎ shàng fàng xià zhèng zài zhěng lǐ de shū , lǐng wǒ men wǎng lóu tī zǒu .
meaning: The entrance volunteer had moved the blue bag and two boxes to the upstairs storeroom. Someone pushing chairs couldn't get through the crowded doorway, so he'd cleared what he assumed was event equipment. He remembered paper sticking out of the bag. Had it contained books? He hadn't opened it; he'd set it beside the boxes and come back down. Chen Yu held up page four and asked to be taken upstairs. The volunteer put down the books he was sorting and led us to the stairs.

text: 我们沿着楼道上去，仓库里正有人收椅子。管理员把门开大一点，让我们从旁边进去。蓝袋子就在靠墙的纸箱旁，陈宇拿起来，先把稿子放到空桌上。里面还有四张，他一张一张排开，一、二、三、五都在。我把楼道那张递过去，他放进三和五中间，又从第一句读到新改的那一句。听见第四页接上了，我才敢把手里的袋子放下，问他这回能排练了吧。
pinyin: wǒ men yán zhe lóu dào shàng qù , cāng kù lǐ zhèng yǒu rén shōu yǐ zi . guǎn lǐ yuán bǎ mén kāi dà yī diǎn , ràng wǒ men cóng páng biān jìn qù . lán dài zi jiù zài kào qiáng de zhǐ xiāng páng , chén yǔ ná qǐ lái , xiān bǎ gǎo zi fàng dào kōng zhuō shàng . lǐ miàn hái yǒu sì zhāng , tā yī zhāng yī zhāng pái kāi , yī , èr , sān , wǔ dōu zài . wǒ bǎ lóu dào nà zhāng dì guò qù , tā fàng jìn sān hé wǔ zhōng jiān , yòu cóng dì yī jù dú dào xīn gǎi de nà yī jù . tīng jiàn dì sì yè jiē shàng le , wǒ cái gǎn bǎ shǒu lǐ de dài zi fàng xià , wèn tā zhè huí néng pái liàn le ba .
meaning: Upstairs, someone was putting chairs away. The manager opened the door wider to let us through. Chen Yu found the blue bag beside the boxes and laid its four remaining sheets on an empty table: one, two, three and five. I handed over the corridor sheet; he put it between three and five and read through to his new line. Only when page four fitted did I put down the bag and ask whether we could finally rehearse.

text: 志愿者说抱歉，刚才应该先问一句。陈宇说找到了就好，下次自己把袋口拉好。我也拿出手机，把蓝袋子已找到发到群里，免得大家还往别处跑。门口仍然有人搬书，志愿者指着另一张桌子，问个人东西放那边行不行。我说行，帮他把桌上的活动资料移开，再贴上一张写着个人物品的纸。陈宇拿着稿子过来，笑说现在先别把这五张也当成交换的书。
pinyin: zhì yuàn zhě shuō bào qiàn , gāng cái yīng gāi xiān wèn yī jù . chén yǔ shuō zhǎo dào le jiù hǎo , xià cì zì jǐ bǎ dài kǒu lā hǎo . wǒ yě ná chū shǒu jī , bǎ lán dài zi yǐ zhǎo dào fā dào qún lǐ , miǎn de dà jiā hái wǎng bié chù pǎo . mén kǒu réng rán yǒu rén bān shū , zhì yuàn zhě zhǐ zhe lìng yī zhāng zhuō zi , wèn gè rén dōng xi fàng nà biān xíng bù xíng . wǒ shuō xíng , bāng tā bǎ zhuō shàng de huó dòng zī liào yí kāi , zài tiē shàng yī zhāng xiě zhe gè rén wù pǐn de zhǐ . chén yǔ ná zhe gǎo zi guò lái , xiào shuō xiàn zài xiān bié bǎ zhè wǔ zhāng yě dàng chéng jiāo huàn de shū .
meaning: The volunteer apologised for not asking before moving it. Chen Yu was glad we'd found it and would close the bag properly next time. I messaged the group so nobody kept searching elsewhere. With books still passing through the entrance, the volunteer suggested another table for personal belongings. I helped clear the event handouts and label it. Arriving with the manuscript, Chen Yu joked that these five sheets weren't exchange books either.

text: 我们把个人袋子移到另一张桌子，贴了说明，再向还在找的人说已经找到了。有位朋友说我就知道没丢，我笑说刚才我们可不知道。他拿起水杯，问还用不用去地下室，我赶紧说不用了，也在群里补了一句。楼下的朋友回复，幸好看见消息，要不就白跑一趟。管理员让我们把蓝袋子带走，桌上只留下场馆的东西。陈宇收好五页稿子，说明天交给演出的人，今晚先不再挪地方。
pinyin: wǒ men bǎ gè rén dài zi yí dào lìng yī zhāng zhuō zi , tiē le shuō míng , zài xiàng hái zài zhǎo de rén shuō yǐ jīng zhǎo dào le . yǒu wèi péng you shuō wǒ jiù zhī dào méi diū , wǒ xiào shuō gāng cái wǒ men kě bù zhī dào . tā ná qǐ shuǐ bēi , wèn hái yòng bù yòng qù dì xià shì , wǒ gǎn jǐn shuō bù yòng le , yě zài qún lǐ bǔ le yī jù . lóu xià de péng you huí fù , xìng hǎo kàn jiàn xiāo xī , yào bù jiù bái pǎo yī tàng . guǎn lǐ yuán ràng wǒ men bǎ lán dài zi dài zǒu , zhuō shàng zhǐ liú xià chǎng guǎn de dōng xi . chén yǔ shōu hǎo wǔ yè gǎo zi , shuō míng tiān jiāo gěi yǎn chū de rén , jīn wǎn xiān bù zài nuó dì fāng .
meaning: We moved the personal bags to another table, labelled them and told the searchers we had found the bag. A friend said he had known it was not lost; I laughed that we certainly had not known that earlier. He asked whether he still needed to check the basement. I quickly said no and updated the group. A friend downstairs was glad to see the message before making a wasted trip. The manager asked us to take the blue bag away and leave only venue equipment on the table. Chen Yu put all five pages together. He would hand them to the performers tomorrow; tonight they would stay put.

text: 排练开始时，陈宇从第一句读起，读到第四页还把纸举起来给大家看了一下，大家都笑了。那张纸有一道新折痕，但字还能看清。他把纸按在桌上，说这里先别翻，让我把这句读完。我接着读自己的下一句，才发现刚才顾着找袋子，把开头的词忘了。陈宇说这回纸没丢，倒是台词丢了。我让他从前一句再来，两个人又试了一遍，这次总算接上。
pinyin: pái liàn kāi shǐ shí , chén yǔ cóng dì yī jù dú qǐ , dú dào dì sì yè hái bǎ zhǐ jǔ qǐ lái gěi dà jiā kàn le yī xià , dà jiā dōu xiào le . nà zhāng zhǐ yǒu yī dào xīn zhé hén , dàn zì hái néng kàn qīng . tā bǎ zhǐ àn zài zhuō shàng , shuō zhè lǐ xiān bié fān , ràng wǒ bǎ zhè jù dú wán . wǒ jiē zhe dú zì jǐ de xià yī jù , cái fā xiàn gāng cái gù zhe zhǎo dài zi , bǎ kāi tóu de cí wàng le . chén yǔ shuō zhè huí zhǐ méi diū , dǎo shì tái cí diū le . wǒ ràng tā cóng qián yī jù zài lái , liǎng gè rén yòu shì le yī biàn , zhè cì zǒng suàn jiē shàng .
meaning: Chen Yu began at the first line and held page four up for everyone to see when he reached it, making everyone laugh. Its new crease didn't obscure the words. Holding it against the table, he asked me not to turn it until he'd finished the line. I tried my next line and realised I'd forgotten its opening while searching for the bag. The paper was safe this time, he joked, but we'd lost the dialogue. I asked him to repeat the previous line; on the second attempt we finally joined it up.

text: 晚上一个没来活动的朋友发消息，问怎么群里找了一上午袋子。我回他说周五我借回家，周六把空袋子还到门边；陈宇后来放进去五页稿子，去搬桌子时，志愿者又把袋子和纸箱搬上二楼。我们在楼道找到第四页，在仓库找到其余四页，已经排完了。他问纸还能不能用，我拍了一张照片发过去，折痕还在，字也看得清。陈宇在旁边补了一句，下次直接带副本，原稿留家里。
pinyin: wǎn shang yī gè méi lái huó dòng de péng you fā xiāo xī , wèn zěn me qún lǐ zhǎo le yī shàng wǔ dài zi . wǒ huí tā shuō zhōu wǔ wǒ jiè huí jiā , zhōu liù bǎ kōng dài zi huán dào mén biān ; chén yǔ hòu lái fàng jìn qù wǔ yè gǎo zi , qù bān zhuō zi shí , zhì yuàn zhě yòu bǎ dài zi hé zhǐ xiāng bān shàng èr lóu . wǒ men zài lóu dào zhǎo dào dì sì yè , zài cāng kù zhǎo dào qí yú sì yè , yǐ jīng pái wán le . tā wèn zhǐ hái néng bù néng yòng , wǒ pāi le yī zhāng zhào piān fā guò qù , zhé hén hái zài , zì yě kàn de qīng . chén yǔ zài páng biān bǔ le yī jù , xià cì zhí jiē dài fù běn , yuán gǎo liú jiā lǐ .
meaning: That evening an absent friend asked why the group had spent the morning looking for a bag. I messaged back: I'd borrowed it Friday and returned it empty Saturday; Chen Yu had added five script pages, then gone to move tables while a volunteer took the bag and boxes upstairs. We found page four in the corridor and the other four in the storeroom, and had finished rehearsing. Were the pages usable? I sent a photo showing the crease and legible words. Chen Yu added that he'd bring copies next time and leave the originals at home.

text: 周五晚上我借了陈宇的蓝袋子，带几本书回家。周六上午到了换书活动，我先把书拿出来，再把空袋子放在一楼门右边，准备等他来搬东西时交还。门的两侧都堆着箱子，我把袋子往里挪了一点，免得挡住入口。我想发个消息，手里又有人递来一本书，问放哪儿。我转头帮他找桌子，就把消息忘了。等陈宇来了，我也没有再过去指给他看。陈宇来了以后先把蓝袋子找到，放进去五页新稿子，接着去搬桌子。我当时在活动桌旁帮人找书，只看到他从门口走过，没有看到他放纸。后来他问袋子在哪，我还说不是在你手里吗。他伸出两只空手给我看，又指向刚搬完的桌子。我这才想起来，早上还的时候是空袋子，他现在找的却已经装了今天要排的新段落。我们先问门口几个人，有人说不用的东西都到地下室去了。我正要过去，陈宇问他有没有见到蓝袋子。那个人说没有，只是以前活动常放在那里。我停下来给负责场地的人打电话，他说今天地下室没有开，先找楼上。陈宇已经走到楼道，叫我过去看，一张稿纸掉在地上，页码正好是四，上面还有他刚改过的字。陈宇把第四页拿起来，指着最后一行给我看，说这一句昨晚才改。我问是不是他搬桌子时掉的，他摇头，说搬的是桌子，稿子早就放进袋里了。我让他先拿好这张，自己回门口问负责收东西的人。刚走到门边，就听见志愿者说蓝袋子也搬上去了。陈宇跟在后面，一听二楼两个字就跑了过来，问仓库的门现在开着没有。负责门口的志愿者说，他把蓝袋子和两只纸箱一起搬到二楼仓库了。门口越来越满，有人推着椅子过不去，他就先把这些东西移开，以为袋子也是活动待用的。他还记得上楼时有纸露在袋口。我问里面是不是放书，他说没打开看，放到纸箱旁就下来了。陈宇举起手里的第四页，问能不能带我们上去，志愿者马上放下正在整理的书，领我们往楼梯走。我们沿着楼道上去，仓库里正有人收椅子。管理员把门开大一点，让我们从旁边进去。蓝袋子就在靠墙的纸箱旁，陈宇拿起来，先把稿子放到空桌上。里面还有四张，他一张一张排开，一、二、三、五都在。我把楼道那张递过去，他放进三和五中间，又从第一句读到新改的那一句。听见第四页接上了，我才敢把手里的袋子放下，问他这回能排练了吧。志愿者说抱歉，刚才应该先问一句。陈宇说找到了就好，下次自己把袋口拉好。我也拿出手机，把蓝袋子已找到发到群里，免得大家还往别处跑。门口仍然有人搬书，志愿者指着另一张桌子，问个人东西放那边行不行。我说行，帮他把桌上的活动资料移开，再贴上一张写着个人物品的纸。陈宇拿着稿子过来，笑说现在先别把这五张也当成交换的书。我们把个人袋子移到另一张桌子，贴了说明，再向还在找的人说已经找到了。有位朋友说我就知道没丢，我笑说刚才我们可不知道。他拿起水杯，问还用不用去地下室，我赶紧说不用了，也在群里补了一句。楼下的朋友回复，幸好看见消息，要不就白跑一趟。管理员让我们把蓝袋子带走，桌上只留下场馆的东西。陈宇收好五页稿子，说明天交给演出的人，今晚先不再挪地方。排练开始时，陈宇从第一句读起，读到第四页还把纸举起来给大家看了一下，大家都笑了。那张纸有一道新折痕，但字还能看清。他把纸按在桌上，说这里先别翻，让我把这句读完。我接着读自己的下一句，才发现刚才顾着找袋子，把开头的词忘了。陈宇说这回纸没丢，倒是台词丢了。我让他从前一句再来，两个人又试了一遍，这次总算接上。晚上一个没来活动的朋友发消息，问怎么群里找了一上午袋子。我回他说周五我借回家，周六把空袋子还到门边；陈宇后来放进去五页稿子，去搬桌子时，志愿者又把袋子和纸箱搬上二楼。我们在楼道找到第四页，在仓库找到其余四页，已经排完了。他问纸还能不能用，我拍了一张照片发过去，折痕还在，字也看得清。陈宇在旁边补了一句，下次直接带副本，原稿留家里。

liǎng gè rén yòu shì le yī biàn , zhè cì zǒng suàn jiē shàng . wǎn shang yī gè méi lái huó dòng de péng you fā xiāo xī , wèn zěn me qún lǐ zhǎo le yī shàng wǔ dài zi . wǒ huí tā shuō zhōu wǔ wǒ jiè meaning: I borrowed Chen Yu's blue bag on Friday to take some books home. At Saturday's book exchange I removed the books and put the empty bag to the right of the downstairs entrance, ready to return it when he arrived. Boxes lined both sides, so I moved it further in to keep the doorway clear. I meant to message him, but someone handed me a book and asked where it went. Helping them find a table, I forgot the message. When Chen Yu arrived, I didn't go back to show him either. Chen Yu found the blue bag, put five new manuscript pages inside and went to move tables. I was helping someone find a book and saw him pass, not insert the pages. Asked where the bag was, I thought he had it. He held out empty hands and pointed at the tables he'd moved. The bag I'd returned empty now held today's new rehearsal section. Someone near the entrance suggested the basement, where things had gone at previous events. Before I went, Chen asked if he'd seen the blue bag. He hadn't. The venue contact told me the basement was closed today and suggested upstairs. Chen called from the corridor: a page lay on the floor, numbered four, with his latest corrections on it. Chen Yu picked up page four and pointed to its last line, which he'd revised the night before. Had he dropped it while moving tables? No: he'd been carrying a table, with the pages already in the bag. I asked him to keep the sheet while I went back to the entrance. A volunteer said the blue bag had gone upstairs too. Hearing 'second floor,' Chen Yu hurried over to ask whether the storeroom was open. The entrance volunteer had moved the blue bag and two boxes to the upstairs storeroom. Someone pushing chairs couldn't get through the crowded doorway, so he'd cleared what he assumed was event equipment. He remembered paper sticking out of the bag. Had it contained books? He hadn't opened it; he'd set it beside the boxes and come back down. Chen Yu held up page four and asked to be taken upstairs. The volunteer put down the books he was sorting and led us to the stairs. Upstairs, someone was putting chairs away. The manager opened the door wider to let us through. Chen Yu found the blue bag beside the boxes and laid its four remaining sheets on an empty table: one, two, three and five. I handed over the corridor sheet; he put it between three and five and read through to his new line. Only when page four fitted did I put down the bag and ask whether we could finally rehearse. The volunteer apologised for not asking before moving it. Chen Yu was glad we'd found it and would close the bag properly next time. I messaged the group so nobody kept searching elsewhere. With books still passing through the entrance, the volunteer suggested another table for personal belongings. I helped clear the event handouts and label it. Arriving with the manuscript, Chen Yu joked that these five sheets weren't exchange books either. We moved the personal bags to another table, labelled them and told the searchers we had found the bag. A friend said he had known it was not lost; I laughed that we certainly had not known that earlier. He asked whether he still needed to check the basement. I quickly said no and updated the group. A friend downstairs was glad to see the message before making a wasted trip. The manager asked us to take the blue bag away and leave only venue equipment on the table. Chen Yu put all five pages together. He would hand them to the performers tomorrow; tonight they would stay put. Chen Yu began at the first line and held page four up for everyone to see when he reached it, making everyone laugh. Its new crease didn't obscure the words. Holding it against the table, he asked me not to turn it until he'd finished the line. I tried my next line and realised I'd forgotten its opening while searching for the bag. The paper was safe this time, he joked, but we'd lost the dialogue. I asked him to repeat the previous line; on the second attempt we finally joined it up. That evening an absent friend asked why the group had spent the morning looking for a bag. I messaged back: I'd borrowed it Friday and returned it empty Saturday; Chen Yu had added five script pages, then gone to move tables while a volunteer took the bag and boxes upstairs. We found page four in the corridor and the other four in the storeroom, and had finished rehearsing. Were the pages usable? I sent a photo showing the crease and legible words. Chen Yu added that he'd bring copies next time and leave the originals at home.

我们沿着楼道上去，仓库里正有人收椅子。管理员把门开大一点，让我们从旁边进去。蓝袋子就在靠墙的纸箱旁，陈宇拿起来，先把稿子放到空桌上。里面还有四张，他一张一张排开，一、二、三、五都在。我把楼道那张递过去，他放进三和五中间，又从第一句读到新改的那一句。听见第四页接上了，我才敢把手里的袋子放下，问他这回能排练了吧。
志愿者说抱歉，刚才应该先问一句。陈宇说找到了就好，下次自己把袋口拉好。我也拿出手机，把蓝袋子已找到发到群里，免得大家还往别处跑。门口仍然有人搬书，志愿者指着另一张桌子，问个人东西放那边行不行。我说行，帮他把桌上的活动资料移开，再贴上一张写着个人物品的纸。陈宇拿着稿子过来，笑说现在先别把这五张也当成交换的书。
我们把个人袋子移到另一张桌子，贴了说明，再向还在找的人说已经找到了。有位朋友说我就知道没丢，我笑说刚才我们可不知道。他拿起水杯，问还用不用去地下室，我赶紧说不用了，也在群里补了一句。楼下的朋友回复，幸好看见消息，要不就白跑一趟。管理员让我们把蓝袋子带走，桌上只留下场馆的东西。陈宇收好五页稿子，说明天交给演出的人，今晚先不再挪地方。
排练开始时，陈宇从第一句读起，读到第四页还把纸举起来给大家看了一下，大家都笑了。那张纸有一道新折痕，但字还能看清。他把纸按在桌上，说这里先别翻，让我把这句读完。我接着读自己的下一句，才发现刚才顾着找袋子，把开头的词忘了。陈宇说这回纸没丢，倒是台词丢了。我让他从前一句再来，两个人又试了一遍，这次总算接上。
晚上一个没来活动的朋友发消息，问怎么群里找了一上午袋子。我回他说周五我借回家，周六把空袋子还到门边；陈宇后来放进去五页稿子，去搬桌子时，志愿者又把袋子和纸箱搬上二楼。我们在楼道找到第四页，在仓库找到其余四页，已经排完了。他问纸还能不能用，我拍了一张照片发过去，折痕还在，字也看得清。陈宇在旁边补了一句，下次直接带副本，原稿留家里。

text: 你不是说那张纸一直在包里吗？

text: 我是说我放进去的时候在。
pinyin: wǒ shì shuō wǒ fàng jìn qù de shí hou zài .

text: 后面呢？

text: 后面我去搬桌子，没一直看着。

text: 所以不是一直，是那时候。

text: 对。刚才急了，把一刻说成一上午。

text: 那现在袋子谁拿？

text: 我拿，直到排练结束。

text: 这句能记下来。

pinyin: bié bǎ zàn shí méi huí fù dàng chéng zuì hòu jù jué .
meaning: Don’t treat a temporary lack of reply as a final refusal.

text: 当天的安排临时改了。
pinyin: dàng tiān de ān pái lín shí gǎi le .
meaning: The plan changed at short notice that day.

text: 她去仓库找多余的椅子。
pinyin: tā qù cāng kù zhǎo duō yú de yǐ zi .
meaning: She went to the storeroom for extra chairs.

text: 地下室里放着旧桌子。
pinyin: dì xià shì lǐ fàng zhe jiù zhuō zi .
meaning: Old tables are kept in the basement.

text: 请别在楼道里放太多东西。
pinyin: qǐng bié zài lóu dào lǐ fàng tài duō dōng xi .
meaning: Please don’t leave too much in the corridor.

text: 新楼房旁边有一条小路。
pinyin: xīn lóu fáng páng biān yǒu yī tiáo xiǎo lù .
meaning: There is a small path beside the new building.

text: 他把物品列成一张表。
pinyin: tā bǎ wù pǐn liè chéng yī zhāng biǎo .
meaning: He made a list of the items.

text: 她去门口领取资料。
pinyin: tā qù mén kǒu lǐng qǔ zī liào .
meaning: She went to collect materials at the door.

text: 请别把那张还没改完的纸拿走。
pinyin: qǐng bié bǎ nà zhāng hái méi gǎi wán de zhǐ ná zǒu .
meaning: Please don’t take away the unfinished page.

text: 他把资料储存在自己的电脑里。
pinyin: tā bǎ zī liào chǔ cún zài zì jǐ de diàn nǎo lǐ .
meaning: He stores the materials on his own computer.

text: 她帮同事看管设备。
pinyin: tā bāng tóng shì kān guǎn shè bèi .
meaning: She watches the equipment for a colleague.

text: 她收藏了几张老节目单。
pinyin: tā shōu cáng le jǐ zhāng lǎo jié mù dān .
meaning: She kept a few old programmes in her collection.

text: 这个场馆周日才开放。
pinyin: zhè gè chǎng guǎn zhōu rì cái kāi fàng .
meaning: This venue only opens on Sunday.

text: 这次演奏换了场地。
pinyin: zhè cì yǎn zòu huàn le chǎng dì .
meaning: This performance has changed location.

text: 她前来确认活动时间。
pinyin: tā qián lái què rèn huó dòng shí jiān .
meaning: She came to confirm the event time.

text: 他路过门口时听见音乐。
pinyin: tā lù guò mén kǒu shí tīng jiàn yīn yuè .
meaning: He heard music while passing the entrance.

text: 他们沿着河边走。
pinyin: tā men yán zhe hé biān zǒu .
meaning: They walk along the river.

text: 通道两侧放着椅子。
pinyin: tōng dào liǎng cè fàng zhe yǐ zi .
meaning: Chairs stand on both sides of the passage.

text: 前方那栋楼就是我们要去的。
pinyin: qián fāng nà dòng lóu jiù shì wǒ men yào qù de .
meaning: The building ahead is our destination.

text: 此处暂时不能进入。
pinyin: cǐ chù zàn shí bù néng jìn rù .
meaning: This area is temporarily closed to entry.

text: 此前活动一直在小厅。
pinyin: cǐ qián huó dòng yì zhí zài xiǎo tīng .
meaning: Previously the event was always in the small hall.

text: 他事后才听说时间改了。
pinyin: tā shì hòu cái tīng shuō shí jiān gǎi le .
meaning: Only afterwards did he hear that the time had changed.

text: 他把这次尝试当作练习。
pinyin: tā bǎ zhè cì cháng shì dàng zuò liàn xí .
meaning: He treats this attempt as practice.

text: 今天恰好没有别的安排。
pinyin: jīn tiān qià hǎo méi yǒu bié de ān pái .
meaning: Today happens to have no other plans.

text: 她特地来听最后一场。
pinyin: tā tè dì lái tīng zuì hòu yī chǎng .
meaning: She came specially for the final performance.

text: 现在不便通话，抱歉。
pinyin: xiàn zài bù biàn tōng huà , bào qiàn .
meaning: Sorry, a call is inconvenient now.

text: 她先道歉，再说明自己的安排。
pinyin: tā xiān dào qiàn , zài shuō míng zì jǐ de ān pái .
meaning: She apologised first, then explained her arrangement.

text: 负责人通报了新的地点。
pinyin: fù zé rén tōng bào le xīn de dì diǎn .
meaning: The organiser announced the new location.

text: 这个消息从小组里传出去了。
pinyin: zhè gè xiāo xī cóng xiǎo zǔ lǐ chuán chū qù le .
meaning: This news spread outside the group.

text: 她回应了关于时间的问题。
pinyin: tā huí yìng le guān yú shí jiān de wèn tí .
meaning: She answered the timing question.

text: 他们还在追究记录出错的原因。
pinyin: tā men hái zài zhuī jiū jì lù chū cuò de yuán yīn .
meaning: They are still investigating the cause of the recording error.

text: 讨论涉及三个不同的安排。
pinyin: tǎo lùn shè jí sān gè bù tóng de ān pái .
meaning: The discussion concerns three different arrangements.

zuò liàn xí . tā qià hǎo kàn jiàn wǒ fàng zhǐ , zhī dào dài zi nà shí hái zài . jīn tiān qià hǎo méi yǒu bié de ān pái . wǒ tè dì dài lái yuán gǎo , xiǎng qǐng dà jiā pái liàn . tā tè dì lái tīng zuì hòu yī chǎng . bào qiàn , wǒ yǐ wéi zhè gè yě shì huó dòng de dōng xi . xiàn zài bù biàn tōng huà , bào qiàn . wǒ wèi méi yǒu wèn jiù bān zǒu dào qiàn . tā xiān dào qiàn , zài shuō míng zì jǐ de ān pái . wǒ men xiàng zài zhǎo dài zi de rén tōng bào yǐ jīng zhǎo dào . fù zé rén tōng bào le xīn de dì diǎn . cāng kù lǐ chuán chū bān yǐ zi de shēng yīn . zhè gè xiāo xī cóng xiǎo zǔ lǐ chuán chū qù le . zhì yuàn zhě huí yìng shuō dài zi shì tā bān shàng qù de . tā huí yìng le guān yú shí jiān de wèn tí . xiān bǎ jīng guò wèn qīng , bù jí zhe zhuī jiū shéi gù yì zuò le shén me . tā men hái zài zhuī jiū jì lù chū cuò de yuán yīn . zhè gè wù huì shè jí fàng de wèi zhì hé bān de rén , bù zhǐ shè jí yán sè . tǎo lùn shè jí sān gè bù tóng de ān pái .
meaning: He took a personal bag for an exchange-event item. Don’t treat a temporary lack of reply as a final refusal. That day I returned the bag before Chen Yu put pages into it. The plan changed at short notice that day. The bag is in the upstairs storeroom, not on the event table. She went to the storeroom for extra chairs. Someone suggested the basement, but we hadn’t moved items there. Old tables are kept in the basement. I saw a loose sheet in the corridor. Please don’t leave too much in the corridor. This two-storey building hosts the event downstairs. There is a small path beside the new building. Keep personal belongings separate from exchangeable books. He made a list of the items. Collect books in the hall, not from private belongings. She went to collect materials at the door. The bag was taken away, not necessarily out of the building. Please don’t take away the unfinished page. The upper floor stores tables and chairs for events. He stores the materials on his own computer. Watching personal bags isn’t a duty the volunteer has agreed to. She watches the equipment for a colleague. I want to keep the pages, not place them among books for exchange. She kept a few old programmes in her collection. The venue manager knows the storeroom, not every bag’s movements. This venue only opens on Sunday. The venue is crowded, so we move unneeded things aside. This performance has changed location. More people came to exchange books, so the entrance needed clearing. She came to confirm the event time. I only passed the corridor and don’t know who carried the bag upstairs. He heard music while passing the entrance. Follow the corridor to its end for the storeroom. They walk along the river. Boxes stand on both sides of the door; I put the bag on the right. Chairs stand on both sides of the passage. They are moving a table ahead, so we wait. The building ahead is our destination. The note says personal items go here; the location later changes. This area is temporarily closed to entry. Before this I only knew the bag had been returned. Previously the event was always in the small hall. Afterwards we reconstructed each step together. Only afterwards did he hear that the time had changed. I wrongly treated the bag’s colour as proof of its location. He treats this attempt as practice. She happened to see me insert the pages and knew the bag was there then. Today happens to have no other plans. I specially brought the original pages for rehearsal. She came specially for the final performance. Sorry, I thought this belonged to the event too. Sorry, a call is inconvenient now. I apologise for moving it without asking. She apologised first, then explained her arrangement. We told the people searching that the bag was found. The organiser announced the new location. The sound of moving chairs came from the storeroom. This news spread outside the group. The volunteer responded that he had moved the bag upstairs. She answered the timing question. Clarify the events before pursuing claims of deliberate acts. They are still investigating the cause of the recording error. The confusion concerns placement and the mover, not only colour. The discussion concerns three different arrangements.

别把暂时没回复当成最后拒绝。
当天我先还袋子，后来陈宇才放进稿子。
当天的安排临时改了。
袋子在二楼仓库，不在活动桌上。
她去仓库找多余的椅子。
有人说找地下室，可我们没有把东西搬到那里。
地下室里放着旧桌子。
我在楼道里看到一张掉出来的纸。
请别在楼道里放太多东西。
这座楼房有两层，活动在一楼。
新楼房旁边有一条小路。
个人物品和可交换的书要分开放。
他把物品列成一张表。
领书在大厅，不能到私人物品里随便领取。
她去门口领取资料。
袋子被拿走了，不说明一定离开了楼房。
请别把那张还没改完的纸拿走。
二楼储存的是活动用的桌椅。
他把资料储存在自己的电脑里。
看管个人袋子不是志愿者已经答应的工作。
她帮同事看管设备。
我想收藏稿子，不是把它放进交换的书里。
她收藏了几张老节目单。
场馆管理员知道仓库在哪，但没看见每个袋子。
这个场馆周日才开放。
场地太满，我们把不用的东西先移开。
这次演奏换了场地。
前来换书的人越来越多，门口需要留空。
她前来确认活动时间。
我只是路过楼道，不知道谁拿着袋子上楼。
他路过门口时听见音乐。
沿着楼道走到尽头，就是仓库。
他们沿着河边走。
门的两侧都有箱子，我把袋子放到右边。
通道两侧放着椅子。
前方正在搬桌子，我们先等一下。
前方那栋楼就是我们要去的。
纸条写此处放个人物品，后来位置变了。
此处暂时不能进入。
此前我只知道袋子还回来了。
此前活动一直在小厅。
事后我们一起补清了每一步。
他事后才听说时间改了。
我把袋子的颜色当作位置的证明，记错了。
他把这次尝试当作练习。
她恰好看见我放纸，知道袋子那时还在。
今天恰好没有别的安排。
我特地带来原稿，想请大家排练。
她特地来听最后一场。
抱歉，我以为这个也是活动的东西。
现在不便通话，抱歉。
我为没有问就搬走道歉。

我们向在找袋子的人通报已经找到。
负责人通报了新的地点。
仓库里传出搬椅子的声音。

志愿者回应说袋子是他搬上去的。
她回应了关于时间的问题。
先把经过问清，不急着追究谁故意做了什么。
他们还在追究记录出错的原因。

讨论涉及三个不同的安排。

text: 我特地带五页新稿子来换书活动，想结束以后请大家排一次。到门口看见自己的蓝袋子，我很自然地把纸放进去，觉得比一直拿在手里方便。门边箱子很多，我知道有人在搬，却没有问蓝袋子会不会也被移走。放好以后我去帮忙搬桌子，回头准备排练时才发现原来的地方空了。那一刻我想起袋子昨晚借给林安，先问她还了没有。
pinyin: wǒ tè dì dài wǔ yè xīn gǎo zi lái huàn shū huó dòng , xiǎng jié shù yǐ hòu qǐng dà jiā pái yī cì . dào mén kǒu kàn jiàn zì jǐ de lán dài zi , wǒ hěn zì rán de bǎ zhǐ fàng jìn qù , jué de bǐ yì zhí ná zài shǒu lǐ fāng biàn . mén biān xiāng zi hěn duō , wǒ zhī dào yǒu rén zài bān , què méi yǒu wèn lán dài zi huì bù huì yě bèi yí zǒu . fàng hǎo yǐ hòu wǒ qù bāng máng bān zhuō zi , huí tóu zhǔn bèi pái liàn shí cái fā xiàn yuán lái de dì fāng kōng le . nà yī kè wǒ xiǎng qǐ dài zi zuó wǎn jiè gěi lín ān , xiān wèn tā huán le méi yǒu .
meaning: I brought five pages for later rehearsal, found my returned bag and put them in without asking about relocation. After table moving I found the space empty and first asked the borrower about returning it.

text: 林安说早上把空袋子放到门右边。我听见空就急了，问怎么会空，我明明放进去五张。她让我先听完，说空是早上还的时候，那时我还没到。我这才想起自己来了以后打开过袋子，里面确实没有书，正好放稿子。她问放完以后呢，我说去搬桌子了。桌子太重，刚才两个人抬了半天，等我再回来，原来的位置只剩两只空箱子。
pinyin: lín ān shuō zǎo shàng bǎ kōng dài zi fàng dào mén yòu biān . wǒ tīng jiàn kōng jiù jí le , wèn zěn me huì kōng , wǒ míng míng fàng jìn qù wǔ zhāng . tā ràng wǒ xiān tīng wán , shuō kōng shì zǎo shàng huán de shí hou , nà shí wǒ hái méi dào . wǒ zhè cái xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ lái le yǐ hòu dǎ kāi guò dài zi , lǐ miàn què shí méi yǒu shū , zhèng hǎo fàng gǎo zi . tā wèn fàng wán yǐ hòu ne , wǒ shuō qù bān zhuō zi le . zhuō zi tài zhòng , gāng cái liǎng gè rén tái le bàn tiān , děng wǒ zài huí lái , yuán lái de wèi zhì zhǐ shèng liǎng zhǐ kōng xiāng zi .
meaning: Lin An said she'd left the empty bag to the right of the entrance. Empty? I'd put five pages in it! Let her finish, she said: it had been empty when she returned it, before I'd arrived. Then I remembered opening it myself and finding no books, leaving room for my manuscript. What had I done afterwards? Moved tables. The table was heavy and had taken two of us a while; by the time I returned, only two empty boxes remained at the spot.

text: 有人说东西都搬到地下室了，我已经转身往楼梯走。林安叫住我，让我先问有没有见到蓝袋子。那个人想了一下，说只是记得上次活动放在那里，今天没有看见。我只好折回来，去问门口的志愿者。他正忙着搬书，让我等一下。我站到旁边，往楼道里看，一张纸躺在地上。林安走过去捡起来，我一看页码，正好是刚才还在找的第四页。
pinyin: yǒu rén shuō dōng xi dōu bān dào dì xià shì le , wǒ yǐ jīng zhuǎn shēn wǎng lóu tī zǒu . lín ān jiào zhù wǒ , ràng wǒ xiān wèn yǒu méi yǒu jiàn dào lán dài zi . nà gè rén xiǎng le yī xià , shuō zhǐ shì jì de shàng cì huó dòng fàng zài nà lǐ , jīn tiān méi yǒu kàn jiàn . wǒ zhǐ hǎo zhé huí lái , qù wèn mén kǒu de zhì yuàn zhě . tā zhèng máng zhe bān shū , ràng wǒ děng yī xià . wǒ zhàn dào páng biān , wǎng lóu dào lǐ kàn , yī zhāng zhǐ tǎng zài dì shang . lín ān zǒu guò qù jiǎn qǐ lái , wǒ yī kàn yè mǎ , zhèng hǎo shì gāng cái hái zài zhǎo de dì sì yè .
meaning: Someone said things had gone to the basement, and I was already heading for the stairs when Lin An called me back to ask whether they'd seen the bag. No; they only remembered the previous event. I returned to the entrance volunteer, who was busy moving books and asked me to wait. Looking down the corridor, I spotted a sheet on the floor. Lin An picked it up. Its number was four—the page I'd been looking for.

text: 我拿着第四页，说稿子不是一直在袋里吗。林安问后来也看着吗，我摇头，改口说放进去时还在，后来我去搬桌子了。她指着门边，让我想想袋口有没有拉好。我记得拿纸时两只手都忙，就那么放了进去，接着有人叫我搬桌子。看着手里折过的纸，我越来越想快点找到另外四张。志愿者这时走过来，问是不是在找那个蓝袋子，我赶紧说对。
pinyin: wǒ ná zhe dì sì yè , shuō gǎo zi bù shì yì zhí zài dài lǐ ma . lín ān wèn hòu lái yě kàn zhe ma , wǒ yáo tóu , gǎi kǒu shuō fàng jìn qù shí hái zài , hòu lái wǒ qù bān zhuō zi le . tā zhǐ zhe mén biān , ràng wǒ xiǎng xiǎng dài kǒu yǒu méi yǒu lā hǎo . wǒ jì de ná zhǐ shí liǎng zhǐ shǒu dōu máng , jiù nà me fàng le jìn qù , jiē zhe yǒu rén jiào wǒ bān zhuō zi . kàn zhuó shǒu lǐ zhé guò de zhǐ , wǒ yuè lái yuè xiǎng kuài diǎn zhǎo dào lìng wài sì zhāng . zhì yuàn zhě zhè shí zǒu guò lái , wèn shì bú shì zài zhǎo nà gè lán dài zi , wǒ gǎn jǐn shuō duì .
meaning: Holding page four, I asked whether the pages hadn't been in the bag the whole time. Had I watched afterwards? No—I corrected myself: they'd been there when I put them in, then I'd moved tables. Lin An asked if I'd closed the bag. Both hands had been busy with the sheets, and someone had called me away. Looking at the folded paper, I wanted to find the other four quickly. Then the volunteer came over: were we looking for the blue bag? Yes, I said at once.

text: 志愿者说搬到二楼时，我终于松口气。他以为袋子也是活动物品，和两只纸箱一起搬走，好让入口空出来。他说纸露在袋口，我想起自己放完以后没有拉好，就请他带我们上去。楼梯那边已经堆了几箱书，我们侧着身走过，找到最里面的蓝袋子。我先打开看，林安拿着楼道捡到的那张纸站在旁边，等我把页码排好。
pinyin: zhì yuàn zhě shuō bān dào èr lóu shí , wǒ zhōng yú sōng kǒu qì . tā yǐ wéi dài zi yě shì huó dòng wù pǐn , hé liǎng zhǐ zhǐ xiāng yì qǐ bān zǒu , hǎo ràng rù kǒu kōng chū lái . tā shuō zhǐ lù zài dài kǒu , wǒ xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ fàng wán yǐ hòu méi yǒu lā hǎo , jiù qǐng tā dài wǒ men shàng qù . lóu tī nà biān yǐ jīng duī le jǐ xiāng shū , wǒ men cè zhe shēn zǒu guò , zhǎo dào zuì lǐ miàn de lán dài zi . wǒ xiān dǎ kāi kàn , lín ān ná zhe lóu dào jiǎn dào de nà zhāng zhǐ zhàn zài páng biān , děng wǒ bǎ yè mǎ pái hǎo .
meaning: The volunteer said he'd moved it upstairs with two boxes to clear the entrance. Paper had stuck out; I remembered not closing the bag. We followed him past boxes of books on the stairs to the blue bag at the back. I opened it while Lin An held the page found in the corridor, waiting for me to order the pages.

text: 袋子里只有四张，我又紧张起来，把一到三放在一起，再找到第五页。林安递来楼道那张，正好是四，新的那一段总算连上了。纸上多了一道折痕，我把它放在桌边慢慢压平，还是有点心疼原稿。志愿者问还能不能读，我说能，都找齐了，先拿去排练吧，晚上回家再把这张夹进书里。
pinyin: dài zi lǐ zhǐ yǒu sì zhāng , wǒ yòu jǐn zhāng qǐ lái , bǎ yī dào sān fàng zài yì qǐ , zài zhǎo dào dì wǔ yè . lín ān dì lái lóu dào nà zhāng , zhèng hǎo shì sì , xīn de nà yī duàn zǒng suàn lián shàng le . zhǐ shàng duō le yī dào zhé hén , wǒ bǎ tā fàng zài zhuō biān màn màn yā píng , hái shi yǒu diǎn xīn téng yuán gǎo . zhì yuàn zhě wèn hái néng bù néng dú , wǒ shuō néng , dōu zhǎo qí le , xiān ná qù pái liàn ba , wǎn shang huí jiā zài bǎ zhè zhāng jiā jìn shū lǐ .
meaning: There were only four pages in the bag. I found one to three and five, then Lin An handed me four from the corridor; the new section was complete. I pressed a fresh crease flat against the table, still disappointed about the original. Was it readable? Yes, everything was there. We'd rehearse now, and I'd press it inside a book at home later.

text: 我们跟志愿者一起把个人东西挪到另一张桌子，林安贴了说明。我把蓝袋子提起来给他看，问下次能不能先留在这边。他说可以，不过结束以后记得拿走，晚上还要收桌子。林安笑着说这回看见了，已经不在门边了。我让她先拿袋子，自己把稿子收成一叠。管理员在旁边叫我们再腾出一点地方，刚收好的椅子还要搬过来，我们又往里站了一点。
pinyin: wǒ men gēn zhì yuàn zhě yì qǐ bǎ gè rén dōng xi nuó dào lìng yī zhāng zhuō zi , lín ān tiē le shuō míng . wǒ bǎ lán dài zi tí qǐ lái gěi tā kàn , wèn xià cì néng bù néng xiān liú zài zhè biān . tā shuō kě yǐ , bù guò jié shù yǐ hòu jì de ná zǒu , wǎn shang hái yào shōu zhuō zi . lín ān xiào zhe shuō zhè huí kàn jiàn le , yǐ jīng bù zài mén biān le . wǒ ràng tā xiān ná dài zi , zì jǐ bǎ gǎo zi shōu chéng yī dié . guǎn lǐ yuán zài páng biān jiào wǒ men zài téng chū yī diǎn dì fāng , gāng shōu hǎo de yǐ zi hái yào bān guò lái , wǒ men yòu wǎng lǐ zhàn le yī diǎn .
meaning: We moved the personal belongings to another table and Lin An labelled it. I asked the volunteer if the blue bag could stay there next time. Yes, but take it home afterwards; the tables would be cleared at night. Lin An laughed: she'd seen this move, and it was no longer by the door. She held the bag while I gathered the manuscript into a stack. The manager needed room for the chairs he'd just put away, so we moved further inside.

text: 排练前林安说这次袋子我拿，桌子你搬，大家都笑了。我说好，不过伞还是你自己拿。她看了一眼靠门的伞，说伞没动过，你先把桌子搬好。我把桌子推到灯旁，稿子放在上面，等大家坐下才拿起来读。排练结束以后，我把五页都收进自己的背包，林安把空蓝袋子还给我。我拉上两只包的口，她在旁边看着，笑说现在终于能走了吧。
pinyin: pái liàn qián lín ān shuō zhè cì dài zi wǒ ná , zhuō zi nǐ bān , dà jiā dōu xiào le . wǒ shuō hǎo , bù guò sǎn hái shi nǐ zì jǐ ná . tā kàn le yī yǎn kào mén de sǎn , shuō sǎn méi dòng guò , nǐ xiān bǎ zhuō zi bān hǎo . wǒ bǎ zhuō zi tuī dào dēng páng , gǎo zi fàng zài shàng miàn , děng dà jiā zuò xià cái ná qǐ lái dú . pái liàn jié shù yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ wǔ yè dōu shōu jìn zì jǐ de bēi bāo , lín ān bǎ kōng lán dài zi huán gěi wǒ . wǒ lā shàng liǎng zhǐ bāo de kǒu , tā zài páng biān kàn zhe , xiào shuō xiàn zài zhōng yú néng zǒu le ba .
meaning: Before rehearsal Lin An said she'd hold the bag and I'd move the table. Everyone laughed. Fine, but she was carrying her own umbrella. It hadn't moved, she said; get the table into place first. I pushed it beside the lamp, put the manuscript on it and picked it up to read once everyone sat down. Afterwards I put all five pages in my backpack, and Lin An handed me the empty blue bag. As I closed both bags, she laughed: could we finally leave?

text: 晚饭时有人问，是不是有人拿走了我们的资料。我说是志愿者把袋子和箱子搬到楼上，不是带出楼房。他问怎么还有一张在楼道，我把第四页拿给他看，说可能上楼时从没拉好的袋口掉出来了，具体哪一下没看见。林安在旁边补充，她捡到时就在楼道地上。朋友摸了摸那道折痕，说还好没踩上。我说字都能看清，刚才已经拿它排完了，今晚回家再压一压。
pinyin: wǎn fàn shí yǒu rén wèn , shì bú shì yǒu rén ná zǒu le wǒ men de zī liào . wǒ shuō shì zhì yuàn zhě bǎ dài zi hé xiāng zi bān dào lóu shàng , bù shì dài chū lóu fáng . tā wèn zěn me hái yǒu yī zhāng zài lóu dào , wǒ bǎ dì sì yè ná gěi tā kàn , shuō kě néng shàng lóu shí cóng méi lā hǎo de dài kǒu diào chū lái le , jù tǐ nǎ yī xià méi kàn jiàn . lín ān zài páng biān bǔ chōng , tā jiǎn dào shí jiù zài lóu dào dì shang . péng you mō le mō nà dào zhé hén , shuō hái hǎo méi cǎi shàng . wǒ shuō zì dōu néng kàn qīng , gāng cái yǐ jīng ná tā pái wán le , jīn wǎn huí jiā zài yā yī yā .
meaning: At dinner someone asked if our materials had been taken away. The volunteer had moved the bag and boxes upstairs, I said, not out of the building. What about the sheet in the corridor? I showed page four; it might have fallen from the unclosed bag on the way up, though I hadn't seen the moment. Lin An said she'd found it on the corridor floor. Our friend touched the crease: lucky nobody stepped on it. The words were clear and we'd rehearsed with it; I'd press it flat at home.

text: 回家后我把第四页夹进一本厚书，其他四张放在桌上，准备明天一起交给演出的人。林安发消息问还心疼吗，我说一点点，毕竟是自己改了好多遍的原稿。她说下次带副本吧，我拿出手机把五页都拍下来，第二天打印一份，改把副本交给演出的人。原来的收在家里，活动带新印的。蓝袋子倒还可以借，她一问我就说行，不过这次还回来记得告诉我放哪儿，别让我再问一上午。
pinyin: huí jiā hòu wǒ bǎ dì sì yè jiā jìn yī běn hòu shū , qí tā sì zhāng fàng zài zhuō shàng , zhǔn bèi míng tiān yì qǐ jiāo gěi yǎn chū de rén . lín ān fā xiāo xī wèn hái xīn téng ma , wǒ shuō yì diǎn diǎn , bì jìng shì zì jǐ gǎi le hǎo duō biàn de yuán gǎo . tā shuō xià cì dài fù běn ba , wǒ ná chū shǒu jī bǎ wǔ yè dōu pāi xià lái , dì èr tiān dǎ yìn yī fèn , gǎi bǎ fù běn jiāo gěi yǎn chū de rén . yuán lái de shōu zài jiā lǐ , huó dòng dài xīn yìn de . lán dài zi dào hái kě yǐ jiè , tā yī wèn wǒ jiù shuō xíng , bù guò zhè cì huán huí lái jì de gào sù wǒ fàng nǎr , bié ràng wǒ zài wèn yī shàng wǔ .
meaning: At home I pressed page four inside a thick book, leaving the other sheets on the desk to hand to the performers tomorrow. Lin An asked if I was still upset. A little: I'd revised that original so many times. Bring copies next time, she said. I photographed all five and printed a set the next day to give the performers instead. I'd keep the originals at home and take the fresh copies to events. She could still borrow the blue bag—just tell me where she'd returned it, so I didn't spend another morning asking.

text: 我特地带五页新稿子来换书活动，想结束以后请大家排一次。到门口看见自己的蓝袋子，我很自然地把纸放进去，觉得比一直拿在手里方便。门边箱子很多，我知道有人在搬，却没有问蓝袋子会不会也被移走。放好以后我去帮忙搬桌子，回头准备排练时才发现原来的地方空了。那一刻我想起袋子昨晚借给林安，先问她还了没有。林安说早上把空袋子放到门右边。我听见空就急了，问怎么会空，我明明放进去五张。她让我先听完，说空是早上还的时候，那时我还没到。我这才想起自己来了以后打开过袋子，里面确实没有书，正好放稿子。她问放完以后呢，我说去搬桌子了。桌子太重，刚才两个人抬了半天，等我再回来，原来的位置只剩两只空箱子。有人说东西都搬到地下室了，我已经转身往楼梯走。林安叫住我，让我先问有没有见到蓝袋子。那个人想了一下，说只是记得上次活动放在那里，今天没有看见。我只好折回来，去问门口的志愿者。他正忙着搬书，让我等一下。我站到旁边，往楼道里看，一张纸躺在地上。林安走过去捡起来，我一看页码，正好是刚才还在找的第四页。我拿着第四页，说稿子不是一直在袋里吗。林安问后来也看着吗，我摇头，改口说放进去时还在，后来我去搬桌子了。她指着门边，让我想想袋口有没有拉好。我记得拿纸时两只手都忙，就那么放了进去，接着有人叫我搬桌子。看着手里折过的纸，我越来越想快点找到另外四张。志愿者这时走过来，问是不是在找那个蓝袋子，我赶紧说对。志愿者说搬到二楼时，我终于松口气。他以为袋子也是活动物品，和两只纸箱一起搬走，好让入口空出来。他说纸露在袋口，我想起自己放完以后没有拉好，就请他带我们上去。楼梯那边已经堆了几箱书，我们侧着身走过，找到最里面的蓝袋子。我先打开看，林安拿着楼道捡到的那张纸站在旁边，等我把页码排好。袋子里只有四张，我又紧张起来，把一到三放在一起，再找到第五页。林安递来楼道那张，正好是四，新的那一段总算连上了。纸上多了一道折痕，我把它放在桌边慢慢压平，还是有点心疼原稿。志愿者问还能不能读，我说能，都找齐了，先拿去排练吧，晚上回家再把这张夹进书里。我们跟志愿者一起把个人东西挪到另一张桌子，林安贴了说明。我把蓝袋子提起来给他看，问下次能不能先留在这边。他说可以，不过结束以后记得拿走，晚上还要收桌子。林安笑着说这回看见了，已经不在门边了。我让她先拿袋子，自己把稿子收成一叠。管理员在旁边叫我们再腾出一点地方，刚收好的椅子还要搬过来，我们又往里站了一点。排练前林安说这次袋子我拿，桌子你搬，大家都笑了。我说好，不过伞还是你自己拿。她看了一眼靠门的伞，说伞没动过，你先把桌子搬好。我把桌子推到灯旁，稿子放在上面，等大家坐下才拿起来读。排练结束以后，我把五页都收进自己的背包，林安把空蓝袋子还给我。我拉上两只包的口，她在旁边看着，笑说现在终于能走了吧。晚饭时有人问，是不是有人拿走了我们的资料。我说是志愿者把袋子和箱子搬到楼上，不是带出楼房。他问怎么还有一张在楼道，我把第四页拿给他看，说可能上楼时从没拉好的袋口掉出来了，具体哪一下没看见。林安在旁边补充，她捡到时就在楼道地上。朋友摸了摸那道折痕，说还好没踩上。我说字都能看清，刚才已经拿它排完了，今晚回家再压一压。回家后我把第四页夹进一本厚书，其他四张放在桌上，准备明天一起交给演出的人。林安发消息问还心疼吗，我说一点点，毕竟是自己改了好多遍的原稿。她说下次带副本吧，我拿出手机把五页都拍下来，第二天打印一份，改把副本交给演出的人。原来的收在家里，活动带新印的。蓝袋子倒还可以借，她一问我就说行，不过这次还回来记得告诉我放哪儿，别让我再问一上午。
pinyin: wǒ tè dì dài wǔ yè xīn gǎo zi lái huàn shū huó dòng , xiǎng jié shù yǐ hòu qǐng dà jiā pái yī cì . dào mén kǒu kàn jiàn zì jǐ de lán dài zi , wǒ hěn zì rán de bǎ zhǐ fàng jìn qù , jué de bǐ yì zhí ná zài shǒu lǐ fāng biàn . mén biān xiāng zi hěn duō , wǒ zhī dào yǒu rén zài bān , què méi yǒu wèn lán dài zi huì bù huì yě bèi yí zǒu . fàng hǎo yǐ hòu wǒ qù bāng máng bān zhuō zi , huí tóu zhǔn bèi pái liàn shí cái fā xiàn yuán lái de dì fāng kōng le . nà yī kè wǒ xiǎng qǐ dài zi zuó wǎn jiè gěi lín ān , xiān wèn tā huán le méi yǒu . lín ān shuō zǎo shàng bǎ kōng dài zi fàng dào mén yòu biān . wǒ tīng jiàn kōng jiù jí le , wèn zěn me huì kōng , wǒ míng míng fàng jìn qù wǔ zhāng . tā ràng wǒ xiān tīng wán , shuō kōng shì zǎo shàng huán de shí hou , nà shí wǒ hái méi dào . wǒ zhè cái xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ lái le yǐ hòu dǎ kāi guò dài zi , lǐ miàn què shí méi yǒu shū , zhèng hǎo fàng gǎo zi . tā wèn fàng wán yǐ hòu ne , wǒ shuō qù bān zhuō zi le . zhuō zi tài zhòng , gāng cái liǎng gè rén tái le bàn tiān , děng wǒ zài huí lái , yuán lái de wèi zhì zhǐ shèng liǎng zhǐ kōng xiāng zi . yǒu rén shuō dōng xi dōu bān dào dì xià shì le , wǒ yǐ jīng zhuǎn shēn wǎng lóu tī zǒu . lín ān jiào zhù wǒ , ràng wǒ xiān wèn yǒu méi yǒu jiàn dào lán dài zi . nà gè rén xiǎng le yī xià , shuō zhǐ shì jì de shàng cì huó dòng fàng zài nà lǐ , jīn tiān méi yǒu kàn jiàn . wǒ zhǐ hǎo zhé huí lái , qù wèn mén kǒu de zhì yuàn zhě . tā zhèng máng zhe bān shū , ràng wǒ děng yī xià . wǒ zhàn dào páng biān , wǎng lóu dào lǐ kàn , yī zhāng zhǐ tǎng zài dì shang . lín ān zǒu guò qù jiǎn qǐ lái , wǒ yī kàn yè mǎ , zhèng hǎo shì gāng cái hái zài zhǎo de dì sì yè . wǒ ná zhe dì sì yè , shuō gǎo zi bù shì yì zhí zài dài lǐ ma . lín ān wèn hòu lái yě kàn zhe ma , wǒ yáo tóu , gǎi kǒu shuō fàng jìn qù shí hái zài , bān zhuō zi . kàn zhuó shǒu lǐ zhé guò de zhǐ , wǒ yuè lái yuè xiǎng kuài diǎn zhǎo dào lìng wài sì zhāng . zhì yuàn zhě zhè shí zǒu guò lái , wèn shì bú shì zài zhǎo nà gè lán dài zi , wǒ gǎn jǐn shuō duì . zhì yuàn zhě shuō bān dào èr lóu shí , wǒ zhōng yú sōng kǒu qì . tā yǐ wéi dài zi yě shì huó dòng wù pǐn , hé liǎng zhǐ zhǐ xiāng yì qǐ bān zǒu , hǎo ràng rù kǒu kōng chū lái . tā shuō zhǐ meaning: I brought five pages for later rehearsal, found my returned bag and put them in without asking about relocation. After table moving I found the space empty and first asked the borrower about returning it. Lin An said she'd left the empty bag to the right of the entrance. Empty? I'd put five pages in it! Let her finish, she said: it had been empty when she returned it, before I'd arrived. Then I remembered opening it myself and finding no books, leaving room for my manuscript. What had I done afterwards? Moved tables. The table was heavy and had taken two of us a while; by the time I returned, only two empty boxes remained at the spot. Someone said things had gone to the basement, and I was already heading for the stairs when Lin An called me back to ask whether they'd seen the bag. No; they only remembered the previous event. I returned to the entrance volunteer, who was busy moving books and asked me to wait. Looking down the corridor, I spotted a sheet on the floor. Lin An picked it up. Its number was four—the page I'd been looking for. Holding page four, I asked whether the pages hadn't been in the bag the whole time. Had I watched afterwards? No—I corrected myself: they'd been there when I put them in, then I'd moved tables. Lin An asked if I'd closed the bag. Both hands had been busy with the sheets, and someone had called me away. Looking at the folded paper, I wanted to find the other four quickly. Then the volunteer came over: were we looking for the blue bag? Yes, I said at once. The volunteer said he'd moved it upstairs with two boxes to clear the entrance. Paper had stuck out; I remembered not closing the bag. We followed him past boxes of books on the stairs to the blue bag at the back. I opened it while Lin An held the page found in the corridor, waiting for me to order the pages. There were only four pages in the bag. I found one to three and five, then Lin An handed me four from the corridor; the new section was complete. I pressed a fresh crease flat against the table, still disappointed about the original. Was it readable? Yes, everything was there. We'd rehearse now, and I'd press it inside a book at home later. We moved the personal belongings to another table and Lin An labelled it. I asked the volunteer if the blue bag could stay there next time. Yes, but take it home afterwards; the tables would be cleared at night. Lin An laughed: she'd seen this move, and it was no longer by the door. She held the bag while I gathered the manuscript into a stack. The manager needed room for the chairs he'd just put away, so we moved further inside. Before rehearsal Lin An said she'd hold the bag and I'd move the table. Everyone laughed. Fine, but she was carrying her own umbrella. It hadn't moved, she said; get the table into place first. I pushed it beside the lamp, put the manuscript on it and picked it up to read once everyone sat down. Afterwards I put all five pages in my backpack, and Lin An handed me the empty blue bag. As I closed both bags, she laughed: could we finally leave? At dinner someone asked if our materials had been taken away. The volunteer had moved the bag and boxes upstairs, I said, not out of the building. What about the sheet in the corridor? I showed page four; it might have fallen from the unclosed bag on the way up, though I hadn't seen the moment. Lin An said she'd found it on the corridor floor. Our friend touched the crease: lucky nobody stepped on it. The words were clear and we'd rehearsed with it; I'd press it flat at home. At home I pressed page four inside a thick book, leaving the other sheets on the desk to hand to the performers tomorrow. Lin An asked if I was still upset. A little: I'd revised that original so many times. Bring copies next time, she said. I photographed all five and printed a set the next day to give the performers instead. I'd keep the originals at home and take the fresh copies to events. She could still borrow the blue bag—just tell me where she'd returned it, so I didn't spend another morning asking.

parts.text: 我特地带五页新稿子来换书活动，想结束以后请大家排一次。到门口看见自己的蓝袋子，我很自然地把纸放进去，觉得比一直拿在手里方便。门边箱子很多，我知道有人在搬，却没有问蓝袋子会不会也被移走。放好以后我去帮忙搬桌子，回头准备排练时才发现原来的地方空了。那一刻我想起袋子昨晚借给林安，先问她还了没有。
林安说早上把空袋子放到门右边。我听见空就急了，问怎么会空，我明明放进去五张。她让我先听完，说空是早上还的时候，那时我还没到。我这才想起自己来了以后打开过袋子，里面确实没有书，正好放稿子。她问放完以后呢，我说去搬桌子了。桌子太重，刚才两个人抬了半天，等我再回来，原来的位置只剩两只空箱子。
有人说东西都搬到地下室了，我已经转身往楼梯走。林安叫住我，让我先问有没有见到蓝袋子。那个人想了一下，说只是记得上次活动放在那里，今天没有看见。我只好折回来，去问门口的志愿者。他正忙着搬书，让我等一下。我站到旁边，往楼道里看，一张纸躺在地上。林安走过去捡起来，我一看页码，正好是刚才还在找的第四页。
我拿着第四页，说稿子不是一直在袋里吗。林安问后来也看着吗，我摇头，改口说放进去时还在，后来我去搬桌子了。她指着门边，让我想想袋口有没有拉好。我记得拿纸时两只手都忙，就那么放了进去，接着有人叫我搬桌子。看着手里折过的纸，我越来越想快点找到另外四张。志愿者这时走过来，问是不是在找那个蓝袋子，我赶紧说对。
志愿者说搬到二楼时，我终于松口气。他以为袋子也是活动物品，和两只纸箱一起搬走，好让入口空出来。他说纸露在袋口，我想起自己放完以后没有拉好，就请他带我们上去。楼梯那边已经堆了几箱书，我们侧着身走过，找到最里面的蓝袋子。我先打开看，林安拿着楼道捡到的那张纸站在旁边，等我把页码排好。
袋子里只有四张，我又紧张起来，把一到三放在一起，再找到第五页。林安递来楼道那张，正好是四，新的那一段总算连上了。纸上多了一道折痕，我把它放在桌边慢慢压平，还是有点心疼原稿。志愿者问还能不能读，我说能，都找齐了，先拿去排练吧，晚上回家再把这张夹进书里。
我们跟志愿者一起把个人东西挪到另一张桌子，林安贴了说明。我把蓝袋子提起来给他看，问下次能不能先留在这边。他说可以，不过结束以后记得拿走，晚上还要收桌子。林安笑着说这回看见了，已经不在门边了。我让她先拿袋子，自己把稿子收成一叠。管理员在旁边叫我们再腾出一点地方，刚收好的椅子还要搬过来，我们又往里站了一点。
排练前林安说这次袋子我拿，桌子你搬，大家都笑了。我说好，不过伞还是你自己拿。她看了一眼靠门的伞，说伞没动过，你先把桌子搬好。我把桌子推到灯旁，稿子放在上面，等大家坐下才拿起来读。排练结束以后，我把五页都收进自己的背包，林安把空蓝袋子还给我。我拉上两只包的口，她在旁边看着，笑说现在终于能走了吧。
晚饭时有人问，是不是有人拿走了我们的资料。我说是志愿者把袋子和箱子搬到楼上，不是带出楼房。他问怎么还有一张在楼道，我把第四页拿给他看，说可能上楼时从没拉好的袋口掉出来了，具体哪一下没看见。林安在旁边补充，她捡到时就在楼道地上。朋友摸了摸那道折痕，说还好没踩上。我说字都能看清，刚才已经拿它排完了，今晚回家再压一压。
回家后我把第四页夹进一本厚书，其他四张放在桌上，准备明天一起交给演出的人。林安发消息问还心疼吗，我说一点点，毕竟是自己改了好多遍的原稿。她说下次带副本吧，我拿出手机把五页都拍下来，第二天打印一份，改把副本交给演出的人。原来的收在家里，活动带新印的。蓝袋子倒还可以借，她一问我就说行，不过这次还回来记得告诉我放哪儿，别让我再问一上午。

text: 你看群里那句了吗？换个主持人，大家就都愿意聊了。

text: 说得也太满了吧。上周那部片本来就好聊。

text: 可是留下的人真多了。

text: 说实话，我怕错过末班车。
pinyin: shuō shí huà , wǒ pà cuò guò mò bān chē .
meaning: Honestly, I was worried about the last bus.

text: 对啊，你又不是讨厌讨论。

text: 那我是不是也不能说大家没兴趣？

text: 先问问嘛。有的人听得挺认真，就是不爱抢着说。

meaning: Ask first. Some people listen carefully but don't like jumping in.

text: 我就是。有人一开口就停不下来。
pinyin: wǒ jiù shì . yǒu rén yī kāi kǒu jiù tíng bù xià lái .
meaning: That's me. Some people get going and never stop.

text: 你看我干吗？我今天还没说完三句话。
pinyin: nǐ kàn wǒ gàn má ? wǒ jīn tiān hái méi shuō wán sān jù huà .
meaning: Why are you looking at me? I've barely finished three sentences today.

text: 现在第四句了。
pinyin: xiàn zài dì sì jù le .
meaning: That makes four now.

text: 行，留点时间给你。你想怎么试？
pinyin: xíng , liú diǎn shí jiān gěi nǐ . nǐ xiǎng zěn me shì ?
meaning: Fine, I'll leave some time for you. What would you try?

text: 先给大家一分钟想，再聊十五分钟。
pinyin: xiān gěi dà jiā yī fēn zhōng xiǎng , zài liáo shí wǔ fēn zhōng .
meaning: Give everyone a minute to think, then discuss for fifteen minutes.

text: 问题提前交，现场也能补一条？

meaning: Submit questions in advance, with another allowed on the day?

text: 可以。想听的就听，不必每个人轮流讲。
pinyin: kě yǐ . xiǎng tīng de jiù tīng , bù bì měi gè rén lún liú jiǎng .
meaning: Sure. People can just listen; no need to make everyone speak in turn.

text: 但要不要给没开口的人留个机会？
pinyin: dàn yào bù yào gěi méi kāi kǒu de rén liú gè jī huì ?
meaning: But should we leave an opportunity for people who haven't spoken?

text: 问一句有没有人想补充，不点名。
pinyin: wèn yī jù yǒu méi yǒu rén xiǎng bǔ chōng , bù diǎn míng .
meaning: Ask if anyone wants to add something, without naming anyone.

text: 上周二十个人看，十二个人留，对吧？

text: 对。前一周也是二十个，八个留。

text: 那就是多二十个百分点，不能说多二十个人。

text: 这回算对了。别把你的四句话也算成百分比。

text: 先试两场，常规放映不动？

text: 散场后，走廊里还有几个人在争论电影的结尾。我想留下听，却一直盯着手机上的车次。主持人问我是不是不喜欢这部片，我说喜欢，只是回家要换一次车。他很快回了一句那下次选早点的场吧，我才松口气。以前群里讨论为什么有人总先走，大家常把原因猜成电影太难、气氛不热，或者那个人不爱说话。轮到我自己，原因却简单得很：最后一班车不会因为结尾好看就等我。
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu , zǒu láng lǐ hái yǒu jǐ gè rén zài zhēng lùn diàn yǐng de jié wěi . wǒ xiǎng liú xià tīng , què yì zhí dīng zhe shǒu jī shàng de chē cì . zhǔ chí rén wèn wǒ shì bú shì bù xǐ huān zhè bù piàn , wǒ shuō xǐ huān , zhǐ shì huí jiā yào huàn yī cì chē . tā hěn kuài huí le yī jù nà xià cì xuǎn zǎo diǎn de chǎng ba , wǒ cái sōng kǒu qì . yǐ qián qún lǐ tǎo lùn wèi shén me yǒu rén zǒng xiān zǒu , dà jiā cháng bǎ yuán yīn cāi chéng diàn yǐng tài nán , qì fēn bù rè , huò zhě nà gè rén bù ài shuō huà . lún dào wǒ zì jǐ , yuán yīn què jiǎn dān de hěn : zuì hòu yī bān chē bù huì yīn wèi jié wěi hǎo kàn jiù děng wǒ .
meaning: After the film, people debated the ending in the corridor. I wanted to listen but kept checking the bus. The host asked whether I disliked the film. I liked it; I needed to change buses. His suggestion of an earlier screening reassured me. The group had guessed people left because films were difficult, the atmosphere was dull or they disliked talking. My own reason was simpler: the last bus would not wait for a good ending.

text: 后来群里有人说，换主持人以后，留下的人从八个变成十二个，所以新主持人的办法明显更好。我翻了两次记录，两场都是二十人看电影，数字没写错。可是前一场周日晚十点才散，后一场周六九点结束；前一部片长一些，后一部片的结尾又特别容易引起讨论。主持人确实也换了，还提前发了三个问题。看见人数上升很高兴，但这么多地方一起变了，要挑出哪一个起了作用，单靠这两行人数可不够。
pinyin: hòu lái qún lǐ yǒu rén shuō , huàn zhǔ chí rén yǐ hòu , liú xià de rén cóng bā gè biàn chéng shí èr gè , suǒ yǐ xīn zhǔ chí rén de bàn fǎ míng xiǎn gèng hǎo . wǒ fān le liǎng cì jì lù , liǎng chǎng dōu shì èr shí rén kàn diàn yǐng , shù zì méi xiě cuò . kě shì qián yī chǎng zhōu rì wǎn shí diǎn cái sàn , hòu yī chǎng zhōu liù jiǔ diǎn jié shù ; qián yī bù piàn zhǎng yī xiē , hòu yī bù piàn de jié wěi yòu tè bié róng yì yǐn qǐ tǎo lùn . zhǔ chí rén què shí yě huàn le , hái tí qián fā le sān gè wèn tí . kàn jiàn rén shù shàng shēng hěn gāo xìng , dàn zhè me duō dì fāng yì qǐ biàn le , yào tiāo chū nǎ yī gè qǐ le zuò yòng , dān kào zhè liǎng xíng rén shù kě bù gòu .
meaning: Someone later credited the new host for increasing those who stayed from eight to twelve. Both screenings had twenty viewers; the counts were correct. But one ended Sunday at ten and the other Saturday at nine. Film lengths and endings differed too, and the new host sent three questions beforehand. The increase was welcome, but two counts could not isolate one cause among all the changes.

text: 陈宇问我，那新主持人到底做得怎么样。我说很喜欢他上次那个问题：在哪一刻改变了对主角的看法。我一下就想起车站那场戏，也想听旁边的人怎么说。陈宇说他也是，不过刚才在群里写得太急，把大家都愿意聊放了进去。他打开手机，改成自己很想继续那场讨论，又问我要不要一起报名。我说先看看结束时间，别又聊到赶不上车。
pinyin: chén yǔ wèn wǒ , nà xīn zhǔ chí rén dào dǐ zuò de zěn me yàng . wǒ shuō hěn xǐ huān tā shàng cì nà gè wèn tí : zài nǎ yī kè gǎi biàn le duì zhǔ jué de kàn fǎ . wǒ yī xià jiù xiǎng qǐ chē zhàn nà chǎng xì , yě xiǎng tīng páng biān de rén zěn me shuō . chén yǔ shuō tā yě shì , bù guò gāng cái zài qún lǐ xiě de tài jí , bǎ dà jiā dōu yuàn yì liáo fàng le jìn qù . tā dǎ kāi shǒu jī , gǎi chéng zì jǐ hěn xiǎng jì xù nà chǎng tǎo lùn , yòu wèn wǒ yào bù yào yì qǐ bào míng . wǒ shuō xiān kàn kàn jié shù shí jiān , bié yòu liáo dào gǎn bù shàng chē .
meaning: Chen Yu asked what I thought of the new host. I loved his question about when our view of the protagonist changed; it brought back the station scene, and I wanted others' reactions. Chen did too, but he'd hastily written that everyone wanted to talk. He changed his message to his own wish to continue, then asked if I'd sign up. First check the finish time, I said, so I wouldn't miss the bus again.

text: 我建议先用两场小范围试点，不换掉常规放映。选定讨论的结束时间，问题提前收一条，现场留一分钟让人想，再开放十五分钟自由讨论。只想听的人可以不说，主持人中间问一次还有没有人想补充，不点名催答案。这样我不用一边开口一边看车，也不会因为沉默被当成没认真看。陈宇答应负责记人数，但我们又加了一项：散场后给愿意回复的人一个短问题，问时间和讨论方式是不是方便。
pinyin: wǒ jiàn yì xiān yòng liǎng chǎng xiǎo fàn wéi shì diǎn , bù huàn diào cháng guī fàng yìng . xuǎn dìng tǎo lùn de jié shù shí jiān , wèn tí tí qián shōu yī tiáo , xiàn chǎng liú yī fēn zhōng ràng rén xiǎng , zài kāi fàng shí wǔ fēn zhōng zì yóu tǎo lùn . zhǐ xiǎng tīng de rén kě yǐ bù shuō , zhǔ chí rén zhōng jiān wèn yī cì hái yǒu méi yǒu rén xiǎng bǔ chōng , bù diǎn míng cuī dá àn . zhè yàng wǒ bù yòng yī biān kāi kǒu yī biān kàn chē , yě bù huì yīn wèi chén mò bèi dàng chéng méi rèn zhēn kàn . chén yǔ dā yìng fù zé jì rén shù , dàn wǒ men yòu jiā le yī xiàng : sàn chǎng hòu gěi yuàn yì huí fù de rén yī gè duǎn wèn tí , wèn shí jiān hé tǎo lùn fāng shì shì bú shì fāng biàn .
meaning: I proposed two small pilot events alongside normal screenings: a fixed end, one advance question, a minute to think and fifteen minutes of discussion. Listening without speaking would be allowed. The host would invite additions without putting individuals on the spot. That let me speak without watching the bus and listen without my silence being mistaken for inattention. Chen Yu would record attendance; willing respondents could also answer a short question about timing and format.

text: 第一场结束，十五个人里有九个留下，其中四个只听。陈宇差点只记五个参与讨论，我提醒他我们没有规定开口才算参加。九个人里，七个回复了那个短问题；有两个人说时间合适，一个人说问题太多，希望只留一个，另外四个人没有提时间。我们把这些意见写在一起，没有让七份回复替没回复的人说话。下一场仍然按约好的十五分钟结束，只把提前的问题减到一个，看看大家能不能把一件事聊得更完整。
pinyin: dì yī chǎng jié shù , shí wǔ gè rén lǐ yǒu jiǔ gè liú xià , qí zhōng sì gè zhǐ tīng . chén yǔ chà diǎn zhǐ jì wǔ gè cān yù tǎo lùn , wǒ tí xǐng tā wǒ men méi yǒu guī dìng kāi kǒu cái suàn cān jiā . jiǔ gè rén lǐ , qī gè huí fù le nà gè duǎn wèn tí ; yǒu liǎng gè rén shuō shí jiān hé shì , yī gè rén shuō wèn tí tài duō , xī wàng zhǐ liú yī gè , lìng wài sì gè rén méi yǒu tí shí jiān . wǒ men bǎ zhè xiē yì jiàn xiě zài yì qǐ , méi yǒu ràng qī fèn huí fù tì méi huí fù de rén shuō huà . xià yī chǎng réng rán àn yuē hǎo de shí wǔ fēn zhōng jié shù , zhǐ bǎ tí qián de wèn tí jiǎn dào yī gè , kàn kàn dà jiā néng bù néng bǎ yī jiàn shì liáo de gèng wán zhěng .
meaning: At the first pilot, nine of fifteen viewers stayed, including four who only listened. Chen Yu nearly recorded just five participants; speaking was not our definition of participation. Seven of the nine answered the short question. Two liked the timing, one wanted only one question, and four did not mention timing. We kept the responses without speaking for nonrespondents. The next event retained fifteen minutes but reduced advance questions to one, allowing fuller discussion of one issue.

text: 第二次我坐到了前面。陈宇看见我，笑说你终于不准备随时逃跑了。我说还是准备回家，只是现在不用逃。他把椅子挪开一点，让后来的人也能坐进来。讨论开始时，那个平时话很少的朋友先说了车站那场戏，我们没有急着接上自己的观点。她讲到一半停了，想了想，又补了一个细节。我那天记得最清楚的不是人数，而是那几秒没人催她的空白。回家的车仍然得赶，想留下的时间却终于有了位置。
pinyin: dì èr cì wǒ zuò dào le qián miàn . chén yǔ kàn jiàn wǒ , xiào shuō nǐ zhōng yú bù zhǔn bèi suí shí táo pǎo le . wǒ shuō hái shi zhǔn bèi huí jiā , zhǐ shì xiàn zài bù yòng táo . tā bǎ yǐ zi nuó kāi yī diǎn , ràng hòu lái de rén yě néng zuò jìn lái . tǎo lùn kāi shǐ shí , nà gè píng shí huà hěn shǎo de péng you xiān shuō le chē zhàn nà chǎng xì , wǒ men méi yǒu jí zhe jiē shàng zì jǐ de guān diǎn . tā jiǎng dào yí bàn tíng le , xiǎng le xiǎng , yòu bǔ le yī gè xì jié . wǒ nà tiān jì de zuì qīng chǔ de bù shì rén shù , ér shì nà jǐ miǎo méi rén cuī tā de kòng bái . huí jiā de chē réng rán děi gǎn , xiǎng liú xià de shí jiān què zhōng yú yǒu le wèi zhì .
meaning: At the second pilot I sat nearer the front. Chen Yu joked I was finally not ready to flee. I still wanted to get home; I no longer needed to flee. He moved a chair to make space. A usually quiet friend began with the station scene. We didn't rush to add our views. She paused, thought and supplied another detail. My clearest memory was not a count but those unhurried seconds. I still had a bus to catch, but time for staying finally had a place.

parts.text: 散场后，走廊里还有几个人在争论电影的结尾。我想留下听，却一直盯着手机上的车次。主持人问我是不是不喜欢这部片，我说喜欢，只是回家要换一次车。他很快回了一句那下次选早点的场吧，我才松口气。以前群里讨论为什么有人总先走，大家常把原因猜成电影太难、气氛不热，或者那个人不爱说话。轮到我自己，原因却简单得很：最后一班车不会因为结尾好看就等我。
后来群里有人说，换主持人以后，留下的人从八个变成十二个，所以新主持人的办法明显更好。我翻了两次记录，两场都是二十人看电影，数字没写错。可是前一场周日晚十点才散，后一场周六九点结束；前一部片长一些，后一部片的结尾又特别容易引起讨论。主持人确实也换了，还提前发了三个问题。看见人数上升很高兴，但这么多地方一起变了，要挑出哪一个起了作用，单靠这两行人数可不够。
陈宇问我，那新主持人到底做得怎么样。我说很喜欢他上次那个问题：在哪一刻改变了对主角的看法。我一下就想起车站那场戏，也想听旁边的人怎么说。陈宇说他也是，不过刚才在群里写得太急，把大家都愿意聊放了进去。他打开手机，改成自己很想继续那场讨论，又问我要不要一起报名。我说先看看结束时间，别又聊到赶不上车。
我建议先用两场小范围试点，不换掉常规放映。选定讨论的结束时间，问题提前收一条，现场留一分钟让人想，再开放十五分钟自由讨论。只想听的人可以不说，主持人中间问一次还有没有人想补充，不点名催答案。这样我不用一边开口一边看车，也不会因为沉默被当成没认真看。陈宇答应负责记人数，但我们又加了一项：散场后给愿意回复的人一个短问题，问时间和讨论方式是不是方便。
第一场结束，十五个人里有九个留下，其中四个只听。陈宇差点只记五个参与讨论，我提醒他我们没有规定开口才算参加。九个人里，七个回复了那个短问题；有两个人说时间合适，一个人说问题太多，希望只留一个，另外四个人没有提时间。我们把这些意见写在一起，没有让七份回复替没回复的人说话。下一场仍然按约好的十五分钟结束，只把提前的问题减到一个，看看大家能不能把一件事聊得更完整。
第二次我坐到了前面。陈宇看见我，笑说你终于不准备随时逃跑了。我说还是准备回家，只是现在不用逃。他把椅子挪开一点，让后来的人也能坐进来。讨论开始时，那个平时话很少的朋友先说了车站那场戏，我们没有急着接上自己的观点。她讲到一半停了，想了想，又补了一个细节。我那天记得最清楚的不是人数，而是那几秒没人催她的空白。回家的车仍然得赶，想留下的时间却终于有了位置。

text: 你怎么每次都坐最后一排？
pinyin: nǐ zěn me měi cì dōu zuò zuì hòu yī pái ?
meaning: Why do you always sit in the back row?

text: 离门近，散场好走。
pinyin: lí mén jìn , sàn chǎng hǎo zǒu .
meaning: It's near the door, so it's easy to leave afterwards.

text: 还以为你不想跟我们聊天。
pinyin: hái yǐ wéi nǐ bù xiǎng gēn wǒ men liáo tiān .
meaning: I thought you didn't want to talk to us.

text: 我想聊啊，我只是还想回家。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng liáo a , wǒ zhǐ shì hái xiǎng huí jiā .
meaning: I do want to talk. I also want to get home.

text: 这两件事并不冲突。
pinyin: zhè liǎng jiàn shì bìng bù chōng tū .
meaning: Those two things aren't in conflict.

text: 对。别替我的车票写性格分析。

text: 那今天呢？

text: 今天讨论提前结束，我能留。

text: 我给你留位置。
pinyin: wǒ gěi nǐ liú wèi zhì .

text: 不用留最后一排。
pinyin: bù yòng liú zuì hòu yī pái .

text: 你终于坐前面了？

text: 好，不过别让我先发言。
pinyin: hǎo , bù guò bié ràng wǒ xiān fā yán .
meaning: Yes, but don't make me speak first.

meaning: How is this paragraph connected to the previous one?

text: 据她说，活动已经换了场地。

text: 截至今天，报名的人数还没变。

text: 这个比例下降了五个百分点。
pinyin: zhè gè bǐ lì xià jiàng le wǔ gè bǎi fēn diǎn .
meaning: This proportion fell by five percentage points.

text: 她用完成的任务衡量进展。
pinyin: tā yòng wán chéng de rèn wù héng liáng jìn zhǎn .

text: 他倾向于下午出门。
pinyin: tā qīng xiàng yú xià wǔ chū mén .
meaning: He tends to go out in the afternoon.

text: 不是每条建议都会被采纳。
pinyin: bù shì měi tiáo jiàn yì dū huì bèi cǎi nà .

text: 试点结束以后再决定是否继续。

meaning: Decide whether to continue after the pilot ends.

text: 这不属于常规安排。
pinyin: zhè bù shǔ yú cháng guī ān pái .
meaning: This isn't part of the usual arrangement.

text: 她提出了一个切实的办法。
pinyin: tā tí chū le yī gè qiè shí de bàn fǎ .
meaning: She proposed a practical solution.

text: 我想确认能否带朋友来。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng què rèn néng fǒu dài péng you lái .
meaning: I'd like to confirm whether I can bring a friend.

text: 你的意思就是说先等回复？
pinyin: nǐ de yì si jiù shì shuō xiān děng huí fù ?
meaning: You mean we should wait for a reply first?

text: 她周末能不能来，很难说。
pinyin: tā zhōu mò néng bù néng lái , hěn nán shuō .
meaning: It's hard to say whether she can come this weekend.

text: 说实话，这个结尾我没看懂。
pinyin: shuō shí huà , zhè gè jié wěi wǒ méi kàn dǒng .
meaning: To be honest, I didn't understand the ending.

text: 电话打断了我们的谈话。
pinyin: diàn huà dǎ duàn le wǒ men de tán huà .
meaning: A phone call interrupted our conversation.

text: 书占据了桌子的大部分地方。
pinyin: shū zhàn jù le zhuō zi de dà bù fèn dì fāng .
meaning: Books occupy most of the table.

text: 她回应了关于地点的问题。
pinyin: tā huí yìng le guān yú dì diǎn de wèn tí .
meaning: She responded to the question about location.

text: 我已经提交了申请。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng tí jiāo le shēn qǐng .
meaning: I've submitted the application.

text: 负责人通报了临时调整。
pinyin: fù zé rén tōng bào le lín shí tiáo zhěng .
meaning: The organiser announced the temporary change.

text: 这个场馆周日开放。
pinyin: zhè gè chǎng guǎn zhōu rì kāi fàng .
meaning: This venue opens on Sunday.

text: 这次还有两个名额。
pinyin: zhè cì hái yǒu liǎng gè míng é .
meaning: Two places are still available this time.

text: 我们最终选了周六下午。
pinyin: wǒ men zuì zhōng xuǎn le zhōu liù xià wǔ .
meaning: We finally chose Saturday afternoon.

text: 我先发消息，免得她白跑。
pinyin: wǒ xiān fā xiāo xī , miǎn de tā bái pǎo .
meaning: I'll message first so she doesn't make a wasted trip.

By Sunday evening, eight replies had arrived. As of today, the registration count hasn't changed. Forty to sixty percent is an increase of twenty percentage points. This proportion fell by five percentage points. Participation cannot be assessed solely by how often someone speaks. She assesses progress through completed tasks. I lean towards trying a shorter discussion first. He tends to go out in the afternoon. The group adopted the suggestion of a minute to think first. Not every suggestion will be adopted. These two events are only a small pilot. Decide whether to continue after the pilot ends. The usual screenings remain. This isn't part of the usual arrangement. We need a practical plan, not merely 'talk more'. She proposed a practical solution. Whether discussion can be extended still needs checking with the venue. I'd like to confirm whether I can bring a friend. Getting home too late on Sunday is inconvenient for me. A call is inconvenient now; let's talk later. As for changing the host, that hasn't been decided. As for what to eat, you choose first. Besides, not everyone who stays necessarily speaks. Let's discuss that tomorrow. That is, we only know attendance differed on these two occasions. You mean we should wait for a reply first? It's hard to say whether changing hosts would help. It's hard to say whether she can come this weekend. To be honest, I was just afraid of missing the last bus. To be honest, I didn't understand the ending. Let her finish before interrupting. A phone call interrupted our conversation. Don't let one person take up all the discussion time. Books occupy most of the table. No immediate response doesn't necessarily mean no interest. She responded to the question about location. Everyone can submit one question. I've submitted the application. The host told the group the new finishing time. The organiser announced the temporary change. The venue closes at ten, so we can't talk until eleven. This venue opens on Sunday. Discussion places and screening places are counted separately. Two places are still available this time. The final decision will wait until the pilot ends. We finally chose Saturday afternoon. Write the finish time clearly so people don't miss their bus. I'll message first so she doesn't make a wasted trip.

影片本身也是一个因素。
价格不是我考虑的唯一因素。

别把外观当成本质。

周日晚回家太晚对我不便。

text: 我接手电影小组的时候，最担心的是散场后的讨论。放映安排清楚，大家买好票、找好座位，片子开始就能坐下来；讨论却没有这样的边界。有时我问了一个问题，三个人同时开口，另一些人连想插话的地方都找不到。有时谁都不说，我就忍不住把问题讲得越来越长，最后听起来像是我又讲了一遍电影。活动结束以后很累，却仍然不知道那些一直点头的人究竟有没有得到自己想要的东西。
pinyin: wǒ jiē shǒu diàn yǐng xiǎo zǔ de shí hou , zuì dān xīn de shì sàn chǎng hòu de tǎo lùn . fàng yìng ān pái qīng chǔ , dà jiā mǎi hǎo piào , zhǎo hǎo zuò wèi , piān zi kāi shǐ jiù néng zuò xià lái ; tǎo lùn què méi yǒu zhè yàng de biān jiè . yǒu shí wǒ wèn le yī gè wèn tí , sān gè rén tóng shí kāi kǒu , lìng yī xiē rén lián xiǎng chā huà de dì fāng dōu zhǎo bù dào . yǒu shí shéi dōu bù shuō , wǒ jiù rěn bú zhù bǎ wèn tí jiǎng de yuè lái yuè zhǎng , zuì hòu tīng qǐ lái xiàng shì wǒ yòu jiǎng le yī biàn diàn yǐng . huó dòng jié shù yǐ hòu hěn lèi , què réng rán bù zhī dào nà xiē yì zhí diǎn tóu de rén jiū jìng yǒu méi yǒu dé dào zì jǐ xiǎng yào de dōng xi .
meaning: When I took over the film group, discussion worried me most. Screening had clear boundaries: tickets, seats and a start. Discussion did not. Sometimes three people spoke at once while others couldn't join. Sometimes silence made me keep expanding a question until I was retelling the film. I finished tired and still unsure whether quiet listeners had got what they wanted.

text: 有一次大家留下得多，群里很快有人夸我比前一个主持人强。我看见很高兴，又有点不好意思。前一个人把场地、设备和报名都交代得很清楚，只是最后那场结束晚了。我知道林安要换车，另一个朋友第二天要早起，不能把他们先走都算到主持人的头上。而且我选的电影短一些，结尾留下一个很明显的问题。若说这次活动有几个安排值得继续试，我愿意；若说一切都是换了我才改善，我自己也说不出口。
pinyin: yǒu yī cì dà jiā liú xià de duō , qún lǐ hěn kuài yǒu rén kuā wǒ bǐ qián yī gè zhǔ chí rén qiáng . wǒ kàn jiàn hěn gāo xìng , yòu yǒu diǎn bù hǎo yì sī . qián yī gè rén bǎ chǎng dì , shè bèi hé bào míng dōu jiāo dài de hěn qīng chǔ , zhǐ shì zuì hòu nà chǎng jié shù wǎn le . wǒ zhī dào lín ān yào huàn chē , lìng yī gè péng you dì èr tiān yào zǎo qǐ , bù néng bǎ tā men xiān zǒu dōu suàn dào zhǔ chí rén de tóu shàng . ér qiě wǒ xuǎn de diàn yǐng duǎn yī xiē , jié wěi liú xià yī gè hěn míng xiǎn de wèn tí . ruò shuō zhè cì huó dòng yǒu jǐ gè ān pái zhí de jì xù shì , wǒ yuàn yì ; ruò shuō yī qiè dōu shì huàn le wǒ cái gǎi shàn , wǒ zì jǐ yě shuō bù chū kǒu .
meaning: When more stayed, someone praised me over the previous host. I was pleased but uneasy. The previous person had organised venue, equipment and registrations well; the final screening merely ended late. Lin An needed a bus connection and someone else an early start. My film was shorter and had a clear open question. I could support trying parts of the arrangement again, but couldn't credit all improvement to replacing the host with me.

text: 我们后来把试点写成一张很短的说明，放映仍按原来的方式进行，讨论另算名额，因为小房间坐不下所有看电影的人。愿意留下的可以在报名时勾一下，想先听也行。结束时间写九点四十五，场馆十点关门。陈宇看了看中间的十五分钟，我让他试着收完这些椅子，再检查设备。他走了一圈回来，说明白了，这段还真不能拿来继续聊。
pinyin: wǒ men hòu lái bǎ shì diǎn xiě chéng yī zhāng hěn duǎn de shuō míng , fàng yìng réng àn yuán lái de fāng shì jìn xíng , tǎo lùn lìng suàn míng é , yīn wèi xiǎo fáng jiān zuò bù xià suǒ yǒu kàn diàn yǐng de rén . yuàn yì liú xià de kě yǐ zài bào míng shí gōu yī xià , xiǎng xiān tīng yě xíng . jié shù shí jiān xiě jiǔ diǎn sì shí wǔ , chǎng guǎn shí diǎn guān mén . chén yǔ kàn le kàn zhòng jiān de shí wǔ fēn zhōng , wǒ ràng tā shì zhe shōu wán zhè xiē yǐ zi , zài jiǎn chá shè bèi . tā zǒu le yī quān huí lái , shuō míng bái le , zhè duàn hái zhēn bù néng ná lái jì xù liáo .
meaning: Our short notice kept the usual screening, with separate discussion places because the small room couldn't seat everyone. People could sign up to stay, including just to listen. Discussion ended at 9:45 and the venue closed at ten. Chen looked at the fifteen-minute gap. I asked him to try putting away the chairs and checking equipment; after a circuit of the room he agreed we couldn't use that time for more conversation.

text: 第一场我给一分钟想问题，房间里忽然很安静，我差点又补一大段解释。陈宇冲我摆了摆手，我才想起这段安静本来就是留出来的。后来有人开口，我没有急着问第二个问题，而是请愿意的人接着说同一个场景。一个朋友说自己只想听，我说可以，又问全场有没有别的人想补充。她听到最后，走前跟我说刚才那种停一下的感觉很好。我第一次发现，主持人不一直说，讨论也并没有因此停下来。
pinyin: dì yī chǎng wǒ gěi yī fēn zhōng xiǎng wèn tí , fáng jiān lǐ hū rán hěn ān jìng , wǒ chà diǎn yòu bǔ yī dà duàn jiě shì . chén yǔ chōng wǒ bǎi le bǎi shǒu , wǒ cái xiǎng qǐ zhè duàn ān jìng běn lái jiù shì liú chū lái de . hòu lái yǒu rén kāi kǒu , wǒ méi yǒu jí zhe wèn dì èr gè wèn tí , ér shì qǐng yuàn yì de rén jiē zhe shuō tóng yī gè chǎng jǐng . yī gè péng you shuō zì jǐ zhǐ xiǎng tīng , wǒ shuō kě yǐ , yòu wèn quán chǎng yǒu méi yǒu bié de rén xiǎng bǔ chōng . tā tīng dào zuì hòu , zǒu qián gēn wǒ shuō gāng cái nà zhǒng tíng yī xià de gǎn jué hěn hǎo . wǒ dì yī cì fā xiàn , zhǔ chí rén bù yì zhí shuō , tǎo lùn yě bìng méi yǒu yīn cǐ tíng xià lái .
meaning: At the first pilot, the minute for thinking was so quiet I almost added another explanation. Chen Yu waved, reminding me silence was planned. Once someone spoke, I didn't rush to a second question but invited thoughts on the same scene. Someone wanted just to listen; that was fine. I invited additions from the room. Afterwards she liked the pauses. I realised discussion didn't stop when its host wasn't constantly talking.

text: 记录的时候我们保留了看电影、留下和开口三个数字。第一场十五人看、九人留、五人说，这些数字说的是不同的事，不能挑最大一个叫作发言人数，也不能挑最小一个说只有五个人喜欢活动。短问题有七份回复，我看见其中两人说时间方便，不能改写成所有九个人都同意。有人希望提前问题少些，我很愿意采纳，因为自己也发现三个问题挤在十五分钟里太赶。下一次减到一个，说明里仍然让人知道可以现场补充。
pinyin: jì lù de shí hou wǒ men bǎo liú le kàn diàn yǐng , liú xià hé kāi kǒu sān gè shù zì . dì yī chǎng shí wǔ rén kàn , jiǔ rén liú , wǔ rén shuō , zhè xiē shù zì shuō de shì bù tóng de shì , bù néng tiāo zuì dà yī gè jiào zuò fā yán rén shù , yě bù néng tiāo zuì xiǎo yī gè shuō zhǐ yǒu wǔ gè rén xǐ huān huó dòng . duǎn wèn tí yǒu qī fèn huí fù , wǒ kàn jiàn qí zhōng liǎng rén shuō shí jiān fāng biàn , bù néng gǎi xiě chéng suǒ yǒu jiǔ gè rén dōu tóng yì . yǒu rén xī wàng tí qián wèn tí shǎo xiē , wǒ hěn yuàn yì cǎi nà , yīn wèi zì jǐ yě fā xiàn sān gè wèn tí jǐ zài shí wǔ fēn zhōng lǐ tài gǎn . xià yī cì jiǎn dào yī gè , shuō míng lǐ réng rán ràng rén zhī dào kě yǐ xiàn chǎng bǔ chōng .
meaning: We retained separate counts: fifteen watched, nine stayed and five spoke. These measured different things, neither nine speakers nor only five who liked the event. Seven replies included two favourable timing comments, not agreement from all nine. A request for fewer advance questions matched my own sense that three in fifteen minutes was rushed. We reduced them to one while allowing additions on the day.

text: 试点结束后，小组没有立刻宣布新办法最成功。我们先确认场馆是否愿意继续提供这个小房间，再问负责收尾的人能不能保持同样安排。我还是主持，但轮到没开口的朋友，不会把名字叫出来要求她马上给答案。林安有一次提前离开，朝我指了指手机，我就知道她要赶车，不用当众问为什么。另一个周末她又留下来，讨论完还帮我们把椅子排好。这样的变化很普通，却让我觉得小组不是在选出一种最热闹的人，而是在给不同的人留下不同的参加方式。
pinyin: shì diǎn jié shù hòu , xiǎo zǔ méi yǒu lì kè xuān bù xīn bàn fǎ zuì chéng gōng . wǒ men xiān què rèn chǎng guǎn shì fǒu yuàn yì jì xù tí gōng zhè gè xiǎo fáng jiān , zài wèn fù zé shōu wěi de rén néng bù néng bǎo chí tóng yàng ān pái . wǒ hái shi zhǔ chí , dàn lún dào méi kāi kǒu de péng you , bù huì bǎ míng zi jiào chū lái yāo qiú tā mǎ shàng gěi dá àn . lín ān yǒu yī cì tí qián lí kāi , cháo wǒ zhǐ le zhǐ shǒu jī , wǒ jiù zhī dào tā yào gǎn chē , bù yòng dāng zhòng wèn wèi shén me . lìng yī gè zhōu mò tā yòu liú xià lái , tǎo lùn wán hái bāng wǒ men bǎ yǐ zi pái hǎo . zhè yàng de biàn huà hěn pǔ tōng , què ràng wǒ jué de xiǎo zǔ bù shì zài xuǎn chū yī zhǒng zuì rè nào de rén , ér shì zài gěi bù tóng de rén liú xià bù tóng de cān jiā fāng shì .
meaning: After the pilot we checked continued room availability and closing duties rather than announcing a winning method. I remained host without naming quiet people for immediate answers. Once Lin An pointed to her phone and left for the bus; I didn't demand a public explanation. Another weekend she stayed and helped with chairs. The ordinary difference made the group feel like space for different ways of joining, rather than a contest for the liveliest person.

yòu yǒu diǎn bù hǎo yì sī . qián yī gè rén bǎ chǎng dì , shè bèi hé bào míng dōu jiāo dài de hěn qīng chǔ , zhǐ shì zuì hòu nà chǎng jié shù wǎn le . wǒ zhī dào lín ān yào huàn chē , lìng yī gè péng you dì èr tiān yào zǎo qǐ , bù néng bǎ tā men xiān zǒu dōu suàn dào zhǔ chí rén de tóu shàng . ér qiě wǒ xuǎn de diàn yǐng duǎn yī xiē , jié wěi liú xià yī gè hěn míng xiǎn de wèn tí . ruò shuō zhè cì huó dòng yǒu jǐ gè ān pái zhí de jì xù shì , wǒ yuàn yì ; ruò shuō yī qiè dōu shì huàn le wǒ cái gǎi shàn , wǒ zì jǐ yě shuō bù chū kǒu . wǒ men hòu lái bǎ shì diǎn xiě chéng yī zhāng hěn duǎn de shuō míng , fàng yìng réng àn yuán lái de fāng shì jìn xíng , tǎo lùn lìng suàn míng é , yīn wèi xiǎo fáng jiān zuò bù xià suǒ yǒu kàn diàn yǐng de rén . yuàn yì liú xià de kě yǐ zài bào míng shí gōu yī xià , xiǎng xiān tīng yě xíng . jié shù shí jiān xiě jiǔ diǎn sì shí wǔ , chǎng guǎn shí diǎn guān mén . chén yǔ kàn le kàn zhòng jiān de shí wǔ fēn zhōng , wǒ ràng tā shì zhe shōu wán zhè xiē yǐ zi , zài jiǎn chá shè bèi . tā zǒu le yī quān huí lái , shuō míng bái le , zhè duàn hái zhēn bù néng ná lái jì xù liáo . dì yī chǎng wǒ gěi yī fēn zhōng xiǎng wèn tí , fáng jiān lǐ hū rán hěn ān jìng , wǒ chà diǎn yòu bǔ yī dà duàn jiě shì . chén yǔ chōng wǒ bǎi le bǎi shǒu , wǒ cái xiǎng qǐ zhè duàn ān jìng běn lái jiù shì liú chū lái de . hòu lái yǒu rén kāi kǒu , wǒ méi yǒu jí zhe wèn dì èr gè wèn zuò fā yán rén shù , yě bù néng tiāo zuì xiǎo yī gè shuō zhǐ yǒu wǔ gè rén xǐ huān huó dòng . duǎn wèn tí yǒu qī fèn huí fù , wǒ kàn jiàn qí zhōng liǎng rén shuō shí jiān fāng biàn , bù néng gǎi xiě yāo qiú tā mǎ shàng gěi dá àn . lín ān yǒu yī cì tí qián lí kāi , cháo wǒ zhǐ le zhǐ shǒu jī , wǒ jiù zhī dào tā yào gǎn chē , bù yòng dāng zhòng wèn wèi shén me . lìng yī gè zhōu mò tā yòu liú xià
