text: 我今天的演出比陈宇他们那场晚结束一点，跑到车站，等的车还没来。群里问还要等我吗，我先发你们进去，别站门口。电话接通，朋友却问是不是不来了。我说不是不去，车还没到，晚点来。他那边正有人笑，没听清，我又提高声音重复了一遍。看着站牌，我也着急，可车还没来，只好先把晚点到三个字打出来，再让他们给我留一把椅子，不用一起站在外面吹风。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān de yǎn chū bǐ chén yǔ tā men nà chǎng wǎn jié shù yī diǎn , pǎo dào chē zhàn , děng de chē hái méi lái . qún lǐ wèn hái yào děng wǒ ma , wǒ xiān fā nǐ men jìn qù , bié zhàn mén kǒu . diàn huà jiē tōng , péng you què wèn shì bú shì bù lái le . wǒ shuō bù shì bù qù , chē hái méi dào , wǎn diǎn lái . tā nà biān zhèng yǒu rén xiào , méi tīng qīng , wǒ yòu tí gāo shēng yīn chóng fù le yī biàn . kàn zhe zhàn pái , wǒ yě zháo jí , kě chē hái méi lái , zhǐ hǎo xiān bǎ wǎn diǎn dào sān gè zì dǎ chū lái , zài ràng tā men gěi wǒ liú yī bǎ yǐ zi , bù yòng yì qǐ zhàn zài wài miàn chuī fēng .
meaning: My show ended a little later than Chen Yu's group, and the bus still hadn't come when I ran to the stop. Asked whether they should wait, I texted them to go inside. On the phone, a friend thought I wasn't coming. I was, just later—the bus wasn't there yet. Laughter at his end drowned me out, so I repeated it louder. I was anxious too, but could only text that I'd arrive late and ask them to save a chair rather than stand outside in the wind.

text: 车站有人说话，电话那头又有散场的响声，我们两边都不太听得清。我发文字，把晚点到写出来，站在车站继续等。朋友又问多久，我抬头看了两次，车终于来了，才补了一句十分钟左右。上车以后我找到靠窗的位置，把刚才没说完的路问清。他说红门就在电影院旁边，我看着窗外一站一站过去，快到时先发了消息，让他不用再站门口找我。
pinyin: chē zhàn yǒu rén shuō huà , diàn huà nà tóu yòu yǒu sàn chǎng de xiǎng shēng , wǒ men liǎng biān dōu bù tài tīng de qīng . wǒ fā wén zì , bǎ wǎn diǎn dào xiě chū lái , zhàn zài chē zhàn jì xù děng . péng you yòu wèn duō jiǔ , wǒ tái tóu kàn le liǎng cì , chē zhōng yú lái le , cái bǔ le yī jù shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu . shàng chē yǐ hòu wǒ zhǎo dào kào chuāng de wèi zhì , bǎ gāng cái méi shuō wán de lù wèn qīng . tā shuō hóng mén jiù zài diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān , wǒ kàn zhe chuāng wài yī zhàn yī zhàn guò qù , kuài dào shí xiān fā le xiāo xī , ràng tā bù yòng zài zhàn mén kǒu zhǎo wǒ .
meaning: People were talking at the stop and the event was ending at the other end of the call. I texted that I'd arrive late and kept waiting. Asked how long, I looked up twice before the bus finally arrived; only then did I estimate about ten minutes. From a window seat I confirmed the red door beside the cinema, watched the stops go past and messaged near arrival so my friend wouldn't stand outside searching for me.

text: 朋友问要不要替我点吃的，我说先别点，路上也许会买一点。他又问到了以后再看吗，我说对，水可以先拿。刚说完，车到了，我把手机放进口袋，上去找座位。旁边有人拿着面包，我才发现自己也饿了，可两只手还要拿包和扶住椅背，只好先坐下来。朋友发来菜单照片，我看了两眼，回他说到了自己选，别急着点，我还没看完。他回了个好，旁边又发来一只装水的杯子。
pinyin: péng you wèn yào bù yào tì wǒ diǎn chī de , wǒ shuō xiān bié diǎn , lù shàng yě xǔ huì mǎi yī diǎn . tā yòu wèn dào le yǐ hòu zài kàn ma , wǒ shuō duì , shuǐ kě yǐ xiān ná . gāng shuō wán , chē dào le , wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng jìn kǒu dài , shàng qù zhǎo zuò wèi . páng biān yǒu rén ná zhe miàn bāo , wǒ cái fā xiàn zì jǐ yě è le , kě liǎng zhǐ shǒu hái yào ná bāo hé fú zhù yǐ bèi , zhǐ hǎo xiān zuò xià lái . péng you fā lái cài dān zhào piān , wǒ kàn le liǎng yǎn , huí tā shuō dào le zì jǐ xuǎn , bié jí zhe diǎn , wǒ hái méi kàn wán . tā huí le gè hǎo , páng biān yòu fā lái yī zhǐ zhuāng shuǐ de bēi zi .
meaning: Asked whether they should order for me, I said not yet; I might buy something on the way. I'd choose when I arrived, but water was fine. The bus came as I finished, and I put my phone away to board. Someone had bread, reminding me how hungry I was, but I needed both hands for my bag and the seat back. Once seated I looked at the menu photo my friend sent. I'd choose there—don't order before I'd finished reading. He agreed and sent a picture of a glass of water.

text: 下车后我沿着小路走，差点又往桥上去。上次的路太熟，我走了几步才想起这次不用过桥，就停下来打开照片。电影院旁边的小店正好有人出来，红门和照片里一样。我给朋友发到了，避开门口等座位的人往里面走。大家已经坐好，旁边空着一把椅子，桌上还有我的水。朋友问是不是又走错门，我说差一点，你下次直接把店名写出来吧。他把菜单递给我，说先吃，吃完我慢慢念给你听。
pinyin: xià chē hòu wǒ yán zhe xiǎo lù zǒu , chà diǎn yòu wǎng qiáo shàng qù . shàng cì de lù tài shú , wǒ zǒu le jǐ bù cái xiǎng qǐ zhè cì bù yòng guò qiáo , jiù tíng xià lái dǎ kāi zhào piān . diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān de xiǎo diàn zhèng hǎo yǒu rén chū lái , hóng mén hé zhào piān lǐ yī yàng . wǒ gěi péng you fā dào le , bì kāi mén kǒu děng zuò wèi de rén wǎng lǐ miàn zǒu . dà jiā yǐ jīng zuò hǎo , páng biān kōng zhe yī bǎ yǐ zi , zhuō shàng hái yǒu wǒ de shuǐ . péng you wèn shì bú shì yòu zǒu cuò mén , wǒ shuō chà yī diǎn , nǐ xià cì zhí jiē bǎ diàn míng xiě chū lái ba . tā bǎ cài dān dì gěi wǒ , shuō xiān chī , chī wán wǒ màn màn niàn gěi nǐ tīng .
meaning: After getting off, I nearly followed the familiar route over the bridge. Remembering I didn't need to cross it, I stopped to check the photo. Someone was leaving the cinema-side shop; its red door matched. I texted that I'd arrived and went around the people waiting outside. My chair and water were ready. Had I gone to the wrong door again? Almost—write the shop name next time. He handed me the menu: eat first, then he'd read it very slowly to me.

text: 喝过水我们才谈演出。我说结尾不是不好，是我没听懂，朋友马上问哪句没听清。我笑着说这次听清了，只是不明白妹妹为什么把信留下。他说不是姐姐吗，我拿出节目单，指着妹妹的名字，让他想想后来回家那场。他看了半天，说自己好像漏了那一小段。我把记得的几句讲给他听，又问他前面的写信那场怎么样。这回轮到我想不起来，我们只好把节目单摊在桌上，从人物名字重新对一遍。
pinyin: hē guò shuǐ wǒ men cái tán yǎn chū . wǒ shuō jié wěi bù shì bù hǎo , shì wǒ méi tīng dǒng , péng you mǎ shàng wèn nǎ jù méi tīng qīng . wǒ xiào zhe shuō zhè cì tīng qīng le , zhǐ shì bù míng bái mèi mei wèi shén me bǎ xìn liú xià . tā shuō bù shì jiě jie ma , wǒ ná chū jié mù dān , zhǐ zhe mèi mei de míng zi , ràng tā xiǎng xiǎng hòu lái huí jiā nà chǎng . tā kàn le bàn tiān , shuō zì jǐ hǎo xiàng lòu le nà yī xiǎo duàn . wǒ bǎ jì de de jǐ jù jiǎng gěi tā tīng , yòu wèn tā qián miàn de xiě xìn nà chǎng zěn me yàng . zhè huí lún dào wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái , wǒ men zhǐ hǎo bǎ jié mù dān tān zài zhuō shàng , cóng rén wù míng zi chóng xīn duì yī biàn .
meaning: Over water I said the ending wasn't bad; I hadn't understood it. Which line hadn't I heard? My friend asked. This time I'd heard it; I didn't understand why the younger sister left the letter. Wasn't it the elder one? I pointed to the younger sister on the programme and the homecoming scene. He thought he'd missed that short section. I recounted what I remembered and asked about the earlier letter-writing scene. That was the part I couldn't recall, so we spread the programme on the table and checked the names together.

text: 聊到后来，刚才和我对节目单的朋友说，他以前看过前半场，后半场没看完；我却漏了开头，刚才问谁写信，正好问到自己没看的地方。陈宇在旁边拿手机找演出的日期，我看了一眼时间，说今天先别回去了，明天还要早起。他说不是现在，只想下次有空三个人一起看完整。我说好，日期以后再定，这回从开头坐到结束。服务员过来问还要什么，我们看着桌上剩下的菜，赶紧说不用了，先把这些吃完，吃完就各自回家。
pinyin: liáo dào hòu lái , gāng cái hé wǒ duì jié mù dān de péng you shuō , tā yǐ qián kàn guò qián bàn chǎng , hòu bàn chǎng méi kàn wán ; wǒ què lòu le kāi tóu , gāng cái wèn shéi xiě xìn , zhèng hǎo wèn dào zì jǐ méi kàn de dì fāng . chén yǔ zài páng biān ná shǒu jī zhǎo yǎn chū de rì qī , wǒ kàn le yī yǎn shí jiān , shuō jīn tiān xiān bié huí qù le , míng tiān hái yào zǎo qǐ . tā shuō bù shì xiàn zài , zhǐ xiǎng xià cì yǒu kōng sān gè rén yì qǐ kàn wán zhěng . wǒ shuō hǎo , rì qī yǐ hòu zài dìng , zhè huí cóng kāi tóu zuò dào jié shù . fú wù yuán guò lái wèn hái yào shén me , wǒ men kàn zhe zhuō shàng shèng xià de cài , gǎn jǐn shuō bù yòng le , xiān bǎ zhè xiē chī wán , chī wán jiù gè zì huí jiā .
meaning: The friend I'd checked the programme with had previously seen the first half but not all of the second; I'd missed the opening, including the letter-writing I'd asked about. Beside us, Chen Yu checked performance dates on his phone. We shouldn't go back tonight—we needed an early start. Not tonight, he said; sometime the three of us could watch the whole thing together. We left the date open and agreed to stay from start to finish. Asked if we wanted anything else, we looked at the food still on the table: finish this, then go home.

text: 我回去以后给他发消息，下一次店名和时间都写全，不只发一个红门。他回了一段故意说得很慢的语音，连店名都说了三遍。我说我听见了，你这样说，等你说完我又饿了。他发来一个笑脸，问那要不要现在再出来吃。我说明天吧，今天真的回家了。我们约好重要的变化先写一句，路上说笑还是照常。睡觉前他把明天的店名和时间发来，我回了个好，这次连地址也看完才放下手机。
pinyin: wǒ huí qù yǐ hòu gěi tā fā xiāo xī , xià yī cì diàn míng hé shí jiān dōu xiě quán , bù zhǐ fā yī gè hóng mén . tā huí le yī duàn gù yì shuō de hěn màn de yǔ yīn , lián diàn míng dōu shuō le sān biàn . wǒ shuō wǒ tīng jiàn le , nǐ zhè yàng shuō , děng nǐ shuō wán wǒ yòu è le . tā fā lái yī gè xiào liǎn , wèn nà yào bù yào xiàn zài zài chū lái chī . wǒ shuō míng tiān ba , jīn tiān zhēn de huí jiā le . wǒ men yuē hǎo zhòng yào de biàn huà xiān xiě yī jù , lù shàng shuō xiào hái shi zhào cháng . shuì jiào qián tā bǎ míng tiān de diàn míng hé shí jiān fā lái , wǒ huí le gè hǎo , zhè cì lián dì zhǐ yě kàn wán cái fàng xià shǒu jī .
meaning: After getting home I asked him to write out the shop name and time next time, instead of just sending “red door.” He replied with a deliberately slow voice message and repeated the name three times. I said I had heard him: at that speed I would be hungry again before he finished. He sent a smiling face and asked if I wanted to go back out for food. Tomorrow, I said; I really was home now. We agreed to text important changes but keep joking on the phone as usual. Before bed he sent tomorrow's shop name and time. I replied yes, this time reading the address too before putting my phone down.

le yī biàn . kàn zhe zhàn pái , wǒ yě zháo jí , kě chē hái méi lái , zhǐ hǎo xiān bǎ wǎn diǎn dào sān gè zì dǎ chū lái , zài ràng tā men gěi wǒ liú yī bǎ yǐ zi , bù yòng yì qǐ zhàn zài wài miàn chuī fēng . chē zhàn yǒu rén shuō huà , diàn huà nà tóu yòu yǒu sàn chǎng de xiǎng shēng , wǒ men liǎng biān dōu bù tài tīng de qīng . wǒ fā wén zì , bǎ wǎn diǎn dào xiě chū lái , zhàn zài chē zhàn jì xù děng . péng you yòu wèn duō jiǔ , wǒ tái tóu kàn le liǎng cì , chē zhōng yú lái le , cái bǔ le yī jù shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu . shàng chē yǐ hòu wǒ zhǎo dào kào chuāng de wèi zhì , bǎ gāng cái méi shuō wán de lù wèn qīng . tā shuō hóng mén jiù zài diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān , wǒ kàn zhe chuāng wài yī zhàn yī zhàn guò qù , kuài dào shí xiān fā le xiāo xī , ràng tā bù yòng zài zhàn mén kǒu zhǎo wǒ . péng you wèn yào bù yào tì wǒ diǎn chī de , wǒ shuō xiān bié diǎn , lù shàng yě xǔ huì mǎi yī diǎn . tā yòu wèn dào le yǐ hòu zài kàn ma , wǒ shuō duì , shuǐ kě yǐ xiān ná . gāng shuō wán , chē dào le , wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng jìn kǒu dài , shàng qù zhǎo zuò wèi . páng biān yǒu rén ná zhe miàn bāo , wǒ cái fā xiàn zì jǐ yě è le , kě liǎng zhǐ shǒu hái yào ná bāo hé fú zhù yǐ bèi , zhǐ hǎo xiān zuò xià lái . péng you fā lái cài dān zhào piān , wǒ kàn le liǎng yǎn , huí tā shuō dào le zì jǐ xuǎn , bié jí zhe diǎn , wǒ hái méi kàn wán . tā huí le gè hǎo , páng biān yòu fā lái yī zhǐ zhuāng shuǐ de bēi zi . xià chē hòu wǒ yán zhe xiǎo lù zǒu , chà diǎn yòu wǎng qiáo shàng qù . shàng cì de lù tài shú , wǒ zǒu le jǐ bù cái xiǎng qǐ zhè cì bù yòng guò qiáo , jiù tíng xià lái dǎ kāi zhào piān . diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān de xiǎo diàn zhèng hǎo yǒu rén chū lái , hóng mén hé zhào piān lǐ yī yàng . wǒ gěi péng you fā dào le , bì kāi mén kǒu děng zuò wèi de rén wǎng lǐ miàn zǒu . dà jiā yǐ jīng zuò hǎo , páng biān kōng zhe yī bǎ yǐ zi , zhuō shàng hái yǒu wǒ de shuǐ . péng you wèn shì bú shì yòu zǒu cuò mén , wǒ shuō chà yī diǎn , nǐ xià cì zhí jiē bǎ diàn míng xiě chū lái ba . tā bǎ cài dān dì gěi wǒ , shuō xiān chī , chī wán wǒ màn màn niàn gěi nǐ tīng . hē guò shuǐ wǒ men cái tán yǎn chū . wǒ shuō jié wěi bù shì bù hǎo , shì wǒ méi tīng dǒng , péng you mǎ shàng wèn nǎ jù méi tīng qīng . wǒ I was anxious too, but could only text that I'd arrive late and ask them to save a chair rather than stand outside in the wind. People were talking at the stop and the event was ending at the other end of the call. I texted that I'd arrive late and kept waiting. Asked how long, I looked up twice before the bus finally arrived; only then did I estimate about ten minutes. From a window seat I confirmed the red door beside the cinema, watched the stops go past and messaged near arrival so my friend wouldn't stand outside searching for me. Asked whether they should order for me, I said not yet; I might buy something on the way. I'd choose when I arrived, but water was fine. The bus came as I finished, and I put my phone away to board. Someone had bread, reminding me how hungry I was, but I needed both hands for my bag and the seat back. Once seated I looked at the menu photo my friend sent. I'd choose there—don't order before I'd finished reading. He agreed and sent a picture of a glass of water. After getting off, I nearly followed the familiar route over the bridge. Remembering I didn't need to cross it, I stopped to check the photo. Someone was leaving the cinema-side shop; its red door matched. I texted that I'd arrived and went around the people waiting outside. My chair and water were ready. Had I gone to the wrong door again? Almost—write the shop name next time. He handed me the menu: eat first, then he'd read it very slowly to me. Over water I said the ending wasn't bad; I hadn't understood it. Which line hadn't I heard? My friend asked. I replied yes, this time reading the address too before putting my phone down.

聊到后来，刚才和我对节目单的朋友说，他以前看过前半场，后半场没看完；我却漏了开头，刚才问谁写信，正好问到自己没看的地方。陈宇在旁边拿手机找演出的日期，我看了一眼时间，说今天先别回去了，明天还要早起。他说不是现在，只想下次有空三个人一起看完整。我说好，日期以后再定，这回从开头坐到结束。服务员过来问还要什么，我们看着桌上剩下的菜，赶紧说不用了，先把这些吃完，吃完就各自回家。
我回去以后给他发消息，下一次店名和时间都写全，不只发一个红门。他回了一段故意说得很慢的语音，连店名都说了三遍。我说我听见了，你这样说，等你说完我又饿了。他发来一个笑脸，问那要不要现在再出来吃。我说明天吧，今天真的回家了。我们约好重要的变化先写一句，路上说笑还是照常。睡觉前他把明天的店名和时间发来，我回了个好，这次连地址也看完才放下手机。

text: 最后一段你没拆信，我还以为忘了。
pinyin: zuì hòu yī duàn nǐ méi chāi xìn , wǒ hái yǐ wéi wàng le .
meaning: You didn't open the letter at the end.I thought you'd forgotten.

text: 没忘，写的就是没拆。
pinyin: méi wàng , xiě de jiù shì méi chāi .
meaning: I hadn't—that's what's written.

text: 那里面到底是什么？
pinyin: nà lǐ miàn dào dǐ shì shén me ?
meaning: What exactly is inside?

text: 没写给观众看。你可以猜，别说你已经知道。
pinyin: méi xiě gěi guān zhòng kàn . nǐ kě yǐ cāi , bié shuō nǐ yǐ jīng zhī dào .
meaning: The audience isn't shown.You can guess,but can't call it known.

text: 我猜是让她别走。
pinyin: wǒ cāi shì ràng tā bié zǒu .
meaning: I guessed it asks her not to leave.

text: 也可能是到了再看。结尾没有给答案。
pinyin: yě kě néng shì dào le zài kàn . jié wěi méi yǒu gěi dá àn .
meaning: It could be for after arrival.The ending gives no answer.

text: 你唱的那句灯还亮着，是等她回来？
pinyin: nǐ chàng de nà jù dēng hái liàng zhe , shì děng tā huí lái ?
meaning: The light still on in the song—is that waiting for her return?

text: 可以这么听，也可以是今晚还没结束。
pinyin: kě yǐ zhè me tīng , yě kě yǐ shì jīn wǎn hái méi jié shù .
meaning: You can hear it that way,or as tonight not being over yet.

text: 没有写下周回来，对吧？
pinyin: méi yǒu xiě xià zhōu huí lái , duì ba ?
meaning: No next-week return date,right?

text: 对。别替歌词订车票。
pinyin: duì . bié tì gē cí dìng chē piào .
meaning: Right.Don't book a ticket on the lyrics' behalf.

text: 好。那现实里你明天几点的车？
pinyin: hǎo . nà xiàn shí lǐ nǐ míng tiān jǐ diǎn de chē ?
meaning: Okay.In real life,when's your train tomorrow?

text: 九点。八点半在入口见就行。
pinyin: jiǔ diǎn . bā diǎn bàn zài rù kǒu jiàn jiù xíng .
meaning: Nine.See you at the entrance at eight thirty.

text: 我来送你。想吃点什么？
pinyin: wǒ lái sòng nǐ . xiǎng chī diǎn shén me ?
meaning: I'll see you off.Want anything to eat?

text: 不用特意买，带水就好。
pinyin: bù yòng tè yì mǎi , dài shuǐ jiù hǎo .
meaning: No special shopping.Just water.

text: 其他人也来？
pinyin: qí tā rén yě lái ?
meaning: Are the others coming too?

text: 他们要上班，别替我把全组叫来。
pinyin: tā men yào shàng bān , bié tì wǒ bǎ quán zǔ jiào lái .
meaning: They have work.Don't call the whole group for me.

text: 知道了。今晚还能再唱一遍吗？
pinyin: zhī dào le . jīn wǎn hái néng zài chàng yī biàn ma ?
meaning: Got it.Can we sing once more tonight?

text: 九点半了，先收东西。场馆十点关。
pinyin: jiǔ diǎn bàn le , xiān shōu dōng xi . chǎng guǎn shí diǎn guān .
meaning: It's nine thirty.Put things away first.The venue closes at ten.

text: 那你要回去休息。
pinyin: nà nǐ yào huí qù xiū xī .
meaning: Then you need rest.

text: 好，没唱完留一点，下次接着唱。
pinyin: hǎo , méi chàng wán liú yī diǎn , xià cì jiē zhe chàng .
meaning: Yes.Leave a little unfinished;continue next time.

text: 这句可以写到群里。
pinyin: zhè jù kě yǐ xiě dào qún lǐ .
meaning: We can put that in the group.

text: 可以，别写下周已经约好了。
pinyin: kě yǐ , bié xiě xià zhōu yǐ jīng yuē hǎo le .
meaning: Yes,but don't say next week is already booked.

text: 到了给我们留言。
pinyin: dào le gěi wǒ men liú yán .
meaning: Message when you arrive.

text: 会的。这句是承诺，不用拿来猜结尾。
pinyin: huì de . zhè jù shì chéng nuò , bù yòng ná lái cāi jié wěi .
meaning: I will.That one's a promise,no need to interpret it like the ending.

text: 短剧最后一幕在车站，主角把一封信递给要走的朋友。她接过来，放进包，没有拆。灯慢慢暗下来，旁边的歌唱到门还没关。我坐在第三排，看见她拉好包带，回头望了一眼，觉得信里肯定是在叫她别走。散场后我把这个想法讲给陈宇，他问哪一句写了别走。我翻节目单找了半天，没有找到。他笑着说刚才连信都没拆，你怎么看到里面的字。我只好把节目单合上，说好吧，那是我猜的。
pinyin: duǎn jù zuì hòu yī mù zài chē zhàn , zhǔ jué bǎ yī fēng xìn dì gěi yào zǒu de péng you . tā jiē guò lái , fàng jìn bāo , méi yǒu chāi . dēng màn màn àn xià lái , páng biān de gē chàng dào mén hái méi guān . wǒ zuò zài dì sān pái , kàn jiàn tā lā hǎo bāo dài , huí tóu wàng le yī yǎn , jué de xìn lǐ kěn dìng shì zài jiào tā bié zǒu . sàn chǎng hòu wǒ bǎ zhè gè xiǎng fǎ jiǎng gěi chén yǔ , tā wèn nǎ yī jù xiě le bié zǒu . wǒ fān jié mù dān zhǎo le bàn tiān , méi yǒu zhǎo dào . tā xiào zhe shuō gāng cái lián xìn dōu méi chāi , nǐ zěn me kàn dào lǐ miàn de zì . wǒ zhǐ hǎo bǎ jié mù dān hé shàng , shuō hǎo ba , nà shì wǒ cāi de .
meaning: In the final station scene, the lead handed a letter to the departing friend. She put it in her bag without opening it. As the lights dimmed, the song mentioned an open door. From the third row, her tightened strap and backward glance made me sure the letter asked her not to leave. Afterwards Chen Yu asked which line said that. I searched the programme without finding it. She hadn't even opened the letter—how had I seen its words? I closed the programme and admitted it was my guess.

text: 陈宇问我为什么这样猜，我说她回头时停了好一会儿，歌也还没结束。他倒觉得那封信是让她到了以后再看，因为前面她说过到了再告诉你。我拿节目单指给他看，问那桌边写信写了那么久呢，他说所以才有很多话，不一定只写别走。我们从最后一幕又讲回前面，越讲越想再看一次。旁边一个朋友插进来，说你们两个猜了半天，还没问演戏的人。我们一起转头，才发现林安已经拿着水出来了。
pinyin: chén yǔ wèn wǒ wèi shén me zhè yàng cāi , wǒ shuō tā huí tóu shí tíng le hǎo yī huì er , gē yě hái méi jié shù . tā dào jué de nà fēng xìn shì ràng tā dào le yǐ hòu zài kàn , yīn wèi qián miàn tā shuō guò dào le zài gào sù nǐ . wǒ ná jié mù dān zhǐ gěi tā kàn , wèn nà zhuō biān xiě xìn xiě le nà me jiǔ ne , tā shuō suǒ yǐ cái yǒu hěn duō huà , bù yí dìng zhǐ xiě bié zǒu . wǒ men cóng zuì hòu yī mù yòu jiǎng huí qián miàn , yuè jiǎng yuè xiǎng zài kàn yī cì . páng biān yī gè péng you chā jìn lái , shuō nǐ men liǎng gè cāi le bàn tiān , hái méi wèn yǎn xì de rén . wǒ men yì qǐ zhuǎn tóu , cái fā xiàn lín ān yǐ jīng ná zhe shuǐ chū lái le .
meaning: Why had I guessed that? Her backward glance lasted, and the song wasn't over. Chen Yu thought she might read the letter after arriving, recalling 'I'll tell you when I get there.' What about the long letter-writing scene? There could be plenty to say beyond asking her to stay. We talked backwards through the play and increasingly wanted another viewing. A friend interrupted: we'd spent all this time guessing without asking the actors. Turning around, we found Lin An had already emerged with water.

text: 林安从后台出来，还拿着半杯水。她今晚演要走的朋友，明早也要坐车去另一个城市，大家围过来就先问信里写了什么。她笑着说剧本没有写，问我们各猜了什么。一个朋友说肯定是让她下周回来，她举起水杯，说先让我把这杯喝完，下周还得看工作。我说好，那明天几点送你，她终于把手机拿出来，指着九点的车次给我看。她点开日期，我这才看清车票早就买好了。
pinyin: lín ān cóng hòu tái chū lái , hái ná zhe bàn bēi shuǐ . tā jīn wǎn yǎn yào zǒu de péng you , míng zǎo yě yào zuò chē qù lìng yī gè chéng shì , dà jiā wéi guò lái jiù xiān wèn xìn lǐ xiě le shén me . tā xiào zhe shuō jù běn méi yǒu xiě , wèn wǒ men gè cāi le shén me . yī gè péng you shuō kěn dìng shì ràng tā xià zhōu huí lái , tā jǔ qǐ shuǐ bēi , shuō xiān ràng wǒ bǎ zhè bēi hē wán , xià zhōu hái děi kàn gōng zuò . wǒ shuō hǎo , nà míng tiān jǐ diǎn sòng nǐ , tā zhōng yú bǎ shǒu jī ná chū lái , zhǐ zhe jiǔ diǎn de chē cì gěi wǒ kàn . tā diǎn kāi rì qī , wǒ zhè cái kàn qīng chē piào zǎo jiù mǎi hǎo le .
meaning: Lin An came backstage with half a cup of water. Like her departing character, she'd travel to another city tomorrow. We crowded round to ask what the letter said. The script didn't say; what did we think? Someone thought it asked her back next week. First let her finish her water, she laughed; next week depended on work. Asked about tomorrow, she showed me the nine o'clock departure on her phone. Opening the date, she let me see that the ticket was already booked.

text: 我还想再听一遍歌，问能不能从灯还亮着那句再来。林安看了看表，说九点半了，十点关门，先收东西吧。陈宇把设备关掉，我和朋友把椅子搬回墙边，刚才坐过的地方一下空了。到了门口，林安轻声唱起今晚这句已经有人听见，我跟着接后面，却又忘了词。她把节目单递给我，上面写着把下一页留给下一次见面。我照着唱完，问下一次是哪天，她说现在还不知道，先让我明天坐上车吧。
pinyin: wǒ hái xiǎng zài tīng yī biàn gē , wèn néng bù néng cóng dēng hái liàng zhe nà jù zài lái . lín ān kàn le kàn biǎo , shuō jiǔ diǎn bàn le , shí diǎn guān mén , xiān shōu dōng xi ba . chén yǔ bǎ shè bèi guān diào , wǒ hé péng you bǎ yǐ zi bān huí qiáng biān , gāng cái zuò guò de dì fāng yī xià kōng le . dào le mén kǒu , lín ān qīng shēng chàng qǐ jīn wǎn zhè jù yǐ jīng yǒu rén tīng jiàn , wǒ gēn zhe jiē hòu miàn , què yòu wàng le cí . tā bǎ jié mù dān dì gěi wǒ , shàng miàn xiě zhe bǎ xià yī yè liú gěi xià yī cì jiàn miàn . wǒ zhào zhe chàng wán , wèn xià yī cì shì nǎ tiān , tā shuō xiàn zài hái bù zhī dào , xiān ràng wǒ míng tiān zuò shàng chē ba .
meaning: Could we sing again from 'the light is still on'? Lin An checked the time: 9:30, with closing at ten; we'd pack first. Chen Yu shut down the equipment while we carried chairs to the wall. At the door she quietly sang 'someone has heard this line tonight.' I tried to join but forgot the words again. Her programme supplied 'leave the next page for our next meeting.' After singing it, I asked when that would be. She didn't know yet—first let her catch tomorrow's train.

text: 第二天我八点半到车站入口，带了一瓶水。林安拉着箱子过来，问其他人呢，我说几个要上班，今天就我来。她接过水，让我帮她拿一下包，自己把箱子上的节目单收进去。我们站到不挡人的地方，又聊昨晚那封信，她还是让我自己猜。我问到了以后能不能告诉我们一声，她说可以，到了就在群里发消息。九点的车快开了，她拿回包，挥挥手走进入口。我站了一会儿，才发现自己手里还拿着没打开的另一瓶水。
pinyin: dì èr tiān wǒ bā diǎn bàn dào chē zhàn rù kǒu , dài le yī píng shuǐ . lín ān lā zhe xiāng zi guò lái , wèn qí tā rén ne , wǒ shuō jǐ gè yào shàng bān , jīn tiān jiù wǒ lái . tā jiē guò shuǐ , ràng wǒ bāng tā ná yī xià bāo , zì jǐ bǎ xiāng zi shàng de jié mù dān shōu jìn qù . wǒ men zhàn dào bù dǎng rén de dì fāng , yòu liáo zuó wǎn nà fēng xìn , tā hái shi ràng wǒ zì jǐ cāi . wǒ wèn dào le yǐ hòu néng bù néng gào sù wǒ men yī shēng , tā shuō kě yǐ , dào le jiù zài qún lǐ fā xiāo xī . jiǔ diǎn de chē kuài kāi le , tā ná huí bāo , huī huī shǒu zǒu jìn rù kǒu . wǒ zhàn le yī huì er , cái fā xiàn zì jǐ shǒu lǐ hái ná zhe méi dǎ kāi de lìng yī píng shuǐ .
meaning: At 8:30 I met Lin An at the station entrance with water. Where were the others? Some had work; it was just me. She had me hold her bag while she packed the programme from her suitcase. Standing out of the way, we discussed the letter again; she still left me to guess. Could she let us know when she arrived? Yes, she'd message the group. With the nine o'clock train nearing departure, she took back her bag and waved. After watching her go, I noticed the other unopened bottle still in my hand.

text: 第二天晚上她发来照片，窗外有很远的灯，配了一句到了，明天再收东西。我把昨天的节目单夹进书里，回她今天有没有忘带伞。她说没有，水也喝完了，又问最后那段录像能不能发给她。我找到递信以后的一小段，先看了一遍，还是没见到信里面写什么。发过去时，我说这回终于把你唱的最后一句听全，下次见面再讲我猜的结尾。
pinyin: dì èr tiān wǎn shang tā fā lái zhào piān , chuāng wài yǒu hěn yuǎn de dēng , pèi le yī jù dào le , míng tiān zài shōu dōng xi . wǒ bǎ zuó tiān de jié mù dān jiā jìn shū lǐ , huí tā jīn tiān yǒu méi yǒu wàng dài sǎn . tā shuō méi yǒu , shuǐ yě hē wán le , yòu wèn zuì hòu nà duàn lù xiàng néng bù néng fā gěi tā . wǒ zhǎo dào dì xìn yǐ hòu de yī xiǎo duàn , xiān kàn le yī biàn , hái shi méi jiàn dào xìn lǐ miàn xiě shén me . fā guò qù shí , wǒ shuō zhè huí zhōng yú bǎ nǐ chàng de zuì hòu yī jù tīng quán , xià cì jiàn miàn zài jiǎng wǒ cāi de jié wěi .
meaning: The next evening she sent a photo of distant lights outside: she'd arrived and would unpack tomorrow. I tucked yesterday's programme inside a book and asked if she'd forgotten her umbrella. I sent it, saying I'd finally caught her full last line and would share my guessed ending next time we met.

meaning: In the final station scene, the lead handed a letter to the departing friend. She put it in her bag without opening it. As the lights dimmed, the song mentioned an open door. From the third row, her tightened strap and backward glance made me sure the letter asked her not to leave. Afterwards Chen Yu asked which line said that. I searched the programme without finding it. She hadn't even opened the letter—how had I seen its words? I closed the programme and admitted it was my guess. Why had I guessed that? Her backward glance lasted, and the song wasn't over. Chen Yu thought she might read the letter after arriving, recalling 'I'll tell you when I get there.' What about the long letter-writing scene? There could be plenty to say beyond asking her to stay. We talked backwards through the play and increasingly wanted another viewing. A friend interrupted: we'd spent all this time guessing without asking the actors. Turning around, we found Lin An had already emerged with water. Lin An came backstage with half a cup of water. Like her departing character, she'd travel to another city tomorrow. We crowded round to ask what the letter said. The script didn't say; what did we think? Someone thought it asked her back next week. First let her finish her water, she laughed; next week depended on work. Asked about tomorrow, she showed me the nine o'clock departure on her phone. Opening the date, she let me see that the ticket was already booked. Could we sing again from 'the light is still on'? Lin An checked the time: 9:30, with closing at ten; we'd pack first. Chen Yu shut down the equipment while we carried chairs to the wall. At the door she quietly sang 'someone has heard this line tonight.' I tried to join but forgot the words again. Her programme supplied 'leave the next page for our next meeting.' After singing it, I asked when that would be. She didn't know yet—first let her catch tomorrow's train. At 8:30 I met Lin An at the station entrance with water. Where were the others? Some had work; it was just me. She had me hold her bag while she packed the programme from her suitcase. Standing out of the way, we discussed the letter again; she still left me to guess. Could she let us know when she arrived? Yes, she'd message the group. With the nine o'clock train nearing departure, she took back her bag and waved. After watching her go, I noticed the other unopened bottle still in my hand. No, and she'd finished the water too. Could I send the last part of the video? Watching the section after the letter was handed over, I still couldn't see its contents. I sent it, saying I'd finally caught her full last line and would share my guessed ending next time we met.

meaning: The rain beside the window hasn't stopped,

text: 你把最后一句留在门边。

meaning: You leave the final sentence by the door.

text: 我把灯调暗一点，

text: 让没说完的话坐在身边。

meaning: And let unfinished words sit beside me.

text: 远处有人叫你的名字，

text: 脚步从这一页走向明天。

text: 灯还亮着，门还没关，

meaning: The light is still on,the door still open,

text: 我在雨里听见一段歌，

meaning: In the rain I hear a piece of song,

text: 唱到这里，先停一停。

text: 下一页留给下一次见面，

text: 今晚这句，已经有人听见。
pinyin: jīn wǎn zhè jù , yǐ jīng yǒu rén tīng jiàn .
meaning: Someone has already heard tonight's line.

text: 窗边的雨还没有停，你把最后一句留在门边。我把灯调暗一点，让没说完的话坐在身边。远处有人叫你的名字，脚步从这一页走向明天。灯还亮着，门还没关，不是每一次等候都要答案。我在雨里听见一段歌，唱到这里，先停一停。下一页留给下一次见面，今晚这句，已经有人听见。
pinyin: chuāng biān de yǔ hái méi yǒu tíng , nǐ bǎ zuì hòu yī jù liú zài mén biān . wǒ bǎ dēng diào àn yī diǎn , ràng méi shuō wán de huà zuò zài shēn biān . yuǎn chù yǒu rén jiào nǐ de míng zi , jiǎo bù cóng zhè yī yè zǒu xiàng míng tiān . dēng hái liàng zhe , mén hái méi guān , bù shì měi yī cì děng hòu dōu yào dá àn . wǒ zài yǔ lǐ tīng jiàn yī duàn gē , chàng dào zhè lǐ , xiān tíng yī tíng . xià yī yè liú gěi xià yī cì jiàn miàn , jīn wǎn zhè jù , yǐ jīng yǒu rén tīng jiàn .
meaning: The rain beside the window hasn't stopped, You leave the final sentence by the door. I turn the light down a little, And let unfinished words sit beside me. Someone far away calls your name, Footsteps walk from this page towards tomorrow. The light is still on,the door still open, Not every wait needs an answer. In the rain I hear a piece of song, Sing this far,and pause for now. Leave the next page for the next meeting, Someone has already heard tonight's line.

meaning: The story moved her deeply.

text: 他们坐在岸边听海浪。
pinyin: tā men zuò zài àn biān tīng hǎi làng .
meaning: They sit by the shore listening to waves.

text: 这封信来自远方。
pinyin: zhè fēng xìn lái zì yuǎn fāng .
meaning: This letter comes from far away.

text: 她有时觉得孤独，仍愿意联系朋友。
pinyin: tā yǒu shí jué de gū dú , réng yuàn yì lián xì péng you .
meaning: She sometimes feels lonely but still wants to contact friends.

text: 这些交流能增进感情。
pinyin: zhè xiē jiāo liú néng zēng jìn gǎn qíng .
meaning: These exchanges can strengthen affection.

text: 两种安排之间需要平衡。
pinyin: liǎng zhǒng ān pái zhī jiān xū yào píng héng .
meaning: The two arrangements need balancing.

text: 作品融合了两种形式。
pinyin: zuò pǐn róng hé le liǎng zhǒng xíng shì .
meaning: The work blends two forms.

text: 别把每个元素都解释成一个人。
pinyin: bié bǎ měi gè yuán sù dōu jiě shì chéng yī gè rén .
meaning: Don't interpret every element as a person.

text: 他愿意演奏最后一段。
pinyin: tā yuàn yì yǎn zòu zuì hòu yī duàn .
meaning: He's willing to play the final passage.

text: 我先把歌词读完整。
pinyin: wǒ xiān bǎ gē cí dú wán zhěng .
meaning: I'll read the full lyrics first.

text: 她想找到合适的节奏。
pinyin: tā xiǎng zhǎo dào hé shì de jié zòu .
meaning: She wants to find a suitable rhythm.

text: 这首乐曲我想再听一遍。
pinyin: zhè shǒu yuè qǔ wǒ xiǎng zài tīng yī biàn .
meaning: I'd like to hear this piece again.

text: 同一场景又上演了一次。
pinyin: tóng yī chǎng jǐng yòu shàng yǎn le yī cì .

text: 你从哪一幕改变了对主角的看法？
pinyin: nǐ cóng nǎ yī mù gǎi biàn le duì zhǔ jué de kàn fǎ ?
meaning: Which scene changed your view of the lead?

text: 换了场景，人物关系没有全变。
pinyin: huàn le chǎng jǐng , rén wù guān xì méi yǒu quán biàn .
meaning: The setting changes without every relationship changing.

text: 先确认场馆的开放时间。
pinyin: xiān què rèn chǎng guǎn de kāi fàng shí jiān .
meaning: First confirm the venue's opening hours.

text: 她说不用每个人都来送行。
pinyin: tā shuō bù yòng měi gè rén dōu lái sòng xíng .
meaning: She says not everyone needs to see her off.

text: 这是一场难忘的见面。
pinyin: zhè shì yī chǎng nán wàng de jiàn miàn .

text: 她为错过那一幕感到遗憾。

text: 先听情绪，再看具体的词。
pinyin: xiān tīng qíng xù , zài kàn jù tǐ de cí .

text: 那句话里隐藏着一个没问出来的问题。
pinyin: nà jù huà lǐ yǐn cáng zhe yī gè méi wèn chū lái de wèn tí .

text: 她透露了下一场的地点。
pinyin: tā tòu lù le xià yī chǎng de dì diǎn .

text: 她收藏了几张旧照片。
pinyin: tā shōu cáng le jǐ zhāng jiù zhào piān .

text: 她盼望收到朋友的消息。

text: 他留言说今天会晚一点。
pinyin: tā liú yán shuō jīn tiān huì wǎn yī diǎn .

text: 她承诺到了以后发消息。
pinyin: tā chéng nuò dào le yǐ hòu fā xiāo xī .
meaning: She promised to message after arriving.

text: 她的心愿是走之前再一起唱一次。这个心愿一直没有说出口。这首歌写心灵里没有说完的话。书里的故事触动了她的心灵。海浪的声音接在最后一句后面。他们坐在岸边听海浪。她要去远方，但没有说永远不回来。这封信来自远方。这一句有孤独，也有期待。她有时觉得孤独，仍愿意联系朋友。一起排练增进了了解。这些交流能增进感情。我想平衡演出和休息。两种安排之间需要平衡。这段把说话和音乐融合起来。作品融合了两种形式。雨声是这段音乐的一个元素。别把每个元素都解释成一个人。演奏结束后，她才把信拿出来。他愿意演奏最后一段。歌词没有写归来的日期。我先把歌词读完整。这一段节奏慢下来，话却没变。她想找到合适的节奏。乐曲在说话之后开始。这首乐曲我想再听一遍。这段短剧今晚首次上演。同一场景又上演了一次。她上台以前先喝了水。上台并不表示不紧张。主角最后没有拆信。你从哪一幕改变了对主角的看法？这个场景发生在车站。换了场景，人物关系没有全变。场馆十点关闭。先确认场馆的开放时间。明早我们去车站送行。她说不用每个人都来送行。那段安静让我很难忘。这是一场难忘的见面。没唱完有点遗憾，但还能下次接着唱。她为错过那一幕感到遗憾。她的情绪在最后一段变了。先听情绪，再看具体的词。她没有隐藏要走的事。那句话里隐藏着一个没问出来的问题。结尾只透露他已经写过信。她透露了下一场的地点。我想收藏这张节目单。她收藏了几张旧照片。经过一番商量，我们先收东西。她一番话让我明白了。这段时而轻，时而响。她时而笑，时而看窗外。早晚还会见面，不等于已经定好日期。这个问题早晚要面对。她仿佛想说什么，又停了。雨声仿佛从窗外进来。我盼望下次一起唱。她盼望收到朋友的消息。到了以后给我们留言。他留言说今天会晚一点。没有确定时间，就别承诺周末回来。她承诺到了以后发消息。

text: 写这首歌的时候，我先写了灯还亮着，再把它放进车站那场戏后面。排练时有人说灯就是等那个朋友回来，我拿着吉他想了一会儿，说我开始写的是人走了，话还留在那个晚上。他说听起来也像在等，我就请他唱一遍他的版本。轮到我唱，最后一句又慢了一点，两个人把录音听完，都觉得那盏灯和开始写时已经有点不一样。至于下周，我连自己的工作时间还没排好，歌词里也确实没写日期。
pinyin: xiě zhè shǒu gē de shí hou , wǒ xiān xiě le dēng hái liàng zhe , zài bǎ tā fàng jìn chē zhàn nà chǎng xì hòu miàn . pái liàn shí yǒu rén shuō dēng jiù shì děng nà gè péng you huí lái , wǒ ná zhe jí tā xiǎng le yī huì er , shuō wǒ kāi shǐ xiě de shì rén zǒu le , huà hái liú zài nà gè wǎn shang . tā shuō tīng qǐ lái yě xiàng zài děng , wǒ jiù qǐng tā chàng yī biàn tā de bǎn běn . lún dào wǒ chàng , zuì hòu yī jù yòu màn le yī diǎn , liǎng gè rén bǎ lù yīn tīng wán , dōu jué de nà zhǎn dēng hé kāi shǐ xiě shí yǐ jīng yǒu diǎn bù yī yàng . zhì yú xià zhōu , wǒ lián zì jǐ de gōng zuò shí jiān hái méi pái hǎo , gē cí lǐ yě què shí méi xiě rì qī .
meaning: I first wrote 'the light is still on,' then placed it after the station scene. Someone heard waiting for the friend to return. Holding my guitar, I said I'd begun with someone leaving while the words stayed in that evening. We each sang a version; mine slowed the last line. Listening back, the lamp felt a little different from when I'd written it. As for next week, my own work schedule wasn't set, and the lyric gave no date.

text: 后来林安建议把下一页留给下一次见面放到后面，而不是开头。前面的雨声和脚步让人先听见离开，后面的那句才带出再见面的盼望。我喜欢这个顺序，可第一次唱太快，下一页几乎跟上一句粘在一起。朋友听完问，结尾不是说先停一停吗，怎么又约见面？我把两句完整读给他听，再按句子分开唱。他跟着读了一遍，笑着说这次听到了，不过最后那个面还能再留长一点。我试着慢下来，林安在旁边数了四下，两个人终于能接上。
pinyin: hòu lái lín ān jiàn yì bǎ xià yī yè liú gěi xià yī cì jiàn miàn fàng dào hòu miàn , ér bù shì kāi tóu . qián miàn de yǔ shēng hé jiǎo bù ràng rén xiān tīng jiàn lí kāi , hòu miàn de nà jù cái dài chū zài jiàn miàn de pàn wàng . wǒ xǐ huān zhè gè shùn xù , kě dì yī cì chàng tài kuài , xià yī yè jī hū gēn shàng yī jù zhān zài yì qǐ . péng you tīng wán wèn , jié wěi bù shì shuō xiān tíng yī tíng ma , zěn me yòu yuē jiàn miàn ? wǒ bǎ liǎng jù wán zhěng dú gěi tā tīng , zài àn jù zi fēn kāi chàng . tā gēn zhe dú le yī biàn , xiào zhe shuō zhè cì tīng dào le , bù guò zuì hòu nà gè miàn hái néng zài liú zhǎng yī diǎn . wǒ shì zhe màn xià lái , lín ān zài páng biān shù le sì xià , liǎng gè rén zhōng yú néng jiē shàng .
meaning: Lin An suggested putting 'leave the next page for our next meeting' near the end. Rain and footsteps first suggested departure; the later line brought back the hope of meeting. But I sang too quickly, joining it to the preceding phrase. My friend heard 'pause for now' and wondered why we were arranging a meeting. I read both lines in full, then sang them separately. He heard it this time, but suggested holding the final syllable a little longer. With Lin An counting four beats, we finally joined in time.

text: 我负责演奏，不演拿信的角色，所以排练时常从旁边看两人。有一次林安忘了把信放进包，直接拿在手上走，画面就像她随时会拆。我们试了两次，最后还是把信收进包，走到门边再回头。包带拉好以后，她看了一眼对方，没有拆信，就转身走。排练完，她问我刚才回头是不是太快。我说只看见头发动了，还没看清表情。她拿起包又走了一遍，回头时多停了一点。我举起吉他，按她走出去的速度再弹两句。陈宇站在门外听，提醒我们别走到一半就把灯关掉。
pinyin: wǒ fù zé yǎn zòu , bù yǎn ná xìn de jué sè , suǒ yǐ pái liàn shí cháng cóng páng biān kàn liǎng rén . yǒu yī cì lín ān wàng le bǎ xìn fàng jìn bāo , zhí jiē ná zài shǒu shàng zǒu , huà miàn jiù xiàng tā suí shí huì chāi . wǒ men shì le liǎng cì , zuì hòu hái shi bǎ xìn shōu jìn bāo , zǒu dào mén biān zài huí tóu . bāo dài lā hǎo yǐ hòu , tā kàn le yī yǎn duì fāng , méi yǒu chāi xìn , jiù zhuǎn shēn zǒu . pái liàn wán , tā wèn wǒ gāng cái huí tóu shì bú shì tài kuài . wǒ shuō zhǐ kàn jiàn tóu fà dòng le , hái méi kàn qīng biǎo qíng . tā ná qǐ bāo yòu zǒu le yī biàn , huí tóu shí duō tíng le yī diǎn . wǒ jǔ qǐ jí tā , àn tā zǒu chū qù de sù dù zài dàn liǎng jù . chén yǔ zhàn zài mén wài tīng , tí xǐng wǒ men bié zǒu dào yí bàn jiù bǎ dēng guān diào .
meaning: As the musician, I watched the two actors from the side. Once Lin An left carrying the letter in her hand, looking ready to open it. After two trials, we put it in the bag and had her look back at the door. She fastened the strap, looked at the other character and left without opening the letter. Had she turned too quickly? I'd seen her hair move but missed her expression. She tried again, pausing longer as she turned. I played two phrases to match her departure; listening outside, Chen reminded us not to switch off the light halfway through.

text: 演出那晚，有人把戏里的离开和林安明早坐车连在一起，围着她问以后还回不回来。她举着水杯，说先别急，明早九点的车，八点半入口见，带水就好。要上班的人不用特意赶去。我第二天有工作，听完松了口气，今晚还可以留下收东西。她把没喝完的水放到桌上，和我一起卷起节目单，说到了以后会发消息，我就请她到时把新房间拍给我们看。
pinyin: yǎn chū nà wǎn , yǒu rén bǎ xì lǐ de lí kāi hé lín ān míng zǎo zuò chē lián zài yì qǐ , wéi zhe tā wèn yǐ hòu hái huí bù huí lái . tā jǔ zhe shuǐ bēi , shuō xiān bié jí , míng zǎo jiǔ diǎn de chē , bā diǎn bàn rù kǒu jiàn , dài shuǐ jiù hǎo . yào shàng bān de rén bù yòng tè yì gǎn qù . wǒ dì èr tiān yǒu gōng zuò , tīng wán sōng le kǒu qì , jīn wǎn hái kě yǐ liú xià shōu dōng xi . tā bǎ méi hē wán de shuǐ fàng dào zhuō shàng , hé wǒ yì qǐ juǎn qǐ jié mù dān , shuō dào le yǐ hòu huì fā xiāo xī , wǒ jiù qǐng tā dào shí bǎ xīn fáng jiān pāi gěi wǒ men kàn .
meaning: After the performance we crowded round Lin An asking about returns. Holding her cup, she gave tomorrow's plan: a nine o'clock departure, meet at the entrance at 8:30, just bring water. People working needn't rush over. I had work and was relieved; I could still help pack tonight. Rolling up programmes together, she promised to message on arrival. I asked for a photograph of her new room.

text: 九点半以后，我们把设备关好。读书的人收纸，工作人员卷线，我把乐器装回盒子。有人走过来说再唱一分钟吧，我指着已经拔掉的线，说唱以前还得重新接线、调音，唱完又要收一遍。他看看空下来的桌子，说那算了，帮我把椅子搬过去。我在门口轻轻哼了一句，林安把最后一行接上，大家笑了。刚才还想再唱的人也跟着哼，没有回去开设备。工作人员拿来最后一把椅子，问我们明天是不是还起得来，我们马上把门让开，一边笑一边往外走。
pinyin: jiǔ diǎn bàn yǐ hòu , wǒ men bǎ shè bèi guān hǎo . dú shū de rén shōu zhǐ , gōng zuò rén yuán juǎn xiàn , wǒ bǎ yuè qì zhuāng huí hé zi . yǒu rén zǒu guò lái shuō zài chàng yī fēn zhōng ba , wǒ zhǐ zhe yǐ jīng bá diào de xiàn , shuō chàng yǐ qián hái děi chóng xīn jiē xiàn , diào yīn , chàng wán yòu yào shōu yī biàn . tā kàn kàn kōng xià lái de zhuō zi , shuō nà suàn le , bāng wǒ bǎ yǐ zi bān guò qù . wǒ zài mén kǒu qīng qīng hēng le yī jù , lín ān bǎ zuì hòu yī xíng jiē shàng , dà jiā xiào le . gāng cái hái xiǎng zài chàng de rén yě gēn zhe hēng , méi yǒu huí qù kāi shè bèi . gōng zuò rén yuán ná lái zuì hòu yī bǎ yǐ zi , wèn wǒ men míng tiān shì bú shì hái qǐ de lái , wǒ men mǎ shàng bǎ mén ràng kāi , yī biān xiào yī biān wǎng wài zǒu .
meaning: After 9:30 we shut down the equipment. Others gathered papers and coiled cables while I packed my instrument. Someone asked for one more minute of singing. I pointed to the disconnected cable: we'd have to reconnect, tune and pack again. Looking at the cleared table, he offered to carry chairs instead. At the door I hummed a phrase; Lin An joined the last line, and we laughed. Even the friend who'd wanted more singing hummed along without restarting anything. Carrying the final chair, a staff member asked if we'd manage to get up tomorrow. We moved out of the doorway, still laughing.

text: 第二天，我在群里看见林安到了的消息，回她新房间看起来怎么样。她说窗很大，东西还没收好，先问昨晚的录像在哪里。我找到文件，把递信和最后一首歌那两段发过去。后来有人问下一次什么时候，我说还没定，等大家把各自的时间发来再约。林安听完录音，指出最后一句比排练时慢，我也发现陈宇在门外那句提醒被录进去了。我们给重复的歌词标了两处，把这一版存好。她说先去收箱子，晚上再听，我回她好，别又把那半杯水忘在桌上。
pinyin: dì èr tiān , wǒ zài qún lǐ kàn jiàn lín ān dào le de xiāo xī , huí tā xīn fáng jiān kàn qǐ lái zěn me yàng . tā shuō chuāng hěn dà , dōng xi hái mò shōu hǎo , xiān wèn zuó wǎn de lù xiàng zài nǎ lǐ . wǒ zhǎo dào wén jiàn , bǎ dì xìn hé zuì hòu yī shǒu gē nà liǎng duàn fā guò qù . hòu lái yǒu rén wèn xià yī cì shén me shí hou , wǒ shuō hái méi dìng , děng dà jiā bǎ gè zì de shí jiān fā lái zài yuē . lín ān tīng wán lù yīn , zhǐ chū zuì hòu yī jù bǐ pái liàn shí màn , wǒ yě fā xiàn chén yǔ zài mén wài nà jù tí xǐng bèi lù jìn qù le . wǒ men gěi chóng fù de gē cí biāo le liǎng chù , bǎ zhè yī bǎn cún hǎo . tā shuō xiān qù shōu xiāng zi , wǎn shang zài tīng , wǒ huí tā hǎo , bié yòu bǎ nà bàn bēi shuǐ wàng zài zhuō shàng .
meaning: The next day Lin An posted that she'd arrived. Her new room had a big window, but she hadn't unpacked; where was last night's video? I sent the letter scene and final song. Asked about another performance, I said we'd wait for everyone's availability. Listening back, Lin An noticed a slower final line; I'd also caught Chen's reminder from outside the door on the recording. We marked two lyric repetitions and saved this version. She'd unpack first and listen again that evening. Fine, I replied—just don't forget another half-cup of water on the table.

gē cí biāo le liǎng chù , bǎ zhè yī bǎn cún hǎo . tā shuō xiān qù shōu xiāng zi , wǎn shang zài tīng , wǒ huí tā hǎo , bié yòu bǎ nà bàn bēi shuǐ wàng zài zhuō shàng .
meaning: I first wrote 'the light is still on,' then placed it after the station scene. Someone heard waiting for the friend to return. Holding my guitar, I said I'd begun with someone leaving while the words stayed in that evening. We each sang a version; mine slowed the last line. Listening back, the lamp felt a little different from when I'd written it. As for next week, my own work schedule wasn't set, and the lyric gave no date. Lin An suggested putting 'leave the next page for our next meeting' near the end. Rain and footsteps first suggested departure; the later line brought back the hope of meeting. But I sang too quickly, joining it to the preceding phrase. My friend heard 'pause for now' and wondered why we were arranging a meeting. I read both lines in full, then sang them separately. He heard it this time, but suggested holding the final syllable a little longer. With Lin An counting four beats, we finally joined in time. As the musician, I watched the two actors from the side. Once Lin An left carrying the letter in her hand, looking ready to open it. After two trials, we put it in the bag and had her look back at the door. She fastened the strap, looked at the other character and left without opening the letter. Had she turned too quickly? I'd seen her hair move but missed her expression. She tried again, pausing longer as she turned. I played two phrases to match her departure; listening outside, Chen reminded us not to switch off the light halfway through. After the performance we crowded round Lin An asking about returns. Holding her cup, she gave tomorrow's plan: a nine o'clock departure, meet at the entrance at 8:30, just bring water. People working needn't rush over. I had work and was relieved; I could still help pack tonight. Rolling up programmes together, she promised to message on arrival. I asked for a photograph of her new room. After 9:30 we shut down the equipment. Others gathered papers and coiled cables while I packed my instrument. Someone asked for one more minute of singing. I pointed to the disconnected cable: we'd have to reconnect, tune and pack again. Looking at the cleared table, he offered to carry chairs instead. At the door I hummed a phrase; Lin An joined the last line, and we laughed. Even the friend who'd wanted more singing hummed along without restarting anything. Carrying the final chair, a staff member asked if we'd manage to get up tomorrow. We moved out of the doorway, still laughing. The next day Lin An posted that she'd arrived. Her new room had a big window, but she hadn't unpacked; where was last night's video? I sent the letter scene and final song. Asked about another performance, I said we'd wait for everyone's availability. Listening back, Lin An noticed a slower final line; I'd also caught Chen's reminder from outside the door on the recording. We marked two lyric repetitions and saved this version. She'd unpack first and listen again that evening. Fine, I replied—just don't forget another half-cup of water on the table.

parts.text: 写这首歌的时候，我先写了灯还亮着，再把它放进车站那场戏后面。排练时有人说灯就是等那个朋友回来，我拿着吉他想了一会儿，说我开始写的是人走了，话还留在那个晚上。他说听起来也像在等，我就请他唱一遍他的版本。轮到我唱，最后一句又慢了一点，两个人把录音听完，都觉得那盏灯和开始写时已经有点不一样。至于下周，我连自己的工作时间还没排好，歌词里也确实没写日期。
后来林安建议把下一页留给下一次见面放到后面，而不是开头。前面的雨声和脚步让人先听见离开，后面的那句才带出再见面的盼望。我喜欢这个顺序，可第一次唱太快，下一页几乎跟上一句粘在一起。朋友听完问，结尾不是说先停一停吗，怎么又约见面？我把两句完整读给他听，再按句子分开唱。他跟着读了一遍，笑着说这次听到了，不过最后那个面还能再留长一点。我试着慢下来，林安在旁边数了四下，两个人终于能接上。

我负责演奏，不演拿信的角色，所以排练时常从旁边看两人。有一次林安忘了把信放进包，直接拿在手上走，画面就像她随时会拆。我们试了两次，最后还是把信收进包，走到门边再回头。包带拉好以后，她看了一眼对方，没有拆信，就转身走。排练完，她问我刚才回头是不是太快。我说只看见头发动了，还没看清表情。她拿起包又走了一遍，回头时多停了一点。我举起吉他，按她走出去的速度再弹两句。陈宇站在门外听，提醒我们别走到一半就把灯关掉。
演出那晚，有人把戏里的离开和林安明早坐车连在一起，围着她问以后还回不回来。她举着水杯，说先别急，明早九点的车，八点半入口见，带水就好。要上班的人不用特意赶去。我第二天有工作，听完松了口气，今晚还可以留下收东西。她把没喝完的水放到桌上，和我一起卷起节目单，说到了以后会发消息，我就请她到时把新房间拍给我们看。
九点半以后，我们把设备关好。读书的人收纸，工作人员卷线，我把乐器装回盒子。有人走过来说再唱一分钟吧，我指着已经拔掉的线，说唱以前还得重新接线、调音，唱完又要收一遍。他看看空下来的桌子，说那算了，帮我把椅子搬过去。我在门口轻轻哼了一句，林安把最后一行接上，大家笑了。刚才还想再唱的人也跟着哼，没有回去开设备。工作人员拿来最后一把椅子，问我们明天是不是还起得来，我们马上把门让开，一边笑一边往外走。
第二天，我在群里看见林安到了的消息，回她新房间看起来怎么样。她说窗很大，东西还没收好，先问昨晚的录像在哪里。我找到文件，把递信和最后一首歌那两段发过去。后来有人问下一次什么时候，我说还没定，等大家把各自的时间发来再约。林安听完录音，指出最后一句比排练时慢，我也发现陈宇在门外那句提醒被录进去了。我们给重复的歌词标了两处，把这一版存好。她说先去收箱子，晚上再听，我回她好，别又把那半杯水忘在桌上。

信没拆，那里面一定让她别走？

再唱一分钟，收尾时间就只多一分钟吧？
pinyin: zài chàng yī fēn zhōng , shōu wěi shí jiān jiù zhǐ duō yī fēn zhōng ba ?

你答应到了留言，这也是歌词猜想？

meaning: Three. Let’s have coffee together.

meaning: Hey, that’s right!

text: 嗯，这个漂亮。
pinyin: Ńg, zhège piàoliang.

pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ méi bái děng.

pinyin: Zhè tí guò guān.

meaning: The old sign says nine and the new notice ten; the two are not one time.

text: 谈过不等于答应，群里最后还要等她自己说。
pinyin: tán guò bù děng yú dā ying , qún lǐ zuì hòu hái yào děng tā zì jǐ shuō .
meaning: Discussion is not agreement; the final group-chat line awaits her own answer.

text: 第一段：周六我可以帮忙，但是三点要走。第二段：我们四点才开始搬桌子。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : zhōu liù wǒ kě yǐ bāng máng , dàn shì sān diǎn yào zǒu . dì èr duàn : wǒ men sì diǎn cái kāi shǐ bān zhuō zi .
meaning: Text 1: I can help on Saturday, but I have to leave at three. Text 2: We start moving the tables at four.

text: 我到店了，你慢慢来。先别替我买票，我朋友可能已经买了。等她回复再说。
pinyin: wǒ dào diàn le , nǐ màn màn lái . xiān bié tì wǒ mǎi piào , wǒ péng you kě néng yǐ jīng mǎi le . děng tā huí fù zài shuō .
meaning: I'm at the shop. Take your time. Don't buy my ticket yet; my friend may already have bought it. Wait for her reply.

text: 只有她同意我们才把照片发出去
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu tā tóng yì wǒ men cái bǎ zhào piān fā chū qù
meaning: We only send the photo if she agrees.

text: 虽然雨很大，我们还是按时到了。
pinyin: suī rán yǔ hěn dà , wǒ men hái shi àn shí dào le .
meaning: Although the rain is heavy, we still arrive on time.

text: 她觉得电影不错，但不太喜欢最后一段。朋友问要不要建议看，她说可以，不过先别把最后一段讲出来。
pinyin: tā jué de diàn yǐng bù cuò , dàn bù tài xǐ huān zuì hòu yī duàn . péng you wèn yào bù yào jiàn yì kàn , tā shuō kě yǐ , bù guò xiān bié bǎ zuì hòu yī duàn jiǎng chū lái .
meaning: She likes most of the film, but not the ending. She would recommend it, with no spoilers.

text: 大雨没有让我们取消见面，只是从公园改到咖啡店，时间仍是两点。
pinyin: dà yǔ méi yǒu ràng wǒ men qǔ xiāo jiàn miàn , zhǐ shì cóng gōng yuán gǎi dào kā fēi diàn , shí jiān réng shì liǎng diǎn .
meaning: The heavy rain didn't cancel our meeting. We moved it from the park to a café, still at two.

text: 他原来想报两个班，发现上课时间相同，只报了周三口语班。读书班等下次。
pinyin: tā yuán lái xiǎng bào liǎng gè bān , fā xiàn shàng kè shí jiān xiāng tóng , zhǐ bào le zhōu sān kǒu yǔ bān . dú shū bān děng xià cì .
meaning: He planned to take two classes, but their times clash. This time he enrolled only in Wednesday speaking.

text: 你别误会，我不是不想帮，只是今天六点以后才有空。如果五点就结束，那今天帮不上。
pinyin: nǐ bié wù huì , wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng bāng , zhǐ shì jīn tiān liù diǎn yǐ hòu cái yǒu kōng . rú guǒ wǔ diǎn jiù jié shù , nà jīn tiān bāng bù shàng .
meaning: Don't misunderstand: I want to help, but I'm only free after six. If it ends at five, I can't help today.

text: 只有她同意，我们才发照片。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu tā tóng yì , wǒ men cái fā zhào piān .
meaning: We only share the photo if she agrees.

text: 哪怕
pinyin: nǎ pà
meaning: Even if.

text: 她说这件外套挺好看，就是有点大。服务员建议换小一号，她说先试试，还没决定买。
pinyin: tā shuō zhè jiàn wài tào tǐng hǎo kàn , jiù shì yǒu diǎn dà . fú wù yuán jiàn yì huàn xiǎo yī hào , tā shuō xiān shì shì , hái méi jué dìng mǎi .
meaning: She likes the coat, but it's a little big. She'll try a smaller size before deciding.

text: 这句话是开玩笑，但你没觉得好笑，我就不继续说。不是让你必须跟着笑。
pinyin: zhè jù huà shì kāi wán xiào , dàn nǐ méi jué de hǎo xiào , wǒ jiù bù jì xù shuō . bù shì ràng nǐ bì xū gēn zhe xiào .
meaning: It was a joke, but if you didn't find it funny, I'll stop. You don't have to laugh.

text: 第一段：歌里唱窗户一直开着。第二段：活动通知说九点关闭小房间。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : gē lǐ chàng chuāng hù yì zhí kāi zhe . dì èr duàn : huó dòng tōng zhī shuō jiǔ diǎn guān bì xiǎo fáng jiān .
meaning: Text 1: The song says the window stays open. Text 2: The notice says the room closes at nine.

text: 我问的是这次报名，不是以前有没有学过。她以前学过写作，这次只报口语。
pinyin: wǒ wèn de shì zhè cì bào míng , bù shì yǐ qián yǒu méi yǒu xué guò . tā yǐ qián xué guò xiě zuò , zhè cì zhǐ bào kǒu yǔ .
meaning: I'm asking about this enrolment, not previous study. She studied writing before; this time she enrolled only in speaking.

text: 这本书被她放回了原来的地方
pinyin: zhè běn shū bèi tā fàng huí le yuán lái de dì fāng
meaning: She put the book back in its original place.

text: 我把资料放回原来的地方了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ zī liào fàng huí yuán lái de dì fāng le .
meaning: I returned the materials to their original place.

text: 两个人各点三十五元的饭，另外一杯茶十元，约好三人付相同的钱，一起分全部费用。第三人只喝茶，也同意这样分。
pinyin: liǎng gè rén gè diǎn sān shí wǔ yuán de fàn , lìng wài yī bēi chá shí yuán , yuē hǎo sān rén fù xiāng tóng de qián , yì qǐ fēn quán bù fèi yòng . dì sān rén zhǐ hē chá , yě tóng yì zhè yàng fēn .
meaning: Two meals cost 35 yuan each and a tea costs 10. All three friends agree to split the whole bill equally.

text: 原来九点开门，新通知说九点半。你九点到可能要等，不是说今天不开。
pinyin: yuán lái jiǔ diǎn kāi mén , xīn tōng zhī shuō jiǔ diǎn bàn . nǐ jiǔ diǎn dào kě néng yào děng , bù shì shuō jīn tiān bù kāi .
meaning: It used to open at nine. The new notice says nine thirty. Arriving at nine may mean waiting, not that it's closed all day.

text: 为了赶车，她没有参加第二段讨论。她说第一段很有意思，下次如果时间合适还想来。
pinyin: wèi le gǎn chē , tā méi yǒu cān jiā dì èr duàn tǎo lùn . tā shuō dì yī duàn hěn yǒu yì si , xià cì rú guǒ shí jiān hé shì hái xiǎng lái .
meaning: She misses the second discussion to catch a bus. She liked the first part and might return if the timing works.

text: 不用一口气讲完，你先说最重要的。我想知道为什么改地点，别的细节以后补。
pinyin: bù yòng yì kǒu qì jiǎng wán , nǐ xiān shuō zuì zhòng yào de . wǒ xiǎng zhī dào wèi shén me gǎi dì diǎn , bié de xì jié yǐ hòu bǔ .
meaning: You don't need to tell me everything at once. Start with why the place changed; the other details can wait.

text: 我把结束时间写清楚了
pinyin: wǒ bǎ jié shù shí jiān xiě qīng chǔ le
meaning: I wrote the ending time clearly.

text: 他既会唱歌，又会写歌词。
pinyin: tā jì huì chàng gē , yòu huì xiě gē cí .
meaning: He can both sing and write lyrics.

text: 朋友写我可能周五来，还要看工作能不能提前结束。负责的人把名字放在还没确认的地方，没有算进已答应人数。
pinyin: péng you xiě wǒ kě néng zhōu wǔ lái , hái yào kàn gōng zuò néng bù néng tí qián jié shù . fù zé de rén bǎ míng zi fàng zài hái méi què rèn de dì fāng , méi yǒu suàn jìn yǐ dā ying rén shù .
meaning: A friend may come on Friday if work finishes early. The organiser keeps the name unconfirmed.

text: 我不是说电影不好，我是没看懂姐姐为什么把信留在桌子上。你看到那一段了吗？
pinyin: wǒ bù shì shuō diàn yǐng bù hǎo , wǒ shì méi kàn dǒng jiě jie wèi shén me bǎ xìn liú zài zhuō zi shàng . nǐ kàn dào nà yī duàn le ma ?
meaning: I'm not saying the film is bad. I didn't understand why the sister left the letter on the table. Did you see that part?

text: 第一段：这个房间安静，我喜欢。第二段：这个房间小，二十个人坐不下。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : zhè gè fáng jiān ān jìng , wǒ xǐ huān . dì èr duàn : zhè gè fáng jiān xiǎo , èr shí gè rén zuò bù xià .
meaning: Text 1: I like this quiet room. Text 2: It's too small for twenty people.

text: 给我留水就好，不用先点饭。我路上吃过一点，到了看饿不饿。
pinyin: gěi wǒ liú shuǐ jiù hǎo , bù yòng xiān diǎn fàn . wǒ lù shàng chī guò yī diǎn , dào le kàn è bù è .
meaning: Just save me some water. Don't order food for me yet. I ate a little on the way and will decide when I arrive.

text: 她不是不去只是晚一点到
pinyin: tā bù shì bù qù zhǐ shì wǎn yī diǎn dào
meaning: She is going; she'll just arrive a little later.

text: 我们先确认地点，然后报名。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān què rèn dì diǎn , rán hòu bào míng .
meaning: We confirm the place, then enrol.

text: 她没有说你做错了，只是问这份资料能不能发给大家。回答还要问作者，所以先没有发。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu shuō nǐ zuò cuò le , zhǐ shì wèn zhè fèn zī liào néng bù néng fā gěi dà jiā . huí dá hái yào wèn zuò zhě , suǒ yǐ xiān méi yǒu fā .
meaning: She asks whether the materials can be shared. The answer is that they still need to ask the author, so they haven't sent them.

text: 你刚才说周四还是周五？这里太吵，我没听清楚，不是已经答应两个晚上都来。
pinyin: nǐ gāng cái shuō zhōu sì hái shi zhōu wǔ ? zhè lǐ tài chǎo , wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ , bù shì yǐ jīng dā ying liǎng gè wǎn shang dōu lái .
meaning: Did you say Thursday or Friday? It's too noisy and I didn't catch it. I haven't agreed to come on both evenings.

text: 第一段：周五前回复才保留座位。第二段：她周六上午才回复。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : zhōu wǔ qián huí fù cái bǎo liú zuò wèi . dì èr duàn : tā zhōu liù shàng wǔ cái huí fù .
meaning: Text 1: Reply before Friday to keep the seat. Text 2: She replies on Saturday morning.

text: 今天别从老入口进，新入口在东边，跟原来的停车地方不同。我发照片给你。
pinyin: jīn tiān bié cóng lǎo rù kǒu jìn , xīn rù kǒu zài dōng biān , gēn yuán lái de tíng chē dì fāng bù tóng . wǒ fā zhào piān gěi nǐ .
meaning: Don't use the old entrance today. The new entrance is on the east side, away from the old parking area. I'll send you a photo.

text: 既然你还没收到回答就先确认一下
pinyin: jì rán nǐ hái mò shōu dào huí dá jiù xiān què rèn yī xià
meaning: Since you haven't received a reply, check first.

text: 手机支架正面承受十二公斤没有问题，背面按同样方法测，超过十公斤就不稳。她想放十一公斤的设备，要求两面都稳。
pinyin: shǒu jī zhī jià zhèng miàn chéng shòu shí èr gōng jīn méi yǒu wèn tí , bèi miàn àn tóng yàng fāng fǎ cè , chāo guò shí gōng jīn jiù bù wěn . tā xiǎng fàng shí yī gōng jīn de shè bèi , yāo qiú liǎng miàn dōu wěn .
meaning: The front of the phone stand holds twelve kilograms. The back becomes unstable above ten. An eleven-kilogram device needs both sides stable.

text: 我只是说她那句写得好，不是说整篇都不用改。第二段还是有点重复。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shì shuō tā nà jù xiě de hǎo , bù shì shuō zhěng piān dōu bù yòng gǎi . dì èr duàn hái shi yǒu diǎn chóng fù .
meaning: I said that one sentence was well written, not that the whole article needs no revision. The second paragraph still repeats itself.

text: 第一组说先整理资料再讨论，第二组说可以边整理边讨论。两组都希望周五前做完。
pinyin: dì yī zǔ shuō xiān zhěng lǐ zī liào zài tǎo lùn , dì èr zǔ shuō kě yǐ biān zhěng lǐ biān tǎo lùn . liǎng zǔ dōu xī wàng zhōu wǔ qián zuò wán .
meaning: One group wants to sort the materials before discussing them; the other wants to do both together. Both want to finish before Friday.

text: 周三免费课不用付费，周五正式课一千二百元，书另外买。你别以为听免费课就是已经报名正式课。
pinyin: zhōu sān miǎn fèi kè bù yòng fù fèi , zhōu wǔ zhèng shì kè yī qiān èr bǎi yuán , shū lìng wài mǎi . nǐ bié yǐ wéi tīng miǎn fèi kè jiù shì yǐ jīng bào míng zhèng shì kè .
meaning: Wednesday's trial class is free. Friday's full course costs 1,200 yuan, with books bought separately. Taking the trial doesn't enrol you in the full course.

text: 无论谁先到都先进去坐
pinyin: wú lùn shéi xiān dào dōu xiān jìn qù zuò
meaning: Whoever arrives first should go inside and sit.

text: 公共汽车临时取消，工作的人说十五点十分有替代车。原来十四点的安排不能继续。她给朋友发了新时间。
pinyin: gōng gòng qì chē lín shí qǔ xiāo , gōng zuò de rén shuō shí wǔ diǎn shí fēn yǒu tì dài chē . yuán lái shí sì diǎn de ān pái bù néng jì xù . tā gěi péng you fā le xīn shí jiān .
meaning: The two o'clock bus is cancelled. Staff announce a replacement at 15:10, and she sends her friend the new time.

text: 他不是没做，只是没按我们说的两面分别测试。先把方法说清楚，再重新做。
pinyin: tā bù shì méi zuò , zhǐ shì méi àn wǒ men shuō de liǎng miàn fēn bié cè shì . xiān bǎ fāng fǎ shuō qīng chǔ , zài chóng xīn zuò .
meaning: He did do the work, but didn't test the two sides separately as requested. Let's clarify the method and do it again.

text: 周六生日聚会她不参加，建议周二晚上七点单独吃饭。朋友说周二可以，地点还没定。
pinyin: zhōu liù shēng rì jù huì tā bù cān jiā , jiàn yì zhōu èr wǎn shang qī diǎn dān dú chī fàn . péng you shuō zhōu èr kě yǐ , dì diǎn hái méi dìng .
meaning: She declines Saturday's birthday gathering and suggests dinner at seven on Tuesday. Her friend agrees to the time; the place isn't settled.

text: 她今天想一个人安静坐一会儿，不是跟谁生气。你可以发一句有需要就叫我，不必一直问。
pinyin: tā jīn tiān xiǎng yī gè rén ān jìng zuò yī huìr , bù shì gēn shéi shēng qì . nǐ kě yǐ fā yī jù yǒu xū yào jiù jiào wǒ , bù bì yì zhí wèn .
meaning: She wants to sit quietly alone for a while; she's not angry with anyone. You can say, 'Call me if you need anything,' without continually asking.

text: 如果她没有同意就不要发照片
pinyin: rú guǒ tā méi yǒu tóng yì jiù bú yào fā zhào piān
meaning: If she hasn't agreed, don't send the photo.

text: 她说真早啊，那时朋友比约定晚了二十分钟。后来她明确说是在开玩笑，希望下次早点。
pinyin: tā shuō zhēn zǎo a , nà shí péng you bǐ yuē dìng wǎn le èr shí fēn zhōng . hòu lái tā míng què shuō shì zài kāi wán xiào , xī wàng xià cì zǎo diǎn .
meaning: Her friend is twenty minutes late. She says, 'Really early!' and then says she's joking and hopes they'll come earlier next time.

text: 十八点开始表演，十七点半先确认设备。来帮忙的人按十七点半，不是十八点才到。
pinyin: shí bā diǎn kāi shǐ biǎo yǎn , shí qī diǎn bàn xiān què rèn shè bèi . lái bāng máng de rén àn shí qī diǎn bàn , bù shì shí bā diǎn cái dào .
meaning: The performance begins at six. Equipment checks start at five thirty. Helpers should come for the checks.

text: 第一段：只要天气好就去。第二段：今天下雨，所以没有去。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : zhǐ yào tiān qì hǎo jiù qù . dì èr duàn : jīn tiān xià yǔ , suǒ yǐ méi yǒu qù .
meaning: Text 1: If the weather is good, we'll go. Text 2: Today it rained, so we didn't go.

text: 我喜欢这个建议，不过还要问活动的地方能不能安排，不是现在就宣布下周一定开始。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān zhè gè jiàn yì , bù guò hái yào wèn huó dòng de dì fāng néng bù néng ān pái , bù shì xiàn zài jiù xuān bù xià zhōu yí dìng kāi shǐ .
meaning: I like the suggestion, but we still need to ask whether the venue can arrange it. We can't announce a definite start next week yet.

text: 她把信收进包里了
pinyin: tā bǎ xìn shōu jìn bāo lǐ le
meaning: She put the letter into her bag.

text: 她不仅会唱，也会写。
pinyin: tā bù jǐn huì chàng , yě huì xiě .
meaning: She can sing and also write.

text: 她想学夜间课程，但是下班时间常变。她先问能不能补听，再决定要不要报名。
pinyin: tā xiǎng xué yè jiān kè chéng , dàn shì xià bān shí jiān cháng biàn . tā xiān wèn néng bù néng bǔ tīng , zài jué dìng yào bù yào bào míng .
meaning: She wants an evening course, but her finishing time at work varies. She asks about catching up on missed classes before deciding.

text: 从今天起每天复习十分钟，不是今天一次做七十分钟就算一周每天都做了。
pinyin: cóng jīn tiān qǐ měi tiān fù xí shí fēn zhōng , bù shì jīn tiān yī cì zuò qī shí fēn zhōng jiù suàn yī zhōu měi tiān dōu zuò le .
meaning: Review for ten minutes every day from today. One seventy-minute session doesn't count as reviewing on all seven days.

text: 影片最后一段她把信收进包，没有打开。朋友认为是不敢看，另外一人认为想到了以后看。画面没给理由。
pinyin: yǐng piàn zuì hòu yī duàn tā bǎ xìn shōu jìn bāo , méi yǒu dǎ kāi . péng you rèn wéi shì bù gǎn kàn , lìng wài yī rén rèn wéi xiǎng dào le yǐ hòu kàn . huà miàn méi gěi lǐ yóu .
meaning: In the final scene she puts an unopened letter in her bag. One friend thinks she's afraid to read it; another thinks she's saving it for later. The film doesn't give a reason.

text: 那句你别让我先讲，是朋友笑着说的。他接着说今天想先听，一会儿再补。
pinyin: nà jù nǐ bié ràng wǒ xiān jiǎng , shì péng you xiào zhe shuō de . tā jiē zhe shuō jīn tiān xiǎng xiān tīng , yī huìr zài bǔ .
meaning: The friend smiled and said, 'Don't make me speak first.' He explained that he wanted to listen first and add something later.

text: 我们先确认场地再报名
pinyin: wǒ men xiān què rèn chǎng dì zài bào míng
meaning: We confirm the venue before enrolling.

text: 先把结束时间写清楚，避免大家错过车。
pinyin: xiān bǎ jié shù shí jiān xiě qīng chǔ , bì miǎn dà jiā cuò guò chē .
meaning: Write the ending time clearly to avoid people missing their bus.

text: 她给朋友改时间的消息已发，但没收到回答。为了不让人白跑，她决定打电话确认，不把已发当已同意。
pinyin: tā gěi péng you gǎi shí jiān de xiāo xī yǐ fā , dàn mò shōu dào huí dá . wèi le bù ràng rén bái pǎo , tā jué dìng dǎ diàn huà què rèn , bù bǎ yǐ fā dāng yǐ tóng yì .
meaning: She sent the changed time but hasn't received a reply. To avoid a wasted trip, she phones to check.

text: 别只看到价格低。第一家十八元不含运输，第二家二十三元已经送到门口。我们要比较总费用。
pinyin: bié zhǐ kàn dào jià gé dī . dì yī jiā shí bā yuán bù hán yùn shū , dì èr jiā èr shí sān yuán yǐ jīng sòng dào mén kǒu . wǒ men yào bǐ jiào zǒng fèi yòng .
meaning: Don't look only at the low price. The first shop charges eighteen yuan before transport. The second charges twenty-three including delivery. We need the total cost.

text: 第一段：夜间活动只开一楼。第二段：二楼借书的地方仍然六点下班。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : yè jiān huó dòng zhǐ kāi yī lóu . dì èr duàn : èr lóu jiè shū de dì fāng réng rán liù diǎn xià bān .
meaning: Text 1: The evening event uses only the first floor. Text 2: The upstairs book-lending service still closes at six.

text: 来了？先别急着上台，喝口水。你紧张也没关系，能停一下再继续，不用装得什么都记住。
pinyin: lái le ? xiān bié jí zhe shàng tái , hē kǒu shuǐ . nǐ jǐn zhāng yě méi guān xì , néng tíng yī xià zài jì xù , bù yòng zhuāng de shén me dōu jì zhù .
meaning: You're here? Don't rush onto the stage; have some water. It's okay to be nervous. You can pause and continue without pretending you remember everything.

text: 虽然时间很短我们仍然说清楚了
pinyin: suī rán shí jiān hěn duǎn wǒ men réng rán shuō qīng chǔ le
meaning: Although the time was short, we still explained it clearly.

text: 小说里说他坐了很久，始终没有打开那个门。读者可以想到害怕，也可以想到等人，下一段才说明原因。
pinyin: xiǎo shuō lǐ shuō tā zuò le hěn jiǔ , shǐ zhōng méi yǒu dǎ kāi nà gè mén . dú zhě kě yǐ xiǎng dào hài pà , yě kě yǐ xiǎng dào děng rén , xià yī duàn cái shuō míng yuán yīn .
meaning: The novel says he sat for a long time without opening the door. Fear and waiting are possible readings; the next part explains why.

text: 灯还亮着是歌词，不是活动的地方通知。九点半先收东西，十点关闭，别为了再唱把最后的整理工作全留给别人。
pinyin: dēng hái liàng zhe shì gē cí , bù shì huó dòng de dì fāng tōng zhī . jiǔ diǎn bàn xiān shōu dōng xi , shí diǎn guān bì , bié wèi le zài chàng bǎ zuì hòu de zhěng lǐ gōng zuò quán liú gěi bié ren .
meaning: 'The light is still on' is a lyric, not the venue notice. Pack at nine thirty and close at ten. Don't leave all the closing work to others just to sing more.

text: 她写先试四周，如果效果合适再继续。朋友转发成已经永远开放，她请他改回原来的条件。
pinyin: tā xiě xiān shì sì zhōu , rú guǒ xiào guǒ hé shì zài jì xù . péng you zhuǎn fā chéng yǐ jīng yǒng yuǎn kāi fàng , tā qǐng tā gǎi huí yuán lái de tiáo jiàn .
meaning: She proposed a four-week trial, continuing only if it works. A friend reposted this as 'already open forever,' and she asked for a correction.

text: 你说好是好，不过太远。这是还在考虑，不是已经答应。我先不替你买票。
pinyin: nǐ shuō hǎo shì hǎo , bù guò tài yuǎn . zhè shì hái zài kǎo lǜ , bù shì yǐ jīng dā ying . wǒ xiān bù tì nǐ mǎi piào .
meaning: You said, 'It's good, but too far.' That's still considering, not agreement, so I won't buy your ticket yet.

text: 我不是不想参加只是今天不方便
pinyin: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng cān jiā zhǐ shì jīn tiān bù fāng biàn
meaning: I do want to take part; today just doesn't work.

text: 她既想说话，也想赶上车。
pinyin: tā jì xiǎng shuō huà , yě xiǎng gǎn shàng chē .
meaning: She wants to talk and catch her bus.

text: 唱歌时把一个字唱得更长，是音乐的需要。课上另外听说话读法，老师说唱得像，不表示说话时每个字都准确。
pinyin: chàng gē shí bǎ yī gè zì chàng de gèng cháng , shì yīn yuè de xū yào . kè shàng lìng wài tīng shuō huà dú fǎ , lǎo shī shuō chàng de xiàng , bù biǎo shì shuō huà shí měi gè zì dōu zhǔn què .
meaning: Singing may extend a syllable for the music. Class separately practises spoken pronunciation; sounding like the song doesn't prove every spoken syllable is accurate.

text: 不是每一个笑都表示同意。我是喜欢刚才的开玩笑，周六帮忙这件事还得看时间。
pinyin: bù shì měi yī gè xiào dōu biǎo shì tóng yì . wǒ shì xǐ huān gāng cái de kāi wán xiào , zhōu liù bāng máng zhè jiàn shì hái děi kàn shí jiān .
meaning: Not every laugh means agreement. I liked the joke, but helping on Saturday still depends on my schedule.

text: 第一段：我想星期天见，上午不方便。第二段：她建议星期天下午两点，对方回复可以。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : wǒ xiǎng xīng qī tiān jiàn , shàng wǔ bù fāng biàn . dì èr duàn : tā jiàn yì xīng qī tiān xià wǔ liǎng diǎn , duì fāng huí fù kě yǐ .
meaning: Text 1: I want to meet on Sunday, but the morning doesn't work. Text 2: She suggests two on Sunday afternoon, and the other person agrees.

text: 先让她说完。你要补充可以，但别把她最后一句盖住，否则我们又要问一遍。
pinyin: xiān ràng tā shuō wán . nǐ yào bǔ chōng kě yǐ , dàn bié bǎ tā zuì hòu yī jù gài zhù , fǒu zé wǒ men yòu yào wèn yī biàn .
meaning: Let her finish. You can add something, but don't drown out her final sentence or we'll have to ask again.

text: 先听完整句再判断意思
pinyin: xiān tīng wán zhěng jù zài pàn duàn yì si
meaning: Listen to the whole sentence before judging its meaning.

text: 不是每一个笑都表示同意。
pinyin: bù shì měi yī gè xiào dōu biǎo shì tóng yì .
meaning: Not every laugh means agreement.

text: 通知说可以参加活动的人有二十个，工作的人另外有位置。现场四名工作的人，不算进这二十人。
pinyin: tōng zhī shuō kě yǐ cān jiā huó dòng de rén yǒu èr shí gè , gōng zuò de rén lìng wài yǒu wèi zhì . xiàn chǎng sì míng gōng zuò de rén , bù suàn jìn zhè èr shí rén .
meaning: The notice allows twenty participants, with separate places for staff. Four staff members don't count towards those twenty.

text: 我现在离开，不是以后不来。今天回家太晚不方便，下次时间早一点还愿意参加。
pinyin: wǒ xiàn zài lí kāi , bù shì yǐ hòu bù lái . jīn tiān huí jiā tài wǎn bù fāng biàn , xià cì shí jiān zǎo yī diǎn hái yuàn yì cān jiā .
meaning: Leaving now doesn't mean I won't come again. Getting home late doesn't work today; I'd still join another event at an earlier time.

text: 她把歌词里的雨理解为等待，朋友理解为声音。两人都举了句子，没有说这是当天真实天气。
pinyin: tā bǎ gē cí lǐ de yǔ lǐ jiě wèi děng dài , péng you lǐ jiě wèi shēng yīn . liǎng rén dōu jǔ le jù zi , méi yǒu shuō zhè shì dàng tiān zhēn shí tiān qì .
meaning: She reads the rain in the lyric as waiting; her friend reads it as sound. Both point to lines in the song, without claiming that it describes that day's weather.

text: 歌词下一页留给下次见面，没有写下周哪天。现实里要约，还得看大家时间。
pinyin: gē cí xià yī yè liú gěi xià cì jiàn miàn , méi yǒu xiě xià zhōu nǎ tiān . xiàn shí lǐ yào yuē , hái děi kàn dà jiā shí jiān .
meaning: The lyric leaves the next page for a future meeting, but doesn't name a day next week. Making a real plan still requires checking everyone's time.

text: 这次只是试点还没决定长期继续
pinyin: zhè cì zhǐ shì shì diǎn hái méi jué dìng cháng qī jì xù
meaning: This is only a pilot; long-term continuation hasn't been decided.

text: 负责的人请愿意的人补充，有人只听。活动规则没有要求每个人开口，所以沉默不等于不按要求。
pinyin: fù zé de rén qǐng yuàn yì de rén bǔ chōng , yǒu rén zhǐ tīng . huó dòng guī zé méi yǒu yāo qiú měi gè rén kāi kǒu , suǒ yǐ chén mò bù děng yú bù àn yāo qiú .
meaning: The organiser invites anyone who wants to add something. Some people only listen. The rules don't require everyone to speak.

text: 一共有五页，袋里一二三五都在，楼里找到四。放回第四页就齐了，但那张纸没有以前那么平了。
pinyin: yī gòng yǒu wǔ yè , dài lǐ yī èr sān wǔ dōu zài , lóu lǐ zhǎo dào sì . fàng huí dì sì yè jiù qí le , dàn nà zhāng zhǐ méi yǒu yǐ qián nà me píng le .
meaning: There are five pages. The bag has pages one, two, three and five; page four was found in the corridor. Returning it completes the set, but that page is no longer flat.

text: 第一段：采访称活动方便了下班的人。第二段：通知要求提前报名，没有空位不能直接进。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : cǎi fǎng chēng huó dòng fāng biàn le xià bān de rén . dì èr duàn : tōng zhī yāo qiú tí qián bào míng , méi yǒu kōng wèi bù néng zhí jiē jìn .
meaning: Text 1: An interview says the event helps people after work. Text 2: The notice requires registration, and no direct entry when it's full.

text: 我说很难说，是还不知道，不是在保证不会。先等他们回复，别替我把答案改成一定。
pinyin: wǒ shuō hěn nán shuō , shì hái bù zhī dào , bù shì zài bǎo zhèng bù huì . xiān děng tā men huí fù , bié tì wǒ bǎ dá àn gǎi chéng yí dìng .
meaning: When I say 'hard to say', I mean I don't know yet, not that it definitely won't happen. Wait for their reply; don't turn my answer into certainty.

text: 从记录来看，有十二个人留下。
pinyin: cóng jì lù lái kàn , yǒu shí èr gè rén liú xià .
meaning: According to the record, twelve people stayed.

text: 电影里姐姐看着妹妹的包，后来妹妹把信带走。前面的她看着包指姐姐，不是两个人都看。
pinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ jiě jie kàn zhe mèi mei de bāo , hòu lái mèi mei bǎ xìn dài zǒu . qián miàn de tā kàn zhe bāo zhǐ jiě jie , bù shì liǎng gè rén dōu kàn .
meaning: The older sister watches the younger sister's bag. Later, the younger sister takes the letter away. In 'she watches the bag', 'she' refers to the older sister.

text: 你把她那句后半段再放一遍。我听见不是不好，但后面没听到，先别替她说完整个看法。
pinyin: nǐ bǎ tā nà jù hòu bàn duàn zài fàng yī biàn . wǒ tīng jiàn bù shì bù hǎo , dàn hòu miàn méi tīng dào , xiān bié tì tā shuō wán zhěng gè kàn fǎ .
meaning: Replay the second half of her sentence. I heard 'it's not bad' but missed the rest. Don't give her complete opinion for her.

text: 搬家那天下午，朋友答应两点来，三点才出现。重箱子已经由邻居帮忙搬上楼了。朋友说既然东西都搬好了，他就明天再来。我请他先留下整理书架。搬完箱子不代表我不再需要帮助，更不代表他原来的安排没有影响。
pinyin: bān jiā nà tiān xià wǔ , péng you dā yìng liǎng diǎn lái , sān diǎn cái chū xiàn . zhòng xiāng zi yǐ jīng yóu lín jū bāng máng bān shàng lóu le . péng you shuō jì rán dōng xi dōu bān hǎo le , tā jiù míng tiān zài lái . wǒ qǐng tā xiān liú xià zhěng lǐ shū jià . bān wán xiāng zi bù dài biǎo wǒ bù zài xū yào bāng zhù , gèng bù dài biǎo tā yuán lái de ān pái méi yǒu yǐng xiǎng .
meaning: My friend promised to help me move at two but arrived at three. A neighbour had carried the heavy boxes upstairs. My friend proposed coming tomorrow instead; I asked him to stay and organise the shelves. The completed move didn't erase the need for help or the effect of his lateness.

text: 别急着再答应一个更大的任务。我想先知道上次为什么没联系我，再看看这次怎么安排。我不是不信任你，只是不想又到最后才发现时间冲突。
pinyin: bié jí zhe zài dā yìng yī gè gèng dà de rèn wù . wǒ xiǎng xiān zhī dào shàng cì wèi shén me méi lián xì wǒ , zài kàn kàn zhè cì zěn me ān pái . wǒ bù shì bù xìn rèn nǐ , zhǐ shì bù xiǎng yòu dào zuì hòu cái fā xiàn shí jiān chōng tū .
meaning: Don't rush to promise a bigger task. I first want to know why you didn't contact me last time, then plan this time. I don't want to discover another clash at the last moment.

text: 哪怕只有一句话也早点告诉我
pinyin: nǎ pà zhǐ yǒu yī jù huà yě zǎo diǎn gào sù wǒ
meaning: Even a short message is enough; tell me early.

text: 这样一直猜，不如直接问清楚。
pinyin: zhè yàng yì zhí cāi , bù rú zhí jiē wèn qīng chu .
meaning: Rather than keep guessing, ask directly.

text: 即使
pinyin: jí shǐ
meaning: Even if.

text: 尽管
pinyin: jǐn guǎn
meaning: Although.

text: 毕业后，我们没有每天联络。有时一个月才谈一次，也不总是讨论大事。这次她来出差，我们只吃了一顿晚饭，没有安排旅游。离开的时候她说，下次见面不用等到有什么特别的事。听到这句话，我反而放心了，不必每次都准备一个值得报告的好消息。
pinyin: bì yè hòu , wǒ men méi yǒu měi tiān lián luò . yǒu shí yī gè yuè cái tán yī cì , yě bù zǒng shì tǎo lùn dà shì . zhè cì tā lái chū chāi , wǒ men zhǐ chī le yī dùn wǎn fàn , méi yǒu ān pái lǚ yóu . lí kāi de shí hou tā shuō , xià cì jiàn miàn bù yòng děng dào yǒu shén me tè bié de shì . tīng dào zhè jù huà , wǒ fǎn ér fàng xīn le , bù bì měi cì dōu zhǔn bèi yī gè zhí de bào gào de hǎo xiāo xī .
meaning: After graduating, we sometimes talk only once a month. During her work trip we just had dinner, with no sightseeing. She said we needn't wait for a special occasion next time. I was relieved that every meeting didn't need some good news to report.

text: 我承认那句话说得太快，让你以为已经决定了。实际只是一个建议，还得问另外两个人。你先别替我宣布，我今天晚上确认以后给你消息。
pinyin: wǒ chéng rèn nà jù huà shuō de tài kuài , ràng nǐ yǐ wéi yǐ jīng jué dìng le . shí jì zhǐ shì yī gè jiàn yì , hái děi wèn lìng wài liǎng gè rén . nǐ xiān bié tì wǒ xuān bù , wǒ jīn tiān wǎn shang què rèn yǐ hòu gěi nǐ xiāo xī .
meaning: I admit I spoke too quickly and made it sound decided. It was a suggestion; two other people still need asking. Don't announce it yet. I'll update you tonight.

text: 住在一起的朋友以前常替我决定周末的活动。我有一次说想安静待在家里，他以为我不满意我们的友谊。我们后来谈了一下，发现我希望保留自己的时间，而他只是担心我一个人会无聊。现在他会先问要不要参加，我也会明确回复，不让他一直猜。
pinyin: zhù zài yì qǐ de péng you yǐ qián cháng tì wǒ jué dìng zhōu mò de huó dòng . wǒ yǒu yī cì shuō xiǎng ān jìng dài zài jiā lǐ , tā yǐ wéi wǒ bù mǎn yì wǒ men de yǒu yì . wǒ men hòu lái tán le yī xià , fā xiàn wǒ xī wàng bǎo liú zì jǐ de shí jiān , ér tā zhǐ shì dān xīn wǒ yī gè rén huì wú liáo . xiàn zài tā huì xiān wèn yào bù yào cān jiā , wǒ yě huì míng què huí fù , bù ràng tā yì zhí cāi .
meaning: My roommate used to choose our weekend activities. When I wanted a quiet day at home, he thought I was unhappy with our friendship. We talked: I wanted time for myself; he worried I'd be bored. Now he asks, and I answer clearly.

text: 你可以不喜欢这首歌，没关系。我问你最后一句听到了什么，是想知道那里为什么停了一下，不是让你证明歌手一定唱得最好。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ bù xǐ huān zhè shǒu gē , méi guān xì . wǒ wèn nǐ zuì hòu yī jù tīng dào le shén me , shì xiǎng zhī dào nà lǐ wèi shén me tíng le yī xià , bù shì ràng nǐ zhèng míng gē shǒu yí dìng chàng de zuì hǎo .
meaning: It's okay not to like this song. I'm asking what you heard in the final line to understand the pause, not to prove the singer is the best.

text: 我在车站偶然遇见一位老同学。她说最近换了工作，正在适应新的时间。我差点马上问工资多少，又想起我们已经很久没见。于是先问新工作最喜欢哪一点。她讲了不少，还主动说到了困难。离开的时候我们交换了联系方式，但没有立即约下一次。
pinyin: wǒ zài chē zhàn ǒu rán yù jiàn yī wèi lǎo tóng xué . tā shuō zuì jìn huàn le gōng zuò , zhèng zài shì yìng xīn de shí jiān . wǒ chà diǎn mǎ shàng wèn gōng zī duō shao , yòu xiǎng qǐ wǒ men yǐ jīng hěn jiǔ méi jiàn . yú shì xiān wèn xīn gōng zuò zuì xǐ huān nǎ yī diǎn . tā jiǎng le bù shǎo , hái zhǔ dòng shuō dào le kùn nán . lí kāi de shí hou wǒ men jiāo huàn le lián xì fāng shì , dàn méi yǒu lì jí yuē xià yī cì .
meaning: I ran into an old classmate at the station. She had changed jobs. Instead of immediately asking about pay, I asked what she liked most. She shared both positives and difficulties. We exchanged contact details without setting another meeting.

text: 到了给我一句消息就行，不用一路报告。九点以后我开会，可能不能马上回复。没收到回复也不表示你没到，我会晚点看。
pinyin: dào le gěi wǒ yī jù xiāo xī jiù xíng , bù yòng yī lù bào gào . jiǔ diǎn yǐ hòu wǒ kāi huì , kě néng bù néng mǎ shàng huí fù . méi shōu dào huí fù yě bù biǎo shì nǐ méi dào , wǒ huì wǎn diǎn kàn .
meaning: Send one message on arrival; no need for a report all the way. I'll be in a meeting after nine and may not reply immediately. I'll check later.

text: 朋友送我一本她喜欢的小说。我读了前几段，发现自己暂时读不下去，担心直接说会伤害她。后来她问我读得怎样，我说人物很有意思，但现在更想看短一点的文章。她笑着说自己第一次读也没读完。我才知道，珍惜礼物不等于必须喜欢每一页。
pinyin: péng you sòng wǒ yī běn tā xǐ huān de xiǎo shuō . wǒ dú le qián jǐ duàn , fā xiàn zì jǐ zàn shí dú bù xià qù , dān xīn zhí jiē shuō huì shāng hài tā . hòu lái tā wèn wǒ dú de zěn yàng , wǒ shuō rén wù hěn yǒu yì si , dàn xiàn zài gèng xiǎng kàn duǎn yī diǎn de wén zhāng . tā xiào zhe shuō zì jǐ dì yī cì dú yě méi dú wán . wǒ cái zhī dào , zhēn xī lǐ wù bù děng yú bì xū xǐ huān měi yī yè .
meaning: A friend gave me a novel she loved. I struggled after a few chapters and worried about hurting her. I told her the characters interested me but I currently wanted shorter pieces. She laughed that she hadn't finished it on her first attempt either.

text: 我今天想早点回去，但不是要你们也散场。你们继续谈就好。我明天很早出门，下次不用这么早的时候再留下。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí qù , dàn bù shì yào nǐ men yě sàn chǎng . nǐ men jì xù tán jiù hǎo . wǒ míng tiān hěn zǎo chū mén , xià cì bù yòng zhè me zǎo de shí hou zài liú xià .
meaning: I want to go home early, but you don't all need to leave. Keep talking. I leave early tomorrow; I'll stay next time when I don't need such an early start.

text: 不是每一次沉默都表示反对
pinyin: bù shì měi yī cì chén mò dōu biǎo shì fǎn duì
meaning: Not every silence means opposition.

text: 只有确认了时间，我才答应参加。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu què rèn le shí jiān , wǒ cái dā yìng cān jiā .
meaning: I only agree to attend after confirming the time.

text: 聚会结束后，有人建议大家把照片发到网上。我愿意分享我们一起做饭的照片，但不想公开家里的地址。朋友先让我选照片，后来还把纸上的地址挡住了。最后发出的两张照片都经过确认。那天我感觉自己的意见被认真听取了，而不是被看成麻烦。
pinyin: jù huì jié shù hòu , yǒu rén jiàn yì dà jiā bǎ zhào piān fā dào wǎng shàng . wǒ yuàn yì fēn xiǎng wǒ men yì qǐ zuò fàn de zhào piān , dàn bù xiǎng gōng kāi jiā lǐ de dì zhǐ . péng you xiān ràng wǒ xuǎn zhào piān , hòu lái hái bǎ zhǐ shàng de dì zhǐ dǎng zhù le . zuì hòu fā chū de liǎng zhāng zhào piān dōu jīng guò què rèn . nà tiān wǒ gǎn jué zì jǐ de yì jiàn bèi rèn zhēn tīng qǔ le , ér bù shì bèi kàn chéng má fán .
meaning: After the gathering, I agreed to share cooking photos but not my home address. My friend let me choose and covered the address on a paper. We confirmed the two photos before posting. I felt my view had been heard.

text: 不是你选的饭店不好，是那里离我下班的地方太远。周五只有一个小时，我怕大部分时间都在路上。周末去就没有这个问题。
pinyin: bù shì nǐ xuǎn de fàn diàn bù hǎo , shì nà lǐ lí wǒ xià bān de dì fāng tài yuǎn . zhōu wǔ zhǐ yǒu yī gè xiǎo shí , wǒ pà dà bù fèn shí jiān dōu zài lù shàng . zhōu mò qù jiù méi yǒu zhè gè wèn tí .
meaning: The restaurant isn't bad; it's far from work. I only have an hour on Friday and worry about spending it travelling. A weekend visit wouldn't have that problem.

text: 她原来准备给迟到的同事发一条很长的消息，把过去几次失误都列出来。写到一半，她发现自己最需要知道的是这次能不能按时完成。于是把消息改成先问进度，再约十分钟沟通。旧问题仍然存在，但她决定不在一条消息里解决所有矛盾。
pinyin: tā yuán lái zhǔn bèi gěi chí dào de tóng shì fā yī tiáo hěn cháng de xiāo xī , bǎ guò qù jǐ cì shī wù dōu liè chū lái . xiě dào yí bàn , tā fā xiàn zì jǐ zuì xū yào zhī dào de shì zhè cì néng bù néng àn shí wán chéng . yú shì bǎ xiāo xī gǎi chéng xiān wèn jìn dù , zài yuē shí fēn zhōng gōu tōng . jiù wèn tí réng rán cún zài , dàn tā jué dìng bù zài yī tiáo xiāo xī lǐ jiě jué suǒ yǒu máo dùn .
meaning: She began a long message listing a late colleague's past mistakes. Halfway through, she realised she mainly needed the current deadline clarified. She instead asked about progress and arranged ten minutes to talk. Older issues remained, but weren't all handled in one message.

text: 你听到我说可以再看看，别直接记成一定会买。我想先比较一下尺寸和价格。要是另外一家更合适，我还可能换。
pinyin: nǐ tīng dào wǒ shuō kě yǐ zài kàn kàn , bié zhí jiē jì chéng yí dìng huì mǎi . wǒ xiǎng xiān bǐ jiào yī xià chǐ cùn hé jià gé . yào shì lìng wài yī jiā gèng hé shì , wǒ hái kě néng huàn .
meaning: When I say we can look again, don't record that as a definite purchase. I want to compare sizes and prices; I might choose another shop.

text: 我先把时间确认好再答应参加
pinyin: wǒ xiān bǎ shí jiān què rèn hǎo zài dā yìng cān jiā
meaning: I'll confirm the time before agreeing to attend.

text: 他说自己不在乎朋友是否回了消息，过了一会儿却又看手机。我问他是不是担心周末的安排。他承认还不知道对方来不来，所以没法买票。后来他发了一个具体问题，说明今天晚上需要决定。回复来得很快，原来对方以为只是普通交流，不知道要确认时间。
pinyin: tā shuō zì jǐ bù zài hū péng you shì fǒu huí le xiāo xī , guò le yī huìr què yòu kàn shǒu jī . wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì dān xīn zhōu mò de ān pái . tā chéng rèn hái bù zhī dào duì fāng lái bù lái , suǒ yǐ méi fǎ mǎi piào . hòu lái tā fā le yī gè jù tǐ wèn tí , shuō míng jīn tiān wǎn shang xū yào jué dìng . huí fù lái de hěn kuài , yuán lái duì fāng yǐ wéi zhǐ shì pǔ tōng jiāo liú , bù zhī dào yào què rèn shí jiān .
meaning: Li said he didn't care about the reply but kept checking his phone. He admitted he needed confirmation before buying weekend tickets. He then asked a specific question and explained the evening deadline. The friend replied quickly; they hadn't realised confirmation was needed.

text: 先别把她没回消息说成不愿意帮。她今天要照顾家人，昨天已经告诉我们晚上才有空。我们可以先找另外一个办法，不必一直等。
pinyin: xiān bié bǎ tā méi huí xiāo xī shuō chéng bù yuàn yì bāng . tā jīn tiān yào zhào gù jiā rén , zuó tiān yǐ jīng gào sù wǒ men wǎn shang cái yǒu kōng . wǒ men kě yǐ xiān zhǎo lìng wài yī gè bàn fǎ , bù bì yì zhí děng .
meaning: Don't take her silence as unwillingness to help. She's caring for family today and told us she'd be free in the evening. We can find another solution instead of waiting.

text: 我们两个人都喜欢旅行，但准备方法不同。她喜欢先查好每段交通，我更愿意到了再决定。一起出门前，我们只把最后一班车和住的地方确定下来，白天留一些空间。旅行过程中有一次多走了路，也没有谁宣布自己的方法永远正确。后来我们仍愿意再一起旅行。
pinyin: wǒ men liǎng gè rén dōu xǐ huān lǚ xíng , dàn zhǔn bèi fāng fǎ bù tóng . tā xǐ huān xiān chá hǎo měi duàn jiāo tōng , wǒ gèng yuàn yì dào le zài jué dìng . yì qǐ chū mén qián , wǒ men zhǐ bǎ zuì hòu yī bān chē hé zhù de dì fāng què dìng xià lái , bái tiān liú yī xiē kōng jiān . lǚ xíng guò chéng zhōng yǒu yī cì duō zǒu le lù , yě méi yǒu shéi xuān bù zì jǐ de fāng fǎ yǒng yuǎn zhèng què . hòu lái wǒ men réng yuàn yì zài yì qǐ lǚ xíng .
meaning: We both like travelling but plan differently. Before leaving we fixed the last bus and accommodation while leaving daytime flexible. We once walked farther than intended, but neither declared their method always right. We still want to travel together.

text: 我感谢你提醒，不过现在这个办法不适合我。不是说你以后别提建议。我想先把手上的事做完，再讨论要不要换方法。
pinyin: wǒ gǎn xiè nǐ tí xǐng , bù guò xiàn zài zhè gè bàn fǎ bù shì hé wǒ . bù shì shuō nǐ yǐ hòu bié tí jiàn yì . wǒ xiǎng xiān bǎ shǒu shàng de shì zuò wán , zài tǎo lùn yào bù yào huàn fāng fǎ .
meaning: Thanks for the reminder, but this method doesn't suit me now. That doesn't mean you should never offer suggestions. I want to finish the current task before discussing a change.

text: 即使这次不能来也可以以后再见
pinyin: jí shǐ zhè cì bù néng lái yě kě yǐ yǐ hòu zài jiàn
meaning: Even if you can't come this time, we can meet later.
